en.concept: Pattern detection for the op+10 string
en.description: Primarily activates on the literal sequence op+10 across word boundaries, across multiple domains; also responds locally to specific strings such as Delphi, Master Detail Scene, and AMphi, as well as list-style Q: openings in StackExchange.

patterns.name: Decimal floating-point exponent notation
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on the English substring `op` immediately followed by the number `10`, across a word boundary; subsequent characters are not fixed.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; medicine, comedy descriptions, discussions, IRC, code documentation, parliamentary text

patterns.name: Delphi proper noun
patterns.context: The name Delphi is split into two tokens; it appears in programming questions and their code-error or project contexts.

patterns.name: Master Detail terminology
patterns.context: Master Detail Scene appears at the start of a title or phrase, followed by repeated detail scene.

patterns.name: amo/AMphi string
patterns.context: Appears in the abbreviation AMphi for alveolar macrophages; the same passage also contains the word ending macr«ophage» in a medical context.

patterns.name: List-item-style Q&A opening
patterns.context: StackExchange snippets begin with Q: followed by multiline numeric/list-style content; not all snippets that begin with Q: share a common trigger beyond this sequence.

patterns.name: Other sporadic subword fragments
patterns.context: No stable co-occurrence condition was found; activations are distributed across ophthalmology papers, Danish parliamentary text, and other snippets, and the specific trigger cannot be reliably distinguished from the examples.

9_145.concept: 对 op+10 字符串的模式检测
9_145.description: 主要对跨词边界的字面序列 op+10 激活，涉及多领域；另对 Delphi、Master Detail Scene、AMphi 等特定字符串，以及 StackExchange 的 Q: 列表式开头有局部响应。

patterns.name: 十进制浮点指数记号
patterns.context: 激活集中在英文子串 `op` 后紧接数字 `10`，跨越词边界；后续字符并不固定。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；医学、喜剧介绍、讨论、IRC、代码文档、议会文本

patterns.name: Delphi 专名
patterns.context: Delphi 名称被拆成两个 token；出现在编程问题及其代码错误或项目语境中。

patterns.name: Master Detail 术语
patterns.context: 标题或短语开头出现 Master Detail Scene，随后重复 detail scene。
patterns.domain: StackExchange，可能是软件界面/场景术语

patterns.name: amo/AMphi 字符串
patterns.context: 出现在肺泡巨噬细胞缩写 AMphi 中；同段也有医学语境里的词尾 macr«ophage»。

patterns.name: 列表项式问答开头
patterns.context: StackExchange 片段以 Q: 和多行数字/列表式内容开头；并非所有同样以 Q: 开头的片段都有此序列以外的共同触发。

patterns.name: 其他零散词片段
patterns.trigger: «and»、«difficulty»、«op»10 以外的多种散见标记词
patterns.context: 未发现稳定共现条件；激活分布于眼科论文、丹麦语议会文本及其他片段，具体触发无法从例子中可靠区分。

en.description: The most salient and recurring cross-corpus cue is the token fragment op, which occurs in many unrelated words; additional triggers include phi in Delphi and AMphi, as well as a few specialized terms such as Master Detail Scene.

patterns.name: Delphi and legacy Pascal identifiers
patterns.context: In Delphi/programming contexts, the name Delphi is split into tokens; segment 5 also contains an error message and a Delphi 7 version number.

patterns.name: In-word fragment containing op
patterns.context: Activation falls on the character fragment op in different complete words: opacification, opéra, mentioned, opcode, Spanish opciones, and Danish oplyse; these do not share a meaning or fixed context.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, Wikipedia, forums, code documentation, multilingual chats, and parliamentary records

patterns.name: phi in the abbreviation AMphi
patterns.context: In a medical context involving Mycobacterium tuberculosis infection and alveolar macrophages, phi is part of the abbreviation AMphi.

patterns.name: Stack and scene phrases
patterns.context: Master Detail Scene/Detail scene appears after Q: at the start of a StackExchange question, possibly as a specialized software or interface term.

9_145.concept: 字母片段 op
9_145.description: 最显著且跨语料重复的线索是 token 片段 op：它出现在多种无关词中；另有 Delphi、AMphi 中的 phi，以及 Master Detail Scene 等少数专门术语触发。

patterns.name: Delphi 与旧式 Pascal 标识符
patterns.trigger: «Del»2«phi»10（段1、5）；段5另有 «Er»3«ro»3« Stack»3« Under»6«flow»3« e»1« Access»4« Viol»2«ation»2
patterns.context: Delphi/编程语境中，Delphi 名称被拆分成 token；段5还出现错误信息及 Delphi 7 版本号。

patterns.name: 包含 op 的词内片段
patterns.trigger: « op»10，分别位于 «op»10«ac»3«ification»4、«op»10«é»2«ra»3、«op»10« mentioned»4、«op»10code、« op»10«c»3«iones»5、« op»10«ly»2
patterns.context: 激活落在不同完整词的 op 字符片段上：opacification、opéra、mentioned、opcode、西班牙语 opciones、丹麦语 oplyse；并非相同词义或固定上下文。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、维基百科、论坛、代码文档、多语种聊天及议会记录

patterns.name: AMphi 缩写中的 phi
patterns.context: 结核分枝杆菌感染与肺泡巨噬细胞的医学语境中，phi 是 AMphi 缩写的一部分。

patterns.name: 堆栈与场景词组
patterns.context: StackExchange 问题开头 Q: 后出现 Master Detail Scene/Detail scene，可能是特定软件或界面术语。

en.description: Activation concentrates at the start of StackExchange titles and in Delphi and column-layout programming text; it also occurs sporadically on the op token, in multilingual text, the AMphi abbreviation, houseboat ads, and disk utility chats, without forming a unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: Opening marker in Q&A posts
patterns.context: At the beginning of StackExchange question text, usually followed by a newline and title; the shared prefix appears in [1][2][3][5][9].

patterns.name: Delphi identifiers
patterns.context: The Delphi programming language name appears in questions about the Delete key, exceptions/access violations, and a question in Portuguese; near [1] there is also «Key» «Down» « ALT» « Key» « St» «uck».

patterns.name: Table column operations
patterns.context: Titles concern updating columns in the same table, or changing Bootstrap from three columns to two while retaining the row; [3] is an application title, Master-Detail Scene, and may be weakly related.

patterns.name: Split token op
patterns.context: This fragment occurs in different languages and word positions: « op»«é»«ra» (opéra), «op»«ciones» (opciones), and « op»«ly» (Danish oplyse). It is not a stable standalone meaning.

patterns.name: Abbreviation AMphi
patterns.context: The abbreviation AM for alveolar macrophages is followed by phi, forming «AM»«phi» in the annotation and corresponding to AMphi; the text also discusses M. tuberculosis infection.

patterns.name: Phone number and houseboat advertisement
patterns.context: Promotes houseboat rentals in the United States and Canada and includes a phone number; no clear semantic connection to the other snippets.

patterns.name: Danish word-initial fragment
patterns.context: The beginning of oplyse (to inform) in a Danish sentence; activation falls on a fragment spanning token boundaries.

patterns.name: Spanish testing utility name
patterns.context: An Ubuntu IRC discussion about recommended disk testing and NTFS repair programs, surrounded by Spanish conversation.

9_145.concept: 异质词元与问答前缀
9_145.description: 激活集中于StackExchange题目开头及Delphi、列布局等编程文本；另散见op词元、多语言文本、AMphi缩写、船屋广告和磁盘工具聊天，未形成统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 问答帖的开头标记
patterns.context: StackExchange 问题文本开头，通常紧接换行和标题；共同的前缀在[1][2][3][5][9]出现。

patterns.name: Delphi 标识符
patterns.context: Delphi 编程语言名称，出现在删除键问题、异常/访问冲突问题及葡萄牙语提问中；[1]附近还有«Key» «Down» « ALT» « Key» « St» «uck»。

patterns.name: 表格列操作
patterns.context: 标题涉及更新同一表的列，或 Bootstrap 从三列改成两列并保留行；[3]则是 Master-Detail Scene 的应用标题，可能是弱关联。

patterns.name: 切分后的词元 op
patterns.context: 该片段在不同语言和词内位置出现：« op»«é»«ra»（opéra）、«op»«ciones»（opciones），以及« op»«ly»（丹麦语 oplyse）。不是稳定的独立词义。

patterns.name: 缩写 AMphi
patterns.context: 肺泡巨噬细胞缩写 AM，后接 phi 构成标注中的«AM»«phi»，对应 AMphi；文中也谈到 M. tuberculosis 感染。

patterns.name: 数字与住宅船广告
patterns.context: 宣传美国和加拿大的船屋租赁，含电话号码；未见与其余片段的明显语义联系。

patterns.name: 丹麦语词首
patterns.context: 丹麦语句子中 oplyse（告知）的词首；激活落在跨词元切分的片段上。

patterns.name: 西班牙语测试工具名
patterns.context: Ubuntu IRC 中讨论推荐的磁盘测试和 NTFS 修复程序，周围是西班牙语对话。

en.description: Primarily activates on terms related to data-table column operations on StackExchange, and also responds to the name Delphi; other isolated patterns include RNA terminology, Spur and Ancaster in entry titles, and number strings, without a unified explanation.

patterns.name: Table column operations
patterns.context: Appears in questions about data tables, asking how to update, reorder, count, or conditionally merge columns.

patterns.name: Delphi name
patterns.context: Appears in titles or question text about Delphi keyboard failures or program errors; activation falls within the name.

patterns.name: RNA biomedical terminology
patterns.context: In an introductory sentence giving the full term and its abbreviation siRNAs in parentheses.

patterns.name: Railway siding-related word
patterns.context: In the entry title “Retrospect Spur,” with activation on a subword fragment of Spur.
patterns.domain: English Wikipedia, geography or railway entries

patterns.name: Place-name fragment
patterns.context: Appears in “Ancaster Old Mill Road Race” and in place names at the beginning of entries.
patterns.domain: English Wikipedia, place-name or event entries

patterns.name: Numbers and units of measure
patterns.context: Number strings appear in math questions about meters and months; the specific trigger is unclear.

patterns.name: Q&A opening marker
patterns.context: Used as the opening marker of a StackExchange question body; it is uncertain whether it is itself a pattern.

9_145.concept: none
9_145.description: 主要对 StackExchange 数据表列操作相关词激活，也响应 Delphi 名称；另见 RNA 术语、条目标题中的 Spur 与 Ancaster、数字串等孤立模式，尚无统一解释。

patterns.name: 表格列操作
patterns.context: 出现于关于数据表的提问中，询问更新、重排、计数或按条件合并列。

patterns.name: Delphi 名称
patterns.context: 出现在 Delphi 键盘故障或程序错误的标题、提问文本中；激活落在名称内部。

patterns.name: RNA 生物医学术语
patterns.context: 术语全称及其括号内缩写 siRNAs 的介绍句中。

patterns.name: 铁路道岔相关词
patterns.context: “Retrospect Spur”条目标题中，激活落在 Spur 一词的分词片段上。
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科，地理或铁路条目

patterns.name: 地名片段
patterns.context: 出现在“Ancaster Old Mill Road Race”及条目开头的地名中。
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科，地名或赛事条目

patterns.name: 数字与度量单位
patterns.context: 数字串出现在询问米数及月份的数学问题中；具体触发依据不明确。

patterns.name: 问答开头标记
patterns.context: 作为 StackExchange 问题正文的开头标记；是否本身构成模式不确定。

en.description: Activation concentrates on local strings in several titles or sentence openings: two snippets contain Slacker/Slack introduced by a newline and the number 1; the rest are scattered across columns, American Dream, Mortgage, and several Pl-initial words or names, without a unified semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Line-initial number and Slacker string
patterns.context: The number “1” appears after a newline, immediately followed by a string beginning with Slack/Slacker; the contexts are a HackerNews title and a tutorial title.

patterns.name: Column update phrase
patterns.context: In a Q&A title, columns follows Update, then the text specifies an operation in the same table.

patterns.name: An American Dream in a proper name
patterns.context: An encyclopedia entry title containing an album name and its parenthetical genre label.

patterns.name: Platinum Mortgage proper name
patterns.context: An organization name in a page or entry title, followed by Description.

patterns.name: Words or names beginning with Pl
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments of words or proper names beginning with Pl; what follows includes place names, names, common words, or title phrases, with no shared syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, medical abstracts, patent backgrounds, etc.

9_145.concept: 局部字符串模式
9_145.description: 激活集中于若干标题或句首中的局部字符串：两段含 Slacker/Slack 并由换行和数字 1 引出；其余分散于 columns、American Dream、Mortgage 及多个 Pl 开头词或名称，未呈现统一语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 行首数字与 Slacker 字符串
patterns.context: 换行后出现数字“1”，紧接着是以 Slack/Slacker 开头的字符串；上下文分别含 HackerNews 标题或教程标题。

patterns.name: 列更新短语
patterns.context: 问答问题标题中，Update 后接 columns，随后说明在 same table 中操作。

patterns.name: 专名中的 An American Dream
patterns.context: 百科条目标题，专辑名及其括号内类型标注。

patterns.name: Platinum Mortgage 专名
patterns.context: 页面或条目标题中的机构名称，后接 Description。

patterns.name: Pl 开头的词或名称
patterns.context: 激活落在 Pl 开头的词或专名片段；后续分别为地名、名称、普通词或标题短语，未见共同句法条件。
patterns.domain: 百科、医学摘要、专利背景等

en.concept: Layout and fields in structured text
en.description: Strong activations often fall on repeated spaces, indentation, and layout boundaries; other patterns include court headers and case fields, table column headings, code configuration/testing/preprocessing directives, and webpage navigation and encyclopedia entry titles. The specific trigger for some corrupted text cannot be determined from its content.

patterns.name: Extensive spaces and layout padding
patterns.context: Space tokens repeatedly activate in monospaced layouts, tables, or aligned court documents; often accompanied by line breaks and aligned fields.
patterns.domain: Tables, court documents, and webpage layouts

patterns.name: Court document header and case fields
patterns.context: Court name, jurisdiction, case number, party names, or locations appear in the title area of court documents, alongside indentation, separator lines, and line breaks.

patterns.name: Table column headings and financial abbreviations
patterns.context: Tab-separated column names form a header resembling market-price or transaction data.

patterns.name: Version and dependency fields in software configuration
patterns.context: A CMake build script declares the minimum version and begins defining a project.

patterns.name: Code testing and header directives
patterns.context: Appears respectively in function calls in test code and preprocessing directives in C/C++ header files.

patterns.name: Home in webpage navigation
patterns.context: In the navigation or page-template area of a court website, not in the judgment text.

patterns.name: Work title and encyclopedia entry opening
patterns.context: A brief introduction describing an album follows an entry title.

patterns.name: Anomalous snippets not fitting the patterns above
patterns.context: The text is severely corrupted or segmented abnormally, with insufficient semantic clues; although embedded in a court document, the triggering fragment itself is difficult to interpret.
patterns.domain: Corrupted text or OCR/encoding noise in legal documents

9_145.concept: 结构化文本的版式与字段
9_145.description: 强激活常落在重复空格、缩进和排版边界；另见法院抬头与案件字段、表格列标题、代码配置/测试/预处理指令，以及网页导航和百科条目标题。部分乱码无法从内容判断具体触发原因。

patterns.name: 大量空格与版式填充
patterns.trigger: 连续的 «                        » 及其他多空格片段
patterns.context: 等宽排版、表格或法院文书的对齐版式中，空格 token 被重复激活；常与换行及字段对齐并存。
patterns.domain: 表格、法院文书及网页排版

patterns.name: 法院文书抬头与案件字段
patterns.trigger: “COURT OF APPEALS”“UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT”“No. 15-15 45”“HOUSTON, TEXAS”等
patterns.context: 法院名称、辖区、案号、当事人姓名或地点出现在法院文件标题区；与缩进、分隔线和换行相伴。

patterns.name: 表格列标题与金融缩写
patterns.context: 列名以制表符分隔，呈现类似市场价格或交易数据的表头。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的金融表格

patterns.name: 软件配置中的版本与依赖字段
patterns.context: CMake 构建脚本中声明最低版本并开始定义项目。

patterns.name: 代码测试与头文件指令
patterns.context: 分别出现在测试代码的函数调用与 C/C++ 头文件的预处理指令中。

patterns.name: 网页导航中的 Home
patterns.context: 法院网站页面的导航或页面模板区域，而非判决正文。

patterns.name: 作品标题与百科条目开头
patterns.context: 条目标题后接简短导语，介绍专辑。

patterns.name: 无法归入上述模式的异常片段
patterns.context: 文本严重乱码或切分异常，缺少足够语义线索；虽嵌在法院文书中，但触发片段本身难以解释。
patterns.domain: 法律文书中的乱码或 OCR／编码噪声

en.concept: Subword fragments and identifiers across domains
en.description: Activations are distributed across biomedical text (polycystic kidney disease, neurology roots, infections, and viral diseases) and several kinds of code identifiers, and also include a mathematical number sequence; no single stable cross-domain trigger feature is apparent.

patterns.name: Polycystic kidney disease terminology
patterns.context: Polycystic kidney disease appears in medical text, including NIH grant descriptions and clinical-feature tables.

patterns.name: Neurologist word stem
patterns.context: The root neurolog is triggered in clinical descriptions of neurologists or neurological disorders.

patterns.name: Mathematical parentheses and number sequences
patterns.context: Parenthesized numbers, punctuation, and multiline number sequences in math problems or derivations; activation concentrates around parentheses and numbers.

patterns.name: Export-window API identifiers
patterns.context: In code documentation or C++ code, involving export windows, rendering support, and related API names.

patterns.name: JavaScript object property traversal
patterns.context: Code that checks an object's own properties and traverses or copies properties in JavaScript.

patterns.name: PHP tests and object pools
patterns.context: PHP test code asserting that submission to an object pool succeeds and that it contains a specified entry.

patterns.name: Medical disease and pathogen phrases
patterns.context: Medical narratives mention tuberculosis infection and alveolar macrophages, or Powassan virus and encephalitis; there is clear activation beyond the neurolog root.

9_145.concept: 多领域词片段与标识符
9_145.description: 激活分布于生物医学文本（多囊肾病、神经科词根、感染与病毒疾病）及多类代码标识符，也包括一段数学数字序列；未见单一稳定的跨领域触发特征。

patterns.name: 多囊肾病术语
patterns.context: 医学文本中出现 polycystic kidney disease，包含 NIH 申请描述和临床特征表格。

patterns.name: 神经科医生词干
patterns.context: 神经科医生或神经系统疾病的临床描述中，触发词根 neurolog。

patterns.name: 数学括号与数字序列
patterns.context: 数学题或推导中的括号数字、标点及换行数字序列；激活集中在括号和数字附近。

patterns.name: 导出窗口 API 标识符
patterns.context: 代码文档或 C++ 代码中，涉及导出窗口、渲染支持及相关 API 名称。

patterns.name: JavaScript 对象属性遍历
patterns.context: JavaScript 中检查对象自有属性并遍历、复制属性的代码。

patterns.name: PHP 测试与对象池
patterns.context: PHP 测试代码中断言对象池提交成功并包含指定条目。

patterns.name: 医学疾病与病原体短语
patterns.trigger: « M»«.» tuberculosis；« alveolar»« macrophages»；« Pow»assan virus；« human» encephalitis
patterns.context: 医学叙述中提及结核感染及肺泡巨噬细胞，或波瓦生病毒与脑炎；除 neurolog 词根外仍有明显激活。

en.description: Activations occur on uppercase or mixed-case proper nouns, identifiers, and titles: error constants, directory and legal section titles, code identifiers, HTML DOCTYPE, and index-access expressions; no single clear semantic meaning unifies the different contexts.

patterns.name: All-caps error codes and identifiers
patterns.context: Code comments distinguish unauthenticated requests from permission denials, representing them with all-caps, underscore-separated constants or status names

patterns.name: Book-catalog-style uppercase titles
patterns.context: Titles are set in uppercase typography, interspersed with token fragments; titles are followed by author names, page numbers, or decorative asterisks
patterns.domain: Catalog or title layout in older books

patterns.name: Special identifiers and type names in code
patterns.context: Code contains camelCase, underscore-style, or mixed-case variables, types, fields, and protocol-related identifiers

patterns.name: Legal document section titles
patterns.context: Opinions organize their arguments with Roman numerals and uppercase section titles, followed by subsections or standard explanations

patterns.name: HTML DOCTYPE public identifier
patterns.context: DOCTYPE declaration at the beginning of an HTML document; the public identifier contains organization, DTD, version, or language information

patterns.name: Consecutive field indexing and short variable names
patterns.context: Code retrieves values from array fields in a table row and assigns the results to short variables; activation is near the object chain and indexing expression

9_145.concept: 大小写显著的专名与标记
9_145.description: 激活见于大写或大小写混杂的专名、标识符和标题：错误常量、目录及法律章节标题、代码标识符、HTML DOCTYPE，以及索引访问表达式；不同场景并无单一明确语义。

patterns.name: 全大写错误码与标识符
patterns.context: 代码注释将未认证请求与权限拒绝区分，并以全大写、下划线分隔的常量或状态名表示

patterns.name: 书籍目录式大写标题
patterns.trigger: «DOWN»« BY»« THE»« SE»«A»、«WH»«Y»« M»«RS»«.»« RAD»«NOR»« FA»«INT»«ED»
patterns.context: 标题以大写排印，夹有分词碎片；标题后带作者名、页码或装饰性星号
patterns.domain: 旧书文本的目录或标题排版

patterns.name: 代码中的特殊标识符与类型名
patterns.context: 代码中出现驼峰式、下划线式或大小写混杂的变量、类型、字段及协议相关标识符

patterns.name: 法律文书章节标题
patterns.context: 判决书以罗马数字及大写章节标题组织论证，后接小节或标准说明

patterns.name: HTML DOCTYPE 公共标识符
patterns.context: HTML 文档开头的 DOCTYPE 声明；公共标识符包含组织名、DTD、版本或语言信息
patterns.domain: HTML 标记 / 网页源码

patterns.name: 连续字段索引与短变量名
patterns.context: 代码从表格行的数组字段取值，并将结果赋给短变量；激活落在对象链及索引表达式附近
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答中的代码

en.description: Primarily responds to uppercase institutions, courts, party names, and litigation roles in legal document title areas, as well as their associated title formatting; it also responds to uppercase subword sequences and citation punctuation. A science book chapter title has a similar form but a different context.

patterns.name: Legal case titles and litigation roles
patterns.context: In the title area of court documents, courts, party names, and litigation roles appear in uppercase or title-style formatting, often interspersed with blank lines, indentation, and line breaks.
patterns.domain: US appellate court opinions and legal documents

patterns.name: Uppercase institutions, departments, and official titles
patterns.context: Government departments, cities, institutions, or job titles in legal documents, usually set in all caps.
patterns.domain: Government institutions and official titles in legal documents

patterns.name: Uppercase proper nouns in case names
patterns.context: Parties, companies, and state names in legal citations or case titles appear in all caps; activation concentrates on proper nouns and adjacent punctuation.

patterns.name: Court layout labels and procedural headings
patterns.context: Case categories, docket numbers, or clerk labels on legal pages, often in a title area separated by blank space.

patterns.name: Split uppercase token sequences
patterns.context: Activation falls on all-caps words or abbreviations composed of multiple subword tokens, rather than only at complete word boundaries; the context may be a title or an in-text citation.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain capitalization and subword tokenization pattern

patterns.name: Chapter title on the composition of water
patterns.context: An all-caps chapter title describing “the composition of water”; an argon chapter title also appears in the same passage.
patterns.domain: Popular science or older scientific book layout

patterns.name: Punctuation and citation format in legal references
patterns.context: Commas, periods, line breaks, and volume or court citation abbreviations appear near case citations; activation is scattered, with no single stable word-meaning trigger.

9_145.concept: 大写标题与专名
9_145.description: 主要响应法律文书标题区的大写机构、法院、当事人姓名和诉讼身份，以及配套的标题排版；也响应大写子词序列和引文标点。另有一段科普书籍章节标题，形式相似但语境不同。

patterns.name: 法律案件标题与诉讼身份
patterns.context: 法院文书标题区中，法院、当事人姓名及诉讼身份以大写或标题式排版出现，常夹有空行、缩进与换行。
patterns.domain: 美国上诉法院判决及法律文书

patterns.name: 大写机构、部门及官方职衔
patterns.context: 出现在法律文书中的政府部门、城市、机构或职务名称，通常采用全大写排印。
patterns.domain: 法律文书中的政府机构与官方称谓

patterns.name: 案件名称的大写专名
patterns.context: 法律引文或案件标题中的当事人、公司及州名以全大写呈现；激活集中在专名及相邻标点。

patterns.name: 法院排版标签与程序性标题
patterns.context: 法律页面中的案件类别、案号或书记官标签，常位于空白分隔的标题区。

patterns.name: 被拆分的大写词元序列
patterns.context: 激活落在由多个子词 token 组成的全大写词或缩写上，而非只在完整词边界；语境可为标题或正文引文。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的大小写与子词分词模式

patterns.name: 水的组成这一章节标题
patterns.context: 书籍章节标题中，描述“水的组成”的全大写标题；同段还出现 argon 章节标题。
patterns.domain: 科普或旧式科学书籍排版

patterns.name: 法律引文中的标点与引证格式
patterns.context: 判例引用附近出现逗号、句点、换行及卷册或法院引证缩写；激活较分散，未见单一稳定词义触发。

en.concept: Declarations and metadata in structured technical text
en.description: Activations are distributed across code declarations (C++ types, members, and parameters, as well as JS variables/imports) and mathematical paper contexts, especially author-address metadata; some of phrases in the paper body also activate weakly.

patterns.name: Types and identifiers in C++/class definitions
patterns.context: Code contexts contain type declarations, class/struct members, or function parameters, often alongside C++ punctuation, qualifiers, and identifiers.
patterns.domain: C++ code in Github and StackExchange

patterns.name: JavaScript variables and module code
patterns.context: Variable declarations, assignments, and module imports in JavaScript, embedded in test scripts or Q&A code snippets.
patterns.domain: Github test scripts, StackExchange programming Q&A

patterns.name: Address metadata in math papers
patterns.context: Author address fields appear after the body of a math paper, containing institution, department, university, city, or country names; activation concentrates on the address field and its formatting.

patterns.name: ModuleList and module construction
patterns.context: C++ deep-learning framework code declares or combines neural network modules; adjacent to general class definitions, but specifically about module containers/base classes.

patterns.name: Prepositional phrases in mathematical exposition
patterns.context: The preposition of appears in technical noun phrases or citations in the body of math papers; activation is weak, and not all paper snippets contain the same collocations.

9_145.concept: 结构化技术文本中的声明与元数据
9_145.description: 激活分布在代码声明（C++ 类型、成员、参数及 JS 变量/导入）和数学论文语境，尤其是论文作者地址元数据；部分论文正文的 of 短语也有弱激活。

patterns.name: C++/类定义中的类型与标识符
patterns.trigger: «inline» void «insert»(«const T» & obj, «GUINT index»);；«struct B : torch::nn::Module {}»；«double mMin»；«MyValidator(double min, double max, QObject *parent)»
patterns.context: 代码上下文中出现类型声明、类/结构体成员或函数参数，常伴随 C++ 标点、限定符和标识符。
patterns.domain: Github 与 StackExchange 中的 C++ 代码

patterns.name: JavaScript 变量与模块代码
patterns.context: JavaScript 代码中的变量声明、赋值及模块导入，嵌在测试脚本或问答代码片段中。
patterns.domain: Github 测试脚本、StackExchange 编程问答

patterns.name: 数学论文中的 address 元数据
patterns.trigger: «address»:；«Faculty of Mathematics, University of Vienna»；«Department of Mathematics, UC Berkeley»；«The Institute of Mathematical Sciences»
patterns.context: 数学论文正文后出现作者地址字段，包含机构、院系、大学、城市或国家名称；触发集中在地址字段及其格式。

patterns.name: ModuleList 与模块构造
patterns.context: C++ 深度学习框架代码中声明或组合神经网络模块；与一般类定义相邻，但内容特指模块容器/基类。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 LibTorch 代码

patterns.name: 数学论述中的介词短语
patterns.trigger: «of» our new formalism；«of» the exterior algebra techniques；«of» any lattice；«of» finitely generated torsion modules；«of» Y. Cheung
patterns.context: 数学论文正文中，介词 of 出现在技术性名词短语或引用中；激活较弱且并非所有论文片段均出现相同搭配。

en.description: Activations often occur in code, especially C/C++ templates, uppercase fragments in identifiers, and names beginning with B/b; test code also appears. Other examples include encyclopedia bibliographies, legal-medical narratives, and biomedical ethics statements, which cannot be grouped under one stable semantic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: C/C++ templates and type conversions
patterns.context: In generic functions or template definitions, template parameter T appears near type traits, type conversions, or string-append code.
patterns.domain: C++ source code on GitHub, spans 3 and 6.

patterns.name: Uppercase fragments in C/C++ identifiers
patterns.context: Code identifiers contain uppercase letters or uppercase macro names, especially across word boundaries, in camelCase names, or in macro-style names; a template context is not required.
patterns.domain: C/C++ code on GitHub, spans 1 and 5; also occurs alongside template code in spans 3 and 6.

patterns.name: B-initial variables or identifiers in code
patterns.context: Code contains variable, type, or constant names beginning with B/b, often with numbers, camelCase, or macro-style uppercase spelling nearby.
patterns.domain: Code snippets on GitHub and StackExchange, spans 4, 5, and 7.

patterns.name: Code structure and delimiters
patterns.context: Functions, variables, structs, or test code in source code, including syntax markers such as parentheses, commas, semicolons, and braces; these markers alone do not explain all activations.
patterns.domain: GitHub and StackExchange code, spans 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, and 9.

patterns.name: English citations and publication information
patterns.context: Citations, sources, or bibliographic records following a historical figure's biography entry.

patterns.name: Legal testimony and medical records
patterns.context: Legal document context describing a person's hospitalization, medical records, and supporting materials.

patterns.name: Academic ethics approval statements
patterns.context: Institutional affiliations and statements about ethics approval, research aims, and procedures for human-subject research in a paper.

patterns.name: Test and encoding benchmark code
patterns.context: Test files or benchmark function names involving encodings such as UTF-8 and UTF-16.

9_145.concept: none
9_145.description: 激活多见于代码，尤以 C/C++ 模板、标识符中的大写片段及 B/b 开头名称为线索；也见于测试代码。另有百科书目、法律医疗叙述和生物医学伦理说明，无法归入同一稳定语义触发模式。

patterns.name: C/C++ 模板与类型转换
patterns.context: 泛型函数或模板定义中，模板参数 T 与类型特征、类型转换或字符串追加代码相邻。
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的 C++ 源码，覆盖段 3、6。

patterns.name: C/C++ 标识符中的大写片段
patterns.context: 代码标识符含大写字母或大写宏名称，特别是跨词边界、驼峰式名称或宏式名称；不要求模板上下文。
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的 C/C++ 代码，覆盖段 1、5；与段 3、6 的模板代码同时出现。

patterns.name: 代码中的 B 开头变量或标识符
patterns.context: 代码中出现以 B/b 开头的变量名、类型名或常量名，周边常有数字、驼峰或宏式大写拼写。
patterns.domain: GitHub、StackExchange 的代码片段，覆盖段 4、5、7。

patterns.name: 代码结构与分隔符
patterns.context: 源代码中的函数、变量、结构体或测试代码，包含括号、逗号、分号、花括号等语法标记；这些标记本身并不能解释全部激活。
patterns.domain: GitHub 与 StackExchange 代码，覆盖段 1、3、4、5、6、7、9。

patterns.name: 英文引文与出版信息
patterns.context: 历史人物传记条目后的引文、来源或书目记录。

patterns.name: 法律证词与医疗记录
patterns.context: 叙述当事人住院、病历与佐证材料的法律文书语境。

patterns.name: 学术伦理审批表述
patterns.context: 论文中的机构隶属信息及人体研究伦理审批、研究目的与程序说明。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学论文，覆盖段 10。

patterns.name: 测试与编码基准代码
patterns.context: 测试文件或基准函数名称，涉及 UTF-8、UTF-16 等编码。
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的测试代码，覆盖段 9。

en.concept: Structured local patterns in specialized text
en.description: The pattern spans code declarations, English prose, publication ethics and affiliations, legal testimony, and pathology results; there is no single semantic theme. More stable local cues are structured expressions, type/entity names, and surrounding punctuation or function words in specialized text.

patterns.name: Types and punctuation in C/C++ code
patterns.context: Near declarations, templates, parameter lists, or struct members in code, often accompanied by type names, underscore identifiers, angle brackets, commas, and semicolons; trigger locations vary across snippets.

patterns.name: English function words and report narration
patterns.context: Function words occur in continuous English prose about governments, people, research, or events; activation may also extend to nearby content words.

patterns.name: Publication ethics and clinical informed consent
patterns.context: After a publisher’s statement, describes obtaining written informed consent before publishing patients’ clinical details or images.

patterns.name: Python C-extension object interface
patterns.context: After discussing Python object lifetimes and NULL checks, gives a C-extension function signature.

patterns.name: Academic affiliation addresses
patterns.context: Institutional, departmental, city, and country addresses in a paper’s closing section or author information.

patterns.name: Legal precedents and cited testimony
patterns.context: After a case citation, recounts witness testimony and claims of damages, locating testimony by page number.

patterns.name: Negative observations in pathology
patterns.context: Reports no other cellular injury or pathological changes in animal or tissue experiments and lists the observation methods.

9_145.concept: 专业文本中的结构化局部模式
9_145.description: 模式横跨代码声明、英语散文、论文伦理与署名、法律证言和病理结果；没有单一语义主题。较稳定的局部线索是专业文本中的结构化表达、类型/实体名及其周围标点或功能词。

patterns.name: C/C++ 代码中的类型与标点
patterns.context: 代码中的声明、模板、参数列表或结构体成员附近，常伴随类型名、下划线标识符、尖括号、逗号和分号；不同代码片段中触发位置并不完全相同。
patterns.domain: Github 上的 C/C++ 代码

patterns.name: 英语功能词与报告叙述
patterns.trigger: 如 « the»、« his»、« and»、« was»、« at»、« in»
patterns.context: 英语连续散文中，功能词出现在政府、人物、研究或事件叙述里；激活点也可能延伸至相邻实词。

patterns.name: 出版伦理与临床知情同意
patterns.context: 出版者声明之后，描述患者临床资料或影像发表前取得书面知情同意。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文出版声明

patterns.name: Python C 扩展对象接口
patterns.context: 讨论 Python 对象生命周期和 NULL 检查后，给出 C 扩展函数签名。

patterns.name: 学术机构地址署名
patterns.context: 论文末尾或作者信息中的机构、院系、城市与国家地址条目。

patterns.name: 法律判例与证言引用
patterns.context: 判例引文之后叙述证人证言、损害主张，并用页码定位证词。

patterns.name: 病理学否定性观察
patterns.context: 动物或组织实验中报告未见其他细胞损伤或病理改变，并列出观察方法。
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学研究摘要

en.description: The strongest triggers center on academic institutions, departments, universities, professors, disciplines, and their locations, especially in paper affiliations and biographies of people’s appointments; there are also responses to lists of occupations, as well as a few statistical reports, political events, biographical narratives, and astronomy terms.

patterns.name: University and department names
patterns.context: In author affiliations, institutional addresses, or biographies, references to universities, departments, professorships, and their institutions; activation often occurs around institution names or titles.
patterns.domain: ArXiv paper affiliations and institutional information, encyclopedia biographies

patterns.name: Disciplines and academic positions
patterns.context: Discipline names, research fields, or academic titles appear in institutional affiliations or descriptions of a person's career.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, biographies, and encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Institution locations and addresses
patterns.context: A city, region, country, or mailing address follows a university or organization; the location itself and address formatting may also contribute to triggering.

patterns.name: Lists of occupations and identities
patterns.context: A person's entry briefly describes them using a list of occupations, identities, or contributions, often adjacent to an institutional appointment or academic title.

patterns.name: Academic paper affiliation formatting
patterns.context: Authors, references, or numbered departmental affiliations in the front matter of papers; includes TeX markup and line-break formatting.

patterns.name: Research reports and polling language
patterns.context: Describes demographic or religious statistics and cites research or surveys as evidence.

patterns.name: Political organizations and event reporting
patterns.context: Describes an event or controversy, as well as statements or roles of people such as organizational leaders or professors.

patterns.name: Biographical event narrative
patterns.context: A chronological account of a person's experiences or events, later mentioning the academic identity of a related person.

patterns.name: Astronomical research terminology
patterns.context: Technical discussion in the body of a paper about a class of celestial objects or populations; appears alongside affiliation information.

9_145.concept: 学术机构与人物任职信息
9_145.description: 最强触发集中于学术机构、院系、大学、教授、学科及其地点，尤其是论文署名和人物任职简介；另对人物职业罗列，以及少数统计报道、政治事件、生平叙述和天文学术语有响应。

patterns.name: 大学及院系机构名称
patterns.context: 在作者署名、单位地址或人物简介中，涉及大学、院系、教授职位及其所属机构；常在机构名称或职位前后激活。
patterns.domain: ArXiv论文署名与单位信息、百科人物简介

patterns.name: 学科与学术职位
patterns.context: 学科名称、研究领域或学术职称出现在机构归属或人物职业介绍中。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、人物传记及百科条目

patterns.name: 机构地点与地址
patterns.trigger: «Geneva, Switzerland»、«New York»、«University of Belgrade»、«University of Warwick»、«Berkeley»
patterns.context: 大学或组织后接城市、地区、国家或邮寄地址；地点本身及地址格式也可能参与触发。
patterns.domain: 论文署名、机构介绍、人物传记

patterns.name: 人物职业与身份罗列
patterns.context: 人物条目中以并列职业、身份或贡献简述人物，常与任职机构或学术头衔相邻。

patterns.name: 学术论文署名格式
patterns.trigger: «author:»、«bibliography:»、作者姓名后的上标编号，以及«Department of»
patterns.context: 论文前置信息中的作者、参考文献或带编号的院系署名；包含 TeX 标记和换行排版。

patterns.name: 研究报告与民调措辞
patterns.context: 叙述人口或宗教相关统计，并以研究或调查来源作为依据。
patterns.domain: 新闻或评论类网络文本

patterns.name: 政治组织及事件报道
patterns.context: 描述活动或争议事件，以及组织负责人、教授等人物的发言或职务。
patterns.domain: 新闻或评论类网络文本

patterns.name: 人物生平事件叙述
patterns.context: 人物经历或事件的时间顺序叙述，后续提及相关人物的学术身份。

patterns.name: 天文学研究术语
patterns.context: 论文正文中对某类天体或对象总体的技术性讨论；与署名信息并列出现。

en.description: Activation commonly occurs in strings of institutions and place names, academic affiliations/citations, and descriptions of people’s positions; it also appears in news-report wording, medical research contexts, theological biographies, and Python import code. Trigger locations often include function words, punctuation, and proper names.

patterns.name: Affiliations or institutional relationships involving organizations, departments, and places
patterns.context: Near names or institutions, departments, universities, cities, and countries appear as organizational or geographic names, often in author affiliations, institutional descriptions, or collaboration statements; activation often falls on prepositions, punctuation, and parts of institution names.
patterns.domain: Academic affiliations, research institution descriptions, and news reports

patterns.name: Academic citations and bibliography formats
patterns.context: Book titles, authors, editors, publication details, citation titles, and page references occur consecutively, often with parentheses, quotation marks, and citation punctuation.

patterns.name: Introductions identifying people’s positions and quotation sources
patterns.context: Near a person’s name, a position, appointment, or institution is given, introducing their views, experience, or a media quote.
patterns.domain: News reports, biographies, and academic profiles

patterns.name: Relational words and reporting language in English coverage
patterns.context: In accounts of reporting or findings, prepositions, articles, conjunctions, and quotation sources appear as frequent function words; triggering is not limited to any one word.

patterns.name: Python import statements
patterns.context: The module-import section at the beginning of a code file, with Python from/import syntax and module or class names.

patterns.name: Theological institutions and academic titles
patterns.context: Seminaries, theological positions, and educational history occur in the same biography; beyond general institutional names, specific theological terms are also present.
patterns.domain: Religious biographies and theological education descriptions

patterns.name: Research projects, samples, and experimental research contexts
patterns.context: Mentions research design, study subjects or cohorts, analytical methods, and clinical or experimental research collaborators.
patterns.domain: Medicine, public health, and biomedical research

patterns.name: Scientific software/model names not clearly fitting other patterns
patterns.context: A specific model name appears alongside code import statements; activation here may be influenced by proper names or code tokens, and this snippet alone does not establish a broader pattern.

9_145.concept: 学术与机构信息文本
9_145.description: 激活常见于机构及地名串、学术署名/引文和人物职务介绍；另见新闻报道措辞、医学研究语境、神学简介与Python导入代码，触发位置常含功能词、标点和专名。

patterns.name: 机构、院系及地名的署名或隶属信息
patterns.trigger: “Department of Astronomy, University of Maryland College Park, College Park, MD, USA”；“Université Paris”“Universität Hamburg”；“Department of Physics, New York University”；“University of Brasília”“University of Mainz”
patterns.context: 姓名或机构附近出现院系、大学、城市、国家等组织与地理名称，常为作者署名、单位介绍或机构合作说明；激活常落在介词、标点和机构名称的一部分上。
patterns.domain: 学术论文署名、研究机构介绍及新闻报道

patterns.name: 学术引文与书目格式
patterns.trigger: “Cambridge: Cambridge University Press, 2008”；“pagination of the standard German Akademie edition of Kant's works”；“‘The Ontological Argument’”
patterns.context: 书名、作者、编者、出版信息、引文标题及页码说明连续出现，且常见括号、引号和引文标点。
patterns.domain: 哲学论文与学术参考文献

patterns.name: 人物职务与引语来源介绍
patterns.trigger: “Principal Investigator of iPrEx”；“he received his Ph.D. from the University of Athens”；“a spokesman for the Family Foundation, in an interview with the Kernel”
patterns.context: 人物姓名附近交代职务、任职或所属机构，并引出其观点、经历或媒体引语。
patterns.domain: 新闻报道、人物简介及学术人物介绍

patterns.name: 英文报道中的关系词与报道措辞
patterns.trigger: “according to a recent study by the Pew Research Center”；“said religion played a very important part of their lives”；“in an interview with”
patterns.context: 报道或调查结果的叙述中，介词、冠词、连接成分及引述来源等高频功能词连续出现；具体触发并不只限于某一个词。

patterns.name: Python 导入语句
patterns.trigger: “from tenpy.models.tf_ising import TFIMModel, TFIChain”；“from test_model import check_general_model”；“import”
patterns.context: 代码文件开头的模块导入区，出现 Python 的 from/import 语法及模块、类名。

patterns.name: 神学机构与教职称谓
patterns.trigger: “Yale Divinity School”；“Professor of Dogmatic Theology at the Holy Cross Theological School”
patterns.context: 神学院、神学教职与教育经历在同一人物简介中出现；除一般机构名称外，还包含特定神学领域词语。
patterns.domain: 宗教人物传记与神学教育介绍

patterns.name: 研究项目、样本与实验研究语境
patterns.trigger: “proof-of-concept study of PrEP in gay men”；“dioxin analysis was obtained from a cohort of 110 individuals in 1992”；“In vitro”
patterns.context: 提及研究设计、研究对象或队列、分析方法及临床或实验研究合作方。
patterns.domain: 医学、公共卫生与生物医学研究

patterns.name: 未明显归入其他模式的科学软件/模型命名
patterns.context: 具体模型名与代码导入语句共同出现；此处激活可能受专名或代码 token 影响，不能仅凭该段确定更广泛模式。

en.concept: Local features of formatting and function words
en.description: Activations are scattered across several text structures: punctuation in academic author addresses, news attribution, encyclopedia navigation, medical records, and the definite article across multiple domains; case also activates in legal text. No single stable semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Punctuation in institutional addresses
patterns.context: Institutional or address information, especially author addresses in mathematics, physics, and other academic texts; highlights concentrate on punctuation such as commas near institution names, and sometimes also involve adjacent «the»

patterns.name: News attribution in quotations
patterns.context: News reports quote sources or identify media outlets; «The» appears before the name of the news source

patterns.name: Definite article and noun phrases
patterns.context: The article appears in different noun phrases; span 1 also includes book titles/collection descriptions, while span 2 includes legal statements, making it difficult to infer more specific conditions from these examples alone
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic, legal, news, and academic texts

patterns.name: References and external-link sections
patterns.context: Navigation or references section at the end of an encyclopedia entry

patterns.name: Case records and patient-related terms
patterns.context: Describes collecting surgical characteristics and patient medical-record data

patterns.name: No discernible local trigger
patterns.context: Appears in «case summary» in a legal judgment; there are no obvious common conditions with the prominent trigger patterns in other spans

9_145.concept: 格式与功能词局部特征
9_145.description: 激活分散于多种文本结构：学术作者地址中的标点、报道归属、百科导航、医学病历，以及多个领域中的定冠词；另在法律文本的case处激活。未见单一稳定语义触发。

patterns.name: 机构地址中的标点
patterns.context: 机构或地址信息中，尤其是数学、物理等学术文本的作者地址；高亮集中在机构名附近的逗号等标点，且有时也涉及相邻的«the»

patterns.name: 引文中的报道归属
patterns.context: 新闻报道引述消息来源或注明媒体出处；«The»位于报道来源名称之前

patterns.name: 定冠词及名词短语
patterns.context: 冠词出现在不同名词短语中；第1段还包括书名/馆藏描述，第2段包括法律陈述，单凭这些例子难以确定更具体的条件
patterns.domain: 百科、法律、新闻及学术文本

patterns.name: 参考文献与外链栏目
patterns.context: 百科条目末尾的导航或参考资料栏目

patterns.name: 病例记录及患者相关词语
patterns.context: 描述收集手术特征和患者病历数据

patterns.name: 未见可归纳的局部触发
patterns.context: 出现在法律判决的«case summary»中；与其他段落的突出触发模式没有明显共同条件

en.description: Responses commonly occur on noun phrases and institution or publication names in formal text, especially “the + institution/publication” and academic biographies; the pattern also covers connecting structures in research-method lists, legal-document lists, media source attributions, and career lists.

patterns.name: Publication issue citations
patterns.context: A journal or publication name appears with month, date, or issue information; activation concentrates on the article the and nearby words.
patterns.domain: Academic papers and mathematical society publication descriptions

patterns.name: Institutional article constructions in academic profiles
patterns.context: In biographies or CVs, a position, discipline, or identity is followed by at the/of the and an institution, university, or school; high response falls on the, with some response on at/of or the discipline term.

patterns.name: Research methods and results statements
patterns.context: A research abstract introduces compound structures and their analytical or spectroscopic validation; commas and method names also respond.

patterns.name: Enumerative punctuation in legal review documents
patterns.context: A judicial opinion lists legal documents reviewed; commas and connecting elements such as possessives and and show responses.

patterns.name: Attribution to news sources
patterns.context: After a news item, reported and a newspaper name appear, resembling attribution to a media source.
patterns.domain: News reports or syndicated news text

patterns.name: Career lists in biographical timelines
patterns.context: People are listed by date, with multiple occupations joined by commas and and; activation is weak and scattered.

9_145.concept: 正式文本中的名词短语连接
9_145.description: 响应常见于正式文本中的名词短语与机构、刊物名称，尤其“the + 机构/出版物”及学术人物履历；另覆盖科研方法列举、法律文书列举、媒体来源引述和职业清单中的连接结构。

patterns.name: 学术出版物的刊期引文
patterns.trigger: « the»10« July»1« 28»2« issue»5« of»7« the»10« journal»4« Proceedings»2« of»2« the»2« National»3 Academy of Sciences；« in»2« the»4 march '08« issue»3« of»8« the»10« Notices»4
patterns.context: 出现期刊或出版物名称前，伴随月份、日期、issue 等刊期信息；激活集中在冠词 the 及其邻近词。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、数学学会刊物介绍

patterns.name: 学术身份中的机构冠词结构
patterns.trigger: « at»10« the»9« monastery；« at»9« the»9 University；« of»3« Philosophy；« at»9« the»9 Holy Cross
patterns.context: 人物简介或履历中，职位、学科或身份后接 at the/of the 机构、大学或学校；高响应落在 the，部分响应落在 at/of 或学科词。
patterns.domain: 百科人物传记、学术履历

patterns.name: 研究方法与结果陈述
patterns.trigger: « structure»1 …« confirmed»3« by»5« elemental»5« analysis»5«,»10« infrared»6« spectroscopy»3
patterns.context: 科研摘要中介绍化合物结构及其分析、光谱验证；逗号与方法名也有响应。

patterns.name: 法律审阅文书中的列举标点
patterns.trigger: « reviewed»3« counsel»1«’»2«s»6« brief»4«,»8« Appellant»3«’»2«s»9« response»6« and»5« the»5
patterns.context: 司法意见中列举审阅的法律文件，逗号及所有格、and 等连接成分带有响应。

patterns.name: 报道来源引述
patterns.context: 新闻事实后接 reported 和报纸名称，类似对媒体来源的引述。
patterns.domain: 新闻报道或新闻转载文本

patterns.name: 人物年表中的职业串列
patterns.trigger: songwriter«,» revue writer«,» playwright«,» journalist« and» theatre critic
patterns.context: 按日期列举人物，并以逗号和 and 串接多个职业；激活较弱且分散。

en.description: Activates mainly near reported or cited sources and publication/institution names in news or academic texts, especially fragments adjacent to articles, prepositions, and proper nouns; sporadic activations also occur around prices, people, and research cohorts, with no unified pattern.

patterns.name: Publication or media names in reporting
patterns.context: In news or article narratives, the preceding text contains reported, according to, or explicit publication information for a periodical; activation often falls on the article and words in the publication name.
patterns.domain: News reporting, encyclopedia biographies, academic news

patterns.name: Academic publication information
patterns.context: When stating research findings or that a study appeared in a journal or issue, strong activation occurs around the journal name or publication information.

patterns.name: Article sequences before institution names
patterns.context: An article or preposition precedes an institution, academic department, or newspaper name, often near a proper noun; activation does not consistently fall on the same part of speech.
patterns.domain: Research institution descriptions, academic addresses, historical biographies

patterns.name: News context in interview quotations
patterns.context: Biographical text mentions a person being interviewed and identifies the media outlet; activation concentrates on the interview phrase and the following publication name.

patterns.name: Sporadic word activations in entity and relation descriptions
patterns.context: These positions occur in contexts involving political identity, product prices, research cohorts, or collaborating institutions; triggers and local structures differ, with no clear shared condition.
patterns.domain: Political biographies, economic reporting, biomedical research

9_145.concept: 来源与机构名称语境
9_145.description: 主要在新闻或学术文本中报道、引用来源及刊物/机构名称附近激活，尤其是冠词、介词与专名相邻的片段；另有价格、人物、研究队列等零散激活，未形成统一规律。

patterns.name: 报道中的刊物或媒体名称
patterns.context: 新闻或文章叙述中，前文出现 reported、according to，或明确引用某刊物的发表信息；激活常落在冠词及刊名词语上。
patterns.domain: 新闻报道、百科传记、学术新闻

patterns.name: 学术论文发表信息
patterns.context: 陈述研究发现或研究发表于某期刊、某一期时，期刊名或出版信息前后出现较强激活。

patterns.name: 机构及其名称中的冠词序列
patterns.trigger: «at»6 «the»6 University of Mainz；«at»9 «the»8 German «cancer»4 Research «center»2；«Department» of «Mathematics»1；«in»5 «The»9 «Morning»2 «Chronicle»1
patterns.context: 机构、学术部门或报刊名称之前出现冠词、介词，且附近有专名；激活并非稳定落在同一词类。
patterns.domain: 科研机构介绍、学术地址、历史传记

patterns.name: 采访引述的新闻语境
patterns.context: 传记文字提到人物接受采访并标明媒体名称；激活集中在采访短语及后续刊名。

patterns.name: 实体与关系描述中的零散词语激活
patterns.context: 这些位置分别处在政治人物身份、商品价格、研究队列或合作机构等语境；触发词及局部结构不一致，未见共同的明确条件。
patterns.domain: 政治传记、经济报道、生物医学科研

en.concept: Sources and institutional information in reporting
en.description: Primarily responds to research findings, interview statements, and their source/institutional attribution in news or academic text; it also covers legal evidence statements and proper names and action words in military reporting, so the pattern is not entirely unified.

patterns.name: Research findings and journal citations
patterns.context: Introduces research, surveys, or their publication details, often including dates, journal names, and institution names; activation is distributed near citations and publication information.

patterns.name: Interview and media-source attribution
patterns.context: Reports people’s statements or experiences and identifies the interviewing media outlet, newspaper, or quoted source.

patterns.name: Academic institutions and researcher information
patterns.context: Research methods or sample descriptions identify collaborating clinical personnel, statisticians, and their institutions.

patterns.name: Legal opinions and medical records
patterns.context: Legal materials cite a doctor’s opinion and hospital records to support statements about a party’s physical condition.

patterns.name: Actions and proper names in military reporting
patterns.context: In reports on airstrikes in Syria, activation concentrates on countries, armed groups, and terms related to military operations.

9_145.concept: 报道中的来源与机构信息
9_145.description: 主要响应新闻或学术文本中研究发现、采访言论及其来源/机构归属；另覆盖法律证据表述和军事报道中的专名与行动词，模式并非完全统一。

patterns.name: 研究成果与期刊引文
patterns.context: 介绍研究、调查或其发表信息，常包含日期、期刊名和机构名；激活分布在引文及出版信息附近

patterns.name: 采访及媒体来源归属
patterns.context: 报道人物言论或经历，并标明采访媒体、报刊或引用来源

patterns.name: 学术机构与研究人员信息
patterns.context: 研究方法或样本说明中交代合作临床人员、统计学家及其机构

patterns.name: 法律意见与病历记录
patterns.context: 法律材料中援引医生意见和住院记录，支持对当事人身体状况的陈述

patterns.name: 军事报道中的行动与专名
patterns.context: 报道叙利亚空袭时，激活集中在国家、武装组织及军事行动相关词语

en.concept: Publication and reporting markers with local technical terms in text
en.description: Activations occur in The within publication names, expressions related to research and publication, and experimental and characterization terms in chemistry abstracts; sporadic patterns also include news sources, military reporting, general function words, and legal formatting markers.

patterns.name: Article before publication names
patterns.context: The in a proper name is activated; some passages also have nearby news or publishing contexts such as publication, reporting, or citation.
patterns.domain: News reporting, academic publishing, historical biographies

patterns.name: Articles in academic paper descriptions
patterns.context: Occurs in descriptions of papers, research, or interviews, often before a noun phrase; not necessarily part of a publication name.
patterns.domain: Academic abstracts, health and science reporting, biographies

patterns.name: News sources and reporting language
patterns.context: Used to introduce a source or act of reporting in coverage of military or public affairs.
patterns.domain: News reporting, news citations in legal materials

patterns.name: Language about publication of papers and research findings
patterns.context: Mentions publication or release of research or articles; contexts also include academic output and records of historical figures' writings.
patterns.domain: Science reporting, academic conferences, historical biographies

patterns.name: Local fragment of a journal name
patterns.context: Occurs in the journal name in “special issue of The Lancet”; this activation specifically falls on a segmented journal-name token.

patterns.name: Chemical experimental materials and characterization vocabulary
patterns.context: Describes extracts, compound structures, and analytical identification methods in organic chemistry or drug research abstracts.

patterns.name: Local activations of English function words
patterns.context: A few common prepositions, articles, or conjunctions are activated in their respective syntactic positions; the provided material does not establish a unified condition.
patterns.domain: News, historical narratives, and general explanatory text

patterns.name: Activations near formatting markers and page numbers
patterns.context: Formatting markers are activated near page breaks or line numbers in legal documents; there is insufficient evidence to determine whether they are related to content-word activations.

patterns.name: Proper nouns and titles in military reporting
patterns.context: Occurs in accounts of Syrian military operations, armed groups, or military sources; ISIL is split into marked tokens.

9_145.concept: 文本中的出版与报道标记及局部专业术语
9_145.description: 激活分布于报刊名中的 The、研究与发表相关表达，以及化学摘要的实验和表征术语；另有新闻来源、军事报道、一般功能词及法律格式标记等零散模式。

patterns.name: 报刊名称前的冠词
patterns.trigger: «The»，后接报刊名称，如“The Sydney Morning Herald”“The Irish Times”“The Wall Street Journal”“The New York Times”“The Lancet”“The Morning Chronicle”
patterns.context: 专名中的 The 被激活；在部分段落中，附近还有发表、报道或引用等新闻/出版语境。
patterns.domain: 新闻报道、学术出版与历史传记

patterns.name: 学术论文描述中的冠词
patterns.context: 出现在论文、研究或访谈的描述中，常位于名词短语前；未必是报刊专名。
patterns.domain: 学术摘要、健康与科学报道、传记

patterns.name: 新闻来源及报道措辞
patterns.context: 报道军事或公共事务时，用于引出消息来源或报道行为。
patterns.domain: 新闻报道、法律材料中的新闻引用

patterns.name: 论文发表及研究成果措辞
patterns.context: 提到研究或文章的发表、刊载；同时有学术成果及历史人物写作记录等不同场景。
patterns.domain: 科学报道、学术会议、历史传记

patterns.name: 期刊名称局部片段
patterns.context: 出现在“special issue of The Lancet”期刊名中；这处激活具体落在拆分后的刊名 token 上。

patterns.name: 化学实验材料与表征词汇
patterns.context: 有机化学或药物研究摘要中，描述提取物、化合物结构及分析鉴定方法。

patterns.name: 英语功能词局部激活
patterns.context: 少量常见介词、冠词或连接词在各自句法位置被激活，难以从所给材料确认统一条件。
patterns.domain: 新闻、历史叙述及一般说明文字

patterns.name: 格式标记与页码附近激活
patterns.context: 法律文书的换页或行号附近出现格式性标记激活；没有足够证据判断它与内容词激活是否相关。

patterns.name: 军事报道专名与称谓
patterns.context: 叙述叙利亚军事行动、武装组织或军方消息时出现；其中 ISIL 被拆分标记。

en.description: Several activations occur in newspaper and journal names and their citations, especially publication lists, dates/issue numbers, and source descriptions; there are also bibliographic citations, historical source references, and instrument-method terms in one chemistry abstract. The commonality is weak, but may relate to proper names and formal documentary language.

patterns.name: Journal and media names
patterns.context: In articles, reviews, or publication citations/lists, the definite article The/the often precedes proper publication names; issue information also occurs.
patterns.domain: News, nutrition, biographies, and publication bibliographies

patterns.name: Newspaper titles in publication lists
patterns.context: Author biographies or work descriptions list newspapers to which the author submitted or contributed articles; newspaper titles are often proper names.

patterns.name: Academic journal and issue citations
patterns.context: When introducing a scholar or research topic, mentions recently published articles, books, or a specific academic journal issue.

patterns.name: Newspaper citations in legal documents
patterns.context: A lawsuit opinion or legal account cites a report published in a newspaper on a particular date.

patterns.name: Bibliographic citations and formats
patterns.context: Authors, editors, place of publication, publisher, year, and title appear consecutively as bibliographic elements.

patterns.name: Historical document titles and newspaper references
patterns.context: The title, volume, date, and letter/newspaper source of a historical document or archival material occur near each other.
patterns.domain: American Revolutionary sources and historical collections

patterns.name: Historical newspaper source names
patterns.context: In accounts of historical people or events, an anonymous letter is said to have appeared in a newspaper, with date/parenthetical information.

patterns.name: Scientific research methods and instrument names
patterns.context: An abstract describes methods used to determine a compound’s structure, listing spectroscopic and diffraction techniques.

9_145.concept: 正式出版物与文献引用
9_145.description: 多段激活出现在报刊、期刊名称及其引述中，尤其是出版物清单、日期/期号和来源说明；另有书目引文、历史文献来源，以及一段化学摘要中的仪器方法术语。共同点较弱，似与专名及正式文献表达有关。

patterns.name: 期刊与媒体名称
patterns.trigger: « the»8 August 26,« 2001»7« issue»6« of»9« the»10« Nutrition»；« The»9« Sydney»5« Morning»2« Herald»；« The»6 Wall« Street»4« Journal»；« The»9« New»6« Yorker»
patterns.context: 在文章、书评或出版物的引述/列举中，期刊、报纸名称前常出现定冠词 The/the；也包括刊期信息。
patterns.domain: 新闻、营养学、人物介绍与出版物书目

patterns.name: 出版物清单中的报刊标题
patterns.trigger: « Time»,« The»6 Wall« Street»4« Journal»,« The»9« Atlantic»,« The»8« New»5« York»5« Times»4«,« The»10« Washington»4« Post»
patterns.context: 作者简介或作品介绍中连续列举作者曾投稿、发表文章的报刊；报刊标题往往由专名组成。

patterns.name: 学术期刊及期号引用
patterns.trigger: « articles»2« and»5 books…« the»6« march '08»…« the»9« Notices»6« of»3« the»6« American»6 Mathematical» Society»
patterns.context: 介绍学者或研究主题时，提及近期发表的文章、书籍或具体学术期刊期号。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的报纸报道引证
patterns.trigger: « The»2 Wall« Street»4« Journal»5« and»9« The»10« New»5« York»6« Times»5« ran»4« articles»
patterns.context: 诉讼意见或法律叙述中，引用特定日期由报纸刊出的报道。

patterns.name: 文献引用与书目格式
patterns.trigger: « (»1«Cambridge»1«:»2« Cambridge»2 University Press, 2008«)»…« '«The»2 Ontological Argument«',»9« in»5
patterns.context: 作者、编辑、出版地、出版社、年份及篇名等书目要素连续出现。

patterns.name: 历史文献标题及报刊引述
patterns.trigger: « Diary»1« of»2« the»3« American»3 Revolution»…« A correspondent»…« the»9« London»6
patterns.context: 历史文献或档案材料的书名、卷次、日期与来信/报刊来源相邻出现。
patterns.domain: 美国革命史料、历史汇编

patterns.name: 历史报刊来源名称
patterns.context: 叙述历史人物或事件时，指出匿名信发表于某一报刊，并附日期/括号信息。

patterns.name: 科学研究方法与仪器名称
patterns.trigger: « high»5«-»3«field»2« NMR»3« spectroscopy»3« and»7« mass»8« spectrometry»3«… X»2-«ray»3 diffraction« study»
patterns.context: 论文摘要中陈述化合物结构的确定方法，列举谱学与衍射技术。

en.description: Activations span publication and citation information: research or reporting followed by journal dates or names, structural characterization and analytical methods in chemistry abstracts, and encyclopedia references, source sections, media lists, and historical publication sources; bibliographic boundary punctuation also stands out.

patterns.name: Reporting/citation metadata for journal articles
patterns.context: After statements of research or news reports, published/reported introduces a publication name, date, or journal information; citation markers cluster around this publication-source metadata.
patterns.domain: News reporting, health and science articles

patterns.name: Structural characterization methods in chemistry papers
patterns.context: In chemistry/drug research, describes compounds or drug structures confirmed by analytical methods; prominent activations fall on structure, analytical techniques, and mass spectrometry terms.

patterns.name: Reference, source, and link section headings
patterns.context: Section headings, source labels, and link labels in encyclopedia entries' concluding or references sections; also includes reference entries immediately following these headings.

patterns.name: Periods in bibliographic entries
patterns.context: In reference formats, periods, colons, and other punctuation separate years, page numbers, publication information, or author-year entries; activation may favor punctuation and entry boundaries.

patterns.name: Citations and periodical sources in historical narratives
patterns.context: Historical narratives note that a letter appeared in a particular newspaper or periodical, with the publication name following a publishing verb.

patterns.name: Lists of media publication credits
patterns.context: Biographical profiles list media organizations for which a person wrote or published work, with organization names separated by commas.

patterns.name: Method terminology in paper results descriptions
patterns.context: Experimental results sentences list instrumental analytical methods; adjacent to the structural characterization pattern, but here prominent triggers also include compound terms within method names and conjunctions in lists.

9_145.concept: 出版物与引文信息
9_145.description: 激活遍及出版与引用信息：研究/报道后接刊物日期或名称，化学摘要中的结构表征和分析方法，以及百科参考文献、来源栏目、媒体名单和历史刊物出处；书目边界标点也突出。

patterns.name: 期刊论文的报告/引文元数据
patterns.trigger: « published»4« in»4« the»8« August»1« 26»1,« 2001»7« issue»6« of»8« the»10« Nutrition»1« journal»4；« reported»5« The»10« Sydney»6« Morning»2« Herald»4；« study»3« published»4« online»2 ...« the»9« Journal»5« ...« National»4 Cancer Institute
patterns.context: 在陈述研究或新闻报道后，以 published/reported 引出刊物名称、日期或期刊信息；引文标记集中在这些出版来源元数据周围。
patterns.domain: 新闻报道、健康与科学文章

patterns.name: 化学论文中的结构表征方法
patterns.trigger: « structures»3 of« all»1« compounds»2；« structure»1 ...« confirmed»4« by»6« elemental»5« analysis»6«,»8« infrared»6« spectroscopy»4 ...« mass»9« spectrometry»3
patterns.context: 化学/药物研究语境中，描述化合物结构或药物结构经分析方法确认；显著激活落在结构、分析技术及质谱相关词上。

patterns.name: 参考文献、来源及链接栏标题
patterns.context: 百科条目末尾或参考资料区的栏目标题、来源标签和链接标签；也包括紧接这些标题的参考文献条目。

patterns.name: 书目条目中的句点标点
patterns.context: 参考文献格式中，年份、页码、出版信息或作者年份条目之间由句点、冒号等标点分隔；激活可能偏向标点及条目边界。
patterns.domain: 历史书目/百科参考文献

patterns.name: 历史叙述中的引文与报刊出处
patterns.trigger: « anonymous»5« letter»2« published»3« in»6« the»9« Journal»4« de»3« Paris»1
patterns.context: 历史叙述指出某信件刊登于特定报纸或刊物，出版动词后接刊名。

patterns.name: 媒体发表经历的列举
patterns.trigger: « has»2 written« for»4 Time«,»5« The»6 Wall« Street»3« Journal»2 ...« The»9« New»5 Republic»3«,»6 Politico
patterns.context: 人物简介中连续列出其为之撰稿或发表作品的媒体机构名称，机构名之间以逗号分隔。
patterns.domain: 人物简介、媒体与新闻业

patterns.name: 论文结果叙述中的方法术语搭配
patterns.trigger: « high»5«-»4«field»2« NMR»3« spectroscopy»2« and»7« mass»9« spectrometry»3
patterns.context: 实验结果句中并列列举仪器分析方法；与结构表征模式相邻，但这里的突出触发还包括方法名称内部的复合词和并列连接。

en.description: The strongest recurring trigger is the article “The” in newspaper or other formal publication names, especially when citing, describing publication history, or identifying a source; it also covers encyclopedia reference/external-link layouts and institutional directory names.

patterns.name: Article before newspaper names
patterns.context: In body text or citation notes, a proper newspaper name begins with The; the neuron responds strongly to The, while subsequent newspaper-name tokens often show weaker activation.
patterns.domain: News reports, biographies, and cited sources

patterns.name: Article before database or institution names
patterns.context: The is followed by the name of an institution, library, or specialized directory; activation extends to some subsequent name tokens.
patterns.domain: References, library directories, and religious biographical sources

patterns.name: The in source attribution and reporting contexts
patterns.context: After a report, a newspaper name identifies the news source, with The followed by the full newspaper name.

patterns.name: Other publication names beginning with The
patterns.context: The publication venue for a review or editorial begins with The; subsequent title tokens also activate, but less strongly than The.

patterns.name: Reference titles and entry formatting
patterns.context: Activation occurs near Wikipedia page navigation headings such as References and External links and their entries; this coexists with triggers on newspaper names.

9_145.concept: 专名引文中的“The”
9_145.description: 最强且反复出现的触发是报刊或其他正式出版物名称中的冠词“The”，尤其在引述、介绍发表经历或标明来源时；还覆盖百科参考文献/外部链接版式及机构目录名称。

patterns.name: 报刊名称前的冠词
patterns.context: 在正文或引用说明中，专有报刊名称以 The 开头，神经元集中响应冠词 The；后续刊名 token 常也有较弱激活。
patterns.domain: 新闻报道、人物传记及引用资料

patterns.name: 资料库或机构名称前的冠词
patterns.context: The 后接机构、图书馆或专业目录名称；激活延伸至名称的部分后续 token。
patterns.domain: 参考资料、图书馆目录及宗教人物资料

patterns.name: 引用来源与报道语境中的 The
patterns.context: 报道内容之后用报刊名称标示消息来源，The 后接完整报纸名称。

patterns.name: 其他 The 开头的刊物名称
patterns.context: 评论或社论的发表载体以 The 开头；后续刊名也有激活，但强度低于 The。

patterns.name: 参考文献标题及条目格式
patterns.context: 百科页面的 References、External links 等导航标题和条目附近出现激活；与报刊名称触发并存。

en.concept: Definite articles in citations and proper names of publications
en.description: Primarily responds to The/the before publication names and words in publication names in citations and publication lists; also occurs in proper names in encyclopedia reference links. Other activations include of in scientific abstracts and a few sporadic layout or title fragments; a plant nutrition webpage passage remains unexplained.

patterns.name: Newspaper, journal, and other publication names
patterns.context: The/the and the following publication-name words; often occurs in citations, lists of an author's works, or news reporting.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia references, news and article citations, publication descriptions

patterns.name: The in proper names
patterns.context: The followed by proper names or noun phrases for institutions, works, or document descriptions, especially in references or link text.

patterns.name: of in descriptions of analytical results
patterns.context: In scientific paper abstracts, of introduces the object or method of analysis; the example concerns characterization of analytical results.

patterns.name: Various marker sequences and layout structures
patterns.context: Activations occur around in-sentence function words, parts of work titles, and chapter/link labels following line breaks, but triggers are unstable and cannot be grouped as a publication-name pattern.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia body text, references, and webpage structure text

9_145.concept: 引文与专名中的定冠词及出版物名
9_145.description: 主要响应引文和出版物清单中刊名前的 The/the 及刊名词语，也见于百科参考链接中的专名；另有科学摘要的 of 和若干零散版面或作品名片段，植物营养网页段无法明确解释。

patterns.name: 报纸、期刊等刊名
patterns.trigger: « the»10« Journal»6« de»5« Paris»3；« The»9« Cardinals»；« The»9« New»6« York»5« Times»4；« The»8« Guardian»5；« The»9« Sydney»6« Morning»
patterns.context: 刊名中的冠词 The/the 及其后的刊名词语；常见于引文、作者发表作品列表或新闻报道。
patterns.domain: 百科参考文献、新闻与文章引述、出版物介绍

patterns.name: 专名中的冠词 The
patterns.trigger: « The»10« National»7« Library»2« of»2« Finland»；« The»5« manuscript»；« The»7« text»
patterns.context: The 后接机构、作品或文献描述等专名/名词短语，尤其处在参考资料或链接文本中。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、参考资料与链接

patterns.name: 分析结果中的 of
patterns.context: 科学论文摘要中，of 引出分析对象或分析方法；本例为分析结果表征。

patterns.name: 多种标记序列与版面结构
patterns.trigger: « last»2« two»1« verses»1« of»2« La»5 Marseilla«ise»1；«↵»与« References»、« External»、« Biography»
patterns.context: 激活出现在句内功能词、作品名组成部分及换行后的章节/链接标签附近，但触发词不稳定，无法归为刊名模式。
patterns.domain: 百科正文、参考文献及网页结构文本

en.description: Activation is scattered across encyclopedia, news, legal, and research texts, often on positions introducing proper names such as “The,” and on information about publications, references, reports, and analytical methods; no single theme covers all examples.

patterns.name: Lists of newspaper, journal, or publication names
patterns.context: In introductions to authors, reviews, articles, or reports, proper names introduce lists of newspapers or publications; some name tokens activate strongly.
patterns.domain: News, biographies, literary criticism, and encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Encyclopedia references and link sections
patterns.context: After the body of an entry come references, external links, or library resources, especially link titles and “The” before them.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia entries and bibliographic/digital collection descriptions

patterns.name: Journal titles and volume/page details in citations
patterns.context: In humanities entries, place of publication, publisher, year, and page numbers are given before moving to references or manuscript links.

patterns.name: Review and reports in legal documents
patterns.context: In legal judgments or litigation documents, discusses whether evidence was disclosed and describes a judge or court reviewing a party’s brief or report.

patterns.name: Chemical analysis methods in research abstracts
patterns.context: An abstract on plant extracts and their compounds describes structural identification using mass spectrometry and nuclear magnetic resonance analysis.

patterns.name: Positions and museum names in biographies
patterns.context: A biography states a historical figure’s curatorial position at a museum and gives the institution’s later name in parentheses.

patterns.name: Works and citations in historical narratives
patterns.context: Encyclopedia accounts of French history, songwriters, or anonymous letters include work titles and newspaper sources.

patterns.name: Appointments and entry navigation in biographies
patterns.context: A religious biography first describes a secret appointment and its formal announcement date, followed by entry navigation links.

patterns.name: Troop size and media attribution in war reporting
patterns.context: Reports on security conditions and troop numbers and duration, identifying a news outlet as the source.

9_145.concept: 专名与资料出处
9_145.description: 激活散见于百科、新闻、法律及科研文本，常落在“The”等引出专名的位置，以及出版物、参考链接、报告和分析方法等信息片段；没有单一主题能覆盖全部实例。

patterns.name: 报刊、期刊或出版物名称列表
patterns.trigger: “The Sydney Morning Herald”“The Sketch”“Time, The Wall Street Journal, The Atlantic”“The New Yorker”“The London Review of Books”“The Nation”等刊物名；常见触发片段为“The”“The New”
patterns.context: 在作者、评论、文章或报道的介绍中，专名引导并列的报刊或出版物名称；名称中的部分词元有强激活。
patterns.domain: 新闻、传记、文学评论及百科条目

patterns.name: 百科条目参考文献与链接区
patterns.trigger: “References”“External links”“Biography at The Cardinals of the Holy Roman Church”“digital copy of the manuscript”“The text”
patterns.context: 条目正文结束后出现参考文献、外部链接或馆藏资料列表，尤其是链接标题及其前后的“The”。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 条目及书目/数字馆藏说明

patterns.name: 书目引文中的刊名与卷页信息
patterns.context: 人文类条目中先给出出版地、出版社、年份和页码，随后转入参考文献或手稿链接。

patterns.name: 司法文书中的审阅及报告
patterns.trigger: “We have carefully reviewed Mr. Fabela’s brief”“report”“toxicology report”“by the State”
patterns.context: 法律判决或诉讼文书中讨论证据是否披露，并描述法官或法院审阅当事人提交的 brief、report。

patterns.name: 科研摘要中的化学分析方法
patterns.trigger: “crude extracts”“isolated compounds”“characterized by analysis of HR-ESI-MS and NMR”
patterns.context: 植物提取物及其化合物的研究摘要，叙述结构鉴定所用的质谱和核磁共振分析。
patterns.domain: 药物化学/天然产物 PubMed 摘要

patterns.name: 人物生平中的职务与博物馆名称
patterns.trigger: “was curator of drawings and prints at the Musée Napoléon”“Musée du Louvre”
patterns.context: 人物简介说明历史人物在博物馆的策展职务，并括注机构后来的名称。

patterns.name: 历史叙述中的作品创作与引文
patterns.trigger: “Masclet, who was friend to Rouget de Lisle, wrote the last two verses of La Marseillaise”；“anonymous letter published in the Journal de Paris”
patterns.context: 关于法国历史、歌曲作者或匿名信的百科叙述，包含作品名称与报刊出处。

patterns.name: 人物任命与条目导航
patterns.trigger: “named as a cardinal in pectore”“nomination was formally published later”以及“References”“External links”
patterns.context: 宗教人物传记先叙述秘密任命及正式公布时间，随后出现条目导航链接。

patterns.name: 战事报道中的驻军规模与媒体归属
patterns.trigger: “a US presence would be required for ‘at least three to five more years’”“reported The Sydney Morning Herald”
patterns.context: 报道安全局势及驻军人数、年限，并以新闻媒体标注消息来源。
patterns.domain: 新闻报道/国际军事新闻

en.concept: Publication and document names and listing formats
en.description: Primarily responds to references, external links, and bibliographic structures in encyclopedia entries, and to media and publication lists in biographical profiles; also responds to multilingual titles, collection descriptions, and media citations. It additionally covers a machine-learning code passage that does not fit a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: References and external links sections
patterns.context: Occurs after the main text, often with line breaks, headings, or link entries; triggers are not necessarily limited to the headings themselves

patterns.name: Publication lists in biographical profiles
patterns.context: Biographical passages list newspapers and journals for which a person wrote, reviewed, or published work

patterns.name: Media names and newspaper citations
patterns.context: Media names appear consecutively in lists, source attributions, or commentary contexts

patterns.name: Phrases within proper names and publication titles
patterns.context: Inside proper names such as Spanish or French titles, newspaper names, and song titles; not a unified semantic category

patterns.name: Bibliography and document cataloging
patterns.context: Author, work, edition, or collection information appears in references, source entries, or manuscript collection descriptions

patterns.name: Machine-learning imports and data loading in programming code
patterns.context: Python code imports scikit-learn tools and reads loan.csv data

patterns.name: Isolated language and formatting cues
patterns.context: Occur respectively in Spanish document titles, theater criticism, and narratives about religious figures; no clear shared trigger condition
patterns.domain: Academic bibliographies, performance reviews, religious biographies

9_145.concept: 出版物与文献名称及列举格式
9_145.description: 主要响应百科条目中的参考文献、外部链接和书目结构，也响应人物简介中列举媒体及出版物；对多语种标题、馆藏说明和媒体引用有反应，另覆盖一段机器学习代码，无法归入同一词义模式。

patterns.name: 参考文献与外部链接区块
patterns.context: 出现在正文之后，常伴随换行、标题或链接条目；触发不一定只限标题本身

patterns.name: 人物简介中的出版物列举
patterns.trigger: « has» written « for»；«published book reviews and essays in publications including»
patterns.context: 人物传记段落中，列举其写作、评论或发表作品的报刊与期刊名称

patterns.name: 媒体名称与报刊引用
patterns.trigger: «The» 后接报刊或出版物名称，如«The» «Atlantic»、«The» «New» «York» «Times»；另有«the» «Journal»
patterns.context: 媒体名在列举、出处或评论语境中连续出现

patterns.name: 专名及出版物标题中的词组
patterns.context: 西班牙语或法语标题、报纸名、歌曲名等专名内部；并非统一语义类别

patterns.name: 书目与文献著录
patterns.context: 参考文献、来源条目或手稿馆藏说明中，出现作者、作品、版本或馆藏信息

patterns.name: 编程代码中的机器学习导入与数据读取
patterns.context: Python 代码中导入 scikit-learn 工具并读取 loan.csv 数据

patterns.name: 孤立的语言与格式线索
patterns.context: 分别出现在西班牙语文献标题、戏剧评论及教会人物叙述中；共同触发条件不明显
patterns.domain: 学术书目、表演评论、宗教人物传记

en.description: Primarily responds to journal and media names, especially U.S. News and World Report; also responds to encyclopedia reference links, list titles, and proper book titles. There are also French historical proper names, chemical analysis abbreviations in papers, and a few inconsistent local activations on common words.

patterns.name: U.S. News & World Report journal name
patterns.context: News and World Report in the journal name, often preceded by U.S. or appearing in ranking or hospital-ranking contexts; activation focuses on the journal-name phrase rather than ordinary news narration.

patterns.name: Lists of book, journal, and media names
patterns.context: Proper names of newspapers, magazines, and book-review publications listed together in biographical or bibliographic passages; commonly formatted as The + name, separated by commas.

patterns.name: Proper names, book titles, and reference-link titles
patterns.context: Proper names in reference or external-link titles, institution names, and work titles; some occur at the end of a passage or in title-like lists.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia references, digital collections, literary criticism

patterns.name: French historical proper names and journal titles
patterns.context: Narratives about French historical figures, the national anthem, or historical documents, with proper names containing French forms.

patterns.name: Chemical analysis method abbreviations
patterns.context: Abbreviations for analytical instruments or methods appearing in natural-products research abstracts when describing structural identification of isolated compounds.

patterns.name: Entry navigation and list labels
patterns.context: Section headings, navigation labels, or category lists on encyclopedia pages, rather than continuous prose.

patterns.name: Local highlights that do not fit the main patterns
patterns.context: Sporadic common words or phrases highlighted in historical narratives, literary criticism, and other contexts, without consistent triggering conditions across passages.

9_145.concept: 刊名与专名/标题识别
9_145.description: 主要响应刊名与媒体名称，尤其是 U.S. News and World Report；也响应百科参考链接、列表标题及专名书名。另有法语历史专名和论文中的化学分析缩写，以及少量无法统一的普通词局部激活。

patterns.name: 《U.S. News & World Report》刊名
patterns.context: 刊名中的 News and World Report，常前接 U.S. 或具体排名、医院排名等语境；激活集中在刊名词组而非普通新闻叙述。

patterns.name: 书刊与媒体名称列表
patterns.trigger: « The»…（刊名或媒体名，如 « The»6« New»…）
patterns.context: 人物简介或书目段落中并列列举报纸、杂志、书评刊物等专名；常见格式为 The + 名称，伴随逗号分隔。
patterns.domain: 百科人物简介、出版物列表

patterns.name: 专名、书名及参考链接标题
patterns.context: 参考文献或外部链接标题、机构名、作品名中的专名；有的位于段落末尾或标题式列表中。
patterns.domain: 百科参考资料、数字馆藏、文学评论

patterns.name: 法语历史专名与刊名
patterns.trigger: « R»2ouget« de»2 Lisle«,»3；« La»6 Marseilla«ise»2；« Journal»4« de»5« Paris»3
patterns.context: 关于法国历史人物、国歌或历史文献的叙述，专名包含法语词形。

patterns.name: 化学分析方法缩写
patterns.context: 天然产物研究摘要中，在说明分离化合物结构鉴定时出现的分析仪器或方法缩写。

patterns.name: 条目导航与列表标签
patterns.context: 百科页面的章节标题、导航标签或分类列表，而非连续正文。

patterns.name: 无法归入主模式的局部高亮
patterns.trigger: « was»3« friend« to»1；« still»1；« full»2« passage»2
patterns.context: 零散普通词或短语在历史叙述、文学评论等上下文中被标亮，缺少跨段一致的触发条件。
patterns.domain: 百科叙述、Gutenberg 文学评论

en.description: Activations are distributed across encyclopedia biographies, references, publication lists, and academic abstracts, involving proper names, bibliographic/institutional titles, dates, and technical terms; there is no single stable lexical or semantic trigger.

patterns.name: References or external links headings
patterns.context: Reference/external link page navigation or section headings occur in passages, often after a line break

patterns.name: Publication names and bibliographic contexts
patterns.context: Mentions journals, newspapers, review publications, or their published content; activation often falls on words within publication names

patterns.name: Institution or collection names
patterns.context: Proper-name phrases refer to organizations, religious groups, or libraries, especially names with a definite article

patterns.name: Numbers and dates
patterns.context: Years or research sample counts are embedded in historical narratives, biographies, or research descriptions; activation does not consistently fall on the numbers themselves

patterns.name: Academic methods and analytical terminology
patterns.context: Describes chemical analysis, research design, data collection, or paper argumentation
