patterns.name: Narratives about people, identity, and family relations
patterns.context: Centered on a person's identity, appointment, family relations, or life events

patterns.name: French proper names or associations with French culture
patterns.context: French place names, songs, or people appear in historical narratives

patterns.name: Corroboration and medical records in legal/medical documents
patterns.context: Legal materials cite a doctor's opinion and hospitalization records as evidence or corroboration

patterns.name: Marriage and religious ceremonies
patterns.context: Describes a marriage anniversary and a blessing ceremony in a church

patterns.name: Chemical substances and plant samples
patterns.context: Reports plant material, solvents, and compound structure identification

patterns.name: Premature birth/birth cohorts and maternal data
patterns.context: Describes placental samples, birth cohorts, gestational age, and maternal questionnaire data

patterns.name: Miners' physical fitness and respiratory condition
patterns.context: Medical opinions on miners' respiratory function and physical activity capacity

patterns.name: Page links or digitized manuscripts
patterns.context: Provides a digital copy of a manuscript and its collection information

patterns.name: Literary criticism and judgments about controversies
patterns.context: Cites a review article and discusses whether a literary question can be resolved

9_145.concept: 文献与专名信息
9_145.description: 激活分散于百科传记、参考资料、刊物名录及学术摘要等，涉及专名、书目/机构标题、年代和专业术语；没有单一稳定的词汇或语义触发点。

patterns.name: 参考文献或外部链接标题
patterns.context: 段落中出现参考文献/外部链接等页面导航或章节标题，常位于换行之后

patterns.name: 出版物名称及其书目语境
patterns.trigger: «Journal» de «Paris»、«_»«Ed»inb. Review»、«The»« New»« Yorker»、«The»« Wall» Street» Journal»
patterns.context: 提及期刊、报纸、评论刊物或其发表内容；激活往往落在刊名中的词

patterns.name: 机构或馆藏名称
patterns.trigger: «The»« Cardinals» of «the»« Holy»« Roman» Church；«The»« National» Library of Finland
patterns.context: 专名短语指向组织、宗教团体或图书馆，尤其是带定冠词的名称

patterns.name: 数字与年代信息
patterns.context: 年份或研究样本数量嵌入历史叙述、传记或研究描述中；激活位置并不稳定地落在数字上

patterns.name: 学术化方法与分析术语
patterns.context: 描述化学分析、研究方案、数据采集或论文论证过程
patterns.domain: 化学与医学研究摘要；学术评论

patterns.name: 人名、身份及亲属关系叙述
patterns.trigger: «He» was named；«Henri»ette Joséphine Béguin, daughter of a naval officer
patterns.context: 以人物身份、任命、家庭关系或人生事件为叙述中心

patterns.name: 法语专名或法国文化关联
patterns.context: 法国地名、歌曲或人物名称出现在历史叙述中

patterns.name: 医学/法律记录中的佐证与病历
patterns.context: 法律材料援引医生意见及住院记录，作为证据或佐证

patterns.name: 婚姻与宗教仪式
patterns.context: 叙述婚姻纪念及教堂中的祝福仪式

patterns.name: 化学物质与植物样本
patterns.context: 报告植物材料、溶剂及化合物结构鉴定

patterns.name: 早产/出生队列与母体数据
patterns.context: 描述胎盘样本、出生队列、孕周及母亲问卷信息

patterns.name: 矿工体能与呼吸状况
patterns.trigger: miner has no impairment from the performance of any level of physical activity
patterns.context: 关于矿工呼吸系统功能及体力活动能力的医学意见

patterns.name: 页面外链或数字化手稿
patterns.context: 提供手稿数字副本及其馆藏信息

patterns.name: 文学作品评论与争议判断
patterns.trigger: «really insoluble»；«full» passage；«article» on Dyce’s «Beaumont and Fletcher»
patterns.context: 引用评论文章并讨论文学问题是否可解

en.description: Activation centers on source and citation information: lists of a person’s works or publications, encyclopedia external links, historical publication details, medical records and research sources, and related articles and discussion links in forums.

patterns.name: Publication lists in biographies
patterns.context: Introductions to an author’s or scholar’s writing and publication history, followed by multiple publication names; also includes lead-ins such as “published book reviews and essays in publications including”.

patterns.name: References and external links at the end of articles
patterns.context: Section headings that appear after the body of a biography, followed by links to external biographies.

patterns.name: Publication and citation sources in historical documents
patterns.context: Historical accounts that identify the newspaper and year in which a letter was published.

patterns.name: Review of medical research case records
patterns.context: Descriptions of research data sources, or use of case records to support opinions in legal or medical materials.

patterns.name: Literature searches and database queries
patterns.context: Research methods or abstracts describing searches through databases, catalogs, or other sources.
patterns.domain: Medical systematic-review abstracts and epidemiological research abstracts

patterns.name: Citations of web links and related discussions
patterns.context: Posts that include links to related webpages or refer to earlier discussions.

9_145.concept: 出处与引用来源
9_145.description: 激活集中在资料出处与引用信息：人物作品或刊物清单、百科外链、历史刊载信息、医学记录与研究检索来源，以及论坛中的相关文章和讨论链接。

patterns.name: 人物传记中的出版物清单
patterns.trigger: «written»、«published»，以及连续列举的刊物名，如«The New Yorker»、«The New York Times»、«The Washington Post»
patterns.context: 介绍作者或学者的写作、发表经历，后接多个出版物名称；也包括“published book reviews and essays in publications including”这样的引出语。

patterns.name: 文章末尾的参考资料与外部链接
patterns.trigger: «References»、«External links»、«Biography at The Cardinals of the Holy Roman Church»
patterns.context: 传记条目正文结束后出现章节标题，随后列出外部传记链接。

patterns.name: 历史文献中的刊物与引文出处
patterns.trigger: «anonymous letter»、«published in the Journal de Paris (1791)»
patterns.context: 叙述历史人物或作品时，交代信件刊载的报纸及年份。

patterns.name: 医学研究中的病例记录审阅
patterns.context: 描述研究数据来源，或法律、医学材料用病历佐证意见。

patterns.name: 文献检索与数据库搜索
patterns.trigger: «Electronic searches of Biological Abstracts»、«A search of telephone directories»
patterns.context: 研究方法或摘要中说明通过数据库、目录等来源进行检索。
patterns.domain: 医学系统综述摘要及流行病学研究摘要

patterns.name: 网页链接及相关讨论的引用
patterns.context: 网络帖子中附上相关网页链接，或指向先前讨论。

en.concept: Common words and formatting fragments in English text
en.description: Activation spans many English genres, including the definite article and common function words, as well as encyclopedia headings, historical and biographical narratives, rankings, medical and chemistry papers, and Python code for reading files; the passages show no stable specialized semantic theme.

patterns.name: The as an article in English
patterns.context: The definite article appears in noun phrases or conventional titles across multiple domains, often alongside activation on nearby common English words.
patterns.domain: English text such as encyclopedias, academic papers, and code documentation

patterns.name: Weak activations on English function words and phrases
patterns.context: Sporadic occurrences in ordinary English syntax or fixed expressions, with no consistent local semantic condition.

patterns.name: Reference and link titles
patterns.context: Section headings and link text at the end of encyclopedia articles, with multiple words in the titles activating.

patterns.name: Narratives about the French national anthem and anonymous letters
patterns.context: Historical narratives mentioning a song’s author, an anonymous letter, and newspaper publication; activation concentrates on words in the subsequent narrative.

patterns.name: Python file-reading code
patterns.context: Scripts calling pandas to read CSV or image files, with code identifiers near file paths.

patterns.name: Medical records and surgical variables
patterns.context: Descriptions of extracting preoperative and intraoperative characteristics and clinical variables from patient records.

patterns.name: Business-school rankings and lists
patterns.context: Ranking sections, ranking categories, and ranking sources in descriptions of universities or business schools.

patterns.name: Phytochemical extraction and mass spectrometry identification
patterns.context: Reports on plant-material extracts and methods for compound structure identification.

patterns.name: Newspaper accusations in political history
patterns.context: Accounts of controversies involving political figures and accusations published in newspapers.

patterns.name: Biomedical data and databases
patterns.context: Descriptions of sample groups, monocyte analyses, and downloading data files from biomedical databases.

patterns.name: Writer biographies and book-review publications
patterns.context: Biographical introductions listing educational background and publications that carried book reviews and articles.

9_145.concept: 英语文本中的常见词与格式片段
9_145.description: 激活分布于多种英语体裁，包含定冠词及常见功能词，也覆盖百科标题、历史与人物叙述、排名、医学和化学论文，以及读取文件的Python代码；各段未呈现稳定的专门语义主题。

patterns.name: 英语中 the 的文章成分
patterns.context: 名词短语或惯用标题中出现定冠词；多个领域均有，常伴随附近普通英语词激活。
patterns.domain: 百科、学术论文、代码说明等英语文本

patterns.name: 英语功能词与短语中的弱激活
patterns.context: 分散出现在普通英语句法或固定表达中；没有一致的局部语义条件。

patterns.name: 参考文献与链接标题
patterns.trigger: «References», «External links», «Biography», «The Cardinals of the Holy Roman Church»
patterns.context: 百科条目末尾的栏目标题及链接文本，标题中的多个词均有激活。

patterns.name: 法国国歌与匿名信叙述
patterns.context: 历史叙述中提及歌曲作者、匿名信及报刊刊载；激活集中于后续叙述词。

patterns.name: Python 文件读取代码
patterns.context: 脚本中调用 pandas 读取 CSV 或图像文件，代码标识符与文件路径邻近。

patterns.name: 病历资料与手术变量
patterns.context: 描述从患者病历提取术前、术中特征及临床变量。

patterns.name: 商学院排名与榜单
patterns.trigger: «Rankings», «MBA Full-time Program Rankings», «US News and World Report»
patterns.context: 大学或商学院介绍中出现排名栏目、排名项目及榜单来源。

patterns.name: 植物化学提取与质谱鉴定
patterns.context: 报告植物材料提取物及化合物结构鉴定方法。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要，天然产物化学

patterns.name: 政治史中的报刊指控
patterns.context: 叙述政治人物争议及报纸刊文指控。

patterns.name: 生物医学数据与数据库
patterns.context: 描述样本分组、单核细胞分析及从生物医学数据库下载数据文件。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学研究

patterns.name: 作家简介与书评刊物
patterns.trigger: «graduate», «published», «essays», «publications», «The New Yorker», «The New York Review of Books»
patterns.context: 人物简介中列举教育背景及发表书评、文章的刊物。

en.description: Activations occur in accounts of religious figures and encyclopedia navigation, patient data records in medical papers, Python plotting code, and French historical songs, newspapers, and political arrest reporting; topics are varied, with no unified meaning.

patterns.name: Religious figures and episcopal titles
patterns.context: Church titles, appointments, or related institutions occur in biographical or church-institution narratives; some activations fall on encyclopedia entry navigation headings.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia biographies, Catholic history, and institutional reporting

patterns.name: Medical research records and patient characteristics
patterns.context: Medical papers describe patient data, clinical characteristics, treatment, or the collection and organization of research data.

patterns.name: Python plotting and data-processing code
patterns.context: Python plotting, legends, image reading, or plotting interface components occur in StackExchange code or question context.

patterns.name: French revolutionary songs and historical publications
patterns.context: Historical narratives mention song lyric authors, anonymous letters, or French newspapers and publication dates.

patterns.name: Political arrests and party reporting
patterns.context: Political history narratives concern arrests, exiles, or accusations published in communist newspapers.

9_145.concept: none
9_145.description: 激活见于教会人物及百科导航、医学论文的患者资料记录、Python绘图代码，也见于法国历史歌曲报刊和政治逮捕报道；主题分散，未见统一词义。

patterns.name: 教会人物与主教职衔
patterns.context: 人物传记或教会机构叙述中出现教会头衔、教职任命或相关机构；部分激活落在百科条目导航标题。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia传记、天主教历史与机构报道

patterns.name: 医学研究记录与患者特征
patterns.context: 医学论文描述患者资料、临床特征、治疗或研究数据的获取和整理。

patterns.name: Python绘图与数据处理代码
patterns.context: StackExchange代码或问题上下文中出现 Python 绘图、图例、图像读取或绘图界面组件。

patterns.name: 法国革命歌曲及历史出版物
patterns.context: 历史叙述提及歌曲歌词作者、匿名信或法国报刊及出版时间。

patterns.name: 政治人物遭逮捕及党派报道
patterns.context: 政治历史叙述涉及逮捕、流亡者或共产党报纸发表指控文章。

en.concept: Proper names, institution names, and document markers
en.description: Activation centers on proper names and structural phrases: NCBI, databases, and data sources in biomedicine; Catholic and Vatican institutions; encyclopedia reference sections, publications, and manuscript collections; it also responds strongly to Python’s pd.read_csv.

patterns.name: National Center for Biotechnology Information name
patterns.context: The full institution name appears next to its parenthetical abbreviation in biomedical methods or database descriptions; NCBI is also split into multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Catholic Church and Vatican institutions
patterns.context: Contexts involving cardinals, Vatican commissions, or Catholic figures and organizations; activation is especially strong on “Pontifical”.

patterns.name: References and external-links sections
patterns.context: Appears in headings or navigation areas at the end of an article, often with line breaks and subsequent link entries.

patterns.name: Python pandas CSV reading
patterns.context: Python scripts calling pandas to read CSV files; the function name may be split into tokens such as “read”, “_”, and “csv”.

patterns.name: Names of U.S. national surveys or datasets
patterns.context: Lists of longitudinal surveys or dataset names when describing research data sources.

patterns.name: Publication-name lists
patterns.context: Continuous lists of newspapers and other publications a person wrote for or contributed to in a biographical introduction.

patterns.name: National libraries and manuscript collections
patterns.context: Descriptions of digital manuscript copies and the collections or institutions that hold them.

patterns.name: Data tables and genomic databases
patterns.context: Mentions of genomic databases and DNA or protein homology searches in bioinformatics methods.

patterns.name: Church-related contexts that do not fit the patterns above
patterns.context: Contexts involving religious figures speaking at meetings and Vatican-related positions, partially overlapping with patterns involving cardinals and “Pontifical”.

9_145.concept: 专名、机构名与文档标记
9_145.description: 激活集中于专名和结构性词组：生物医学中的NCBI、数据库与数据源，天主教及梵蒂冈机构，百科参考文献栏、出版物和馆藏手稿；另对Python的pd.read_csv有明显反应。

patterns.name: 国家生物技术信息中心名称
patterns.context: 在生物医学方法或数据库描述中，完整机构名与括号内缩写相邻出现；NCBI 词内还会被拆成多个 token。

patterns.name: 天主教会与梵蒂冈机构
patterns.context: 涉及枢机、梵蒂冈委员会或天主教相关人物与组织时；“Pontifical”出现时激活尤其强。
patterns.domain: 宗教、天主教百科或新闻

patterns.name: 参考文献及外部链接栏
patterns.context: 出现在条目末尾的标题或导航区域，常伴随换行和后续链接条目。

patterns.name: Python pandas 读取 CSV
patterns.context: Python 脚本中调用 pandas 读取 CSV 文件；函数名可拆分为“read”“_”“csv”等 token。

patterns.name: 美国国家调查或数据集名称
patterns.context: 介绍研究数据来源，列举纵向调查或数据集名称。

patterns.name: 出版物名称列表
patterns.trigger: “The Wall Street Journal”“The Atlantic”“The New York Times”等
patterns.context: 人物简介中连续罗列其写作或供稿的报刊名称。

patterns.name: 国家图书馆与馆藏手稿
patterns.context: 介绍手稿的数字副本及其所在馆藏或收藏机构。

patterns.name: 数据表与基因组数据库
patterns.context: 生物信息学方法中提及基因组数据库及 DNA、蛋白质同源性检索。

patterns.name: 无法归入上述模式的教会相关语境
patterns.context: 涉及宗教人士在会议发言及梵蒂冈相关职务，但与枢机、Pontifical 等词组模式部分重叠。

en.concept: Proper names and code terms across diverse texts
en.description: Activation spans Python plotting and data-reading code, bioinformatics database descriptions, and publication lists and section headings in Wikipedia biographies; there is no single obvious trigger that accounts for all passages.

patterns.name: Python plotting code
patterns.context: Matplotlib/pandas plotting, legends, axes, or figure objects in Python code or question descriptions; some code tokens and punctuation are also marked.

patterns.name: Python data and image file reading
patterns.context: Code involving pandas CSV reading, or reading image files and local paths; “read” stands out across multiple passages.

patterns.name: NCBI and other databases in bioinformatics
patterns.context: Biomedical research texts mentioning NCBI data downloads, database searches, or gene/protein homology analyses.

patterns.name: Publication lists in biographies
patterns.context: Lists of positions, published works, or media and publication names in biographical introductions; multiple words in proper-name lists activate.

patterns.name: References and external-links headings
patterns.context: Reference or external-links sections and link titles appearing after the body of a biography.

patterns.name: Terms related to cardinal bishops
patterns.context: Narratives about someone’s appointment as a cardinal and the announcement date.

9_145.concept: 多样文本中的专名与代码词
9_145.description: 激活分布于Python绘图与数据读取代码、生物信息学数据库表述，以及维基人物传记中的出版物列表和栏目标题；不存在能覆盖全部片段的单一明显触发词。

patterns.name: Python绘图代码
patterns.context: Python 代码或问题描述中出现 Matplotlib/pandas 绘图、图例、坐标轴或图形对象；部分代码 token 和标点也被标记。

patterns.name: Python数据与图像文件读取
patterns.context: 围绕 pandas 读取 CSV，或读取图像文件及本地路径的代码；«read»在多个片段中突出。

patterns.name: NCBI等数据库与生物信息学
patterns.context: 生物医学研究文本提及从 NCBI 下载数据、数据库检索或基因/蛋白同源性分析。

patterns.name: 人物传记中的出版物列表
patterns.context: 人物简介中列举任职、发表作品或评论的媒体与出版物名称；专名列表中多个词被激活。

patterns.name: 参考文献及外部链接标题
patterns.context: 传记条目正文后出现参考文献或外部链接栏目及链接标题。

patterns.name: 基数主教相关词语
patterns.context: 叙述某人获任命为枢机主教及任命公布时间。

en.concept: Technical and document fragments across domains
en.description: Activation appears in Python plotting and CSV-reading code, data sources and clinical methods in biomedical papers, and encyclopedia reference headings and historical narratives; no clear shared semantic pattern is evident.

patterns.name: Python plotting code
patterns.context: Appears in Python/pandas plotting code or its documentation, often near legends, axes, bar charts, and image-file operations.

patterns.name: Reading CSV data
patterns.context: Code for reading CSV files with pandas, often with a file path; the trigger may fall on a function-name fragment or a nearby code token.

patterns.name: Biomedical sources and databases
patterns.context: Methods or background sections describing public databases, data downloads, sequence analyses, or genome analyses.

patterns.name: Clinical research measurements and medical record information
patterns.context: Clinical research methods passages describing patient characteristics, measurement methods, or the acquisition of medical record data.

patterns.name: References and external-links headings
patterns.context: Navigation or references subsection headings at the end of encyclopedia articles.

patterns.name: Letters and verse in French historical texts
patterns.context: Encyclopedia prose describing historical figures, song lyrics, or letters published in old newspapers; activation is scattered, with no clear common trigger.

9_145.concept: 多领域技术与文档片段
9_145.description: 激活见于 Python 绘图及 CSV 读取代码、生物医学论文的数据来源与临床方法，也见百科参考标题和历史叙述；共同语义模式不明显。

patterns.name: Python 绘图代码
patterns.context: 出现在 Python/pandas 绘图代码或其说明中，常与图例、坐标轴、柱状图和图像文件操作相邻。

patterns.name: 读取 CSV 数据
patterns.context: pandas 读取 CSV 的代码，常带文件路径；触发点可能落在函数名片段或邻近代码 token 上。

patterns.name: 生物医学资料来源与数据库
patterns.context: 论文方法或背景中描述公共数据库、数据下载、序列或基因组分析。

patterns.name: 临床研究测量与病历信息
patterns.context: 临床研究方法段落，说明患者特征、测量方式或病历资料获取。

patterns.name: 参考资料与外部链接标题

patterns.name: Russian adjective endings
patterns.context: Cyrillic segmentation of Russian place names or adjectives; highlights concentrate at word beginnings and several in-word fragments, commonly in -ский/-ий forms.

patterns.name: Continuous letter fragments in English transliterations and proper nouns
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across internal substrings of English proper nouns, foreign place names, or transliterated words, involving multiple different words, with no consistent meaning or fixed affix.
patterns.domain: English encyclopedia entries on people, places, religion, and ethnic groups

patterns.name: In-word fragments in long Swedish words
patterns.context: In Swedish sentences, activation occurs within long words and also in the recurring function word skulle; no single lexical condition can be determined.

patterns.name: inpatient in medical text
patterns.context: The complete word appears in contexts concerning psychiatric/inpatient care planning and resource utilization at inpatient facilities; adjacent medical terms are not highlighted.

patterns.name: Other sporadic in-word activations in medical text
patterns.context: Local activations on several medical, organizational, or general English words in PubMed abstracts; beyond sharing a medical style, they have no obvious common triggering substring.

patterns.name: Encyclopedia entry titles and body formatting
patterns.context: Activations occur in titles, line breaks, and recurring entry proper nouns/category terms, but are sporadic and do not reveal a distinct formatting or semantic trigger.

9_321.description: 激活以词内字母片段为主，尤其见于多语种专名、转写词及俄语/瑞典语词形；另对 PubMed 中 inpatient 等词有反应。aw片段跨不同语境复现，但其余触发分散，未形成统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 词内片段「aw」
patterns.context: 激活落在跨词边界或词内的 aw 字母片段，出现在不同拼写的专名中；本身不要求特定语义。
patterns.domain: 多语种词汇、专名及百科文本

patterns.name: 俄语形容词词尾
patterns.context: 俄语地名或形容词的西里尔字母切分；高亮集中在词首和若干词内片段，常见 -ский/-ий 词形。
patterns.domain: 俄语词汇表／词典式内容（Github）

patterns.name: 英语转写及专名中的连续字母片段
patterns.context: 激活分布于英语专名、外来地名或转写词的内部子串，涉及多个不同词，未见一致语义或固定词缀。
patterns.domain: 英语百科人物、地名、宗教及族群条目

patterns.name: 瑞典语长词词内片段
patterns.context: 在瑞典语句子中，激活出现在长词内部，也出现在反复出现的功能词 skulle；没有可确定的单一词义条件。

patterns.name: 医学文本中的 inpatient
patterns.context: 该词完整出现于精神科/住院医疗规划及住院机构资源利用语境；未高亮相邻医学术语。

patterns.name: 医学文本的其他零散词内激活
patterns.context: PubMed 摘要中若干医疗、组织或一般英语词的局部激活；除同属医学文体外，没有明显共同触发子串。

patterns.name: 百科条目标题与正文格式
patterns.context: 标题、换行以及反复出现的条目专名/类别词中有激活，但分布零散，难以确定独立的格式或语义触发条件。

en.concept: Multilingual text fragments and proper nouns
en.description: Activations occur on subword fragments in multilingual text and encyclopedia proper nouns, and also cover abstract terminology on mental health and ovarian cancer, as well as parliamentary sentences; no stable, unified semantic or syntactic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Proper nouns and their tokenized fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments of proper nouns; examples include place names, church names, plant genera, and ethnic groups, with some words split into multiple tokens

patterns.name: Russian spellings and transliterated entries
patterns.context: Line-by-line listings of Cyrillic word forms with Latin-letter transliterations or codes in parentheses

patterns.name: Mental health clinical terminology
patterns.context: Medical abstracts describing care planning after traumatic events and mentioning community and inpatient psychiatric services

patterns.name: Swedish parliamentary records
patterns.context: Swedish parliamentary meeting records and statements by members; activation covers multiple subwords in Swedish words

patterns.name: Ovarian cancer abstract terminology
patterns.context: A project abstract describes epithelial ovarian cancer as the deadliest gynecologic malignancy

patterns.name: Bollywood biographical accounts
patterns.context: A biography recounts a person's move to Mumbai to pursue a film career and their relationships with siblings and film works

patterns.name: Local triggers not attributable to a shared meaning
patterns.context: Based on the currently excerpted context alone, it is difficult to determine a shared condition with the other triggers

9_321.concept: 多语种文本片段与专名
9_321.description: 激活分布于多语种文本与百科专名的子词片段，也覆盖精神卫生、卵巢癌等摘要术语及议会语句；未见稳定统一的语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 专名及其分词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名的子词片段上；有地名、教堂名、植物属名和族名，部分词被拆成多个 token

patterns.name: 俄文拼写与转写条目
patterns.context: 逐行列出西里尔词形及括号内拉丁字母转写或代码

patterns.name: 精神卫生临床术语
patterns.context: 医疗摘要中描述创伤事件后的照护规划，且提及社区及住院精神科服务

patterns.name: 瑞典语议会记录
patterns.context: 瑞典语议会开会记录及议员发言；激活覆盖瑞典语词的多个子词

patterns.name: 卵巢癌摘要术语
patterns.context: 项目摘要说明上皮性卵巢癌及其为致死率最高的妇科恶性肿瘤

patterns.name: 宝莱坞人物传记
patterns.context: 传记叙述人物赴孟买从影、与兄弟及电影作品的关系

patterns.name: 无法归入共同语义的局部触发
patterns.context: 只凭当前截取上下文难以确定其与其他触发的共同条件

en.description: Activations are scattered across fields and formats, including research descriptions, legal numbering, application abbreviations, mathematical symbols, word fragments in names or titles, conversational questions, and ecological terminology. Several examples activate on split word fragments, but no unified trigger can be confirmed.

patterns.name: Words following being
patterns.context: The sentence contains “being carried on,” followed by a description of the scope or methods of research work.

patterns.name: Numbers and hyphens in legal citations
patterns.context: A hyphen-separated numerical citation is followed by an abbreviation and a court name.

patterns.name: Administrative abbreviations and application wording
patterns.context: An institutional or project abbreviation is immediately followed by Application for and a fragment of a funding number.

patterns.name: Mathematical expression symbols and variables
patterns.context: In a math problem, value is followed by a question mark and a parenthesized variable; the feature may also be sensitive to compact sequences of variables and operators.

patterns.name: Name fragments after numbers
patterns.context: A split name or word fragment appears after a number and period.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in proper nouns
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on split word fragments embedded in an airport proper name; it is uncertain whether these resemble the other examples.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in titles
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on split title-word fragments followed by a colon and subtitle.

patterns.name: Conversational questions
patterns.context: A question asks whether anyone knows something, followed by the colloquial hell.

patterns.name: Fragments of plant-community terminology
patterns.context: Ecological terms such as woody plant species appear in an abstract title; activations concentrate on within-word fragments.

9_321.description: 激活分散于多种领域和格式：包括研究描述、法律编号、申请缩写、数学符号、姓名或标题中的词片段、口语疑问及生态学术语。若干例子在拆分词片段上激活，但无法确认统一触发规律。

patterns.name: being 后的词语
patterns.context: 句中出现 “being carried on”，随后描述研究工作的范围或方法。

patterns.name: 法律编号中的数字与连字符
patterns.context: 连字符分隔的数字编号后接缩写及法院名称。

patterns.name: 行政缩写与申请表述
patterns.context: 机构或项目缩写后紧接 Application for 及资助编号片段。

patterns.name: 数学表达式符号与变量
patterns.context: 数学题中 value 后接问号及括号内变量；也可能对紧凑的变量、运算符序列敏感。

patterns.name: 数字后的姓名片段
patterns.context: 数字和句点后出现被拆分的姓名或词语片段。

patterns.name: 专名中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在拆分后的词片段中，嵌于机场专名；与其他例子是否同类不确定。

patterns.name: 标题中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在被拆分的标题词片段，后接冒号及副标题。

patterns.name: 口语疑问表达
patterns.context: 疑问句中询问是否有人知道某事，后接口语化的 hell。

patterns.name: 植物群落术语片段
patterns.context: 摘要标题中 woody plant species 等生态学术语；激活集中于词内片段。

en.description: All excerpts strongly activate on the preposition «in»; it is followed by groups of people, diseases, time values, topics, settings, or application scopes. Medical titles are frequent, but mathematics, social science, botany, patents, and general explanatory sentences also fit.

patterns.name: Strong activation on preposition in
patterns.context: «in» is followed by patients/diseases, time values, case presentations, research topics, plants, or other noun phrases; it appears across varied syntax and genres.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain, especially medical titles, math questions, and explanatory text

patterns.name: Diseases or research subjects in medical titles
patterns.context: Medical literature titles or abstract excerpts focus on diseases, treatments, clinical presentations, or pathogens; «in» connects the research subject with patients, cases, or disease contexts.

patterns.name: Numerical or unit expressions in mathematical contexts
patterns.context: Math questions/excerpts containing numbers, fractions, or units; activation is prominent on «in» and also occurs around numerical expressions.

patterns.name: in phrases for abstract topics
patterns.context: «in» introduces an abstract field, the setting of a research subject, or an application scope; a medical context is not required.
patterns.domain: Social science titles, botany titles, patent descriptions

patterns.name: Progressive constructions in general explanatory text
patterns.context: Ordinary declarative sentences describe work in progress and mention differences in methods; «in» remains a strong trigger.

9_321.description: 所有片段都强烈激活于介词 «in»；其后接人群、疾病、时间数值、主题、环境或应用范围。医学标题较多，但数学、社会科学、植物学、专利及一般说明句也符合。

patterns.name: 介词 in 的强激活
patterns.context: «in» 后接患者/疾病、时间数值、病例表现、研究主题、植物或其他名词短语；多种句法与文体中均出现。
patterns.domain: 跨领域，尤见医学标题、数学问句及说明性文本

patterns.name: 医学标题中的疾病或研究对象
patterns.context: 医学文献标题或摘要片段，围绕疾病、治疗、临床表现或病原体展开；«in»连接研究对象与患者、病例或疾病背景。

patterns.name: 数学语境中的数值或单位表达
patterns.trigger: « years»« are»« there» … « millenn»«ia»；«t»« value»« in»« -»«2»«/»«13»
patterns.context: 包含数字、分数或单位的数学问句/片段；激活显著落在«in»，也出现在数值表达周边。

patterns.name: 抽象主题中的 in 短语
patterns.context: «in»引出抽象领域、研究对象所在环境，或某一应用范围；不要求医学语境。
patterns.domain: 社会科学标题、植物学标题、专利说明

patterns.name: 一般说明文字中的进行式结构
patterns.context: 普通陈述句中描述工作正在开展，并提及方法差异；«in»仍是强触发点。

en.concept: Tenth Circuit Court of Appeals opinion headers
en.description: Primarily responds to centered headers, unpublished markings, and “FOR THE TENTH CIRCUIT” formatting on the first page of U.S. Tenth Circuit Court of Appeals opinions. Isolated activations on data-rights statements, team encyclopedia sentences, and biomedical abstracts are not explained by the main pattern.

patterns.name: Unpublished-opinion markings and Tenth Circuit headers
patterns.context: First-page court-document headers; commonly all caps, centered, indented, and line-broken, often including “FILED”
patterns.domain: U.S. federal appellate opinions, especially unpublished Tenth Circuit opinions

patterns.name: Alternative Tenth Circuit header layouts
patterns.context: The same court name appears repeatedly in title case or all caps, alongside first-page elements such as dates and docket information; “DO NOT PUBLISH” is not necessarily present

patterns.name: Formatting and word strings for a specific court name
patterns.context: First page of a legal document; may be a repeated title, a date line, or a fragment near docket information

patterns.name: Data-use restrictions and proprietary-rights statements
patterns.context: States that market data may not be distributed without permission and emphasizes proprietary rights in the data
patterns.domain: Business email or data licensing/confidentiality terms

patterns.name: Team names and encyclopedia descriptions
patterns.context: A team name is followed by a definitional description such as “are a Minor League Baseball team”

patterns.name: Biomedical terminology and negative qualification
patterns.context: A statement uses a term as its subject and “is not the only” to introduce a non-exclusive mechanism

patterns.name: Fragmentary legal headers or docket text
patterns.context: Appears near court headers, dates, and circuit court names; seems to be text damaged by scanning/OCR or truncation, with no independently identifiable trigger pattern

9_321.concept: 第十巡回法院判决抬头
9_321.description: 主要响应美国第十巡回上诉法院判决首页的居中抬头、未公开标记及“FOR THE TENTH CIRCUIT”等格式；另有数据权利声明、球队百科句和生物医学摘要等孤立激活，无法由主模式解释。

patterns.name: 未公开判决标记与第十巡回法院抬头
patterns.trigger: “[DO NOT PUBLISH]”、“IN THE UNITED STATES COURT OF APPEALS”、“FOR THE TENTH CIRCUIT”
patterns.context: 法院文件首页抬头；常见全大写、居中排版、缩进及换行，常带“FILED”
patterns.domain: 美国联邦上诉法院判决，尤其是第十巡回法院未公开判决

patterns.name: 第十巡回法院多种抬头排版
patterns.trigger: “United States Court of Appeals”、“Tenth Circuit”、“UNITED STATES COURT OF APPEALS”、“FOR THE TENTH CIRCUIT”
patterns.context: 同一法院名称以标题式或全大写形式重复出现，伴随日期、案卷信息等首页元素；未必含“DO NOT PUBLISH”
patterns.domain: 美国第十巡回法院文件

patterns.name: 特定法院名称的格式与词串
patterns.trigger: “United States Court of Appeals”、“Tenth Circuit”及其全大写版本
patterns.context: 法律文书首页；可能是标题重复、日期行或案卷信息附近的截断片段

patterns.name: 数据使用限制与专有权声明
patterns.trigger: “disseminate the IntercontinentalExchange Market Data”、“without the express written consent”、“exclusive and valuable property rights”
patterns.context: 声明未经许可不得传播市场数据，并强调数据的专有权利
patterns.domain: 商业邮件或数据许可/保密条款

patterns.name: 球队名称与百科介绍
patterns.context: 球队名称后接“are a Minor League Baseball team”等定义式介绍
patterns.domain: 英语维基百科、体育条目

patterns.name: 生物医学术语及否定限定句
patterns.trigger: “Mitosis is not the only distributor of mutated cells”
patterns.context: 以术语作主语、用“is not the only”引出非唯一机制的陈述

patterns.name: 残缺法律标题或案卷文本
patterns.context: 出现在法院抬头、日期和巡回法院名称附近，似为扫描/OCR或截断造成的残文，无法单独判定触发规律

en.description: The shared trigger is amplify, but its objects and contexts vary: it can mean amplifying nucleic acids in PCR, disseminating content, intensifying climate effects, improving understanding, or enhancing traits and physical perturbations.

patterns.name: PCR amplification of nucleic acid sequences
patterns.context: Amplify is followed by DNA/RNA, a gene, region, or sequence; commonly occurs in methods or research descriptions.
patterns.domain: Molecular biology, immunology, and biomedical papers

patterns.name: Disseminating or amplifying content
patterns.context: Amplify means sharing, promoting, or expanding the reach of content.
patterns.domain: Social media, employee advocacy, and marketing copy

patterns.name: Enhancing climate-change effects
patterns.context: Amplify means that climate change exacerbates or enhances an effect; the meaning is contrasted with “reduce.”

patterns.name: Improving understanding
patterns.context: Amplify occurs with understanding, meaning to deepen or promote understanding of a topic.

patterns.name: Enhancing existing traits
patterns.context: Amplify is followed by an abstract positive trait and means strengthening its advantages.

patterns.name: Amplifying physical perturbations
patterns.context: It refers to a perturbation related to magnetic buoyancy; the discussion considers whether a dynamical process can amplify it to a high value.

9_321.description: 共同触发词是 amplify，但宾语和语境多样：既表示 PCR 扩增核酸，也表示传播内容、加剧气候效应、增进理解或增强特质与物理扰动。

patterns.name: PCR 扩增核酸序列
patterns.trigger: “amplify the internal transcribed spacer region”“amplify message”“amplify rearranged CD3R13 regions”“amplify sequences”
patterns.context: amplify 后接 DNA/RNA、基因、区域或序列；常见于实验方法或研究描述。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、免疫学、生物医学论文

patterns.name: 传播或放大内容
patterns.trigger: “amplify other peoples’ posts”“amplify company approved content”
patterns.context: amplify 表示分享、推广或扩大内容传播。
patterns.domain: 社交媒体、员工倡导与营销文案

patterns.name: 增强气候变化影响
patterns.context: amplify 指气候变化会加剧或增强某种效应；此处语义与“reduce”对照。

patterns.name: 增进理解
patterns.context: amplify 与 understanding 搭配，表示深化或促进对某主题的理解。
patterns.domain: 衰老神经生物学研究资助摘要

patterns.name: 增强既有特质
patterns.context: amplify 后接抽象正面特质，意为强化其优点。

patterns.name: 放大物理扰动
patterns.context: it 指磁浮力相关扰动；讨论动力过程能否将其放大到高值。

en.description: Triggers are scattered: examples include degree and scope words, verbs of change or completion, predicates following pronouns, suggestions and obligations, and evaluative judgments. There are also temporal expressions and several strong triggers that cannot be grouped together. The examples span genres and lack one stable pattern.

patterns.name: Degree adverbs emphasizing attention or extent
patterns.context: Appears in comparative, negative, scope, or degree expressions, often modifying a following predicate or noun; this pattern covers only some examples and cannot explain all strong activations.
patterns.domain: Reviews, narratives, academic text, and legal text

patterns.name: Completion and result expressions
patterns.context: A past participle or past-tense verb occurs in a result-, change-, or completion-related construction; the forms are similar, but their syntax and meaning are not fully consistent.
patterns.domain: Reviews, project descriptions, and sports narratives

patterns.name: Predicates following personal or possessive pronouns
patterns.context: A pronoun or possessive form is followed by a description of a person, relationship, or action; includes colloquial contractions and narrative uses.
patterns.domain: Forum conversation, literary reviews, and news narratives

patterns.name: Expressions of caution, recommendation, or obligation
patterns.context: Offers a recommendation, expectation, or obligation, usually followed by a verb; activations are weak and contexts vary widely.

patterns.name: Temporal and sequencing cues
patterns.context: Mentions time, order, or the present moment; these occur in different narratives and may be sporadic co-occurrences.

patterns.name: Evaluation and judgment
patterns.context: Expresses an evaluation or opinion about a person or thing, or a legal judgment.
patterns.domain: Conversational reviews, explanatory text, and legal quotations

patterns.name: Triggers near titles, names, and proper nouns
patterns.context: These strong triggers are scattered across email, legal quotations, sports quotes, and forum replies; they lack a shared local semantic condition and may reflect independent or incidental patterns.
patterns.domain: Business email, legal text, forums, and sports narratives

9_321.concept: 异质的功能词与谓词触发
9_321.description: 触发点分散：程度与范围词、变化或完成动词、代词后的谓词、建议义务及评价判断均有例子；另有时间序列词和若干无法归并的强触发，跨体裁且缺少稳定单一规律。

patterns.name: 强调关注或程度的程度副词
patterns.context: 出现在比较、否定、范围或程度表达中，常修饰后续谓词或名词；本模式只覆盖部分例子，不足以解释所有强激活。
patterns.domain: 评论、叙述、学术及法律文本

patterns.name: 完成与结果表达
patterns.context: 过去分词或过去式出现在结果、变化或完成相关结构中；形式相似但句法与语义不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 评论、项目说明与赛事叙述

patterns.name: 人物或所有格代词后的谓词
patterns.trigger: «hes»（hes gotta / hes a）、«He's»、«her»（her daughter / her works）
patterns.context: 代词或所有格形式后接对人物、关系或行为的说明；包括口语缩写和叙述性用法。
patterns.domain: 论坛口语、文学评论、新闻叙述

patterns.name: 审慎、建议或义务表达
patterns.context: 提出建议、预期或义务，通常后接动词；触发较弱且语境跨度大。

patterns.name: 时间与序列线索
patterns.context: 提及时间、顺序或当前时点；分布在不同叙述中，可能只是零散共现。

patterns.name: 评价与判断
patterns.context: 表达对人物或事物的评价、看法或法律相关判断。
patterns.domain: 口语评论、说明及法律引文

patterns.name: 标题、姓名及专名附近的触发
patterns.context: 这些强触发分散在邮件、法律引文、赛事引语及论坛回复中；缺乏共同的局部语义条件，可能是独立或偶然模式。
patterns.domain: 商务邮件、法律、论坛及赛事叙述

en.concept: Common word forms and phrases in quotations
en.description: The clearest local cue is “that’s” in quotations, but it occurs across many genres. There is also “I love working” and several quoted fragments on unrelated topics. There is insufficient evidence to group all activations into a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: First-person enjoyment and engagement at work
patterns.context: A direct quote expresses enjoyment of a job or volunteer work; “working” activates strongly.
patterns.domain: Biographical profiles and charity organization descriptions

patterns.name: Quotation markers in conversational narratives
patterns.context: The contraction “that’s” appears in direct quotation; its ’s activates strongly, while the surrounding context is not fixed.
patterns.domain: Legal testimony, personal quotes, news, and novel dialogue

patterns.name: Encouraging workplace speech
patterns.context: A speech addressed to employees or a team emphasizes personal participation and contribution to company matters.

patterns.name: Rebuttal of evidence in legal documents
patterns.context: Discusses an immigrant marriage and allegations of evading immigration law; the decision states that the party did not adequately rebut the evidence.

patterns.name: Proposal and jealousy dialogue
patterns.context: Novel characters discuss infatuation, marriage, and another person’s jealousy, including emotionally charged direct quotations.

patterns.name: Narrative of a sports injury
patterns.context: A witness describes the other party attacking with a knife and identifies the part of their body that was injured.

patterns.name: Pursuit, threats, and dangerous experiences
patterns.context: Recalls a frightening experience of being pursued and expecting to be caught, and uses it in a legal argument.

patterns.name: Reporting on changes in market activity
patterns.context: News coverage describes changing attitudes among trade-clearing members and market conditions.

patterns.name: Community responsibility and pride
patterns.context: The speaker connects living locally with a sense of pride and community responsibility.

9_321.concept: 引语中的常见词形与短语
9_321.description: 最显著的局部线索是引语中的 “that’s”，但它横跨多种文体；另有 “I love working” 和若干主题各异的引语片段。没有足够证据把所有激活归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 第一人称爱好与工作投入
patterns.context: 人物直接引语中，表达喜欢某项工作或志愿活动；“working”激活较强。
patterns.domain: 人物简介、慈善组织介绍

patterns.name: 口语叙述中的引语标记
patterns.context: 直接引语里出现缩写 “that’s”；该词尾 ’s 激活强，周围语境并不固定。
patterns.domain: 法律证词、人物引语、新闻与小说对白

patterns.name: 鼓励性职场讲话
patterns.context: 面向员工或团队的讲话，强调个人对公司事务的参与和贡献。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的证据反驳
patterns.context: 讨论移民婚姻与规避移民法的指控，裁决评价当事人未能充分反驳证据。

patterns.name: 求婚与嫉妒对白
patterns.context: 小说人物谈到迷恋、婚姻及他人嫉妒，包含带感情色彩的直接引语。

patterns.name: 运动伤害叙述
patterns.context: 证人描述对方持刀袭击并指出自己受伤部位。

patterns.name: 追逐威胁与危险经历
patterns.trigger: “running down that road with two jackals after you”; “caught you”
patterns.context: 回忆被追赶、预期被抓住的可怕经历，并用于法律论证。
patterns.domain: 法律陈述中的叙述性引语

patterns.name: 市场业务变化报道
patterns.trigger: “it’s not business as usual”; “when it comes”
patterns.context: 新闻报道交易清算成员态度变化及市场业务状况。

patterns.name: 社区责任与自豪
patterns.trigger: “take a little more pride”; “responsibility to your community”
patterns.context: 说话者把在当地生活与自豪感、社区责任相联系。

en.description: Activations are scattered across thanks and acquisition, W in mathematical formulas, chart duration, diabetes research, game jail rules, and sentence-initial conjunctions or line-break boundaries; no single semantic pattern covers all passages.

patterns.name: Thanks and gratitude after giving, help, or participation
patterns.context: Expresses thanks, gratitude, or reciprocation for what others have given, their participation, or their contributions; also includes descriptions of someone obtaining a degree or qualification through work
patterns.domain: Personal letters, event copy, and biographies

patterns.name: English word-form token “W” and its mathematical-symbol context
patterns.context: The letter W appears in mathematical formulas as a vector symbol or group name; activations fall on tokens around the symbol
patterns.domain: Mathematical papers (vectors, Lie groups, graph theory)

patterns.name: “Spent” referring to time or chart duration
patterns.context: Describes how long a song remained on a chart

patterns.name: Diabetes and its treatment research
patterns.context: Regulatory T-cell therapy in animal models to prevent or reverse type 1 diabetes

patterns.name: Prison/jail rules
patterns.context: Explains how turns work after landing on the jail square in a game

patterns.name: Sentence-initial conjunctions and paragraph boundaries
patterns.context: Conjunctions, headings, and boundary tokens appear at the start of text or after a line break; no consistent semantic context is evident
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia, mathematical text, and web content in mixed corpora

9_321.description: 激活分散于感谢与获得、数学公式中的 W、排行榜停留、糖尿病研究、游戏监狱规则，以及句首连接词或换行边界；没有单一语义模式能覆盖全部段落。

patterns.name: 给与、帮助或参与后的感谢与感激
patterns.trigger: “thank you”, “grateful”, “thank you for having given me”, “earned him”
patterns.context: 表达对他人给予、参与或贡献的谢意、感激或回报；也包括描述某人因工作而获得学位、资格等
patterns.domain: 私人书信、活动文案、人物传记

patterns.name: 英文词形 token“W”及其数学符号环境
patterns.context: 字母 W 出现在数学公式中，作为向量符号或群的名称；激活落在符号周围的 token
patterns.domain: 数学论文（向量、李群、图论）

patterns.name: “spent”表示耗时或榜单停留
patterns.context: 描述歌曲在排行榜上持续停留的时间长度

patterns.name: 糖尿病及其治疗研究
patterns.context: 动物模型中调节性 T 细胞疗法预防或逆转 1 型糖尿病

patterns.name: 监狱／入狱规则
patterns.context: 解释游戏规则中进入监狱格后的回合处理

patterns.name: 句首连接词及段落边界
patterns.context: 文本起始处或换行后出现的连接词、标题及边界 token；缺少一致的语义上下文
patterns.domain: 混合语料中的百科、数学文本及网页内容

en.description: Activations occur on descriptive objects and their experiences, attributes, or participation relationships across several text types: medical conditions and patients, biographical accounts, and activities involving trainees. Formula symbols and objects monitored in patent interfaces are two additional isolated cases.

patterns.name: Diseases or medical subjects being described or affected
patterns.context: Medical passages introduce a disease, patient group, pathological feature, or research subject; activations often fall on disease-related nouns and descriptions of people.

patterns.name: Biographical accounts and personal experiences
patterns.context: Introduces a person’s background, upbringing, experiences, or personal information; activations often occur near possessive pronouns and descriptions of experiences.
patterns.domain: Biographical profiles, encyclopedia articles, and promotional writing

patterns.name: Trainees participating in program activities
patterns.context: A program description says that trainees will participate in activities, receive support, or develop skills.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and formula objects
patterns.context: A theoretical physics text discusses operators, states, and coefficients; the trigger lies within formula symbols and differs semantically from the other passages.

patterns.name: Objects monitored in patent interfaces
patterns.context: A patent background defines the systems, methods, and monitored objects involved in an invention.

9_321.description: 激活出现在多种文本中的描述性对象与其经历、属性或参与关系：医学疾病及患者、人物生平、培训对象活动；另有公式符号和专利界面监测对象两类孤例。

patterns.name: 疾病/医学对象被描述或影响
patterns.context: 医学段落中介绍疾病、患者群体、病理特征或研究对象；激活常落在疾病相关名词及人群描述上。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文与研究摘要

patterns.name: 人物生平与经历叙述
patterns.context: 介绍人物背景、成长、经历或个人信息；激活多出现在所有格代词及经历描述附近。
patterns.domain: 人物介绍、百科条目及宣传性文字

patterns.name: 受训者参与项目活动
patterns.context: 项目说明培训对象将参与活动、接受支持或提升技能。

patterns.name: 数学符号与公式对象
patterns.context: 理论物理文本中讨论算符、态及系数，触发点位于公式符号内部，和其余段落的语义主题不同。

patterns.name: 专利中的界面监测对象
patterns.trigger: «interface»、«two»，尤指«interface of two liquid lubricated mechanical seal»
patterns.context: 专利背景中界定发明所涉及的系统、方法及监测对象。

en.description: Activations occur around duration expressions, infinitive actions or responsibilities, patent specifications, and local contexts involving behavioral feedback, clinical presentations, legal reimbursement, and project oversight; these patterns span disparate domains and do not share a unified trigger condition.

patterns.name: Duration and time span
patterns.context: Activation occurs near expressions of time spent, duration, or span; the time may be a day, several months, working hours, or time spent with someone or something.
patterns.domain: Educational descriptions, forum posts, legal materials

patterns.name: to followed by an action or state
patterns.context: An infinitive to is followed by a verb or a nominal action/responsibility expression; activation is concentrated mainly on the following content word, but may also fall on to.
patterns.domain: Patent background, toxicology descriptions, legal materials, project management descriptions

patterns.name: Properties, structure, and numerical specifications in patents
patterns.context: Patent technical background or prior-art descriptions specify properties through numerical ranges, dimensions, or material structures; some activations fall near example phrases and structural words such as have/raised.

patterns.name: Behavioral feedback about risks or problems
patterns.context: When discussing user behavior or interface feedback, personalized comparisons and quantitative data are used to describe a behavior or tendency.
patterns.domain: HackerNews forum discussions, product and behavior analysis

patterns.name: Clinical presentation of skin lesions
patterns.context: A medical passage shifts from a susceptible population or disease prevalence to a description of the typical appearance of lesions.

patterns.name: Cost reimbursement and assets in law
patterns.context: A legal proceeding describes a state government recovering incarceration costs from a party, with nearby mentions of assets or benefits.

patterns.name: Oversight responsibilities in scientific projects
patterns.context: Describes the organization, management, and scientific oversight responsibilities of a project's core institution.

patterns.name: Local activations not sufficiently explained
patterns.context: These activations are scattered across local positions including chemical names, material names, teacher, observational behavior, and abbreviation segmentation, and cannot be explained by a single stable condition; some overlap with passages containing the listed patterns.

9_321.description: 激活分布于持续时间表达、不定式动作或职责、专利规格，以及行为反馈、临床表现、法律追偿和项目监督等局部语境；这些模式领域跨度大，触发条件并不统一。

patterns.name: 持续时间与时间跨度
patterns.trigger: «spend»10 a great« deal»2« of»4« the»6« school»2« day»2；«been»6« months»1；«spend»9« time»3；«until»3 7 or 7:30
patterns.context: 激活落在表示花费、持续或跨度的时间表达附近；时间可为一天、数月、工作时段或与某事共度的时间。
patterns.domain: 教育说明、论坛帖子、法律材料

patterns.name: to 后接动作或状态
patterns.trigger: «to»1« have»10 catalytic« properties；«to»1« have»10 toxic« effects；«to»2« spend»9« time；«to»5« the»9 scientific oversight
patterns.context: 不定式 to 后接动词或名词性动作/职责表达；触发强度主要落在后续内容词，也可能落在 to。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、毒理说明、法律材料、项目管理说明

patterns.name: 专利中的性质、结构与数值规格
patterns.trigger: «for»1 example, greater than about 12 Ang«strom»3«s»2 in diameter；«have»9« a»3« raised»5 line pattern；«at»4 least 15« g»1/m2 and at« most»1 45 g/m2
patterns.context: 专利技术背景或现有技术描述中，以数值范围、尺寸或材料结构限定性质；部分激活落在例示短语及 have/raised 等结构词附近。

patterns.name: 风险或问题的行为反馈
patterns.trigger: users« like»1 you« spent»10« an»3 average« of»1 30 seconds« more»2 looking；«irrational behaviors
patterns.context: 讨论用户行为或界面反馈时，用个人化比较和量化数据说明某类行为或倾向。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 论坛讨论、产品与行为分析

patterns.name: 皮肤病灶的临床表现
patterns.trigger: «AK»6«s»7« typically»5« present»9« as»8 red, scaly« lesions
patterns.context: 医学段落由易感人群或疾病流行情况转入病灶的典型外观描述。

patterns.name: 法律中的费用追偿与资产
patterns.trigger: reimbursement« for»5« the»7 costs of incarceration；«the»9 costs« of»4« incarceration
patterns.context: 法律程序说明州政府向当事人追偿监禁费用，附近提及资产或福利。

patterns.name: 科学项目的监督职责
patterns.context: 说明项目管理核心机构的组织、管理与科学监督职责。

patterns.name: 未充分解释的局部激活
patterns.context: 这些激活分散在化学物质名称、材料名称、教师、观察行为及缩写拆分等局部位置，未能由单一稳定条件解释；其中部分与已列模式所在段落重叠。

en.description: Activations are scattered across common copulas, function words, research/technical vocabulary, and formatting conventions. The clearest recurring forms are was, it’s, and present, but this is insufficient to infer a single semantic category.

patterns.name: Copula “was”
patterns.context: The past-tense copula was, followed by a temperature or evaluative complement

patterns.name: Copula “it’s”
patterns.context: The contraction it’s followed by an adjective or clause, as in “it’s wicked,” “it’s a joke,” or “it’s why”

patterns.name: Present-tense “present”
patterns.context: Present used as a verb to mean that a lesion manifests, or as an adjective to indicate that a neuron is located somewhere

patterns.name: “Have” in perfect or existential constructions
patterns.context: Have used as a causative or possessive verb in an infinitive or structural description

patterns.name: Generic word “the” and structural continuation
patterns.context: The definite article appears in noun phrases, especially in technical descriptions or prose sentences
patterns.domain: Novels, medical papers, and patent text

patterns.name: Technical vocabulary and product descriptions
patterns.context: Introduces computer product features and uses

patterns.name: Nervous system terminology
patterns.context: A research statement describes where neurons are located

patterns.name: Description of medical lesions
patterns.context: Describes the manifestation and prevalence of lesions

patterns.name: High-frequency function words in varied discourse
patterns.context: Ordinary conversational narrative, with no stable, specific semantic trigger

patterns.name: Ordinary words in dialogue and quotations
patterns.context: Novel dialogue and narration, with strong activations near common words or punctuation

patterns.name: Salutations and punctuation in email
patterns.context: Email formatting and everyday workplace communication

patterns.name: Forum separators and discussion text
patterns.context: Separators, topic words, and judgment statements in forum posts

patterns.name: Formatting and technical wording in patents
patterns.context: Patent background sections, accompanied by periods, line breaks, and technical terminology

9_321.description: 激活分散于常见系词、功能词、科研/技术词汇及文体格式；较明确的重复是 was、it’s、present，尚不足以归结为单一语义类别。

patterns.name: 系词“was”
patterns.trigger: « was»10，位于“it was over 100 degrees”和“he said it was okay”中
patterns.context: 过去时态的系词 was，后接温度或评价性补语

patterns.name: 系词“it’s”
patterns.context: 缩写 it’s 后接形容词或从句，如“it’s wicked”“it’s a joke”“it’s why”

patterns.name: 现在时“present”
patterns.context: present 作动词，表示病变呈现，或作形容词表示神经元存在于某处

patterns.name: 完成/存在句中的“have”
patterns.trigger: “likely«.»2 That«'s»4 the way he« likes»2 to« have»4 us learn”及“designed»4 to« have»9 the«8 same»8 length”
patterns.context: have 作使役/拥有动词，处于不定式或结构性说明中

patterns.name: 泛指词语“the”与结构性续接
patterns.trigger: « the»3 cleverest；« the»8 same；“in« elderly»1 people”
patterns.context: 定冠词出现在名词短语中，尤其是技术描述或散文句子
patterns.domain: 小说、医学论文、专利文本

patterns.name: 技术词汇及产品叙述
patterns.context: 介绍计算机产品功能与用途

patterns.name: 神经系统术语
patterns.context: 科研陈述中描述神经元所在位置

patterns.name: 医学病变描述
patterns.context: 描述病变的表现及流行率

patterns.name: 多样话语中的高频功能词
patterns.trigger: “know why”“I didn’t feel”“who is over in Iraq”
patterns.context: 普通口语叙述，未见稳定的特定语义触发词

patterns.name: 对话与引语中的普通词
patterns.context: 小说对话及叙述，强激活落在常见词或标点附近

patterns.name: 邮件中的称呼与标点
patterns.context: 邮件格式及日常工作沟通

patterns.name: 论坛分隔符与讨论文本
patterns.context: 论坛帖子中的分隔符、话题词及判断句

patterns.name: 专利中的格式与技术措辞
patterns.context: 专利背景技术段落，伴随句号、换行及技术术语

en.concept: English copulas and the contraction ’s, with miscellaneous items
en.description: Activations are scattered across varied English genres and vocabulary, appearing more often in be verbs and structures such as it/It + ’s, but inconsistently; there are also have the same, animals, Hi, All, and several isolated text fragments, with no unified explanation yet.

patterns.name: Forms of be verbs in sentences
patterns.context: Multiple activations occur in English copular or auxiliary constructions, especially was, is, have, and the contraction ’s; these may be followed by an adjective, noun, or clause. This cannot be summarized as responding to only one grammatical function.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English narrative, dialogue, and expository text

patterns.name: Expressions in comments or quotations
patterns.context: In comments, evaluations, or explanatory sentences, the subject it/its is followed by ’s or not; some examples are quotations or forum replies.
patterns.domain: Online discussions, book reviews, and informal English

patterns.name: have the same in RISC descriptions
patterns.context: In technical descriptions, to is followed by have the same length, with consecutive «have»«the»«same» activations standing out.

patterns.name: Standalone activation on the personal pronoun It
patterns.context: The pronoun itself appears in different syntactic positions, but activation strength is inconsistent as to whether ’s follows; examples include «It»'s another gem, «It»'s a funny thing, and «it» was okay.

patterns.name: Animal comparison wording in research results
patterns.context: An experimental results section compares animals on a TP diet with those on a control food diet.

patterns.name: Forum post boundary markers
patterns.context: Forum content includes numbered items and line-break separators, surrounded by discussion of posting guidelines and whether to stay silent; the association of the markers themselves is unclear.

patterns.name: Opening salutation in dialogue
patterns.context: An email begins with Hi Clayton, followed by a comma and line break.

patterns.name: All in literary dialogue
patterns.context: A response in fictional dialogue says “«All» right”.

patterns.name: Fragment at an email greeting
patterns.context: A text fragment possibly caused by a scanning or transcription error appears before fictional dialogue; its trigger cannot be confirmed.

patterns.name: Spelling fragment in a book title or name
patterns.context: The spelling fragment Shaks«pere» appears in literary dialogue; it may be related to segmentation or a spelling anomaly.

patterns.name: Other local lexical activations
patterns.context: These words are scattered across personal narratives, patent descriptions, book reviews, forums, emails, research papers, and fiction; apart from a few local collocations, there is insufficient evidence to group them into a shared trigger pattern.

9_321.concept: 英语系词及缩写 ’s，伴随杂项
9_321.description: 激活分散于多种英语文体和词汇，较常见于 be 动词及 it/It + ’s 等结构，但不稳定；另有 have the same、animals、Hi、All 和若干孤立文本片段，尚无统一解释。

patterns.name: 句中 be 动词形态
patterns.context: 多个激活出现在英语系词或助动词结构中，尤其是 was、is、have 及缩写 ’s；后续可接形容词、名词或分句。不能将此概括为只响应某一种语法功能。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英语叙述、对话及说明文

patterns.name: 评论或引语中的表达
patterns.context: 评论、评价或解释性语句中，主语 it/its 后接 ’s 或 not；部分例子是引语或论坛回复。
patterns.domain: 网络讨论、书评与非正式英语

patterns.name: RISC 描述中的 have the same
patterns.context: 技术说明中，to 后接 have the same length，连续的«have»«the»«same»激活突出。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、计算机体系结构说明

patterns.name: 人称代词 It 的独立激活
patterns.context: 代词本身在不同句法位置出现，但激活强度与是否随后有 ’s 不一致；例如«It»'s another gem、«It»'s a funny thing，以及«it» was okay。

patterns.name: 科研结果中的动物比较措辞
patterns.context: 实验结果段落中，比较 TP 饮食与 control food diet 的动物。

patterns.name: 论坛帖子边界标记
patterns.context: 论坛内容中出现数字编号及换行分隔，周围讨论发帖指引与是否噤声；该标记本身的关联不明。

patterns.name: 对话中的开头称呼
patterns.context: 邮件以 Hi Clayton 开头，后接逗号和换行。

patterns.name: 文学对话中的 All
patterns.context: 小说对白中回答“«All» right”。

patterns.name: 邮件问候处的残片
patterns.context: 可能是扫描或转录错误形成的文本残片，位于小说对话前，无法确认其触发原因。

patterns.name: 书名人名拼写残片
patterns.context: Shaks«pere» 这一拼写片段出现在文学对话中；可能与切分或拼写异常有关。

patterns.name: 其他局部词汇激活
patterns.context: 这些词分散出现在个人叙述、专利说明、书评、论坛、邮件、科研论文及小说中；除了个别局部搭配，没有足够证据归为共同的触发模式。

en.description: Primarily responds to have, perform, served, and similar structures in predicates expressing function, purpose, or benefit. Weaker activations occur on it’s judgments, quotation/topic transitions, and for before a specific recipient.

patterns.name: Statements of function, purpose, or capability
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on the infinitive “to have,” “have” in modal or passive constructions, and predicates near statements of purpose or function; commonly describes an object’s properties, capabilities, or intended effects.
patterns.domain: Patent technical backgrounds, legal documents, and general explanatory prose

patterns.name: Judgments and opinions in conversation
patterns.context: In conversation or commentary, activation falls on ’s in the contraction “it’s,” used to introduce an explanation or evaluation.

patterns.name: Quotations and discourse transitions in dialogue
patterns.context: Occurs near phrases that connect discourse or introduce a topic in narration or prose; [1] activates on “was” in quoted content, while [6] activates on “for” in the topic-transition phrase “For the.”

patterns.name: Close relationships or specific recipients
patterns.context: When describing a pet’s behavior and its particular beneficiary, activation falls on the preposition “for”; the context emphasizes that the behavior is specific to one person.

9_321.description: 主要响应功能、目的或利益相关谓语中的 have、perform、served 等结构；另对 it’s 判断、引述/话题衔接及专属对象前的 for 有较弱激活。

patterns.name: 功能、目的或能力表述
patterns.trigger: “to have toxic effects”[4]；“is expected to have heat resistance”[5]；“designed to have the same length”[8]；“designed to perform their functions”[10]；“best interest will be served”[9]
patterns.context: 激活集中在不定式“to have”、情态或被动结构中的“have”，以及目的/功能谓语附近；常见于说明对象具有什么性质、能力或预期效果。
patterns.domain: 专利技术背景、法律文书及一般说明文

patterns.name: 口语中的判断与观点
patterns.context: 在口语或评论中，激活落在缩写“it’s”中的“’s”，用于提出解释或评价。

patterns.name: 对话中的引述与话语衔接
patterns.trigger: “He says it was over 100 degrees”[1]；“As for the worries and annoyances”[6]
patterns.context: 出现在叙述或散文中连接话语、引入话题的短语附近；[1]激活在引述内容的“was”，[6]激活在话题转换短语“For the”中的“for”。

patterns.name: 亲密关系或专属对象
patterns.context: 在描述宠物行为及其特定受益对象时，激活位于介词“for”前；上下文强调行为专属于某个人。

en.concept: Multiple local phrases and technical property descriptions
en.description: Activation excerpts span varied genres; patent technical text often describes functions, structures, or properties, while other examples concern slogans, medical causation, plot turns, film titles, and time expressions in education. No unified trigger word is apparent.

patterns.name: Function, property, or structure descriptions in patent background
patterns.context: A technical object or material is followed by a description of its function, structure, properties, or process; common forms include “have/has + noun” or “perform + functions”.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent background, electronics, optoelectronics, and materials technology

patterns.name: Technical description verb with an object
patterns.context: Describes an action performed by an LCD device; activation falls on “displays” and the following “an”.

patterns.name: Prepositional phrase in a care slogan
patterns.context: An imperative self-care slogan; activation is strongest near “of Your”.
patterns.domain: Pile-CC, online text or promotional slogan

patterns.name: Statement of viral lethality
patterns.context: Describes the effect of HIV-1 on human helper T cells; “kills” has the strongest activation.

patterns.name: Narrative turn involving something unattainable
patterns.context: A narrative accepts that something cannot be achieved; activation occurs near “was” and “never”.

patterns.name: Contraction in a list of film titles
patterns.context: A list of films by decade; activation is concentrated on “It’s”.

patterns.name: Quantity expression about a teacher observing students
patterns.context: Describes a teacher spending a large amount of time observing students during the school day.

9_321.concept: 多类局部词组与技术属性表述
9_321.description: 激活片段横跨多种文体；专利技术文本中多见功能、结构或性质表述，其余分别涉及口号、医学因果、剧情转折、片名及教育中的时间表达，未见统一触发词。

patterns.name: 专利背景中的功能、属性或结构表述
patterns.trigger: “perform their functions”“has a structure”“have its electron”“have heat resistance”
patterns.context: 技术对象或材料后接其功能、结构、性质或过程；常见于“have/has + 名词”或“perform + functions”。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景，电子、光电及材料技术

patterns.name: 带宾语的技术描述动词
patterns.context: 描述 LCD 设备执行的动作，激活落在“displays”及其后的“an”。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景，显示设备

patterns.name: 照护口号中的介词短语
patterns.context: 祈使式自我照护口号；“of Your”附近激活最强。

patterns.name: 病毒致死表述
patterns.context: 描述 HIV-1 对人体辅助 T 细胞的作用；“kills”激活最强。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景，生物医学

patterns.name: 无法实现的叙事转折
patterns.trigger: “was never possible to bring her lover back”
patterns.context: 叙事中接受某件事不可能实现；“was”“never”附近激活。
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科，剧情概述

patterns.name: 电影片名列表中的缩写形式
patterns.context: 年代电影片名列表；激活集中在“It’s”。
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科，片名列表

patterns.name: 教师观察学生的数量表达
patterns.trigger: “spend a great deal of the school day observing”
patterns.context: 描述教师在教学日中花大量时间观察学生。

en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly on it’s (“it is/has”) forms in colloquial evaluations, fictional dialogue, and book reviews. Other lexical triggers include displays in patents, formulation percentages, and attends in legal texts.

patterns.name: it’s in contracted questions or comments
patterns.context: In colloquial text, it’s is followed by a reason, judgment, or evaluation; nearby expressions often include think/why/another/funny.
patterns.domain: Forum dialogue, fictional dialogue, book reviews, and general narrative

patterns.name: displays in patent device descriptions
patterns.context: An LCD device displays images; preceding text lists device properties and uses.

patterns.name: attends in a legal context
patterns.context: Describes the daily activities of a detained person and measures for their safe care.

patterns.name: Percentage symbols in patent formulations
patterns.context: Oil composition and content ranges by weight; values are followed by percentages and formulation components.

9_321.description: 激活主要集中在 it’s（“it is/has”）形式，出现在口语评价、小说对白及书评中；另有专利中的 displays、配方百分数，以及法律文本中的 attends，呈现不同词汇触发。

patterns.name: 缩写式否定问候或评论中的 it’s
patterns.context: 口语文本中 it’s 后接原因、判断或评价；周围常有 think/why/another/funny 等表达
patterns.domain: 论坛对话、小说对白、书评及一般叙述

patterns.name: 专利设备描述中的 displays
patterns.context: LCD 设备作为显示器展示图像，前文列举设备属性和用途

patterns.name: 法律语境中的 attends
patterns.context: 描述被拘押者的日常生活活动及其安全照护措施

patterns.name: 专利配方中的百分数符号
patterns.context: 油品组成及按重量计的含量范围；数值后接百分数和配方成分

en.concept: Frequent syntactic collocations and function words
en.description: Activations are scattered: several passages highlight the preposition to and its following constituent, and they also often fall on high-frequency function words or collocations such as had/have/was/it/has; verbs and punctuation boundaries in patents, contracts, and narratives also activate, with no single stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: to in fixed collocations
patterns.context: Activation mainly falls on the preposition or infinitive marker to, especially when followed by the, a noun, or a verb; the local context does not require a specific meaning.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres including legal text, patents, medicine/public policy, narrative, and online text

patterns.name: Common function words and continuation of collocations
patterns.context: Activation occurs on common function words or high-frequency collocations in sentences; these are not always adjacent to the main to pattern and may reflect broad local lexical/syntactic features.
patterns.domain: Legal text, novels, medical narratives, patent specifications

patterns.name: Structural terms in patent specifications
patterns.context: Occurs in patent passages describing device components, material formulations, or the advantages and disadvantages of prior art; some strong activations fall on general verbs or syntactic markers.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent background and technical descriptions

patterns.name: Payment wording in contract clauses
patterns.context: A lease lists items payable in addition to rent; activations are distributed near payment, the payee, and clause labels.

patterns.name: Punctuation and line-break boundaries
patterns.context: Punctuation or paragraph/sentence boundaries are also marked and occur in different genres; they may be accompanying signals, with no stable semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Patents, legal text, and general text

patterns.name: Negation/permission expressions in narrative dialogue
patterns.context: Profane dialogue discusses sex and refusal; activations fall near common auxiliaries, pronouns, or contractions.

patterns.name: Factual judgments in narrative
patterns.context: Narration or dialogue makes judgments about events, explains a diagnosis, or exposes a forgery; overlaps with function-word/contraction collocations.

patterns.name: Online comment excerpt
patterns.context: An online comment follows a microwave discussion; activation occurs at the start of the comment and on common colloquial collocations, but there is no more specific shared trigger feature.

9_321.concept: 高频句法搭配与功能词
9_321.description: 激活较分散：多段突出介词 to 及其后接成分，也常落在 had/have/was/it/has 等高频功能词或搭配上；专利、合同和叙事中的动词、标点边界亦有激活，未见单一稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: 固定搭配中的 to
patterns.trigger: « to»（如 «to»1« the»1、«to»6« the»5、«to»3« Landlord»2、«to»5 mental health）
patterns.context: 主要激活在介词或不定式标记 to 后，尤其后接 the、名词或动词；局部上下文不要求特定语义。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、专利、医学/公共政策、叙事与网络文本等多种文体

patterns.name: 常见功能词与搭配延续
patterns.trigger: « had»、« have»、« was»、« been»、« it»、« has» 等
patterns.context: 在句中常见功能词或高频搭配处激活；与主模式的 to 并非总相邻，可能反映宽泛的局部词汇/句法特征。
patterns.domain: 法律、小说、病历叙述、专利说明书

patterns.name: 专利说明书中的结构性词项
patterns.context: 专利段落中描述装置构成、材料配方或现有技术优缺点时出现；部分强激活落在一般动词或句法标记上。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景与技术说明

patterns.name: 合同条款中的支付表述
patterns.context: 租赁合同列明租金之外应付项目，激活分布于支付、受领方及条款标签附近。

patterns.name: 标点与换行边界
patterns.context: 标点或段落/句子边界也被标记，且出现在不同体裁中；可能是伴随信号，缺少稳定语义条件。

patterns.name: 叙事对话中的否定/许可表达
patterns.trigger: « won»1't even « let»2 me « have»5 a wank；« it»1«'s»9 disgusting
patterns.context: 粗俗对话中谈及性与拒绝；激活落在常见助动词、代词或缩写附近。

patterns.name: 叙述中的事实判断
patterns.trigger: « it»5« was»9 dengue fever；« it»3«'s»9« a»1 fake
patterns.context: 叙述或对话对事件作判断、说明诊断或揭穿伪造；与功能词/缩写搭配重合。
patterns.domain: 个人经历叙述、小说剧情

patterns.name: 网络评论片段
patterns.context: 微波炉讨论后接网络评论；激活位于评论开头和常见口语搭配，但缺少更具体的共享触发特征。

en.description: Activations are scattered across several word types: protect and its objects, the colloquial contraction it’s, the preposition/infinitive marker to, the definite article the, and several isolated word forms and collocations. They occur across domains, with no stable semantic or syntactic pattern that explains all passages.

patterns.name: protect and its protected objects
patterns.context: When describing the function and purpose of materials, food/medicine, or judicial care, protect(s) is followed by the protected object; activation also extends to the immediately following object.

patterns.name: it’s in colloquial contractions
patterns.context: The contraction it’s in dialogue or informal writing, often in sentences expressing judgment, evaluation, or a reported opinion; activation falls on ’s.

patterns.name: to in phrases
patterns.context: The preposition or infinitive marker to connects expressions of rights, purposes, actions, or attribution; activation occurs across multiple syntactic functions.
patterns.domain: Public policy, law, patents, dialogue, and fiction

patterns.name: The high-frequency function word the
patterns.context: Ordinary definite-article usage in noun phrases; activation varies in strength and is often near stronger activations, but no single semantic condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: Research, forums, fiction, policy, and patents

patterns.name: Other local word forms or collocations
patterns.context: Scattered activations fall on subword fragments, auxiliary/noun collocations, contracted negatives, or common expressions; no stable shared condition emerges across passages.

9_321.description: 激活分散在多类词上：protect及其对象、口语缩写it’s、介词/不定式to、定冠词the，以及若干孤立词形和搭配。跨领域出现，尚无能统一解释全部段落的稳定语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: protect 及其保护对象
patterns.context: 在说明材料、食品/药物或司法照护的功能与目的时，protect(s) 后接被保护对象；激活也延伸到紧邻对象。

patterns.name: 口语缩写里的 it’s
patterns.context: 对话或非正式文字中的缩写 it’s，常出现在判断、评价或转述观点的句子里；激活落在 ’s 上。
patterns.domain: 小说对话、论坛、口语化建议

patterns.name: 短语中的 to
patterns.context: 介词或不定式标记 to，连接权利/目的/动作或归属表达；在多种句法功能中均见激活。
patterns.domain: 公共政策、法律、专利、对话与小说

patterns.name: 高频功能词 the
patterns.context: 普通定冠词用法，出现在名词短语中；强度不一，附近常有较强激活，但未见单一语义条件。
patterns.domain: 科研、论坛、小说、政策与专利

patterns.name: 其他局部词形或搭配
patterns.context: 零散激活分别落在词内片段、助动词/名词搭配及否定缩写或常见表达中；跨段未形成稳定共同条件。

en.description: Activations occur across multiple domains and genres: rights and freedoms, legal judgments, patent structures and performance, medical research and titles, project goals, and product advertising. Technical or research-effect descriptions are common locally, but no unified trigger pattern covers all passages.

patterns.name: Rights, freedoms, and related effects
patterns.context: Discusses the effects of policy measures or specific civil liberties; the noun phrase is introduced by to
patterns.domain: Public policy, law, and human rights

patterns.name: Component structure and figure descriptions in patent specifications
patterns.context: Describes device structure using figure numbers, component names, and positional relationships

patterns.name: Legal rulings and penalties in case law
patterns.context: Quotes an earlier court ruling and explains a penalty prescribed by statute

patterns.name: Performance, compatibility, and material properties of patent technology
patterns.context: Evaluates the performance, compatibility, surface morphology, and effects of materials, devices, or processes
patterns.domain: Patent technical background and invention descriptions

patterns.name: Treatment effects and measures in biomedical research
patterns.context: Reports the effects of a drug or intervention on a disease or tissue measure and gives experimental results

patterns.name: Project goals and protective function
patterns.context: Begins with a project objective and describes the protective use of a material to be developed

patterns.name: Disease prevention and treatment research titles
patterns.context: Uses an Effects of... structure to state a research topic on the effects of diet or supplements on disease prevention or treatment

patterns.name: Display device properties and uses
patterns.context: Lists display advantages and explains their operating principle or application

patterns.name: Cooling performance in product advertising
patterns.context: Introduces a product name and promotes long-lasting cooling; the wording is brief and promotional

9_321.description: 激活分布于多种领域与文体：权利自由、法律判决、专利结构及性能、医学研究与标题、项目目标和商品宣传。局部常见技术或研究效果表述，但没有覆盖所有段落的统一触发模式。

patterns.name: 权利、自由及相关影响
patterns.trigger: « to»« mental» health；« to»« the»« freedoms» of» movement, residence, assembly
patterns.context: 讨论政策措施造成的影响，或具体公民自由；名词短语由 to 引出

patterns.name: 专利说明书中的部件结构与附图描述
patterns.trigger: «FIG»...；«air cleaner»...« includes»...« body portion»...« air inlet»
patterns.context: 以图号、部件名称和位置关系说明装置结构
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术／技术说明

patterns.name: 判例中的法律裁定与处罚
patterns.trigger: « held» that»...；« punishment» of»... state officer guilty of malpractice
patterns.context: 引述法院先前判决，并说明法律条文规定的处罚

patterns.name: 专利技术的性能、兼容性及材料性质
patterns.trigger: « fails» to» provide»... sensitivity or stability；« has» substantially»... no»... problem；« substantially» flat»
patterns.context: 评价材料、器件或工艺的性能、兼容性、表面形态及效果
patterns.domain: 专利技术背景与发明说明

patterns.name: 生物医学研究中的治疗效果与指标
patterns.trigger: « has» the» most»... effect；« elevated» the»... brain water content
patterns.context: 报告药物或干预对疾病、组织指标的作用及实验结果

patterns.name: 研究项目目标及防护功能
patterns.trigger: «The» long term objective...；« protects» lead-pigmented paint
patterns.context: 以项目目标开篇，描述拟开发材料的保护用途

patterns.name: 疾病预防与治疗研究标题
patterns.trigger: «Effects» of» the» consumption...« prevention» and» treatment»
patterns.context: 以 Effects of... 结构陈述饮食或补充剂对疾病防治的研究主题
patterns.domain: 医学论文标题／摘要片段

patterns.name: 显示设备的特性与用途
patterns.trigger: « image» quality；« low» power consumption；« LCD» device» displays»
patterns.context: 列举显示器优点，并说明其显示原理或应用

patterns.name: 商品宣传中的保冷功效
patterns.trigger: «YETI Colster»...« keeps» cans and bottles so cold
patterns.context: 以产品名引出保冷时间长的卖点，语气简短宣传化

en.description: Covers expressions of protection, descriptions of patent properties, the referential use of “its,” and sporadic words in biomedical and legal contexts. Triggers are scattered, with no unifying condition beyond local phrases.

patterns.name: Protection-related expressions
patterns.context: Expressions involving protection and its object; [1] is privacy, [2] is lead pigment, and [5] is the developing rat cerebral cortex.
patterns.domain: Technology reviews, materials research, nutrition, and neuroscience

patterns.name: Descriptions of properties or degree in patents
patterns.context: Describes material or device properties in patent background text; [3] is followed by properties such as low resistance and high relative values, [4] describes the terminal surface, and [7] describes compatibility.

patterns.name: “its” as reference or possession
patterns.context: The pronoun refers to an object mentioned earlier: [1] refers to a proprietary product, and [8] refers to an intermediate stage in a quotation.

patterns.name: Specific terms or noun phrases
patterns.context: Activation falls on local words from different topics: [6] is “the small intestine,” [9] concerns prevention and treatment, and [10] is the right to a jury trial. No shared stable lexical meaning or syntactic condition is apparent.

9_321.description: 覆盖保护表达、专利性质描述、“its”指代，以及生物医学和法律语境中的零散词语；触发分散，除局部词组外缺少统一条件。

patterns.name: 保护相关表达
patterns.context: 出现保护及其对象的表达；[1]为隐私，[2]为铅颜料，[5]为发育中的大鼠大脑皮层。
patterns.domain: 科技评论、材料研究、营养与神经科学

patterns.name: 专利中的性质或程度描述
patterns.context: 专利背景文本中描述材料或设备的性质；[3]接低电阻、高相对值等性质，[4]描述终端表面，[7]描述兼容性。

patterns.name: “its”指代或所有关系
patterns.context: 代词指向前文对象：[1]指专有产品，[8]指引文中的中间阶段。

patterns.name: 特定术语或名词短语
patterns.context: 激活落在不同主题中的局部词语：[6]为“the small intestine”，[9]涉及预防与治疗，[10]为陪审团审判权利；看不出共同的稳定词义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、法律论述

en.concept: Descriptions of properties and functions of technical objects
en.description: Activations often occur in nominal, relational, and property descriptions in technical text: describing the composition or position of components or materials, processes and results, protective functions, or performance evaluations; patent-style terminology and clauses often accompany them.

patterns.name: Relational or property descriptions in patent technical background
patterns.context: In patent backgrounds or specifications, a technical noun is the subject of descriptions of components, materials, structures, and their positions, composition, or properties; multi-layer modifiers and numbering are common.

patterns.name: Material preparation and process results
patterns.context: Discusses materials, chemical processes, or manufacturing processes, especially products, reaction byproducts, and their properties or effects.
patterns.domain: Patent technical descriptions; materials and chemistry

patterns.name: Protection and its object
patterns.context: Descriptions of the protective function of a material or structure; protect is followed by the protected object or area, often in accounts of research aims or experimental results.

patterns.name: Performance deficiencies or suitability evaluations
patterns.context: Evaluates the performance, stability, sensitivity, or compatibility of materials or compounds, often through comparisons, deficiencies, or negative statements.

9_321.concept: 技术对象的属性与功能陈述
9_321.description: 激活多见于技术说明中的名词化、关系与性质陈述：描述部件或材料的构成位置、工艺及结果、保护功能，或评价性能；常伴随专利式术语和从句。

patterns.name: 专利技术背景中的关系或性质陈述
patterns.context: 专利背景或说明书中，以技术名词为主语，描述部件、材料、结构及其位置、组成或性质；常见多层定语和编号。

patterns.name: 材料制备与工艺结果
patterns.context: 讨论材料、化学过程或加工工艺，特别是产物、反应副产物及其性质或影响。
patterns.domain: 专利技术说明；材料与化学

patterns.name: 保护及其作用对象
patterns.trigger: “encapsulant which not only protects lead-pigmented paint”、“molecules which only protect the near-surface region”
patterns.context: 保护材料或结构的功能描述；protect 后接被保护对象或区域，常处于研究目的或实验结果的叙述中。

patterns.name: 性能不足或适用性评价
patterns.trigger: “fails to provide a sufficiently acceptable sensitivity or stability”、“has substantially no particular problem regarding the compatibility”
patterns.context: 评价材料或化合物的性能、稳定性、灵敏度或相容性，常以对比、缺陷或否定性表述出现。

en.description: Most passages activate at has, involving an object possessing an attribute, structure, or reaction outcome. There are also activations at its in two distinct expressions, and at but in the contrastive supplementary structure not only… but….

patterns.name: has after a nominal constituent
patterns.context: In relative clauses or statements describing an object, material, product, or reaction, the trigger is has, usually preceded by a nominal subject and followed by an attribute, structure, or result.
patterns.domain: Mainly patent technical backgrounds and specifications; also general narrative

patterns.name: Emphatic structures after its
patterns.context: A pronoun its is followed by a nominal or superlative expression, especially structures like “its the middle” and “its most …”; activation falls on its rather than the following content.

patterns.name: Contrastive but in quotations
patterns.context: In the “not only … but …” structure, but introduces a supplementary effect contrasting with the preceding item.

9_321.description: 多数段落在 has 处激活，涉及对象具有某种属性、结构或反应结果；另有 its 处于两种不同表达中的激活，以及 not only… but… 转折补充结构中的 but 激活。

patterns.name: 名词性成分后的 has
patterns.trigger: “has”标记为9；其前常见 “which has”“product has”“reaction generally has”
patterns.context: 在描述对象、材料、产品或反应的关系从句或陈述中，触发点是 has，前面通常有名词主语；后续接属性、结构或结果。
patterns.domain: 专利技术背景与说明书为主，也见一般叙述

patterns.name: its 后的强调结构
patterns.trigger: “its”标记为9；第3段为 “its the middle”，第4段为 “At its most”
patterns.context: 代词 its 后接名词性或最高级表达，尤其是 “its the middle”“its most …” 一类结构；激活落在 its 而不是后续内容。

patterns.name: 引语中的 but 对照
patterns.context: 在 “not only … but …” 结构中，but 引出与前项相对的补充效果。

en.concept: Descriptions of methods, properties, and structures in technical literature
en.description: Activations concentrate around statistical methods and significance statements in papers, descriptions of patent device structures, and statements about protective materials or activity/properties retained after modification; fixed patent opening boilerplate may also contribute independently.
