patterns.name: Statistical analysis and significance reporting
patterns.context: Near statistical analysis methods, test selection, result reporting, or significance thresholds; includes names of statistical tests, analysis methods, and P/p-value expressions.
patterns.domain: Methods and results in biomedical papers

patterns.name: Structure formation and device descriptions in patents
patterns.context: Describes the formation and positions of semiconductor device layers, pads, openings, or display device components; activation often occurs near the article “an” and the following noun phrase.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent background and invention descriptions

patterns.name: Protective coatings and material applications
patterns.context: Introduces research goals and the protective effect of a material on a specific object.

patterns.name: Retention of activity or functional properties
patterns.context: Describes compound analogs, cells, or molecules retaining their original activity, capability, or properties after modification, treatment, or binding.

patterns.name: Unexplained truncated patent-background fragment
patterns.context: Fixed opening boilerplate in a patent; although it shares the patent genre with the device topic in paragraph 3, the activation position may also reflect the boilerplate itself.

9_321.concept: 技术文献中的方法、性质与结构陈述
9_321.description: 激活集中于论文统计方法与显著性表述、专利器件结构描述，也见于保护性材料和改造后仍保留活性或性质的表述；专利固定开篇套语可能另有贡献。

patterns.name: 统计分析及显著性报告
patterns.trigger: “statistical analysis”“All statistical analyses”“one-way ANOVA”“Kruskal-Wallis”“post hoc test”“P”“p value”
patterns.context: 统计分析方法、检验选择、结果汇报或显著性阈值附近；包括统计检验名称、分析方法及 P/p 数值表达。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文的方法与结果

patterns.name: 专利中的结构形成与器件描述
patterns.trigger: “is formed on”“opening in the region”“bonding pad”“polarizing plate”
patterns.context: 描述半导体器件层、焊盘、开口或显示器件部件的形成和位置；激活常出现在冠词“an”及其后续名词短语附近。

patterns.name: 保护性涂层与材料用途
patterns.context: 介绍研究目标及材料对特定对象的保护作用。

patterns.name: 保留活性或功能性质
patterns.trigger: “retains the sub-nanomolar potency”“retain self-renewal”“retains its spectroscopic and functional properties”
patterns.context: 描述化合物类似物、细胞或分子在改造、处理或连接后仍保有原有活性、能力或性质。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究摘要与论文

patterns.name: 未解释的专利背景截断片段
patterns.trigger: “Field of the Invention”“present invention relates to”
patterns.context: 专利固定开篇套语；虽与段3的器件主题同属专利文体，但激活位置也可能反映该套语本身。

en.concept: descriptions of entity structure and properties
en.description: Most activations occur in descriptions of the composition, structure, regions, and properties of materials, devices, or biological entities, especially formed/has/having/containing in patents. Other patterns include research objectives, appearance classifications, and forum-based visual evaluations.

patterns.name: Construction and properties of materials/devices in patents
patterns.context: Patent background or invention descriptions explain the structure, composition, properties, and function of a device, material, or product; trigger words often occur in “has/having/containing” after nouns and in structural descriptions.

patterns.name: Composition or core structure of materials/substances
patterns.context: Explains what components a substance consists of, or that a component is located at its core; here, calcium phosphate/apatite in calcium oxalate stones.

patterns.name: Biomedical research objectives and protective functions
patterns.context: Research plans or abstracts state long-term objectives and describe what an item protects.

patterns.name: Parts and regions in appearance descriptions
patterns.context: Describes the size and color of an anatomical or illustrated region, followed by details of local areas.

patterns.name: Appearance classification and perceptual evaluation
patterns.context: Informal discussions make category associations about visual objects, evaluate their appearance, or discuss reclassification.

9_321.concept: 实体的结构与属性描述
9_321.description: 多数激活出现在材料、器件或生物实体的组成、结构、区域及性质描述中，尤其是专利里的 formed/has/having/containing；另有研究目标、外观分类和论坛视觉评价等少数模式。

patterns.name: 专利中的材料/器件构造与性质
patterns.trigger: “is formed on”“has an opening”“has a multi-layer structure”“having an enhanced light leakage”“containing a water-dispersible pigment”“silicon-containing polymer”
patterns.context: 专利背景或发明描述中，围绕器件、材料或产品说明结构、组成、性质及功能；触发词常见于名词后的“has/having/containing”及结构描述。

patterns.name: 材料/物质的组成或核心结构
patterns.context: 说明物质由何种成分构成，或某成分位于其核心；此处为草酸钙结石中的磷酸钙/磷灰石。

patterns.name: 生物医学研究目标与保护功能
patterns.context: 研究计划或摘要中陈述长期目标，并描述材料保护对象的功能。

patterns.name: 外观描述中的部位与区域
patterns.context: 以解剖或图示区域为对象，连续描述尺寸、颜色及局部区域。

patterns.name: 外观分类与感知评价
patterns.context: 非正式讨论中对视觉对象进行类别联想、外观评价或反分类讨论。

en.description: Activations are distributed across contexts including patent structures and imaging, insect morphology, program and forum narratives, pharmacology and nutrition research, literary criticism, and medical statistics. Trigger words and semantic functions differ markedly across segments, with no stable shared lexical meaning or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Patent structural description
patterns.context: Describes the structure and relative positions of insulating films, glass coatings, and pads

patterns.name: Moth wing-pattern terminology
patterns.context: Describes wing color, wingspan, and pattern regions; “dis” is the initial fragment of discal

patterns.name: Program team activities
patterns.context: Introduces a program in which each episode features a team of paranormal enthusiasts and skeptics working together

patterns.name: Agreement with an HN opinion
patterns.context: A commenter expresses agreement and discusses the development of Hacker News

patterns.name: Protecting lead-based pigments
patterns.context: The research goal is to develop encapsulation materials that can protect lead-based pigments

patterns.name: Statement of drug properties
patterns.context: States that Ajulemic acid derivatives retain analgesic and anti-inflammatory properties

patterns.name: Effects of vitamin deficiency
patterns.context: Compares animal responses to vitamin A deficiency and describes changes in the chicken small intestine

patterns.name: Narrative of protest experience
patterns.context: Recounts Grace Paley spending several days in prison because of a protest

patterns.name: SEM imaging description
patterns.context: Discusses imaging conditions and the signal-to-noise ratio of scanning electron microscope images

patterns.name: Statistical results format
patterns.context: Describes how data such as bone density are presented and identifies the statistical software used

9_321.description: 激活分散于专利结构与成像、昆虫形态、节目和论坛叙述、药理与营养研究、文学评论及医学统计等语境；各段触发词和语义功能差异明显，未见稳定共享的词义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 专利结构描述
patterns.context: 描述绝缘膜、玻璃涂层与焊盘的结构及其相对位置

patterns.name: 蛾翅斑纹术语
patterns.context: 描述翅膀颜色、翼展和斑纹区域；“dis”是 discal 的词首片段

patterns.name: 节目团队活动
patterns.context: 介绍节目每集由超自然现象爱好者和怀疑者组成的团队共同活动

patterns.name: HN 观点认同
patterns.context: 评论者表达认同，并谈论 Hacker News 的发展

patterns.name: 保护含铅颜料
patterns.context: 研究目标是研发可保护含铅颜料的封装材料

patterns.name: 药物性质陈述
patterns.context: 说明 Ajulemic acid 衍生物保留镇痛和抗炎性质

patterns.name: 维生素缺乏效应
patterns.context: 比较动物对维生素 A 缺乏的反应，并描述鸡的小肠变化

patterns.name: 抗议经历叙述
patterns.context: 叙述 Grace Paley 因抗议而在监狱度过数日

patterns.name: SEM 成像说明
patterns.context: 讨论扫描电子显微镜图像的成像条件与信噪比

patterns.name: 统计结果格式
patterns.trigger: «range»9；«All data» ... mean, standard deviation and range
patterns.context: 交代骨密度等数据的呈现方式及统计软件

en.concept: relational and property descriptions in expository texts
en.description: Activations are distributed across several types of expository text: academic statistics and numerical reporting, scientific material and morphology descriptions, patent components and spatial relations, and narrative and literary reviews. Some passages share technical terminology or structural descriptions, but there is no single clear trigger pattern covering all the data.

patterns.name: Statistical analysis and numerical reporting
patterns.context: Academic expressions concerning analysis software, p-values, statistical tests, or summary data in methods or results sections.

patterns.name: Local collocations in nominal technical descriptions
patterns.context: Technical or expository text describing components, regions, morphology, or position; no stable shared trigger word is apparent across passages.

patterns.name: Patent structure and component descriptions
patterns.context: Patent background or technical explanations list device materials, layers, components, and their spatial relations.

patterns.name: Materials, morphology, and composition in scientific texts
patterns.context: Papers report nanoparticle properties or describe the mineral composition and structure of stones.
patterns.domain: Pharmaceutics, biomedicine, and mineral composition research

patterns.name: Characters and attention in narrative
patterns.context: Narrative text describes a character’s judgment of events and behavioral tendencies.

patterns.name: Biographical protest narratives in literary criticism
patterns.context: Reviews or essays quote a writer’s work and mention their protest activities.

9_321.concept: 说明性文本中的关系与属性描述
9_321.description: 激活分布于多类说明性文本：学术统计与数值报告、科学材料和形态描述、专利部件及空间关系，以及叙事和文学评论。部分片段共享技术名词或结构描述，但没有覆盖所有语料的单一明确触发模式。

patterns.name: 统计分析与数值报告
patterns.trigger: “Statistical Analysis”“All statistical analyses were performed using SPSS version 16/22”“p<0.305”“means ± standard deviation”
patterns.context: 统计方法或结果段中，围绕分析软件、p 值、统计检验或汇总数据的学术表达。

patterns.name: 名词性技术描述中的局部搭配
patterns.trigger: “the ground colour”“the dis…cal and postdiscal areas”“a lighter pattern”“an opening in the region”
patterns.context: 技术或说明性文字中，描述部件、区域、形态或位置；片段间未见稳定的共同触发词。
patterns.domain: 维基百科自然史描述、专利

patterns.name: 专利结构与部件说明
patterns.trigger: “liquid-pervious topsheet”“liquid-impervious backsheet”“liquid-absorbent core”“penis insertion mouth”；“formed on”“bonding pad”“glass coat”
patterns.context: 专利背景或技术说明中列举器件材料、层、部件及其空间关系。

patterns.name: 科学文本中的材料、形态与组成
patterns.context: 论文中报告纳米颗粒性质，或说明结石矿物组成及结构。
patterns.domain: 药剂学、生物医学与矿物组成研究

patterns.name: 叙事中的人物与注意力描述
patterns.trigger: “Anna is certain her parents were killed in the fire”“spends the least amount of time focusing on searching”
patterns.context: 叙事性文字中描述人物对事件的判断及行为倾向。

patterns.name: 文学评论中的传记性抗议叙述
patterns.trigger: “Grace Paley Reader”“writing from behind the bars”“spent six days for protesting”
patterns.context: 评论或随笔中引用作家作品，并提及其抗议经历。

en.description: Activations are distributed across scientific, patent, and encyclopedia texts, with a local preference for the lower bound “at least,” expressions of position/structure, and section or entry formatting. Other isolated examples include wing terminology, statistical thresholds, retain, and cast lists; overall, there is no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Qualifier in anatomical terminology
patterns.context: When describing a stone’s composition, the phrase “at its core” indicates the mineral’s location within the core; the strong activation in this example falls on core in “10 core”.

patterns.name: Statistical threshold and decimal value
patterns.context: In a statistical analysis section, strong activation occurs near the p-value and decimal number, peaking on “10 p”; this threshold expression does not recur elsewhere.

patterns.name: Retain meaning preserve or contain
patterns.context: In a description of flower color changes, indicates that a feature remains after a transition; the highest activation falls on the definite article “the” that follows it.

patterns.name: Lower-bound quantity in patent claims
patterns.context: In a description of semiconductor device structures, “at least one” introduces a selected constituent layer or material; strong activation falls on least.

patterns.name: Upper-end position in patent structural description
patterns.context: Describes a bag’s construction and opening position, specifying that the opening is at the upper end; the highest activation falls on upper.

patterns.name: Minimum quantity and dimension constraints in a patent
patterns.context: In a description of an invention concerning metal pipes and their manufacture, “at least two” specifies the number of inner diameters of irregular pipes; the highest activation is on least.

patterns.name: Recurring quantity or dimension qualifier least
patterns.context: Patent technical descriptions use “at least” to express a lower bound; “at an interval” and “large diameter” also occur in descriptions of dimensions and spacing, but it is unclear whether they belong to the same trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Local-region term on butterfly wings
patterns.context: A specialized wing-region term appears in a description of forewing color patterns; the strongest activation is on “the” and a fragment associated with “discal”.

patterns.name: Statistics-methods section in heading style
patterns.context: A heading in a research paper’s methods section is followed by statistical software and a significance threshold; the specific peak falls on “p<0.305”.

patterns.name: Histology section heading in a paper
patterns.context: A section heading in experimental results or methods is followed by a description of brain tissue processing; strong activation also occurs after the heading on “the end”.

patterns.name: Characters and seasons in a Wikipedia cast list
patterns.context: A television cast list gives the actor’s role and seasons after each name; activations cluster near line breaks in the entries and on “Recurring”.

patterns.name: Common articles and positional expressions across mixed domains
patterns.context: In a wing description, strong activation occurs near the article and prepositional phrase “in the”; the example also contains a distinctive wing term, so it is unclear whether the article itself is an independent trigger.

9_321.description: 激活分布于多类科学、专利和百科文本，局部偏好数量下限“at least”、位置/结构表达及章节或条目格式；另有翅部术语、统计阈值、retain、角色名单等单例，整体未显示统一语义触发。

patterns.name: 解剖学术语中的限定词
patterns.context: 描述结石成分时，短语“at its core”引出矿物位于核心的部位关系；本例强激活落在“10 core”中的 core。

patterns.name: 统计阈值与数字小数
patterns.context: 统计分析段落中，p 值及小数数字附近出现强激活，最高落在“10 p”；未见其他段复现此阈值表达。

patterns.name: 表示保留或包含的 retain
patterns.context: 花朵颜色变化的描述中，表示转变后仍保有某特征；最高激活落在其后定冠词“the”。

patterns.name: 专利权利要求中的数量下限
patterns.context: 半导体器件结构描述中，以“at least one”引入选取的组成层或材料；强激活落在 least。

patterns.name: 专利结构描述中的上端位置
patterns.context: 描述袋体的构造及开口位置时，指出开口位于上端；最高激活落在 upper。

patterns.name: 专利中的最小数量与尺寸限定
patterns.context: 金属管及制造方法的发明领域描述，以至少两个限定不规则管的内径数量；最高激活在 least。

patterns.name: 反复出现的数量或尺寸限定词 least
patterns.context: 专利技术描述中以“at least”表达下限；另见“at an interval”及“large diameter”等尺寸、间距描述，但是否属于同一触发模式不确定。

patterns.name: 蝶翅上的局部区域词
patterns.context: 描述前翅颜色图案时，出现专门的翅面区域术语；最强激活在“the”以及“discal”相关片段。

patterns.name: 标题式统计方法章节
patterns.context: 实验论文的方法部分标题及其后统计软件和显著性阈值；具体峰值落在“p<0.305”。

patterns.name: 论文中的组织学章节标题
patterns.context: 实验结果或方法文本中的章节标题，后接脑组织处理描述；主要强激活也出现在标题之后的“the end”。

patterns.name: 维基人物出演名单的角色与季数
patterns.context: 电视角色列表中，姓名后列出演员饰演角色及出演季数；激活集中在条目换行附近和“Recurring”。

patterns.name: 领域混杂的常见冠词和位置表达
patterns.context: 在翅膀描述中冠词和介词短语“in the”附近激活很强；除此之外该例还含独特的翅部术语，无法确认冠词本身是独立触发条件。

en.concept: Structural and positional descriptions in expository text
en.description: Activations span various types of expository text: the definite article the recurs, along with end or edge positions, and content related to biological morphology, engineering structures, experimental stages, scientific results, and mathematical notation. Other domain-specific patterns concern mining processes, algorithms, and stone composition; no single semantic trigger explains all segments.

patterns.name: Definite article the in descriptive text
patterns.context: The definite article is followed by the object, part, property, or process stage being described; it may also be an ordinary grammatical element and cannot by itself explain all activations.
patterns.domain: Expository genres including encyclopedias, patents, and scientific papers

patterns.name: End or edge position
patterns.context: Refers to an object’s end, edge, or experimental endpoint when describing a structure, experimental time point, or morphological feature.
patterns.domain: Patents, medical papers, and descriptions of plant or animal morphology

patterns.name: Anatomical/morphological parts and features
patterns.context: Lists body parts, morphology, and texture in noun phrases; may include precise dimensions or local regions.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic descriptions of insect, plant, and other biological morphology

patterns.name: Engineering components and geometric positions
patterns.context: Describes the shape and relative positions of components such as cylinders, openings, and keyways, or the structure of an insertion end.
patterns.domain: Patent technical background or mechanical-structure description

patterns.name: Experimental/process endpoint or stage
patterns.context: Organizes a narrative by a time endpoint or procedural stage, rather than merely describing a spatial location.
patterns.domain: Medical experiment reports and statistics or machine-learning methods papers

patterns.name: Academic section headings and line-break separators
patterns.context: Activations occur near section headings, Markdown-style separators, or paragraph boundaries.

patterns.name: Math problems and symbols
patterns.context: Algebraic equations, variables, and repeated problem-solving instructions; activations are distributed across problem symbols and text.

patterns.name: Vein mining and vertical extension
patterns.context: Describes mining along inclined veins, extracting ore from horizontal drifts, and extending to greater depths.

patterns.name: Chemical substances and stone composition
patterns.context: Describes calcium phosphate/apatite composition in calcium oxalate stones and its position in the stone core.

patterns.name: Statistical measures and results
patterns.context: Reports experimental measurements and their expression as percentages.

patterns.name: Algorithm steps and variable selection
patterns.context: Discusses grouping structures in high-dimensional problems and describes a multistage algorithmic process.

9_321.concept: 说明性文本中的结构与位置描述
9_321.description: 激活覆盖多种说明性文本：反复出现定冠词the、末端或边缘位置，以及生物形态、工程结构、实验阶段、科学结果和数学符号等；另有矿业过程、算法和结石成分等领域特异模式，未见能解释全部片段的单一语义触发。

patterns.name: 描述性文本中的定冠词 the
patterns.trigger: «The»、«the»，尤见于 «the» 后接名词或名词短语
patterns.context: 句中定冠词后接被描述对象、部位、性质或流程阶段；该形式也可能只是一般语法成分，无法单独解释全部激活。
patterns.domain: 百科、专利、科学论文等说明性文体

patterns.name: 末端或边缘位置
patterns.context: 在描述结构、实验时间点或形态特征时，指对象的末端、边缘或实验终点。
patterns.domain: 专利、医学论文、植物或动物形态描述

patterns.name: 解剖／形态部位与特征
patterns.context: 以名词短语罗列生物个体的身体部位、形态和纹理；有时包含精确尺寸或局部区域。
patterns.domain: 百科全书式昆虫、植物及其他生物形态描述

patterns.name: 工程部件与几何位置
patterns.context: 说明圆柱、开口、键槽等部件的形状、相对位置或插入端结构。
patterns.domain: 专利技术背景或机械结构说明

patterns.name: 实验／过程的终点或阶段
patterns.context: 以时间终点或步骤阶段组织叙述，而非单纯描述空间部位。
patterns.domain: 医学实验报告、统计或机器学习方法论文

patterns.name: 学术章节标题与换行分隔
patterns.trigger: «Histopathological studies»、«Antioxidant status»、«Description»，以及 «↵» 后的标题／横线
patterns.context: 激活出现在章节标题、Markdown 式分隔线或段落边界附近。

patterns.name: 数学题与符号运算
patterns.context: 代数方程、变量和重复出现的解题指令；激活标记分布于题目符号和文字中。

patterns.name: 矿脉开采与垂直延伸
patterns.context: 讲述沿倾斜矿脉采掘、由水平巷道回采及向更深处延伸的过程。

patterns.name: 化学物质与结石成分
patterns.context: 描述草酸钙结石的磷酸钙／磷灰石组成及其在结石核心的位置。

patterns.name: 统计量及结果表述
patterns.context: 报告实验测量结果及其百分比表达。

patterns.name: 算法步骤与变量选择
patterns.context: 讨论高维问题中的分组结构，并说明多阶段算法流程。

en.description: Activations span several types of text: Let/Suppose introducing symbols, functions, and equations in math problems is prominent. Other examples include biological morphology, patent components, climate narratives, and experimental methods; the non-mathematical passages cover unrelated topics.

patterns.name: The mathematical prompt word Let
patterns.context: Introduces variables, functions, or equations in math problems, especially Let/Suppose followed by a symbol, definition, or equality. Activation sometimes falls on the introductory word or the immediately following variable.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and expressions
patterns.context: Variables, functions, arithmetic expressions, and equations occur densely, often adjacent to problem instructions or definitions; this co-occurs with the Let pattern but can also occur independently.

patterns.name: Regional terms in wing-vein/wing-surface descriptions
patterns.context: Describes the size, color, and wing-surface regions of insect wings.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia biological taxonomy or morphology descriptions

patterns.name: Absorbent product components and structure in patents
patterns.context: Patent-style structural language describes a bag, layers, and their uses or openings.

patterns.name: Climate and rainy-season narratives
patterns.context: Describes high temperatures, humidity, rainfall, and the duration of the rainy season by month, then shifts to government and political headings.

patterns.name: Unit-digit questions in math problems
patterns.context: Asks for the units digit of an expression, followed by a Let definition for a new problem.

patterns.name: Shape, surface, and protrusion descriptions of biological morphology
patterns.context: Describes biological morphology in terms of length, body shape, dorsal surface, ridges, and protrusions.

patterns.name: Experimental methods and behavioral procedure headings
patterns.context: Reports animal control groups, dosing schedules, and the rationale for doses, followed by a behavioral procedure subsection heading.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central experimental paper methods sections

9_321.concept: 结构化定义与描述文本
9_321.description: 激活覆盖多类文本：突出数学题中 Let/Suppose 引入符号、函数和方程；另见生物形态描述、专利部件、气候叙述及实验方法等，非数学段落彼此主题各异。

patterns.name: 数学题引导词 Let
patterns.context: 数学题中引入变量、函数或方程；尤其是 Let/Suppose 后接符号、定义或等式。激活有时落在引导词或紧随的变量上。

patterns.name: 数学符号与表达式
patterns.context: 变量、函数、算术表达式及方程密集出现，常与题目指令或定义相邻；与 Let 模式共现，但也可能独立出现。

patterns.name: 翅脉／翅面描述中的区域术语
patterns.context: 描述昆虫翅膀的尺寸、颜色和翅面区域。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 生物分类或形态描述

patterns.name: 专利中的吸收用品部件与结构
patterns.context: 以专利式结构语言说明袋体、片层及其用途或开口。

patterns.name: 气候与降雨季节叙述
patterns.context: 按月份叙述高温、湿度、降雨及雨季延续时间，随后转入政府与政治标题。

patterns.name: 数学题中的单位数字提问
patterns.context: 询问表达式的个位数字，后接新题的 Let 定义。

patterns.name: 生物形态的外形、表面与突起描述
patterns.trigger: “Body elongate-elliptical”、“ends equally rounded”、“finely reticulated ridges”及“distinct knobs”
patterns.context: 按长度、体形、背部表面及脊和突起描述生物形态。

patterns.name: 实验方法与行为程序标题
patterns.context: 交代动物对照组、给药安排和剂量依据，之后出现行为程序小节标题。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 实验论文方法部分

en.description: Activations mix English function words and punctuation formatting, mathematical expressions and problem templates, patent components and dimension descriptions, and vocabulary from biomedical experiments, stone composition, and materials processing; no stable semantic theme explains all segments.

patterns.name: Local punctuation/formatting symbols
patterns.context: Near patent numbers, mathematical line breaks, or document-structure markers; activations fall on formatting symbols rather than stable semantic words.
patterns.domain: Formatting and boundaries in mixed corpora

patterns.name: English function words and phrase structure
patterns.context: Ordinary English syntax, especially articles, prepositions, copulas, and question structures; activations are distributed across common function words.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, patents, and math problems

patterns.name: Numbers, dimensions, and component relationships in patents
patterns.context: Numbers occur next to inch measurements, intervals, and component numbers, describing structures such as pipes and fins and their arrangement.

patterns.name: Insertion ends/direction and mechanical structures in patents
patterns.context: Describes specific structures and relative positions of openings, insertion ends, cylinders, or keyways in devices.

patterns.name: Numbers and operators in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: In polynomial expansions, algebraic expressions, or complex-number expressions, activations concentrate on arithmetic symbols and numbers; no single mathematical-object theme is evident.

patterns.name: Math problem instructions and question templates
patterns.context: Occurs in template sentences that give problem instructions, define functions, or ask for remainders, often adjacent to formulas.

patterns.name: Biomedical histology and sample processing
patterns.context: Experimental methods describe collecting tissue after animal euthanasia and necropsy, dissecting the aorta, and conducting analyses.

patterns.name: Biomedical stone composition
patterns.context: Discusses the composition and observations of calcium phosphate/apatite in the core of calcium oxalate stones.

patterns.name: Materials and surface treatment
patterns.context: Concerns material structures and processing, then shifts to a description of obtaining a hydrophilic surface.

patterns.name: Layered structure of hygiene products
patterns.context: Describes a product composed of a liquid-permeable topsheet, liquid-impermeable backsheet, and absorbent core; an insertion opening appears later.

9_321.description: 激活混合了英语功能词与标点格式、数学算式和题目模板、专利部件及尺寸描述，以及生物医学实验、结石成分和材料工艺词汇；没有一个稳定的语义主题能解释全部片段。

patterns.name: 局部标点/格式符号
patterns.context: 在专利编号、数学换行或文档结构标记附近；激活落在格式符号而非稳定语义词上。
patterns.domain: 混合语料的格式与边界

patterns.name: 英语功能词及短语结构
patterns.trigger: «It»、« is»、« to»、« a»、« of»、« in»、« the»、« at»、« when»
patterns.context: 普通英语句法中，尤其冠词、介词、系词和问句结构；激活分散在常见功能词上。

patterns.name: 专利中的数字、尺寸与部件关系
patterns.context: 数字与英寸尺寸、间隔、部件编号相邻，描述管、翅片等结构及其排列。

patterns.name: 专利中的插入端/方向与机械结构
patterns.trigger: « upper end»、« insertion mouth»、« insertion end»、« direction»、« cylinder»、« keyway»
patterns.context: 描述器具的开口、插入端、圆柱或键槽等具体结构及相对位置。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的数字与运算符
patterns.context: 在多项式展开、代数式或复数表达式中，激活集中于算术符号及数字，未见单一数学对象主题。

patterns.name: 数学题指令与设问模板
patterns.context: 出现在题目指令、定义函数或询问余数的模板句中，常与公式相邻。

patterns.name: 生物医学组织学与样本处理
patterns.trigger: « animals»、« euthan»、« arteries»、« organs»、« histology»、« aorta»、« section»
patterns.context: 动物处死和尸检后采集组织、解剖主动脉并进行分析的实验方法叙述。

patterns.name: 生物医学结石成分
patterns.trigger: « apatite»、« CaOx»、« Ca»、« P»、« stones»、« core»
patterns.context: 讨论草酸钙结石核心中磷酸钙/磷灰石的组成及观察结果。

patterns.name: 材料与表面处理
patterns.trigger: « Ge»、« Si MQWs»、« NSL»、« RIE»、« hydrophilic surface»
patterns.context: 涉及材料结构与工艺，随后转入获得亲水表面的表述。

patterns.name: 卫生用品的层状结构
patterns.trigger: « liquid-pervious»、« topsheet»、« liquid-impervious»、« backsheet»、« liquid-absorbent core»
patterns.context: 描述由透液表层、不透液底层及吸收芯构成的用品；后文出现插入开口。

en.concept: Boundaries and descriptive terms in structured technical text
en.description: Activations occur at sentence ends and section boundaries, around millimeter dimensions, morphological and geometric descriptions, animal experiments, and histological/medical terminology; they also appear sporadically in layered patent components, algebraic notation, and hydrophilic surfaces. Segment 5 lacks a confirmable shared trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Sentence-final punctuation and paragraph/section boundaries
patterns.context: In scientific or encyclopedic text, activations are especially strong near sentence-final punctuation, blank lines, and new section headings; the blank line in segment 1 reaches the highest strength of 10.
patterns.domain: Formatting structure in papers, encyclopedia entries, and technical texts

patterns.name: Millimeter units and dimension statements
patterns.context: Occurs when reporting lengths, dimensions, or measurements; the unit mm is marked, usually near a number or the measured object.

patterns.name: Morphological and geometric descriptions
patterns.context: Activates when describing the shape, surface structure, orientation, or relative dimensions of an entity, including animal morphology and objects at accident scenes.
patterns.domain: Natural-history descriptions and legal fact statements

patterns.name: Animal experiments and histology procedures
patterns.context: Methods sections involving animal handling, sample collection, histological examination, or experimental ethics approval.
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper methods and experimental results

patterns.name: Medical tissue, lesions, and inflammation terminology
patterns.context: Medical papers discuss organs, tissue, stone composition, or inflammation; this is not limited to animal-experiment procedures.

patterns.name: Layered materials/components listed in patents
patterns.context: Patent claims or background sections use compounds to list a product’s layers, materials, and their relative positions.

patterns.name: Algebraic expressions and variables
patterns.context: Math problems or solutions introduce variables and write polynomial or function expressions; the visible fragments are heterogeneous.

patterns.name: Hydrophilic surfaces in materials science
patterns.context: Occurs when discussing manufacturing or treating a material surface; the segment also contains section-boundary markers from a technical paper.

9_321.concept: 结构化技术文本中的边界与描述性术语
9_321.description: 激活分布于句末和章节边界、毫米尺寸、形态几何描述、动物实验及组织学/医学术语，并零星见于专利层状部件、代数记号和亲水表面；第5段缺少可确认的共同触发模式。

patterns.name: 句末标点及段落/章节边界
patterns.trigger: 句号 «.»、换行 «↵»，以及换行后章节标题开头，如 «An»giography analysis、«Description»、«Assessment»、«Immunohistochemical studies»
patterns.context: 科学或百科文本中，句末标点、空行和新章节标题附近激活尤强；第1段的空行处达到最高强度10。
patterns.domain: 论文、百科条目及技术文本的排版结构

patterns.name: 毫米单位及尺寸陈述
patterns.context: 在描述长度、尺寸或测量值时出现，单位 mm 被标记；其前后通常是数值或被测物体。
patterns.domain: 生物学、医学及自然史描述

patterns.name: 形态与几何形状描述
patterns.trigger: «elongate»-elliptical、«ends equally rounded»、«finely» reticulated «ridges»、«irregular» oval shape、«longest» side、«perpendicular»
patterns.context: 描述实体的外形、表面结构、方向或相对尺寸时激活，包含动物形态和事故现场物体。
patterns.domain: 自然史描述与法律事实陈述

patterns.name: 动物实验及组织学流程
patterns.trigger: «animals» were «euthan»ized、«autopsy»、«histology»、«Animal» Care and Use Committee、«Mice» were «sacrificed»、«tumors» were «harvested»
patterns.context: 涉及动物处置、取材、组织学检查或实验伦理审批的实验方法段落。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文方法与实验结果

patterns.name: 医学组织、病变与炎症术语
patterns.context: 医学论文中讨论器官、组织、结石成分或炎症；不局限于动物实验流程。

patterns.name: 专利中的层状材料/部件列举
patterns.context: 专利权利要求或背景技术中，以复合词列出产品的层、材料及相互位置关系。
patterns.domain: 专利与卫生用品结构描述

patterns.name: 代数表达式及变量
patterns.context: 数学题或解答中引入变量并书写多项式、函数表达式；可见片段较杂乱。

patterns.name: 材料科学中的亲水表面
patterns.context: 谈及通过工艺获得或处理材料表面时出现；该段同时含有技术论文中的章节边界标记。

en.description: Activations occur most consistently at line breaks, paragraph boundaries, and the section headings or new paragraph beginnings that follow, especially in encyclopedia and biomedical texts; activations on some body words do not fit a shared pattern.

patterns.name: Section heading immediately after a line break
patterns.context: A line break follows the end of a paragraph or list, followed by a section heading; activations cluster at the line break and around the heading.

patterns.name: Section heading after road and location information
patterns.context: In encyclopedia entries, body text about locations, transport, or facilities transitions via a line break to a heading or the start of a new paragraph; the trigger is not always the heading itself.

patterns.name: Paper subsection heading after a line break
patterns.context: A line break follows methods or results text and is immediately followed by a subsection heading such as immunohistochemistry or experimental analysis.

patterns.name: Line-break markers in experimental paragraphs
patterns.context: A line-break separator between the end of a paper paragraph and the next subsection; the specific heading content varies.

patterns.name: Specific paragraph-transition formatting
patterns.context: A formatting marker appears after a line break, followed by a heading; there is no apparent commonality in the heading meanings, suggesting a preference for a particular text layout or marker combination.

patterns.name: Local words in body text
patterns.context: These words are marked in body text across segments but occur in different semantic and syntactic contexts; no shared trigger condition can be confirmed.
patterns.domain: Patent, biomedical paper, and encyclopedia body text

9_321.description: 激活最一致地出现在换行、段落边界及其后的章节标题或新段起始处，尤其是百科与生物医学文本；若干正文词的激活无法归为同一规律。

patterns.name: 换行后紧邻章节标题
patterns.context: 段落或列表结束后出现换行，随后是章节标题；激活集中在换行及标题前后。

patterns.name: 道路与地点信息后的章节标题
patterns.context: 百科条目中地点、交通、设施等正文之后，以换行和标题或新段落起始词衔接；触发位置并不总是标题本身。

patterns.name: 换行后的论文小节标题
patterns.context: 方法或结果叙述后出现换行，紧接免疫组化、实验分析等小节标题。

patterns.name: 实验段落中的换行标记
patterns.context: 论文正文段末到下一小节之间的换行分隔；具体标题内容各异。

patterns.name: 特定段落衔接格式
patterns.context: 换行后出现格式标记，再接标题；与实际标题含义无明显共同点，可能偏向特定文本布局或标记组合。
patterns.domain: 百科条目及结构化语料

patterns.name: 正文中的局部词语
patterns.context: 这些词在各段正文中被标记，但分属不同语义和句法环境；未见可确认的共享触发条件。
patterns.domain: 专利、生物医学论文及百科正文

en.description: Activations occur on sentence-final punctuation, paragraph breaks and section headings, articles and subword fragments, as well as formulas, math problems, patent geometry descriptions, social hierarchies, insect morphology, and educational terminology. No consistent semantic or lexical condition emerges.

patterns.name: Sentence-final punctuation
patterns.context: At the end of methods or technical explanations, punctuation is often preceded by an abbreviation, parentheses, or units; however, punctuation activations are not consistently marked in the given text.

patterns.name: Line breaks before section headings
patterns.context: A blank line appears after a paragraph or methods description, followed by a new section heading; the opening word or heading itself is also marked.

patterns.name: Letter sequences in proper names
patterns.context: Activation falls within a tokenized word or on a local fragment; word classes and meanings are inconsistent.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial definite articles and local collocations
patterns.context: Ordinary noun phrases or sentence beginnings; sometimes near sections, descriptive nouns, or proper names, but with no consistent semantic condition.

patterns.name: Values, formulas, and mathematical symbols
patterns.context: Function definitions and equations in math problems, tire geometry descriptions in patents, or measurement formulas in papers; these passages have no single shared trigger symbol.

patterns.name: Highlighted relative-position word
patterns.context: Describes the ordering of social ranks, with a group occupying the highest level.

patterns.name: Taxonomic terms in biological descriptions
patterns.context: Describes the color and regions of insect wings; activation occurs within a morphological orientation term.

patterns.name: Emphasis words in multiword entries or headings
patterns.context: Phrases and section headings in educational project introductions or experimental papers receive activations; no stable shared collocation is apparent.

9_321.description: 激活分布在句末标点、段落换行与章节标题、冠词和词内片段，也见于公式、数学题、专利几何描述、社会层级、昆虫形态及教育术语；未形成一致语义或词法条件。

patterns.name: 句末标点
patterns.context: 方法或技术说明的句末，标点前常有缩写、括号或单位；不过标点的激活标记在给定文本中并不统一。

patterns.name: 章节标题前的换行
patterns.context: 段落或方法说明结束后出现空行，随后开始新章节标题；标题起始词或标题本身也被标记。

patterns.name: 专名中的字母组合
patterns.context: 激活落在被分词拆开的词内部或其局部片段，词类和语义并不一致。

patterns.name: 句首定冠词及局部搭配
patterns.context: 普通名词短语或新句开头；有时邻近章节、描述性名词或专名，但没有一致的语义条件。

patterns.name: 数值、公式与数学符号
patterns.context: 数学题中的函数定义与方程、专利中的轮胎几何说明，或论文中的测量公式；这些片段没有共同的单一触发符号。

patterns.name: 高亮的相对位置词
patterns.context: 描述社会等级次序时，表示某群体处于最高层级。

patterns.name: 生物学描述中的分类术语
patterns.context: 描述昆虫翅膀的颜色和区域，激活出现在形态学方位术语内部。

patterns.name: 多词条目或标题中的强调词
patterns.context: 教育项目介绍或实验论文中，短语及章节标题获得激活；未见稳定的共同搭配。

en.description: Strongly responds to location phrases in which “the” is followed by a local position, part, or structural noun, especially body parts, surfaces, exits, planes, and connection points. Common in morphology and experimental descriptions, and also found in facilities, patents, and research texts.

patterns.name: Anatomical locations and body parts
patterns.context: Describes colors, spots, morphology, or features on a part; the part term is often preceded by “at,” “on,” or another prepositional phrase

patterns.name: Spatial locations and facility parts
patterns.context: A location or facility part is included as an object of description or localization; the location term usually follows a preposition or possessive construction

patterns.name: Color and morphological appearance descriptions
patterns.context: Describes the color, texture, spots, and shape of an organism’s body, wings, tissue, or surface, often alongside body-part terms

patterns.name: Downstream or terminal part
patterns.context: Specifies an outlet or terminal position of a component in a technical device; the segment also contains a patent description of a non-contact region and imaging apparatus

patterns.name: Experimental subjects and tissue sites
patterns.context: Reports changes and observation sites in animal tissue, cultures, or plant organs in experiments or research results

patterns.name: Spatial planes and orientation
patterns.context: Describes the orientation of a measurement field using a plane; here it occurs in conditions for magnetic-field and NMR experiments

patterns.name: Neuromuscular structural location
patterns.context: Discusses a molecular interaction at a specific synaptic membrane or neuromuscular junction

patterns.name: Locative relation words and local structures
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on the article in a locative phrase and the following position, surface, or local-structure noun; the specific semantic domains vary across segments
patterns.domain: Expository and technical texts across multiple domains

9_321.description: 强烈响应“the”后接局部位置、部位或结构名词的定位短语，尤其是身体部位、表面、出口、平面及连接点；常见于形态与实验描述，也见于设施、专利和科研文本。

patterns.name: 解剖位置及身体部位
patterns.trigger: «the»9/«the»10 后接身体部位或解剖位置，如“«the»10« throat»”“«the»9« crown»”“«the»9« points»”
patterns.context: 描述某一部位上的颜色、斑点、形态或特征；部位词前常出现“at”“on”或介词短语

patterns.name: 空间位置与设施部位
patterns.trigger: “«the»10« south»bound”“«the»10« outlet»”以及“«the»9« station house»”等位置名词短语
patterns.context: 位置或设施部位作为描述、定位对象的一部分；位置词通常处在介词或所属结构之后
patterns.domain: 百科条目、专利技术文本

patterns.name: 颜色与形态外观描述
patterns.context: 描述物种身体、翅膀、组织或表面颜色、纹理、斑点及形状，常与身体部位词连用
patterns.domain: 动物学、植物学及形态学文体

patterns.name: 下游或末端部位
patterns.context: 技术装置中指明部件的出口或末端位置；该段同时含专利中的非接触区域及成像装置描述

patterns.name: 实验对象及组织部位
patterns.context: 实验或研究结果中报告动物组织、培养物或植物器官的变化及观察位置

patterns.name: 空间平面与取向
patterns.context: 用平面或方向描述测量场的取向；此处处在磁场及NMR实验条件中

patterns.name: 神经肌肉结构位置
patterns.context: 将分子相互作用置于特定突触膜或神经肌肉连接处讨论
patterns.domain: 神经科学与生物医学项目摘要

patterns.name: 部位关系词与局部结构
patterns.trigger: “«at»«the»10”“«on»«the»9”等位置结构，以及“«where»”引出的结构连接点
patterns.context: 激活集中于定位短语中的冠词及其后续位置、表面或局部结构名词；各段具体语义领域不一
patterns.domain: 多领域说明性与技术性文本

en.description: Activations mainly occur in concrete descriptions of spatial locations, ends, or regions, as well as localization of biological tissue, layers, and component relationships. Other cases include morphological descriptions, experimental examinations, social-rank terminology, and an advertisement about keeping items cold; the latter patterns are more weakly related.

patterns.name: Spatial regions or terminal positions of body parts
patterns.context: Describes the end, position, or region occupied by a structure, device, or event; sometimes involves compound directional terms.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, insect morphology, transport infrastructure, and patent technical descriptions; segments 1, 2, 3, 7, 10

patterns.name: Anatomical structures and tissue localization
patterns.context: Specifies the location or composition of biological tissue or nerves, or the site of a receptor or examination.

patterns.name: Layers, sheets, or planar structures
patterns.context: Describes distinct layers, panels, or planar structures, often qualified by position or adjacency.
patterns.domain: Patents, art installations, and materials/physics research; segments 3, 6, 7

patterns.name: Orientation, direction, and relative position
patterns.context: Uses directional terms, vertical positioning, or relationships between objects to describe spatial arrangement.
patterns.domain: Papers, patents, and facility descriptions; segments 3, 6, 7

patterns.name: Specific biological or device components
patterns.context: Lists components in a technical description and explains their installation, materials, or relationships.
patterns.domain: Medical instrument papers and patent backgrounds; segments 2, 7

patterns.name: Anatomical level or tissue subregion
patterns.context: Specifies the extent of an injury or protein expression within a layer of neural tissue.

patterns.name: Highest position in a hierarchy
patterns.context: “platform” refers to a position in the social hierarchy, not a physical platform.

patterns.name: Cold-retention duration in product advertising
patterns.context: A brief promotional phrase emphasizes that a container keeps its contents cold for a long time.

patterns.name: Descriptive morphology and color patterns
patterns.context: Introduces the distribution of colors and patterns on insect wings; trigger points include spatial words that describe regions.

patterns.name: Site of experimental measurement or imaging examination
patterns.context: Specifies the object of measurement, experimental conditions, or examination site; the relationship of these words to the positional pattern is uncertain.
patterns.domain: Medical and physics research abstracts; segments 2, 6, 10

9_321.description: 激活主要见于空间位置、端部或区域，以及生物组织定位、层片和部件关系的具体说明；也包括形态描述、实验检查、社会等级用语和保冷广告，后几类关联较弱。

patterns.name: 身体部位的空间区域或末端位置
patterns.trigger: «tip»、«dis»cal« area»、«postdis»cal« areas»、«south»bound« platform»、«upper» end»、«at» the «injection» site
patterns.context: 描述某结构、器械或事件所处的端部、位置或区域；有时涉及复合方位词。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、昆虫形态、交通设施及专利技术描述；段1、2、3、7、10

patterns.name: 解剖结构与组织定位
patterns.context: 说明生物组织、神经或受体所在的位置、组成或检查部位。
patterns.domain: 医学与神经生物学摘要；段4、8、10

patterns.name: 层、薄片或面状结构
patterns.context: 描述相互区分的片层、面板或平面结构，常以位置或相邻关系限定。
patterns.domain: 专利、艺术设施与材料/物理研究；段3、6、7

patterns.name: 方位、方向与相对位置
patterns.trigger: «along» … «ab» plane、«between» these two sheets、«south»bound« platform»、«upper» end
patterns.context: 以方向词、上下位置或两者之间的关系描述空间排列。
patterns.domain: 论文、专利与设施说明；段3、6、7

patterns.name: 生物或器物的具体结构部件
patterns.trigger: «ultrasonic transducers»、«epoxy resin bracket»、«liquid-pervious topsheet»、«liquid-impervious backsheet»、«liquid-absorbent core»
patterns.context: 在技术性描述中列举组成部件，并交代其安装、材料或相互关系。
patterns.domain: 医学仪器论文与专利背景；段2、7

patterns.name: 解剖层级或组织内分区
patterns.context: 在损伤或蛋白表达的语境中，具体指出神经组织内的层次范围。

patterns.name: 层级中的最高位置
patterns.context: “platform”指社会等级中的位置，而非物理平台。

patterns.name: 商品宣传中的保冷时长
patterns.context: 以简短宣传语强调容器能长时间保持内容物低温。

patterns.name: 描述性形态与颜色图案
patterns.context: 介绍昆虫翅膀的颜色和图案分布；触发点包括描述区域的空间词。
patterns.domain: 百科全书式物种描述；段1

patterns.name: 实验测量或成像检查的部位
patterns.context: 交代测量对象、实验条件或检查所针对的部位；这些词本身与位置模式的联系不确定。
patterns.domain: 医学与物理研究摘要；段2、6、10

en.description: Activations occur at sentence ends, line breaks, and heading boundaries, and also involve experimental methods, animal morphology descriptions, patent structures, math problem solving, website disclaimers, and nutrition. No clear semantic trigger spans all domains.

patterns.name: Sentence endings and punctuation
patterns.context: Activations often occur at sentence-final boundaries after periods, after line breaks, or near the start of a new paragraph or heading; this appears across different domains.

patterns.name: Scientific methods and experimental results
patterns.context: Experimental or technical scientific texts involve animals, tissues, measurements, detection, or instrumentation methods; activations concentrate on local words or phrases within sentences.

patterns.name: Descriptive morphology and color
patterns.context: Describes organisms by appearance, color, body parts, and morphological features; activations fall on descriptive nouns or adjacent words.

patterns.name: Structure of absorbent products
patterns.context: Patent claims or background sections describe the materials and relative positions of product layers.

patterns.name: Mathematical equations and problem-solving instructions
patterns.context: In math exercises, an instruction to solve for a variable follows an equation.

patterns.name: Website disclaimers and parental notices
patterns.context: A website link disclaimer advises users to exercise their own judgment and reminds parents to protect children.

patterns.name: Animal nutrition and deficiency response
patterns.context: Compares animal responses to vitamin A deficiency and supplementation and mentions intestinal effects.

9_321.description: 激活分布在句末、换行和标题边界，也涉及实验方法、动物形态描写、专利结构、数学解题、网站免责声明及营养学；未见贯穿各领域的明确语义触发模式。

patterns.name: 句末及标点
patterns.trigger: 句号后的未标记标点，以及其后的标题或新句开头，如「.»4«」「↵»9Immunohistochemical」「.»6 All experiments」
patterns.context: 激活常出现在句号后的句末边界、换行后或新段落/标题附近；不同领域均出现。

patterns.name: 科学方法与实验结果
patterns.trigger: 「the injection site」「tumors were harvested」「Luciferase reporter assay」「three ultrasonic transducers」
patterns.context: 实验性或技术性科学文本中，涉及动物、组织、测量、检测或仪器方法；激活集中在句子内部的局部词语或短语。

patterns.name: 描述性形态与颜色
patterns.context: 以外观、颜色、部位及形态特征描述生物；激活落在描述性名词或相邻词语上。

patterns.name: 吸收性制品结构
patterns.context: 专利权利要求或背景技术中，描述制品各层的材料与相对位置。

patterns.name: 数学方程与解题指令
patterns.context: 数学练习文本中，方程式后出现要求求解变量的指令。

patterns.name: 网站免责声明与家长提示
patterns.trigger: 「no control」「no responsibility」「use your own discretion」「protect your kids」
patterns.context: 网站链接免责声明中，提醒用户自行判断并提示家长保护儿童。

patterns.name: 动物营养与缺乏反应
patterns.trigger: 「vitamin A deficiency」「vitamin A repletion」「quick response」「deficient dietary intake」
patterns.context: 比较动物对维生素A缺乏及补充的反应，并提及肠道影响。

en.description: The most consistent response is to specific noun phrases containing the, especially those involving parts, components, and their locations in expository text. Other examples include color and appearance, patent structures, and quantitative scientific statements. Some sporadic high-activation words are difficult to explain independently.

patterns.name: The in definite articles and noun phrases
patterns.context: Introduces a specific anatomical part, object component, body region, or other identified object in expository prose; the is especially strongly activated in several passages.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, patents, medical abstracts, and scientific papers

patterns.name: Positional and component-localization expressions
patterns.context: Describes an object’s position on, inside, at the end of, or in a specific region; common in structural, morphological, and measurement descriptions.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic explanations, patent structural descriptions, medical and scientific writing

patterns.name: Anatomical or structural nouns
patterns.context: Nouns refer to body parts or components of an object, often paired with the, at, in, and other localization expressions.
patterns.domain: Biology and medicine, architectural descriptions, patents

patterns.name: Color and appearance features
patterns.context: Describes the colors, spots, stripes, and patterns of animals, body regions, or surfaces; mostly encyclopedic or natural-history-style appearance descriptions.

patterns.name: Patent components and geometric structures
patterns.context: Describes the structure of devices or products using component names, directions, ends, and spatial relations.

patterns.name: Quantitative scientific reports
patterns.context: Reports values such as experimental time, body measurements, weight, field strength, or concentration, usually embedded in technical statements.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, encyclopedia data, ArXiv, and environmental science abstracts

patterns.name: High-activation words with no apparent pattern
patterns.context: These sporadic tokens do not show a consistent, independent semantic trigger in their local sentences; they may be influenced by neighboring structure or tokenization.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; not attributable to a specific style

9_321.concept: 具体对象的说明性定位
9_321.description: 最稳定的反应是说明性文本中带 the 的具体名词短语，尤其涉及部位、部件及其方位；另见颜色外观、专利结构和定量科学陈述。部分零散高激活词难以独立解释。

patterns.name: 定冠词与名词短语中的 the
patterns.trigger: «the»，以及相邻的名词短语，如 «the» «throat»、«the» «east end»、«the» «injection site»
patterns.context: 在说明性散文中引出具体解剖部位、物体部件、身体区域或其他已指明对象；多个片段中 the 的激活尤其强。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、专利、医学摘要及科学论文

patterns.name: 方位和部件定位表述
patterns.context: 描述对象上、内、端部或特定区域的位置；常见于结构、形态与测量描述。
patterns.domain: 百科说明、专利结构描述、医学和科学文体

patterns.name: 解剖或结构性名词
patterns.context: 名词指向生物体部位或物体的组成部分，常与 the、at、in 等定位表达搭配。
patterns.domain: 生物与医学、建筑描述、专利

patterns.name: 颜色与外观特征
patterns.context: 描述动物、身体区域或表面颜色、斑点、条纹和图案；多为百科或自然史式外观描写。

patterns.name: 专利部件与几何结构
patterns.context: 以部件名称、方向、端部和空间关系描述装置或制品的结构。

patterns.name: 定量科学报告
patterns.context: 报告实验时间、体尺、重量、场强或浓度等数值，通常嵌在技术性陈述中。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、百科数据、ArXiv 与环境科学摘要

patterns.name: 模式不明显的高激活词
patterns.context: 这些零散 token 在局部句子中没有显示出一致、独立的语义触发条件；可能受邻近结构或 token 切分影响。
patterns.domain: 跨领域，无法单独归为特定文体

en.concept: Descriptions of specific objects and parts
en.description: Activations often fall on specific parts or regions following “the,” as well as nouns, technical term fragments, and quantitative information in descriptions of organisms, medical topics, plants, materials, and objects. They concern morphology, location, condition, experimental results, or injury across a wide range of genres.

patterns.name: Body parts or anatomical regions following “the”
patterns.context: The highest activations concentrate on the part or region name after the; meanings span biological anatomy, brain regions, limbs, and plant tissues/traits, and are not limited to humans.
patterns.domain: Biological descriptions, medical papers, botany, and legal factual narratives

patterns.name: Nouns in descriptions of parts and morphology
patterns.context: Describes specific objects such as organs, body or plant parts, lesions, and object shapes; highlights fall on nouns or noun-phrase components, sometimes modified by color, morphology, or position.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic biological descriptions, medical research, patents, and legal texts

patterns.name: In-word fragments in technical terms
patterns.context: Activations fall on tokenized fragments of compounds, abbreviations, or specialized names; contexts typically involve anatomy, molecular measures, genes, or material structures, but the trigger words do not share a specific meaning.

patterns.name: Measurements, changes, and quantitative results
patterns.context: Reports an object’s dimensions, experimental duration, magnitude of change, or height; contexts often contain numbers, units, and measurement or comparison descriptions.
patterns.domain: Research papers, encyclopedias, and legal factual narratives

patterns.name: Medical or biological processes and states
patterns.context: Describes an organism’s response to nutrition, experimental treatment, or disease, as well as tissue condition, substance distribution, or injury.
patterns.domain: PubMed papers, plant biology, and legal accident narratives

9_321.description: 激活常落在“the”后的具体部位/区域，以及生物、医学、植物、材料和物体描述中的名词、术语片段与定量信息；涉及形态、位置、状态、实验结果或损伤，文体跨度较大。

patterns.name: “the”后接身体部位或解剖区域
patterns.trigger: «the»8« throat»、«the»8« vent»；另见«the»9« underside»、«the»9« gyrus»、«the»9« lower» limbs»、«the»9« higher» sugar» content»
patterns.context: 最高激活集中在 the 后的部位或区域名；词义横跨生物解剖、脑区、肢体以及植物组织/性状，并非只限于人体。
patterns.domain: 生物描述、医学论文、植物学及法律事实叙述

patterns.name: 部位及形态描述中的名词
patterns.context: 对器官、身体或植物部位、病灶、物体形状等具体对象进行描述；高亮落在名词或名词短语成分上，部分文本带颜色、形态或位置修饰。
patterns.domain: 百科生物描述、医学科研、专利及法律文本

patterns.name: 专门术语中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分标记的复合词、缩写或专业名称片段中；上下文通常涉及解剖、分子指标、基因或材料结构，触发词本身不共享一个具体语义。
patterns.domain: 昆虫形态学、医学/生物科研、专利

patterns.name: 测量、变化和定量结果
patterns.trigger: «47–50 mm»；«35 days»；«decrease»；«two and a half inches»
patterns.context: 对象的尺寸、实验时长、变化幅度或高度被报告；上下文常含数字、单位及测量或比较叙述。
patterns.domain: 科研论文、百科及法律事实陈述

patterns.name: 医学或生物过程与状态
patterns.trigger: «quick» response»；«altered» the small intestine»；«sacrificed»；«accumulated» abundantly»；«suffered» injury»
patterns.context: 陈述生物体对营养、实验处理或疾病的响应、组织状态、物质分布或损伤。
patterns.domain: PubMed论文、植物生物学及法律事故叙述

en.description: Activations concentrate in technical expository writing: components, shapes, and uses in patents; species morphology and texture; and biomedical results or measurement equipment. Their shared feature is concrete, objective, specialized description rather than a clear single topic word.

patterns.name: Structures and components in patent claims or invention descriptions
patterns.context: Describes the shape, composition, position, and dimensions of devices, materials, or components, often in patent background and invention-description syntax; also includes specific structural designs.

patterns.name: Body morphology and surface texture descriptions
patterns.context: Uses objective, dense morphological vocabulary to describe the body shape, color, surface structure, and texture of animals or plants.

patterns.name: Experimental biomedical results and changes
patterns.context: Reports experimental treatments, sample responses, or measured biomedical changes, including comparisons, results, and quantitative metrics.

patterns.name: Medical instruments and measurement procedures
patterns.context: Explains how medical measurement systems measure blood flow and describes related instrument components; adjacent to the experimental-results pattern but focused on equipment and methods.

patterns.name: Patent product descriptions of specific uses or insertion sites
patterns.context: Patent text describes the opening of a pouch-like product and its specific use or insertion site; although still a patent structural description, the content is distinct.

9_321.description: 激活集中于技术性说明文：专利中的构件、形状、用途，物种形态与纹理，以及生物医学结果或测量设备；共同特点是具体、客观的专业描述，而非明显的单一主题词。

patterns.name: 专利权利要求或发明描述中的结构与部件
patterns.trigger: “a metal tube of irregular shape”“at least two inner diameters”“a nebulizing device”“at least two nebulizing elements”“the width of the sipe”
patterns.context: 描述装置、材料或构件的形状、组成、位置和尺寸，常见专利背景与发明说明的句式；也包括具体结构设计。

patterns.name: 身体形态及表面纹理描述
patterns.trigger: “wingspan”“ground colour”“forewings”“Body elongate-elliptical”“finely reticulated ridges”“smooth and glossy”“leathery in texture”
patterns.context: 以客观、密集的形态学词汇描述动物或植物的体型、颜色、表面结构及质地。

patterns.name: 实验性生物医学结果与变化
patterns.trigger: “vitamin A deficiency”“altered the small intestine”“biochemical and the morphological levels”“decrease of MAO-A”“maximum decreases”
patterns.context: 报告实验处理、样本反应或测得的生物医学变化，含比较、结果和定量指标。

patterns.name: 医学仪器与测量流程
patterns.trigger: “continuous wave velocimeter”“measure the spatial mean velocity”“output calculator”“oesophageal catheter”“ultrasonic transducers”
patterns.context: 说明医疗测量系统如何测量血流及相关仪器部件；与实验结果模式相邻但侧重设备和方法。

patterns.name: 具体用途或插入部位的专利产品描述
patterns.context: 专利文本描述袋状产品的开口及其特定用途或插入部位；虽同属专利结构说明，但内容独特。

en.concept: neut word beginnings and sporadic terms
en.description: The strongest activations cluster at the beginning of neut: they occur in both neutropenia (an adverse medical reaction or symptom) and neutrons (nuclear physics). A few other scattered triggers include The in a password example, option in code, published in a license, and defined in a technical answer. No shared semantic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: neutropenia term
patterns.context: The trigger falls on the initial neut in neutropenia; the suffix is split inconsistently. It often appears in sentences listing hematological adverse reactions or disease manifestations.
patterns.domain: Medicine, clinical research, and biomedical papers

patterns.name: neutron term
patterns.context: The trigger falls on the initial neut in neutrons; the context concerns nuclear reaction cross sections or nuclide decay.

patterns.name: Definite article in a password example
patterns.context: The trigger is The at the beginning of or locally within a description of a ZIP password example; the password is stated immediately afterward.

patterns.name: option in a C++ API
patterns.context: option appears before a C++ type name or template expression and is followed by parentheses; the context is not medical.

patterns.name: published in GPL license text
patterns.context: Fixed software-license wording describing publication by a foundation.
patterns.domain: Github source comments and license text

patterns.name: Form of defined
patterns.context: In a StackExchange technical answer, defined appears in parentheses to indicate that an operation or behavior is defined.

9_433.description: 最强激活集中在 neut 词首：既命中 neutropenia（医学不良反应或症状），也命中 neutrons（核物理）。另有少量分散触发，分别是密码例句中的 The、代码中的 option、许可证中的 published、技术答复中的 defined，未见统一语义条件。

patterns.name: neutropenia 词项
patterns.context: 触发点落在 neutropenia 的词首 neut 上，后缀拆分方式不固定；多见于列举血液学不良反应或疾病表现的句子。
patterns.domain: 医学、临床研究与生物医学论文

patterns.name: 中子词项
patterns.context: 触发点落在 neutrons 的词首 neut；上下文谈核反应截面或核素衰变。

patterns.name: 密码示例中的定冠词
patterns.context: 触发点是描述 ZIP 密码示例时句首或局部的 The，后文直接说明密码。

patterns.name: C++ API 中的 option
patterns.context: option 出现在 C++ 类型名或模板表达式之前，后接括号；不是医学语境。

patterns.name: GPL 许可文本中的 published
patterns.context: 软件许可证固定措辞中，描述许可证由基金会发布。
patterns.domain: Github 源码注释、许可证文本

patterns.name: 定义的词形
patterns.context: StackExchange 技术回答中，括号内用 defined 表示某操作或行为有定义。

en.concept: neut- word forms and sporadic technical terms
en.description: Primarily responds to the neut- prefix, found in both neutrons and neutropenia; there is also scattered activation on option in technical contexts and The password in Q&A, which are difficult to explain uniformly.

patterns.name: Neutrophil-related words
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on the token prefix neut; it may be followed by rons (neutrons) or ropenia (neutropenia), rather than being triggered only by a complete term.
patterns.domain: Nuclear physics, medical papers, and clinical literature

patterns.name: Passwords and brute-force cracking
patterns.context: Describes using a simple brute forcer to try to crack a password-protected zip file; activation falls on the definite article The, not password itself.

patterns.name: Socket receive-buffer option
patterns.context: Sets the TCP socket receive-buffer size option in C++ Boost.Asio code.
patterns.domain: Github source code, C++ network programming

patterns.name: License option wording
patterns.context: The phrase “at your option” in GNU GPL license text.

patterns.name: Type option
patterns.context: Discusses whether std::get<Type> is available and mentions tuple type uniqueness.

9_433.description: 主要响应 neut- 前缀：既出现在 neutrons，也出现在 neutropenia；另有分散激活于技术语境中的 option、以及问答中的 The password，难以统一解释。

patterns.name: 中性粒细胞相关词
patterns.context: 激活集中在 token 前缀 neut；其后可接 rons（中子）或 ropenia（中性粒细胞减少症），不是只由某个完整术语触发。
patterns.domain: 核物理、医学论文与临床文献

patterns.name: 密码与暴力破解
patterns.context: 描述用简单 brute forcer 尝试破解受密码保护的 zip 文件，激活落在定冠词 The，而非 password 本身。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 问答，编程/技术支持

patterns.name: socket 接收缓冲区选项
patterns.context: C++ Boost.Asio 代码中设置 TCP socket 的接收缓冲区大小选项。
patterns.domain: Github 源代码，C++ 网络编程

patterns.name: 许可证选项措辞
patterns.context: GNU GPL 许可文本中“at your option”这一措辞。
patterns.domain: Github 源代码注释/许可证文本

patterns.name: 类型选项
patterns.context: 讨论 std::get<Type> 是否可用，并提到 tuple 类型唯一性。

en.description: The most stable word-form cue is the neut- subword, covering neutrons and neutropenia; there is also strong activation on sentence-initial The, a newline after $ following a formula, and $ before an amount. Other triggers are sporadic and difficult to explain uniformly.

patterns.name: neutron(s) subword
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on the neut- initial subword; it occurs in neutron(s) and neutropenia, the latter being a medical term.

patterns.name: Article The
patterns.context: The definite article at the beginning of a sentence or new sentence, capitalized in ordinary prose.

patterns.name: Fragment within a proper name
patterns.context: Activation falls on the final subword of the proper name Herriman, rather than on a word with an obvious syntactic or semantic relation.

patterns.name: Mathematical formula boundary
patterns.context: A newline immediately follows the dollar sign ending a mathematical expression, as prose begins after the formula.

patterns.name: Currency symbol
patterns.context: The dollar sign precedes a numeric amount, followed by a fee value.

patterns.name: Capitalized word-initial fragment
patterns.context: Apart from the article The, both examples occur at the beginning of a sentence or new sentence; activation may also partly depend on capitalization or local position.

patterns.name: Other infrequent or difficult-to-explain triggers
patterns.context: Scattered across different vocabulary and formatting positions; apart from medical terms, mathematical symbols, and Q&A excerpts, they cannot be explained by the same obvious contextual condition.

9_433.description: 最稳定的词形线索是 neut- 子词，涵盖中子与 neutropenia；另对句首 The、公式后的 $ 换行、金额 $ 有强激活。其余触发零散，难以统一解释。

patterns.name: neutron(s) 子词
patterns.context: 激活集中在 neut- 起始子词；可见于 neutron(s) 和 neutropenia，后者是医学词汇。
patterns.domain: 核物理摘要、医学/生物医学文本

patterns.name: 冠词 The
patterns.context: 普通句子中大写句首或新句开头的定冠词。
patterns.domain: 问答、机构介绍、生物医学摘要

patterns.name: 专名内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名 Herriman 的末尾子词，而非句法或语义上明显相关的词。

patterns.name: 数学公式边界
patterns.context: 数学表达式结束的美元符号后紧接换行，公式之后转入正文。

patterns.name: 金额符号
patterns.context: 美元符号位于数字金额之前，后接费用数值。

patterns.name: 词首大写片段
patterns.context: 除冠词 The 外，两例都位于句首或新句开头；触发也可能部分依赖大写词首或局部位置。

patterns.name: 其他低频或难解释触发
patterns.context: 分散于不同词汇和格式位置，除医学术语、数学符号及问答片段外，无法由同一明显上下文条件解释。

en.concept: English subword fragments and heterogeneous text triggers
en.description: Activations are most apparent in wanted (2 segments) and neut-related neutron/neutrophil fragments (3 segments), with other scattered instances in Latin word forms, legal publication notices and suspected OCR fragments, an email about an unexpected situation, and Something. Overall, there is no single stable semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Past-tense form wanted of English want
patterns.context: wanted occurs within a sentence to mean wanting, having wanted to learn about something, or wanting to do something; it may be followed by a to-infinitive
patterns.domain: General English prose or website copy

patterns.name: Neutron-related term fragment
patterns.context: neut is the initial substring of neutron(s) or neutropenia and occurs in scientific text

patterns.name: Latin word-form fragment subs
patterns.context: The word is split into subword fragments; it occurs in the Latin form Idaea subsaturata

patterns.name: Publication restriction notice in a legal document
patterns.context: All-caps notice, near “NOT DESIGNATED FOR PUBLICATION” and a case number

patterns.name: Anomalously split characters or OCR text
patterns.context: Letters, symbols, and spaces are scattered across incoherent lines, with no clear ordinary semantic structure
patterns.domain: Suspected scanning, typesetting, or OCR fragments in legal documents

patterns.name: Name and unexpected situation at the start of an email
patterns.context: An email begins with a possibly truncated name or salutation, followed by a report of unexpected difficulties

patterns.name: Label-like string Something There
patterns.context: At the beginning of a short quotation or text fragment; followed by Herriman title text whose meaning cannot be determined from the excerpt
patterns.domain: Web or bibliographic text; specific genre unclear

9_433.concept: 英语词片段与异质文本触发
9_433.description: 激活最明显地出现在 wanted（2段）、neut- 中子/中性粒细胞相关词片段（3段），另分散于拉丁词形、法律出版声明与疑似 OCR 残片、邮件意外情况及 Something 等文本。整体没有单一稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: 英文 want 的过去式形式 wanted
patterns.context: wanted 位于句中，表示想要、曾想了解或做某事；附近可接 to 不定式
patterns.domain: 普通英文叙述或网页文案

patterns.name: 中子相关术语片段
patterns.context: neut 是 neutron(s) 或 neutropenia 的词首子串，出现在科学文本中

patterns.name: 拉丁词形片段 subs
patterns.context: 词被拆成子词片段；出现在拉丁语词形 Idaea subsaturata 中

patterns.name: 法律文件的出版限制声明
patterns.context: 全大写版式声明，附近有“NOT DESIGNATED FOR PUBLICATION”及案件编号

patterns.name: 异常拆分的字符或 OCR 文本
patterns.context: 字母、符号及空格分散在不连贯行中，未见清楚的普通语义结构
patterns.domain: 法律文件中的疑似扫描、排版或 OCR 残片

patterns.name: 邮件开头的人名及意外状况
patterns.context: 邮件中先出现可能被截断的人名或称呼，随后报告遇到意外困难

patterns.name: 标注性字符串 Something There
patterns.context: 短引文或文本片段开头；后接无法从片段确定语义的 Herriman 标题文字
patterns.domain: 网页或书目类文本，具体文体不明

en.description: Strongly responds mainly to the “Field” heading in patent text and the invention-related formulaic wording that follows it; it also responds to commas across domains, alongside sporadic activation on date-based news, engineering terms, paper titles, weather headlines, and colloquial comments, which cannot be grouped into a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Patent field heading
patterns.context: Occurs at the field heading in a patent specification, usually immediately before a newline, followed by an overview of the invention or disclosure.

patterns.name: Invention-related wording in patent summaries
patterns.context: Appears after a patent field heading or at the start of a patent background paragraph to introduce the subject matter of the invention or disclosure; in this batch, its activation is markedly lower than that on «Field» in the heading.

patterns.name: Punctuation before a comma
patterns.context: The comma itself is a marker token; it appears in different contexts such as dates, technical descriptions, paper titles, and news headlines, with no evident unified semantic condition in the samples alone.

patterns.name: Date and news headline
patterns.context: A date is followed by a location and the beginning of a news-style headline.

patterns.name: Specific object in a technical field
patterns.context: Discusses gas turbines, particularly requirements that aircraft engines must meet; the comma also activates, but there is no evidence that the object words and comma share the same pattern.

patterns.name: Paper title fragment
patterns.context: Appears in an academic paper title mentioning immunochemistry and monoclonal antibodies.

patterns.name: Weather alert headline
patterns.context: A news-style headline reports a winter storm warning taking effect and schools closing; activation concentrates on the comma and closed.

patterns.name: Exclamatory game comment
patterns.context: An informal exclamation in quotation marks, followed by a mention of another Mario game; the comma and an interjection fragment activate.

9_433.description: 主要对专利文本的“Field”领域标题及其后的发明关联套语强烈响应；另对逗号有跨领域响应，并有日期新闻、工程术语、论文标题、天气标题和口语评论等零散激活，无法归入同一语义模式。

patterns.name: 专利领域标题
patterns.context: 出现在专利说明书的领域标题处，通常紧接换行，后续进入发明或披露内容的概述。

patterns.name: 专利概述中的发明关联表述
patterns.context: 位于专利领域标题之后或专利背景段落开头，用来引出发明或披露所涉及的主题；本批次中触发强度明显低于标题中的«Field»。

patterns.name: 逗号前的标点
patterns.context: 逗号本身是标记 token；出现在日期、技术描述、论文标题或新闻标题等不同语境，单凭样本看不出统一的语义条件。

patterns.name: 日期与新闻标题
patterns.context: 日期后接地点和新闻式标题开头。

patterns.name: 技术领域中的特定对象
patterns.context: 讨论燃气涡轮，特别是航空发动机必须满足的要求；逗号也激活，但没有证据说明对象词与逗号模式相同。

patterns.name: 论文标题片段
patterns.context: 出现在学术论文标题中，标题提及免疫化学及单克隆抗体。

patterns.name: 天气警报标题
patterns.context: 新闻式标题报告冬季风暴警报生效及学校关闭；激活集中在逗号和 closed。

patterns.name: 感叹式游戏评论
patterns.context: 引号中的口语感叹，后续提到另一款 Mario 游戏；逗号和感叹词片段激活。

en.description: The most stable signal is the comma, especially within sentences or as a separator between code parameters or fields. There are also sporadic activations on titles, dates, code, proper names, and words from various domains, without a unified semantic explanation.

patterns.name: Comma punctuation
patterns.context: The word or line following the comma varies; the marker appears across sentence types and domains.
patterns.domain: Medical titles, technical Q&A, dates, email, news, and patent text

patterns.name: Comma separating code parameters
patterns.context: A comma in code or configuration snippets, often separating parameters or fields; it may overlap with the general comma pattern.

patterns.name: A at the start of a title or phrase
patterns.context: Capitalized A appears in a title or at the beginning of a sentence; the two examples are followed by “Paradigm” and “mitava,” respectively.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within proper names
patterns.context: A word is split into multiple tokens, with activation on an internal fragment of a proper name or word; there is no stable semantic or contextual commonality.

patterns.name: Revealed in a title
patterns.context: A title contains “Revealed by”, followed by a research method or source of discovery.

patterns.name: Edge-curvature terminology in natural language
patterns.context: Discusses the curvature of a graphic edge and how to alter or restore its degree of curvature.

patterns.name: Code function and parameters
patterns.context: At the start of a function definition, with a function name and comma-separated parameter list.

patterns.name: Description of curcumin and its compounds
patterns.context: Begins with Curcumin, followed by a description of it as a yellow polyphenolic compound.

patterns.name: Date format
patterns.context: An English month or abbreviation, day, comma, and year form a date, which may be followed by body text.

patterns.name: Exclamatory tone in a quotation
patterns.context: A short sentence inside quotation marks, consisting of an interjection and an exclamatory particle, followed by game-related commentary.

patterns.name: Name and greeting in an email
patterns.context: An email opens with a recipient salutation, then proposes finding time to talk.

patterns.name: Configuration fields and values
patterns.context: Consists of multiple lines of field names, values, and edits in parentheses; commas separate fields or operations.

patterns.name: Substrate processing phrase in a patent
patterns.context: A patent background section discusses patterned semiconductor substrates and substrates of rejected products.

9_433.description: 最稳定信号是逗号，尤其出现在句中或代码参数、字段分隔处；另有标题、日期、代码、专名及多种领域词语的零散激活，尚无统一语义解释。

patterns.name: 逗号标点
patterns.context: 逗号后面紧接的词或换行内容可以不同；该标记出现在多种句式和领域中。
patterns.domain: 医学标题、技术问答、日期、邮件、新闻及专利文本

patterns.name: 代码参数分隔逗号
patterns.context: 代码或配置片段中的逗号，常用于分隔参数或字段；可能与一般逗号模式重合。

patterns.name: 标题或短语开头的 A
patterns.context: 大写 A 出现在标题或句首；两个例子后续分别是 “Paradigm” 和 “mitava”。

patterns.name: 专名内部的子词片段
patterns.context: 词被切分为多个 token，激活落在专名或词语的内部片段上；没有稳定的词义或上下文共性。

patterns.name: 标题中的 Revealed
patterns.context: 标题中出现 “Revealed by”，后接研究方法或揭示来源。

patterns.name: 自然语言中的边缘曲率术语
patterns.context: 讨论图形边缘的曲率，以及如何改变或恢复边缘的弯曲程度。

patterns.name: 代码函数与参数
patterns.context: 函数定义开头，包含函数名和逗号分隔的参数列表。

patterns.name: 姜黄素及其化合物描述
patterns.context: 以 Curcumin 开头，后接其作为黄色多酚化合物的说明。

patterns.name: 日期格式
patterns.context: 英文月份或月份缩写、日、逗号、年份组成的日期，后续可接正文。

patterns.name: 引语中的感叹语气
patterns.context: 引号内以感叹词和语气词组成的短句，后接游戏相关评论。

patterns.name: 邮件中的名字及寒暄
patterns.context: 邮件开头出现收件人称呼，随后提出找时间讨论。

patterns.name: 配置字段与数值
patterns.context: 以多行字段名、数值和括号中的修改项构成；逗号分隔字段或操作。

patterns.name: 专利中的基底处置短语
patterns.context: 专利背景段落谈及图案化半导体基底及不合格产品基底。

en.description: Activations span code, papers, patents, and medical text. Punctuation and structural boundaries are common, alongside the relational word “same” and terminology and identifiers from various domains. The segments are difficult to reduce to a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Symbols, punctuation, and structural delimiters
patterns.context: Punctuation or delimiters occur at sentence, code-line, or text-structure boundaries, often activating with neighboring tokens; commonality across contexts is weak.
patterns.domain: Mixed corpus: Q&A, code, papers, and patents

patterns.name: Expressions of sameness or identity
patterns.context: Indicates that entities, threads, or properties are the same; occurs in both graphics descriptions and code explanations.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and type declarations
patterns.context: Occurs near source code, comments, or field declarations, often as part of an identifier or type name.

patterns.name: Medical drug names
patterns.context: Drug names are listed consecutively in an unfinished abstract sentence.

patterns.name: Golf preventive exercises and body parts
patterns.context: Title-like phrase listing a sport and body parts.

patterns.name: Drug metabolism research terminology
patterns.context: Describes drug disposition processes in a study and is followed by a radiolabel symbol.

patterns.name: Message fields and duplicate data
patterns.context: Repeated message fields and their numbers or value descriptions in code or protocol files.

patterns.name: Binary data and audio/video tags
patterns.context: Audio-related tags and values occur in a byte array or resource data.

patterns.name: Semiconductor substrate processing
patterns.context: Discusses the challenges posed by patterned products that fail wafer acceptance criteria and by monitor substrates.

patterns.name: Geometric distortion parameters
patterns.context: Code comments define shape direction, distortion, and tilt parameters, with geometric shapes used as examples.

patterns.name: Schrödinger equation abstract
patterns.context: The abstract begins by stating two equations involving a time variable and a potential function.

9_433.description: 激活分布跨越代码、论文、专利及医学文本；标点和结构边界较常见，另有“same”关系词与多类领域术语、标识符。各段难以归结为单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 符号、标点及结构分隔符
patterns.context: 标点或分隔符出现在句子、代码行或文本结构边界处，常与邻近 token 一起激活；不同语境中共同点较弱。
patterns.domain: 混合语料：问答、代码、论文及专利

patterns.name: 同一/相同关系表达
patterns.context: 表示实体、线程或性质相同；在图形描述和代码说明中均出现。

patterns.name: 代码标识符与类型声明
patterns.context: 出现在源码、注释或字段声明附近，常是标识符或类型名的一部分。

patterns.name: 医学药物名称
patterns.context: 药物名连续列举，摘要句未完。

patterns.name: 高尔夫预防性练习及身体部位
patterns.trigger: “Preventative exercises in golf: arm, leg, and back.”
patterns.context: 标题式短语列出运动项目和身体部位。

patterns.name: 药物代谢研究术语
patterns.context: 并列描述研究中的药物处置过程，后接放射性标记符号。

patterns.name: 消息字段与重复数据
patterns.context: 代码或协议文件中重复消息字段及其编号、取值说明。

patterns.name: 二进制数据与音视频标签
patterns.context: 字节数组或资源数据中出现音频相关标签及数值。

patterns.name: 半导体基板处置
patterns.context: 讨论不符合晶圆验收标准的图案化产品及监控基板所带来的挑战。

patterns.name: 几何畸变参数
patterns.context: 代码注释定义形状方向、畸变和倾斜参数，并用几何形状解释。

patterns.name: 薛定谔方程摘要
patterns.context: 摘要开头陈述两个含时间变量和势函数的方程。

en.description: Activations are scattered across quoted x strings in code, local fragments of proper names and terms, and legal citation titles. These triggers share no stable semantic or contextual rule.

patterns.name: x string and subsequent numeric comparison
patterns.context: `x` appears at the beginning of a quoted string or as the beginning of an identifier/value; subsequent content varies across examples

patterns.name: Local token activations in proper names or terms
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments of various unrelated proper names, common words, or variable names, with no consistent semantic or grammatical condition
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, patents, code Q&A, academic papers

patterns.name: Citation/title format in legal text
patterns.context: Occurs in citations, titles, and bibliographic information in legal commentary or case materials; activations are scattered across title words

9_433.description: 激活分散于代码中带引号的 x 字符串、专名及术语的局部片段，以及法律引文标题；这些触发之间缺少稳定的共同语义或上下文规则。

patterns.name: x 字符串及其后的数字比较
patterns.context: `x` 出现在带引号的字符串开头，或作为标识符/值的开头；不同示例中后续内容不同

patterns.name: 专名或术语中的局部 token 激活
patterns.context: 激活落在多种不相关的专名、普通词或变量名的子词片段上，没有一致的语义或语法条件
patterns.domain: 百科、专利、代码问答、学术论文

patterns.name: 法律文本中的引文/标题格式
patterns.trigger: `Shoplifting — An Analysis of Legal Controls`、`Legislation — Survey and Analysis` 等标题片段
patterns.context: 出现在法律评论或判例材料的引文、标题和书目信息中；激活分散在标题词语中

en.description: Activations cover Markdown markers for scanned-page images, inline CSS styles, a LaTeX derivative formula, an NIH project abstract, and frontend import statements inside JSON. Their commonality is structured documents or code fragments, but the specific trigger patterns differ.

patterns.name: Scanned-page image markers
patterns.context: TIFF scanned-page images are inserted consecutively in a document, followed by page numbers or citation numbers; activations are distributed across markers, filenames, extensions, and numbers

patterns.name: CSS style declarations
patterns.context: CSS properties and values in HTML tags or style objects, especially semicolon-separated inline styles

patterns.name: Mathematical derivative formula
patterns.context: A formula takes the radial derivative of angular velocity, adjacent to descriptions of a boundary layer, Keplerian motion, and related topics

patterns.name: Grant projects and core facilities
patterns.context: Grant application text describing a project, core facilities, and their support

patterns.name: Frontend import statements in JSON
patterns.context: JavaScript/component-library import code stored as a string in a JSON field, including escaped quotation marks and package paths

9_433.description: 激活覆盖扫描页图像的 Markdown 标记、CSS 行内样式、LaTeX 导数公式、NIH 项目摘要，以及 JSON 内前端导入语句；共同点是结构化文档或代码片段，但具体触发模式各异。

patterns.name: 扫描页图像标记
patterns.context: 文档中连续插入 TIFF 扫描页图像，后接页码或引用编号；激活分布在标记、文件名、扩展名和数字上
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 的论文/扫描文档 Markdown

patterns.name: CSS 样式声明
patterns.context: HTML 标签或样式对象中的 CSS 属性和值，尤其是分号分隔的行内样式
patterns.domain: Github 上的 HTML/CSS 代码

patterns.name: 数学导数公式
patterns.context: 公式中对角速度作径向导数，并与边界层、Keplerian motion 等描述相邻
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学/物理论文 LaTeX

patterns.name: 基金申请项目与核心设施
patterns.trigger: `This PPG's three Projects`、`Cores`、`Administrative & Biostatistical Support`、`Animal Health and Sample…`
patterns.context: 描述项目、核心设施及其支持内容的资助申请文本

patterns.name: JSON 中的前端导入语句
patterns.context: JSON 字段内以字符串形式保存的 JavaScript/组件库导入代码，含转义引号与包路径

en.description: Primarily sensitive to numbers and nearby punctuation: decimals, percentages, ranges, thousands separators, dates and times, measurements, status codes, strain numbers, and numbers in legal citations all occur, often in structured or technical text.

patterns.name: Decimal points and percentage values
patterns.context: A decimal point occurs in a number, often in a percentage, ratio, or measurement; adjacent numbers may have thousands separators or units.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia statistics, personal finance Q&A, medical abstracts

patterns.name: Numbers and dates with punctuation
patterns.context: Numbers are adjacent to commas, hyphens, or colons, forming election vote counts, dates, currency amounts, or times.

patterns.name: Numeric legal citations
patterns.context: In legal opinions or statutory citations, numbers are mixed with volume numbers, page numbers, paragraph symbols, and abbreviations.

patterns.name: Numeric status codes in configuration files
patterns.context: In server configuration snippets, numbers appear near HTTP error status codes and file paths.

patterns.name: Numeric medical measurements
patterns.context: Medical abstracts report surgical or clinical measurements using numbers, error ranges, decimals, and units.

patterns.name: Numbered biological names
patterns.context: A strain number follows a bacterial name; the number is embedded in a proper name or experimental subject identifier.

patterns.name: Numeric ranges and ratios
patterns.context: Numbers express percentages, ranges, or relative changes within statistical or experimental descriptions.

patterns.name: Other numbers and punctuation adjacent to numbers
patterns.context: Scattered numbers occur in local contexts such as times, statutes, strains, or years; it is unclear whether they correspond to distinct trigger patterns.

9_433.description: 主要对数字及其邻近标点敏感：小数、百分比、范围、千位分隔、日期时间、测量值、状态码、菌株编号和法律引证中的数字均出现；常见于结构化或技术文本。

patterns.name: 小数点与百分比数值
patterns.context: 小数点出现在数字中，常用于百分比、比率或测量值；相邻数字可能带千位分隔符或单位。
patterns.domain: 百科统计、个人理财问答、医学摘要

patterns.name: 带标点的数字与日期
patterns.context: 数字与逗号、连字符或冒号相邻，组成选举票数、日期、货币数额或时间。

patterns.name: 数字化法律引证
patterns.context: 法律判决或法条引证中，数字与卷号、页码、段落符号及缩写混排。

patterns.name: 配置文件中的数字状态码
patterns.context: 服务器配置片段中，数字出现在 HTTP 错误状态码及文件路径附近。
