patterns.name: 数字化医学测量
patterns.context: 医学摘要以数字、误差范围、小数和单位报告手术或临床测量。

patterns.name: 编号化生物学名称
patterns.context: 细菌名称后接菌株编号，数字嵌在专名或实验对象标识中。

patterns.name: 数值范围与比例
patterns.context: 数字表达百分比、范围或相对变化，嵌在统计或实验叙述中。
patterns.domain: 百科统计、生命科学研究

patterns.name: 其他数字与数字相邻标点
patterns.context: 零散数字出现在时间、法条、菌株或年份等局部语境中；无法确定它们是否各自对应独立触发模式。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、法律、生物医学、问答

en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly in quantitative reporting: metrics and their ratios, percentages, decimals, confidence intervals, and OR statistics. They also occur in configuration and code identifiers and in real-estate price comparisons.

patterns.name: Statistical ratios and decimal values
patterns.context: Activations occur near metric names, values, and statistical significance information in quantitative metrics or comparisons; no particular value or fixed syntax is required.
patterns.domain: Medical paper results, population and housing statistics

patterns.name: Numeric and statistical reporting formats
patterns.context: Formats for statistical results, confidence intervals, odds ratios, or group comparisons involving numbers, punctuation, and statistical abbreviations.

patterns.name: Technical identifiers and delimiters
patterns.context: Near protocol names, underscore-separated configuration keys, colons, and numeric values in code or configuration text; activations involve combinations of technical strings and punctuation.

patterns.name: Width and container identifiers in code
patterns.context: Activations occur around identifiers for container maximum width, media queries, and related items in CSS/Sass code comments and mixin definitions.

patterns.name: Real-estate prices per unit
patterns.context: When discussing luxury homes, compares regional prices per square foot or gives housing prices.

patterns.name: Delivery mode and clinical association
patterns.context: Reports an association between clinical factors and outcomes, quantified using adjusted OR and significance values.

9_433.concept: 数字指标与结构化数值
9_433.description: 激活主要集中于数字化定量报告：指标及其比率、百分数、小数、置信区间和OR等统计格式；另见配置与代码标识符，以及房地产单价比较。

patterns.name: 统计比率与小数数值
patterns.trigger: «rate»、«ratio»、«coverage»、«mortality»、«survival»、«vacancy»，以及紧邻的百分比或小数数值，如«5.»«26»%、«1.»«25»、«0.»«29»%
patterns.context: 定量指标或比较结果的表述中，常在指标名、数值及统计显著性信息附近激活；不要求特定数值或固定句法。
patterns.domain: 医学论文结果、人口住房统计

patterns.name: 数值与统计报告格式
patterns.context: 统计结果、置信区间、比值比或组间比较的格式中，涉及数字、标点和统计缩写。
patterns.domain: 医学论文摘要与研究结果

patterns.name: 技术标识符与分隔符
patterns.context: 代码或配置文本中，协议名、下划线连接的配置键、冒号及数字值附近；呈现出对技术字符串和标点组合的激活。

patterns.name: 代码中的宽度与容器标识符
patterns.context: CSS/Sass代码注释与混入定义中，围绕容器最大宽度、媒体查询等标识符激活。

patterns.name: 按单位呈现的房地产价格
patterns.context: 谈论豪宅价格时，以每平方英尺为单位比较地区价格，或给出房价数值。
patterns.domain: 房地产新闻或市场报道

patterns.name: 交付方式与临床关联
patterns.context: 报告临床因素与结局的关联，并以调整后OR及显著性数值量化。

en.description: Primarily sensitive to numbers, ratios, means, and statistical markers in results reporting, especially comparative group results, percentages, confidence intervals, and effect sizes; it also covers category counts, legal unit prices, and sports averages, as well as fragments of clinical terms.

patterns.name: Reporting statistical values or ratios
patterns.context: Reports measurements, proportions, ratios, means, and similar values in narrative or results sentences; often follows structures such as of/at/about/an average of.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, public health, economics, legal valuations, encyclopedic statistics

patterns.name: Numerical results for comparison groups
patterns.context: Compares multiple groups, sites, or outcomes, often with statistical wording such as respectively, CI, p-values, and risk ratios.

patterns.name: Percentage and confidence interval format
patterns.context: Gives percentages, confidence intervals, or significance tests in statistical results; values and punctuation occur in close proximity.

patterns.name: Association or effect size in academic results
patterns.context: Describes associations between exposure and outcome or reports adjusted effect estimates and uncertainty.

patterns.name: Categorical statistics and itemized counts
patterns.context: Gives a total first, then breaks the quantity down by subcategory; numbers are often stated in natural language rather than as statistical tests.

patterns.name: Unit price in a legal valuation
patterns.context: Estimates the sale value of land and gives an approximate average unit price.
patterns.domain: Legal ruling or statement of legal facts

patterns.name: Average performance in sports statistics
patterns.context: Summarizes a player's cumulative results and average performance in a game or tournament.

patterns.name: Clinical terms and results not covered by the above patterns
patterns.context: Specialized terms and conclusion fragments in medical text; although they occur in research abstracts, these fragments alone do not establish a consistent trigger relationship with numerical reporting.

9_433.description: 主要对结果叙述中的数值、比率、均值及统计标记敏感，尤其是比较组结果、百分比、置信区间和效应量；也覆盖分类计数、法律单价与体育平均成绩，另见临床术语片段。

patterns.name: 统计数值或比率的报告
patterns.context: 在叙述或结果句中报告测量值、比例、比率、均值等；常处于 of/at/about/an average of 等结构之后。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、公共卫生、经济、法律估值、百科统计

patterns.name: 比较组的数值结果
patterns.trigger: 并列列出多个数值或结局，如 «6».«13»%, «8».«13»%, «12».«9»%« respectively
patterns.context: 多个组别、部位或结局之间进行比较，常伴随 respectively、CI、p 值、risk ratio 等统计表述。

patterns.name: 百分比及置信区间格式
patterns.context: 在统计结果中给出百分比、置信区间或显著性检验；数值和标点紧邻出现。

patterns.name: 学术结果中的关联或效应量
patterns.context: 描述暴露与结局之间的关联，或报告调整后的效应估计及不确定性。

patterns.name: 分类统计与分项计数
patterns.trigger: «The number of»、«of which»，以及按 sector、agriculture、forestry 等类别列出的数字
patterns.context: 先给总数，再按子类别分解数量；数字常以自然语言叙述而非统计检验呈现。
patterns.domain: 百科全书式地方或经济概况

patterns.name: 法律估值中的单价
patterns.context: 估算土地出售价值，给出近似平均单价。
patterns.domain: 法律判决或法律事实陈述

patterns.name: 体育统计中的平均表现
patterns.trigger: «an average of» 后接数字和小数，如 «10 26«.»104
patterns.context: 概述球员在比赛或赛事中的累计成绩及平均表现。

patterns.name: 未能归入上述模式的临床术语与结果叙述
patterns.trigger: «baroreflex effectiveness index»、«cervical imbalances»、«vacuum assisted delivery» 等术语
patterns.context: 医学文本中的专科术语及结论片段；虽然同处研究摘要，但无法仅由这些片段确定与数值报告模式有一致的触发关系。

en.description: Primarily responds to statistical values and their formats, especially decimals, ratios, percentages, amounts, and rankings. It occurs in writing about cricket data, medical statistics, employment data, and election vote counts, as well as at sentence-initial thousands.

patterns.name: Decimal or statistical values
patterns.context: Numeric expressions with decimals, percentages, ratios, or amounts; numbers are often split into multiple tokens. Triggers tend to fall on the value or an immediately adjacent token.
patterns.domain: Statistical text, economics and medical papers, Q&A discussions

patterns.name: Ranking numbers
patterns.context: An entry about a person describes their career-high ranking, often with a date; activations favor the ranking value and nearby expressions.

patterns.name: Cricket performance statistics
patterns.context: A cricket narrative includes a player's bowling or batting statistics; there are also words related to averages that are not marked.

patterns.name: Election scores and votes
patterns.context: Competition or election results are tabulated by polling district, listing candidates' total scores or votes.

patterns.name: Isolated sentence-initial number
patterns.context: A number appears at the start of a sentence, followed by a thousands-separated number; the topic is inflation and yield, but the marker is concentrated on the numeric token.

9_433.description: 主要响应统计数值及其格式，尤其是小数、比率、百分比、金额和排名；在板球数据、医疗统计、就业数据、选举票数等文体中均出现，另有句首千位数。

patterns.name: 小数或统计数值
patterns.context: 带小数、百分比、比率或金额的数值表达，常见数字被拆成多个 token；触发位置多在数值或其紧邻 token。
patterns.domain: 统计文本、经济与医学论文、问答讨论

patterns.name: 排名数字
patterns.context: 人物条目中描述职业生涯最高排名，常带日期；激活偏向排名数值及其邻接表达。

patterns.name: 板球表现统计
patterns.context: 板球叙述中出现球员的投球或击球数据；也有未标记的平均值相关词。

patterns.name: 选举得分与票数
patterns.context: 竞赛或选举结果按投票区汇总，并列出候选人的总分或票数。
patterns.domain: 欧洲歌唱大赛结果类百科条目

patterns.name: 孤立的句首数字
patterns.context: 数字出现在句首，后接逗号分隔的千位数；此处虽谈通胀与收益率，但标记集中在数字 token。

en.description: Primarily activates near numerical statistical expressions, especially “average of + value”; it also covers monetary amounts, percentages, medical ratios, resolution, and dense command-line options, and cannot be reduced to a single domain or fixed meaning.

patterns.name: Average in sports statistics
patterns.context: After an individual's or team's sports performance, lists data such as wickets and runs and an average; includes bowling and batting averages.

patterns.name: Consecutive numbers and statistical values
patterns.context: Activation occurs near quantitative descriptions, covering monetary amounts, economic forecasts, medical risk ratios, and population employment statistics; the semantic domains are not uniform.
patterns.domain: Legal, economic, medical, and population statistics

patterns.name: Resolution and values with units
patterns.context: In an astronomical observation description, a spatial resolution is followed by a value in pixels.

patterns.name: Configuration options and command-line flags
patterns.context: Lists hyphenated options and library names consecutively in a software build or configuration command.

9_433.description: 主要在数字化统计表达附近激活，尤其是“average of 数值”；也覆盖金额、百分比、医学比值、分辨率及密集命令行选项，无法归结为单一领域或固定语义。

patterns.name: 体育统计中的平均值
patterns.context: 人物或队伍的体育表现后，列出 wickets、runs 等数据及平均值；包括保龄球平均值和击球平均值。

patterns.name: 连续数字与统计数值
patterns.trigger: « of»… 数值，或数值、小数与百分比
patterns.context: 激活出现在量化描述附近，涵盖金额、经济预测、医学风险比、人口就业统计等；语义领域并不统一。
patterns.domain: 法律、经济、医学及人口统计

patterns.name: 分辨率与带单位的数值
patterns.context: 天文观测描述中，空间分辨率后接像素单位数值。

patterns.name: 配置选项与命令行标记
patterns.context: 在软件构建或配置命令中，连续列出带连字符的选项和库名。

en.description: All segments contain quantitative information, with activations especially near numbers and numeric expressions such as decimals and percentages. Domains include sports, economics, law, finance, and biomedicine. Sports statistics vocabulary may be an accompanying feature of numeric contexts rather than an independent trigger.

patterns.name: Numbers before decimal points and subsequent decimals
patterns.context: Numbers or values such as percentages appear in decimal notation in the text, often near the decimal point; sometimes the decimal point itself is unmarked. The marker is not limited to one type of value
patterns.domain: Explanatory text on statistics, sports results, economics, law, finance, biomedicine, and other topics

patterns.name: Sports results and pitching terminology
patterns.context: Cricket or baseball player, season, and team statistics; occurs alongside numeric-format patterns

patterns.name: Percentages and election/economic statistics
patterns.context: Percentages or growth rates are expressed numerically for social or economic indicators

patterns.name: Quantitative biomedical results
patterns.context: Significance thresholds, concentrations, or range values in research results

patterns.name: Financial returns
patterns.context: Historical investment returns are stated as percentages and averages

patterns.name: Real-estate valuation and unit prices
patterns.context: An estimate of land-sale value in a legal case, with a currency symbol and area unit

patterns.name: Ordinary numeric punctuation and statistical numbers
patterns.context: Commas or decimal notation within values, or numbers adjacent to units; co-occurs with the segment's main statistical information

patterns.name: Qualifiers in medical numeric comparisons
patterns.context: Quantitative results are introduced by medians, ranges, or significance tests

9_433.description: 所有段落都含有定量信息，激活尤其落在数字及小数、百分数等数值表达附近；领域涵盖体育、经济、法律、金融及生物医学。体育统计等词汇可能是数值语境的伴随特征，而非独立触发因素。

patterns.name: 小数点前的数字及后续小数
patterns.trigger: 如“average of 10 26”“8 12”“11 2”“1 176”“$8 per square foot”“median 0 117”；标记多出现在数值中的小数点前后数字
patterns.context: 数字或百分比等数值按文本中的小数写法出现，常见于小数点附近；有时小数点本身未标记。标记并非只针对某一种数值类型
patterns.domain: 统计数据、体育成绩、经济、法律、金融、生物医学等说明性文本

patterns.name: 体育成绩与投球术语
patterns.trigger: “wickets”“bowling average”“earned run average”“pitching staff”等；数值常接在“average of”之后
patterns.context: 板球或棒球的球员、赛季及球队统计；与数值格式模式同时出现

patterns.name: 百分比与选举、经济统计
patterns.context: 百分比或增长率在社会、经济指标中以数字表示

patterns.name: 生物医学定量结果
patterns.context: 研究结果中的显著性阈值、浓度或范围数值

patterns.name: 金融回报率
patterns.context: 历史投资回报以百分比和平均值陈述

patterns.name: 地产估值与单位价格
patterns.context: 法律案件中对土地出售价值的估算，数值带货币符号及面积单位

patterns.name: 普通数字标点及统计数字
patterns.context: 数值中的逗号、小数写法或数字与单位相连；与该段主要统计信息并存

patterns.name: 医学数值比较中的限定词
patterns.context: 定量结果由中位数、范围或显著性检验引出

en.description: Strong activation often occurs in statistical numerical contexts, especially average and its value: cricket bowling averages, financial or group averages, audience averages, and baseball ERA. Other numerical contexts include a medical viral-load threshold, economic growth rates, and stock-index changes.

patterns.name: Average in cricket bowling statistics
patterns.context: Describes a bowler's wickets, performance, or ranking; average usually means bowling runs conceded per wicket, and values are often decimals.
patterns.domain: Cricket reporting, athlete and tournament biographies

patterns.name: Average in financial or economic data
patterns.context: Average denotes the mean investment return or group cost, often near percentages, currency, years, or statistical comparisons.
patterns.domain: Personal finance Q&A, public health statistics

patterns.name: Average audience ratings
patterns.context: Average modifies audience numbers and is compared with data from the previous year or another period.

patterns.name: Earned run average for baseball pitchers
patterns.context: In baseball team pitching statistics, average is part of the fixed statistical term ERA and occurs near words such as pitching staff and record.

patterns.name: CMV viral load and detection threshold
patterns.context: Numbers and units form a laboratory measurement and threshold description; average does not appear, so this differs from the main pattern.

patterns.name: Economic growth rates and quarterly forecasts
patterns.context: Describes quarterly economic growth and annualized growth rates, with numbers expressed as percentages; average does not appear.

patterns.name: Financial market index changes
patterns.context: Lists the daily percentage changes of multiple Asian stock indexes; average does not appear.

9_433.description: 强激活多落在统计数字语境，尤其是 average 及其数值：板球投球平均、金融或群体平均、收视平均，以及棒球 ERA。另有医学载量阈值、经济增长率和股指涨跌等数字统计语境。

patterns.name: 板球投球统计中的 average
patterns.trigger: “average”及其后的数值，如“average of 10.26”“bowling average of 12.86”
patterns.context: 描述投手的 wickets、表现或排名，average 通常指投球平均失分；数值常以小数呈现。
patterns.domain: 板球报道、运动员与赛事传记

patterns.name: 金融或经济数据中的平均值
patterns.context: average 表示投资回报或群体成本的平均量，附近常有百分比、货币、年份或统计比较。
patterns.domain: 个人理财问答、公共卫生统计

patterns.name: 收视率的平均值
patterns.context: average 修饰观众人数，并与前一年或另一时段的数据比较。

patterns.name: 棒球投手的 earned run average
patterns.context: 棒球球队投手统计语境中，average 属于固定统计术语 ERA，邻近 pitching staff、record 等词。

patterns.name: CMV 病毒载量与检测阈值
patterns.context: 数字和单位构成实验室测量及阈值描述；未出现 average，和主要模式不同。

patterns.name: 经济增长率及季度预测
patterns.context: 描述季度经济增长及年度化增长率，数字以百分比呈现；没有 average。

patterns.name: 金融市场指数涨跌
patterns.context: 列举多个亚洲股票指数的当日涨跌百分比；没有 average。

en.description: Primarily sensitive to expressions related to statistical and measurement values, often near quantities, ratios, amounts, predictions, or experimental measurements; also shows weak activation on numeric punctuation tokenization and the cricketer’s name Ridgway, the latter possibly incidental.

patterns.name: Numeric tokens in percentages or decimal values
patterns.context: Across various numeric expressions, activation occurs near subsequent digits or numeric boundaries; sometimes preceded by words introducing values, such as of, rate, reach, roughly, or resolution.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain statistical, economic, medical, and scientific texts

patterns.name: General quantity or scale descriptions
patterns.context: Describes survey samples, numbers of users or devices, totals, averages, and similar quantities; percentages, ratios, or measurements may also appear in the same context.
patterns.domain: Demographic surveys, technology forecasts, economics, and medical research

patterns.name: Punctuation and tokenization boundaries near numbers
patterns.context: When numbers are split by punctuation, spaces, or subword fragments, activation may also occur on adjacent tokens; these examples alone do not establish that punctuation itself is a trigger.

patterns.name: way in a path-related name
patterns.context: The name Ridgway contains the substring way, in a surrounding account of a cricket career; activation is weak and may be incidental or related to the word form.

patterns.name: Measurement and experimental observation values
patterns.context: Specialized measurement contexts such as medical viral loads and astronomical image resolution, with values followed by units or measurement terminology.

patterns.name: Sports narratives not assigned to a clear pattern
patterns.context: Although average appears, the main content concerns a player’s debut and wickets; its connection to the statistical-value pattern in other passages is uncertain.

9_433.description: 主要对统计与测量数值相关表达敏感，常见于数量、比例、金额、预测值或实验测量附近；也有数字标点分词及板球人名 Ridgway 的弱激活，后者可能是偶然。

patterns.name: 百分比或小数数值中的数字 token
patterns.context: 多种数值表达中，激活落在后续数字或数值边界附近；有时前面是 of、rate、reach、roughly、resolution 等引出数值的词。
patterns.domain: 跨领域统计、经济、医学与科学文本

patterns.name: 一般性数量或规模表述
patterns.context: 描述调查样本、用户或设备数量、总额、平均值等；同一上下文还可能出现百分比、比率或测量值。
patterns.domain: 人口调查、科技预测、经济与医学研究

patterns.name: 数字附近的标点及分词边界
patterns.context: 数字被标点、空格或子词切分时，激活也可能落在相邻 token；仅凭这些例子无法确定标点本身是触发因素。

patterns.name: 路径相关人名中的 way
patterns.context: 人名 Ridgway 内出现 way 子串，周围是板球生涯叙述；激活较弱，可能是偶然或词形相关。

patterns.name: 计量与实验观测数值
patterns.context: 医学病毒载量及天文学图像分辨率等专业测量语境，数值后接单位或测量术语。

patterns.name: 未能归入明确模式的体育叙述
patterns.context: 虽出现 average，但主要内容是球员首次出赛及 wickets；与其他段的统计数值模式联系不确定。

en.description: All passages contain dense quantitative information; the neuron prefers numbers, units, percentages, statistical measures, and contexts involving their comparison or change, across medical, scientific, and economic texts.

patterns.name: Quantitative values and units
patterns.context: Reports measurements, proportions, forecasts, ratios, or amounts in scientific or news text; often adjacent to numbers, units, parentheses, and statistical symbols.
patterns.domain: Medicine, natural sciences, economic news, and statistical reporting

patterns.name: Numerical comparisons and changes
patterns.context: Values are placed in a temporal, baseline, forecast, upper/lower-bound, or relative comparison; common in economic trends, population forecasts, and research results.

patterns.name: Statistical results in medical research
patterns.context: Reports treatment efficacy, exposure, risk, or follow-up statistics in clinical or epidemiological results, with numbers linked to statistical terms and confidence intervals.

patterns.name: Dollar amounts and economic indicators
patterns.context: Amounts or economic forecasts occur alongside years and indicators such as costs, wealth, or growth.
patterns.domain: Economic news, business, and mining reporting

patterns.name: Scientific parameters and orders-of-magnitude units
patterns.context: Values appear as measurement units, model parameters, or distribution characteristics in scientific or medical text.

patterns.name: Ratios, ranges, and delimiter formats
patterns.context: Numbers appear in complex formats such as decimals, hyphenated ranges, parentheses, percent signs, or formula symbols; activation often falls on a number or adjacent punctuation.

9_433.description: 各段均含密集定量信息；神经元偏好数值、单位、百分比、统计指标及其比较或变化语境，跨医学、科学与经济文本。

patterns.name: 定量数值及单位表达
patterns.trigger: 数字、百分数、小数和单位/量词，如“5000 copies”“36%”“$11 per ounce”“30 and 50 billion”“1.88”“1.64”
patterns.context: 科学或新闻文本中报告测量值、比例、预测值、比率或金额；常与数字、单位、括号及统计符号相邻。
patterns.domain: 医学、自然科学、经济新闻及统计报道

patterns.name: 数值比较与变化
patterns.trigger: “up from”“up”“increased”“reach”“of 19”“at a nadir”“more than”等变化、比较或范围表达
patterns.context: 数值被放入时间、基线、预测、上下限或相对比较中；常见于经济趋势、人口预测和研究结果。

patterns.name: 医学研究的统计结果
patterns.trigger: “odds ratio [OR]”“p=”“95 % CI”“incidence rate ratio”“mean follow-up period”
patterns.context: 临床或流行病学结果中报告疗效、暴露、风险或随访统计量，数字与统计术语及置信区间相连。

patterns.name: 美元金额与经济指标
patterns.trigger: “$266.21 trillion”“$51.29 trillion”“$1,142”“$11 per ounce”“ad spending forecast”
patterns.context: 金额或经济预测与年份、成本、财富、增长等经济指标并列。
patterns.domain: 经济新闻、商业及矿业报道

patterns.name: 科学参数及数量级单位
patterns.context: 科学或医学文本中，数值作为测量单位、模型参数或分布特征出现。
patterns.domain: 生物医学与天体物理研究

patterns.name: 比率、区间及分隔符格式
patterns.context: 数字以小数、连字符范围、括号、百分号或公式符号等复杂格式呈现，激活位置常落在数字或邻接标点上。

en.description: Activation most often occurs in quantitative statements: means, ratios, percentages, amounts, thresholds, distances, or similarity metrics, often adjacent to numbers and units; the domains and metrics vary considerably.

patterns.name: Statistical means and averages
patterns.context: Describes a mean or average level, often followed by a value, ratio, or cost; the term itself and nearby statistical expressions show strong activation.
patterns.domain: Sports statistics, legal finance, and mining economics

patterns.name: rate metrics with numeric values
patterns.context: In economic growth, advertising expenditure forecasts, or epidemiology, rate is followed by a percentage or annualized value; “at a … rate” also occurs.

patterns.name: Medical quantitative thresholds and loads
patterns.context: Clinical indicators, thresholds, or treatment outcomes in medical research; the specific metrics differ between the two passages.

patterns.name: Chemical bond lengths and interatomic distances
patterns.context: In materials or computational chemistry, describes the distance between an atomic pair and gives a symbolic value.

patterns.name: Percentage, value, and unit expressions
patterns.context: Values are embedded in statistical statements; sometimes a percentage is adjacent to a value, and sometimes it is accompanied by an indicator name. This pattern partially overlaps with other statistical patterns.

patterns.name: Currency amounts and financial inflows/outflows
patterns.context: Amounts begin with a dollar sign and describe income, expenditure, or unit costs; strong activation occurs near amount-related words.

patterns.name: Approximate or estimated values
patterns.context: Uncertainty or approximation wording introduces estimates of years, growth rates, or other values.

patterns.name: Numeric comparisons or changes
patterns.context: Compares forecast values or proportions over time, using change expressions such as up from and increases.

patterns.name: Molecular similarity without an evident shared statistical trigger
patterns.context: Reports a similarity index in a genome comparison; although it includes percentages and values, its specific context differs from distances, means, or economic ratios.

9_433.description: 激活多出现在定量陈述中：均值、比率、百分比、金额、阈值、距离或相似性指标，常邻接数字与单位；具体领域和指标差异较大。

patterns.name: 统计均值与平均值
patterns.trigger: “average»10« of»6« 12»2«.”（3）；“average»2« monthly»3« income”（4）；“an« average»4« operating»5« cash»5« costs”（6）
patterns.context: 描述均值或平均水平，常接数值、比率或成本；该词本身及邻近统计表达激活较强。
patterns.domain: 体育统计、法律财务、矿业经济

patterns.name: 数值的 rate 指标
patterns.trigger: “an»2« annual»6« rate»9« of»8 2«.»15« percent”（7）；“forecast»3« to»6« 1»2«.»28%”（8）；“transmission rate« is»5 2.4%”（9）
patterns.context: 在经济增长、广告支出预测或流行病学中，rate 后接百分比或年化数值；也出现“at a … rate”。
patterns.domain: 经济新闻、公共卫生统计

patterns.name: 医学定量阈值与负荷
patterns.trigger: “DNA»4 load»9« cut»6-«off»7« value»8« of»6 5000 copies”（5）；“insufficient erection« for»1 penetration”（1）
patterns.context: 医学研究语境中的临床指标、阈值或治疗结果；两段的具体指标不同。

patterns.name: 化学键长与原子间距
patterns.trigger: “Na - O« distance»4 $d_{{\rm Na-O}} = 2.3$ Å”及“Na - Si« distance»10”（2）
patterns.context: 材料或计算化学中，描述原子对间的距离并给出符号化数值。

patterns.name: 百分比、数值与单位表达
patterns.context: 数值嵌入统计性陈述；有时百分比紧邻数值，有时伴随指标名称。此模式与其他统计模式部分重叠。
patterns.domain: 医学微生物学、体育统计

patterns.name: 货币金额与财务收支
patterns.context: 金额以美元符号开头，并描述收入、支出或单位成本；高激活落在金额相关词附近。

patterns.name: 近似或估计值
patterns.context: 不确定性或近似措辞引出估算的年限、增长率或数值。
patterns.domain: 矿业经济、宏观经济新闻

patterns.name: 数值比较或变化
patterns.trigger: “revised … forecast to 1.28% growth … up from … 1.24%”（8）；“increases … to 6.36%”（9）
patterns.context: 对预测值或比例作前后比较，使用 up from、increases 等变化表达。
patterns.domain: 经济新闻、公共卫生统计

patterns.name: 无明显共享统计触发的分子相似性
patterns.trigger: “highest similarity … with an ANI value of 99.17% and dDD”（10）
patterns.context: 基因组比较中报告相似性指数；虽含百分比和数值，但与距离、均值或经济比率的具体语境不同。

en.description: Responds to quantitative expressions with units, percentages, or statistical contexts, covering economic and financial data, medical research measures, biological similarity and size, and physical quantities.

patterns.name: Economic and financial values
patterns.context: Reports amounts, growth rates, revenue and expenditure, or total wealth in economic or financial narratives, often with temporal, comparative, or forecast conditions
patterns.domain: Economic news reporting, bankruptcy legal documents

patterns.name: Medical research statistics
patterns.context: Reports viral load, symptom scores, patient proportions, and follow-up time in clinical or medical research

patterns.name: Numerical values in biological classification comparisons
patterns.context: Quantifies genomic similarity between strains or species as a percentage

patterns.name: Biological morphology measurements
patterns.context: Gives the maximum body length, including the tail, in a species description

patterns.name: Physical quantities and constants
patterns.context: Gives values and units for quantities such as astronomical periods, speed, or inertia in a physics explanation

9_433.description: 对带单位、百分比或统计语境的定量数值表达有反应，涵盖经济财务数据、医学研究指标、生物学相似度与尺寸，以及物理量。

patterns.name: 经济与财务数值
patterns.trigger: “spending forecast”“growth”“monthly income”“expenses”“net income”“wealth totaled”，以及“$”“%”后的数值
patterns.context: 经济、财务叙述中报告金额、增长率、收入支出或财富总量，常带时间、比较或预测条件
patterns.domain: 新闻经济报道、破产法律文件

patterns.name: 医学研究统计
patterns.trigger: “copies/mL”“5000 copies”“pain score”“mean follow-up period”“19.18”“range”等数值与单位或统计术语
patterns.context: 临床或医学研究中报告病毒载量、症状评分、患者比例及随访时间

patterns.name: 生物分类比较数值
patterns.context: 以百分比量化菌株或物种间的基因组相似性

patterns.name: 生物形态尺寸
patterns.context: 物种描述中给出身体（含尾部）的最大长度

patterns.name: 物理量与常数
patterns.context: 物理说明中给出天体周期、速度或惯性等量及其数值、单位

en.description: Activation spans quantitative reporting in scientific, medical, technical, financial, economic, and sports texts: metrics or statistics adjacent to values, units, or percentages, commonly in descriptions of numeric results. Triggering domains vary, with no single thematic keyword.

patterns.name: Technical and scientific numeric statistics
patterns.context: In scientific or technical descriptions, a statistic, measurement, or metric name appears before a value, unit, or percentage; multiple tokens around these metric terms and values activate.
patterns.domain: Biomedicine, crystallography, microbial taxonomy, and patented technology

patterns.name: Financial and economic value reporting
patterns.context: In business, legal-financial, or economic news, amounts and percentages are stated in connection with income, wealth, growth forecasts, or growth rates.
patterns.domain: Economic news, personal finance, and bankruptcy law materials

patterns.name: Sports statistics
patterns.context: In cricket match recaps, numbers report players’ performance and tournament statistics.

9_433.description: 激活覆盖科研、医学、技术、财务经济及体育文本中的定量报告：指标或统计量与其数值、单位、百分比相邻，常见数值结果的说明。触发领域多样，未见单一主题词。

patterns.name: 技术与科研数值统计
patterns.context: 在科研或技术说明中，数值、单位或百分比之前出现统计量、测量值或指标名称；这些指标词及其数值附近的多个 token 激活。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、晶体学、微生物分类及专利技术

patterns.name: 财务与经济数值报告
patterns.context: 在商业、法律财务或经济新闻中，围绕收入、财富、增长预测或增长率陈述金额和百分比。
patterns.domain: 经济新闻、个人财务及破产法律材料

patterns.name: 体育统计数字
patterns.context: 板球赛事回顾中，以数字报告球员的比赛成绩和锦标赛统计。

en.description: The neuron often responds near measures and their values in quantitative statements: medical and scientific measurements, economic and financial data, and sports statistics; it also appears on process yields in patents. Some strong activation falls on word-internal fragments and may be unrelated to numerical patterns.

patterns.name: Numerical results or measures
patterns.context: Reports quantitative results, measurements, scores, or averages; trigger points often fall near the measure name or value.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, astronomy, sports, and other technical or statistical texts

patterns.name: Financial and economic values
patterns.context: States income, wealth, expenditure, growth forecasts, or growth rates in economic or legal narratives.
patterns.domain: News, economic commentary, bankruptcy legal materials

patterns.name: Process yield
patterns.context: Compares recovery rates or total output across process steps; activation concentrates near “yield” and its value.

patterns.name: Possible English word-internal fragments or tokenization artifacts
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments of words split by tokenization and is difficult to explain through complete semantics or consistent local syntax.

9_433.description: 神经元多在定量陈述中响应指标及其数值附近：医学和科学测量、经济财务数据与体育统计；另见专利中的工艺产率。部分高激活落在词内片段，可能与数值模式无关。

patterns.name: 数值化结果或指标
patterns.trigger: “value of”后接数值，或“score was”“average … of”等测量指标表达
patterns.context: 报告定量结果、测量值、评分或平均值；触发点常落在指标名称或数值附近。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、天文学、体育等技术或统计文本

patterns.name: 财务与经济数值
patterns.trigger: “forecast of”“income totaled”“wealth totaled”“growth … rate of”等，以及金额、百分比、年度数据
patterns.context: 经济或法律叙述中陈述收入、财富、支出、增长预测或增长率。
patterns.domain: 新闻、经济评论、破产法律材料

patterns.name: 流程产率
patterns.context: 比较工艺步骤的回收率或总产量，激活集中在“yield”及其数值附近。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、生物制品制造

patterns.name: 可能的英文词内片段或切分伪影
patterns.context: 激活落在被分词切开的词内片段，难以由完整语义或一致的局部句法解释。
patterns.domain: 新闻文本中的词内子词

en.description: Primarily responds to precise numeric expressions near metrics, ratios, thresholds, and experimental parameters, especially when values are adjacent to units, percentages, decimals, ranges, or “of/is/rate” structures; domains vary widely, and the trigger form is more consistent than the topic.

patterns.name: Ratios or metrics in quantitative relationships
patterns.context: In technical or report-style sentences, a value is assigned the meaning of a metric, ratio, yield, threshold, score, or measurement; common formats include “metric + of/is + value,” as well as “rate of” and “ratio of.”
patterns.domain: Biomedicine, patents, scientific papers, and quantitative accounts in news/commentary

patterns.name: Experimental conditions and operating parameters
patterns.context: Values describe experimental or device operating conditions, material proportions, speed, pressure, time, or bandwidth, embedded in methods or technical descriptions.
patterns.domain: Chromatography / experimental methods, patented device descriptions, astronomical observations

patterns.name: Percentage and range-style values
patterns.context: Activation occurs near numeric expressions such as percentages, ranges, or precise decimals; values sometimes indicate proportions or comparisons, and sometimes biological measurements, so meanings are not entirely consistent.
patterns.domain: Medical results, microbial taxonomy, patents, and public policy commentary

patterns.name: Adjacent numeric, unit, and punctuation formats
patterns.context: Adjacent to measurement values, units, range parentheses, colons, or decimal points; no specific metric name is required, and numeric formatting itself may contribute to activation.
patterns.domain: Scientific and medical data reporting, engineering parameters

patterns.name: Numeric thresholds for grouping or clinical decisions
patterns.context: A value serves as a threshold, boundary, or grouping condition for determining risk, income category, or experimental result.
patterns.domain: Clinical research, medical testing, news / policy commentary

9_433.description: 主要对指标、比率、阈值及实验参数附近的精确数值表达起反应，尤其是数值与单位、百分比、小数、范围或“of/is/rate”结构相邻；领域跨度大，触发形式比主题更一致。

patterns.name: 定量数值关系的比值或指标
patterns.trigger: “cut-off value”“step yield”“process yield”“ANI value”“albumin-to-globulin ratio”“pain score”“urine calcium:creatinine ratio”“tax rate”“clearance”“total bandwidth”等指标名，常接“of”或“is”及数值
patterns.context: 在技术或报告式语句中，数值被赋予指标、比率、产率、阈值、评分或测量值的含义；常见格式为“指标 + of/is + 数值”，也包括“rate of”及“ratio of”。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、专利、科学论文及新闻/评论中的定量叙述

patterns.name: 实验条件和操作参数
patterns.trigger: “at a flow rate of 0.3244 ml min”“in 7 min”“80% ACN”“at 3000 psi”“with a total bandwidth of 7.5 GHz”
patterns.context: 数值描述实验或设备运行条件、材料比例、速度、压力、时间或带宽，嵌在方法或技术说明中。
patterns.domain: 色谱/实验方法、专利设备说明、天文观测

patterns.name: 百分比及范围型数值
patterns.context: 激活落在百分数、范围或精确小数等数字表达附近；有时数值表示占比或比较，有时是生物测量值，含义并不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 医学结果、微生物分类、专利及公共政策评论

patterns.name: 相邻数值、单位与标点格式
patterns.context: 紧邻测量数值、单位、范围括号、冒号或小数点；不要求特定指标名称，数字格式本身可能参与激活。
patterns.domain: 科学与医学数据报告、工程参数

patterns.name: 数值阈值用于分组或临床判定
patterns.trigger: “of 8 or more”“less than $8,500 a year”“At a plasma CMV DNA load cut-off value of 5000 copies”
patterns.context: 数值作为阈值、界限或分组条件，用于判定风险、收入类别或实验结果。
patterns.domain: 临床研究、医学检验、新闻/政策评论

en.description: Primarily responds to numerical data and their measures, units, and introductory structures, especially near “of + value”; seen in technical parameters, experimental and clinical measurements, and encyclopedia population figures.

patterns.name: Numerical fields in technical or scientific data
patterns.context: Values occur in phrases describing parameters, thresholds, measurements, or process conditions, especially “of + value/unit” or immediately beside a technical quantity name; the trigger is not always the number itself and may instead fall on the quantity name, unit, or nearby punctuation.
patterns.domain: Patents, medical and biological papers, software documentation, experimental methods, computational physics; paragraphs 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 10

patterns.name: Population statistics
patterns.context: Encyclopedia entries introduce a location's population with “had a population of” or “population”; the number usually has a thousands separator or is followed by people.

patterns.name: Pain scores and threshold-like expressions
patterns.context: Clinical abstracts report scale scores for symptomatic populations and give scores using “of + value”; the numerical context is a clinical measure, not a physical quantity or population count.

9_433.description: 主要响应数值型数据及其指标、单位和引出结构，尤见“of + 数值”附近；覆盖技术参数、实验与临床测量，也响应百科人口数。

patterns.name: 技术或科学数据中的数值字段
patterns.trigger: 数值及其邻近的单位、指标或字段值，如“clearance … of 0.010 inch”“load cut-off value of 5000 copies”“page size … 4096 bytes”“flow rate of 0.244 ml min”“ANI value of 99.7%”“step yield … 60–70%”“time step of 1.63 fs”
patterns.context: 数值嵌在说明参数、阈值、测量结果或工艺条件的短语中，尤其是“of + 数值/单位”或数值紧邻技术量名；触发点不总是数值本身，也可能落在量名、单位或附近标点。
patterns.domain: 专利、医学与生物学论文、软件文档、实验方法、计算物理；段1、2、4、5、6、7、10

patterns.name: 人口统计数字
patterns.context: 百科条目以“had a population of”或“population”引出地点人口数，数字通常带千位分隔符或后接 people。

patterns.name: 疼痛评分及其阈值式表述
patterns.context: 临床摘要报告症状人群的量表分数，并用“of + 数值”给出评分；数值语境是临床指标而非物理量或人口数。

en.description: Often occurs in quantitative descriptions: the preposition of near measurements, thresholds, proportions, or scores; also appears in rate/average expressions, numeric ranges, and technical conditions. Some activation occurs in different syntactic positions, such as follow-up and result statistics, and cannot be reduced to a single trigger word.

patterns.name: Quantity / measurement following of
patterns.context: The preposition of commonly occurs before a value or quantitative result, especially measurements, thresholds, scores, proportions, or statistics in scientific and technical texts; however, the trigger is not adjacent to a number after of in every passage.
patterns.domain: Biomedicine, analytical chemistry, sports statistics, tax, and technical documents

patterns.name: rate measurement expressions
patterns.context: When rate or average denotes a quantitative rate or average, it occurs near a specific value or measurement condition.
patterns.domain: Analytical chemistry, sports statistics, patented technology

patterns.name: Follow-up duration
patterns.context: Describes the follow-up period and its duration in clinical narratives.

patterns.name: Numeric thresholds and ranges
patterns.context: Values serve as thresholds, intervals, or application conditions; no fixed unit or syntactic position is required.

patterns.name: B-tree page-size conditions
patterns.context: Software documentation discusses data item size, page size, and the resulting storage behavior.

patterns.name: Other numeric result contexts
patterns.context: Activation occurs in statistical results, taxonomic similarity, or tax-rate statements, without forming a specific context that accounts for the other passages.
patterns.domain: Medical research, microbial taxonomy, tax reporting

9_433.description: 多见于量化叙述：介词 of 邻近测量值、阈值、比例或评分；也出现在 rate/average、数值范围和技术条件中。部分激活落在 follow-up、结果统计等不同句法位置，无法归结为单一触发词。

patterns.name: of 后的数量/测量值
patterns.context: 常见于数值或量化结果前的介词 of，尤其是科学技术文本中的测量值、阈值、评分、比例或统计量；但触发点并非每段都紧贴 of 后的数字。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、分析化学、体育统计、税务及技术文档

patterns.name: rate 测量表述
patterns.context: rate 或 average 表示某种量化速率、平均值时，邻近具体数值或测量条件。
patterns.domain: 分析化学、体育统计、专利技术

patterns.name: 随访时长
patterns.context: 临床叙述中描述随访期间及其时长。

patterns.name: 数值阈值及范围
patterns.context: 数值用于阈值、区间或应用条件；不要求固定单位或句法位置。

patterns.name: B-tree 页面大小条件
patterns.context: 软件文档中谈论数据项大小、页面大小及其导致的存储行为。

patterns.name: 其他数字结果语境
patterns.context: 激活出现在统计结果、分类学相似度或税率陈述中，未形成一个足以涵盖其他段落的特定语境。
patterns.domain: 医学研究、微生物分类、税务报道

en.description: Especially sensitive to quantitative metrics and their numerical expression: common statistics, scores, ratios, thresholds, experimental parameters, technical configuration values, as well as treatment doses and biochemical targets. Spans medical, encyclopedic, software, and sports texts.

patterns.name: Quantitative metric with a threshold
patterns.context: First introduces a measurable numerical metric, then gives a decision boundary or threshold; usually embedded in a complete medical results sentence.
patterns.domain: Medical research, diagnosis, or experimental results

patterns.name: Numerical statistic or metric and its value
patterns.context: A statistic or metric name is followed by of and then a value; examples include disease scores, unemployment rates, literacy rates, genomic similarity, or sports averages.
patterns.domain: Medical and encyclopedic statistics, biological taxonomy, sports reporting

patterns.name: Technical parameter setting
patterns.context: Software documentation describes a parameter’s default value or configuration size; the number is an implementation detail rather than a population statistic.

patterns.name: Treatment dose and biochemical target value
patterns.context: A treatment dose is adjusted, with a blood-marker reference range used as the target; does not necessarily use an explicit “of + number” structure.
patterns.domain: Clinical case reports or treatment reports

9_433.description: 对量化指标及其数值表达尤为敏感：常见统计量、评分、比率、阈值、实验参数、技术配置值，也包括治疗剂量与生化目标。跨医学、百科、软件和体育文本。

patterns.name: 带阈值的量化指标
patterns.trigger: “cut-off value of 5000 copies”“cut-off score of 6.5”“threshold at 25.5 W/mm2”“threshold at 3.2 J/mm2”
patterns.context: 先介绍可测量的数值指标，再给出判定界限或阈值；通常嵌在完整的医学结果句中。
patterns.domain: 医学研究、诊断或实验结果

patterns.name: 数值统计指标及其数值
patterns.trigger: “mean disease score of 0.9”“rate of 3.6%”“rate of 69%”“average of 59.25%”“value of 99.7%”“average of 12.86”
patterns.context: 统计量或指标名称后接 of，再接数值；涉及疾病评分、失业率、识字率、基因组相似度或体育平均数据。
patterns.domain: 医学、百科统计、生物分类、体育报道

patterns.name: 技术参数设置值
patterns.trigger: “This value used to default to 4”“page size of 4096 bytes”
patterns.context: 软件文档描述参数的默认值或配置尺寸，数值用于实现细节而非人群统计。

patterns.name: 治疗剂量与生化目标值
patterns.trigger: “dose was increased to 30 mg three times daily”“serum calcium level … at the lower end of the reference range”
patterns.context: 治疗剂量调整，并以血液指标的参考范围作为目标；不一定采用显式“of + 数字”结构。

en.description: Primarily responds to quantitative expressions in scientific, technical, and statistical texts: values and units, measurement parameters, experimental conditions, thresholds, and predicted or historical values. It spans software, economics, medicine, ecology, and various scientific papers, often accompanied by formulas or formatting markers.

patterns.name: Numeric values and units
patterns.context: Technical or scientific descriptions provide measurements, parameters, thresholds, dimensions, speeds, or timescales; common forms include a number adjacent to a unit or accompanied by mathematical notation.
patterns.domain: Software documentation, economic news, astronomy, medicine, biology, physics, and materials science

patterns.name: Statistical values and thresholds
patterns.context: When reporting forecasts, detection thresholds, or historical statistics, numbers quantify proportions, decision boundaries, or orders of magnitude; words indicating statistical meaning occur before or after the values.
patterns.domain: Economic news, clinical research, ecology, and population descriptions

patterns.name: Experimental conditions and parameters
patterns.context: Methods for experiments or simulations specify instrument settings, material samples, operating conditions, or computational parameters, often introduced by “of” or “at.”

patterns.name: Formatted technical values and markers
patterns.context: Values are embedded in formulas, LaTeX, unit expressions, or paper citations / figure markers; formatting may include subscripts, currency symbols, or encoding artifacts.

patterns.name: Sequence words preceding specific values
patterns.context: Numbers are introduced by phrases indicating comparison, change, or quantity; activation may occur near the value and may also involve words describing the numeric relationship.

9_433.description: 主要响应科学、技术及统计文本中的定量表达：数值与单位、测量参数、实验条件、阈值和预测/历史数值；覆盖软件、经济、医学、生态及多类科学论文，常伴公式或格式标记。

patterns.name: 数值单位与量纲表达
patterns.trigger: 数值后接单位或量纲，如“4096 bytes”“7.5 GHz”“25.5 W/mm2”“220μm”“1.63 fs”“100 km s”“300 km s−1”
patterns.context: 技术或科学叙述中给出测量值、参数、阈值、尺寸、速度或时间尺度；常见形式是数字与单位相邻，或带有数学标记。
patterns.domain: 软件文档、经济新闻、天文学、医学、生物学、物理与材料科学

patterns.name: 统计值与阈值
patterns.trigger: “forecast of 1.8% growth”“load cutoff value of 5000 copies”“record low of 500 fish”
patterns.context: 报告预测、检测阈值或历史统计时，数字用于量化比例、判定界限或数量级；数值前后有描述统计意义的词语。
patterns.domain: 经济新闻、临床研究、生态与种群描述

patterns.name: 实验条件和参数
patterns.trigger: “bandwidth of 7.5 GHz”“intensity threshold at 25.5 W/mm2”“sample thickness of approximately 220μm”“time step of 1.63 fs”
patterns.context: 实验或模拟方法中说明仪器设置、材料样品、操作条件或计算参数，常由“of”“at”等引出数值。

patterns.name: 格式化技术数值及标记
patterns.context: 数值嵌在公式、LaTeX、单位表达或论文引用/图表标记中；格式可能包含上下标、货币符号或编码痕迹。

patterns.name: 特定数值前的序列词
patterns.trigger: “up from an April forecast”“from a record low of 500 fish”“with a total bandwidth of”
patterns.context: 数字由比较、变化或数量说明短语引出；激活可落在数值附近，也可能伴随描述数值关系的词。

en.description: Each passage contains numerical parameters, statistics, thresholds, or measurements, spanning software configuration, medical metrics, engineering dimensions, astronomical parameters, species similarity, and viewership; triggers and domains vary.

patterns.name: Numerical threshold or measurement
patterns.context: A number appears as an experimental result, threshold, measurement, or parameter, often immediately next to a descriptive noun.

patterns.name: Numerical values in database or model configuration
patterns.context: Numbers describe software configuration, storage capacity, or default settings.

patterns.name: Audience counts and year-over-year statistics
patterns.context: Viewership statistics are presented as audience counts and comparisons with an earlier period, with words such as “record” or “average”.

patterns.name: Proper-name or abbreviation cues before numbers
patterns.context: Different technical terms introduce or qualify the following number; the activation point is not fixed to a single number format.

9_433.description: 各段均出现带数值的参数、统计量、阈值或计量结果，涉及软件配置、医学指标、工程尺寸、天文参数、物种相似度及收视人数；触发形式和领域多样。

patterns.name: 数值阈值或测量值
patterns.trigger: 数值及其单位或量纲，如“5000 copies”“0.010 inch”“8 or more”“312 GW/cm^2”
patterns.context: 数值作为实验结果、阈值、测量值或参数出现；常紧邻描述性名词

patterns.name: 数据库或模型配置中的数值
patterns.trigger: “larger than this size”“default to 4”“page size of 4096 bytes”
patterns.context: 数值用于说明软件配置、存储容量或默认设置

patterns.name: 观众数与同比统计
patterns.trigger: “average of 594,100 viewers”“from last year’s average of 156,000”
patterns.context: 以人数和前期比较呈现收视统计，且出现“record”“average”等词

patterns.name: 数值前的专名或缩写线索
patterns.trigger: “load cut-off value”“clearance”“pain score”“ratio”“bandwidth”“ANI value”“GTE cut-off score”“peak irradiance”
patterns.context: 不同专业名词引出或限定后续数值；激活落点并不固定在同一个数字格式上
patterns.domain: 跨领域技术与学术文本

en.description: All passages activate near quantities, counts, or metric values, especially after attribute nouns followed by of; domains and specific metrics vary widely.

patterns.name: of before scientific quantities or counts
patterns.context: Describes the value of a metric, attribute, or parameter; a common form is noun + of + number, and the number may include units, percentages, error ranges, or scientific notation.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, medical abstracts, technical documentation, patents, and statistical web text

9_433.description: 各段均在量值、计数或指标取值附近激活，尤其常见于属性名词后的 of 及其数值；领域和具体指标差异很大。

patterns.name: 科学量值或计数前的 of
patterns.trigger: “of”后接数值、比率、尺寸或单位（如 “load cut-off value of 5000 copies”“arm length of $3×10^9$m”“mass of about 16 tonne”“score of 8”）
patterns.context: 描述某个指标、属性或参数的取值；常见形式为名词 + of + 数值，且数值可能带单位、百分比、误差范围或科学记号。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、医学摘要、技术文档、专利及统计性网页文本

en.description: Primarily responds to numbers and nearby expressions, especially measurements, experimental parameters, thresholds, and settings introduced by prepositions in scientific and technical texts; also includes output, speed, and tax-rate percentages in news.

patterns.name: Values and units in measurement results
patterns.context: In scientific, medical, or engineering texts, a value appears as a measurement result, threshold, experimental parameter, or material/device specification; activation is often on or near the value.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, medical papers, technical documents

patterns.name: Prepositions introducing values and parameters
patterns.context: A preposition introduces a measurement, condition, or parameter, with the value and unit forming a phrase; commonly co-occurs with scientific reporting or specifications.

patterns.name: Thresholds, defaults, or setpoints
patterns.context: A value is described as a decision threshold, default setting, or experimental/system parameter rather than a general quantity.

patterns.name: Output, throughput, and rate
patterns.context: Values describe output or speed per unit of time, usually qualified by expressions such as “per day” or “velocity.”

patterns.name: Tax rates and percentages
patterns.context: A percentage represents a tax rate and appears in a description of income or a taxpayer group.

9_433.description: 主要对数值及其邻近表达作出反应，尤其是科学技术文本中由介词引出的测量、实验参数、阈值和设定值；也涉及产量、速度及新闻中的税率百分比。

patterns.name: 测量结果中的数值及单位
patterns.trigger: 数字、数值范围或数值表达，常紧邻单位或物理量，如“4.95”“7.5 GHz”“9,470 metric tons per day”“312 GW/cm^2”
patterns.context: 科学、医学或工程文本中，数值作为测量结果、阈值、实验参数或材料/设备规格出现；激活位置常在数值或其附近。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、医学论文、技术文档

patterns.name: 数值前的介词与参数引介
patterns.trigger: “of”“at”“with”“for”以及其后的参数短语，如“bandwidth of 7.5 GHz”“at 775 nm”“a time step of 1.63 fs”
patterns.context: 介词引出测量值、条件或参数，数值与单位构成短语；常与科学报告或规格说明共现。

patterns.name: 阈值、默认值或设定值
patterns.trigger: “cut-off value of 5000 copies”“default to 4”“a time step of 1.63 fs”等
patterns.context: 数值被说明为判定阈值、默认设置或实验/系统参数，而非一般数量叙述。
patterns.domain: 医学、软件工程、实验科学

patterns.name: 产量、吞吐量与速率
patterns.trigger: “average plant throughput of 9,470 metric tons per day”及“1590ft/sec”
patterns.context: 数值描述单位时间内的产出或速度，通常由“per day”“velocity”等限定。
patterns.domain: 采矿报道、历史军事叙述

patterns.name: 税率与百分比
patterns.context: 百分比表示税率，置于收入或纳税人群体的说明中。

en.description: Activations focus on quantitative information: numbers and their metric names, scores, counts, or units, especially in “of” constructions and measurement contexts. Also includes software size thresholds, defaults, and numerical comparisons.

patterns.name: Numbers before units or dimensions
patterns.context: A number, statistic, or measurement is linked to a unit, dimension, or quantitative metric; commonly follows “of”, and also includes constructions such as “up to”.
patterns.domain: Expository texts such as scientific papers, medical research, encyclopedias, and news

patterns.name: Score, index, or count values
patterns.context: A number is used for a scale score, disease score, or total count; the metric name is often linked to the number by “of” or “near”.

patterns.name: Size thresholds and defaults in software
patterns.context: Programs or documentation discuss data size, storage thresholds, and configuration defaults, with numbers adjacent to parameters such as page size.

patterns.name: Reference comparison following a number
patterns.context: Reports a peak or annual figure and compares it with a number from another period; no common unit is apparent here.

patterns.name: “a” followed by a quantitative noun phrase
patterns.context: An article precedes a measured object or metric name, followed by a number; the article itself may be part of the local trigger, but the specific dimensions vary across passages.
patterns.domain: Scientific, medical, and encyclopedic expository text

patterns.name: Numerical physical or medical metric statement
patterns.context: The sentence reports a sample statistic; the number is a mean or average score and is accompanied by an error range or confidence interval.

patterns.name: Currency or monetary value
patterns.context: A physical quantity is formatted with a dollar sign, but the context actually expresses power in milliwatts; it should not be generalized as currency.

9_433.description: 激活集中于定量信息：数值及其指标名、评分、计数或单位，尤其常见“of”结构和测量语境；也包括软件大小阈值、默认值及数字比较。

patterns.name: 单位或量纲前的数值
patterns.trigger: "value of 5000 copies"、"power of $250 mW"、"density of $n=12..."、"temperature of 6,870 K"、"throughput of 9,470 metric tons per day"、"salt content of up to 0.5%"
patterns.context: 数值、统计量或测量结果与单位、量纲或定量指标相连；常见于“of”之后，也包括“up to”等结构。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、医学研究、百科和新闻等说明性文本

patterns.name: 评分、指数或计数值
patterns.trigger: "pain score of 8"、"disease score of 0.9"、"issue count near 45 million"
patterns.context: 数值用于量表评分、疾病评分或总量计数；指标名与数值之间常有“of”或“near”。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、公共议题报道

patterns.name: 软件中的大小阈值与默认值
patterns.trigger: "larger than this size"、"This value used to default to 4"
patterns.context: 程序或文档讨论数据大小、存储阈值及配置默认值，数字与页面大小等参数相邻。

patterns.name: 数字后接参照比较
patterns.context: 报告峰值或年度数值，并与另一时期的数字作比较；此处未明显出现常见单位。

patterns.name: “a”与量化名词短语
patterns.trigger: "a plasma CMV DNA load"、"a laser power"、"a charge carrier density"、"an effective temperature"、"an average plant throughput"
patterns.context: 冠词后接测量对象或指标名，随后给出数值；冠词本身可能是局部触发的一部分，但各段具体量纲不同。
patterns.domain: 科学、医学和百科说明文

patterns.name: 有数值的物理或医学指标表述
patterns.trigger: "average voiding score was 3.77 +/- 0.25"、"mean disease score of 0.9"
patterns.context: 句中陈述样本统计量，数值是均值或平均评分，且伴有误差范围或置信区间。

patterns.name: 货币或金额数值
patterns.context: 物理量以美元符号形式排版，但该上下文实际表达的是毫瓦功率；不应将其概括为货币。

en.description: Primarily responds to quantitative metrics reported in scientific and technical contexts, especially measurement nouns, scores, thresholds, and dimensions next to numbers; specific metrics span medicine, physics, astronomy, software, and mining, with specialized parameters such as bandwidth and page size also represented.

patterns.name: Quantitative measurement and its dimension
patterns.context: Reports a quantitative result in scientific or technical text; activation often falls on the measurement metric noun, with numbers, units, or comparison conditions nearby.
patterns.domain: Research papers, medical research, engineering and technical documentation

patterns.name: Threshold, score, or cutoff
patterns.context: In clinical or experimental results, a metric is followed by a score, threshold, or numerical boundary; often used for grouping, comparison, or prediction.

patterns.name: Bandwidth configuration
patterns.context: Describes the settings of a relevant instrument or system, followed by a total bandwidth value and GHz unit.

patterns.name: Data-structure page size
patterns.context: Reports page-size parameters when discussing B-tree nodes, overflow pages, and data-item storage.

patterns.name: Metal mining and capacity metrics
patterns.context: Describes a mine entering production and its average processing rate, followed by a daily tonnage.

patterns.name: Physical energy and power
patterns.context: Reports the areal energy gain of a bilayer structure and gives the laser-power conditions.

patterns.name: Velocity-space correlation scale
patterns.context: Describes a two-point correlation function in velocity space and enhanced correlations within a particular velocity range.

patterns.name: Average disease score in research results
patterns.context: Reports the mean disease score at the end of an animal study, with a confidence interval.

9_433.description: 主要响应科研和技术语境中报告的定量指标，尤其是紧邻数值的测量名词、评分、阈值及量纲；具体指标跨医学、物理、天文、软件和矿业，另有带宽、页面大小等专门参数。

patterns.name: 定量测量值及其量纲
patterns.trigger: 数值附近的测量名词或单位，如 «bandwidth»10、«throughput»9、«charge»6 «carrier»9、«correlation»5 «scale»9、«load»10
patterns.context: 科学或技术文本中报告定量结果；激活常落在测量指标名词上，周围有数值、单位或比较条件。
patterns.domain: 科研论文、医学研究、工程与技术文档

patterns.name: 阈值、评分或截点
patterns.context: 临床或实验结果中，指标后接评分、阈值或数值界限；常用于分组、比较或预测。
patterns.domain: 医学论文与生物医学研究

patterns.name: 带宽配置
patterns.context: 说明相关仪器或系统的设置，后接总带宽数值及 GHz 单位。
patterns.domain: 天文学／射电天文技术论文

patterns.name: 数据结构页面大小
patterns.context: 讨论 B-tree 节点、溢出页及数据项存储时，报告页面大小参数。

patterns.name: 金属矿产与产能指标
patterns.context: 叙述矿山投产及其平均处理量，后接每日吨数。

patterns.name: 物理能量与功率
patterns.context: 报告双层结构的面能量增益，并给出激光功率条件。
patterns.domain: 凝聚态物理／激光物理论文

patterns.name: 速度空间相关尺度
patterns.context: 描述速度空间中的两点相关函数及特定速度区间内的相关增强。

patterns.name: 研究结果中的平均疾病评分
patterns.context: 动物研究结束时报告疾病评分均值，并附置信区间。

en.description: Primarily responds to statements of quantities, parameters, and specifications in technical, scientific, and patent texts, especially values introduced through structures such as of or is; also includes be-verb descriptions and question of fact in law, so the patterns are not entirely uniform.

patterns.name: Quantity or parameter introduced by of
patterns.context: In technical or scientific explanations, a number, unit, or parameter value follows expressions such as of, is, or on the order of; not all instances are triggered by the same fixed phrase.
patterns.domain: Quantitative statements in academic papers, technical documentation, news, and patents

patterns.name: Description or value following was
patterns.context: A sentence uses a be verb to link a subject with a noun, adjective, participle, or judgment; these instances occur across several passages, but the following structures are inconsistent.

patterns.name: Size and page settings in technical documentation
patterns.context: Describes B-tree nodes, overflow pages, and page sizes, with size adjacent to numerical thresholds.

patterns.name: Question in legal argument
patterns.context: Defines a disputed matter as a question of fact and discusses who should properly decide it; unlike the other passages, it is not primarily quantitative or technical.

9_433.description: 主要在技术、科学及专利文本中，对数量、参数和规格的表述有反应，尤其是数值经 of、is 等结构引出；另见 be 动词描述及法律中的 question of fact，模式并不完全统一。

patterns.name: 数量或参数由 of 引出
patterns.trigger: “size of 64”“bandwidth of 7.5 GHz”“density of $n=…$”“time step of 1.63 fs”“uncertainty … is $\approx 300$”“throughput of 9,470”“ANI value of 99.7%”“density … on the order of 100”等
patterns.context: 在技术或科学说明中，数值、单位或参数值跟在 of、is 或 on the order of 等表达后；并非所有实例都由同一固定词组触发。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、技术文档、新闻及专利中的定量陈述

patterns.name: was 后接描述或数值
patterns.trigger: “was a pretrained Resnet50”“were generated”“was around 1.4mm”“was set up”“is unusually high”“was … considered secure”“is a question”
patterns.context: 句中使用 be 动词连接主语与名词、形容词、分词或判断；这些实例分布在多个段落，但后续结构并不一致。

patterns.name: 技术文档中的 size 与页面设置
patterns.trigger: “larger than this size”“page size”“size of 4096 bytes”
patterns.context: 描述 B-tree 节点、溢出页及页面大小，出现 size 与数值阈值的相邻语境。

patterns.name: 法律论证中的 question
patterns.trigger: “a question of fact”“is a question”“question which”
patterns.context: 把争议事项界定为事实问题，并讨论由谁适当裁定；与其余偏定量或技术的段落不同。

en.description: The neuron primarily responds to noun phrases that introduce or report quantitative attributes in technical texts, especially density, content, load, throughput, dimensions, temperature, bandwidth, and activation energy. The common structure is “attribute of value/unit,” across science, engineering, and medicine.

patterns.name: Density and its measurement
patterns.context: Technical descriptions introduce the density of a material, carrier, or defect, often followed directly by a value or unit; passages 1, 5, and 7 explicitly contain density, while passage 9 lacks the word but has a similar quantitative measurement structure.
patterns.domain: Materials science, biological genomics, semiconductor devices; passage 9 is clinical virology measurement

patterns.name: Measurement or specification of a numeric quantity
patterns.context: Reports numeric attributes of technical objects, commonly with a noun followed by of and a specific value, unit, or magnitude; passages 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 follow this structure.
patterns.domain: Astronomical observations, software documentation, mining, optical experiments, stellar physics

patterns.name: Energy and activation-energy terminology
patterns.context: Describes the activation energy of a physical quantity such as relaxation time or viscosity; the phrase occurs twice consecutively in passage 3 and is followed by a symbolic value.

patterns.name: Quantitative descriptions of carriers
patterns.context: A carrier density phrase is followed by a value or formula in a sentence reporting a measurement.

patterns.name: Genomic composition and percentage
patterns.context: Describes the overall GC content of a bacterial chromosome, followed by a percentage.

patterns.name: Clinical detection threshold
patterns.context: Clinical measurement context for viral load, describing a detection threshold followed by a value in copies.

patterns.name: Performance scale of particles or equipment
patterns.context: Engineering performance descriptions of mining production capacity or wafer defect levels, both quantified by magnitude.

patterns.name: Page-size parameter
patterns.context: Software implementation documentation explains B-tree page size and its effect on overflow pages.

patterns.name: Experimental sample thickness
patterns.context: Sample preparation descriptions in microscopy / optics give the sample thickness followed by an approximate value and length unit.

patterns.name: Stellar effective temperature
patterns.context: Stellar physics descriptions give the effective temperature of a star as a value in kelvins.

patterns.name: Bandwidth specification
patterns.context: Observational equipment specifications give the total bandwidth as a value in GHz.

9_433.description: 神经元主要响应技术文本中引出或报告定量属性的名词短语，尤其密度、含量、载荷、吞吐量、尺寸、温度、带宽及激活能；多见“属性 of 数值/单位”结构，领域跨科学、工程与医学。

patterns.name: 密度及其测量值
patterns.context: 技术描述中介绍某种材料、载流子或缺陷的密度，并常紧接数值或单位；段1、5、7明确出现 density，段9虽无该词，但有相似的量化测量结构
patterns.domain: 材料科学、生物基因组、半导体器件；段9为临床病毒学测量

patterns.name: 数值量的测定或规格
patterns.context: 报告技术对象的数值属性，常见名词后接 of 和具体数值、单位或量级；段2、4、6、8、10均如此
patterns.domain: 天文观测、软件文档、采矿、光学实验、恒星物理

patterns.name: 能量及激活能术语
patterns.context: 松弛时间或黏度等物理量的激活能描述；段3中该短语连续出现两次，并接符号化数值

patterns.name: 载流子相关的量化表述
patterns.context: 载流子密度短语后跟数值或公式，位于测量结果句中

patterns.name: 基因组组成与百分比
patterns.context: 介绍细菌染色体时说明其总体 GC 含量，后接百分比

patterns.name: 临床检测阈值
patterns.context: 病毒载量的临床测量语境，描述检测阈值并接 copies 数值

patterns.name: 粒子或设备的性能规模
patterns.context: 采矿生产能力或晶圆缺陷水平的工程性能描述，均以数值量级刻画
patterns.domain: 采矿报道、半导体专利背景

patterns.name: 页面尺寸参数
patterns.context: 软件实现文档中说明 B-tree 页面大小及其对溢出页的影响

patterns.name: 实验样品厚度
patterns.context: 显微/光学样品制备描述中，样品厚度后接近似数值与长度单位

patterns.name: 恒星有效温度
patterns.context: 恒星物理描述中，给出恒星的有效温度及开尔文数值

patterns.name: 带宽规格
patterns.context: 观测设备配置说明中，给出总带宽及 GHz 数值

en.description: Activations often occur near parameter nouns and their values, units, or durations, especially density, size, throughput, energy, thickness, lifetime, follow-up period, and financial amounts; similarity percentages also occur.

patterns.name: Density values in scientific measurements
patterns.context: The trigger word density refers to density in a physics or materials-science context; activation occurs near the numerical expression.

patterns.name: Measurement expressions with numerical parameters and units
patterns.context: Involves a quantitative attribute, number, and unit or time span; typically appears in structures such as a parameter noun followed by of/between.
patterns.domain: Engineering, physics, biomedicine, and legal texts

patterns.name: Length and spatial-scale parameters
patterns.context: Describes the dimensions of astronomical or aerospace systems, with numbers attached to length parameter nouns.

patterns.name: Financial amounts and income accounting
patterns.context: In financial texts, amounts are linked to fields such as monthly income and net income.

patterns.name: Percentage similarity
patterns.context: Similarity is reported as a percentage when comparing bacterial strains.

9_433.description: 激活多出现在参数名词及其数值、单位或时长附近，尤其是密度、尺寸、吞吐量、能量、厚度、寿命、随访期及财务金额；另见相似度百分比。

patterns.name: 科学测量中的 density 数值
patterns.trigger: “density”以及紧随其后的数值/单位，如 “carrier density…of $n=2·10” 和 “experimental density (2.2 g/cm³)”
patterns.context: 触发词 density 在物理或材料科学语境中指密度；激活落在数值表达附近。

patterns.name: 数值参数与单位的测量表达
patterns.trigger: “throughput…of 9,470 metric tons per day”“energy…between 1.0 and $2.3 GeV”“sample thickness…of approximately $20μm”“life expectancy…of 23.8 years”“mean follow-up period…of 3.6 years”
patterns.context: 涉及量化属性、数值及单位或时间跨度；通常出现在名词参数后接 of/between 等结构中。
patterns.domain: 工程、物理、生物医学和法律文本

patterns.name: 长度与空间尺度参数
patterns.context: 描述天体/航天系统的尺寸，数值附着于长度参数名词。

patterns.name: 财务金额与收入核算
patterns.trigger: “monthly income totaled $24,267 per month”“monthly net income…$3150 per month”
patterns.context: 财务文本中金额与月收入、净收入等字段相连。

patterns.name: 百分比相似度
patterns.context: 菌种比较中，以百分比报告相似度。

en.concept: Technical parameters and their quantitative expression
en.description: All passages are quantitative or technical in nature, involving measurable metrics, parameters, scales, ratios, or capacity and their values; however, the activation position varies among metric names, nearby syntax, and numerical notation.

patterns.name: Numerical values and units of technical quantities
patterns.context: Triggers are mostly physical quantities, statistics, or equipment parameter names, immediately followed by numbers, units, or quantitative expressions; some examples also have modifiers before or after the number.
patterns.domain: Quantitative descriptions in scientific papers, medical abstracts, and industrial reporting

patterns.name: Values following metric or parameter names
patterns.context: Activation occurs on or after a metric or parameter name (e.g., score, density); the number gives a measurement result or condition. The score example also explicitly involves a pain-rating context.

patterns.name: Standalone device or scale terminology
patterns.context: When describing the spatial resolution of an observing instrument or the geometric scale of an astronomical shell, activation falls on measurement terms such as resolution, radius, or thickness and nearby positions.

patterns.name: Material-composition parameters in methodology
patterns.context: Following model assumptions such as PAH size distributions, a dust-to-gas mass ratio appears as a composition parameter; activation concentrates on ratio and nearby quantitative expressions.

patterns.name: Industrial capacity metric
patterns.context: In a report on a mine entering production, average modifies plant throughput, followed by a daily metric-tonnage figure.

patterns.name: Activation is not always on the parameter name
patterns.context: Within the same set of passages, strong activation falls on parameter names as well as nearby prepositions, equals signs, numbers, or units; the exact position varies with syntax and notation and is not necessarily fixed to a single part of speech.

9_433.concept: 技术参数及其量化表达
9_433.description: 所有片段都在定量或技术性语境中，出现可测量的指标、参数、尺度、比率或产能及其数值；但激活位置在指标名和邻近语法、数值记号间变化。

patterns.name: 技术量的数值与单位
patterns.trigger: 「resolution»10« between 3 and 4%」「density»10」「bandwidth»9 of 7.5GHz」「thickness»9 of 10 arcmin」「value»9 of 99.7%」「ratio»9」「throughput»9」「thickness»9 of approximately 420μm」
patterns.context: 触发词多为物理量、统计量或设备参数名，紧邻其后的数值、单位或量化表达；部分例子在数字前后还出现限定词。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、医学摘要及工业报道中的定量说明

patterns.name: 指标或参数名后的量值
patterns.context: 在指标名或参数名（如 score、density）处或其后激活，数值给出测量结果或条件；score 例中还明确出现痛感评分语境。

patterns.name: 单独的器件/尺度词语境
patterns.context: 在描述观测设备的空间分辨率或天体壳层几何尺度时，激活落在分辨率、半径、厚度等测量量词及其邻近位置。
patterns.domain: 天文学观测与天体物理

patterns.name: 方法学中的材料组成参数
patterns.context: 在 PAH 尺寸分布等模型假设之后，出现尘埃与气体质量比这一组成参数；激活集中在 ratio 及邻近量化表达。

patterns.name: 工业产能指标
patterns.context: 矿山投产报道中，average 修饰 plant throughput，随后以每日公吨数表达处理量。

patterns.name: 激活位置并非总是参数名
patterns.context: 同一批片段中，强激活既落在参数名，也落在介词、等号、数值或单位附近；具体位置因句法和记号而异，未必总是固定的单一词类。

en.description: Mostly quantitative statements with numbers and units, especially averages, ratios, ranges, income, and engineering stress; topics and styles vary, and lifetime estimates also occur.

patterns.name: Quantitative statements of quantities and averages
patterns.context: Technical, scientific, or financial texts report measurements, ratios, totals, or averages, often with a number and unit following “of”; activation may fall on quantity words, number-related words, or nearby units
patterns.domain: News, scientific papers, patents, and legal financial texts

patterns.name: Proportions and ratios
patterns.context: Describes a percentage, closeness to a ratio, or a proportional metric such as similarity, usually with a specific value
patterns.domain: News, scientific papers, patents, and financial texts

patterns.name: Physical stress and pressure
patterns.context: Describes stress or pressure on materials, devices, or mechanical components and its value, sometimes discussing its effects

patterns.name: Numerical ranges and measurement conditions
patterns.context: Scientific experiments or equipment descriptions give measurement ranges, density, or observation conditions

patterns.name: Tax rates and income amounts
patterns.context: Describes a person’s or debtor’s financial situation using monetary amounts, percentages, or monthly income

patterns.name: Bacterial similarity metric
patterns.context: Compares bacterial strains and reports genomic similarity as a specific percentage

patterns.name: Gold-mine production throughput
patterns.context: Reports the plant’s daily processing capacity after a mine begins production

patterns.name: Expectation and possibility statements
patterns.context: In a text describing a species’ lifetime, infers a lifetime that was not directly studied; the connection to quantitative-metric patterns is not obvious

9_433.description: 多为带数值和单位的定量陈述，尤其是平均值、比率、范围、收入及工程应力；主题和文体多样，另有寿命推断。

patterns.name: 数量与平均值的定量陈述
patterns.trigger: “average”及其后的数值或单位，如“average plant throughput”“average lifespan”“combined average monthly income”；也包括“total bandwidth of 7.5GHz”“resolution between 3 and 4%”等数值量
patterns.context: 技术、科学或财务文本中报告测量值、比率、总量或平均值，常见“of”后接数值与单位；激活可落在量词、数值相关词或单位附近
patterns.domain: 新闻、科学论文、专利和法律财务文本

patterns.name: 比例及比率
patterns.trigger: “tax rate”“aspect ratio”“resolution”“ANI value”等比例或比率表达
patterns.context: 描述百分比、接近某个比值，或相似度等比例指标，通常伴随具体数值
patterns.domain: 新闻、科学论文、专利和财务文本

patterns.name: 物理应力与压力
patterns.trigger: “mechanical stress”“contact stress”；“stress”后跟“of about 400 kPa”或“from about 100 kPa”
patterns.context: 描述材料、器件或机械部件所受应力/压力及其数值，有时讨论其造成的影响

patterns.name: 数值范围与测量条件
patterns.trigger: “ranged from … up to …”“at a charge carrier density of …”“around 1.4mm”
patterns.context: 科学实验或设备描述中，给出测量范围、密度或观测条件

patterns.name: 税率与收入金额
patterns.trigger: “tax rate of 13.9%”“pay a tax rate of 10%”“monthly net income of $3150 per month”
patterns.context: 以货币金额、百分比或月度收入描述个人或债务人的财务状况

patterns.name: 细菌相似度指标
patterns.context: 比较细菌菌株，并用具体百分数报告基因组相似性

patterns.name: 金矿生产吞吐量
patterns.trigger: “plant throughput of 9,470 metric tons per day”
patterns.context: 报告矿山投产后的工厂日处理量

patterns.name: 预期与可能性表述
patterns.context: 在描述物种寿命的文字中，对未直接研究的寿命作推断；与定量指标模式关系不明显

en.description: Primarily responds to names of metrics appearing around values in technical texts, such as throughput, calcium level, resolution, density, thickness, similarity, irradiance, stress, and bandwidth; these metrics belong to different disciplines. Passage 7 is general narrative and is difficult to explain with this pattern.

patterns.name: Technical parameter nouns following values
patterns.context: Describes a measurement, material property, performance metric, or experimental setting in a technical or scientific text; common structures place modifiers before the noun and a value or unit after it, or vice versa.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, medical papers, patents, and technical descriptions

patterns.name: Metric terms in quantitative reporting
patterns.context: Around reported values, metrics include averages, concentrations / levels, resolution, density, thickness, similarity, irradiance, stress, or bandwidth; contexts across different disciplines can trigger activation.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain quantitative scientific and engineering prose

patterns.name: Mismatched general narrative
patterns.context: A general historical narrative discusses causal speculation; the passage has no salient quantitative-parameter reporting structure.

9_433.description: 主要响应技术文本中围绕量值出现的指标名词，如吞吐量、钙水平、分辨率、密度、厚度、相似度、辐照度、应力和带宽；这些指标分属不同学科。第7段是一般叙述，难以由此模式解释。

patterns.name: 量值后的技术参数名词
patterns.context: 技术或科学文本中，描述一个测量量、材料性质、性能指标或实验设置；常见结构为名词前接修饰语、名词后接数值或单位，或反之。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、医学论文、专利和技术说明

patterns.name: 定量报告中的指标词
patterns.trigger: “average”“serum calcium level”“resolution”“charge carrier density”“sample thickness”“ANI value”“peak irradiance”“contact stress”“total bandwidth”
patterns.context: 围绕数值报告平均值、浓度/水平、分辨率、密度、厚度、相似度、辐照度、应力或带宽等指标；不同学科语境均可触发。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的定量科学与工程文体

patterns.name: 不匹配的通用叙述
patterns.context: 一般历史叙述中谈及因果猜测；片段没有显著的定量参数报告结构。
patterns.domain: 通俗历史或说明性散文

en.concept: Quantitative metrics and their numerical values
en.description: All passages report or constrain a quantifiable metric: metric names are often adjacent to words such as value, rate, density, load, score, level, throughput, or bandwidth, and linked to numbers, units, thresholds, or target ranges; specific fields vary.

patterns.name: Numerical metric or measurement
patterns.context: Technical or scientific prose reports quantitative results, measurements, thresholds, proportions, or performance metrics; activation often falls on the metric name and nearby relational words, units, or numbers
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, medical research, engineering specifications, news data

patterns.name: Tax rates and income comparisons
patterns.context: Compares tax rates paid by different income groups and mentions personal income and tax rates

patterns.name: Taxonomic similarity and ANI
patterns.context: Compares genomic similarity between bacterial strains and reports an ANI value

patterns.name: Disease score
patterns.context: Reports the average disease score for an animal group near the end of a study

patterns.name: Bandwidth in observational configurations
patterns.context: Describes a correlator configuration and the bandwidth of an observing instrument

patterns.name: Carrier density
patterns.context: Reports the charge-carrier density corresponding to carrier mobility

patterns.name: Mine capacity
patterns.context: Reports the average daily processing rate after a mine begins production

patterns.name: Viral-load threshold
patterns.context: Uses a specific value as a threshold for plasma CMV DNA detection or assessment

patterns.name: Wafer defect density
patterns.context: Describes the typical number of micropipe defects per unit area in silicon carbide wafers

patterns.name: Communication packet error-rate specification
patterns.context: Specifies the packet error-rate requirement that vehicle-to-vehicle communication equipment must meet at a given speed

patterns.name: Blood-calcium target level
patterns.context: Adjusts a drug dose to reach a specific blood-calcium target value

9_433.description: 所有片段都在报告或限定一个可量化指标：指标名常与 value、rate、density、load、score、level、throughput 或 bandwidth 等词相邻，并连接数值、单位、阈值或目标范围；具体领域各异。

patterns.name: 数值指标或测量值
patterns.trigger: 数值前的指标名及其与数值的关系，如 «rate»、«value»、«bandwidth»、«throughput»、«density»、«load»、«Error Rate»、«score»、«level»；常见形式为“指标 + of/at + 数值”或“指标 + 数值”
patterns.context: 技术或科学叙述中报告定量结果、测量值、阈值、比例或性能指标；激活往往落在指标名以及邻近的关系词、单位或数值上
patterns.domain: 科学论文、医学研究、工程规格、新闻数据

patterns.name: 税率与收入比较
patterns.context: 比较不同收入群体所缴税率，提到个人收入及税率

patterns.name: 分类学相似度及ANI
patterns.context: 比较细菌菌株的基因组相似性并报告 ANI 数值

patterns.name: 疾病评分
patterns.context: 研究结尾报告动物组的平均疾病评分

patterns.name: 观测配置的带宽
patterns.context: 描述相关器配置及观测仪器的带宽
patterns.domain: 天文学或射电观测论文

patterns.name: 载流子密度
patterns.context: 报告载流子迁移率对应的电荷载流子密度
patterns.domain: 凝聚态物理或材料科学论文

patterns.name: 矿山产能
patterns.context: 报告矿山投产后的日均处理量

patterns.name: 病毒载量阈值
patterns.context: 以特定数值作为血浆 CMV DNA 检测或判断阈值

patterns.name: 晶片缺陷密度
patterns.trigger: «defect» «density»；“on the order of 100 per square cent…”
patterns.context: 描述碳化硅晶圆中微管缺陷的典型单位面积数量
patterns.domain: 专利背景及半导体材料

patterns.name: 通信误包率规格
patterns.context: 规定车辆间通信设备在给定速度下须满足的误包率要求

patterns.name: 血钙目标水平
patterns.trigger: «serum» «calcium» «level»；“at the lower end of the reference range”
patterns.context: 调整药物剂量以达到特定血钙目标值

en.description: All passages highlight a parameter or metric name in quantitative statements, followed by or associated with values, units, ranges, or comparison results; domains differ but include mining capacity, stress, similarity, lifespan, blood calcium, bandwidth, thickness, window size, irradiance, and resolution.

patterns.name: Values in measurement parameters
patterns.context: A value, unit, or numeric range appears near the name of a parameter or measured quantity; the value itself is usually not marked, and activation concentrates on the quantity name.
patterns.domain: Quantitative statements in scientific papers, patents, medical cases, and legal-financial explanations

patterns.name: Numeric relationships and reporting constructions
patterns.context: The quantity name appears in a phrase reporting a value, comparison result, or set parameter; common collocations include average/total/peak, value/level, and stress/expectancy/size/resolution.
patterns.domain: Cross-disciplinary technical and factual explanatory prose

patterns.name: Life expectancy in law
patterns.context: When calculating the present value of retirement benefits, life expectancy is described using a life-expectancy table and the person’s age.
patterns.domain: Legal opinion or trial factual statement

patterns.name: Medical treatment target
patterns.context: A case narrative adjusts a medication dose with the goal of bringing serum calcium to the lower end of the reference range.

patterns.name: Names of academic metrics or quantities
patterns.context: Activation falls on nouns naming experimental, engineering, or statistical quantities, rather than proper names, general narrative, or units.
patterns.domain: Engineering, physics, biomedicine, and statistical technical texts

9_433.description: 各段均在定量陈述中突出参数或指标名，后接或关联数值、单位、范围及比较结果；领域虽异，包含矿业产能、应力、相似度、寿命、血钙、带宽、厚度、窗口大小、辐照度和分辨率。

patterns.name: 计量参数中的数值
patterns.context: 在参数或测量量名称之后，附近出现数值、单位或数值范围；数值本身通常未标记，激活集中在量名上。
patterns.domain: 科技论文、专利、医学病例及法律财务说明中的定量陈述

patterns.name: 数值关系与报告句式
patterns.context: 量名处于报告数值、比较结果或设定参数的短语中，常见搭配包括 average/total/peak、value/level、stress/expectancy/size/resolution。
patterns.domain: 跨学科技术与事实性说明文

patterns.name: 法律中的预期寿命
patterns.context: 计算退休福利现值时，以生命预期表和当事人年龄描述预期寿命。
patterns.domain: 法律意见或庭审事实陈述

patterns.name: 医学治疗目标
patterns.context: 病例叙述调整药物剂量，目标是使血清钙达到参考范围较低端。

patterns.name: 学术指标或量值的名称
patterns.context: 激活落在用来命名实验、工程或统计量的名词上，而不是专名、一般叙述或单位上。
patterns.domain: 工程、物理、生物医学及统计技术文本

en.description: Activations are scattered across several word forms and proper names: World (mostly in names), Exp-, Category labels, and sporadic words in migration, sports, medicine, and biographical entries. No clear cross-domain rule is apparent.

patterns.name: World in proper or organization names
patterns.context: Appears in names or titles, followed by nouns for specific fields, events, organizations, etc.; the word itself activates strongly.

patterns.name: Exp word-initial fragment
patterns.context: Appears in words beginning with Exp, including “Expense(s)” and “Expansion”; the following stems differ.

patterns.name: Category classification label
patterns.context: Appears as a category field at the end of a Wikipedia entry, followed by a colon and category name.

patterns.name: Migration-related migrate
patterns.context: Describes people moving somewhere, followed by the destination “to Germany”.

patterns.name: Sports events and results narratives
patterns.context: Lists competitors and event background in descriptions of billiards events.

patterns.name: Medical term role
patterns.context: Describes a physiological or disease-related function in the construction “plays a fundamental role in”.

patterns.name: Anemia- and transfusion-related terms
patterns.context: Discusses transfusions and iron overload complications in patients with sickle cell anemia.

patterns.name: Sports doubles events
patterns.context: Describes men's doubles partners, medals, or event champions.

patterns.name: Names and positions of people
patterns.context: Titles of biographical entries and descriptions of birth details and university positions.

9_757.description: 激活分散于若干词形与专名：World（多为名称）、Exp-、Category 标签，以及迁移、体育、医学和人物条目中的零散词。跨领域一致规则不明显。

patterns.name: World 用于专名或机构名称
patterns.context: 出现在名称或标题中，后接特定领域、赛事、组织等名词；该词本身激活较强。

patterns.name: Exp 词首片段
patterns.context: 出现在以 Exp 开头的词中，包括 “Expense(s)” 和 “Expansion”；后续词干不同。
patterns.domain: 邮件主题、欧洲议会文本

patterns.name: Category 分类标签
patterns.context: 作为维基百科条目末尾的分类字段，后接冒号及分类名称。

patterns.name: 迁移相关 migrate
patterns.context: 谈及人群迁往某地，后接目的地 “to Germany”。

patterns.name: 体育赛事及成绩叙述
patterns.context: 台球赛事介绍中，列述参赛选手及赛事背景。

patterns.name: 医学术语 role
patterns.context: 在 “plays a fundamental role in” 结构中说明生理或疾病相关作用。

patterns.name: 贫血与输血相关术语
patterns.context: 讨论镰状细胞贫血患者输血及铁过载并发症。

patterns.name: 体育双打项目
patterns.context: 描述男子双打搭档、奖牌或赛事冠军。

patterns.name: 人物姓名与职务
patterns.context: 人物条目标题及其出生信息、大学职务介绍。

en.concept: Word-form fragments and specific lexical triggers
en.description: Activation is not a single semantic feature: prominent hits include the Exp fragment (expense, expansion), World-related words, the Category classification label, the medical term sickle, and migrate; the airway inflammation passage has no clear corresponding trigger word.

patterns.name: Expansion/growth roots
patterns.context: Activation is prominent on the token fragment “Exp” within words, but the two word senses and contexts differ: one is expansion, the other expense(s).
