patterns.domain: Business emails, aviation policy, general text

patterns.name: World-related words
patterns.context: Occurs in proper names or fixed phrases; the referents are the world’s top players, World Heritage sites, world-class athletes, or World Doubles.

patterns.name: Category label
patterns.context: Structured category labels at the end of Wikipedia entries or in category lists.

patterns.name: “sick cell” phrase
patterns.context: Occurs in the disease name sickle cell anemia, in medical discussions of adult patients, transfusions, or complications.

patterns.name: Migration word
patterns.context: Describes groups that still hope to move to Germany and their regions of origin.

9_757.concept: 词形片段与特定词汇触发
9_757.description: 激活并非单一语义特征：显著命中 Exp 片段（expense、expansion）、World 相关词、Category 分类标签、医学词 sickle 及 migrate；气道炎症段无明显对应触发词。

patterns.name: 扩张/增长词根
patterns.context: 激活突出在单词内部的分词片段“Exp”，但两类词义和语境不同：一类为 expansion，另一类为 expense(s)。
patterns.domain: 商务邮件、航空政策、一般文本

patterns.name: World 相关词
patterns.trigger: “World”»9/10，出现在 “World's”“World Cultural heritage”“World”“World Doubles”等形式中
patterns.context: 在专名或固定短语中出现；所指分别是世界顶尖选手、世界文化遗产、世界级运动员或 World Doubles。
patterns.domain: 体育百科、文化旅游、人物传记

patterns.name: Category 标记
patterns.context: Wikipedia 条目末尾或分类列表中的结构化类别标签。

patterns.name: sick cell 短语
patterns.context: 出现在疾病名称 sickle cell anemia 中，并位于成人患者、输血或并发症的医学讨论里。

patterns.name: migration 词
patterns.context: 描述仍希望移居德国的群体及其来源地区。

en.description: High-activation patterns are sporadic: the word-initial Exp, the word form World, and local contexts involving immigration, disease effects, iron overload, beam expansion, smoking restrictions, and medical ethics. No clear semantic theme unifies all fragments.

patterns.name: Exp word form
patterns.context: High activation occurs after the initial substring Exp, while the subsequent word senses and contexts differ; the form may correspond to expense, expansion, expanded, expressed.
patterns.domain: Emails, parliamentary text, patents, medical papers

patterns.name: World word form
patterns.context: World occurs in a possessive or in the combination World Cultural; local contexts are snooker event descriptions and cultural heritage tourism.

patterns.name: Migration and immigration
patterns.context: Narrative about Montenegrins moving to Germany, with nearby mentions of refugees, the Yugoslav Wars, and migration origins.

patterns.name: Airway inflammation and disease effects
patterns.context: The structure “fundamental role in” describes the role of airway inflammation in diseases such as asthma.

patterns.name: Iron overload
patterns.context: Medical discussion of transfusion complications in patients with sickle cell anemia mentions iron overload and related endocrine abnormalities.

patterns.name: Laser beam expansion
patterns.context: A patent technical description in which a laser and beam pass through a beam expander to form expanded light.

patterns.name: Smoking regulations and tighter oversight
patterns.context: Discusses smoking bans or indoor smoking policies, expressing a need for more uniform, stricter regulations and related concerns.

patterns.name: Well-being and self-determination
patterns.context: Medical decision-making ethics discussion connects well-being with self-determination and family influence.

9_757.description: 高激活模式分散：Exp词首、World词形，以及移民、疾病作用、铁过载、光束扩展、禁烟监管和医疗伦理等局部语境；未见能统一覆盖全部片段的明确语义主题。

patterns.name: Exp 词形
patterns.context: 高激活出现在词首子串 Exp 后，后续词义和语境各不相同；形式可对应 expense、expansion、expanded、expressed。
patterns.domain: 邮件、议会文本、专利、医学论文

patterns.name: 世界 / World 词形
patterns.context: World 出现在所有格或 World Cultural 组合中；局部上下文分别是斯诺克赛事描述和文化遗产旅游。

patterns.name: 迁移与移民
patterns.context: 关于黑山人迁往德国的叙述，附近提到难民、南斯拉夫战争及迁徙来源地。

patterns.name: 气道炎症与疾病作用
patterns.context: “fundamental role in”结构，说明气道炎症在哮喘等疾病中的作用。

patterns.name: 铁过载
patterns.context: 镰状细胞贫血患者输血并发症的医学讨论中，提及铁过载及其相关内分泌异常。

patterns.name: 激光光束扩展
patterns.context: 专利技术描述中，激光及光束经过扩束器后形成扩展光。

patterns.name: 吸烟规定与收紧监管
patterns.context: 讨论禁烟或室内吸烟政策，表达对更统一、更严格规定的需要及相关担忧。
patterns.domain: 医学研究、公共卫生政策

patterns.name: 福祉与自我决定
patterns.context: 医疗决策伦理讨论中，将福祉与自我决定、家庭影响联系起来。

en.description: Activations are scattered across several word-initial or subword fragments: School, Air, please, Exp, and a few Polish word forms, event names, and species-name fragments; their contexts differ.

patterns.name: English word-initial School
patterns.context: English words or phrases beginning with School; in [9] it is followed by the plural suffix s, and in [10] by problems.

patterns.name: English word-initial Air
patterns.context: Begins with Air and discusses inflammation or pollution and their health effects.

patterns.name: please in emails
patterns.context: Polite requests in email body text; once near the beginning of a sentence and once after “Attached”.

patterns.name: Exp in email subjects
patterns.context: Appears as the initial fragment of Expense/Expenses in email subjects, with strong activation in both instances.

patterns.name: Polish word-form fragments
patterns.context: Polish sentence fragments involving word segmentation; no clear semantic condition shared with the other segments.

patterns.name: World in event names
patterns.context: Appears after a year as part of the sports event name “World Table Tennis Championships”.

patterns.name: Fragment within a proper name
patterns.context: Appears in “great sturgeon (Huso huso)” as a subword segmentation of the English fish name.

9_757.description: 激活分散在若干词首或子词片段：School、Air、please、Exp，以及少数波兰语词形、赛事名称和物种名片段；各自上下文不同。

patterns.name: 英语词首 School
patterns.context: 英文中以 School 开头的词或短语；在 [9] 后接复数词尾 s，在 [10] 后接 problems。

patterns.name: 英语词首 Air
patterns.context: 以 Air 开头，谈及炎症或污染及其健康影响。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、环境健康文本

patterns.name: 邮件中的 please
patterns.context: 邮件正文中的礼貌请求；一次位于句首附近，一次在“Attached”之后。

patterns.name: 邮件主题中的 Exp
patterns.context: 邮件主题里作为 Expense/Expenses 的词首片段出现，且两处均有较强激活。

patterns.name: 波兰语词形片段
patterns.context: 波兰语句子片段，涉及词形切分；没有明显与其他段共享的语义条件。

patterns.name: 赛事名称中的 World
patterns.context: 位于年份之后，构成体育赛事名称“World Table Tennis Championships”。

patterns.name: 专名内部片段
patterns.context: 出现在“great sturgeon (Huso huso)”中，是英文鱼名的子词切分。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、物种名称

en.description: Strong activation repeatedly occurs on periods, especially at the end of titles or phrases; in mathematical fragments it also falls on formula symbols, variables, and numbers. Several medical terms and proper names also show subword boundaries, along with activations on body text words; the pattern is not fully consistent.

patterns.name: Periods at title endings and abstract-body line breaks
patterns.context: A period marks the end of a title or phrase, followed by a line break and the beginning of body text; prominent in multiple PubMed abstracts and also seen in GitHub project descriptions.
patterns.domain: Abstracts, titles, and project configuration text

patterns.name: Periods in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: A period immediately follows mathematical notation or a number, occurring in formulas, numerical values, or math problem fragments; it need not follow a natural-language title.

patterns.name: Token boundaries within proper names or abbreviations
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments of drug names, personal names, or terms that have been tokenized; these words occur in abstracts or bibliographic text after titles.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, pharmacology, and bibliographic text

patterns.name: Technical version marker in a title
patterns.context: Occurs in the parameter of the build configuration command «cmake_minimum_required»; the period at the end of the version number is also strongly activated.

patterns.name: Space tokenization in anatomical terms
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on subword fragments of anatomical/clinical terms at the start of titles; the period at the title’s end is also strongly activated.

patterns.name: Mathematical variables and equality symbols
patterns.context: Variables and operators occur in math problems or formula fragments; activation is distributed across multiple symbols, not just periods.

patterns.name: Numerical lists and digit strings
patterns.context: Numerical fragments made up of consecutive digits and decimal points, without visible natural-language explanation.

patterns.name: Unclear lexical and syntactic activations
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across medical titles, body-text words, and common sentence-initial words; fragments alone do not reveal a shared trigger condition. It may reflect a mix of subword boundaries and title/body formatting.

9_757.description: 强烈激活反复出现在句点，尤其标题或短语结束处；数学片段中也落在公式符号、变量及数字上。另有若干医学术语、专名的子词边界和正文词语激活，模式不完全一致。

patterns.name: 标题末尾句点及摘要正文换行
patterns.context: 句点标记标题或短语的结束，之后出现换行并开始正文；在多个 PubMed 摘要中明显，也见于 GitHub 项目描述。
patterns.domain: 摘要、标题与项目配置文本

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的句点
patterns.context: 句点紧接数学记号或数字，处于公式、数值或数学题片段中；不要求前面是自然语言标题。

patterns.name: 专名或缩写内部的分词边界
patterns.context: 激活落在被切分的药名、人名或术语子词上；这些词出现于标题后的摘要或书目文本。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、药理学及书目文本

patterns.name: 标题中的技术版本标记
patterns.context: 出现在构建配置命令 «cmake_minimum_required» 的参数中，版本号末尾句点也强烈激活。

patterns.name: 解剖学术语中的空格分词
patterns.context: 激活集中于标题开头的解剖学／临床术语子词，标题末尾句点同样强烈激活。

patterns.name: 数学变量与等式符号
patterns.context: 变量及运算符出现在数学题或公式片段中；该段激活分布于多个符号而不只句点。

patterns.name: 数值列表与数字串
patterns.context: 连续数字和小数点构成的数值片段，缺少可见的自然语言解释。

patterns.name: 不明的词汇及句法激活
patterns.context: 激活分布在医学标题、正文词语及句首常用词上，无法仅凭片段确定共同触发条件；可能与子词边界或标题／正文格式混杂。

en.description: Activations are concentrated on toolbar fields or controls in texts from multiple domains: configuration, resource names, browser options, and automated operations. Other patterns include Khmer characters, legal boilerplate, military reporting, medical cases, email attachment records, and biology abstracts.

patterns.name: toolbar term and related interface controls
patterns.context: Appears in code text involving UI controls, interface configuration, resource identifiers, or browser settings; [1] also contains a toolbar field

patterns.name: Khmer text fragment
patterns.context: Khmer characters appear near field values or labels such as Email, Url, and toolbar; nearby characters also activate strongly

patterns.name: Publication status statement
patterns.context: Appears in boilerplate court-opinion language indicating whether an opinion has been officially published

patterns.name: Military organization name
patterns.context: Co-occurs with news-reporting terms such as Gaza, militants, claimed responsibility, and firing a rocket

patterns.name: Medical cases and anatomical terms
patterns.context: Describes symptoms, imaging examinations, and lesion locations in medical case narratives

patterns.name: Email attachment migration record
patterns.context: An automatically generated parenthetical record indicating that an embedded image has been moved to a file

patterns.name: String resources and localization identifiers
patterns.context: XML string resource entries containing resource names, message IDs, and translated text

patterns.name: Program variables and browser state settings
patterns.context: Code assigns session state and uses strings to set options such as the browser toolbar and menu bar

patterns.name: Zebrafish rearing and growth
patterns.context: Abstract title and body discuss larval feed, rearing methods, and growth and survival

patterns.name: Interface automation operations
patterns.context: Structured operation records describing waiting for the interface to become idle and clicking a toolbar button

9_757.description: 激活集中于多领域文本中的 toolbar 字段或控件：配置、资源名、浏览器选项与自动化操作；另有 Khmer 字符、法律固定语、军事报道、医学病例、邮件附件记录及生物学摘要等不同模式。

patterns.name: toolbar 词及相关界面控件
patterns.trigger: “toolbar”（[5] 中为“extra-toolbar-buttons”，[7] 为“abc_toolbar_collapse_description”，[8] 为“toolbar=no”，[10] 为“toolbar button”）
patterns.context: 出现在 UI 控件、界面配置、资源标识或浏览器设置等代码文本中；[1] 也包含 toolbar 字段

patterns.name: Khmer 文本片段
patterns.trigger: 高激活 token 包括“ត”“ថ”“ប”“ទ”，夹在标点和字段格式中
patterns.context: Khmer 字符出现在类似 Email、Url、toolbar 的字段值或标签附近；对周围字符的激活也较强
patterns.domain: Github 数据或配置样式文本

patterns.name: 出版状态语句
patterns.context: 出现在法院意见书的固定格式语句中，说明意见是否正式发表

patterns.name: 军事组织名称
patterns.context: 与 Gaza、militants、claimed responsibility、firing a rocket 等新闻报道用语共现

patterns.name: 医学病例与解剖术语
patterns.context: 医学病例叙述中描述症状、影像检查和病变位置

patterns.name: 邮件附件迁移记录
patterns.context: 括号中的自动生成记录，指示嵌入图片已移至文件

patterns.name: 字符串资源与本地化标识
patterns.context: XML 字符串资源条目，含资源名、消息 ID 和翻译文本

patterns.name: 程序变量与浏览器状态设置
patterns.context: 代码中赋值会话状态，并以字符串设置浏览器工具栏、菜单栏等选项

patterns.name: 斑马鱼养殖与生长
patterns.trigger: “first-feeding larval zebrafish”“Type L saltwater rotifers”“Promoting high rates”
patterns.context: 摘要标题和正文讨论幼体饵料、养殖方法及生长存活
patterns.domain: PubMed 水产与生物学摘要

patterns.name: 界面自动化操作
patterns.context: 描述等待界面空闲并点击工具栏按钮的结构化操作记录
patterns.domain: Github 测试或自动化数据

en.concept: Recognition of word forms with specific stems
en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly on different extensions of the amphib word family and the actin word family; there are also sporadic activations for Archive-related terms, hyphenated Node.js titles, and Montenegro/Yugoslavia-related word forms.

patterns.name: amphibian word family
patterns.context: The amphib stem takes different affixes and appears in sentences or phrases; referents include amphibians, amphibious robots, and the mineral amphibole.

patterns.name: actin word family
patterns.context: actin appears as a biological term or within compound terms.

patterns.name: Archive-related terms
patterns.context: Discusses preserving user content, historical archives, and internet archive organizations.

patterns.name: Year and hyphenated Node.js title
patterns.context: Title-style phrase connecting a time span, a technology name, and a use case with hyphens.

patterns.name: Montenegro/Yugoslavia word forms
patterns.context: Discusses Montenegrin immigrants and the historical account of the region's then-membership in Yugoslavia.

9_757.concept: 含特定词干的词形识别
9_757.description: 激活主要集中于 amphib 词族的不同扩展形式和 actin 词族；另对 Archive 档案用语、Node.js 连字符标题及 Montenegro/Yugoslavia 相关词形有零散激活。

patterns.name: amphibian词族
patterns.context: 词干 amphib 后接不同词缀，出现在句中或短语中；分别指两栖动物、两栖机器人、amphibole 矿物。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、机器人学、毒理学

patterns.name: actin词族
patterns.context: actin 作为生物学术语出现，或嵌在复合术语中。
patterns.domain: 细胞生物学、分子生物学

patterns.name: 档案相关词
patterns.context: 讨论保存用户内容、历史档案及互联网档案机构。

patterns.name: 年份与 Node.js 连字符标题
patterns.context: 标题式短语，以连字符连接时间长度、技术名称与使用情境。

patterns.name: Montenegro/Yugoslavia词形
patterns.context: 涉及蒙特内哥罗移民及其当时属于南斯拉夫的历史叙述。

en.description: The most consistent trigger is the colon and backslash in Windows drive paths, often accompanied by directory names, filenames, and path strings in technical Q&A, commands, and code. Segment 10 also activates on LaTeX backslash commands, suggesting that the backslash itself may be a broader trigger.

patterns.name: Windows drive paths
patterns.context: In Windows paths or command-line text, especially a drive letter followed by a backslash; multiple activations fall on the drive letter, colon, and slash.
patterns.domain: Windows instructions, command lines, code, and errors; includes documentation and discussions

patterns.name: Directories and filenames in paths
patterns.context: Path separators connect drive letters, directories, user folders, or filenames; often appears in discussions of path settings, file locations, or access problems.
patterns.domain: Windows, Excel/VBA, .NET errors, and file-path Q&A

patterns.name: Escaped or literal strings in paths
patterns.context: Path-like strings appear in code, commands, or quoted text; quotes, literal-string syntax, or the path itself may accompany activation.
patterns.domain: PowerShell, C#, Excel/VBA, and technical Q&A

patterns.name: Backslash commands in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: In LaTeX mathematical expressions, the backslash is a command prefix rather than a Windows path separator.

9_757.description: 最一致的触发是 Windows 盘符路径中的冒号与反斜杠，常伴随目录名、文件名及路径字符串，出现在技术问答、命令和代码里。第10段也激活于 LaTeX 的反斜杠命令，说明反斜杠本身可能是更广泛的触发。

patterns.name: Windows 驱动器路径
patterns.context: 在 Windows 路径或命令行文本中，尤其是盘符后接反斜杠；多个示例激活落在盘符、冒号和斜杠上。
patterns.domain: Windows 使用说明、命令行、代码和报错；涵盖文档与讨论

patterns.name: 路径中的目录与文件名
patterns.context: 路径分隔符连接盘符、目录、用户文件夹或文件名；常在讨论路径设置、文件位置或访问问题时出现。
patterns.domain: Windows、Excel/VBA、.NET 错误与文件路径问答

patterns.name: 路径字符串中的转义或逐字量
patterns.context: 代码、命令或引述文本中出现类似路径的字符串；引号、逐字字符串写法或路径本身均可能伴随激活。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的反斜杠命令
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学表达式中反斜杠作为命令前缀，而非 Windows 路径分隔符。

en.description: Activations often occur in web text, especially question openings, terminology, and external links in technical Q&A; they also cover specific technical content such as HTML, regex, layouts, and XML. Other examples include digit problems, HN design comments, and literary criticism, with no single trigger semantics.

patterns.name: Question-post openings and interrogative sentences
patterns.context: Commonly appears at the start of StackExchange question bodies, where the question asks about a term, method, or answer; the marker itself activates, as do several words in the question.

patterns.name: Web links and URL fragments
patterns.context: Multiple URL fragments activate repeatedly when the body cites an external page, code example, or resource link; nearby words may also activate.
patterns.domain: Web text, technical Q&A, and code configuration

patterns.name: Class and programming technology questions
patterns.context: Technical questions about classes, data structure behavior, or SSL communication; activation locations are scattered, with no fixed term combination.

patterns.name: HTML and example-code markers
patterns.context: Technical content containing HTML snippets, comments, line breaks, and links to online code examples.

patterns.name: Regular expression examples
patterns.context: Russian-language description of a problem matching an IP at the start of a line with a regular expression, listing examples and a regex101 link.

patterns.name: Float layout and column heights
patterns.context: Describes a float layout breaking due to inconsistent column heights and includes a Plunker example.

patterns.name: XML Schema configuration
patterns.context: The schemaLocation attribute in an XML configuration and URLs related to a Maven POM.

patterns.name: Digit arithmetic problem
patterns.context: Asks for the hundreds digit of an integer, with short-answer-style line breaks.

patterns.name: Literary criticism and narrative vocabulary
patterns.context: Comments on characterization and humor in a work and narrates the heroine's experience of unjust suspicion; unlike the other technical Q&A patterns.

patterns.name: Design evaluation and entity links in an HN comment
patterns.context: Discusses the reasons for Quora's new design and includes HTML entity encoding and linked content.

9_757.description: 激活常见于网页文本，尤其是技术问答中的提问开头、术语与外链；也覆盖 HTML、正则、布局、XML 等具体技术内容。另有数位题、HN设计评论和文学评论，无法归为单一触发语义。

patterns.name: 问题帖开头与问句
patterns.context: 常见于 StackExchange 问题正文的开头，问句询问某个术语、做法或答案；标记本身有激活，问句中的若干词也有激活。

patterns.name: 网页链接与 URL 片段
patterns.context: 在正文引用外部页面、代码示例或资源链接时，多个 URL 片段反复激活；链接周围的词也可能激活。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、技术问答及代码配置

patterns.name: 类与编程技术提问
patterns.context: 谈到类、数据结构行为或 SSL 通信的技术问题；触发位置分散，未呈现固定术语组合。

patterns.name: HTML 与示例代码标记
patterns.context: 包含 HTML 片段、注释、换行及在线代码示例链接的技术内容。

patterns.name: 正则表达式示例
patterns.context: 俄语说明正则表达式在行首匹配 IP 的问题，并列出示例及 regex101 链接。

patterns.name: 浮动布局与列高度
patterns.context: 描述列高不一致导致浮动布局出错，并附 Plunker 示例。

patterns.name: XML Schema 配置
patterns.context: XML 配置中的 schemaLocation 属性及 Maven POM 相关 URL。

patterns.name: 数位算术题
patterns.context: 询问整数的百位数字，带有短答案式换行。

patterns.name: 文学评论与叙事词汇
patterns.context: 评论作品的人物刻画与幽默，并叙述女主人公遭受不公怀疑；与其他技术问答模式不同。

patterns.name: HN 评论中的设计评价与实体链接
patterns.context: 讨论 Quora 推出的新设计及其可能原因，夹有 HTML 实体编码和链接内容。

en.description: Activations are scattered across specific strings in patent terminology, code licenses and compression descriptions, paper formulas and machine-learning text, email proper names, and forum comments/links; no shared semantic or formal trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Body Shop proper name
patterns.context: Part of a name, preceded by the preposition «in the» and followed by «Fuel Station».

patterns.name: toner save term
patterns.context: Patent background text discussing print-data classification and the toner save method applicable to each category.

patterns.name: meat and animal products
patterns.context: A phrase in a link URL about meat and animal products; the body discusses the standard of living in the United States.

patterns.name: Compression algorithm performance tradeoff
patterns.context: Describes an algorithm's performance in terms of compression speed and compression ratio.

patterns.name: Apache License version label
patterns.context: A license declaration in a code file header, followed by the license definition and licensing terms.

patterns.name: Distribution generalization and optimization formula
patterns.context: Introduces a predictive model and its optimization problem, including mathematical symbols and formulas.

patterns.name: Rent trends and source link
patterns.context: States that an indicator has remained stable in recent years and includes a chart link from a rental website.

patterns.name: Academic search filtering operation
patterns.context: Instructs the user to adjust a filter slider and links to a Semantic Scholar year search.

patterns.name: Blog name and thesis term
patterns.context: Mentions a humorous blog and its URL, describing it in the body as a more serious version.

patterns.name: Mathematical formula containing cosh
patterns.context: A derivation involving the hyperbolic cosine function, fractions, and logarithms.

9_757.description: 激活分散于专利术语、代码许可证与压缩说明、论文公式及机器学习文字、邮件专名和论坛评论/链接中的具体词串；看不出共同的语义或形式触发条件。

patterns.name: Body Shop 固有名称
patterns.context: 作为名称的一部分，前有介词 «in the»，后接 «Fuel Station»。

patterns.name: toner save 术语
patterns.context: 专利背景文本中，讨论打印数据分类及各类别适用的 toner save 方法。

patterns.name: meat and animal products
patterns.context: 链接 URL 中出现关于肉类和动物产品的短语，正文谈及美国生活水平。

patterns.name: 压缩算法性能权衡
patterns.context: 描述算法在压缩速度与压缩率之间的表现。

patterns.name: Apache License 版本标注
patterns.context: 代码文件头部的许可证声明，后续接许可证定义及许可条款。

patterns.name: 分布泛化与优化公式
patterns.context: 介绍预测模型及其优化问题，包含数学符号和公式。

patterns.name: 租金走势及来源链接
patterns.context: 称某指标近年保持平稳，并附带租房网站的图表链接。

patterns.name: 学术搜索筛选操作
patterns.context: 指导用户调整筛选滑块，链接到 Semantic Scholar 的年份搜索。

patterns.name: 博客名称及 thesis 词
patterns.context: 提及一个幽默博客及其网址，正文将其称为较严肃版本。

patterns.name: 含 cosh 的数学公式
patterns.context: 公式推导中出现双曲余弦函数、分式和对数。

en.description: A clearer pattern is selective activation on English intraword subword splits and camel-case identifier fragments; other activations are scattered across mathematical symbols, interface words, email words, patent terminology, and numbers, with no unified condition.

patterns.name: English intraword subwords and suffixes
patterns.context: Activation falls on intraword subwords in segmented English words, especially between a stem and a derivational or inflectional suffix; adjacent ordinary words usually do not activate.

patterns.name: Case boundaries in identifiers
patterns.context: Components of camel-case program identifiers are marked separately, especially in Java method parameters or variable names.

patterns.name: Specific tokens and formatting fragments
patterns.context: Appears in mathematical expressions and symbolic computations; activations involve variables, exponent symbols, and numbers, but the overall pattern is unclear.

patterns.name: Scattered semantic/contextual words
patterns.context: These words or numbers activate in local contexts across the segments, but there is no consistent cross-segment semantic or syntactic condition; examples include interface layout descriptions, code, email text, patent technical text, and table numbers.
patterns.domain: Multiple domains: programming Q&A, email, patents, tables

9_757.description: 较清楚的现象是对英语词内拆分子词及驼峰标识符片段的选择性激活；其余激活分散于数学符号、界面词、邮件词、专利用语和数字，缺少统一条件。

patterns.name: 英语词内子词与后缀
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的英语词的词内子词上，尤其词干与派生或屈折后缀之间；相邻的普通词通常不激活。

patterns.name: 标识符中的大小写边界
patterns.context: 驼峰式程序标识符的组成部分被分别标记，尤其在 Java 方法参数或变量名中。

patterns.name: 特定 token 与格式片段
patterns.context: 出现在数学表达式及符号化计算中；激活涉及变量、幂符号与数字，但整体规律不明确。

patterns.name: 语义/上下文相关的零散词
patterns.context: 这些词或数字在各段局部语境中激活，但跨段无一致的语义或句法条件；包括界面布局描述、代码、邮件文本、专利技术文本及表格数字。
patterns.domain: 多领域：编程问答、邮件、专利、表格

en.description: Activation is distributed across words linking time, place, scope, and clauses, and also involves spatial descriptions. A few passages show local triggers involving Japanese grammar, sports team names, and generic objects; no unified semantic theme is apparent.

patterns.name: Time/place relational words
patterns.context: Marks temporal, spatial, or sequential relations in clauses or narratives; activation falls on relational adverbs or conjunctions.
patterns.domain: Technology discussions, forums, event descriptions, historical or geographical narratives

patterns.name: Time and scope expressions
patterns.context: Activation occurs near temporal or scope components in expressions of duration, future periods, or continuity.
patterns.domain: Forums, everyday explanations, legal texts, event notices

patterns.name: Contrast and concessive links
patterns.context: Connects clauses expressing opposition, contrast, or concession; the trigger word itself or an adjacent component is activated.

patterns.name: Spatial orientation and regional descriptions
patterns.context: Describes areas, directions, terrain, or population distribution; activation involves words expressing spatial relations.

patterns.name: Clause/proposition introduction and referential links
patterns.context: Introduces a clause, refers back to preceding content, or connects a subsequent proposition; some activation falls on relational or referential words.
patterns.domain: Forum arguments, legal provisions, general expository text

patterns.name: Japanese sentence-final forms and grammar discussion
patterns.context: Discusses classical or modern Japanese grammar, sentence-final forms, and their functions.

patterns.name: English teams and country names
patterns.context: Country or team names occur in sports or team performance commentary; nearby text discusses rankings or performance.

patterns.name: Object concepts in forums
patterns.context: Discusses future design objects or generic items; activation falls on generic nouns.

9_757.description: 激活分布于时间、地点、范围及从句衔接词，也涉及方位描述；少数段另有日语语法、体育国家名和泛指物件等局部词汇触发，未见统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 时间/地点关系词
patterns.context: 在从句或叙述中标记时间、地点或先后关系；激活落在关系副词或连词上。
patterns.domain: 科技讨论、论坛、活动说明、历史或地理叙述

patterns.name: 时间与范围表达
patterns.context: 时间长度、未来时段或持续范围表达中，时间/范围成分附近激活。
patterns.domain: 论坛、生活说明、法律文本、活动通知

patterns.name: 转折与让步连接
patterns.context: 连接相反、对照或让步的分句；触发词本身或紧邻成分激活。

patterns.name: 地点方位与区域描述
patterns.context: 描述区域、方位、地形或人口分布；激活涉及地点关系的词。

patterns.name: 从句/命题引入与指代衔接
patterns.context: 引出从句、回指前述内容，或连接后续命题；部分激活落在关系/指代词上。
patterns.domain: 论坛论述、法律条文、一般说明文

patterns.name: 日语句末与语法讨论
patterns.context: 讨论古典或现代日语语法、句末形式及其功能。

patterns.name: 英语球队与国家名
patterns.context: 体育或球队表现评论中出现国家/队名；附近讨论排名或表现。

patterns.name: 论坛中的物件概念
patterns.context: 讨论未来设计对象或泛指物品，激活落在泛化名词上。

en.concept: Expressions of speech and thought, with sporadic triggers
en.description: Activations are scattered across contexts. They occur especially when narrators use thought to explain a judgment or action, and in that clauses introducing something understood or communicated; there are also words related to the future/expectations, locations, and generic things or experiences, with no single stable theme.

patterns.name: Narrative shift emphasizing “thought”
patterns.context: A first-person narrator explains why they took an action or formed a judgment; also appears in comments on another person's judgment.

patterns.name: Understanding or cognition in that-clauses
patterns.context: that introduces a clause followed by something someone understood, was told, or judged; examples here include “her name and initials will not be…” and “others besides just me…”, as well as the construction “told them the venue was…”.
patterns.domain: Medical paper statements, news reports, technical discussions

patterns.name: Future or location in hypothetical contexts
patterns.context: Discusses the near-future relationship between humans and objects, expectations for an open-source project, or information about the area around a location; trigger words are inconsistent.
patterns.domain: Technical comments, open-source project narratives, encyclopedic entries

patterns.name: Words related to generic things or experiences
patterns.context: Appears in contexts discussing object design or personal car-care experiences; the two segments have no evident shared local syntactic pattern.

9_757.description: 激活分散于多种语境：尤其出现在叙述者用 thought 解释判断或行动，以及 that 引出的理解、告知内容中；另见未来/期望、地点和泛指事物或经验相关词，未见单一稳定主题。

patterns.name: 强调“thought”的叙述转折
patterns.context: 第一人称叙述者说明自己为何采取某个行动或形成判断；也出现在对他人判断的评论中。

patterns.name: that 从句中的理解或认知
patterns.context: that 引出从句，后接某人理解、被告知或判断的内容；本组中后接 “her name and initials will not be…”、“others besides just me…” 等，也有 “told them the venue was…” 的结构。
patterns.domain: 医学论文声明、新闻报道、技术讨论

patterns.name: 设想中的未来或定位
patterns.context: 谈论近未来人类与物品的关系、开源项目的期望，或地点周边信息；触发词并不一致。
patterns.domain: 技术评论、开源项目叙述、百科条目

patterns.name: 泛指事物或经验相关词
patterns.context: 在讨论物品设计或个人汽车护理经验的语境中出现；两段没有明显共同的局部句法模式。
patterns.domain: 技术评论、汽车护理经验

en.description: The topics and styles of high-activation examples are diverse; local patterns often involve quotations, pronouns, or words around think/said, but trigger words and syntactic positions are inconsistent. Numbers, dark mode, and task Q&A occur only sporadically and cannot be explained by a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: “that” in reported or quoted statements
patterns.context: These fragments show activation adjacent to or concentrated near that, thought, and scene, but syntactic positions vary across examples, so no stable trigger substring can be confirmed.

patterns.name: Near pronouns or quoted content
patterns.context: Activation falls near words such as them, us, you, think, and said; these occur in different contexts and show no unified local grammatical condition.
patterns.domain: News, expository text, forum discussions, patent background

patterns.name: Website dark-mode discussion
patterns.context: Discusses a website signup overlay and dark mode, with activation prominent around thought; this is a single example, so it is unclear whether the trigger is the topic or the word.

patterns.name: Quantity or order-of-magnitude information
patterns.context: Numbers occur in statements about counts or frequency, but activation does not consistently fall on the numbers themselves.

patterns.name: Task Q&A instructions
patterns.context: After a remote user answers a previous question, a suggested follow-up response is given; activation is concentrated near think.

9_757.description: 高激活例子主题和文体分散；局部常见于引述、代词、think/said 一带，但触发词与句法位置不一致。数字、暗黑模式及任务问答仅零星出现，无法由统一语义模式解释。

patterns.name: 报告或引用语句中的“that”
patterns.trigger: [3] “the ease of access …”；[7] “convince yourself that they did not”；[8] “thought was obviously”；[9] “thought this would”；[10] “scenario”
patterns.context: 这些片段中可见激活紧邻或集中在 that、thought、场景等词附近，但各例的句法位置不一致，无法确认稳定触发子串。
patterns.domain: 百科、论坛讨论、商业文本

patterns.name: 代词或引述内容附近
patterns.trigger: [1] “told them the venue”；[4] “tell you you couldn’t”；[5] “when do you think you can”；[6] “All this being said, I think”
patterns.context: 激活落在 them、us、you、think、said 等词附近；这些词在不同语境中出现，未显示统一的局部语法条件。
patterns.domain: 新闻、说明文字、论坛讨论、专利背景

patterns.name: 网页暗黑模式讨论
patterns.trigger: [2] “because I thought they used too many dark patterns”
patterns.context: 讨论网站注册遮罩与暗黑模式，激活突出 thought 一带；单例，不能确定是主题还是词汇触发。

patterns.name: 数量或数量级信息
patterns.context: 数字出现在人数或频率陈述中，但激活并未稳定落在数字本身。

patterns.name: 任务问答指令
patterns.trigger: [5] “did you finish the task I gave you?”、“when do you think you can do it?”
patterns.context: 远程用户回答先前问题后，给出后续回应建议；激活集中在 think 附近。
patterns.domain: 专利背景/交互流程说明

en.concept: Expressions of speech and thought, with sporadic activations
en.description: Strong activations often fall on reporting verbs and words such as think and Thought that express others' speech or thoughts; other activations include proper-name fragments, sporadic words such as before and syntactic positions, and beam and which in optical patent text. Overall, the triggers are not unified.

patterns.name: Quoting or reporting another person's speech
patterns.context: Activation falls on reporting verbs followed by or introducing another person's words, judgment, or instructions; «think»9 in segment 8 also appears in a construction asking what someone thinks.
patterns.domain: News, forum dialogue, personal narratives, patent dialogue procedures

patterns.name: Expressions of ideas and thought
patterns.context: Expressions of thinking or asking about intentions and opinions; «Thoughts» in segment 9 is a heading introducing the poster's own ideas.

patterns.name: Specific word fragments and proper-name boundaries
patterns.context: The activated fragment is within a proper name or at an intraword segmentation boundary, rather than a clearly semantic full word: Pelotas, McMaster, HPE.

patterns.name: Temporal precedence conjunction
patterns.context: Narrates events that happened before leaving a store, expressing temporal precedence.

patterns.name: Ordinary vocabulary or syntactic-position triggers
patterns.context: These high-activation words occur in different syntactic positions and semantic environments, with no consistent local trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Finance, forums, personal narratives, patents, Q&A

patterns.name: Optics technical phrase
patterns.context: Appears in patent technical descriptions of optical fibers, output beams, and wavelength ranges; apart from these two higher-activation markers, there is no obvious concentration of activations.

9_757.concept: 言语与思考表达，兼有零散触发
9_757.description: 强激活较常落在引述动词以及think、Thought等表达他人话语或想法的词上；另有专名片段、before等零散词和句法位置，以及光学专利文本中的beam、which，整体触发并不统一。

patterns.name: 引述或转述他人发言
patterns.context: 激活落在引述动词上，后接或引出他人的话语、判断、指示；第8段的«think»9也出现在询问对方想法的句式中。
patterns.domain: 新闻、论坛对话、个人叙述、专利对话流程

patterns.name: 想法与思考表达
patterns.context: 思考或询问意图、观点的表达；第9段的«Thoughts»是发帖者引出个人想法的标题。
patterns.domain: 专利对话示例、问答论坛

patterns.name: 特定词片段与专名边界
patterns.context: 激活片段处于专名或词内分词边界，而非明确的完整语义词：Pelotas、McMaster、HPE。
patterns.domain: 百科、技术论坛、财经新闻

patterns.name: 时间先后连接词
patterns.context: 叙述离开商店之前发生的事件，表达时间先后。
patterns.domain: 个人经历、法律相关叙述

patterns.name: 普通词汇或句法位置触发
patterns.context: 这些高激活词分散在不同句法位置和语义环境中，未见一致的局部触发条件。
patterns.domain: 财经、论坛、个人叙述、专利、问答

patterns.name: 光学技术短语
patterns.context: 出现在光纤、输出光束及波长范围的专利技术描述中；除这两个较高标记外没有明显集中激活。

en.concept: Heterogeneous word fragments and referential structures
en.description: Activation is distributed across diverse contexts. The clearest patterns are me that/it, follow-up questions with sure about/of, and numbers and variables in polynomial factorization; there are also taxonomic word fragments and isolated topical words, discourse words, and phrasing from code discussions.

patterns.name: Me in informing or explaining contexts
patterns.context: In first-person narration or quotations, me is followed by a that-clause or it-clause; the strongest trigger is concentrated on me that
patterns.domain: Forum Q&A, firearm- and law-related narratives

patterns.name: Follow-up questions after sure
patterns.context: In quotations or direct questions, sure is followed by about/of and a demonstrative

patterns.name: Specific numbers and factors in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Polynomial factorization and its results, with numbers, variable p, and operators interspersed

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments of taxonomic proper names
patterns.context: Genus or family names are split into multiple subword fragments near taxonomy-list headings

patterns.name: Descriptions of destroying or radically changing a system
patterns.context: Discusses abolishing a system entirely and its possible consequences
patterns.domain: Hacker News discussions of social systems

patterns.name: Tell clauses expressing discouragement or restriction
patterns.context: Narrates someone telling another person that they cannot do something; unlike first-person reported me that clauses

patterns.name: Discourse about motivation and application
patterns.context: Discusses whether an application differs from its original motivation and infers the conceivability of an idea

patterns.name: Words related to imagined objects
patterns.context: Mentions fantasies about people one cannot have, followed by examples such as a coworker or neighbor

patterns.name: Referential words in lock and firearm narratives
patterns.context: Narrates buying a gun lock and a clerk explaining the law; in addition to me that, domain-specific words are activated

patterns.name: Referential words in array content and error explanations
patterns.context: Describes a code error and an array-to-string display issue; me that is followed by the error content

patterns.name: Sporadic wording about code libraries and iterators
patterns.context: Discusses a tool or language feature being easy to use and compatible with iterators, followed by a quoted follow-up question

9_757.concept: 异质词片段与指代结构
9_757.description: 激活分散于多种语境：尤以 me that/it、sure about/of 的追问，以及多项式分解中的数字和变量为明显模式；另有分类学词片段及若干主题词、论述词和代码讨论措辞。

patterns.name: 告知或解释语境中的 me
patterns.context: 第一人称叙述或引述中，me 后接 that 从句或 it 从句；最强触发集中在 me that
patterns.domain: 论坛问答、枪械与法律相关叙述

patterns.name: sure 后的追问
patterns.context: 引用或直接提问中，sure 后跟 about/of 及指示词

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的特定数字与因式
patterns.context: 多项式因式分解及其结果，数字、变量 p 和运算符交错出现

patterns.name: 分类学专名的分词片段
patterns.context: 属名或科名被拆分成多个子词片段，出现在分类列表标题附近
patterns.domain: 维基百科生物分类条目

patterns.name: 破坏/彻底改变系统的表述
patterns.trigger: « completely»5 would most certainly have a negative effect
patterns.context: 讨论彻底废除某制度及其可能后果
patterns.domain: Hacker News 社会制度讨论

patterns.name: 表达劝阻或限制的 tell 子句
patterns.trigger: «you»9« you»4 couldn’t do something；«told« us»5« we»1 couldn’t»
patterns.context: 讲述他人告知某人做不到某事；与第一人称转述的 me that 子句不同

patterns.name: 动机与应用的论述词
patterns.context: 讨论应用是否不同于原始动机，并推论某个想法的可构想性

patterns.name: 幻想对象相关词
patterns.context: 谈及对无法拥有之人的幻想，后接工作或邻居等例子
patterns.domain: 个人生活或关系类文章

patterns.name: 锁具与枪械叙述中的指代词
patterns.context: 叙述购买枪锁及店员告知法律规定；除 me that 外还有领域词触发

patterns.name: 数组内容与错误说明中的指代词
patterns.context: 描述代码错误及数组转字符串显示问题；me that 后接错误内容

patterns.name: 零散代码库与迭代器相关措辞
patterns.context: 讨论某种工具或语言特性易用、兼容迭代器，随后出现引用追问

en.description: Activations are scattered across technical Q&A, encyclopedias, patent examples, and forum discussions: these include narration after “me,” category names and fragments of place names, markers of reasoning, engineering and container terminology, institutional Q&A, and understanding-style responses and weekend topics in forums.

patterns.name: Reference or content clause after “me”
patterns.context: In first-person narration, verbs such as tell or force follow me, often introducing a that-clause or quoted content.

patterns.name: Biological names in taxonomy entries
patterns.context: In encyclopedia entries introducing a taxon, genus, or species, proper taxonomic names are split across multiple tokens.

patterns.name: “Thoughts” expressing reasoning or a claim
patterns.context: After describing an approach or explaining a need, a questioner uses “my thoughts” to introduce their reasoning.

patterns.name: Asking when someone can do something in dialogue
patterns.context: In dialogue-system examples, after the answer “no,” a follow-up asks when the task is expected to be completed.
patterns.domain: Dialogue examples in patent background sections

patterns.name: Mechanical engineering and prototyping terminology
patterns.context: First-person recollections of work experience mention engineers consulting websites and doing prototyping.

patterns.name: Split fragments in place names
patterns.context: When describing residents, award winners, or cultural figures from a place, place names and personal names are split into subwords.

patterns.name: Container permissions and processes
patterns.context: Discussion of processes inside containers gaining excessive access after a privileged flag is set.

patterns.name: Institution names and web-service Q&A
patterns.context: A Q&A asks for the name and contact information of an external institution and answers with the website software it developed.

patterns.name: Concessive response: “I get what you’re saying”
patterns.context: A forum response first acknowledges the other person’s point, then adds a qualification or rebuttal; paragraph 10 also has a similar acknowledge-then-concede structure.

patterns.name: Social customs around weekends and church
patterns.context: Using whether people go to church on Sundays as an example, the discussion asks whether people today still need a shared day of rest.

9_757.description: 激活分散于技术问答、百科、专利示例及论坛讨论：包括“me”后的叙述、分类名和地名片段、思路标记、工程与容器术语、机构问答，以及论坛中的理解式回应和周末话题。

patterns.name: “me”后的指代或内容从句
patterns.context: 第一人称叙述中，me 后接告知、强迫等动词，常继续引出 that 从句或引用内容。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答；个人经历叙述

patterns.name: 分类条目中的生物学名称
patterns.context: 百科条目在介绍分类单元、属或物种时，专有分类名被拆分为多个 token。

patterns.name: 表达思路或主张的“thoughts”
patterns.context: 提问者在描述方案或解释需求后，用“我的想法”引出自己的推理。

patterns.name: 对话中询问对方何时能做某事
patterns.context: 对话系统示例中，回答“no”后接续询问完成任务的预计时间。
patterns.domain: 专利背景中的对话示例

patterns.name: 机械工程与原型设计用语
patterns.context: 以第一人称回忆职业经历，谈工程师查阅网站、开展原型设计。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 个人经验/技术讨论

patterns.name: 地名中的拆分片段
patterns.context: 叙述某地的居民、获奖者或文化人物时，地名和人名被拆分成子词。

patterns.name: 容器权限与进程
patterns.context: 讨论给容器设置特权标志后，容器内进程获得过多访问权限。

patterns.name: 机构名称与网络服务问答
patterns.context: 问答中询问外部机构的名称和联系方式，并回答其开发的网站软件。

patterns.name: “I get what you’re saying”的让步回应
patterns.context: 论坛讨论中先表示理解对方观点，再提出补充或反驳；第10段也有相近的理解后让步结构。

patterns.name: 周末与教会的社会习惯讨论
patterns.context: 以周日是否去教会为例，讨论现代人是否仍需要共同休息日。

en.concept: Common English words and syntactic fragments
en.description: Activation is distributed across common function words, relational words, and paragraph openers in texts from multiple domains, and also appears in numeric indices, firearm regulations, licenses, and scripts; there is no stable single semantic trigger across passages.

patterns.name: Explanatory continuation after relational word that
patterns.context: Strong activation often occurs on the word before that or on that itself, especially when that introduces an explanation, statement, or clause; the exact hit token is not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: English function words and ordinary narration
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across function words, short words, or syntactic positions in ordinary sentences, with no stable specific semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Forums, technical Q&A, and legal texts

patterns.name: Numeric and index expressions
patterns.context: Numbers and nearby brackets or commas are activated in arrays, indices, or numeric structures.

patterns.name: Lock and firearm law narratives
patterns.context: Multiple activation words occur in descriptions of gun shops, firearms, and related laws; locally, words such as “me” and “that” are especially strongly activated.
patterns.domain: Personal experience and firearm law discussions

patterns.name: License and software project text
patterns.context: A project name follows a license template, with activation on common words and fragments of the project name.

patterns.name: Batch script control syntax
patterns.context: Activation occurs around control flow and comments in Windows batch scripts.

patterns.name: Introducing subjective judgments or ideas
patterns.context: Some opening words or phrases are activated when a paragraph or answer introduces a question, explanation, observation, or personal idea.

9_757.concept: 英语常见词与句法片段
9_757.description: 激活分散在多领域文本的常见功能词、关系词及段落引入语，也见于数字索引、枪支法规、许可证和脚本；不同段落间缺乏稳定的单一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 关系词 that 后续说明
patterns.context: 强激活常出现在 that 前的词或 that 本身，尤其在 that 引出解释、陈述或从句时；具体命中 token 并不完全一致。

patterns.name: 英语功能词与普通叙述
patterns.context: 激活分散在普通句子中的功能词、短词或句法位置，缺少稳定的特定语义条件。
patterns.domain: 论坛、技术问答及法律文本

patterns.name: 数字与索引表达
patterns.context: 数组、索引或带数字的结构化表达中，数字及括号、逗号附近出现激活。

patterns.name: 锁与枪支法律叙述
patterns.context: 描述枪店、枪支及相关法律时出现多个激活词，局部尤以“me”“that”等词激活较强。
patterns.domain: 个人经历与枪支法规讨论

patterns.name: 许可证与软件项目文本
patterns.context: 许可证模板后接项目名称，激活落在常见词及项目名片段上。
patterns.domain: 开源软件许可证、代码仓库

patterns.name: 批处理脚本控制语法
patterns.context: Windows 批处理脚本中，控制流和注释周边出现激活。

patterns.name: 主观判断或构想的引入
patterns.context: 段落或回答中引出问题、解释、观察或个人构想时，部分起始词或短语激活。

en.description: Activations have no stable, single meaning: they clearly include personal pronouns in that-clauses, purpose/result introducers, numeric index structures, and several proper-name fragments; other terms are scattered across varied contexts.

patterns.name: That in object clauses
patterns.context: That introduces a clause, especially when followed by a personal pronoun as subject; several fragments appear, but not every that triggers activation
patterns.domain: Forums, comments, and general explanatory text

patterns.name: Purpose or summary introducers
patterns.context: A word introduces a goal, result, or intended outcome, with activation on these introducers

patterns.name: Thoughts word form
patterns.context: In the title-like phrase “My Thoughts:”, Thoughts has the strongest activation

patterns.name: Numeric and index sequences
patterns.context: Code or mathematical discussions of arrays or index calculations; after a sequence, the text asks for the maximum value of the third index

patterns.name: Internal fragments of brands/proper names
patterns.context: Embedded in a gun-store/product name or a game-system proper name, with unstable trigger boundaries; activation may favor capitalized fragments within proper names

patterns.name: Research-related noun fragment
patterns.context: Appears in the website name “MedicalResearch.com” in a medical disclaimer

patterns.name: Other sporadic word forms
patterns.context: These words activate sporadically in different syntactic and semantic environments, without a shared local context

9_757.concept: 混合的词形与句法线索
9_757.description: 激活没有稳定单一语义：明显包括 that 从句中的人称代词、目的/结果引导词、数字索引结构及若干专名片段；其余词项分散于多种语境。

patterns.name: 宾语从句中的 that
patterns.trigger: “that”或 “that his wife”; 激活集中在 that 后的 “you”“me”“we”
patterns.context: that 引导的从句中，尤其是 that 后接人称代词作主语；多个片段出现，但并非每个 that 都触发
patterns.domain: 论坛、评论及一般说明文本

patterns.name: 目的或总结引导词
patterns.context: 词语引出目标、结果或所追求内容，激活落在这些引导词上

patterns.name: thoughts 词形
patterns.context: 标题式短语 “My Thoughts:” 中，Thoughts 激活最强

patterns.name: 数字与索引序列
patterns.trigger: 多组方括号数字及 “third index”
patterns.context: 数组或索引计算的代码/数学讨论；序列后询问第三个索引的最大值

patterns.name: 品牌/专名内部片段
patterns.context: 嵌在枪店/产品名称或游戏系统专名中，触发边界不稳定，可能偏向专名中的大写字母片段
patterns.domain: 用户叙述、游戏网站介绍

patterns.name: 研究相关名词片段
patterns.context: 出现在医疗免责声明中的网站名称 “MedicalResearch.com”

patterns.name: 其他零散词形
patterns.context: 这些词在不同句法和语义环境中零散激活，缺少共同的局部语境

en.description: Activation often falls on words for a goal, purpose, or overall work that refer back to earlier text; it also appears in expressions introducing an addressee, a point of epistemic shift in an argument, or a proposed solution. The commonality is introducing a follow-up explanation within a sentence, though the specific words and domains differ.

patterns.name: Goal/purpose summary
patterns.context: In sentences describing the goals, purpose, or overall work of a project, study, or plan, this/these often refer back to preceding text; activation falls on the goal noun or a related summary word
patterns.domain: Research project summaries, medical research, patent background

patterns.name: Addressee and communicated content
patterns.context: The verb tell is followed by me/you, then introduces the content being communicated
patterns.domain: Q&A, forum discussions, and technical support conversations

patterns.name: Turning point in judgment or understanding
patterns.context: A sentence introduced by what raises a fact the other person has not recognized, followed by is that introducing an explanation

patterns.name: Proposing a solution
patterns.context: After describing device signal processing, “One way is to…” introduces an operational solution

9_757.description: 激活常落在回指上文的目标、目的或总体工作词上，也出现在告知对象、论辩中的认识转折点及提出办法的表达中；共同点是句中引出后续说明，但具体词汇和领域不同。

patterns.name: 目标/目的总结
patterns.trigger: “goal”“aims”“effort”，尤其是“accomplish this goal”“achieve these aims”“accomplish these aims”“this effort”
patterns.context: 在说明项目、研究或计划的目标、目的或总体工作的句子中，常由 this/these 指回上文；激活落在目标名词或相关概括词上
patterns.domain: 科研项目简介、医学研究与专利背景

patterns.name: 人称对象与告知内容
patterns.context: 动词 tell 后接 me/you，随后引出所告知的内容
patterns.domain: 问答、论坛讨论和技术支持对话

patterns.name: 判断或认识的转折点
patterns.context: 以 what 引导的句子提出对方未认识到的事实，后接 is that 引出解释

patterns.name: 提出解决办法
patterns.context: 在描述设备信号处理后，以“One way is to…”引出操作方案

en.concept: Lexical items and phrase fragments in specific contexts
en.description: Activations are scattered across diverse texts: realize in rebuttal sentences, you in lyrics, me in personal narratives, plan in business quotes, way introducing an approach, aims/objectives for research goals, mainstream in wrestling, and NoSQL in a software name. Only some patterns recur.

patterns.name: Cognition verbs in prompts, arguments, or goal statements
patterns.context: The trigger is realize, followed by is that introducing an explanation, rebuttal, or argument; the trigger position is the same in two passages.

patterns.name: Personal pronoun you
patterns.context: In paragraph 1, you appears in lyrics and refers to the addressee; in paragraph 2, me appears in a personal narrative and indirect quotation. The semantics and style differ, with insufficient evidence to group them as one pattern.
patterns.domain: Lyrics; narrative about a gun-store experience

patterns.name: Quoted report of company plans and cash accumulation
patterns.context: Quotes speculation about a company’s future strategy, with plan adjacent to a possessive relation and a description of cash accumulation.

patterns.name: Introducing a method or approach
patterns.context: Uses way is to to introduce a specific technical procedure.

patterns.name: Concluding marker for research objectives
patterns.context: NIH project text first lists research objectives, then uses To achieve ... to shift to the implementation plan or subsequent work.

patterns.name: Mainstream label in popular wrestling assessments
patterns.context: mainstream is split across tokens; it appears in the context of assessments of American professional wrestling.

patterns.name: Internal fragment in a software name
patterns.context: Activation falls on the NoSQL fragment of a camel-case project name, rather than on the equivalent word in ordinary sentences.

9_757.concept: 特定语境中的词汇与短语片段
9_757.description: 激活分散在多种文本中：反驳句的 realize、歌词中的 you、个人叙述中的 me、商业引语中的 plan、方案引入的 way、研究目标 aims/objectives、摔角词 mainstream 和软件名 NoSQL。仅部分模式有重复。

patterns.name: 提示、论点或目标陈述中的认识动词
patterns.trigger: “What you fail to realize is that”“What you don't realize is that”
patterns.context: 触发点是 realize，后接 is that 引出解释、反驳或论据；两段中触发位置相同。

patterns.name: 人称代词 you
patterns.context: 段1 的 you 出现在歌词中，指向对话对象；段2 的 me 出现在个人叙述及间接引语中。两处语义和文体不同，缺乏足够证据归为同一模式。
patterns.domain: 歌词；枪械商店经历叙述

patterns.name: 公司计划与现金积累的报道引语
patterns.trigger: “company's plan”后接 «plan»9，并出现“collect as much cash as possible”
patterns.context: 引述对公司未来策略的推测，plan 紧邻所属关系和现金积累描述。

patterns.name: 方法或方案的引入
patterns.trigger: “One way”后接«way»9，再接“is to simply split”
patterns.context: 以 way is to 引入具体技术操作方案。

patterns.name: 研究目标的收束标记
patterns.trigger: “To achieve these objectives”中的«objectives»9；“To achieve these aims”中的«aims»9
patterns.context: NIH 项目文本先列研究目标，随后用 To achieve ... 转入执行方案或后续工作。

patterns.name: 大众摔角评价中的主流标签
patterns.context: mainstream 被拆分跨 token 呈现；在对美国职业摔角的评价语境中出现。

patterns.name: 软件名称中的内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在驼峰式项目名的 NoSQL 片段，而非普通句子中的同类词。

en.description: Activation is distributed across texts from multiple domains and involves within-word token boundaries, proper-name fragments, common words, pronouns, and punctuation; strongly activated words and contexts lack stable semantic or syntactic commonality, making it difficult to infer a single trigger pattern from the available samples.

patterns.name: Me after specific words
patterns.context: High activation falls near within-word or word boundaries, including pronouns, common words, and proper names; these instances lack stable semantic or syntactic conditions.
patterns.domain: Forums, webpages, research texts, and general narratives

patterns.name: Within-word boundary in widescreen
patterns.context: Activation falls within the tokenized English word “widescreen”; the same passage also includes “down-convert & record” and “split the signal,” but there is not enough evidence to confirm them as trigger conditions.

patterns.name: Within-name boundary in an esports proper name
patterns.context: Activation repeatedly appears on fragments within the same proper name, YGOPRO; other names or within-word boundaries also occur, but the commonality across passages is unclear.
patterns.domain: Introduction to an online Yu-Gi-Oh! battle system

patterns.name: Tokenized within-word fragments
patterns.context: Activation occurs on tokenized within-word fragments or single-letter fragments; these fragments do not appear to share semantics or contextual conditions.

patterns.name: Scattered common words and punctuation
patterns.context: Each passage also contains isolated activations across words with widely varying parts of speech, meanings, and contexts, with no consistent pattern.
patterns.domain: Mixed web corpus, forums, and ordinary narratives

9_757.description: 激活分散于多领域文本，涉及词内分词边界、专名片段、常见词、代词、标点等；强激活词及上下文缺乏稳定语义或句法共性，现有样本难以归纳单一触发模式。

patterns.name: 特定单词后的 me
patterns.context: 高激活落在词内或词边界附近，包含代词、常见词及专名；这些实例之间缺少稳定的语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 论坛、网页、科研文本及一般叙述

patterns.name: 宽屏词内边界
patterns.context: 激活落在被分词切开的英文单词“widescreen”内部；同段还出现“down-convert & record”及“split the signal”，但没有足够证据确认它们是触发条件。
patterns.domain: 消费电子、视频录制说明

patterns.name: 电竞专名内部边界
patterns.context: 同一专名 YGOPRO 的内部片段重复出现激活；也有其他名称或词内边界实例，但各段的共性不清楚。
patterns.domain: Yu-Gi-Oh! 线上对战系统介绍

patterns.name: 拆分词内片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在切分的词内片段或单字母片段；看不出这些片段共享语义或上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 摔角评论、科研项目介绍

patterns.name: 散见的常见词和标点
patterns.context: 各段另有若干孤立激活，词性、含义与上下文差异很大，无法归结为一致模式。
patterns.domain: 混合网页语料、论坛及普通叙述

en.description: Activations are scattered across many fields: quotations and plans, methods and research objectives, commentary, and entities in finance, technology, research, music, wrestling, firearms, and politics. Their commonality is weak; they often occur near content continuations or key nouns.

patterns.name: Quoting in object clauses
patterns.context: Introduces the content of a statement after a verb, especially what a person or institution said or planned; the trigger often follows a reporting verb

patterns.name: Introducing a judgment or method
patterns.context: Introduces a practice, typical method, or research objective, often with phrases such as One way / typical approach / objectives

patterns.name: Developing a viewpoint or argument
patterns.context: Presents evaluations and arguments about works, people, plots, or political reform; activation falls on nouns or content-continuation points in the discussion

patterns.name: Domain terms composed of proper names and abbreviations
patterns.context: Near institution, technology, or research-domain names and abbreviations, activation may concentrate on proper-name fragments rather than a consistent syntactic position

patterns.name: Quantities and forecast data
patterns.context: Financial news reports forecasts, earnings, and per-share values

patterns.name: Special research grants and project history
patterns.context: States the source and year of project funding, renewals, and core research training for the project

patterns.name: Video signal processing explanation
patterns.context: Explains conversion, recording, aspect ratio, and subsequent processing of high-definition signals

patterns.name: Time-series data analysis
patterns.context: Introduces a dataset that changes over time and explains that a visual summary is used to select a time interval

patterns.name: Juxtaposed geographic and political entities
patterns.context: Lists the constituent regions of the United Kingdom and contrasts them with England in discussing the need for reform

patterns.name: Evaluations of performances and events
patterns.context: Calls for credible characters, storylines, and actual matches, then comments on mainstream American wrestling

patterns.name: Music album and recording reviews
patterns.context: Discusses dialogue and volume on an album, and the possibility of assembling a live CD

patterns.name: Narrative about buying a firearm
patterns.context: Recounts buying a gun lock at a gun shop and a clerk explaining laws related to used guns

patterns.name: Abstract statements about funding plans
patterns.context: Discusses a company’s long-term plans and its goal of accumulating as much cash as possible

9_757.description: 激活分散于多领域：引述与计划、方法和研究目标、评论论述，以及财经、技术、科研、音乐、摔角、枪械和政治实体等内容；共同点较弱，常落在内容承接或关键名词附近。

patterns.name: 宾语从句引述
patterns.trigger: « me»10« that»7« the»6« law»5；« analyst»5« said»9« he»6；« plan»9« is»1
patterns.context: 动词后引出陈述内容，尤其是人物或机构的说法、计划；触发位置常在引述谓语之后

patterns.name: 判断或方法引入
patterns.trigger: « way»9« is»1；« approach»9 is to；« objectives»9
patterns.context: 介绍一种做法、典型方法或研究目标，常由 One way / typical approach / objectives 等短语引出

patterns.name: 观点或论点展开
patterns.context: 围绕作品、人物、情节或政治改革展开评价和论述；激活落在论述中的名词或观点承接处
patterns.domain: 评论、娱乐讨论、政治评论

patterns.name: 专名与缩写组成的领域术语
patterns.context: 机构、技术或研究领域专名及缩写附近，激活可能集中在专名片段而非统一句法位置
patterns.domain: 枪械相关叙述、财经、科研

patterns.name: 数量与预测数据
patterns.trigger: «5»3« billion»8« predicted»6；« 31»« cents»1 per« share»3；« 26»1« cents»4
patterns.context: 财务新闻中报告预测、收益及每股数值

patterns.name: 专项研究资助与项目经历
patterns.context: 陈述项目获得资助的来源、年份、续期，以及项目核心研究训练

patterns.name: 视频信号处理说明
patterns.trigger: down-convert & record；« signal»2 coming from；« wides»creen
patterns.context: 说明高清信号的转换、录制、画幅及后续处理方式

patterns.name: 时间序列数据分析
patterns.context: 介绍随时间变化的数据集，并说明可视化摘要用于筛选时间区间

patterns.name: 地理与政治实体并列
patterns.context: 并列列举英国构成地域，并与 England 对照讨论改革需求

patterns.name: 演出与赛事内容评价
patterns.context: 要求可信角色、故事线和实际比赛，随后评论美国主流摔角

patterns.name: 音乐专辑与录音评论
patterns.context: 讨论专辑中的对白、音量及拼制现场 CD 的可能性

patterns.name: 枪械购买叙述
patterns.trigger: « lock»3«)»5 from« Ade»2«'s»3« Gun»3« Shop»3；« me»10« that»7
patterns.context: 讲述在枪店购买枪锁及店员解释二手枪相关法律
patterns.domain: 个人叙述、枪械法律话题

patterns.name: 抽象的资金计划陈述
patterns.trigger: « collect»2« as»6 much« cash»4« as»8 possible
patterns.context: 讨论公司长期计划及尽可能收集现金的目标
patterns.domain: 创业公司讨论、论坛引述

en.description: The clearest recurring cue is say/saying in forum contexts, often accompanied by first-person expressions; other highlights are distributed across research data, technical solutions, project funding, firearm law, music reviews, and business discussions, with no unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: Expressing or reporting speech
patterns.context: Speech verbs occur in first-person expressions or contexts reporting opinions; they often introduce a subsequent claim or personal wish.

patterns.name: First-person reference
patterns.context: Narrates personal experiences or expresses a personal position; partially overlaps with the speech pattern.

patterns.name: Quantitative research results
patterns.context: Reports study subjects, measured outcomes, or statistical results, often accompanied by numbers, units, or significance descriptions.

patterns.name: Technical solutions or operating instructions
patterns.context: Describes technical equipment or design goals and proposes an implementation.

patterns.name: Proper names and project funding descriptions
patterns.context: Occurs in descriptions of institutions or project names and funding experiences; activation is distributed across proper names and funding-related wording.

patterns.name: Firearm and legal anecdote
patterns.context: Appears in a personal account of buying a gun lock and related laws.

patterns.name: Album and audio descriptions
patterns.context: Discusses live recordings, album content, and listener audibility.

patterns.name: Business plans and cash
patterns.context: Reports speculation about a company’s future and cash accumulation strategy.

patterns.name: Other scattered highlighted words
patterns.context: These words appear respectively in narratives about gun locks and research project summaries, with no evidence sufficient to infer a shared trigger condition.

9_757.description: 最明显的重复线索是论坛语境中的 say/saying，常与第一人称表达相伴；其余高亮分散于研究数据、技术方案、项目资助、枪械法律、音乐评论和商业讨论，未显出统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 表达或引述言说
patterns.context: 言说动词出现在第一人称表达或转述观点的语境中；常引出后续主张或个人愿望。

patterns.name: 第一人称指涉
patterns.context: 叙述个人经历或表达个人立场；与言说模式有部分重合。

patterns.name: 定量研究结果
patterns.context: 报告研究对象、测量指标或统计结果，常伴随数字、单位或显著性描述。

patterns.name: 技术方案或操作说明
patterns.context: 说明技术设备或设计目标、提出实现方式。
patterns.domain: 消费电子讨论、专利背景

patterns.name: 专名及项目资助描述
patterns.context: 机构或项目名称及资助经历的叙述中出现；激活分散在专名和资助用语。

patterns.name: 枪械与法律轶事
patterns.context: 个人讲述购买枪锁及相关法律时出现。

patterns.name: 专辑及音频描述
patterns.context: 讨论现场录音、专辑内容及听众可听性。

patterns.name: 商业计划与现金
patterns.context: 转述对公司未来及现金积累策略的推测。

patterns.name: 其他零散高亮词
patterns.context: 这些词分别出现在枪锁叙事及科研项目介绍中，未见足以归纳为共同触发条件的证据。

en.description: Activations are scattered across texts from many domains, often appearing in tokenized word fragments, abbreviations, hyphenated compounds, and possessive boundaries; numbers, function words, and isolated content words also trigger. The examples do not share a unified semantic theme, and some may be due to context or tokenization boundaries.

patterns.name: Abbreviations, hyphens, and tokenization boundaries
patterns.context: Activations often fall on word fragments split by special tokenization, abbreviation letters, or internal hyphens; the same fragment can occur across diverse topics.

patterns.name: Professional abbreviations or proper-name fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur around abbreviations for medicine, funding projects, equipment, or place names, but the abbreviations have different meanings.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in noun phrases and compounds
patterns.context: The trigger fragment is embedded in descriptive noun phrases, compounds, or domain terms, with no unified topic.
patterns.domain: Academic abstracts, technical explanations, natural history, and online discussions

patterns.name: Near possessives and apostrophes
patterns.context: Activation concentrates near possessive forms or word-final apostrophes, followed by a noun or abbreviation.

patterns.name: Numbers, units, and neighboring text
patterns.context: In a few passages, activation occurs near years, values, or units; it is unclear whether numbers themselves are a shared trigger.
patterns.domain: Project descriptions, animal ranges, music reviews

patterns.name: Sporadic triggers in conjunctions and common expressions
patterns.context: Some common function words are marked in different contexts, usually alongside stronger domain terms or token fragments; this may be an adjacency or context effect.

patterns.name: Several isolated content-word triggers
patterns.context: Appears in only one passage; topics differ, and the available examples are insufficient to establish a shared semantic pattern.

9_757.description: 激活分散在多领域文本中，常见于分词拆开的词片段、缩写、连字符复合词及所有格边界；另有数字、功能词和孤立内容词触发。各例语义不统一，部分可能由上下文或分词边界造成。

patterns.name: 缩写、连字符与分词边界
patterns.context: 激活常落在被特殊分词拆开的词片段、缩写字母或词内连字符附近；同一片段可跨多种主题出现。

patterns.name: 专业缩写或专名片段
patterns.context: 医学、资助项目、设备或地名缩写处出现激活，但各处缩写的含义不同。

patterns.name: 名词短语及复合词内部片段
patterns.context: 触发片段嵌在描述性名词短语、复合词或领域术语中；并无统一主题。
patterns.domain: 学术摘要、技术说明、自然史与网络讨论

patterns.name: 所有格与撇号附近
patterns.context: 激活集中在所有格或词尾撇号附近，后接名词或缩写。

patterns.name: 数字、单位及其邻近文本
patterns.context: 少数片段中年份、数值或单位附近有激活；无法确认数字本身是共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 项目介绍、动物活动范围、音乐评论

patterns.name: 连接词与常见表达中的零散触发
patterns.trigger: « and»、« but»、« it»、« the»、« that»、« do»
patterns.context: 一些常见功能词在不同语境中被标记，周围通常还有较强的领域词或分词片段；可能是邻接或上下文效应。

patterns.name: 若干孤立的内容词触发
patterns.context: 仅在单段出现，主题彼此不同，现有样本不足以确认共同语义模式。
patterns.domain: 评论、宣传、枪支经历、医学

en.description: Activations are scattered across topics and styles: animal home ranges and housing security, company plans, medical risks, data visualization, social exclusion, urine recycling, education grants, transportation transition, and software map discussions. There is no clear shared semantic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: home range and housing security
patterns.context: Describes an animal’s average home range or housing’s role as social security; trigger positions involve home, home range, or the security-related meaning of housing.
patterns.domain: Animal ecology; personal finance and social commentary

patterns.name: Company plans and cash accumulation
patterns.context: Discusses speculation about a company’s future, or company plans and cash accumulation.

patterns.name: Health risks, diseases, and symptoms
patterns.context: Lists long-term health risks and symptoms among transplant survivors.

patterns.name: Analysis of time-varying data
patterns.context: Introduces large datasets that change over time and their visualization analysis.

patterns.name: Exclusion in social interactions
patterns.context: Describes social activities centered on drinking as uncomfortable or exclusionary.

patterns.name: Urine sterility and recycling
patterns.context: Argues that urine is sterile and can be handled or recycled; preceding text mentions cover materials and composting.
patterns.domain: Practical living / sanitation and recycling discussion

patterns.name: Education program grants and laboratory research
patterns.context: Introduces project funding sources, renewals, and research training.

patterns.name: Transportation transition and conclusions
patterns.context: Discusses the transition from fossil-fuel transportation to electric transportation and cites conclusions.

patterns.name: Software tools, code, and map tiles
patterns.context: Compares the debugging difficulty and cost of software or map services, as well as tile services.

9_757.description: 激活散布于多种主题与文体：动物栖息范围和住房保障、公司计划、医学风险、数据可视化、社交排斥、尿液回收、教育拨款、交通转型及软件地图讨论。没有明确共享的语义触发模式。

patterns.name: home range及房产保障
patterns.context: 描述动物的平均栖息范围，或住房作为社会保障的作用；触发位置涉及 home、home range 或住房的保障含义。
patterns.domain: 动物生态；个人理财与社会评论

patterns.name: 公司计划与资金积累
patterns.trigger: “company's plan is to collect as much cash as possible”
patterns.context: 讨论对公司未来的推测，或公司计划、现金积累。

patterns.name: 健康风险、疾病与症状
patterns.trigger: “life-threatening chronic health conditions”“disease”“symptoms that inhibit quality of life”
patterns.context: 列举移植幸存者的长期健康风险及症状。

patterns.name: 时间变化数据分析
patterns.context: 介绍大型随时间变化的数据及其可视化分析。

patterns.name: 社交互动中的排斥
patterns.context: 将以饮酒为中心的社交活动描述为令人不适或具有排斥性。

patterns.name: 尿液无菌及回收
patterns.context: 主张尿液无菌、可处理或回收；前文提及覆盖物和堆肥。
patterns.domain: 生活实践／卫生与回收讨论

patterns.name: 教育项目拨款与实验室研究
patterns.context: 介绍项目经费来源、续期及研究训练。
patterns.domain: 医学教育／机构项目介绍

patterns.name: 交通转型与结论
patterns.context: 讨论从化石燃料交通向电动交通转型，并引述结论。

patterns.name: 软件工具、代码与地图瓦片
patterns.context: 比较软件或地图服务的调试难度、价格与瓦片服务。
patterns.domain: 软件开发／开源地图讨论

en.description: Primarily responds to discourse-organizing expressions that introduce subsequent content: proposing a method (approach/way/method), beginning a list or explanation (First/first/possibility), and, less commonly, speculation, expected evaluations, and inverted proposed constructions.

patterns.name: “way / approach / method” followed by an explanation of a plan
patterns.context: Introduces a method, approach, or steps to be discussed next; the following text typically explains them. Activation is concentrated on approach, way, method, and adjacent articles/ordinals.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, forum/web explanations, and practical guides

patterns.name: “First, …” list development
patterns.context: The preceding text has announced innovations, reasons, or a plan divided into items; First begins the first item.
patterns.domain: Research grant applications and academic papers

patterns.name: “The first is that” introducing a problem or explanation
patterns.context: After listing multiple problems, reasons, or possibilities, an ordinal or possibility introduces a specific explanation; strong activation falls on introducers such as first/possibility.
patterns.domain: Patent background sections and medical papers

patterns.name: “guess, however, is that” speculation
patterns.context: The author first states a personal guess, then uses is that to introduce a judgment; the tone is commentarial and cautious.

patterns.name: “thought it would” expectation statement
patterns.context: Evaluates whether a product or tool meets or exceeds the user’s prior expectations; activation concentrates on the collocation thought it.

patterns.name: “proposed are” inversion introducing research work
patterns.context: After Also at the beginning of a sentence, proposed + are appears in inversion to introduce proposed research or discovery work; this is not the usual subject-first order.

9_757.description: 主要响应引出后续内容的篇章组织表达：提出方法（approach/way/method）、开始列举或解释（First/first/possibility），也覆盖推测、预期评价及 proposed 倒装等少见触发。

patterns.name: “way / approach / method”后接方案说明
patterns.trigger: [1] «A»2« typical»1« approach»10 is；[2] «One»3« way»9 is；[10] «A»2« second»3« method»9 in
patterns.context: 引出接下来要讲的做法、方案或步骤，后文通常继续说明其内容；触发较集中在 approach、way、method 及其相邻冠词/序数词。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、论坛/网页说明及实用指南

patterns.name: “First, …”列举展开
patterns.context: 前文已宣布创新点、原因或方案分为若干项，First 后开始列出第一项。
patterns.domain: 科研资助申请与学术论文

patterns.name: “The first is that”提出问题或解释
patterns.context: 在先列举多个问题、原因或可能性之后，用序数词或 possibility 引出具体解释；强激活落在 first/possibility 一类引导词上。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术与医学论文

patterns.name: “guess, however, is that”推测
patterns.context: 作者先表达个人推测，再由 is that 引出判断；具有评论、审慎推论语气。

patterns.name: “thought it would”预期表达
patterns.context: 评价某产品或工具符合甚至超过使用者原先预期，激活集中于 thought it 的搭配。

patterns.name: “proposed are”倒装引出研究工作
patterns.context: 句首 Also 后以 proposed + are 倒装，引出拟开展的研究或发现工作；不是常规主语先行语序。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究计划文本

en.description: Activations are scattered across academic and online texts. More discernible patterns introduce methods or possibilities, research proposals and objectives, or emphasize degree or focus. There are also sporadic triggers such as first-person judgments and medical phrases that are difficult to group.

patterns.name: “way” introducing a method or proposal
patterns.context: After explaining a problem, goal, or existing situation, introduces a method, possibility, or proposal; no specific domain is required.

patterns.name: “proposed” marking proposed content
patterns.context: Describes a research plan, research direction, or planned work in passive or inverted constructions; often accompanied by lists and research subjects.

patterns.name: Listing research objectives
patterns.context: In a research design or project description, introduces numbered objectives with “objectives are”.

patterns.name: Emphasis on significance or importance
patterns.context: Emphasizes risk level, frequency of use, or the only item that can be summarized; surface forms vary and may simply express degree or focus.
patterns.domain: Medical research, physics papers, online commentary

patterns.name: “life” phrases
patterns.context: Describes life-threatening disease risks or quality of life in medical contexts.

patterns.name: Reporting or interpreting observations
patterns.context: A first-person speaker gives an opinion or infers something from observed circumstances; trigger words vary.

patterns.name: Other sporadic activations
patterns.context: The available contexts show no shared local trigger or clearly consistent semantic condition.

9_757.description: 激活分散于学术和网络文本；较可辨模式是引出方法或可能性、研究提案与目标，以及强调程度或焦点。另有第一人称判断和医学短语等零散触发，难以归并。

patterns.name: “way”引出方法或方案
patterns.context: 在说明问题、目标或已有情况后，引出一种方法、可能性或方案；不要求特定领域。

patterns.name: “proposed”标记提议内容
patterns.context: 被动或倒装表达中说明研究计划、研究方向或工作内容；附近常有列举和研究对象。

patterns.name: 列举研究目标
patterns.context: 在研究设计或项目描述中，以“objectives are”引出编号目标。

patterns.name: 显著性或重要性强调
patterns.context: 强调风险等级、常用程度或唯一可归纳事项；词面形式各异，可能只是程度或焦点表达。
patterns.domain: 医学研究、物理学论文、网络评论

patterns.name: “life”短语
patterns.context: 医学语境中描述危及生命的疾病风险或生活质量。

patterns.name: 报告或解释观察结果
patterns.context: 第一人称发言者给出看法或对观察到的情况作推断；触发词并不相同。

patterns.name: 其他零散激活
patterns.context: 现有上下文中没有共同的局部触发或明确一致的语义条件。

en.concept: Introducing a proposal, objective, or judgment
en.description: Activations cluster around expressions that introduce what follows: proposing a method or solution, listing research objectives or proposals, and statements of medical risk or possibility. They also occur in inferences in personal narratives.

patterns.name: Introducing a method or proposal
patterns.context: When explaining a solution, procedure, or research strategy, common constructions include “X way/approach is ...”; activations are strongest near way/approach.

patterns.name: Introducing research objectives or proposals
patterns.context: When listing research objectives, plans, or proposed work, the following content is often introduced by objectives/proposed.

patterns.name: Biomedical results or possibility statements
patterns.context: In medical or biomedical discussion, introduces risks, diseases, mechanistic explanations, or possible causes; triggers are scattered and do not fully match the first two constructions.

patterns.name: Judgment or inference in a narrative
patterns.context: A first-person narrator recalls a judgment made at the time based on limited information.

9_757.description: 激活集中于引出后续内容的表达：提出方法或方案、列举研究目标或提案；也见于医学风险与可能性陈述，以及个人叙述中的推断。

patterns.name: 方法或方案引入
patterns.context: 在说明某问题的解决办法、操作步骤或研究策略时，常见句式为“X way/approach is ...”；way/approach 附近的激活最明显。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、技术说明、问答

patterns.name: 研究目标或提案引入
patterns.context: 列举研究目标、研究计划或拟开展的工作时，常由 objectives/proposed 引出后续内容。

patterns.name: 生物医学结果或可能性陈述
patterns.context: 在医学或生物医学论述中，引出风险、疾病、机制解释或可能原因；触发较分散，不完全符合前两种句式。

patterns.name: 叙述中的判断或推断
patterns.trigger: “The only thing that I inferred at the time”
patterns.context: 第一人称叙述者回顾当时根据有限信息作出的判断。

en.concept: Expressions of key judgments and explanations
en.description: Activations occur in expressions of explanations and research goals, possibilities and methods, and superlative evaluations; they also appear in medical, legal, conflict-reporting, and time-data contexts. There is no unified domain theme across passages.

patterns.name: Explanations, judgments, or research goals in sentences
patterns.context: Trigger words often occur in sentences presenting a conjecture, possible cause, typical method, or research goal, and are often adjacent to structures such as is, are, and that.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, research abstracts, Q&A, and general discussion

patterns.name: Superlatives or degree evaluations
patterns.context: Evaluates risk or the difficulty of a practice; carries the main evaluative emphasis in the phrase.

patterns.name: Court references in legal texts
patterns.context: Refers to a court in formal legal discussion, especially in contexts such as jurisdiction or before the court.

patterns.name: Points of contention in conflict reporting
patterns.context: Used with sticking to identify a key dispute in negotiations or ceasefire issues.

patterns.name: Symptoms and quality of life in medicine
patterns.context: Discusses chronic conditions, symptoms, and their impact on quality of life in transplant survivors.

patterns.name: Time processing and temporal change
patterns.context: Concerns the representation, selection, and storage of time-series data or time-zone objects.

9_757.description: 激活分布于解释与研究目标、可能性和方法、最高级评价等表达，也见于医学、法律、冲突报道及时间数据语境；不同段落间缺乏统一的领域主题。

patterns.name: 句子中的解释、判断或研究目标
patterns.context: 触发词多出现在提出猜测、可能原因、典型方法或研究目标的句子中，常与 is、are、that 等结构相邻。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、研究摘要、问答及一般论述

patterns.name: 最高级或程度评价
patterns.context: 评价风险或某种做法的难易程度；在短语中承载重点评价。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的法院指称
patterns.context: 正式法律论述中指法院，尤其出现在 jurisdiction 或 before the court 等语境。

patterns.name: 冲突报道中的争议焦点
patterns.context: 与 sticking 搭配，指出谈判或停火问题中的关键争议。

patterns.name: 医学中的症状与生活质量
patterns.context: 讨论移植幸存者的慢性疾病、症状及生活质量影响。

patterns.name: 时间处理与时间变化
patterns.context: 涉及时间序列数据或时区对象的表示、选择与存储。

en.concept: Cross-genre text structure and domain terminology
en.description: Activations are distributed across genres: court designations in legal texts, function words and explanatory structures in Q&A, and domain-specific phrases about data conversion, research interviews, licenses, financial calculations, decision rationales, and visualization methods. The passages lack a single stable semantic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Court designation in legal opinions
patterns.context: Judicial procedure involving court jurisdiction, party motions, or summary judgment; “court” refers to the judicial institution.

patterns.name: Common function words in explanatory prose
patterns.context: When explaining reasons, speculating, or describing a problem, activations fall near common connectives or determiners; specific topics vary.

patterns.name: Data-format conversion instructions
patterns.context: Discusses converting XML data to JSON or simplified XML.

patterns.name: Family samples and interviews in research design
patterns.context: Describes repeated interview arrangements for family samples and research objectives.

patterns.name: License and software distribution statements
patterns.context: Standard legal wording about software license versions and distribution disclaimers.

patterns.name: Financial calculation method descriptions
patterns.context: Introduces earnings stability and calculation methods expressed as formulas.

patterns.name: Rationales and decision speculation in commentary
patterns.context: First cautiously speculates about the reasons for a decision, then offers the speaker’s strongest explanation.

patterns.name: Typical methods in data visualization
patterns.context: Discusses time-varying datasets and using visual summaries to identify time intervals.

9_757.concept: 跨文体文本结构与领域术语
9_757.description: 激活分布于多种文体：法律中的court称谓、问答里的功能词与解释结构，以及数据转换、研究访谈、许可证、金融计算、决策理由和可视化方法等领域词句。各段缺乏单一稳定的语义触发模式。

patterns.name: 法律意见中的法院称谓
patterns.context: 法院管辖权、当事人动议或简易判决等司法程序语境；“court”在句中作司法机构称谓。

patterns.name: 说明性文字中的常见功能词
patterns.context: 解释原因、提出猜测或描述问题时，激活落在常见连接词或限定词附近；具体主题并不一致。

patterns.name: 数据格式转换说明
patterns.trigger: «JSON»、«xml»，以及“convert … to JSON”“minify the xml data”
patterns.context: 讨论将 XML 数据转换为 JSON 或精简 XML 的操作。

patterns.name: 研究设计中的家庭样本与访谈
patterns.context: 描述家庭样本的重复访谈安排和研究目标。

patterns.name: 许可证与软件分发声明
patterns.context: 软件许可证版本及分发免责声明的固定法律措辞。

patterns.name: 金融计算方法说明
patterns.trigger: “«method» of calculation”“«Another» way to look at «it»”
patterns.context: 介绍收益稳定性及以公式表达的计算方法。

patterns.name: 评论中的理由与决策推测
patterns.context: 先谨慎推测某项决策的原因，再提出个人认为最有力的解释。

patterns.name: 数据可视化中的典型方法
patterns.context: 讨论时变数据集及用可视化摘要识别时间区间。

en.description: Activations are scattered across court terminology, technical code and Q&A, research texts, and commentary. A more common pattern is “idea/thought/thing/first” introducing an opinion or key point in a question, alongside loosely related relational and domain-specific words that do not form a single stable trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Introducing an opinion or statement of the key issue
