patterns.name: 数学答案中的负号
patterns.context: 数学问答里公式之后的答案开头，负号激活强于同段多数 token

patterns.name: 无法归入一致模式的局部触发
patterns.context: 专利段落中的零散字母或数字片段，未显示稳定词汇或语义条件

patterns.name: 无法归入一致模式的词内片段
patterns.trigger: 「« influ»」「« present»」「« not»」「« specify»」「« depressed»」「« ent»」「« he»」「« ú»」
patterns.context: 跨哲学、专利、议会、数学和论坛文本出现的不同词内片段；没有可证实的共同触发条件

en.description: Activation mainly falls on in-word fragments in multilingual text, especially Dutch word-form fragments and Portuguese dizer, recordar, and related examples; there are also sporadic in-word fragments, with no consistent semantic or discourse condition.

patterns.name: Dutch in-word suffix fragments
patterns.context: High activation is concentrated on continuous fragments inside Dutch words, often corresponding to word endings or inflectional parts; the context is words split by the tokenizer within complete sentences.
patterns.domain: Dutch parliamentary speeches; also Dutch philosophical commentary

patterns.name: Portuguese dizer
patterns.context: Triggered in Portuguese sentences, near discourse structures meaning “I need to say” or “I must say”.

patterns.name: Portuguese in-word fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in a Portuguese discussion of preposition omission; the trigger fragments occur in word forms such as tend[e] and Note-se.

patterns.name: Words related to recording/recalling
patterns.context: Occurs in parliamentary speeches, followed by “as palavras”, introducing a recollection or quotation of someone’s words.

patterns.name: Den in a German academic citation
patterns.context: Appears in the reference title “spekulatives Denken”; activation is on the in-word stem fragment of a German word capitalized in context.

patterns.name: In-word fragments in Portuguese personal terms
patterns.context: Appears within forms such as pessoal and pessoalmente; the fragment is not a stable independent word or unified semantic trigger.
patterns.domain: Portuguese parliamentary speeches and language discussion

patterns.name: Uncategorized multilingual in-word fragments
patterns.context: Several activations fall on in-word or short-word fragments in different languages, with no stable shared meaning, syntactic position, or discourse function.

9_836.description: 激活主要落在多语种文本中的词内片段，尤以荷兰语词形片段和葡萄牙语 dizer、recordar 等为突出实例；另有零散词内片段，未见一致语义或语篇条件。

patterns.name: 荷兰语词内后缀片段
patterns.context: 高激活集中在荷兰语词内部的连续片段，常对应词尾或词形变化部分；上下文为完整句子中被分词切开的词。
patterns.domain: 荷兰语议会发言；也见于荷兰语哲学评论

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语 dizer

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在葡萄牙语有关省略介词的讨论中；触发片段分别位于 tend[e] 与 Note-se 一类词形中。
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语语言用法讨论（StackExchange）

patterns.name: 记录/回忆相关词
patterns.context: 出现在议会发言中，后接“as palavras”，引出对某人话语的回顾或引用。

patterns.name: 德语学术引用中的 Den
patterns.context: 出现在参考文献标题“spekulatives Denken”中，激活的是德语词内大写词干片段。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语人称词内部片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在 pessoal 与 pessoalmente 一类词形内部；片段不构成稳定的独立词或统一语义触发。
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语议会发言及语言讨论

patterns.name: 未能归并的多语种词内片段
patterns.context: 若干激活落在不同语言的词内或短词上，未显示稳定共同的词义、句法位置或语篇功能。
patterns.domain: 荷兰语、葡萄牙语及哲学/议会文本

en.description: Activations occur across multilingual parliamentary transcripts, with more prominent activations on forms of address to the chair, line breaks, and Dutch word fragments. Isolated examples also occur in an English conversation about mental illness, a German recess time, and a Portuguese expression of judgment; no unified semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Dutch “mensen” and its endings
patterns.context: A Dutch noun meaning people or related forms occur in a passage; activation falls on a subword within the word and is often near a sentence or clause boundary.
patterns.domain: EuroParl political speeches and PhilPapers discussion

patterns.name: Parliamentary address “Senhor Presidente”
patterns.context: Formal address to the chair or a member in parliamentary speeches, usually at the start of a speech after a line break or in a salutation.

patterns.name: Dutch endings -ingen / -ing
patterns.context: Nominal endings or within-word segments in Dutch forms; sometimes occur near sentence endings, but not all examples are strong.

patterns.name: Speech/meeting markers in multilingual parliamentary records
patterns.context: Near line breaks, applause markers, or language labels, especially at speaker changes in parliamentary speeches; activation may also fall on adjacent forms of address.

patterns.name: English conversation about mental illness
patterns.context: Fictional dialogue mentions “mental disease” and “insanity”; activation concentrates on an emphatic response.

patterns.name: German meeting recess time
patterns.context: A number in a time expression is activated when meeting minutes announce a recess.

patterns.name: Portuguese emphatic judgment
patterns.context: In an explicit judgment expression at the beginning of a sentence, such as “É evidente,” activation falls within the adjective.

patterns.name: Sporadic within-word fragments, unclear pattern
patterns.context: Scattered subword activations across passages, with no consistent cross-example clues in meaning or context; they should not be grouped into a clear pattern.

9_836.description: 激活分布于多语种议会转录，较显著地落在称呼主席、换行及荷兰语词形片段；另有英语精神疾病对话、德语休会时间和葡语判断表达等孤例，未见统一语义触发。

patterns.name: 荷兰语“mensen”及其词尾
patterns.context: 荷兰语段落中出现表示人的名词或相关词形；激活落在词内子词，且常邻近句子或分句边界。

patterns.name: 议会称谓“Senhor Presidente”
patterns.context: 议会发言中对主席或议员的正式称呼，通常在换行后的发言开头或称呼语中。

patterns.name: 荷兰语词尾 -ingen / -ing
patterns.context: 荷兰语词形中的名词词尾或词内分段；有时出现在句末附近，但并非所有例子都强。

patterns.name: 跨语言议会记录的发言／会议标记
patterns.context: 换行、掌声标记或语言标签附近，尤其是议会发言人切换处；激活也可落在相邻称呼词。

patterns.name: 英语精神疾病对话
patterns.context: 小说对话谈及“mental disease”及“insanity”，激活集中在带感叹意味的回应。

patterns.name: 德语会议休会时间
patterns.context: 会议记录宣布休会时，时间表达中的数字被激活。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语强调判断
patterns.context: 句首“É evidente”一类明确判断表达中，激活落在形容词内部。

patterns.name: 零散词内片段，模式不明
patterns.trigger: 如“coleg”“Bushill-Matthews”中的片段、“produção/ produtos”相关片段、“desvio”中的片段
patterns.context: 各段零星子词激活，缺少跨例一致的词义或语境线索；不宜并入明确模式。

en.description: The strongest indication is subword fragments within Portuguese and Dutch words, especially the Portuguese dizer stem; there are also sporadic activations on long Dutch words, mathematical digits and symbols, and punctuation, which cannot be grouped under one stable semantic or syntactic function.

patterns.name: Stem of the Portuguese verb dizer
patterns.context: Appears as dizer (to say, to state) and its participial form dizendo in parliamentary speeches; strong activation concentrates on the verb stem, often in a syntactic position introducing an opinion or subsequent statement.

patterns.name: Strong stem/final fragments in Portuguese verb forms
patterns.context: When Portuguese words are split into subwords, the verb stem or infinitive-related fragment activates; observed forms include decidido, tende, and recordar.
patterns.domain: Portuguese parliamentary texts, language discussions, and quotations

patterns.name: Syntactic/function-word fragments in Portuguese phrases
patterns.context: Occurs in Portuguese clauses, prepositional phrases, and sentence transitions; may relate to high-frequency Portuguese subwords or endings, but trigger positions are not stable.
patterns.domain: Portuguese parliamentary debates and philosophical texts

patterns.name: Dutch in-word subword activation
patterns.context: Activation falls on split fragments within long Dutch words; examples include ingenomen and tenuitvoerlegging. The two examples differ in meaning and syntactic function.

patterns.name: Digit or symbol fragments in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Activates near polynomial definitions and equations, especially digits, minus signs, and mathematical variables; difficult to unify with the Portuguese and Dutch patterns in natural language.

patterns.name: Punctuation/digit subwords in paper text
patterns.context: A colon in a philosophical quotation and split fragments related to “verdade” activate; another instance involves digits and punctuation in a paper. No stable shared context is evident.

patterns.name: Sentence-final punctuation in document fragments
patterns.context: Periods near sentence or document-fragment boundaries activate, but only in a few samples and may be a local phenomenon.

9_836.description: 最突出的迹象是葡语和荷兰语词语内部的子词片段，尤其葡语 dizer 词干；另有荷兰语长词、数学数字符号及标点等零散激活，无法归为同一稳定语义或句法功能。

patterns.name: 葡语动词 dizer 的词干
patterns.context: 在议会发言中出现 dizer（说、表示）及其分词形式 dizendo；强激活集中在动词词干部分，常处于引出意见或后续发言的句法位置。

patterns.name: 葡语动词形式中的强词干/词尾片段
patterns.context: 葡语词语被切分成子词时，动词词干或不定式相关片段激活；所见词形包括 decidido、tende、recordar。
patterns.domain: 葡语议会文本、语言讨论及引语

patterns.name: 葡语短语中的句法/功能词片段
patterns.trigger: «» 中与 «que»、«por»、«na»、«para» 等相邻的切分片段
patterns.context: 出现在葡语从句、介词短语和句子衔接中；可能与高频葡语子词或词尾有关，但触发位置并不稳定。
patterns.domain: 葡语议会辩论与哲学文本

patterns.name: 荷兰语词内子词激活
patterns.context: 激活落在荷兰语长词的词内切分片段；分别见 ingenomen 和 tenuitvoerlegging。两例词义与句法功能不同。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的数字或符号片段
patterns.context: 在多项式定义和等式附近激活，尤其涉及数字、负号及数学变量；与自然语言中的葡语、荷兰语模式难以统一。

patterns.name: 论文正文中的标点/数字子词
patterns.context: 哲学引文中冒号及“verdade”相关切分片段激活；另一处则是论文中的数字和标点，二者未见稳定共同上下文。

patterns.name: 文档片段中的句末标点
patterns.context: 句子或文档片段边界附近的句号激活，但只见于少数样本，可能是局部现象。

en.concept: Multilingual local word fragments and phrasing
en.description: The main pattern is local word-fragment activation in Portuguese parliamentary text, especially around evident, opinion statements, verbs, and parliamentary phrasing; other heterogeneous patterns involve Dutch opinion and victim-related terms, mathematical symbols, lexical explanations, and German constitutional phrasing. The third passage is unexplained.

patterns.name: Portuguese “evidente” and related continuations
patterns.context: In Portuguese parliamentary speeches, when expressing a position, making a transition, or evaluating a view; the strongest response falls on the ending of “evidente,” and also occurs after a similar “certo” and on “dizer”

patterns.name: Portuguese infinitive ending -ar
patterns.context: In Portuguese verbs or infinitive forms, activation sometimes falls on the -ar ending and also occurs within “recordar”; the trigger position is not fully consistent

patterns.name: Words and word boundaries in Portuguese parliamentary formulas
patterns.context: Function words, verbs, and following elements in long Portuguese sentences may activate; no single fixed syntactic position is apparent
patterns.domain: EuroParl speeches and StackExchange explanatory text

patterns.name: Dutch expressions of opinion
patterns.context: After reporting a victimization rate, the text shifts to the speaker's view; strong responses concentrate on “mening” (opinion) and nearby words

patterns.name: Dutch victim-related words
patterns.context: Topics involving violence and its victims; activation occurs within compound words or nouns

patterns.name: Portuguese “open” and constructive phrasing
patterns.context: When emphasizing keeping dialogue open and constructive, activation concentrates on the word for open and its repeated use

patterns.name: Symbols and numbers in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: In derivative calculations or algebraic expressions, line breaks, minus signs, coefficient numbers, and adjacent variables show high activation

patterns.name: Discussion of informal usage in a Portuguese quotation
patterns.context: Explains that a word was once fashionable in informal circles and discusses its subsequent use and inclusion in dictionaries

patterns.name: Portuguese parliamentary salutations and forms of address
patterns.context: When greeting or addressing the chair or a member in a parliamentary speech

patterns.name: German constitutional-process phrasing
patterns.context: Discusses restarting the constitutional process and expresses the view that achieving a goal would be easier

patterns.name: Local word fragments in general Portuguese vocabulary
patterns.context: These activations are distributed across different word classes and syntactic positions, with insufficient evidence for a unified morphological or semantic trigger

9_836.concept: 多语种局部词片与措辞
9_836.description: 主线是葡语议会语料中的局部词片激活，尤其明显、意见表达、动词及议会措辞；另有荷兰语意见与受害者用词、数学符号、词汇说明和德语宪法表述等异质模式。第3段无法解释。

patterns.name: 葡语“evidente”及其延续
patterns.trigger: « evident»8«e»10« que»5« perman»2ece»2mos»1；« evident»9«e»10«,»6« sen»8hora»6；« é»3« cert»6o»5« -,»3 a tít…« dizer»9
patterns.context: 葡语议会发言中，围绕表态、转折或对某观点作评价时；最强响应落在“evidente”词尾，亦见于相近的“certo”之后及“dizer”
patterns.domain: EuroParl 葡语口语化议会辩论

patterns.name: 葡语不定式 -ar 词尾
patterns.trigger: « dist»2«anc»2«iar»5；« particip»3«ar»2；« record»7«ar»9；« pens»7«o»7« até»9（相邻但不构成同一词尾）
patterns.context: 葡语动词或不定式词形中，激活有时落在 -ar 结尾，也出现在词内“recordar”；触发位置并不完全一致
patterns.domain: EuroParl 与 StackExchange 葡语文本

patterns.name: 葡语议会套语中的词与词边界
patterns.trigger: « por»8« uma»2；« com»5；« gost»5«aria»7；« record»7«ar»9；« dizer»9« que»4
patterns.context: 葡语长句中的功能词、动词及其后续成分均可能激活；未见单一固定句法位置
patterns.domain: EuroParl 演讲及 StackExchange 说明文字

patterns.name: 荷兰语意见表述
patterns.trigger: « Ik»3« ben»4« d»2«us»6« van»5« mening»9« dat»6
patterns.context: 在统计受害比例后转入发言者观点，强响应集中于“mening”（意见）及附近词

patterns.name: 荷兰语受害者相关词
patterns.context: 涉及暴力及其受害者的议题；复合词或名词内部均有激活
patterns.domain: EuroParl 荷兰语社会议题发言

patterns.name: 葡语“开放”及建设性表述
patterns.context: 强调保持对话开放、建设性时；激活集中在开放一词及其重复表达

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的符号与数字
patterns.context: 导数计算或代数式中，换行、减号、系数数字和变量相邻位置出现高激活

patterns.name: 葡语引语中的非正式用语讨论
patterns.context: 解释某词曾是非正式圈子里的时尚说法，并讨论其后续使用和词典收录

patterns.name: 葡语议会致辞及称谓
patterns.context: 议会发言中向主席或议员致意、称呼对方时

patterns.name: 德语宪法进程表述
patterns.trigger: « den»5« Mitt»3elpunkt stellen…« den»3« Ver»2fassungsprozess wieder anzustoßen
patterns.context: 讨论重新启动宪法进程，并表达对更易实现某目标的判断

patterns.name: 葡语一般词汇中局部词片
patterns.context: 这些激活分布在不同词类和句法位置，没有足够证据归为统一的词形或语义触发条件

en.description: Activations occur on word endings, punctuation, and a few words expressing explanation or judgment in Portuguese and Dutch parliamentary or commentary texts. «registou» stands out in two Portuguese genres. Numeric activations also appear in math problems, with no consistent semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Portuguese word endings, punctuation, and sentence closure
patterns.context: Activations often fall on final subword fragments in Portuguese words, commas, periods, and line breaks, especially near the end of sentences or speech segments; not every passage activates only on punctuation.
patterns.domain: Portuguese parliamentary speeches and Portuguese texts

patterns.name: Portuguese verb stem «regist-»
patterns.context: Appears in sentences narrating or reporting that something has been recorded or registered; this verb fragment receives the highest-level activation.
patterns.domain: Portuguese bibliographic descriptions and EU project reports

patterns.name: «dizer» and expressions introducing explanations
patterns.context: In constructions such as «Não preciso de dizer que», meaning there is no need to state the obvious or introducing an explanation.

patterns.name: «evidente» and introducing judgments
patterns.context: When «É evidente» or «é evidente que» introduces an explicit judgment, the word ending activates strongly.

patterns.name: Emphasis and pointing things out
patterns.context: In «Gostaria de salientar aqui que», introducing something to emphasize or point out.

patterns.name: Dutch «vind»
patterns.context: Occurs in «Daarom vind ik», expressing the speaker’s opinion or judgment.

patterns.name: Dutch terms for power relations
patterns.context: Appears in discussions of changes in daily life and shifts in power relations; activation is concentrated on the internal «verh» fragment.

patterns.name: Numbers and decimal fragments in math problems
patterns.context: Activations occur on numeric character fragments and near decimal points in unit-conversion exercises and their numeric expressions; this differs from the other language passages.

9_836.description: 激活分布在葡语、荷兰语议会或评论文本中的词尾、标点及少数表达说明或判断的词；「registou」在两种葡语文体中突出。另见数学题数字激活，未见统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 葡语词尾标点与句末收束
patterns.trigger: 「,»」「.»」「↵」，以及词尾如「alertando」「evidente」中的末尾子词片段
patterns.context: 激活常落在葡语词的后部子词、逗号句号及换行处，尤其在句子或发言片段收束附近；并非每段都只在标点上激活。
patterns.domain: 葡语议会发言及葡语文本

patterns.name: 葡语动词词干「regist-」
patterns.context: 出现在叙述或报告已记录、登记某事的句子中；该动词片段获得最高等级激活。
patterns.domain: 葡语书目介绍与欧盟项目报告

patterns.name: 「dizer」及表达说明
patterns.context: 在「Não preciso de dizer que」这类表示无需赘言、引出说明的句式中。

patterns.name: 「evidente」及判断引入
patterns.context: 以「É evidente」或「é evidente que」引入明确判断时，词尾部分强烈激活。

patterns.name: 强调与指出
patterns.context: 在「Gostaria de salientar aqui que」中，引出强调或指出的内容。

patterns.name: 荷兰语「vind」
patterns.context: 位于「Daarom vind ik」中，表达说话者观点或判断。

patterns.name: 荷兰语权力关系词
patterns.context: 出现在日常生活变化与权力关系改变的论述中，激活集中于词内「verh」片段。

patterns.name: 数学题中的数字与小数片段
patterns.context: 单位换算练习题及其数值表达中，数字字符片段和小数点附近出现激活；与其余语言段落不同。

en.concept: Portuguese word forms and number-format fragments
en.description: Activations occur mainly on regist- word forms, parliamentary forms of address, and expressions such as tenho in Portuguese data; another group appears on numbers and decimal points in unit-conversion problems. Several other Portuguese word-form fragments are scattered and lack a unified condition.

patterns.name: Portuguese record/registration word forms
patterns.context: Occurs in Portuguese sentences, where the stem regist- takes different inflectional endings; surrounding contexts involve an author's experience, listening and recording, or project performance.
patterns.domain: Bibliographic introductions, European Parliament speeches and reports

patterns.name: Polite forms of address in European Parliament speeches
patterns.context: Addressing the chair or a female member in European Parliament speeches or proceedings; several subword fragments in these forms of address activate.

patterns.name: Portuguese first-person singular tenho
patterns.context: Portuguese first-person singular present tense, used respectively to mean “I have a small correction” and “I have nothing to add.”

patterns.name: Portuguese expressions for naturally/of course and related discourse words
patterns.context: Discourse transitions or stance expressions in parliamentary speeches; the triggering words differ but are used to organize a statement or emphasize a judgment.

patterns.name: Numbers and decimal points in unit-conversion problems
patterns.context: Math problems ask for conversions between units of length, mass, volume, or time; values and decimal points are tokenized separately, with activation concentrated on number tokens and weaker activation on the prompt text.

patterns.name: Evaluative word forms in Portuguese political reports
patterns.context: Word-form fragments activate when discussing project improvement or restrictions on parliamentary activity; no clear shared lexical item links them to the other high-activation patterns.
patterns.domain: European Parliament reports and policy speeches

patterns.name: Sporadic Portuguese endings/syntactic fragments
patterns.context: Distributed across different syntactic positions and words; difficult to group into a stable semantic or grammatical trigger condition.

9_836.concept: 葡语词形与数字格式片段
9_836.description: 激活主要见于葡语语料中的 regist- 词形、议会称谓及 tenho 等发言用语；另一组出现在单位换算题的数字和小数点。另有若干分散的葡语词形片段，缺少统一条件。

patterns.name: 葡语中记录/登记词形
patterns.context: 出现在葡萄牙语句子中，词干 regist- 接后缀形成不同变位；周边语境分别涉及作者经历、听取并记录、项目表现。
patterns.domain: 书目介绍、欧洲议会发言与报告

patterns.name: 欧洲议会发言中的礼貌称呼
patterns.context: 欧洲议会发言或议事记录中，称呼主席或女议员；这些称谓的若干分词片段有激活。

patterns.name: 葡语第一人称单数 tenho
patterns.context: 葡语第一人称单数现在时，分别用于表示“我有一个小修正”和“我没什么可补充”。

patterns.name: 葡语自然/当然及相近话语词
patterns.context: 议会发言中的论述衔接或立场表达；触发词并不相同，均用于组织陈述或强调判断。

patterns.name: 单位换算题中的数字与小数点
patterns.context: 数学题要求在长度、质量、体积或时间单位间换算；数值和小数点分段呈现，激活集中于数字 token，而题干文字激活较弱。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 单位换算练习

patterns.name: 葡语政治报告中的评价词形
patterns.context: 谈及项目改善或议会活动受到限制时，词形片段出现激活；与其他高激活模式没有明确共同词项。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会报告与政策发言

patterns.name: 零散葡语词尾/句法片段
patterns.context: 分布在不同句法位置和不同词汇中，难以归并为稳定的词义或语法触发条件。

en.description: Activations are scattered across multilingual texts: the «end» fragment in Portuguese and German words, along with various verb stems, foreign-language word-initial fragments, and numbers in math problems. There is no stable semantic or stylistic commonality; local patterns are weak and scattered.

patterns.name: Word-initial «end» in sentence-final or medial position
patterns.context: Word-initial substring «end» in Portuguese «endereço» (stem «end») and German «endlich» (stem «end»); they occur in parliamentary speech sentences and philosophical discourse, respectively.
patterns.domain: Portuguese parliamentary speeches; German philosophical texts

patterns.name: Sentence-medial verbs or verb stems
patterns.context: Verbs or verb stems in sentence-continuation positions across languages, including Portuguese «dizer», «Tenho», «recordar», «saber», and Dutch «vind»; these forms do not constitute a shared lexical or grammatical category.
patterns.domain: Parliamentary speeches, questions, and forum texts

patterns.name: Foreign-language word fragments continuing a sentence
patterns.context: Marked word-initial fragments in German «einstimmig» and Dutch «eerste», occurring in sentence or phrase continuation positions.

patterns.name: Numeric fragments in number expressions
patterns.context: Activations occur near numbers or numeric answers in math exercises involving conversions, months, and durations; they are scattered across multiple numbers, with no consistent numeric format.

patterns.name: Colloquial expression after a word-meaning explanation
patterns.context: A Portuguese forum text begins a colloquial example with «Tenho bué de coisas» after explaining the use of the word «abundância».

9_836.description: 激活散见于多语种文本：葡萄牙语、德语词中的「end」片段，以及多种动词词干、外语词首片段和数学题数字。没有稳定的语义或文体共性；各片段局部模式弱且分散。

patterns.name: 句末或句中词干「end」
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语 «endereço»（词干 «end»）和德语 «endlich»（词干 «end»）中的词首子串；分别出现在议会发言句子中和哲学论述中。
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语议会发言；德语哲学文本

patterns.name: 句末动词或动词词干
patterns.context: 不同语言中处于句子延续位置的动词或动词词干，包括葡萄牙语 «dizer»、«Tenho»、«recordar»、«saber»，以及荷兰语 «vind»；这些形式不构成同一词汇或语法类别。
patterns.domain: 议会演讲、问句和论坛文本

patterns.name: 句首续接的外语词片段
patterns.context: 德语 «einstimmig» 和荷兰语 «eerste» 中被标记的词首片段，处于句子或短语延续处。

patterns.name: 数字表达中的数值片段
patterns.context: 换算、月份与时间长度等数学练习中，数字或数值答案附近出现激活；标记分散在多个数字间，并非统一数值格式。

patterns.name: 解释词义后的口语表达
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语论坛文本在说明词语「abundância」的用法后，以 «Tenho bué de coisas» 开始口语化例句。

en.description: Strong activations occur on within-word fragments across languages and domains, with no stable semantic condition; there are also local themes involving parliamentary institutional language, discussion of Portuguese constructions, philosophical concepts, and book advertisements.

patterns.name: Word-final or internal syllables in cross-word fragments
patterns.context: Many strong activations fall on segmented subword fragments; the fragments span different parts of speech and meanings, with no identifiable shared morphological or semantic condition.
patterns.domain: German, Dutch, Portuguese, and English; philosophy, parliamentary texts, Q&A, book advertisements, and other genres

patterns.name: Parliamentary procedure and institutional terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in discussions of European Parliament debates, requests, committees, or parliamentary activities, often with formal speech phrasing.

patterns.name: Discussion of Portuguese constructions and words
patterns.context: One passage discusses the omission of prepositions in Portuguese; another is an explanatory answer in a Portuguese programming Q&A.
patterns.domain: StackExchange, language discussion and programming Q&A

patterns.name: Conceptual vocabulary in philosophical discourse
patterns.context: Abstract discussions cover Kant, faith and knowledge, as well as value and testimony in Dutch philosophical texts.
patterns.domain: PhilPapers, German and Dutch philosophical texts

patterns.name: Evaluative quotations in book advertisements
patterns.context: Information about book editions, endorsements, and publication locations in advertisements or publishing material.

9_836.description: 强激活分布在多语种、跨领域的词内片段上，未见稳定语义条件；另有议会机构用语、葡萄牙语构式讨论、哲学概念和书籍广告等局部主题。

patterns.name: 跨词片段中的词尾或词内音节
patterns.trigger: 分词标注中突出了一些词内片段，如«end»、«imm»、«get»、«tend»、«morning»、«onder»、«rest»、«Ent»、«even»
patterns.context: 较多强激活落在被切分的词片段上；片段本身跨越不同词类和语义，无法确定统一的词法或语义条件。
patterns.domain: 德语、荷兰语、葡萄牙语及英语；哲学、议会文本、问答和书籍广告等

patterns.name: 议会程序与机构用语
patterns.context: 出现在欧洲议会辩论、请求、委员会或议会活动的讨论中，常伴随正式发言措辞。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语构式与词语讨论
patterns.context: 一段讨论葡萄牙语中省略介词的现象；另一段是葡萄牙语编程问答中的解释性回答。

patterns.name: 哲学论述中的概念词
patterns.context: 抽象论述分别涉及康德、信仰与知识，以及荷兰语哲学文本中的价值和见证。
patterns.domain: PhilPapers，德语与荷兰语哲学文本

patterns.name: 书籍广告中的评价引语
patterns.context: 书籍版本、推荐语及出版地点等广告或出版信息。

en.description: Occur mainly in Dutch parliamentary text, distributed across degree adverbs, predicates, time expressions, prepositions, and within-word fragments; also include German and Portuguese word fragments, Morning in a book-review quotation, and numbers and units in math Q&A. Trigger conditions are not unified.

patterns.name: Emphatic expressions in Dutch parliamentary speeches
patterns.context: Near degree or relational adverbs in formal Dutch sentences, such as “very certain,” “very precise,” “in front of…,” and “among/between”; not necessarily the same fixed phrase.

patterns.name: Dutch verbs and expression fragments
patterns.context: Common predicates or time expressions in Dutch parliamentary sentences; activation falls on within-word fragments or adjacent words, with no unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: Dutch fragments and function words
patterns.context: High-frequency prepositions and articles occur in continuous Dutch text, as do fragments inside compounds marked as split tokens; the instances are not all the same word or meaning.
patterns.domain: European Parliament and Dutch philosophical texts

patterns.name: Multilingual endings or within-word fragments
patterns.context: In non-Dutch texts, activation falls on endings, stems, or within-word fragments, with no consistent language or semantic condition apparent.

patterns.name: Word in a publication title and quotation
patterns.context: Appears in the book-review quotation attribution “--_Morning Post._”; there is insufficient evidence to link it to other patterns.

patterns.name: Numbers and unit fragments in math problems
patterns.context: Number strings, units, and decimal digits are marked in conversion or quantity questions; activations include not only numbers but also text fragments.

9_836.description: 主要见于荷兰语议会文本，激活分布在程度副词、谓语、时间表达、介词及词内片段；另见德语和葡语词片段、书评引文中的Morning、数学问答的数字与单位，触发条件并不统一。

patterns.name: 荷兰语议会发言中的强调表达
patterns.context: 在荷兰语正式句子中，程度或关系副词附近，如“非常确定”“非常精确”“在……面前”“其中/相互”等；未必是同一个固定短语。

patterns.name: 荷兰语动词与表达片段
patterns.context: 荷兰语议会语句中的常见谓语或时间表达，激活落在词内片段或相邻词上，缺少统一的词义条件。

patterns.name: 荷兰语中词片段及虚词
patterns.context: 荷兰语连续文本中出现高频介词、冠词，以及被拆分标记的复合词内部片段；并非每处同一词或同一语义。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会及荷兰语哲学文本

patterns.name: 多语种词尾或词内片段
patterns.context: 非荷兰语文本中，激活落在词尾、词干或词内片段，未显示一致的语言或词义条件。
patterns.domain: 德语哲学、葡萄牙语议会文本

patterns.name: 出版物标题和引文中的词
patterns.context: 出现在书评引文署名“--_Morning Post._”中；没有足够证据说明它与其他模式相关。
patterns.domain: 19世纪书籍前言或出版物文本

patterns.name: 数学题中的数字与单位片段
patterns.context: 换算或数量问答中，数字串、单位及小数数字被标记；激活对象不止数字，也包括文本词片段。

en.description: Primarily responds to Portuguese first-person speech and Dutch parliamentary courtesies; also covers word-meaning explanations, technical Q&A, and philosophical discourse. Activations often fall on subword fragments, forms of address, speech verbs, and punctuation, and cannot be reduced to a single meaning.

patterns.name: Portuguese first-person wishes and speech
patterns.context: First-person forms in Portuguese verb phrases, common in parliamentary speeches or Q&A; activations fall on verbs, internal fragments, and adjacent punctuation
patterns.domain: European Parliament speeches in Portuguese; Portuguese Q&A

patterns.name: Dutch parliamentary courtesies and forms of address
patterns.context: Courteous turns to speak and forms of address for the chair and representatives in formal parliamentary speeches; several phrases are scattered at the beginnings or middles of passages

patterns.name: Quantity meaning in Portuguese word-meaning explanations
patterns.context: Explains the use of a word in Angolan Portuguese and clarifies its meaning

patterns.name: Technical question about Portuguese video links
patterns.context: Asks how to remove a link to a video from a webpage, in a code or web-element context

patterns.name: Testimony and value in Dutch philosophical discourse
patterns.context: Philosophical discourse concerning value, happiness, and the testimony of a sentence; it has no obvious parliamentary-address format

patterns.name: Isolated Dutch parliamentary compliment
patterns.context: A parliamentary speech praises an exhibition held at the European Parliament; the context includes a member’s role and forms of address

patterns.name: Cross-word-ending fragments and punctuation activations
patterns.context: Activations sometimes fall on within-word subword fragments or positions such as commas and line breaks, rather than on whole words; no single meaning explains them

9_836.description: 主要响应葡语第一人称发言及荷兰语议会礼貌致辞；也覆盖词义解释、技术问答和哲学论述。激活常落在子词片段、称谓、发言动词及标点上，不能归结为单一语义。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语第一人称愿望与发言
patterns.trigger: «Gostaria de saber»、«Gostaria hoje»、«Tenho»、«não tenho muito a acrescentar»
patterns.context: 葡语动词短语中的第一人称形式，常见于议会发言或问答；激活落在动词、词内片段及相邻标点上
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会葡萄牙语发言；葡语问答

patterns.name: 荷兰语礼貌致辞与称谓
patterns.trigger: «ik verleen u met veel genoegen het woord»、«Mevrouw de Voorzitter»、«geachte afgevaardigden»、«de heer»
patterns.context: 正式议会发言中的礼貌授予发言、称呼主席和代表；若干短语分散在段首或段中
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会荷兰语会议记录

patterns.name: 葡语词义解释中的数量义
patterns.context: 说明词语在安哥拉葡语中的用法，并解释其意义

patterns.name: 葡语视频链接技术提问
patterns.trigger: «Como posso remover cada link»、«vídeo»、«Tenho esta div»
patterns.context: 询问网页中如何移除指向视频的链接，包含代码或网页元素语境

patterns.name: 荷兰语哲学论述中的见证与价值
patterns.context: 哲学论述，涉及价值、幸福及句子的见证；没有明显议会致辞格式

patterns.name: 单独的荷兰语议会礼貌赞誉
patterns.context: 议会发言中称赞在欧洲议会举办的展览，语境含委员身份与称呼

patterns.name: 跨词尾片段与标点激活
patterns.context: 激活有时落在词内子词片段或逗号、换行等位置，而非完整词；无法由单一词义解释

en.concept: Portuguese tenho forms and sporadic word fragments
en.description: Primarily responds strongly to Portuguese first-person «Tenho/tenho», often in parliamentary speeches or questions; other isolated cases are triggered by internal fragments of unrelated words, such as Groningen, endlich, ongetwijfeld, tenuitvoerlegging, and decidido, which cannot be grouped under a shared meaning or part of speech.

patterns.name: Portuguese «Tenho» in first-person speech
patterns.context: Portuguese first-person singular «Tenho» (I have / I …), occurring at the beginning of a speech or question and followed by a personal statement; the form is marked as segmented in the samples.
patterns.domain: Portuguese StackExchange questions, EuroParl parliamentary speeches

patterns.name: Portuguese «tenho» in parliamentary speeches
patterns.context: First-person Portuguese «tenho» in parliamentary speeches, used to indicate something to add, ask a question, or express an intention; activations often occur at the beginning or within a sentence.

patterns.name: Word-initial fragment of Dutch parliamentary «tenuitvoerlegging»
patterns.context: The word-initial fragment of the Dutch long word «tenuitvoerlegging» (implementation); its meaning is unrelated to the first-person verbs in other activated samples.

patterns.name: Fragment in the English place name Groningen
patterns.context: The Dutch place name Groningen appears in an English sentence, with activation concentrated on the internal fragment «ron»; no other instance of the same form is observed.

patterns.name: Word-initial fragment of German «endlich»
patterns.context: The German adverb endlich (finally) in philosophical discourse, with activation on a word-initial fragment; it differs from Portuguese tenho in both meaning and grammar.

patterns.name: Internal fragment of Dutch «ongetwijfeld»
patterns.context: «Ongetwijfeld» (undoubtedly) in Dutch philosophical texts; high activation spans a continuous internal fragment, with no other instance of the same word observed.

patterns.name: Word-initial fragment of «décidé» in French loanword/parliamentary context
patterns.context: Portuguese parliamentary text containing «foi decidido» (it has been decided); activation falls on a cross-origin spelling fragment of the word for “decided”; no comparable recurrence can be confirmed.

9_836.concept: 葡语 tenho 词形及偶发词片段
9_836.description: 主要强烈响应葡语第一人称“Tenho/tenho”，常处于议会发言或提问中；另有多个孤例触发于无关词的内部片段，如Groningen、endlich、ongetwijfeld、tenuitvoerlegging和decidido，无法归并为同一语义或词类。

patterns.name: 葡语第一人称发言的“Tenho”
patterns.context: 葡语中第一人称单数“Tenho”（我有／我……），位于发言或提问开头，后接个人陈述；覆盖的样本中词形被拆分标注。
patterns.domain: 葡语 StackExchange 提问、EuroParl 议会发言

patterns.name: 葡语议会发言中的“tenho”
patterns.context: 葡语议会发言中第一人称“tenho”，用于表示有话要补充、提出问题或表达意愿；激活位置常在句首或句内。

patterns.name: 荷兰语议会中的“tenuitvoerlegging”词首
patterns.context: 荷兰语长词“tenuitvoerlegging”（实施）的词首片段；词义与其他激活样本中的第一人称动词无关。

patterns.name: 英语地名 Groningen 中的片段
patterns.context: 英语句子中出现荷兰地名 Groningen，激活集中于其内部片段“ron”；不见相同词形的其他实例。

patterns.name: 德语“endlich”词首
patterns.context: 哲学论述中德语副词 endlich（最终），激活落在词首片段；与葡语 tenho 的语义和语法均不同。

patterns.name: 荷兰语“ongetwijfeld”词中片段
patterns.context: 荷兰语哲学文本中的“ongetwijfeld”（毫无疑问），高激活覆盖词中连续片段；未见其他同词实例。

patterns.name: 法语借词／议事语境中的“décidé”词首
patterns.context: 葡语议会文本中“foi decidido”（已经决定），激活落在决定一词的跨词源拼写片段；没有可确认的同类复现。

en.description: Activations are scattered across languages and genres: parliamentary forms of address, line-break punctuation, and Portuguese expressions of desire; within-word subword fragments; and isolated topics such as credit cards, political rhetoric, philosophy, bibliography, acknowledgments, and drama. No unified semantic trigger is evident.

patterns.name: European Parliament speech conventions
patterns.context: Forms of address, line breaks, and punctuation in European Parliament speeches or debates; often found in parliamentary statements or at paragraph boundaries.
patterns.domain: EuroParl, Portuguese, Dutch, and other parliamentary speeches

patterns.name: Portuguese future-tense expression of desire
patterns.context: Portuguese «Gostaria de» (“I would like to”) introduces a question or request for clarification; activation is concentrated on Gostaria and the following infinitive.

patterns.name: Internal suffixes and word-form fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on continuous subword fragments inside words in multiple languages, often in long words or inflected and derived forms; they span Portuguese, English, German, and Dutch.

patterns.name: Credit card numbers and brands
patterns.context: Discussion of the correspondence between bank card number prefixes and the VISA and Mastercard brands.

patterns.name: Left- and right-wing political rhetoric
patterns.context: A political speech scene mentions reactions from the left and right, describing audience reactions with wit, mockery, or sarcasm.

patterns.name: Kantian philosophical terminology
patterns.context: Philosophical discourse discusses antinomy, Kant, and concepts such as faith and knowledge.

patterns.name: Dutch abstract-concept discourse
patterns.context: Abstract nouns are used to discuss connections, reversals, and testimony among ideas or values; the sentences are theoretical in meaning.

patterns.name: Portuguese literary bibliography and usage notes
patterns.context: Introduces Portuguese dictionaries and authors, describes their travels, and then presents a usage note for a word.
patterns.domain: StackExchange, Portuguese literary or lexical discussion

patterns.name: Dutch parliamentary acknowledgments
patterns.context: At the end of a parliamentary speech, thanks are given to members from various groups, committee staff, and others.

patterns.name: Dramatic dialogue and stage directions
patterns.context: Dramatic text with character names, direct dialogue, and stage directions.

9_836.description: 激活跨多语种、多文体分散：包括议会称呼、换行标点与葡语愿望句，词内子词片段，以及信用卡、政治修辞、哲学、书目、致谢和戏剧等孤立主题，未见统一语义触发。

patterns.name: 欧洲议会发言程式
patterns.context: 欧洲议会演讲或辩论的称呼、换行与标点；常在议事语句或段落边界出现。
patterns.domain: EuroParl，葡萄牙语、荷兰语等议会发言

patterns.name: 葡语将来式愿望表达
patterns.context: 葡语 Gostaria de（“我想/希望”）引出询问或说明请求；激活集中在 Gostaria 及其后续不定式。

patterns.name: 词内后缀与词形片段
patterns.context: 激活落在多语种词内部的连续子词片段，常见于长词或屈折、派生词形；跨越葡语、英语、德语、荷兰语。

patterns.name: 信用卡编号与品牌
patterns.context: 讨论银行卡号码前缀与 VISA、Mastercard 品牌的对应关系。

patterns.name: 左右派政治修辞
patterns.context: 政治演讲场景中提及左右派反应，并以机智言辞、嘲讽或挖苦描写听众反应。

patterns.name: 康德哲学术语
patterns.context: 哲学论述中讨论二律背反、康德及信仰与知识等概念。

patterns.name: 荷兰语抽象概念论述
patterns.context: 以抽象名词讨论观念或价值之间的联系、倒转与见证；句子语义偏理论性。
patterns.domain: 荷兰语学术或哲学文本

patterns.name: 葡萄牙文学书目与用语记录
patterns.context: 介绍葡萄牙语词典、作者及其旅行经历，并引出某词的用法记录。

patterns.name: 荷兰语议会致谢
patterns.context: 议会发言末尾感谢各派议员、委员会工作人员等。

patterns.name: 戏剧台词与舞台说明
patterns.context: 带人物名、直接对白及舞台表演说明的戏剧文本。

en.description: Activations concentrate on Portuguese tenho in several speech contexts, alongside scattered word forms: Dutch onder and gest-, end within German endlich, English wonder, and Portuguese vez. They span languages and parts of speech, with no unified visible semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Portuguese first-person “tenho”
patterns.context: Tenho occurs in first-person statements; in [1] and [3] it is followed by a complement or discourse content, and in [5], [6], and [9] it appears in parliamentary speech or Q&A contexts.
patterns.domain: Portuguese forum text and European Parliament speeches

patterns.name: Dutch “onder”
patterns.context: Functions as a preposition or adverb in Dutch parliamentary procedural language, occurring in “onderbroken” and “onder leiding,” respectively.

patterns.name: Dutch “gest-” word form
patterns.context: Means being supported in a Dutch sentence and occurs between “word … door de lidstaten.”

patterns.name: Within-word “end” in German
patterns.context: Occurs within an adverbial form meaning “finally” in philosophical discussion.

patterns.name: English “wonder”
patterns.context: Describes something as worthy of wonder in a dramatic line, occurring in poetic dialogue.

patterns.name: Portuguese “vez”
patterns.context: Part of an expression of frequency in the construction “é a segunda vez que…” (“this is the second time that…”).

9_836.description: 激活集中于葡语 tenho（多种发言语境），另有零散词形：荷兰语 onder、gest-，德语 endlich 内的 end、英语 wonder，以及葡语 vez；跨语言、跨词类，缺少统一可见语义模式。

patterns.name: 葡语第一人称“tenho”
patterns.trigger: «Ten»…«ho»，即葡语动词 tenho（“我有/我已经……”）
patterns.context: 第一人称陈述中出现 tenho；在[1]和[3]后接补语或话语内容，在[5]、[6]、[9]出现在议会发言或问答语境。
patterns.domain: 葡语论坛文本及欧洲议会发言

patterns.name: 荷兰语“onder”
patterns.context: 荷兰语议会程序表述中作介词或副词，分别出现在“onderbroken”和“onder leiding”等结构里。

patterns.name: 荷兰语“gest-”词形
patterns.context: 荷兰语句中表示受到支持，位于“word … door de lidstaten”之间。

patterns.name: 德语词内“end”
patterns.context: 哲学论述中出现在表示“最终”的副词词形内部。

patterns.name: 英语“wonder”
patterns.context: 戏剧台词中描述某事值得惊叹，词形处在诗体对白中。

patterns.name: 葡语“vez”
patterns.context: “é a segunda vez que…”（这是第二次……）结构中，作为次数表达的一部分。

en.concept: Local word fragments in multilingual texts
en.description: Activations occur across multilingual European Parliament texts, often on forms of address, expressions of hope or recall, and internal word fragments in Portuguese speeches; other cases include Dutch parliamentary terms, a Go assignment operator, and “Morning” in an old book advertisement.

patterns.name: Identity forms of address and greetings in parliamentary speeches
patterns.context: In parliamentary speeches or procedural texts, addresses such as chair or Madam open a speech, or first-person forms express hope, opinion, or an announcement; activations often fall on the form of address or related verb.

patterns.name: Segmented fragments within Portuguese words
patterns.context: Internal subword fragments are often activated in Portuguese texts, including parliamentary speeches and word-meaning discussions; no single fixed meaning or syntactic function is evident.

patterns.name: Word fragments in Dutch parliamentary procedure texts
patterns.context: Dutch parliamentary contexts, with activations distributed across verbs, quantity expressions, and terms related to parliamentary sessions.

patterns.name: Assignment operator in code
patterns.context: In Go code, a buffer is initialized immediately after the short variable declaration and assignment operator.

patterns.name: Time-period name in a book-advertisement phrase
patterns.context: Appears as part of the newspaper name Morning Post in a quotation from an old English publishing advertisement.
patterns.domain: Gutenberg book advertisements or publishing material

patterns.name: Portuguese lexical definition and example
patterns.context: After explaining the meaning of the Angolan term «bué», the text transitions to a first-person example.

patterns.name: Forms of address for parliamentary speakers
patterns.context: A parliamentary speaker addresses the chair or a member, using German and Portuguese forms.

9_836.concept: 多语种文本中的局部词片段
9_836.description: 激活分布于多语种欧洲议会文本，常见于葡语发言中的称谓、希望或回顾表达及词内片段；另有荷兰语议事词、Go赋值符号和旧书广告中的 Morning。

patterns.name: 议会发言中的身份称谓与致意
patterns.context: 议会发言或程序文本中，以主席、女士等称谓开场，或用第一人称表达希望、看法、宣布；激活常落在称谓或相关动词上。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会多语种议事记录

patterns.name: 葡语词语内部的切分片段
patterns.context: 葡语文本中常激活词内子词片段；涵盖议会发言和词义讨论，未见单一固定词义或句法功能。
patterns.domain: 葡语议会文本及问答文本

patterns.name: 荷兰语议会程序文本中的词片段
patterns.context: 荷兰语议会语境，激活分布在动词、数量表达及议会会议相关词语中。

patterns.name: 代码中的赋值操作符
patterns.context: Go 代码中，短变量声明赋值符号后紧接缓冲区初始化。

patterns.name: 书籍广告语中的时段名称
patterns.context: 英语旧式出版广告引文中，作为报刊名称 Morning Post 的一部分出现。

patterns.name: 葡语词汇释义及例句
patterns.context: 解释 Angola 用语“bué”的含义后，转入第一人称例句。

patterns.name: 议会人物发言称谓
patterns.context: 议会发言者向主席或委员致辞，包含德语、葡语形式。

en.concept: Local expressions and formulas in multilingual texts
en.description: Activations cover Portuguese first-person speech, repetition and responses in parliamentary contexts, Dutch parliamentary formulas, and isolated English book-advertisement terms and Go buffer code; overall, there is no single cross-language lexical trigger.

patterns.name: Portuguese first-person intention to speak
patterns.context: Portuguese first-person expressions meaning “want to know,” “want to add something,” or “I have…”; some contexts are parliamentary speeches and others are everyday Q&A

patterns.name: Repetition and responses in Portuguese parliamentary speeches
patterns.context: Discusses no longer repeating something, responding to a previously asked question, and noting that this is the second occurrence or speech

patterns.name: Dutch parliamentary speech formulas
patterns.context: In parliamentary speeches, greeting the chair and audience, stating the focus of a speech, or proposing to inform Parliament about something or connect it to something

patterns.name: Morning Post in book advertisements
patterns.context: A newspaper review is quoted in a book review or publishing advertisement, surrounded by information on editions, bindings, and book endorsements

patterns.name: Go buffer initialization code
patterns.context: A byte buffer is created in a Go function that retrieves a socket option

patterns.name: Colloquial Portuguese quantity expression
patterns.context: Colloquial Portuguese «bué de» meaning “a lot of things” follows «Tenho»

9_836.concept: 多语种文本中的局部表达与套语
9_836.description: 激活覆盖葡语第一人称发言、议会中的重复与回应、荷兰语议会套语，以及孤立的英语书籍广告词和Go缓冲区代码；整体并无单一跨语种词法触发。

patterns.name: 葡语第一人称发言意愿
patterns.context: 葡语第一人称表达想知道、想补充发言，或“我有……”；有的上下文为议会发言，有的为日常问答

patterns.name: 葡语议会中的重复与回应
patterns.context: 谈论不再重复某事、回应先前提出的问题，并指出这是第二次发生或发言

patterns.name: 荷兰语议会发言套语
patterns.context: 议会演说中向主席及听众致意，说明发言重点，或提出把某事告知议会、联系起来

patterns.name: 书籍广告中的 Morning Post
patterns.context: 书评或出版广告引述报纸评价，周围有版本、装帧及书籍推荐语
patterns.domain: 英文书籍广告／古腾堡文本

patterns.name: Go 缓冲区初始化代码
patterns.context: 获取 socket option 的 Go 函数中创建字节缓冲区
patterns.domain: Go 语言技术文档与代码

patterns.name: 葡语口语数量表达
patterns.context: “Tenho”之后用葡语口语 bué de 表示很多东西

en.description: The strongest activations often fall on first-person expressions, opinions, or questions in parliamentary speeches, but also cover wishes, formal meeting language, book-review words, Go assignment syntax, and a comma after a Hungarian form of address; there is no consistent trigger across passages.

patterns.name: Expressing an intention to speak or speech content
patterns.context: In Portuguese first-person speech, means “want to say” or “must say,” often occurring mid-sentence to introduce an evaluation or opinion

patterns.name: Asking for information about a decision
patterns.context: In Portuguese, a question about a decision is introduced by “want to know”

patterns.name: Stating an opinion
patterns.context: A first-person judgment or opinion is expressed at the beginning or middle of a sentence, in Dutch or German

patterns.name: Verb in a Dutch expression of wishes
patterns.context: A wish meaning “hope … will bring …,” following New Year greetings and a reference to European unity

patterns.name: Dutch expression for a formal meeting
patterns.context: Refers to someone recently attending or appearing before others at an event, occurring within a sentence

patterns.name: Time-related word in an English book review
patterns.context: Appears as part of a newspaper name in a book-promotion quotation’s attribution

patterns.name: Go assignment syntax
patterns.context: Allocates a slice to a local variable inside a Go function

patterns.name: Comma after a Hungarian form of address
patterns.context: A comma follows the address “Madam President” in a parliamentary speech

9_836.description: 激活最强处多落在议会发言中的第一人称表达、观点或提问，但也覆盖祝愿、正式会见措辞及书评词语、Go赋值语法和匈牙利语称呼后的逗号；跨段缺少统一触发形式。

patterns.name: 表达发言意愿或发言内容
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语第一人称发言中，表示“想说”或“必须说”，常位于句中引出评价或观点

patterns.name: 询问决定信息
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语中以“想知道”引出对某项决定的提问

patterns.name: 表述观点
patterns.context: 句首或句中用第一人称表达判断、看法，荷兰语或德语

patterns.name: 荷兰语祝愿中的动词
patterns.context: “希望……能带来……”的祝愿语境，接在新年祝福和欧洲团结之后

patterns.name: 荷兰语正式会见表达
patterns.context: 谈及某人近期在某场合出席或面对他人，处于句中

patterns.name: 英文书评中的时段词
patterns.context: 书籍宣传引文署名中，作为报纸名称的一部分出现
patterns.domain: 十九世纪英文出版物书评及书目

patterns.name: Go 赋值语法
patterns.context: Go 函数体内为局部变量分配切片

patterns.name: 匈牙利语称呼后的逗号
patterns.context: 议会发言中以“主席女士”称呼听众后接逗号

en.description: Activations span multilingual parliamentary speeches, Portuguese within-word fragments, and formal forms of address; they also occur in Go assignment initialization, Dutch policy compounds, and old-book layout. There is no single stable meaning.

patterns.name: Portuguese endings and within-word fragments
patterns.context: Portuguese words are split into multiple tokens; activation covers within-word fragments and common endings, with some instances in the middle or at the beginning of a sentence.
patterns.domain: EuroParl Portuguese speeches and StackExchange Portuguese Q&A

patterns.name: Multilingual parliamentary forms of address and polite speech
patterns.context: Formal forms of address to the chair, commissioners, or interlocutors in parliamentary speeches, as well as polite expressions and turn-taking phrases; prominent activation occurs near forms of address.
patterns.domain: EuroParl German, Dutch, and Portuguese parliamentary debates

patterns.name: Dutch honorific and affirmative expression
patterns.context: After addressing someone as “Mijnheer Solana,” the speaker expresses pleasure or agreement; activation falls on the honorific, pronouns, and emphatic expressions.

patterns.name: Assignment operator in Go standard-library code
patterns.context: Short variable declaration inside a Go function, followed by a make call and buffer initialization.

patterns.name: Buffer declaration in Go code
patterns.context: Creates a byte-slice buffer in a socket-options function; activation concentrates on the local variable and initialization statement.

patterns.name: Time word in an English book advertisement quotation
patterns.context: After publication information such as edition, cloth binding, and price, an English endorsement is attributed to the Morning Post; activation concentrates on Morning in the newspaper name.
patterns.domain: Gutenberg old-book advertisements or publication layout

patterns.name: Spanish “to say” and its complement
patterns.context: Expresses “I also wanted to say something about them”; the strongest activation is on the verb meaning to say or speak.

patterns.name: Punctuation in English Go documentation comments
patterns.context: A socket-function description sentence ends and a new line follows, immediately before a Go function declaration.

patterns.name: Dutch policy vocabulary and paternity leave
patterns.context: Discusses paternity leave and its connection to another type of parental leave; activation occurs within a compound policy term.

patterns.name: English layout and publication-information formatting
patterns.context: Book edition, binding, and price information are separated from quotations, attributions, and publication locations by decorative symbols and line breaks.

9_836.concept: 多语种分词与语境片段
9_836.description: 激活跨多语种议会发言、葡语词内片段及正式称呼，也见Go赋值初始化、荷兰语政策复合词和旧书版式；没有单一稳定词义。

patterns.name: 葡语词尾与词内片段
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语词被分成多个 token；激活覆盖词内片段及常见词尾，部分实例处于句中或句首。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 葡语发言及 StackExchange 葡语问答

patterns.name: 多语言议会称呼与礼貌发言
patterns.context: 议会发言中对主席、委员或对方的正式称呼，以及礼貌表达和发言转接语；称呼附近有突出激活。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 德语、荷兰语和葡语议会辩论

patterns.name: 荷兰语敬语与肯定表达
patterns.context: 以“Mijnheer Solana”称呼对方后，表达高兴或赞同；激活落在敬语、代词和强调性表达上。

patterns.name: Go 标准库代码中的赋值符
patterns.context: Go 函数体内短变量声明，后接 make 调用及缓冲区初始化。

patterns.name: Go 代码中的缓冲区声明
patterns.context: socket 选项函数中创建字节切片缓冲区；激活集中于局部变量及初始化语句。

patterns.name: 英文书籍广告引文中的时间词
patterns.context: 书籍版本、布面与价格等出版信息之后，英文推荐语署名为 Morning Post；激活集中在报纸名称中的 Morning。
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 旧书籍广告或出版物版面

patterns.name: 西班牙语“说”及其补语
patterns.context: 表达“我也想说一些关于它们的事”；激活最强处是表示说、讲的动词。

patterns.name: 英语 Go 文档注释中的标点
patterns.context: socket 函数说明句结束并换行，紧接 Go 函数声明。

patterns.name: 荷兰语政策词汇与父亲假期
patterns.context: 讨论父亲假期及其与另一类育儿假期的关联；激活位于复合政策术语内部。

patterns.name: 英文版面与出版信息格式
patterns.context: 书籍版本、装帧和价格信息与引文、署名、出版地之间以装饰符号和换行分隔。

en.concept: Multilingual word fragments and speech openings
en.description: Activations are scattered across languages and genres: Portuguese first-person speech verbs and expressions related to «Tenho» stand out most; other cases include parliamentary address formulas, common Dutch words, a fragment in an English newspaper name, and a buf assignment in Go code. They are difficult to explain with a single semantic or grammatical pattern.

patterns.name: «Tenho» and its following object
patterns.context: In Portuguese first-person statements or questions, followed by expressions of desire, opinion, inquiry, or topic introduction; strong activations concentrate on the verb stem or internal subword fragment, while the specific verbs differ across contexts.
patterns.domain: European Parliament speeches, Portuguese Q&A, and dialogue

patterns.name: Turning to a speech after a form of address
patterns.context: In formal parliamentary speeches, a form of address to the chair or members is followed by first-person speech content.

patterns.name: Dutch parliamentary speech formulas
patterns.context: Common words or phrase fragments in Dutch parliamentary speeches, used respectively to emphasize “very” and “recently”; no consistent local syntactic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Morning in English bibliographic text
patterns.context: Appears in the book-promotion quotation attribution «Morning Post», with activation on an internal fragment of the newspaper name.
patterns.domain: Gutenberg book advertisements or cover matter

patterns.name: Buffer initialization in technical text
patterns.context: Go code declares a byte-slice buffer and assigns a make call; the trigger is adjacent to the variable name and assignment operator.

9_836.concept: 多语种词片段及发言起始
9_836.description: 激活分散在多语种、多文体中：葡语一人称发言动词与“Tenho”相关表达最突出；另见议会称呼套语、荷兰语常见词、英语报纸名片段及Go代码的buf赋值，难以由单一语义或语法模式解释。

patterns.name: “Tenho”及其后续宾语
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语一人称陈述或提问中，后续接愿望、意见、提问或引出话题的表达；强激活集中在动词词干/词内子词片段，不同语境下具体动词并不相同。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会发言、葡萄牙语问答及对话

patterns.name: 称呼后转入发言
patterns.context: 正式议会发言中，向主席或议员致称呼后，接第一人称发言内容。

patterns.name: 荷兰语议会套语
patterns.context: 荷兰语议会演说中的常见词或词组片段，分别用于强调“非常”和“最近”；并未显示统一的局部句法条件。

patterns.name: 英语书目中的 Morning
patterns.context: 出现在书籍宣传语引文署名“Morning Post”中，激活落在报纸名称的词内片段。
patterns.domain: 古腾堡书籍广告或封面附文

patterns.name: 技术语句中的 buffer 初始化
patterns.context: Go 代码中声明字节切片缓冲区并赋予 make 调用；触发紧邻变量名及赋值符号。

en.concept: Intent and discourse organization in speech
en.description: Activations favor first-person expressions of desire or plans, speech transitions, and forms of address to the chair in Portuguese and Dutch parliamentary speeches. They also cover oral corrections, language explanations, book quotations, Go buffer code, and Dutch policy passages; these patterns are not fully unified.

patterns.name: Portuguese first-person expression of desire or inquiry
patterns.context: Portuguese verb gostaria (“would like”) is followed by de + infinitive to express a polite desire or question; it also occurs in “gostaria de dizer.”

patterns.name: Portuguese dizer “to say”
patterns.context: The verb dizer occurs in first-person parliamentary speech, followed respectively by “alguma coisa” and a “que” clause; in some contexts it is adjacent to the expression of desire with gostaria.

patterns.name: Transitions or evaluations in Portuguese political speeches
patterns.context: A parliamentary speech shifts to an additional opinion after stating an important event, or expresses surprise; this does not fully overlap with expressions of desire or speech verbs.

patterns.name: Portuguese forms of address to the chair and polite speech openings
patterns.context: The speaker addresses the presiding officer as “Madam/Sir President” before making a statement or expressing an intention; the core form of address and construction span languages, but the activating words differ.

patterns.name: Portuguese parliamentary term for oral alteration
patterns.context: Before a vote, a member announces a small oral alteration.

patterns.name: Portuguese word-meaning explanation and usage examples
patterns.context: The preceding text discusses a word's meaning in Angolan Portuguese and its prepositional collocation, then gives a first-person example sentence.

patterns.name: Dutch wil ik “I want to”
patterns.context: “wil ik” occurs after a time adverbial, expressing what the speaker will do next; it broadly resembles the expression of desire in Portuguese gostaria de.

patterns.name: Morning Post in an English book title and promotional quotation
patterns.context: A newspaper name and quotation appear in the publication information and endorsement layout of a 19th-century book.

patterns.name: Buffer initialization in Go code
patterns.context: Creates a byte-slice buffer with make inside the GetSockoptString function.

patterns.name: Dutch onlang(s) before a political name
patterns.context: A parliamentary sentence mentions something that recently happened to or was said by a political figure; activation concentrates on the time adverb and the following passage.

patterns.name: Dutch summary ending after addressing the chair
patterns.context: After “I will conclude,” the speaker addresses Madam President and continues speaking to the members.

patterns.name: Dutch sentence-initial relative or complement fragment
patterns.context: The passage continues the preceding text, expressing that something merits recognition within the framework of an initiative; the trigger does not clearly form a unified construction with the subsequent time expression.

9_836.concept: 发言中的意图与话语组织
9_836.description: 激活偏向葡语、荷兰语议会发言中的第一人称意愿/计划表达、发言转折及主席称呼，也涵盖口头修正、语言释义、书籍引文、Go 缓冲区代码和荷兰语政策语段；这些模式并非完全统一。

patterns.name: 葡语第一人称表达愿望或提问
patterns.trigger: «g»1«ost»7«aria»7« também»5« de»5 d«izer»10« alg»3«uma»5 co«isa»4；«G»2«ost»8«aria»6« de»5« saber»9
patterns.context: 葡语动词 gostaria（愿意、想要）后接 de + 不定式，表达礼貌愿望或询问；也出现于「gostaria de dizer」后。

patterns.name: 葡语 dizer「说」
patterns.context: 动词 dizer 出现在第一人称议会发言中，分别接「alguma coisa」及「que」从句；与 gostaria 的愿望表达在部分语境中相邻。

patterns.name: 葡语政治发言中的转折或评价
patterns.context: 议会发言中陈述重要事件后转入补充意见，或表达惊讶；与愿望、说话动词并不完全重合。

patterns.name: 葡语主席称呼及礼貌发言开头
patterns.trigger: «Sen»4«hor»4« Presidente»5«,»7« ten»9«ho»5« uma»2；«M»2«ev»3«rou»1«w»4« de»3« Voor»2«zitter»2«,»6« van»3«mor»2«gen»4« wil»9« ik»5
patterns.context: 以「主席女士/先生」称呼主持人后，开始陈述或表达意图；核心称呼、句型跨语言，但激活词不同。

patterns.name: 葡语 oral alteration 议事用语
patterns.context: 投票前议员宣布提出一项小的口头修正。

patterns.name: 葡语词义解释与用法举例
patterns.context: 前文讨论某词在安哥拉葡语中的含义及介词搭配，随后以第一人称句子举例。

patterns.name: 荷兰语 wil ik「我想要」
patterns.context: 时间状语之后出现「wil ik」，表达发言者接下来要做的事；与葡语 gostaria de 有宽泛的意愿表达相似。

patterns.name: 英语书名与宣传引文中的 Morning Post
patterns.context: 十九世纪书籍的出版信息和推荐语排版中，出现报纸名称及引用。

patterns.name: Go 代码中的缓冲区初始化
patterns.context: GetSockoptString 函数中用 make 创建 byte 切片缓冲区。

patterns.name: 荷兰语政治姓名前的 onlang(s)
patterns.context: 议会句子中提及某政治人物近期发生或表示的事情；激活集中在时间副词和其后续语段。

patterns.name: 荷兰语主席称呼后总结收尾
patterns.context: 「我将结束」之后称呼主席女士，并继续面向委员发言。

patterns.name: 荷兰语句首关系或补语片段
patterns.context: 句段开头延续前文，表示在某倡议框架内值得认可；触发部分与后续时间表达不构成明显统一句式。

en.concept: Word-initial subword fragments and formatting boundaries
en.description: Activation falls mainly on the word-initial subword fragments “Ser” and “Der,” alongside several newline and email-format fragments. Ser often occurs in biomedical vocabulary; Der occurs in German text and names. Other sporadic activations lack a consistent semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Word-initial subword fragment “Der”
patterns.context: At the beginning of German sentences or names/forms of address; both instances immediately follow a newline, and the latter is inside an email recipient’s name.
patterns.domain: German-language European Parliament text, Enron emails

patterns.name: Word-initial subword fragment “Ser”
patterns.context: At the beginning of English biomedical terms or proper nouns, followed by subword fragments forming Serine, Serodiagnosis, Serum, Ser608Leu, Serotonergic, Serotonin, and Serigne; the first five occur in PubMed/NIH-related text, and the last is a personal name.
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper titles/abstracts, NIH project text; also a Wikipedia personal name

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Social
patterns.context: At the beginning of a title or abstract, followed by a social-science topic phrase such as “influences in sports activity”.

patterns.name: Local patterns in email formatting
patterns.context: Email body endings, signatures, quoted display names, email addresses, dates, and other email-header formatting fragments. Activations are scattered across formatting symbols and name/address fragments.

patterns.name: Newline markers in body text
patterns.context: The newline itself is marked, occurring at line breaks in abstract body text and parliamentary records, and in blank lines after Wikipedia entry titles; the text following the newline varies.
patterns.domain: PubMed abstracts, European Parliament records, Wikipedia

patterns.name: Sporadic subword fragments without a clear pattern
patterns.context: Fragments occur inside German compounds, “Habits” in an English abstract, gene polymorphism markers, and proper nouns. Apart from word-initial fragments such as “Ser” or “Der,” no stable shared condition is apparent.

9_1610.concept: 词首子词元与格式边界
9_1610.description: 激活主要落在词首子词元“Ser”和“Der”，并伴随若干换行及邮件格式片段；Ser 多见于生物医学词汇，Der 见于德语文本与姓名，其他零散激活缺乏统一语义。

patterns.name: 词首子词元“Der”
patterns.context: 在德语句子或姓名/称呼开头；两处均紧接换行，后一处位于邮件收件人姓名内部。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会德语文本、Enron 邮件

patterns.name: 词首子词元“Ser”
patterns.context: 出现在英语生物医学词汇或专名开头，后续子词元分别组成 Serine、Serodiagnosis、Serum、Ser608Leu、Serotonergic、Serotonin、Serigne；前五个为 PubMed/NIH 相关文本，最后一个为人名。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文标题/摘要、NIH 项目文本；另有维基百科人名

patterns.name: 句首 Social
patterns.context: 标题或摘要开头，后接“influences in sports activity”等社会科学主题表述。

patterns.name: 邮件格式中的局部模式
patterns.context: 邮件正文结尾、签名、带引号的显示名、邮箱地址及日期等邮件头格式片段。激活分散在格式符号和姓名/地址片段上。

patterns.name: 正文中的换行标记
patterns.context: 换行本身被标记，出现在摘要正文换行、议会记录换行及维基百科条目标题后的空行；换行后文本不统一。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、欧洲议会记录、维基百科

patterns.name: 无法明确归纳的零散子词元
patterns.context: 分别处于德语复合词、英文摘要中的“Habits”、基因多态性标记及专名内部，除“Ser”或“Der”等词首片段外看不出稳定共同条件。
patterns.domain: 议会文本、PubMed 摘要、维基百科

en.concept: Word-initial Ser substring and structural boundaries
en.description: The most consistent cue is the word-initial substring “Ser,” spanning several biomedical terms and one personal name; other activations are scattered across line breaks, headings, names, email headers, and sports-activity phrases, with no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Word fragments beginning with Ser-
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on tokens beginning with the character/subword fragment Ser; consistent whole-word meaning is not required, and the following word forms vary widely.
patterns.domain: Mainly PubMed biomedical abstracts; also NIH research entries and a Wikipedia biography

patterns.name: Paragraph openings and heading/line-break structure
patterns.context: Activation occurs near line breaks, especially at structural boundaries such as paragraph openings, headings, names, or email headers; the triggering substring is not consistent.

patterns.name: Sports activity topic words
patterns.context: Phrases at the heading or sentence opening of abstracts about adolescent sports activity and leisure time.
patterns.domain: PubMed social and health research abstracts

patterns.name: German parliamentary headings and speakers
patterns.context: Headings and speaker/subsequent-agenda formatting in German parliamentary records.

patterns.name: Email sign-offs and headers
patterns.context: Quoted/forwarded email formatting, including sign-offs, sender, address, and timestamp.

9_1610.concept: 词首 Ser 子串及结构边界
9_1610.description: 激活最一致的线索是词首子串“Ser”，覆盖多种生物医学词及一个人名；其余激活分散在换行、标题、姓名、邮件头和体育活动短语中，未显示统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: Ser- 开头的词片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在以字符/子词片段 Ser 开始的 token 上；它并不要求完整词义一致，后续词形差异很大。
patterns.domain: 主要是 PubMed 生物医学摘要；另见 NIH 研究条目和 Wikipedia 人名

patterns.name: 段首与标题/换行结构
patterns.trigger: «↵» 及其后的标题或姓名开头，如 «H»«ab»（[1]）、«Der»（[2]）和邮件引用行中的 «best»、«D»（[3]）
patterns.context: 激活出现在换行附近，尤其是段首、标题、姓名或邮件头等结构边界；触发子串并不统一。
patterns.domain: 摘要、议会记录、电子邮件

patterns.name: sports activity 主题词
patterns.trigger: «in»« sports»« activity» 与 «among»« adolescents»；另有 «leisure»« time»« sports»« activity»
patterns.context: 围绕青少年体育活动及休闲时间的摘要标题/句首短语。
patterns.domain: PubMed 社会与健康研究摘要

patterns.name: 德语议会标题与发言人
patterns.context: 德语议会记录中的标题及发言人/后续议程格式。

patterns.name: 邮件署名与邮件头
patterns.trigger: «best» 后接 «Jim»，以及带引号的 «D»«il»«g»、«Joe»、邮箱地址和日期时间
patterns.context: 邮件引用/转发格式，含署名、发件人、地址与时间戳。

en.concept: Word-initial fragments and several isolated words
en.description: The most consistent pattern is a strong response to the word-initial fragment «Ser», found in various biomedical terms; there are also a few isolated responses: word-initial Der/Derrick, notable in a patent, and Habits in a sports-activity abstract.

patterns.name: Word-initial Ser- subword fragment
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on the token fragment «Ser», which continues into Serine, Serodiagnosis, Serum, Ser608, Serotonergic, and Serotonin. The context does not require a shared word meaning.
patterns.domain: Mainly PubMed biomedical abstracts; also NIH ExPorter

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Der in reports/transcribed text
patterns.context: A sentence- or line-initial word in German text; [3] is a parliamentary record, while [4] is the recipient name Derrick in an English email, split into «Der» and a subsequent fragment, possibly reflecting the same word-initial fragment rather than the German article.
patterns.domain: EuroParl German parliamentary records; Enron email headers

patterns.name: Phrases related to virtual and augmented reality
patterns.context: Appears in “Most notable are virtual and augmented reality systems,” emphasizing the category of systems being listed.

patterns.name: Physical activity topic phrase
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of an abstract about adolescent leisure-time sports activity; activation covers the in-word fragments «H», «ab», «its».

9_1610.concept: 词首片段及若干孤立词
9_1610.description: 最一致的模式是对词首片段 «Ser» 的强响应，见于多种生物医学词汇；另有少数孤立响应：Der/Derrick 词首、专利中的 notable、体育活动摘要中的 Habits。

patterns.name: 词首 Ser- 子词片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在 token 片段 «Ser»；后续分别组成 Serine、Serodiagnosis、Serum、Ser608、Serotonergic、Serotonin。上下文并不要求同一词义。
patterns.domain: 主要为 PubMed 生物医学摘要，也见 NIH ExPorter

patterns.name: 报告/转写文本中的段首 Der
patterns.context: 德语文本中作为句首或行首词；[3] 是议会记录，[4] 是英文邮件内的收件人姓名 Derrick 被切分为 «Der» 与后续片段，可能是同一词首片段而非德语冠词。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 德语议会记录；Enron 邮件头

patterns.name: 虚拟与增强现实相关短语
patterns.context: 出现在 “Most notable are virtual and augmented reality systems” 中，强调所列举系统类别。

patterns.name: 运动活动主题短语
patterns.context: 出现在关于青少年闲暇时间体育活动的摘要开头；激活覆盖词内片段 «H»、«ab»、«its»。

en.concept: Local word-form fragments and boundary markers
en.description: Activation is scattered across several local word forms and markers: biomedical examples consistently highlight initial Ser; code examples highlight XML tag openings; the rest involve sentence-initial Most, an internal fragment of Habits, and ’Twas in a Christmas poem.

patterns.name: Sentence-/word-initial Ser- subword fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls on words or subword fragments beginning with Ser, which continue into different words; in these examples, the fragment is at the start of the displayed context.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers on protein kinases, tuberculosis diagnosis, culturing, gene polymorphisms, and serotonin-related topics

patterns.name: XML tag opener
patterns.context: Tag openings in C# XML documentation comments; the “///” comment prefix is also marked.

patterns.name: Was in an idiom
patterns.context: The opening of the Christmas poem “’Twas the Night Before Christmas,” with an apostrophe contraction and a proper noun.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Most
patterns.context: A sentence begins with Most, followed by notable, then introduces virtual- and augmented-reality systems.

patterns.name: Internal fragment of Habits
patterns.context: After a paragraph break, a new sentence begins “Habits of leisure time sports activity”; activation falls on a trailing subword fragment.
patterns.domain: Medical abstract on adolescent sports activity

9_1610.concept: 局部词形片段与边界标记
9_1610.description: 激活分散在多类局部词形与标记上：生物医学例子共同突出词首 Ser；代码例子突出 XML 标签起始；其余分别是句首 Most、Habits 的词内片段和圣诞诗句中的 ’Twas。

patterns.name: 句首/词首 Ser- 子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在以 Ser 开头的词或子词片段上，后续拼成不同词；这些例子中该片段都位于所示上下文起始处。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文，涉及蛋白激酶、结核诊断、培养、基因多态性及血清素相关内容

patterns.name: XML 标签起始符
patterns.context: C# XML 文档注释中的标签起始；同时标记“///”注释前缀。

patterns.name: 习语中的 Was
patterns.context: 圣诞诗句“’Twas the Night Before Christmas”的开头，带撇号缩写与专名。

patterns.name: Most 句首词
patterns.context: 句子中以 Most 起始，后接 notable，随后引出虚拟现实与增强现实系统。

patterns.name: Habits 词内片段
patterns.context: 段落换行后新句以“Habits of leisure time sports activity”开头，激活落在词尾子词片段。
patterns.domain: 青少年体育活动的医学论文摘要

en.concept: Word-initial Ser substring and a few heterogeneous patterns
en.description: The main response is to the word-initial substring Ser, covering biomedical terms and personal names; there are also value/? in a mathematical context and an independent activation in a Christmas poem, which the main pattern cannot explain.

patterns.name: Ser-initial protein/biomedical tokens
patterns.context: Activation falls on words or word fragments beginning with Ser; the continuation can form serine, serotonin, serum, protein-variant markers, and other forms, not all in the same type of context.
patterns.domain: Biomedical texts, research abstracts, and NIH data

patterns.name: Ser-initial names or proper nouns
patterns.context: Activation occurs at the beginning of proper nouns; activation also appears at line breaks following names in Wikipedia entries.

patterns.name: value in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: In math problems or expression fragments, activation appears around value and a question mark; there is no clear connection to Ser- forms.

patterns.name: Christmas poem title and text
patterns.context: Activation occurs across multiple words in the set line “’Twas the Night Before Christmas” and the explanatory text that follows.

9_1610.concept: 词首 Ser 子串及少数异质模式
9_1610.description: 主要响应词首子串 Ser，涵盖生物医学词与人名；另有数学语境的 value/? 及圣诞诗句的独立激活，无法由主模式统一解释。

patterns.name: Ser- 开头的蛋白质/生物医学词元
patterns.context: 激活落在以 Ser 开头的词或词片段上；后续内容可构成 serine、serotonin、serum、蛋白变异标记等，并非都在同一类语境。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、论文摘要及 NIH 数据

patterns.name: Ser- 开头的人名或专名
patterns.context: 激活位于专名开头；维基条目中名字后的换行处也出现激活。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的 value
patterns.context: 数学题目或表达式片段中，激活在 value 和问号附近；与 Ser- 词形无明显联系。

patterns.name: 圣诞诗标题与文本
patterns.context: 固定诗句 “’Twas the Night Before Christmas” 及其后续说明文字中有激活，分布在多个词上。

en.concept: Stems in technical terms and melt
en.description: Activation concentrates on “rhe”-related words (including rheology and rheumatic) and melt; there are also patterns involving conjunctival, punctuation in a coal-waste passage, citation/quantity punctuation, place-name segmentation, and sporadic technical terms.

patterns.name: rheology-related terminology
patterns.context: The token sequence beginning «rhe» receives the strongest activation in medical, food-science, and biomedical prose; it appears in rheology terms and in “rheumatic.”

patterns.name: melt
patterns.context: The word “melt” is activated in contexts about resistance to melting, heat, glacial meltwater, and melt emulsification.
patterns.domain: Food science, literary prose, geology, and patents

patterns.name: conjunctival
patterns.context: A specific anatomical term in a scientific title about the bacterial flora of cats.

patterns.name: coal-waste context
patterns.context: Activation peaks on punctuation following an abbreviation for coal combustion waste, within discussion of ash ponds and regulation.

patterns.name: quantity punctuation
patterns.context: Comma and closing-parenthesis tokens are strongly activated in a bibliographic citation and a parenthetical population range.
patterns.domain: Patent prose and informal city description

patterns.name: city-name tokenization
patterns.context: Unusual segmented place-name and stylized spelling in an informal passage about Asheville; no clear link to the scientific or lexical patterns.

patterns.name: miscellaneous scientific terms
patterns.context: Technical vocabulary appears in scientific or patent passages, but these tokens do not form a consistent shared trigger beyond technical subject matter.

9_1610.concept: 技术词中的词干与 melt
9_1610.description: 激活集中在“rhe”相关词（含 rheology 与 rheumatic）和 melt；另有 conjunctival、煤废弃物段落中的标点、引用/数量标点、地名切分及零散技术词模式。

patterns.name: rheology-related terminology
patterns.context: The token sequence beginning «rhe» receives the strongest activation in medical, food-science, and biomedical prose; it appears in rheology terms and in “rheumatic.”

patterns.name: melt
patterns.context: The word “melt” is activated in contexts about resistance to melting, heat, glacial meltwater, and melt emulsification.
patterns.domain: Food science, literary prose, geology, and patents

patterns.name: conjunctival
patterns.context: A specific anatomical term in a scientific title about the bacterial flora of cats.

patterns.name: coal-waste context
patterns.context: Activation peaks on punctuation following an abbreviation for coal combustion waste, within discussion of ash ponds and regulation.

patterns.name: quantity punctuation
patterns.context: Comma and closing-parenthesis tokens are strongly activated in a bibliographic citation and a parenthetical population range.
patterns.domain: Patent prose and informal city description

patterns.name: city-name tokenization
patterns.context: Unusual segmented place-name and stylized spelling in an informal passage about Asheville; no clear link to the scientific or lexical patterns.

patterns.name: miscellaneous scientific terms
patterns.context: Technical vocabulary appears in scientific or patent passages, but these tokens do not form a consistent shared trigger beyond technical subject matter.

en.description: In most passages, activation falls on melt: including melting, fusion, meltwater, melting reactions, and the political decline or figurative dissolution expressed by melt down. In passage 7, activation falls on AND in a title, which this account does not explain.

patterns.name: melt and its compound forms
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on the word melt, covering melting of ice and snow, materials melting when heated, political decline, and figurative dissolution. The specific meaning varies by context.
patterns.domain: News, encyclopedias, patent technology, chemistry, literature

patterns.name: Uppercase AND
patterns.context: The all-caps word appears in the title-like phrase “DEVELOPMENT AND APPLICATIONS OF NEW PROBES”; there is no nearby melt trigger.
patterns.domain: NIH project title or database text

9_1610.description: 绝大多数片段中，激活落在 melt：包括融化、熔化、融水、熔融反应，以及 melt down 的政治衰退或比喻消融。第7段则激活标题中的 AND，无法由此解释。

patterns.name: melt 及其复合形式
patterns.context: 激活集中在 melt 一词上；涵盖冰雪融化、材料受热熔化、政治衰退及比喻性的消融。具体含义随上下文变化。
patterns.domain: 新闻、百科、专利技术、化学、文学

patterns.name: 大写 AND
patterns.context: 全大写词出现在项目标题式短语 “DEVELOPMENT AND APPLICATIONS OF NEW PROBES” 中；没有邻近 melt 触发。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目标题或数据库文本

en.description: High activations are scattered across domains and semantic content, often falling on specific fragments of words, abbreviations, or symbols (such as AP, ys, NGO, ≲, Beer, Ecosystem, inveterate). No stable shared semantic or syntactic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Strong activation on fixed phrases and at word boundaries
patterns.context: Activation falls on specific fragments of complete words, abbreviations, or multi-subword forms; some are internal suffixes/fragments, while others are standalone words or symbols. These examples alone do not establish a unified contextual or semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: emails, parliamentary text, social and scientific articles, fiction, encyclopedias, and web text

9_1610.concept: 词汇/子词片段检测（暂定）
9_1610.description: 高激活分散在不同领域和语义内容中，常落在词语、缩写或符号的特定片段（如AP、ys、NGO、≲、Beer、Ecosystem、inveterate）；未见稳定的共同语义或句法触发条件。

patterns.name: 固定语块与词边界处的强激活
patterns.context: 激活落在完整词、缩写或多子词词形的特定片段上；有些是词内后缀/词片，有些是独立词或符号。仅凭这些例子无法确定统一的上下文语义条件。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：邮件、议会文本、社会与科学文章、小说、百科及网页文本

en.description: Activation is scattered across several text types, with emphasis on uppercase emphasis WILL and uppercase names or proper nouns segmented into subwords. It also responds strongly to isolated fragments such as accused, island, C.S.I., and mimic, without a unified semantic or stylistic condition.

patterns.name: Uppercase WILL
patterns.context: Emphatic uppercase WILL appears within sentences, expressing prediction, intent, or a name-spelling fragment in legal opinions; its position is not fixed.
patterns.domain: Forums, legal text, religious emails, business emails

patterns.name: Uppercase HADIT／HADITU
patterns.context: A segmented form of the uppercase proper noun HADITU in historical narrative, in sentences describing its influence or control.

patterns.name: Continuous uppercase fragments in personal names
patterns.context: Names in legal documents are segmented into subwords, with name components shown as uppercase fragments; WILLIAM is especially prominent in two legal passages.

patterns.name: Identity or label terms
patterns.context: A first-person occupational statement describes helping people accused of crimes cope with charges.

patterns.name: Geographic term island
patterns.context: An English learner discusses Japanese history and states in a simple sentence that Japan is an island country.

patterns.name: Abbreviated title / media marker
patterns.context: An abbreviation in an article title or site name, followed by content about a bank-card skimmer.

patterns.name: Neuroscience term fragment
patterns.context: Discusses whether an electronic nose imitates neural architecture when comparing it with biological olfaction.

9_1610.description: 激活分散于多类文本，集中涉及大写强调 WILL、按子词切分的大写人名或专名；另对 accused、island、C.S.I.、mimic 等孤立词片段强烈响应，缺少统一语义或文体条件。

patterns.name: 大写 WILL
patterns.context: 大写强调的 WILL 出现在句中，表达预测、意愿或法律意见中的姓名拼写片段；触发位置并不固定。
patterns.domain: 论坛、法律文本、宗教邮件、商务邮件

patterns.name: 大写 HADIT／HADITU
patterns.context: 历史叙述中大写专名 HADITU 的分词形式，位于描述其影响力或控制力的句子中。

patterns.name: 人名拼写中的连续大写片段
patterns.context: 法律文书的人名按子词切分，姓名部分以大写片段呈现；WILLIAM 在两个法律段落中尤为突出。

patterns.name: 身份或标签词
patterns.context: 第一人称职业自述中，描述帮助被控犯罪者应对指控。
patterns.domain: 个人简介、法律职业自述

patterns.name: 地理词 island
patterns.context: 英语学习者谈日本历史时，以简单句说明日本是岛国。
patterns.domain: 非正式、学习者英语叙述

patterns.name: 缩写标题／媒体标记
patterns.context: 文章标题或站点名中的缩写，后接关于银行卡 skimmer 的内容。

patterns.name: 神经科学术语片段
patterns.context: 比较电子鼻与生物嗅觉系统时，讨论其是否模仿神经架构。

en.concept: Function words and common word fragments across domains
en.description: Activation spans multiple genres and topics, often falling near determiners and common function words. Other patterns include fixed patent phrasing, religious vocabulary, institutional/legal entities, and news and speech fragments; no single stable semantic theme is apparent.

patterns.name: Determiner DET and tail
patterns.context: Triggers often fall near determiners; in passage 1, DET and AIL are marked as separate fragments, which does not establish a specific word meaning.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A; also patent, academic, and legal text

patterns.name: Fixed phrasing in patent claims
patterns.context: Chemical patents describe materials, processes, or components using patent-style enumeration.

patterns.name: Theological and religious discourse
patterns.context: Discusses divinity, creation, God, or biblical narratives.

patterns.name: Describing group membership and background
patterns.context: States the composition, expertise, or background of an organization’s or committee’s members.

patterns.name: Drug development and synthesis
patterns.context: Describes ADC plans, quantities of drug materials, and synthesis requirements.

patterns.name: Trusts and institutions in legal documents
patterns.context: Formal legal narrative describing the management and payment of entities, joint offices, and trust funds.

patterns.name: Historical/speech-like exhortation and insulting commands
patterns.context: Addresses an audience in a classical oratorical style, with humiliating commands or mockery.
patterns.domain: Historical political speech or literary quotation

patterns.name: News caption and land-conservation issues
patterns.context: Local news caption mentioning horseback riders, a location, and congressional reauthorization of a fund.

patterns.name: Protocol/message formats and XML
patterns.context: Discusses message types or checks whether DETAILS contains XML; the specific trigger relates to formatting fragments.

patterns.name: Wording about servitude, freedom, and peace
patterns.context: Uses rhetorical contrast to discuss servitude, freedom, and departure; its clear commonality with the other passages is uncertain.

9_1610.concept: 多领域文本中的功能词及常见词片段
9_1610.description: 激活分布于多种文体与主题，常落在限定词及常见功能词附近；另有专利固定措辞、宗教词汇、机构/法律实体，以及新闻和演说片段，未见单一稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: 冠词/限定词 DET 与尾部
patterns.context: 触发常落在限定词附近；第1段中 DET 与 AIL 被拆分标记，不能据此确定具体词义。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答；也见专利、学术及法律文本

patterns.name: 专利权利要求的固定措辞
patterns.context: 化学专利描述材料、工艺或组分，出现专利式枚举措辞。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景/技术文本

patterns.name: 神学与宗教论述
patterns.context: 讨论神性、创造、神或圣经叙事。
patterns.domain: 宗教哲学与基督教论述
