patterns.name: 描述群体成员与背景
patterns.context: 陈述组织或委员会的成员构成、专长或背景。
patterns.domain: NIH 研究项目/机构文本

patterns.name: 药物研发与合成
patterns.context: 说明 ADC 方案、药物材料用量及合成需求。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究计划文本

patterns.name: 法律文件中的信托与机构
patterns.context: 正式法律叙述，说明实体、联合办公室及信托基金的管理和付款。

patterns.name: 历史/演说式劝诫与侮辱性命令
patterns.context: 以古典演说口吻劝诫受众，并带有屈辱性的命令或讥讽。
patterns.domain: 历史性政治演说或文学引文

patterns.name: 新闻图片说明与土地保护议题
patterns.context: 地方新闻图片说明，提及骑马者、地点及国会重新授权基金。
patterns.domain: 地方新闻/公共土地政策

patterns.name: 协议/消息格式与 XML
patterns.context: 讨论消息类型或检查 DETAILS 是否包含 XML；具体触发与格式化片段有关。

patterns.name: servitude、自由与和平措辞
patterns.context: 以修辞性对照谈奴役、自由及离去；与其余段落的明确共同点不清。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 文学或历史性文本

en.description: Activation is scattered across multiple genres, often falling on internal word fragments, uppercase names, or title words. Other sporadic patterns involve function words in formal text, pronouns in quotations, numbers, and list formatting, making it difficult to identify a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: Internal word fragments and suffixes
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on contiguous or adjacent letter fragments within words, often stems, endings, or participial forms of longer words; these occur in different contexts.

patterns.name: Uppercase names and legal citation formatting
patterns.context: Names appear in all caps or segmented uppercase, often alongside initials, commas, periods, or list formatting; examples include court personnel and names in book catalogs.

patterns.name: State names and uppercase words in headings
patterns.context: All-caps words, state names, or company names appear in news headlines or page headers; uppercase forms may co-occur with internal word segmentation.

patterns.name: Function words and conventional expressions in formal style
patterns.context: Connectives, articles, and conventional legal phrases in formal or institutional text are marked; triggers are scattered, with no single fixed collocation apparent.

patterns.name: Incomplete or unusual word-form fragments
patterns.context: Long words are segmented into letter fragments, with activation on internal substrings; some fragments may be parts of word forms rather than standalone words.

patterns.name: Personal pronouns and negative contractions in dialogue
patterns.context: Direct quotations embedded in news reports, where pronouns or negative contractions are marked; this pattern has only one example.

patterns.name: Numbers and list formatting
patterns.context: Activation appears near years, numbers, indentation, and short name fragments in lists or catalog entries.

9_1610.description: 激活分散于多种文体，常落在词内字母片段、全大写姓名或标题词；另有正式文本功能词、引语代词、数字及列表排版等零散模式，难以归为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 词内字母片段与后缀
patterns.context: 激活集中在词内部连续或相邻的字母片段，常是较长词的词干、词尾或分词形式；在不同上下文中均出现。

patterns.name: 大写姓名及法律引文排版
patterns.context: 姓名以全大写或分段大写显示，常伴随姓名缩写、逗号、句点或名单式排版；包括法院人员姓名及书籍目录姓名。

patterns.name: 州名及标题中的大写词
patterns.context: 新闻标题或页眉中出现全大写词、州名或公司名称；大写形态和词内分段可能共同出现。

patterns.name: 正式语体中的功能词与惯用表达
patterns.context: 较正式或机构化文本中的连接词、冠词和司法惯用表达被标记；触发较分散，未见单一固定搭配。

patterns.name: 残缺或不寻常的词形片段
patterns.context: 长词被拆成字母片段，激活落在内部子串；部分片段可能是词形的一部分而非独立词。

patterns.name: 对话中的人称代词及否定缩写
patterns.context: 新闻报道中嵌入直接引语，代词或否定缩写被标记；本模式样本仅一段。

patterns.name: 数字与条目式排版
patterns.context: 列表或目录条目中的年份、编号、缩进和短姓名片段附近出现激活。

en.concept: Recognition of headings and in-word fragments
en.description: Activation often falls on in-word subword fragments, especially religious words in headings and tables of contents; other examples cover legal authority, emphatic emails, spiritual philosophy, organizational descriptions, and publication titles, with no single stable semantics.

patterns.name: Religious words in headings
patterns.context: Religious terms appear in book contents, chapter headings, or academic titles, often alongside science, ethics, mythology, and related topics.
patterns.domain: Book titles, tables of contents, and academic texts

patterns.name: Letter fragments within tokenized words
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal subword fragments of whole words, not only religious terms; also seen in “POETRY,” “ECONOMY,” and “COME.”

patterns.name: Legal authority and judicial review
patterns.context: Legal discussion of authority, statutory provisions, and court review.

patterns.name: Emphatic all-caps requests
patterns.context: Emails use all caps in a forceful or emphatic tone and include requests or commands.

patterns.name: Divinity and metaphysical experience
patterns.context: Discussion of divine experience, monism, and the manifestation of creation.

patterns.name: Activity descriptions of an anti-poverty organization
patterns.context: Description of the organization’s members, policy discussions, cooperation, and outreach activities.

patterns.name: Bibliographic titles and publication information
patterns.context: Layout content from book or journal title pages and tables of contents, including journal names, volume numbers, or dates.

9_1610.description: 激活常落在词内子词片段，尤其是标题和目录中的宗教词；其余样例还覆盖法律权限、强调式邮件、灵性哲学、机构介绍及出版标题等，未见单一稳定语义。

patterns.name: 标题中的宗教词
patterns.context: 书籍目录、章节标题或学术标题中出现宗教相关词，常与科学、伦理、神话等并列
patterns.domain: 书籍标题、目录及学术文本

patterns.name: 分词内部的字母片段
patterns.context: 激活落在完整词的内部子词片段，并非只限宗教词；也见于“POETRY”“ECONOMY”“COME”等词

patterns.name: 法律权限与司法审查
patterns.context: 法律论述中讨论权限、法律条文及法院审查

patterns.name: 强调式大写请求
patterns.trigger: “YOU BETTER BACK OFF”“YOU SHOULD BE ASKING”“COME VISIT”
patterns.context: 邮件中使用全大写，语气强硬或强调，并包含请求、命令

patterns.name: 神性与形而上体验
patterns.context: 讨论神性体验、一元论及创造显现

patterns.name: 反贫困组织的活动描述
patterns.context: 介绍组织成员、政策交流、合作与联络活动

patterns.name: 书目标题及出版信息
patterns.context: 书籍或期刊扉页、目录等排版内容，含刊名、卷号或日期

en.description: Activation is scattered across different word forms and legal, academic, catalog, and commentary contexts. Some peaks fall on internal fragments of words such as quant, maxim, and RELIGIOUS; others occur on words such as jurisdiction, license, apply, and conducted. No unified semantic or syntactic pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Internal re- / renewed change
patterns.context: Occurs in a narrative describing a tropical cyclone changing intensity again; the internal fragments involve the re- prefix and intensify.

patterns.name: Quantification and measurement word forms
patterns.context: The trigger falls on the quant- stem in statements about quantifying data or genetic effects.

patterns.name: Maximization word form
patterns.context: The trigger falls on the maxim- stem in a sentence about using resources efficiently and avoiding waste.

patterns.name: Jurisdiction
patterns.context: A legal provision addresses whether a court has authority to review a certain type of administrative or removal decision.

patterns.name: Rights granted by a software license
patterns.context: An open-source license lists the rights to use, copy, modify, distribute, and sublicense software.

patterns.name: Internal fragment in a catalog heading
patterns.context: Activation concentrates inside the segmented word RELIGIOUS, which appears in an all-caps, catalog-style section heading.

patterns.name: Provision does not apply
patterns.context: A regulation uses shall not apply to state that a provision does not apply in a specific situation, followed by conditions relating to parents or guardians.

patterns.name: Conducting an experiment
patterns.context: Describes how an experimental procedure is carried out; here, an RHI session is conducted without metronome sounds.

patterns.name: Internal fragment of abstract
patterns.context: In discussing whether political influence should be considered abstractly, strong activation falls on think; abstract has only weaker internal-fragment activation.

9_1610.description: 激活分散在不同词形和法律、学术、目录及评论语境中；部分高点落在 quant、maxim、RELIGIOUS 等词内片段，也有 jurisdiction、license、apply、conducted 等词，未见统一语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 词内 re- / 重新变化
patterns.context: 出现在描述热带气旋强度再次变化的叙述中；词内片段涉及 re- 前缀及 intensify。

patterns.name: 量化与测量词形
patterns.context: 触发点落在 quant- 词干，出现在说明对数据或遗传影响进行量化的语句中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学与遗传学论文

patterns.name: 最大化词形
patterns.context: 触发点落在 maxim- 词干，句子谈及高效利用资源、避免浪费。

patterns.name: 司法管辖权
patterns.context: 在法律条文中，法院是否有权审查某类行政或移除决定。

patterns.name: 软件许可授予权利
patterns.context: 开源许可文本列举使用、复制、修改、分发及再许可软件的权利。

patterns.name: 目录标题中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在分词标注的 RELIGIOUS 一词内部；该词出现在目录式大写章节标题中。

patterns.name: 条款不适用
patterns.context: 法规以 shall not apply 表述某条款不适用于特定情形，后接父母或监护人相关条件。

patterns.name: 实验实施
patterns.context: 描述实验环节如何进行；此处为在无节拍器声条件下实施 RHI session。

patterns.name: 抽象一词的内部片段
patterns.context: 在讨论是否应以抽象方式思考政治影响时，强激活落在 think；abstract 仅有较弱的内部片段激活。

en.description: Activation spans several text types: the scope of legal provisions, case citations, and statutory interpretation; experimental conditions, service quality, and research methods in medical studies; and sports quotations and descriptions of tropical cyclone development. No single semantic pattern runs through all the corpora.

patterns.name: Negative applicability in legal provisions
patterns.context: A legal provision states that a rule does not apply to specific people or circumstances, often near words such as section, parents, and persons.

patterns.name: Legal case citations
patterns.context: Volume numbers, reporter abbreviations, page numbers, and years in case citations, mixing digits and abbreviations.

patterns.name: Interpretation of legal provisions and legislative intent
patterns.context: Discussion of state and local legislative authority, or inference of legislative intent from statutory wording.

patterns.name: Experimental conditions in medical research
patterns.context: Research abstracts describe experimental setups, differences in conditions, and their effects on study results.

patterns.name: Quality standards for medical services
patterns.context: Lists quality principles such as timeliness, efficiency, and resource use in medical services.

patterns.name: Methods in medical services research
patterns.context: Research abstracts introduce healthcare settings, research methods, and fieldwork.

patterns.name: Inspirational tone in sports figures’ quotations
patterns.context: Quotes a baseball figure discussing Jackie Robinson Day and inspiring others with courage and overcoming fear.

patterns.name: Description of meteorological processes
patterns.context: Chronological account of cyclone development, such as a tropical depression strengthening into a tropical storm.

9_1610.description: 激活覆盖多类文本：法律条文的适用范围、判例引注与立法解释；医学研究的实验条件、服务质量和研究方法；另见体育引语及热带气旋演变描述。没有贯穿所有语料的单一词义模式。

patterns.name: 法律条文中的否定适用
patterns.context: 法律条文规定某项规定不适用于特定人或情况，常邻近 section、parents、persons 等词。

patterns.name: 法律判例引注
patterns.context: 判例引用中的卷号、报告集缩写、页码和年份，包含数字与缩写的混排。

patterns.name: 法律条文解释与立法意图
patterns.context: 讨论州与地方政府立法权，或通过条文措辞推断立法意图。

patterns.name: 医疗研究中的实验条件
patterns.context: 研究摘要描述实验安排、条件差异及其对研究结果的影响。

patterns.name: 医疗服务质量标准
patterns.context: 列举医疗服务的及时性、效率及资源使用等质量原则。

patterns.name: 医疗服务研究方法
patterns.context: 研究摘要介绍医疗服务情境、研究方法和实地工作。

patterns.name: 体育人物引语中的鼓舞语气
patterns.context: 引述棒球人物谈论 Jackie Robinson Day，并以勇气和克服恐惧鼓舞他人。

patterns.name: 气象过程描述
patterns.context: 按时间顺序叙述热带低压增强为热带风暴等气旋演变。

en.concept: Wording on legal scope of application
en.description: Primarily responds to wording in legal provisions that limits scope or excludes applicability, as well as fixed process-description phrasing in patents. There are also sporadic activations on UN and IG letter fragments in uppercase headings or inside words.

patterns.name: Applicability/non-applicability wording in legal provisions
patterns.context: Legal provisions specify which people or situations a provision or law applies to, or exclude certain subjects; common collocates include section, provisions, persons, and insurers.

patterns.name: Process descriptions in patent text
patterns.context: This fixed phrase introduces a process or measurement step, near words such as measuring, manufacturing, deformation, and strain.

patterns.name: Segmented UN fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls on the contiguous letters UN inside a word, rather than on an obvious semantic unit; examples occur in a publication title and the word for a community.

patterns.name: Word-initial fragment in headings
patterns.context: Activation corresponds to the letters IG inside English words, surrounded by catalog headings or uppercase subheadings; the specific semantics vary.

9_1610.description: 主要响应法律条文中限定适用范围或排除适用的措辞，以及专利中的固定工艺描述句式；另对若干大写标题或词内的 UN、IG 字母片段有零散激活。

patterns.name: 法律条文中的适用／不适用措辞
patterns.context: 法律规定说明某条款或法律适用于哪些人或情形、或排除哪些对象；常与 section、provisions、persons、insurers 等搭配。

patterns.name: 专利文本中的过程描述
patterns.context: 以该固定句式引出工艺或测量步骤，附近出现 measuring、manufacturing、deformation、strain 等词。

patterns.name: UN 的分词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在词中连续的 UN 字母片段，而非明显的语义单位；分别出现在通讯刊名、社区一词中。

patterns.name: 标题中的词首片段
patterns.context: 激活对应英文词内部的 IG 字母片段，周边是目录标题或大写小标题；具体语义不一致。

en.description: Activation mainly falls on maxim- forms, not/apply and provision in legal provisions, and decompensated in medical terminology; there are also sporadic heading tokenization, hospital names, and quantitative measurement triggers.

patterns.name: maximize/maximally forms
patterns.context: The stem maxim takes -ally or -ise, expressing maximizing or doing something as much as possible; appears in sentences or technical descriptions.
patterns.domain: Medical research, healthcare quality, machine learning

patterns.name: Applicability and negation in legal provisions
patterns.context: In legal clauses, exceptions, or statements of legislative intent, the negator not appears next to verbs such as apply/have or in a continuous phrase with them.

patterns.name: decompensated in medical terminology
patterns.context: decompensated is split into subword tokens; it describes both worsening mental state and heart failure.

patterns.name: provision in legal texts
patterns.context: Refers to a legal rule or clause in statutes or judicial opinions.

patterns.name: JACK spelling split in a heading
patterns.context: In a table-of-contents-style chapter heading, the name JACK is split into multiple tokens and listed alongside story chapter titles.

patterns.name: Swiss university hospital names
patterns.context: Institution names recur in lists of university hospital affiliations from several Swiss cities.

patterns.name: Quantitative measurement in medical research
patterns.context: Describes instrument-based detection and quantification of exosomes; activation falls on the stem of quantifies.

patterns.name: Statements about evidence and scientific knowledge
patterns.context: Describes providing services based on scientific knowledge and evidence-based guidelines; maximises also appears in the passage.

9_1610.description: 激活主要落在 maxim- 词形、法律条文中的 not/apply、provision，以及医学术语 decompensated；另有零散的标题分词、医院名称和量化检测触发。

patterns.name: maximize/maximally 词形
patterns.context: 词干 maxim 后接 -ally 或 -ise，表达最大化、尽可能多地；出现在句中或技术描述中。
patterns.domain: 医学研究、医疗质量、机器学习

patterns.name: 法律条文中的适用与否定
patterns.trigger: « not»6« apply»10（2）；« does»1« not»6« apply»8（4）；« would»4« not»7« have»9（10）
patterns.context: 法律文本的条款、例外或立法意图表述中，否定词 not 与 apply/have 等动词相邻或形成连续短语。

patterns.name: 医学术语中的 decompensated
patterns.context: decompensated 被拆分成子词 token；分别用于描述精神状态恶化和心力衰竭。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的 provision
patterns.context: 法律条文或司法意见中指法律规定、条款。

patterns.name: 标题中的 JACK 拼写分块
patterns.context: 目录式章节标题中，人名 JACK 被拆分为多个 token，并与故事章节标题并列。

patterns.name: 瑞士大学医院名称
patterns.context: 多个瑞士城市的大学医院署名列表中，机构名称重复出现。

patterns.name: 医学研究中的量化检测
patterns.context: 描述仪器检测并量化外泌体，激活落在 quantifies 的词干部分。

patterns.name: 证据与科学知识表述
patterns.trigger: «prov»4iding services« based»1 on scientific« knowledge»2 and evidence‐based« guidelines»1（3）
patterns.context: 介绍以科学知识和循证指南为基础提供服务；此段还同时出现 maximises。

en.description: Activations occur across many types of contexts: legal clauses on non-applicability, obligations, and liability; split word fragments; prompts to think or recall; and sporadic content from medical, diplomatic, email, and business reporting. No single semantic pattern explains all passages.

patterns.name: Negative or exception clauses
patterns.context: Legal text describing a clause as inapplicable, commonly using the structure not apply or shall not apply; another passage contains not required.

patterns.name: Legal contract obligations and clause references
patterns.context: Contracts or legal provisions stating that a party is bound by contract terms, or citing clauses, provisions, or contractual relationships.

patterns.name: Split word forms/subword fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on morpheme fragments inside Swedish words and letter fragments in English uppercase headings; these are not complete words.
patterns.domain: Swedish news/diplomatic texts, email subject lines, news headlines

patterns.name: Prompts to think in quotations or appeals
patterns.context: In advice or political rhetoric, think appears in contexts asking readers/listeners to imagine something, pause to think, or recall something.

patterns.name: Reminding someone of something
patterns.context: An event as subject evokes a word or meaning for someone.

patterns.name: Frustration with and relief from automated phone systems
patterns.context: Describes frustration caused by an automated phone system, then shifts to imagining the relief of being rid of it.

patterns.name: Delivery of diplomatic documents
patterns.context: In Swedish reporting, the subject submits a memorandum, document, or proposal to Chinese authorities; high activation falls on a fragment within läm-nade.

patterns.name: Legal proof and immunization
patterns.context: Legal provisions use a doctor's certificate or public health authority confirmation as proof of immunization; activations are weak and scattered.

patterns.name: Accidental conduct in negligence liability
patterns.context: Discusses whether teachers must anticipate the various everyday accidents and related risks involving students.

patterns.name: Subject line for a revised settlement agreement
patterns.context: An email subject line uses an uppercase, split-marked word to indicate that an agreement draft has been revised and to request that earlier versions be disregarded.

patterns.name: Healthcare company and margins
patterns.context: Business reporting assesses a company's health in its industry and mentions price increases and margins.

9_1610.description: 激活分布于多类语境：法律中的不适用、义务和责任条款；拆分词片段；劝人思考或回想；以及医疗、外交、邮件和商业报道等零散内容。无单一语义模式能解释全部段落。

patterns.name: 否定或例外条款
patterns.context: 法律文本中描述某条款不适用，常见结构为 not apply，或 shall not apply；另有一段含 not required。

patterns.name: 法律合同义务与条款列举
patterns.context: 合同或法律条文中说明一方受合同条款约束，或援引条款、规定、合同关系。

patterns.name: 被拆分的词形/子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在瑞典语词内部的词素片段、英文大写标题中的字母片段；并非完整词。
patterns.domain: 瑞典语新闻/外交文本、邮件标题、新闻标题

patterns.name: 引述或呼吁中的思考提示
patterns.context: 劝告或政治修辞中，think 出现在要求读者/听者设想、停顿思考或回顾某事的语境。

patterns.name: 使某人想起或提醒
patterns.trigger: « reminds»1« him»1 of« the»1« word»1« courage»2
patterns.context: 主语事件使人联想到某个词或意义。

patterns.name: 自动语音电话带来的挫折与宽慰
patterns.trigger: « agony»4 ... «repeat»2 ... automated voice ... «wastes»2；«think»9 of the relief
patterns.context: 描述电话自动语音系统造成的烦恼，并转向想到摆脱它后的宽慰。

patterns.name: 外交文件交付
patterns.context: 瑞典语报道中，主语将备忘录、文件或提案提交给中国当局；高激活落在 läm-nade 的词内片段。

patterns.name: 法律证明与免疫接种
patterns.context: 法律条文以医生证明或公共卫生部门确认作为免疫接种证明；激活较弱且分散。

patterns.name: 法律过失责任中的意外行为
patterns.context: 讨论教师是否须预见学生日常发生的各种意外行为及相关危险。

patterns.name: 修订版和解协议标题
patterns.context: 邮件标题以大写、拆分标记的词说明协议草案已修订，并要求忽略早期版本。

patterns.name: 健康公司与利润率
patterns.context: 商业报道评价某公司在行业中的健康程度，并提及提价和利润率。

en.concept: In-word subword fragments and word forms
en.description: The clearest pattern is the English maxim- stem and its forms; other activations include lä, mynd-, and several in-word subword fragments in Swedish EuroParl, as well as the legal negator not and an isolated instance of think in novel dialogue.

patterns.name: maxim- forms and derivatives
patterns.context: The stem maxim combines with different endings to form maximise/maximally/maximizes/maximise and related forms; activation concentrates on the stem or near tokenization boundaries.
patterns.domain: Various styles, including healthcare services, education, and machine learning

patterns.name: Subword fragments within Swedish word forms
patterns.context: Tokenized fragments occur within Swedish forms meaning “submit/propose” and “leave”; the strongest activation falls on lä.

patterns.name: Swedish administrative stem mynd-
patterns.context: Appears at an internal subword boundary in myndigheter (authorities/institutions).
patterns.domain: EuroParl, Swedish political and administrative texts

patterns.name: Highlighted fragments within Swedish verbs
patterns.context: Swedish forms are split into multiple subwords; activation falls on stems or internal fragments, with no clear shared semantic category.

patterns.name: Negator in legal provisions
patterns.context: not is marked in US legal provisions when specifying an exemption or applicability condition.

patterns.name: think in novel dialogue
patterns.context: think appears within direct speech in an English novel.

9_1610.description: 最清楚的模式是英语 maxim- 词干及其词形；另有瑞典语 EuroParl 中 lä、mynd-及若干词内子词片段，以及法律否定词 not 和小说对白 think 的孤立激活。

patterns.name: maxim- 词形及其派生形式
patterns.context: 词干 maxim 与不同词尾拼接，构成 maximise/maximally/maximizes/maximise 等词形；激活集中在词干或分词边界附近。
patterns.domain: 医疗服务、教育、机器学习等多种文体

patterns.name: 瑞典语词形内的子词片段
patterns.context: 瑞典语词形中出现被切分的词内片段，分别处于“提交/提出”和“离开”等不同词形中；强激活落在 lä 上。

patterns.name: 瑞典语行政词干 mynd-
patterns.context: 出现在 myndigheter（当局/机构）一词的词内子词边界处。
patterns.domain: EuroParl，瑞典语政治与行政文本

patterns.name: 瑞典语动词词内的高亮片段
patterns.context: 瑞典语词形被切为多个子词；强度落在词干或词内片段，未呈现明显统一的语义类别。

patterns.name: 法律条文中的否定词
patterns.context: 美国法律条文规定某项豁免或适用条件时，not 获得标记。

patterns.name: 小说对白中的 think
patterns.context: 英文小说对白中，think 出现在直接引语内。

en.description: Strong activations often fall within several words: the maxim word family, think, learned, pivot, establish, rescued, and eligibility. Maxim and think each occur across multiple passages, while the others are mostly isolated. Passage 5 has no clear corresponding pattern.

patterns.name: maxim word-form fragment
patterns.context: The triggering fragment occurs in forms such as maximise/maximizes/maximally; surrounding contexts concern resource use, course objectives, and caregiver participation. The shared word form may be the main trigger rather than a unified meaning.
patterns.domain: Healthcare quality guidelines, education programs, medical research

patterns.name: think prompts
patterns.context: Imperative or thought-guiding expressions ask the reader to imagine something; one concerns courage and Robinson, while another occurs in a fictional character's inner speech.

patterns.name: learn word-form fragment at the end
patterns.context: Occurs only in the chapter title “WHAT JACK LEARNED FROM PEDRO”, with the trigger falling on the participial form learned.
patterns.domain: Novel table of contents or chapter title

patterns.name: pivot word-form fragment at the end
patterns.context: Appears in a description of a mechanical structure, explaining that a platform component rotates around a frame; activation is concentrated on a fragment within pivot.

patterns.name: establish word-form fragment at the end
patterns.context: Appears in yoga meditation guidance, instructing the reader to establish a safe mental space; activation falls on a fragment within establish.

patterns.name: rescue word-form fragment at the end
patterns.context: Appears only in the chapter title “JACK IS RESCUED”, with the trigger falling on a fragment within rescued.
patterns.domain: Novel table of contents or chapter title

patterns.name: eligibility word-form fragment at the end
patterns.context: Appears in an all-caps subheading in a formal email, indicating a client's eligibility for a program.

9_1610.description: 强激活多落在若干词内部片段：maxim 词族、think、learned、pivot、establish、rescued、eligibility；其中 maxim 与 think 各跨多段，其余多为孤例。第5段缺少明显对应规律。

patterns.name: maxim 词形片段
patterns.context: 触发片段出现在 maximise/maximizes/maximally 等词形中；周围上下文分别涉及资源利用、课程目标、照护者参与。可能主要由共同词形触发，而非统一语义。
patterns.domain: 医疗质量指南、教育项目、医学研究

patterns.name: think 思考指令
patterns.context: 祈使式或引导思考的表达，要求读者设想某事；一个是关于勇气与 Robinson，另一个是小说人物的内心话语。
patterns.domain: 体育报道引语、小说对话

patterns.name: 结尾 learn 的词形片段
patterns.context: 仅见于章节标题“WHAT JACK LEARNED FROM PEDRO”中，触发落在 learned 的分词词形。

patterns.name: 结尾 pivot 的词形片段
patterns.context: 出现在机械结构描述中，说明平台组件绕框架转动；激活集中于单词 pivot 的词内片段。

patterns.name: 结尾 establish 的词形片段
patterns.context: 出现在瑜伽冥想指导中，指示建立一个安全的心理空间；激活落在 establish 的词内片段。

patterns.name: 结尾 rescue 的词形片段
patterns.context: 只出现在章节标题“JACK IS RESCUED”中，触发落在 rescued 的词内片段。

patterns.name: 结尾 eligibility 的词形片段
patterns.context: 出现在正式邮件的全大写小标题中，表示客户参加项目的资格。

en.description: The clearest pattern is think in imperative or reflective contexts (especially think about); other activations are scattered across all-caps headings, proper nouns, and internal fragments of medical/technical terms, with no consistent semantic or syntactic trigger.

patterns.name: think followed by about
patterns.context: In imperative or persuasive contexts, someone is asked to think about something; it can also appear in emotional or reflective narration.

patterns.name: Word endings split in headings
patterns.context: In all-caps chapter headings, activation falls on subword fragments within words rather than at whole-word boundaries.

patterns.name: Letter fragments within proper nouns or terms
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal word fragments in all-caps form headings or terminology.

patterns.name: In-word fragments in medical terms
patterns.context: In Portuguese parliamentary texts, activation appears on short letter fragments at word beginnings or internally; there is no clear semantic connection to the English think pattern.

patterns.name: Word-final fragments in medical terminology
patterns.context: In technical descriptions, activation concentrates on fragments within specialized verbs.

patterns.name: In-word fragments in healthcare terms
patterns.context: In healthcare principles or definitions, activation falls on internal fragments in several words, with no consistent whole-word or syntactic trigger.

patterns.name: Fragments within personal names
patterns.context: People and institution names appear in academic descriptions; activation is weak, and it is uncertain whether proper names are the trigger.

9_1610.concept: 局部词形/子词片段激活
9_1610.description: 最明显模式是祈使或反思语境中的 think（尤其 think about）；其余激活分散在全大写标题、专名及医学/技术词汇的词内片段，未呈现一致语义或句法触发。

patterns.name: think 后接 about
patterns.context: 祈使或劝说语境中，要求读者/听者思考某事；也可出现在情绪或反思性叙述中
patterns.domain: 新闻、政治邮件、小说叙述

patterns.name: 标题中的分词词尾
patterns.context: 全大写章节标题中，激活落在单词内部的子词片段，而非完整词边界

patterns.name: 专名或术语内部的字母片段
patterns.context: 全大写表单标题或术语中，激活落在词内部片段

patterns.name: 医学术语中的词内片段
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语议会文本中，激活出现在词首/词内的短字母片段；与英语 think 模式无明显语义联系

patterns.name: 医学术语词尾片段
patterns.context: 技术描述中，激活集中在专业动词内部的片段

patterns.name: 健康服务词内片段
patterns.context: 健康服务原则或定义中，激活落在多个词的内部片段，未见统一完整词或句法触发条件
patterns.domain: 公共卫生/医疗研究文本

patterns.name: 人名内部片段
patterns.context: 人物与机构名称出现在学术描述中；激活较弱，是否由专名触发不确定

en.concept: Prompts to think and sporadic word-form cues
en.description: The strongest theme is think/Think and its objects of thought, often used to advise, recall, or evaluate. Other cues include medical maxim, philosophical belongs, split fragments in tables of contents, and sporadic cues involving names, pauses, and controversy reporting.

patterns.name: think and subsequent thought content
patterns.context: Imperative or advisory contexts ask readers to imagine, consider, or evaluate something; explicitly appears in passages 1, 2, 3, 5, and 10, while passage 6 also has «LE»ARN»9«ED»5
patterns.domain: Commentary, persuasion, fiction, and chapter titles

patterns.name: maxim in medical quality terminology
patterns.context: Formal descriptions of healthcare service quality or clinical care; the term spans token boundaries
patterns.domain: PubMed medical and health sciences academic text

patterns.name: belong indicating affiliation or relation
patterns.context: Discusses the relationship of beings to an inherent order and the good

patterns.name: Local fragment of the name Robinson
patterns.context: Appears in the name Jackie Robinson Day; the same passage also has think, but the name fragment may be an independent trigger

patterns.name: Name fragments and spelling patterns
patterns.context: In uppercase chapter listings, markers fall on split name, word, or number fragments; there is no clear shared semantic condition
patterns.domain: Novel table of contents or scanned text

patterns.name: Emphatic pause in political speech
patterns.context: Asks listeners to stop and think about the stakes; the pause word and think occur in the same sentence

patterns.name: Word fragments related to insults and reputation
patterns.context: Public criticism sparks controversy involving insults to residents and students and damage to reputation; the trigger lies within a word

9_1610.concept: 思考提示及零散词形线索
9_1610.description: 最强主线是 think/Think 及其思考对象，常用于劝告、回想或评估；另有医疗 maxim、哲学 belongs、目录中的拆词片段，以及零散姓名、停顿和争议报道线索。

patterns.name: think 及其后续思考内容
patterns.context: 祈使或劝告语境中要求读者想象、考虑或评估某事；段1、2、3、5、10明确出现，段6另有 «LE»ARN»9«ED»5
patterns.domain: 评论、劝说、小说叙述及章节标题

patterns.name: 医疗质量术语中的 maxim
patterns.context: 医疗服务质量或临床照护的正式描述；词项跨 token 边界呈现
patterns.domain: PubMed 医疗卫生学术文本

patterns.name: 表示归属或关系的 belong
patterns.context: 讨论存在者与内在秩序、善之间的归属关系

patterns.name: 人名 Robinson 的局部片段
patterns.context: 出现在 Jackie Robinson Day 的人名中；同段亦有 think，但该姓名片段可能是独立触发线索

patterns.name: 人名片段与拼写模式
patterns.context: 大写章节目录中，标记落在拆分的人名、词语或编号片段上；没有明显共享的语义条件

patterns.name: 政治演说中的强调停顿
patterns.context: 要求听众停下来思考利害关系；停顿词与 think 同处一句
patterns.domain: 政治邮件或演说式文本

patterns.name: 辱骂、声誉相关词语片段
patterns.context: 公开批评引发争议，涉及侮辱居民、学生及损害声誉；触发位置在词内部

en.description: Activation often falls on local character fragments within English or Swedish words, and also appears in headings and body text; a few fragments involve emphasis, maximization, or evaluative words, but meanings and contexts vary across corpora, with no unified trigger.

patterns.name: Clearly segmented subword fragments within English words
patterns.context: Activation often falls on a character sequence within a word, while other parts of the same word are unmarked or weakly activated; it spans headings, body text, and promotional language, with no fixed meaning or syntactic position.
patterns.domain: English novels and headings (1, 7), Pile-CC comments (8); also segmented words in other texts

patterns.name: Emphasis/evaluation words and their internal suffixes
patterns.context: Appears in expressions of emphasis, maximization, or evaluation, often marking only part of a word; includes English and Swedish, and activation does not always cover the whole word.

patterns.name: Fragments within Swedish words
patterns.context: Located within words in continuous Swedish text, often interspersed with other unmarked parts of the word; no clear unified meaning.

patterns.name: Common words or short fragments in body text
patterns.context: Appears in sentence body text, but nearby words of the same type are not consistently activated; semantics and functions vary widely, preventing a reliable semantic or syntactic trigger from being identified.

patterns.name: Headings, chapters, and layout markers
patterns.context: Appears in table-of-contents-style chapter headings, book titles, or chapter openings, alongside line breaks, numbering, and all-caps formatting; differs somewhat from activation in paragraph text.

patterns.name: Dispersed activation near the ends of Swedish words
patterns.context: Appears within words or near word boundaries, with fragmented marking; no confirmable meaning or fixed morphological condition.

9_1610.description: 激活多落在英文或瑞典语词内的局部字符片段，也见于标题和正文；少数片段涉及强调、最大化或评价词，但跨语料、词义和语境不一致，尚无统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 英文词中带有明确切分的子词片段
patterns.context: 激活常落在词内的一段字符上，而同词其他部分未标记或激活较弱；跨越标题、正文与宣传语，未见固定词义或句法位置。
patterns.domain: 英文小说及标题（1、7）、Pile-CC 评论（8）；也可见于其他文本中的切分词

patterns.name: 强调／评价词及其词内后缀
patterns.context: 出现在强调、最大化或评价性表达中，且常只标记词的一部分；包括英语和瑞典语，激活不总覆盖完整词。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本、医疗论文

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内片段
patterns.context: 位于瑞典语连续语句中的词内，常与词的其他未标记部分交错；没有明显统一词义。

patterns.name: 正文中的普通高频词或短词片段
patterns.context: 在句子正文中出现，但邻近同类词并不稳定激活；各段语义和用途差异大，无法归纳出可靠的语义或句法触发条件。

patterns.name: 标题、章节与版式标记
patterns.context: 出现在目录式章节标题、书名或章节开头，夹杂换行、编号和大写排版；与段落正文中的激活不完全相同。
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 小说／非虚构书籍版式

patterns.name: 瑞典语完整词尾附近的离散激活
patterns.context: 出现在词内部或词边界附近，标记呈碎片化；缺少可确认的词义或固定形态条件。

en.description: Activations are scattered across words and common phrases such as care and think, split-marked word fragments, code regex flags, and legal restrictions; there is no clear unified meaning across them.

patterns.name: Common expressions with care
patterns.context: Appears in expressions of negation, low concern, or caution; intensity falls on care itself, while the negation word is not always the trigger.
patterns.domain: News, art commentary, and historical narrative

patterns.name: Imperative think
patterns.context: Appears in “Just think” or “think about”, often as advice or a prompt to imagine.

patterns.name: Irregular capitalization/participial fragments
patterns.context: Subword fragments within words activate; examples are mostly uppercase emphatic text or cross-lingual forms, but also include ordinary words.
patterns.domain: Novel chapter titles, online insults, parliamentary text

patterns.name: Regex fragments in code
patterns.context: In the middle of a Python regular expression flag name, near escape characters and character-class expressions.

patterns.name: Legal obligation/restriction language
patterns.context: Legal clauses that limit a liability or obligation by stating it does not apply.

9_1610.description: 激活分散在 care、think 等词及其常见短语，也出现在被拆分标记的词内片段、代码正则标志和法律限制语句；各处没有明显统一语义。

patterns.name: care 常见表达
patterns.context: 在否定、低在意程度或涉及谨慎的表达中出现；强度落在 care 本身，而否定词不总是触发点。
patterns.domain: 新闻、艺术评论及历史叙述

patterns.name: think 命令式
patterns.context: 出现在 “Just think” 或 “think about” 中，常用于劝告或设想。

patterns.name: 不规则大写/分词片段
patterns.context: 词内子词片段受到激活；样例多为大写强调文本或跨语言词形，但也见于普通单词。
patterns.domain: 小说章节标题、网络辱骂、议会文本

patterns.name: 代码中的正则表达式片段
patterns.context: Python 正则表达式标志名中部，且附近有转义符与字母类表达式。

patterns.name: 法律义务/限制用语
patterns.context: 法律条文中限定某项责任或义务不适用的句式。

en.description: Activation spans the thinking verb, scrutinise, internal fragments of rare words, all-caps headings, and subwords in personal names; some activations concentrate on internal fragments of longer or less frequent words, with scrutinise recurring twice.

patterns.name: Imperative or cognitive use of think
patterns.context: think is followed by about/a comma and an object of thought, serving as advice or as a thinking action in narration.

patterns.name: Stem of scrutinise
patterns.context: scrutinise means to examine closely; one instance takes photographs as its object, while another is paired with development policy.
patterns.domain: Philosophical writing, policy or academic texts

patterns.name: In-word fragments in rare words
patterns.context: Activation falls within longer, less frequent, or morphologically complex words: unembellished, enunciate, and jeopardised.

patterns.name: Split spelling in book titles or table-of-contents headings
patterns.context: Headings use all caps, and activation is distributed within English words split into multiple subwords.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in personal names
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal subword fragments in personal names; the text consists of a continuous list of Spanish names.

patterns.name: Local fragments in legal vocabulary
patterns.context: Legal argumentation concerns bankruptcy exemptions or jury selection; strong activation concentrates on internal or initial fragments of words such as enunciate and forbids.

9_1610.concept: 词语内部子词片段识别
9_1610.description: 激活跨越思考动词、scrutinise、罕见词内部片段、全大写标题和人名子词；部分集中在较长或低频词的内部片段，另有两处重复的 scrutinise。

patterns.name: think 的祈使或认知用法
patterns.context: think 后接 about/逗号及思考对象，作为劝告或叙事中的思考动作

patterns.name: scrutinise 的词干
patterns.context: scrutinise 表示仔细审视；一处以 photographs 为宾语，另一处与开发政策并列
patterns.domain: 哲学论述、政策或学术文本

patterns.name: 罕见词中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在较长、低频或复杂构词的词内部，分别为 unembellished、enunciate、jeopardised
patterns.domain: 回忆录叙述、法律、医学研究

patterns.name: 书名或目录标题中的分词拼写
patterns.context: 标题采用全大写，激活分布在拆分成多个子词的英文词内部

patterns.name: 人名中的子词片段
patterns.trigger: « VER»1«G»2ARA, BER«EN»4«IZE»3 GAL«IC»2IA,« EN»4«RI»3«QUE»3… L«UC»7«Í»2«A»3… S«IN»9«DEL»2
patterns.context: 激活落在人名的内部子词片段，文本为连续列出的西班牙语姓名

patterns.name: 法律词汇中的局部片段
patterns.context: 法律论证中涉及破产豁免或陪审员遴选；强激活集中在 enunciate、forbids 等词的内部或开头片段

en.description: Activations concentrate on internal fragments of several English and Swedish word forms: scrutin-, maxim-, recommendation-related forms, and think, nobody, learn, advantaged, and enunciate. These words belong to different contexts, with no unified semantic or syntactic pattern yet apparent.

patterns.name: scrutinise stem and policy review
patterns.context: The scrutin- stem occurs in contexts discussing policy positions or ethical issues, followed by different suffix forms

patterns.name: maxim- stem
patterns.context: The maxim- stem forms maximise or maximally in sentences about resource use and information provision

patterns.name: People going against the crowd and nobody
patterns.context: Discusses consumer choices, going in a different direction from the crowd, and other people's reactions

patterns.name: Encouraging expression with think about
patterns.context: Direct quotation encourages someone to think about another person's actions in response to fear

patterns.name: Recommendation-related word forms
patterns.context: Swedish verb forms recommending an action

patterns.name: learned in chapter titles
patterns.context: All-caps, book-table-of-contents-style chapter title highlighting a fragment within learned
patterns.domain: Novel table of contents or chapter title

patterns.name: advantaged
patterns.context: Describes one party being unfairly given a market advantage in a legal dispute

patterns.name: enunciate
patterns.context: States legal policy in a bankruptcy provision or judicial opinion

9_1610.description: 激活集中于若干英语及瑞典语词形的内部片段：scrutin-、maxim-、推荐相关词形，以及 think、nobody、learn、advantaged、enunciate 等；这些词分属不同语境，尚无统一语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: scrutinise 词干及政策审查
patterns.trigger: «scrutin»10«ise»2« or»2 develop a particular policy« position»2；«scrutin»9«ized»2
patterns.context: scrutin- 词干位于讨论政策立场或伦理议题的语境中，后接不同形态词尾

patterns.name: maxim- 词干
patterns.context: maxim- 词干构成 maximise 或 maximally，处在说明资源利用、信息提供的句子中

patterns.name: 人群逆向与 nobody
patterns.trigger: «crowd»5 is going one way；«nobody»10 wants to hear
patterns.context: 谈论消费选择、与大众不同的方向，以及他人的反应

patterns.name: think about 的鼓励表达
patterns.context: 直接引语中劝人思考某人的行为，以应对恐惧

patterns.name: 推荐相关词形
patterns.context: 瑞典语中建议采取行动的动词词形
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会、市场竞争讨论

patterns.name: 章节标题中的 learned
patterns.context: 书籍目录式全大写章节标题，突出 learned 的词内片段

patterns.name: advantaged
patterns.context: 法律争议中描述一方被不公平地赋予市场优势

patterns.name: enunciate
patterns.context: 破产法条文或司法意见中陈述法律政策

en.description: Activation spans languages, styles, and topics, often occurring on subwords within words, word endings, and English or Spanish function words. It also involves emphatic emotional words in quotations, formal technical and policy terms, and change-related words in all-caps announcements. No single stable semantic theme is apparent.

patterns.name: Continuation of segmented words and internal fragments
patterns.context: Activation often occurs on morphemes or subword fragments within words, especially endings, stems, and following parts; ordinary words and cross-word continuations also appear.

patterns.name: Common function words and continuations in English sentences
patterns.context: Occurs in consecutive word sequences in English narratives or explanatory sentences. Activation sometimes concentrates on short function words and sometimes extends to neighboring content words.

patterns.name: Emphatic or evaluative wording
patterns.context: In quotations or evaluative statements, involves emphasis, emotional reactions, or degree of salience; contexts differ across examples.

patterns.name: Spanish word forms and syntactic fragments
patterns.context: In formal Spanish sentences about the Lisbon Treaty, activation is distributed across articles, conjunctions, pronouns, and internal word fragments.

patterns.name: Word-internal changes in all-caps announcements
patterns.context: In brief all-caps notices, activation concentrates on words indicating that a location has changed and their internal parts.

patterns.name: Normative technical or policy terminology
patterns.context: Technical, policy, or evaluation contexts in formal explanatory texts; the trigger words respectively concern resource use and review.
patterns.domain: Medical quality guidelines, disaster policy texts

9_1610.description: 激活分布跨语种、文体和主题，常落在词内子词、词尾及英语或西语功能词上；也涉及引语中的强调情绪词、正式技术政策词，以及全大写公告中的变更词，未见单一稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: 分词与词内片段续接
patterns.context: 激活常落在单词内部的词素或子词片段上，尤其是词尾、词干与后续部分；同时可见普通词及跨词续接。

patterns.name: 英语句中常见功能词与续接
patterns.trigger: « to»、« the»、« and»、« of»、« have»、« been»、« I»、« no»
patterns.context: 出现在英语叙述或说明句的连续词串中，激活有时集中于短功能词，有时延伸到邻近实词。

patterns.name: 强调或评价性措辞
patterns.trigger: « WHAT»、« close»、« think»、« no»、« never»、« applaud»
patterns.context: 在引语或评价性语句中，涉及强调、情绪反应或显著程度；各例上下文并不相同。

patterns.name: 西班牙语词形及句法片段
patterns.context: 西班牙语关于《里斯本条约》的正式句子中，激活分布于冠词、连词、代词及词内片段。

patterns.name: 全大写公告中的词内变化
patterns.context: 全大写的简短通知中，激活集中在表示位置已变更的词及其词内部分。

patterns.name: 规范性技术或政策用语
patterns.context: 正式说明文本中的技术、政策或评估语境；触发词分别涉及资源利用和审查。
patterns.domain: 医疗质量指南、灾害政策文本

en.description: Activations are scattered across multilingual parliamentary and academic texts, English narrative, and math problems. They fall on specific word fragments or numbers and cover negation, dependence, need, guarantees, interrogative expressions, and zero, without a stable shared meaning.

patterns.name: Character “ç” within a Portuguese word
patterns.context: Activation falls on ç in a Portuguese word, in “alcançar”; the same corpus passage later contains Portuguese words such as “respeita”.

patterns.name: Relationship expressed through dependence on features
patterns.context: A Portuguese academic sentence says that the relationship between creativity, innovation, and CT depends on their respective features; activation is concentrated on fragments of “depender” and “características”.

patterns.name: Apostrophe suffix in a negative contraction
patterns.context: The n't portion of an English contraction, especially the t after the apostrophe; the same passage also contains the expression “couldn’t think of”.
patterns.domain: Pile-CC, personal tribute or interview-style text

patterns.name: Negation and expressions of care
patterns.context: English dialogue negates that someone or bystanders care about something; activation falls on care.

patterns.name: “Need” and its policy context
patterns.context: A Spanish parliamentary sentence says that something “needs” European Parliament approval; activation is concentrated on fragments of the stem and suffix of necesitar.

patterns.name: Local authorities and duty to guarantee
patterns.context: A Portuguese parliamentary speech asks Strasbourg's local authorities to guarantee certain conditions; activations occur in “autoridades locais” and “garantam”.

patterns.name: Interrogative “no doubt”
patterns.context: The fixed expression “no hay duda de que” (“there is no doubt that”) in Spanish parliamentary text; activation falls on duda.

patterns.name: Self-expression and vulnerability
patterns.context: First-person discussion of theater, self-presentation, and personal origins; look appears in the direct quotation “look where I’m from”.

patterns.name: Present perfect structure meaning “have been”
patterns.context: News commentary uses “have never been more …” to emphasize the vulnerable state of independent news and democracy.

patterns.name: The digit zero in a math problem
patterns.context: Zero appears as a digit in a negative operand in a decimal multiplication problem.

9_1610.description: 激活分散于多语种议会与学术文本、英语叙述和数学题；分别落在特定词片段或数字上，涵盖否定、依赖、需要、保障、疑问表达及零，缺少稳定共同语义。

patterns.name: 葡语词内的“ç”字符
patterns.context: 激活落在葡语词的 ç 上，出现在“alcançar”中；同一语料段随后有“respeita”等葡语词。

patterns.name: 依赖特征的关系表述
patterns.context: 葡语学术句中，创造力、创新与 CT 之间的关系被说成取决于各自特征；激活集中在“depender”和“características”的词片段。

patterns.name: 否定缩写中的撇号词尾
patterns.context: 英语缩写中的 n't 部分，尤其是撇号后的 t；同段附近还有“couldn’t think of”这一表达。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC，个人致辞或访谈式文本

patterns.name: 否定与关心表达
patterns.context: 英语对话中，否定某人或旁人关心某事；激活落在 care。

patterns.name: “需要”及其政策语境
patterns.context: 西班牙语议会句中，表示某事项“需要”欧洲议会批准；激活集中在 necesitar 的词干及词尾片段。

patterns.name: 地方当局与保障责任
patterns.context: 葡语议会发言要求斯特拉斯堡地方当局保障某些情况；激活分布于“autoridades locais”和“garantam”。

patterns.name: 疑问式“不怀疑”
patterns.context: 西班牙语议会文本中的固定表达“no hay duda de que”（毫无疑问）；激活落在 duda。

patterns.name: 自我表达与脆弱性
patterns.context: 第一人称谈论戏剧、自我展示及个人来处；look 出现在直接引语“look where I’m from”中。

patterns.name: “曾经如此”的完成时结构
patterns.context: 新闻评论中以“have never been more …”强调独立新闻与民主的脆弱处境。

patterns.name: 数学题中的数字零
patterns.context: 小数乘法题的负数操作数中，零作为数字字符出现。

en.description: In three mathematical fragments, numbers, operators, and operational relations are prominent. In the remaining texts, activation is distributed across Portuguese and English word-internal fragments, spanning domains with no clear, consistent semantic or syntactic conditions.

patterns.name: Numbers and operators in math problems
patterns.context: Numbers, minus signs, multiplication signs, and operational relations in the problem occur together in arithmetic or comparison questions; activation often falls on number fragments and operators
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, exercises and calculation problems

patterns.name: Subword fragments within Portuguese words
patterns.context: In Portuguese sentences, activation falls on words or affix fragments presented in split form; there is no clear single meaning or syntactic position
patterns.domain: European Parliament, paper abstracts, Q&A texts

patterns.name: Local fragments within English words
patterns.context: In continuous English text, activation is scattered across words or word-internal fragments in narratives, research methods, and personal statements, with no stable shared semantics

9_1610.description: 三个数学片段中，数字与运算符、运算关系较突出；其余文本的激活分布在葡语和英语词内片段，跨领域且无清楚一致的语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 数学运算题中的数字与运算符
patterns.context: 算术题或比较题中，数字、负号、乘号及问题中的运算关系相邻出现；激活常落在数字片段及运算符上

patterns.name: 葡语词语内部的子词片段

patterns.domain: 新闻、医学论文、个人叙述

en.concept: Multilingual word forms and expression fragments
en.description: Activation spans multiple patterns: first-person polite expressions and verb morphology in Portuguese parliamentary speeches; responses also include necessity-related forms containing necess-. Local strong activation also appears in English negation, personal accounts, academic dependency relations, and literary descriptions of gaze.

patterns.name: Portuguese forms containing “necess-” and related forms
patterns.context: Trigger fragments include the necess- stem, especially in forms expressing need, necessity, or lack of necessity; occurs in Portuguese and English contexts
patterns.domain: Portuguese speeches in the EU Parliament, English public health explanations

patterns.name: First-person expressions in Portuguese parliamentary speeches
patterns.context: In formal Portuguese speeches, speakers use the first person to express hopes, gratitude, or discuss being granted the floor; common in members’ remarks and statements of position

patterns.name: Participles or verb endings in Portuguese inflected forms
patterns.context: Verb-morphology fragments in Portuguese prose, involving various tenses, persons, and stems, with no clear unifying semantic condition

patterns.name: English negation and emphatic expressions
patterns.context: Negation, emphatic responses, or expressions of inability in English narratives or quotations

patterns.name: Self-presentation in English personal narratives
patterns.context: First-person discussion of works expresses personal views, experiences, identity, or vulnerability

patterns.name: Relations and dependencies in academic discourse
patterns.context: States that relations between creativity, innovation, and related metrics depend on their respective characteristics

patterns.name: Descriptions of gaze in literary narratives
patterns.context: The narrator guides readers to observe a character’s gaze and its movement

patterns.name: English forms of “become”
patterns.context: English infinitive phrase following an object or identity description; this fragment signal is relatively isolated

9_1610.concept: 多语种词形与表达片段
9_1610.description: 激活覆盖多种模式：葡语议会发言中的第一人称礼貌表达及动词形态，此外响应含 necess- 的必要性词形；英语否定、个人自述、学术依赖关系和文学视线描写也有局部强激活。

patterns.name: 葡语词形“necess-”及其相关形式
patterns.context: 触发片段包含 necess- 词干，尤其在表示需要、必要或不必的词形中；葡语和英语语境都有
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会葡语发言、英语公共卫生说明

patterns.name: 葡语议会发言中的第一人称表达
patterns.context: 葡语正式发言中，演讲者以第一人称表达希望、感谢或谈及获准发言；常见于议员致辞及议题陈述

patterns.name: 葡语动词屈折形式中的分词或动词词尾
patterns.context: 葡语正文中的动词形态片段，涉及多种时态、人称和词干，未见明确统一的语义条件

patterns.name: 英语否定与强调表达
patterns.context: 英语叙述或引语中的否定、强调性回答或否定能力表达

patterns.name: 英语个人叙述中的自我呈现
patterns.trigger: «wanted»4 …« my» viewpoint …« to»« be»« vulnerable»；« look»9 where I«'m» from
patterns.context: 第一人称谈论作品表达个人观点、经历、身份或脆弱感

patterns.name: 学术论述中的关系与依赖表述
patterns.context: 指出创造力、创新与相关指标之间的关系取决于各自特征

patterns.name: 文学叙述中的视线描写
patterns.trigger: «Look»9 how … people's eyes are all off
patterns.context: 叙事者引导读者观察人物目光及其转移

patterns.name: 英语“become”词形
patterns.context: 宾语或身份描述之后的英语不定式短语；该片段信号较孤立

en.description: Activation patterns vary: numbers in mathematical calculations, durations and concentrations in experimental methods, and several English or Portuguese word fragments, dialogue words, and healthcare service terms. No single semantic or formatting pattern covers all passages.

patterns.name: Numbers and decimal calculations
patterns.context: Occurs in multiplication problems, numerical expressions, and calculation instructions, including decimals, negative numbers, and numbers near operators; activations are distributed over digit substrings rather than whole words.

patterns.name: Time quantities in experimental procedures
patterns.context: In tissue section or sample processing steps, numbers indicate incubation or treatment duration; passages 2 and 10 also involve peroxidase blocking.

patterns.name: Percentages in biomedicine
patterns.context: Percentages follow solution or serum concentrations and specify experimental treatment conditions; appear in passages 2 and 10.

patterns.name: Specific substrings within English words
patterns.context: Activation falls inside split English words, across different words and contexts; it is difficult to reduce these to a unified meaning or grammatical condition.

patterns.name: look in spoken dialogue
patterns.context: In character dialogue, Look introduces the listener's attention or evidence; only one instance.

patterns.name: gostaria in Portuguese
patterns.context: In European Parliament Portuguese speech, the first-person conditional expresses “would like/wish”; activation falls on the initial fragment.

patterns.name: respeita in Portuguese
patterns.context: In European Parliament Portuguese proceedings, appears in the structure “no que respeita a” (“with regard to”); an internal word fragment activates.

patterns.name: Healthcare service quality descriptions
patterns.context: Lists dimensions of healthcare service quality or efficiency, describing timeliness, reduced delays, service delivery, and resource use; activation falls on initial or internal fragments of English words.

9_1610.description: 激活模式多样：数学计算中的数字、实验方法中的时长和浓度，以及若干英语或葡萄牙语词片段、对白词和卫生服务术语；没有单一语义或格式能覆盖全部片段。

patterns.name: 数字与小数计算
patterns.context: 出现在乘法题、数值表达和计算指令中，包含小数、负数及运算符附近的数字；激活分布在数字子串而非完整词上。

patterns.name: 实验步骤中的时间量
patterns.context: 组织切片或样本处理步骤中，数字表示孵育、处理时长；段2和段10还涉及过氧化物酶封闭。

patterns.name: 生物医学中的百分数
patterns.context: 百分数跟在溶液或血清浓度之后，用于实验处理条件；段2、10出现。

patterns.name: 英语词内部的特定子串
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的英文词内部，涵盖不同词及不同语境；目前难以归结为统一词义或语法条件。
patterns.domain: 英语散文与生物医学文本

patterns.name: 口语对白中的 look
patterns.context: 人物对话中以 Look 引出对听者的注意或证据；仅此一例。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语中的 gostaria
patterns.context: 欧洲议会葡萄牙语发言中，第一人称条件式表达“愿意/希望”；激活落在词首片段。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语中的 respeita
patterns.context: 欧洲议会葡萄牙语议事文本中，出现在“no que respeita a（关于）”结构；词内片段激活。

patterns.name: 卫生服务质量描述
patterns.context: 列举医疗服务质量或效率维度，描述及时性、减少延误、服务交付及资源利用；激活落在英语词的开头或内部片段。
patterns.domain: 卫生政策/医疗服务指南

en.description: Activation is scattered across Portuguese word fragments, time values and experimental terminology in English methods texts, and sporadic expressions in parliamentary sentences and personal profiles. The experimental methods are internally more consistent, but the rest are difficult to attribute to a single mechanism.

patterns.name: Numbers and time concentrations in English experimental texts
patterns.context: In experimental method descriptions, numeric time values are followed by time units; activation sometimes falls on the number and sometimes near the unit.

patterns.name: Within the name chloramphenicol acetyl transferase
patterns.context: The full term chloramphenicol is followed by acetyl transferase; activation falls on the hen substring in the middle of the term.

patterns.name: Portuguese verb forms and grammatical fragments
patterns.context: In Portuguese sentences, activation concentrates on part of a verb stem or inflected form; the examples differ in semantics and syntactic position.

patterns.name: Forms in Portuguese parliamentary texts
patterns.context: In parliamentary speeches or policy texts, local activation appears on common function words, verb forms, or evaluative words; these are not fully consistent with the other highly activated words in the passage.

patterns.name: Minutes and closed punctuation in procedure steps
patterns.context: In tissue-section or cell-processing workflows, media, concentrations, and times form experimental steps; several tokens around time parameters also show activation.

patterns.name: Expressions of emphasis or stance in Portuguese
patterns.context: Statements in parliamentary speeches express importance, permission, or willingness to speak; specific trigger forms differ.

patterns.name: Fragments in unusual Portuguese compounds
patterns.context: The internal fragment of the Portuguese compound alcanç ar (alcançar), with no clear trigger condition shared with the other patterns.

patterns.name: Negation/quantity expressions in English personal profiles
patterns.context: In a personal profile about an interest in football, an expression emphasizes that nothing compares to a particular experience.

patterns.name: Immunostaining steps for tissue sections
patterns.context: Describes the blocking of endogenous peroxidase; experimental terms and actions also show activation in addition to the time value.

patterns.name: Other sporadic Portuguese word fragments
patterns.context: Short words or internal fragments appear scattered through parliamentary texts, with no identifiable shared condition.

9_1610.description: 激活分散于葡萄牙语词段、英语实验文本中的时间数字与实验术语，以及议会语句和个人简介中的零散表达；实验方法内部较一致，其余难归为单一机制。

patterns.name: 英语实验文本中的数字及时间浓度
patterns.context: 实验方法描述中，数字时间值后接时间单位；有时激活落在数字，有时落在单位附近。

patterns.name: 氯霉素乙酰转移酶名称内部
patterns.context: 完整术语 chloramphenicol 后接 acetyl transferase，激活落在术语中部的 hen 子串。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学研究计划/实验文本

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语动词形式及语法词段
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语句子中，激活集中在动词词干或屈折形式的一部分；各例语义和句法位置不同。
patterns.domain: 学术摘要、欧洲议会发言

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语议会文本中的形式
patterns.context: 议会演讲或政策文本中，对常见功能词、动词形式或评价性词语有局部激活；与该段其他高激活词并不完全一致。

patterns.name: 处理步骤中的分钟数与封闭标点
patterns.context: 组织切片或细胞处理流程中，介质、浓度及时间构成实验步骤；对时间参数周边若干 token 也有激活。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语中强调或态度表达
patterns.context: 议会发言中表达重要性、许可或发言意愿的语句；具体触发形式不同。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语特殊复合词中的片段
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语复合词 alcanç ar（alcançar）的词内片段，未见明显与其他模式一致的触发条件。

patterns.name: 英语个人简介中的否定/数量表达
patterns.context: 个人足球兴趣简介中，强调没有任何事物能与某种体验相比的表达。

patterns.name: 组织切片免疫染色步骤
patterns.context: 描述内源性过氧化物酶封闭步骤；除时间数字外，实验术语和动作也出现激活。

patterns.name: 其他零散葡萄牙语词段
patterns.context: 议会文本中分散出现的短词或词内片段，缺少可确认的共同条件。

en.description: Activation is scattered: English legal texts lean toward Nothing clauses and will not negation; Portuguese and Spanish parliamentary speeches also feature expressions of importance, need, permission, desire, or topic, as well as nothing and get in personal narratives.

patterns.name: Legal clauses with Nothing negation
patterns.context: At the start of a sentence or after a legal/disclaimer quotation, followed by a negative qualification such as “Nothing in/contained …”; activation also covers neighboring words.

patterns.name: Negated combinations of not and be
patterns.context: Future-tense negative statements in legal arguments or court memoranda, especially “will not be controlled” and “will not attempt”.

patterns.name: Portuguese expressions of importance
patterns.context: Evaluates the importance of a matter in Portuguese political speeches; expressions of permission such as «permit»«a» also appear, though it is unclear whether they share the same trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Portuguese expressions of need/necessity
patterns.context: In a Spanish-language discussion of the EU Treaty, states that a procedure or approval is necessary.

patterns.name: Portuguese expressions of desire
patterns.context: Members politely and indirectly express their wish to speak in the first person.

patterns.name: Portuguese expressions of permission
patterns.context: In a political context, requests permission for a candidate to do something, near wording about importance.

patterns.name: Portuguese topic marker meaning “with regard to”
patterns.context: The structure “No que respeita aos…” introduces the topic to be discussed next.

patterns.name: English emphatic nothing
patterns.context: In personal narratives or personal beliefs, nothing is used for absolute emphasis rather than as a legal qualification.
patterns.domain: Personal introductions, statements by football fans

patterns.name: English words related to emotional understanding
patterns.context: First-person account of others not understanding why the speaker wears a mantilla; activation concentrates on colloquial expressions of understanding.

patterns.name: Cannot be assigned to the patterns above
patterns.context: No stable, repeatable local trigger structure is apparent; activation may be related to the individual contexts of the marked words.
patterns.domain: Spanish parliamentary texts, English legal texts

9_1610.concept: 多语种否定与强调表达
9_1610.description: 激活分散：英语法律文本中偏向 Nothing 条款及 will not 否定式；另见葡、西语议会发言里的重要、需要、许可、愿望或话题表达，以及个人叙述中的 nothing 和 get。

patterns.name: Nothing否定式法律条款
patterns.context: 句首或引述法律/免责声明后，接“Nothing in/contained …”之类的否定性限定；激活也覆盖相邻词。

patterns.name: not 与 be 的否定搭配
patterns.context: 法律论证或法院备忘录中的将来时否定陈述，尤见于“will not be controlled”“will not attempt”。

patterns.name: 葡语重要性表达
patterns.context: 葡语政治发言中评价事项的重要性；同时出现 «permit»«a» 一类许可表达，但不确定是否同一触发模式。
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语欧洲议会发言

patterns.name: 葡语需/需要表达
patterns.context: 西班牙语欧盟条约讨论中，说明某种程序或批准是必要的。
patterns.domain: 西班牙语欧洲议会文本

patterns.name: 葡语愿望表达
patterns.context: 议员以礼貌、委婉的第一人称表达发言意愿。
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语欧洲议会发言

patterns.name: 葡语许可表达
patterns.context: 政治语境中要求允许候选人做某事，邻近重要性措辞。
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语欧洲议会发言

patterns.name: 葡语“关于”话题标记
patterns.context: “No que respeita aos…”结构，引出接下来讨论的主题。
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语欧洲议会文本

patterns.name: 英语强调 nothing
patterns.context: 个人叙述或个人信念中以 nothing 作绝对化强调，而非法律限定句。
patterns.domain: 个人介绍、足球爱好者陈述

patterns.name: 英语情感理解相关词
patterns.context: 第一人称叙述他人不理解说话者佩戴 mantilla 的原因；激活集中在口语理解表达。

patterns.name: 无法归入上述模式
patterns.context: 未见稳定可重复的局部触发结构；可能与被标记词各自的语境有关。
patterns.domain: 西班牙语议会文本、英语法律文本

en.description: Activation spans legal rulings, negative statements, multilingual academic expressions, pharmacological terminology, arithmetic fractions, and experimental procedures. Local cues differ, with no stable shared trigger pattern explaining all fragments.

patterns.name: Negation followed by modality or judgment
patterns.context: A negation word and subsequent modal, verb, or judgment form a negative statement; the negation word itself is not always the activation point, so local context matters.
patterns.domain: General narrative, legal texts, film reviews

patterns.name: Legal judgments and discretionary wording
patterns.context: Judicial opinions discuss judicial discretion, legal authority, or witness examination; high activation falls on different words, including “will”, “not”, “be”, and “here”.

patterns.name: Expressions of necessity in Spanish
patterns.context: In the EU Treaty context, states that parliamentary approval is needed; high activation concentrates on “necesita la”.

patterns.name: Dependency relations in Portuguese
patterns.context: An academic conclusion states that a relation depends on individual or contextual characteristics; activation concentrates on “depender das características”.

patterns.name: Drug names and pharmacological classes
patterns.context: Introduces a drug and its receptor classification in experimental pharmacology; activation falls on the drug name “Phentol”.

patterns.name: Fractions and arithmetic expressions
patterns.context: Fractions with minus signs, parentheses, and operators occur in sequence in a math problem; activation concentrates on number tokens.

patterns.name: Experimental procedures and duration
patterns.context: The methods section describes participant operations and rest periods step by step; “for” and “60” show activation.

9_1610.description: 激活跨法律判词、否定陈述、多语种学术表达、药理术语、算术分数及实验步骤；局部线索各异，未见能解释全部片段的稳定共同触发模式。

patterns.name: 否定词后接情态或判断
patterns.trigger: “nothing in the world can”[1]；“will not be controlled”[3]；“Nothing in this section prevents”[4]；“nobody cares”[9]
patterns.context: 否定词及后续情态、动词或判断形成否定陈述；否定词本身不总是激活点，需结合局部上下文观察。
patterns.domain: 通用叙述、法律文本、影评

patterns.name: 法律判断与裁量措辞
patterns.trigger: “discretion of the trial judge which will not be controlled unless abused”[3]；“judges, pursuant to”[4]；“proper to inquire”[7]
patterns.context: 司法意见中说明法官裁量、法律权限或证人审查；高激活落在“will”“not”“be”“here”等不同词上。

patterns.name: 西班牙语中必要性表述
patterns.context: 欧盟条约语境中陈述需要议会批准；高激活集中于“necesita la”。
patterns.domain: 西班牙语议会／政治文本

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语中依赖关系
patterns.context: 学术结论说明关系取决于个体或情境特征；激活集中在“depender das características”。

patterns.name: 药物名称及药理分类
patterns.context: 实验药理学中介绍药物及其受体分类；激活落在药名“Phentol”。

patterns.name: 分数与算术表达式
patterns.context: 数学题中连续出现带负号的分数、括号及运算符；激活集中于数字 token。

patterns.name: 实验流程与时长
patterns.context: 方法部分按步骤描述参与者操作及休息时间；“for”“60”出现激活。

en.concept: Diverse word fragments and local expressions
en.description: Activations are scattered across languages and genres: Spanish expressions of need, legal case-law formulas and discussions of witness credibility, negative expressions, numbers in mathematical formulas, imperative phrases, and Portuguese word fragments. Trigger conditions are local and vary considerably, with no single stable feature apparent.

patterns.name: Spanish word form for “need”
patterns.context: In a Spanish sentence, “se necesita” follows “se” and means “is needed”; it is followed by the noun phrase “la aprobación”.

patterns.name: Function words in a judicial review formula
patterns.context: Describes the standard for appellate review of evidentiary rulings or trial-court discretion, especially the judicial formula “will not be controlled unless abused”.

patterns.name: Negation and existential quantifier emphasis
patterns.context: Activation falls on an initial word in a negative or restrictive expression; one example is “nothing in the world can”, another is the sentence-initial “Without directly replying”. They have no clear shared syntactic context.
patterns.domain: Personal essay/football fan profile; nineteenth-century novel dialogue and narrative

patterns.name: Fractions and rational-number operations
patterns.context: Equations and evaluation problems involving negative numbers, integers, or fractions; number activations are inconsistent, and other similar numbers are often unmarked.

patterns.name: Witness credibility and adversarial cross-examination
patterns.context: Legal discourse states that questioning an adverse witness and presenting material affecting credibility are appropriate; the sentence “Nowhere is this better established” is prominent.

patterns.name: Imperative in a celebrity anecdote
patterns.context: A report recounts someone backstage telling another person to leave a locker room; high activation falls on the command “get out”.

patterns.name: Portuguese internal word fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments within Portuguese words: “somente” (“only”) and “depender” (“depend on”); there is no clear shared semantic or syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Academic abstract on the relationship between creativity, innovation, and CT

9_1610.concept: 多样词片段与局部表达
9_1610.description: 激活分散于多种语言和文体：西语需要表达、法律判例公式及证人可信度论述、否定表达、数学算式数字、命令短语、葡语词内片段。触发条件局部且彼此差异明显，难以归为单一稳定特征。

patterns.name: 西班牙语「需要」词形
patterns.context: 西班牙语句中在“se”之后构成“se necesita”，表示需要；后面接名词短语“la aprobación”。
patterns.domain: 欧盟政治／法律制度说明，EuroParl

patterns.name: 司法审查公式中的功能词
patterns.trigger: «will»5« not»8« be»9« controlled»4« unless»4；另有« discretion»5、« judge»4
patterns.context: 描述证据采信或审判裁量受上诉审查的标准，尤其是“will not be controlled unless abused”这一司法公式。

patterns.name: 否定与存在量化强调
patterns.context: 激活落在否定或限制性表达的起始词上；一例为“nothing in the world can”，另一例为句首“Without directly replying”。两者没有明显共同句法环境。
patterns.domain: 个人随笔／足球爱好者简介；十九世纪小说对话叙事

patterns.name: 分数与有理数运算
patterns.context: 包含负数、整数或分数的算式及求值题；数字激活不稳定，其他类似数字常未标记。

patterns.name: 证人可信度与对抗式盘问
patterns.context: 法律论述称询问不利证人的动机、展示影响可信度的材料是适当的；突出句中“Nowhere is this better established”。

patterns.name: 名人轶事中的命令词
patterns.context: 报道人物在后台转述他人命令某人离开更衣室；高激活落在命令“get out”上。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在葡萄牙语词内部片段：“somente”（仅仅）以及“depender”（取决于）；无明显共同语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 关于创造力、创新与CT关系的学术摘要

en.description: Activation spans literary, legal, Spanish, medical, and mathematical texts, involving function words, emphatic words, legal formulae, word-internal subword fragments, numeric variables, and punctuation. There is no single stable trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Emphasized words or phrases
patterns.context: Ordinary words are highlighted in sentences to express strong judgment, ability, or emotion; activation may also mark only a local word within a phrase.

patterns.name: Negation words and modal expressions
patterns.context: Activation falls on function words in negation, obligation, or future-modal structures, but the marked words are inconsistent.

patterns.name: Negation and judicial terminology in legal phrasing
patterns.context: Legal arguments or rulings contain fixed expressions involving negation, discretion, and court procedure.

patterns.name: Spanish word forms and affix fragments
patterns.context: In Spanish texts, words are split into multiple tokens; high activation falls on internal word fragments and a few function words.

patterns.name: Morpheme/subword fragments within English words
patterns.context: Medical terms are split into subwords, with activation concentrated on spelling fragments rather than whole words.

patterns.name: Numbers and variables in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Tokens near numbers, variables, and punctuation are activated in equations and algebraic expressions.

patterns.name: Direct quotations and punctuation in dialogue
patterns.context: Question marks and line-break markers are activated in literary dialogue; ordinary English words in the same passage are also activated, so no unified trigger rule is apparent.

patterns.name: Sporadic activation of English vocabulary
patterns.context: These words occur in different semantic and syntactic contexts, and the available samples are insufficient to identify shared conditions.

9_1610.concept: 异质的局部 token 激活
9_1610.description: 激活分布跨文学、法律、西班牙语、医学与数学文本，涉及功能词、强调词、法律固定语、词内子词片段、数字变量及标点；没有单一稳定触发模式。

patterns.name: 被强调的词或短语
patterns.context: 句中普通词被突出，表达强烈判断、能力或情感；也可能只标记短语中的局部词。
patterns.domain: 个人足球博客，口语叙事

patterns.name: 否定词与情态表达
patterns.context: 否定、义务或将来情态结构中，激活落在功能词上；但标记并不一致。

patterns.name: 法律句式中的否定及裁判用语
patterns.context: 法律论证或判决中出现否定、裁量权和法院程序的固定表达。

patterns.name: 西班牙语词形与词缀片段
patterns.context: 西班牙语文本中，词被拆成多个 token；高激活落在词内片段及少量虚词上。

patterns.name: 英文词内的 morpheme/子词片段
patterns.context: 医学术语被切分成子词，激活集中于拼写片段，而非完整词。

patterns.name: 数学表达中的数字与变量
patterns.context: 方程和代数式中，数字、变量及标点附近的 token 被激活。

patterns.name: 对话中的直接引语与标点
patterns.context: 文学对白中，问号和换行标记被激活；同段还出现普通英文词激活，无法归入统一触发规则。

patterns.name: 英语词汇的零散激活
patterns.context: 这些词出现在不同语义和句法环境中，现有样本不足以确定共同条件。

en.description: Activation is scattered across diverse texts and word forms: not/will/to in legal sentences, n in negative contractions, and isolated triggers such as without, necesita, amnestic, 15 min, and nothing. No stable semantic or stylistic pattern consistently accounts for all passages.

patterns.name: Negation and judgment expressions in English judicial texts
patterns.context: In legal arguments, courts or rules express discretion, standards of review, or procedural principles; the negation word not is especially prominent, and “not attempt” and “to secure” also occur.

patterns.name: Part of a negative contraction in English sentences
patterns.context: The “n” within a negative contraction is prominent, used respectively in a general statement and a character’s quotation.

patterns.name: Need expressions in Spanish necesita
patterns.context: In a Spanish sentence, approval by Parlamento is a required condition; activation concentrates on a stem fragment of necesitar.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial contrast with English without
patterns.context: In a narrative, a character does not answer directly; the sentence-initial preposition without introduces a manner of acting or an absent condition.

patterns.name: Letter fragment in the English word amnestic
patterns.context: In a pharmacology abstract, the terms amnestic and antiamnestic occur together; the prominent feature is the internal n fragment.

patterns.name: Time and units after experimental steps
patterns.context: In a tissue-staining workflow, hydrogen peroxide treatment is described, followed by its duration.

patterns.name: Negation fragment in nothing
patterns.context: A personal statement uses nothing to introduce something that has no equal in the world; the prominent fragment is within the negative pronoun.

9_1610.description: 激活分散于多种文本与词形：法律语句中的 not/will/to，否定缩写中的 n，及 without、necesita、amnestic、15 min、nothing 等孤立触发点。未见可统一覆盖所有段落的稳定语义或文体模式。

patterns.name: 英语司法文本中的否定与判断表达
patterns.context: 法律论证中，法院或规则表达裁量、审查标准、程序原则；否定词 not 尤其突出，也见 “not attempt” 和 “to secure”。

patterns.name: 英语句中否定缩写的部分
patterns.context: 否定缩写内部的 “n” 处于突出位置，分别用于泛论和人物引语。

patterns.name: 西班牙语 necesita 中的需要表达
patterns.context: 西班牙语句中 Parlamento 批准是所需条件；激活集中于 necesitar 的词干片段。

patterns.name: 英语 without 的句首转折
patterns.context: 叙述中人物没有直接回答，句首介词 without 引出行为方式或缺失条件。

patterns.name: 英语 amnestic 词中的字母片段
patterns.context: 药理学摘要中，术语 amnestic 与 antiamnestic 并列；突出的是词内 n 片段。

patterns.name: 实验步骤后的时间与单位
patterns.context: 组织染色实验流程中，先描述过氧化氢处理，随后标明处理时长。

patterns.name: nothing 中的否定词片段
patterns.context: 个人陈述以 nothing 引出世界上无可匹敌的事物；突出片段在否定代词词内。

en.description: Activation is scattered across will not and rule purposes in legal texts, parliamentary word forms in two languages, English negative contractions, emphatic expressions, experimental durations, and fictional narratives. There is no unified stable semantic or stylistic pattern.

patterns.name: Negation/restriction in legal discretion or court decisions
patterns.context: Courts discuss discretionary decisions not being interfered with, or state that a court will not take a particular action; activation mainly falls near not or will

patterns.name: “to secure” in the purpose of a judicial rule
patterns.context: Introduces the purpose of the Federal Rules of Procedure; strong activation concentrates on secure

patterns.name: Spanish expressions of necessity
patterns.context: Discusses cases requiring European Parliament approval under the Lisbon Treaty; the trigger word occurs in a statement of necessity

patterns.name: Greek participatory forms
patterns.context: Discusses mechanisms introduced to encourage fishermen to participate; activation concentrates on an internal fragment of the Greek word for “participate”

patterns.name: Emphatic expression about the world/ability
patterns.context: A personal profile emphatically states that something is unmatched; activation falls on words such as nothing, world, and can

patterns.name: Fragment within a negative contraction
patterns.context: When discussing the flexibility of successful people, the wasn fragment in a negative contraction shows strong activation

patterns.name: Fragment within a negative contraction
patterns.context: Discusses a situation seeming strange to those unaccustomed to it; the aren fragment within a negative contraction is activated

patterns.name: Time quantity and experimental procedure steps
patterns.context: Biomedical tissue-section methods describe hydrogen peroxide treatment and its duration; the highest activation is on 15

patterns.name: Absence of a direct response in dialogue
patterns.context: In a narrative, a character does not answer directly and then takes action; activation concentrates on sentence-initial Without

9_1610.description: 激活分散于法律中的 will not 与规则目的、两种语言的议会词形、英语否定缩略词、强调表达、实验时长及小说叙事；没有统一稳定的语义或文体模式。

patterns.name: 法律裁量或法院决定中的否定/限制表述
patterns.trigger: «will» «not»（[1] 为 not be controlled；[10] 为 will not attempt）
patterns.context: 法院论述裁量决定不受干预，或说明法院不会采取某项做法；激活主要落在 not 或 will 一带

patterns.name: 司法规则目的中的“to secure”
patterns.trigger: «to» «secure» the just, speedy and inexpensive determination
patterns.context: 介绍联邦程序规则的目的；强激活集中在 secure

patterns.name: 西班牙语必要性表达
patterns.context: 谈《里斯本条约》扩大需要欧洲议会批准的情形；触发词位于关于必要性的表述中
patterns.domain: EuroParl 西班牙语议会文本

patterns.name: 希腊语参与词形
patterns.context: 谈引入鼓励渔民参与的机制；激活集中在希腊语“参与”词的词内片段

patterns.name: 世界/能力的强调表达
patterns.context: 个人简介中以强调语气宣称某事无可匹敌；激活落在 nothing、world、can 等词
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 足球主题个人陈述

patterns.name: 否定句中的缩略词内片段
patterns.context: 谈成功者灵活性时，否定缩略形式内的 wasn 片段获得强激活

patterns.name: 否定缩略词内片段
patterns.context: 谈某种情形对不习惯者而言显得奇怪；激活落在否定缩略形式 aren 的词内片段

patterns.name: 时间数量及实验操作步骤
patterns.context: 组织切片实验方法中，描述过氧化氢处理及持续时间；最高激活在 15
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学实验方法

patterns.name: 对话中直接回应的缺席
patterns.context: 叙事中人物没有直接回答，随后采取行动；激活集中在句首 Without

en.description: Activations occur across languages and genres: local words and phrases concerning participation, need, nominal status, negative evaluation, or replies, as well as recurring legal-text patterns with will not plus a verb and exception/conditional review language; experimental duration numbers also occur.

patterns.name: Need/necessity expressions
patterns.context: A sentence states that an action or approval is “necessary”, followed by an object or condition; only one instance.

patterns.name: Participation-related word form
patterns.context: Describes a new mechanism encouraging a group to participate; the Greek word form is split into fragments.

patterns.name: Negative expression for a direct reply
patterns.context: In dialogue narration, a character does not answer directly, after which their action is recounted; appears once.

patterns.name: Negative judgment in judicial discretion/review
patterns.context: A court states that a discretionary decision will not be controlled unless there is abuse; a similar legal “will not … unless” structure also occurs in appellate review.

patterns.name: Court does not attempt to elaborate
patterns.context: A court states that the document will not detail the allegations here; a procedural note in a legal memorandum.

patterns.name: Negative evaluation/possibility statement
patterns.context: Uses “nothing in the world can…” for a strong evaluation; only one instance.

patterns.name: Nominal status/representation of a committee
patterns.context: A parliamentary report is submitted in the committee's name; activation is concentrated on the Portuguese expression for “on behalf of/in the name of”.

patterns.name: Stem in a negative contraction
patterns.context: The English quotation contains wasn’t, with strong activation on a stem fragment after the split; the context discusses successful people.

patterns.name: Experimental duration number
patterns.context: An experimental procedure gives the hydrogen peroxide treatment duration as “15 min”; activation falls near the number and unit.

patterns.name: Statement that a court will not reverse
patterns.context: Explains that an appellate court will not reverse a district court decision unless a subsequent condition is met; this shares the legal review structure with passage 4 but has a different predicate.

9_1610.concept: 分散的否定与判断表达
9_1610.description: 激活分布于多种语言和文体：有参与、需要、名义、否定评价或回答等局部词句，也反复出现在法律文本的 will not 加动词及例外／条件式审查表述；另有实验时长数字。

patterns.name: 需要／需要性表述
patterns.context: 句中表达某种行动或批准是“必需的”，后接对象或条件；只有一例。
patterns.domain: 西班牙语欧洲议会文本

patterns.name: 参与／参加相关词形
patterns.context: 描述新机制鼓励某群体参与；希腊语词形分片标记。

patterns.name: 直接回应的否定表达
patterns.context: 对话叙述中，人物没有直接回答，随后转述其动作；只出现一次。

patterns.name: 司法裁量／审查中的否定判断
patterns.context: 法院表述裁量决定不受控制，除非存在滥用；相近的“will not … unless”法律句式也见于判决审查。

patterns.name: 法院不尝试详述
patterns.context: 法院说明本文件不会在此详尽列述指控；法律备忘录中的程序性说明。

patterns.name: 否定式评价／可能性陈述
patterns.context: 以“世界上没有什么能……”表达强烈评价；只有一例。

patterns.name: 委员会名义／名义身份
patterns.context: 议会报告由委员会名义提交；激活集中在葡语“代表／以……名义”表达。
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语欧洲议会程序文本

patterns.name: 否定缩写中的词干
patterns.context: 英语引语中出现 wasn’t，强激活落在分词后的词干片段；上下文谈及成功人士。

patterns.name: 实验时长数字
patterns.context: 实验步骤中给出过氧化氢处理时长“15 min”；激活落在数字及单位附近。

patterns.name: 法院不会撤销的表述
patterns.context: 说明上诉法院除非满足后续条件，否则不会推翻地区法院决定；与第4段同属法律审查句式，但谓语不同。

en.description: Activation is scattered across English legal will not be/not to constructions and sentence-initial Without; Spanish necesita and internal subword fragments of Greek implementation- and usage-related words also appear in EU texts. Across languages and styles, these are difficult to attribute to a single trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Negated “will not be”
patterns.context: In legal analysis, especially when courts discuss discretion or standards of review, will not be occurs consecutively; it is often near a passive predicate.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and legal memoranda

patterns.name: Not in legal negation or obligation structures
patterns.context: Not is followed by an infinitive, expressing that a court must not take a particular action; occurs alongside discussion of legal review and judicial discretion.

patterns.name: Spanish necesita
patterns.context: In Spanish sentences, necesita expresses need in institutional explanations about the EU Treaty, parliamentary approval, and similar topics.

patterns.name: Greek εφαρμογή (implementation)
patterns.context: In Greek policy contexts, refers to implementation of a policy or rule; the word is split into multiple subword tokens.

patterns.name: Greek χρησιμοποίηση (use)
patterns.context: In Greek safety and health regulations, the word refers to the use of equipment; activation falls on split fragments within the word.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Without in direct speech
patterns.context: In English narrative, sentence-initial Without directly replying introduces an action in which a character does not answer directly.

patterns.name: n't within a negative word
