patterns.context: In English quotation, the negative contraction wasn't occurs in a sentence describing the character of successful people.

patterns.name: n't within a negative word
patterns.context: In an English blog post, nothing is followed by the generalizing expression in the world can…; the highlighted fragment spans the negation word and the following preposition.

9_1610.concept: 否定与制度性词语片段
9_1610.description: 激活分散于法律英语的 will not be／not to、英语否定词及句首 Without；另见欧盟文本中西语 necesita 和希腊语实施、使用类词的内部子词片段。跨语言与文体，难以归为单一触发模式。

patterns.name: 否定式「will not be」
patterns.context: 法律论述中，尤其法院说明裁量或审查标准时，连续出现 will not be；附近常有被动谓语。
patterns.domain: 美国判例与法律备忘录

patterns.name: 法律否定或义务结构中的 not
patterns.context: not 后接不定式，表达法院不得采取某种做法；与法律审查、司法裁量论述相邻。

patterns.name: 西班牙语 necesita
patterns.context: 西班牙语句子中，以 necesita 表达需要，处于欧盟条约、议会批准等制度性说明里。
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会西班牙语文本

patterns.name: 希腊语 εφαρμογή（实施）
patterns.context: 希腊语政策语境中，表示政策或规则的实施；词被切分成多个子词 token。

patterns.name: 希腊语 χρησιμοποίηση（使用）
patterns.context: 希腊语安全与健康规范中，词语表示设备的使用；激活落在该词内部的切分片段。
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会希腊语法规文本

patterns.name: Without 直接引语开头
patterns.context: 英文叙事中，句首 Without directly replying 引出人物未直接回答的动作。

patterns.name: 否定词内的 n't
patterns.context: 英文引语中，否定缩写 wasn't 出现在描述成功者性格的句子里。

patterns.name: 否定词内的 n't
patterns.context: 英文博文中，nothing 后接 in the world can… 的泛指表达；高亮片段跨在否定词及后续介词上。

en.description: Activations are scattered across languages and genres: English negative forms and restrictive expressions, internal fragments in Spanish and Greek words, and digit substrings in math problems. There is no clear unified semantic or formal feature.

patterns.name: Negative auxiliary and following action in English sentences
patterns.context: English sentences use not in structures such as will not be controlled and will not attempt; activation is especially concentrated on not and the following predicate

patterns.name: Internal fragment of Spanish necesitar
patterns.context: In a Spanish sentence, the verb necesitar is split into subword fragments; the context concerns a requirement for parliamentary approval

patterns.name: Internal fragment of Greek συμμετέχουν
patterns.context: A sequence of Greek subword fragments forms a verb meaning participate, in the context of fisheries policy measures

patterns.name: English adverb directly
patterns.context: Sentence-initial Without directly replying introduces a narrative in which a character does not answer directly

patterns.name: English negative pronoun nothing
patterns.context: A football fan states that nothing in the world can match the emotional experience of football

patterns.name: English negative contraction n't
patterns.context: The character quotation contains wasn’t, in a summary of successful people's flexibility

patterns.name: Mathematical numerical and operator strings
patterns.context: In symbolic math problems, activation falls on numbers or digit substrings; examples involve equations, fractions, algebraic expressions, and evaluation

9_1610.description: 激活分散于不同语言和文体：英语否定形式、否定或限制性表达，西班牙语及希腊语词内片段，以及数学题中的数字子串。各处缺少统一明显的语义或形式特征。

patterns.name: 英语句中否定助动词与后续动作
patterns.context: 英语句子中，否定词 not 出现在 will not be controlled、will not attempt 等结构里；激活尤其集中于 not 及其后续谓语

patterns.name: 西班牙语 necesitar 的词内片段
patterns.context: 西班牙语句中，动词 necesitar 被分成子词片段；上下文是需要议会批准的条件

patterns.name: 希腊语 συμμετέχουν 的词内片段
patterns.context: 希腊语连续子词片段组成表示参与的动词，处于捕鱼政策措施的语境

patterns.name: 英语副词 directly
patterns.context: 句首 Without directly replying，引出人物没有直接回答的叙事

patterns.name: 英语否定代词 nothing
patterns.context: 足球爱好者陈述世界上没有任何事物能比得上足球带来的情感体验

patterns.name: 英语否定缩写 n't
patterns.context: 人物引语中的缩写 wasn’t，出现在对成功人士灵活性的概括中

patterns.name: 数学数值与运算符号串
patterns.context: 符号化数学题中，激活落在数字或数字子串；涉及方程、分数、代数表达式与求值

en.description: Activations across all segments fall on Bessel, vessel, or word fragments containing essel; contexts include Bessel mathematical terms and names, as well as vessels, microvessels, hulls, and anatomical names. Segment 1 also contains cloak vocabulary, with no clear connection to the main word form.

patterns.name: High-activation substrings in Bessel terminology
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on the spelling fragment Bessel or essel near word-internal or word boundaries; examples occur in mathematical terms, names, and vessel-related words.
patterns.domain: Mathematics and science papers, medical papers, patents

patterns.name: Invisibility-cloak vocabulary
patterns.context: Discussion of invisibility cloaks and their shells; Bessel analysis also appears in the same segment.

patterns.name: Vessel and balloon-catheter contexts
patterns.context: Descriptions of balloon overexpansion and balloon-to-vessel ratios.

patterns.name: Microvessel density and tissue assessment
patterns.context: Tissue sections, protein-expression scoring, and microvessel-density quantification occur near one another.

patterns.name: Bessel potentials and kernels
patterns.context: Local properties of Bessel potentials, or discussions of convergence and universality involving Bessel kernels and other kernels.

patterns.name: The name Bessel van der Kolk
patterns.context: The name Bessel van der Kolk appears in writing about bodily imprints and trauma.

patterns.name: The anatomical name Kiesselbach
patterns.context: Appears within the name Kiesselbach plexus in patent descriptions of the nasal septal mucosa and intranasal drug delivery.

patterns.name: Microvessel formation and cytokines
patterns.context: Discussion of IL-19's effects on endothelial cells and microvessel formation.

patterns.name: Vessel structures and deployment
patterns.context: Descriptions of floating hulls and their carried structures, rigid connections, and deployment of underwater objects.

patterns.name: Multivessel disease
patterns.context: Multivessel disease is mentioned among factors associated with stent thrombosis.

9_1724.description: 各段激活都落在 Bessel、vessel 或含 essel 的词形片段上；涵盖 Bessel 数学术语与姓名，以及血管、微血管、船体和解剖名称等语境。第1段另有 cloak 词汇，但与该主词形无明显关联。

patterns.name: Bessel 术语中的高激活子串
patterns.context: 激活集中在拼写片段 Bessel 或词内/词界附近的 essel；出现在数学术语、姓名以及血管相关词中。
patterns.domain: 数学与科学论文、医学论文、专利

patterns.name: 不可见斗篷词汇
patterns.context: 讨论隐形斗篷及其外壳；同段也出现 Bessel 分析。

patterns.name: 血管与球囊导管语境
patterns.context: 球囊过度扩张及 balloon-to-vessel 比值的描述。

patterns.name: 微血管密度与组织评估
patterns.context: 组织切片、蛋白表达评分及微血管密度定量相邻出现。

patterns.name: Bessel 势与核函数
patterns.context: Bessel potentials 的局部性质，或 Bessel 核与其他核的收敛、普适性讨论。

patterns.name: Bessel van der Kolk 姓名
patterns.context: 姓名 Bessel van der Kolk 出现在身体印记与创伤主题的文字中。
patterns.domain: 身心健康类非虚构文字

patterns.name: Kiesselbach 解剖名
patterns.context: 鼻中隔黏膜及鼻腔给药的专利描述中，出现在 Kiesselbach 丛名称内。

patterns.name: 微血管生成与细胞因子
patterns.context: 讨论 IL-19 对内皮细胞及微血管形成的作用。

patterns.name: vessel 结构与部署
patterns.context: 浮动船体及其携带结构、刚性连接和水下物体部署的描述。

patterns.name: 多血管疾病
patterns.context: 列举支架血栓相关因素时提到多血管疾病。

en.description: Activations primarily fall on the spelling fragments Bessel and vessel: the former appears in mathematical terms and names, while the latter appears in vascular terms and ordinary words for ships. Their commonality seems to be similar letter forms rather than a shared meaning or domain.

patterns.name: Bessel word fragment
patterns.context: The literal substring Bessel appears in mathematical papers, often modifying analysis, kernels, potentials, or functions; the context does not require a fixed phrase.

patterns.name: Word fragments containing vessel
patterns.context: Activations fall on internal fragments of vessel, appearing in vascular terms (e.g., microvessel, balloon:vessel, multivessel) as well as ordinary uses of vessel; meanings and domains vary.

patterns.name: Bessel in a name
patterns.context: Bessel is part of a person’s name, appearing in the name of a trauma author rather than in a mathematical term.

9_1724.description: 激活主要落在拼写片段 Bessel、vessel：前者见数学术语及人名，后者见血管词和普通船舶词；共同点更像相似字形片段，而非统一语义或领域。

patterns.name: Bessel 词片段
patterns.context: 字面子串 Bessel 出现在数学论文中，常修饰分析、核、势或函数；上下文不要求某一固定短语。

patterns.name: 含 vessel 的词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 vessel 的内部片段，出现在血管相关词（如 microvessel、balloon:vessel、multivessel）及普通 vessel 中；词义和领域不固定。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、专利及工程文本

patterns.name: 人名中的 Bessel
patterns.context: Bessel 是人名的一部分，出现在创伤作者姓名中，而非数学术语。

en.concept: Ind word-initial fragment and other word fragments
en.description: Primarily responds to word-initial Ind (Indiana, Indirect, Indications, Indocyanine), with strong activations also on local fragments of Bessel and anesthetics and the word-initial fragment of Investor; the contexts span domains and the triggering forms are not uniform.

patterns.name: Word-initial Ind-
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on the Ind substring at the beginning of a word, with no fixed continuation; examples include Indiana, Indirect, Indications, and Indocyanine.

patterns.name: Specific letter sequence Bessel
patterns.context: Appears in the technical term Fourier-Bessel analysis, with activations on an internal subword fragment of Bessel.

patterns.name: Local fragment at the end of anesthetics
patterns.context: In a medical sentence describing nerve damage, activations fall on a word-final fragment of anesthetics.

patterns.name: Word-initial fragment in an investor letter
patterns.context: Appears in the title “Value Matters: Investor Letter,” with activations on the beginning of Investor.

9_1724.description: 主要响应词首 Ind（Indiana、Indirect、Indications、Indocyanine），另对 Bessel、anesthetics 的局部片段及 Investor 词首有强激活；跨领域，触发形式并不统一。

patterns.name: 词首 Ind-
patterns.context: 激活集中在单词开头的 Ind 子串，后续词形不固定；包括 Indiana、Indirect、Indications、Indocyanine。

patterns.name: 特定字母串 Bessel
patterns.context: 出现在 Fourier-Bessel analysis 这一技术术语中，激活落在 Bessel 内部的子词片段。

patterns.name: 局部麻醉剂词尾
patterns.context: 在描述神经损伤的医学句子中，激活落在 anesthetics 的词尾片段。

patterns.name: 投资者信函词首
patterns.context: 出现在标题“Value Matters: Investor Letter”中，激活落在 Investor 的词首。

en.description: The strongest and most recurrent signal is word-initial Ind, spanning Indiana, the medical term Indications, and other Ind- words; remaining activations are sporadic, occurring on legal citation numbers, the ending of Trinity, and function words in chemical titles.

patterns.name: Ind-initial forms and the beginning of Indiana
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on word-initial Ind; this may continue as Indiana (e.g., Indiana Hoosiers, Indiana v. Edwards) or form other words.

patterns.name: Indications in medical vocabulary
patterns.context: The beginning of Indications triggers activation; examples occur in contexts involving medical indications, surgery, treatment, or outcomes.

patterns.name: Word-initial fragment of Indirect
patterns.context: Word-initial Ind is followed by direct to form indirect; this example also involves a description of light illumination.

patterns.name: In-word fragment in Indocyanine green
patterns.context: In the dye name Indocyanine green, activation is distributed across the beginning and subsequent in-word fragments.

patterns.name: Numbers and legal citation format
patterns.context: Reporter volume numbers, reporter abbreviations, and page numbers in U.S. case citations; strong activation falls on the volume-number digits.

patterns.name: In-word fragment in Trinity
patterns.context: In the proper name Trinity, activation concentrates on the ending fragment inity; occurs in institution names.

patterns.name: myristicyclin in a chemical name
patterns.context: A synthesis paper title contains synthesis, of, and a racemic marker; myristicyclin A itself is unmarked.

9_1724.description: 最强且反复的信号是词首 Ind，涵盖 Indiana、医学术语 Indications 及其他 Ind- 词；其余激活零散落在法律引证数字、Trinity 词尾和化学标题功能词等处。

patterns.name: Ind- 开头及 Indiana 词首
patterns.context: 激活集中在词首 Ind；后续可接 Indiana（如 Indiana Hoosiers、Indiana v. Edwards），也可继续构成其他词。
patterns.domain: 维基百科标题、医学摘要

patterns.name: 医学词汇中的 Indications
patterns.context: Indications 一词开头触发；出现在医学适应证、手术、治疗或结果相关语境。

patterns.name: Indirect 的词首片段
patterns.context: 词首 Ind 后接 direct，形成 indirect；本例还涉及光线照明的描述。

patterns.name: Indocyanine green 词内片段
patterns.context: 染料名称 Indocyanine green 中，激活分布于词首和后续词内片段。

patterns.name: 数字与法律引证格式
patterns.context: 美国判例引证中的报告卷号、报告集缩写和页码；强激活落在卷号数字。

patterns.name: Trinity 词内片段
patterns.context: 专名 Trinity 中，激活集中于词尾片段 inity；出现在机构名称中。

patterns.name: 化学名称中的 myristicyclin
patterns.context: 合成论文标题中出现合成、of 和外消旋标记；myristicyclin A 本身未标记。
patterns.domain: PubMed 化学/药物研究摘要标题

en.description: Primarily activates on the word-initial substring Ind, including Indiana, Indications, Indirect, and Indocyanine; it also activates on of in medical abstracts. The two types of triggers occur in different fragments, with no stable shared meaning or context observed.

patterns.name: Ind at the beginning of a word
patterns.context: The word-initial Ind substring can continue as different words, such as Indiana, Indications, Indirect, or Indocyanine; activation does not depend on any one complete word meaning.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic entries, patent backgrounds, and medical abstracts

patterns.name: Preposition of
patterns.context: of appears in a phrase, sometimes adjacent to sentence-initial or title-like structures such as Reconstitution and Reversal.

9_1724.description: 主要对词首子串 Ind 激活，涵盖 Indiana、Indications、Indirect、Indocyanine 等；另对医学摘要中的 of 有激活。两类触发分布在不同片段，未见稳定的共同语义或语境。

patterns.name: 单词开头 Ind
patterns.context: 词首的 Ind 子串；可续接为 Indiana、Indications、Indirect 或 Indocyanine 等不同词，触发并不依赖某一种完整词义。
patterns.domain: 百科、专利背景、医学摘要

patterns.name: 介词 of
patterns.context: 短语中出现 of；有时与句首或标题式的 Reconstitution、Reversal 等结构相邻。

en.description: The main pattern is token activation on word-initial Ind, especially in Indiana, Indications, Indirect, and Indocyanine; strong activations also occur on webpage source markers and in-word fragments of two Bulgarian words, which cannot be explained by one shared meaning or domain.

patterns.name: Word-initial Ind token activation
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on the beginnings of words or phrases starting with Ind; subsequent meanings and contexts vary.

patterns.name: Specific HTML/script markers
patterns.context: In Wikipedia page HTML/JavaScript configuration text, activation falls on specific markers and numbers rather than word-initial Ind.

patterns.name: In-word fragment in Bulgarian
patterns.context: Activation falls on an in-word fragment of the Bulgarian word «перспектива», in a sentence about people having prospects in rural areas.
patterns.domain: Bulgarian text from the European Parliament

patterns.name: Bulgarian in-word fragment and HTML
patterns.context: Activation falls on the initial fragment of the Bulgarian word «первые»; the word is embedded in HTML paragraph tags and webpage text.

9_1724.concept: 词首 Ind，另有离群激活
9_1724.description: 主要模式是词首 Ind 的分词激活，尤其是 Indiana、Indications、Indirect、Indocyanine；另有网页源码标记及两个保加利亚语词内片段的强激活，无法由同一词义或领域统一解释。

patterns.name: 词首 Ind 分词激活
patterns.trigger: 词首 «Ind»10；随后有时是 «ications»5、«irect»5 或 «ocy»9«anine»8« green»7
patterns.context: 激活集中在以 Ind 开头的词或短语开头；后续词义和上下文不固定。

patterns.name: 特定 HTML/脚本标记
patterns.context: 维基百科页面的 HTML/JavaScript 配置文本中，激活落在特定标记与数字上，而非 Ind 词首。

patterns.name: 保加利亚语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活位于保加利亚语词 «перспектива» 的词内片段，出现在句子谈及人们在乡村地区拥有前景的语境中。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会保加利亚语文本

patterns.name: 保加利亚语词内片段及 HTML
patterns.context: 激活位于保加利亚语词 «первые» 的开头片段；词语嵌在 HTML 段落标记和网页文本中。

en.concept: Boundaries and markers in technical phrases
en.description: Activations often fall on the ends of quoted technical phrases, titles, search terms, or proper names and their punctuation; they also occur on italicized scientific names, abbreviations, compound terms, numbers, and figure/table references. The shared feature across domains is a local boundary or marker cue, not a single topic.

patterns.name: Bibliographic information and source citation markers
patterns.context: When listing search terms, guideline names, paper titles, or cited content in sequence, especially at the end of quoted phrases and on following punctuation or citation markers
patterns.domain: Bibliographic and citation text in medical literature, patents, academic papers, and technical documents

patterns.name: Phrase endings in proper names or titles
patterns.context: Proper names, work titles, nicknames, or category labels appear as quoted phrases; activation falls at the phrase ending or on immediately following punctuation

patterns.name: Latin scientific names and italic boundaries
patterns.context: Latin scientific names of plant pathogens or microorganisms are set in italics, often alongside species names, disease descriptions, or scientific-name boundaries

patterns.name: Numbers and units/numerical expressions
patterns.context: Ages, years, statistical sample sizes, and measurements for individuals or study samples appear in prose or abstracts

patterns.name: Boundaries within compressed terms and technical names
patterns.context: Technical names formed by joining hyphens, abbreviations, and ordinary words, especially those related to image encoding and data compression

patterns.name: Psychometric/statistical method markers
patterns.context: Abbreviations and terms appearing when papers introduce model coefficients, regression results, or statistical visualizations

patterns.name: Boundaries of professional medical terms or diagnostic categories
patterns.context: Medical diagnoses, disease categories, or clinical guideline titles are listed as phrases, usually in quotation marks

patterns.name: Materials/process phrases and figure/table references
patterns.context: After describing coating materials, construction steps, or experimental subjects, parenthetical term labels and figure/table references provide additional information

9_1724.description: 激活常落在引号内的专业短语、题名、检索词或专名末尾及其标点，也见斜体学名、缩写、复合术语、数值和图表引用；跨领域共享的是局部边界/标记线索，而非单一主题。

patterns.name: 书目信息与来源引文标记
patterns.trigger: 引号中的文献题名或搜索词以逗号分隔，并以引文边界标记收尾，如 “carotid artery disease,”、“Management of cholestatic liver diseases,”、“Real-Time Image Redundancy Reduction Using Transform Coding Techniques,”；也包括 “vitreous finish,” 后的图号标记
patterns.context: 连续列举检索词、指南名称、论文题名或引文内容时，尤其在引号内的短语末尾及其后的标点/引用标记
patterns.domain: 医学文献、专利、学术论文及技术文档中的书目和引文文本

patterns.name: 专名或标题中的短语末尾
patterns.trigger: “Open Arms”、“Faithfully”、“I'll Be Alright Without You”中的 “Faithfully,”；“The Golden Child,”；“Old/Mid School”
patterns.context: 专名、作品名、绰号或类别标签作为引号中的短语出现，激活落在短语末尾或紧随其后的标点
patterns.domain: 百科条目、音乐与人物传记

patterns.name: 拉丁学名及其斜体边界
patterns.trigger: “Rhizoctonia solani”、“Pseudomonas syringae pv.”、“Lachrymans”、“Trichoderma”中的斜体标记 «*»
patterns.context: 植物病原体或微生物拉丁学名以斜体排印，常伴随物种名、病害描述或学名边界
patterns.domain: 植物病理学与生物医学论文

patterns.name: 数字与单位/数值表达
patterns.context: 人物或研究样本的年龄、年份、统计样本量及测量值出现在叙述或摘要中
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要与百科传记

patterns.name: 压缩术语及技术名称内部边界
patterns.trigger: “cosine-transform/DPCM compression algorithm”及“Transform Coding Techniques”中的复合技术术语
patterns.context: 连字符、缩写与普通词拼接构成的技术名称，尤其与图像编码、数据压缩相关

patterns.name: 心理测量/统计方法标记
patterns.context: 论文中介绍模型系数、回归结果或统计可视化时出现的缩写和术语
patterns.domain: 神经科学与统计方法论文

patterns.name: 专业医学术语或诊断类别边界
patterns.trigger: “cholestatic liver diseases,”及“carotid artery disease,”、“coronary artery disease,”
patterns.context: 医学诊断、疾病类别或临床指南标题以短语形式列出，通常位于引号中

patterns.name: 材料/工艺短语与图表引用
patterns.context: 描述涂层材料、施工步骤或实验对象后，以括号中的术语标签和图表引用补充说明

en.description: Strong activation primarily occurs on colons that connect a main title to a subtitle in academic titles, across topics such as medicine, engineering, and the environment; there is also a response to quotation marks in methods paragraphs and references to supplementary materials.

patterns.name: Colons in titles
patterns.context: A subtitle, study description, or specific research subject follows the main title; a long noun phrase usually precedes the colon.
patterns.domain: Academic paper titles, especially in medical and scientific literature

patterns.name: Quotation marks in methods passages and supplementary-material references
patterns.context: The main text describes methods or points to supplementary tables, with formatted cross-references.
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper text and supplementary materials

9_1724.concept: 学术文本中的结构标记
9_1724.description: 主要对学术标题中连接主标题与副标题的冒号强烈激活，跨医学、工程、环境等主题；另对方法段落的引号标注及补充材料引用有反应。

patterns.name: 标题中的冒号
patterns.context: 标题主标题之后接副标题、研究说明或具体研究对象；冒号前通常已有较长的名词短语。
patterns.domain: 学术论文标题，尤其是医学与科学文献

patterns.name: 方法文段中的引号与补充材料引用
patterns.context: 正文说明方法或指向补充表格，并出现格式化的交叉引用。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文正文及补充材料

en.concept: Sensitive to formatting boundaries and punctuation
en.description: Activations are distributed across colons and nearby numbers, field labels, percentages, and identifiers; they also occur on fragments of technical compound words, bibliographic title boundaries, and common function words. The corpus is mostly formatted emails and academic abstracts, with no unified pattern.

patterns.name: Numbers and formatted fields before colons
patterns.context: Numbers, times, or identifiers appear densely; activation concentrates on colons and adjacent numbers, often alongside spaces or line breaks
patterns.domain: Formatted text such as email meeting schedules and operations notices

patterns.name: Label headings introduced by colons
patterns.context: An all-caps section label in a report or abstract is followed by a colon; some heading characters are split into marked tokens
patterns.domain: Research grant abstracts, public health research abstracts

patterns.name: Percentages and experimental-condition values
patterns.context: Numbers and punctuation in quantitative results, proportions, or experimental conditions; values are usually embedded in sentences

patterns.name: Compound words in disease and research terminology
patterns.context: Technical long words, hyphenated words, or less common terms are split into multiple subword fragments; activations are distributed within and between words

patterns.name: Boundary punctuation in titles, proper names, and bibliographic information
patterns.context: Punctuation and boundary words are activated in research titles, project identifiers, and biographical or bibliographic records

patterns.name: English function words and comparison structures
patterns.context: Prepositions, articles, conjunctions, or comparison words in ordinary sentences; no single stable syntactic environment
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts and general academic text

patterns.name: Title case and abbreviation fields
patterns.context: Field labels, abbreviations, and capitalized text in email templates or research abstracts

9_1724.description: 激活分散于冒号及其邻近数字、栏目标签、百分比和编号，也见专业复合词片段、书目标题边界及常见功能词；语料多为格式化邮件和学术摘要，模式并不统一。

patterns.name: 冒号前的数字与格式字段
patterns.context: 数字、时间或标识符密集出现；激活集中在冒号及其相邻数字，常伴随空格或换行
patterns.domain: 邮件会议安排、运维通知等格式化文本

patterns.name: 冒号引出的标签标题
patterns.trigger: “PUBLIC HEALTH RELEVANCE:”“PARTICIPANTS:”“MAIN RESULTS:”中的冒号及标题文字
patterns.context: 报告或摘要中全大写栏目标签之后接冒号，部分标题字符被拆分标记
patterns.domain: 科研资助摘要、公共卫生研究摘要

patterns.name: 百分比与实验条件数值
patterns.context: 定量结果、比例或实验条件中的数字和标点；数值通常嵌在句子中

patterns.name: 疾病与研究术语中的复合词
patterns.context: 专业长词、连字符词或较少见术语被拆成多个子词片段；激活散布于词内及词间
patterns.domain: 眼科、药理、生物医学摘要

patterns.name: 标题、专名与书目信息的边界标点
patterns.trigger: “Clinical Trial * 15-EI-10038:”“Bonnie Zimmerman interviewed by Susan Sayer”“Lesbian Nation:”“Study”后的引号
patterns.context: 研究标题、项目编号、人物书目记录中，标点和边界词获得激活
patterns.domain: 临床试验登记、访谈/书目记录

patterns.name: 英语功能词及比较结构
patterns.context: 普通句子中的介词、冠词、连词或比较词；并无单一稳定句法环境
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要及一般学术文本

patterns.name: 标题式大小写与缩写字段
patterns.context: 邮件模板或科研摘要中的字段标签、缩写和大写格式文本
patterns.domain: 企业运维邮件、科研摘要

en.description: Activations are distributed across genres: structural markers in research text, study-plan titles, and medical terminology; they also occur in recipe steps, Japanese order-status explanations, and news headlines. No single meaning covers all examples.

patterns.name: Punctuation or structural boundaries in medical and research text
patterns.context: In research abstracts, study plans, or paper text, punctuation is followed by objectives, methods, results, headings, or new paragraphs; not all punctuation triggers activation, so consider this alongside other patterns
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, NIH study plans, research reports

patterns.name: Study-plan titles and application terminology
patterns.context: In structured study plans or applications, heading labels and colons introduce objectives, plans, or application descriptions; the recipe step label «Mixture:» also shows strong activation
patterns.domain: NIH grant applications and research plans; also cooking recipes

patterns.name: Specialized discipline terms ending in -ology
patterns.context: Professional medical terms appear in research objectives or care descriptions in the context of cancer treatment research

patterns.name: Acute promyelocytic leukemia terminology
patterns.context: Describes leukemia cells, cell lines, and related biological mechanisms

patterns.name: Kidney-disease section headings
patterns.context: A paper poses, as a question, whether a particular biomarker can distinguish diseases

patterns.name: Katakana words in Japanese order-status explanations
patterns.context: Japanese customer-service or system explanations describing updates to website order status and related information when a receiving function malfunctions
patterns.domain: Japanese technical support or e-commerce explanations

patterns.name: PLAY BALL headline
patterns.context: An all-caps English phrase appears in a news caption or page headline
patterns.domain: News coverage, sports or entertainment pages

patterns.name: Recipe steps and utensil descriptions
patterns.context: Baking or cooking instructions describing oven temperature, a frying pan, and preparation steps

patterns.name: Antibody labels in biomedical research
patterns.context: Describes the therapeutic effects of antibody preparations, vaccines, or tumor models
patterns.domain: Immunology, oncology, and infectious disease research

9_1724.description: 激活分布在多种体裁：科研文本的结构标记、研究计划标题和医学专业术语；另见食谱步骤、日文订单状态说明及新闻标题。没有单一词义能覆盖全部例子。

patterns.name: 医学与科研文本中的标点或结构边界
patterns.trigger: 高激活常落在段落或句子边界标点，如 «:»、«.»、«↵»；也包括论文小节标题中的 «?»
patterns.context: 科研摘要、研究计划或论文正文中，标点后接目标、方法、结果、标题或新段落；但并非所有标点都触发，需结合其他模式看
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、NIH 研究计划、科研报告

patterns.name: 研究计划标题及申报术语
patterns.context: 结构化研究计划或申请材料中，标题标签和冒号引出目标、方案或应用说明；食谱中的步骤标签 «Mixture:» 也有强激活
patterns.domain: NIH 资助申请、科研计划；另有烹饪食谱

patterns.name: 以 -ology 结尾的专业学科词
patterns.context: 癌症治疗研究语境中，专业医学词出现在研究目标或照护描述里

patterns.name: 急性早幼粒细胞白血病术语
patterns.context: 描述白血病细胞、细胞系及相关生物机制

patterns.name: 肾脏疾病小节标题
patterns.trigger: «Does suPAR Discriminate Primary FSGS from Other Proteinuric Kidney Diseases?»
patterns.context: 论文中以疑问句形式提出特定生物标志物能否鉴别疾病的问题
patterns.domain: 肾脏病学论文小节标题

patterns.name: 日文订单状态说明中的片假名词
patterns.context: 日文客服或系统说明，讲述接收功能异常时网站订单状态等信息的更新
patterns.domain: 日语技术支持或电商说明

patterns.name: PLAY BALL 标题
patterns.context: 新闻图注或版面标题中出现大写英文短语
patterns.domain: 新闻报道、体育或娱乐版面

patterns.name: 食谱步骤与器具描述
patterns.context: 烘焙或烹饪指令，描述烤箱温度、平底锅及准备步骤

patterns.name: 生物医学研究中的抗体标签
patterns.context: 描述抗体制剂、疫苗或肿瘤模型中的治疗作用
patterns.domain: 免疫学、肿瘤学与传染病研究

en.description: The most consistent activation feature across segments is the comma, often at the boundary of a clause, parenthetical, appositive, or list; some segments also involve parentheses, quotations, or punctuation adjacent to line breaks. Languages and topics vary.

patterns.name: Activation on commas and neighboring words
patterns.context: Activation generally falls on comma tokens; words around commas often mark clause, parenthetical, or list boundaries, but languages and content vary.
patterns.domain: Multilingual text, including parliamentary speeches, news, encyclopedias, and medical texts

patterns.name: Parentheticals and discourse transitions in French parliament
patterns.context: In French parliamentary contexts, commas set off forms of address, concessive parentheticals, or evaluative phrases from the rest of a sentence.

patterns.name: Commas in English quotations and news sentences
patterns.context: Commas separate place-name abbreviations, quoted information, or appositives; the neuron also activates on punctuation after closing parentheses.

patterns.name: Punctuation after closing parentheses or figure citations
patterns.context: Punctuation occurs near the boundary of an inserted structure formed by parentheses or citation markers.

patterns.name: Speech-marker boundaries in parliamentary transcripts
patterns.context: Commas are adjacent to line breaks or parentheses in descriptions recording collective parliamentary actions.

9_1724.description: 各段激活最一致的特征是逗号，常处于从句、插入语、同位语或列举的边界；部分段还涉及括号、引语或换行相邻的标点。语言与主题多样。

patterns.name: 逗号及其前后词的激活
patterns.context: 激活普遍落在逗号 token；逗号前后常为从句、插入语或列举边界，但具体语言和内容不同。
patterns.domain: 多语种文本；议会发言、新闻、百科及医学文本等

patterns.name: 法语议会中的插入语和话语衔接
patterns.trigger: « chers »collègues« , »« à »observer；« Par dérogation »,；« Le problème », c'est；« avec raison »,
patterns.context: 法语议会语境中，逗号将呼语、让步插入语或评价性短语与句子其余部分分隔。

patterns.name: 英语引语与新闻句中的逗号
patterns.context: 逗号用于地名缩写、引语信息或同位语分隔；神经元也激活在括号闭合后的标点位置。

patterns.name: 括号闭合或图表引用后的标点
patterns.context: 标点位于括号或引用标记构成的插入结构边界附近。

patterns.name: 议会逐字记录中的发言标记边界
patterns.context: 逗号与换行、括号相邻，出现在记录议会集体动作的叙述中。

en.description: Activations are distributed across multilingual, cross-domain texts and often fall on boundaries such as commas, periods, or line breaks, and on nearby connectives, parentheticals, and concessive structures. Specific triggering contexts vary considerably; other examples include code explanations, scientific naming, and quoted news.

patterns.name: Contrast or question introduction within a French sentence
patterns.context: Activations fall on a comma and the following “the question is…” structure; preceding text discusses policy or institutional issues.

patterns.name: Commas in medical records
patterns.context: In French clinical records, sentences describing medical history, examinations, or test results are separated by commas.

patterns.name: Commas in French commentary
patterns.context: In statements of public opinion or evaluation, a comma is followed by an additional comment phrase.

patterns.name: Commas and parentheticals in French legislative sentences
patterns.context: In legal or parliamentary texts, commas mark inserted exceptions or qualifiers.

patterns.name: Comma and conjunctive adverb in Italian sentences
patterns.context: Formal Italian texts use commas to set off the sentence-initial or medial conjunctive adverb “inoltre” (moreover).

patterns.name: Commas around a French parenthetical
patterns.context: In French commentary, commas enclose the medial conjunctive adverb “donc”; the surrounding text expresses an inference.

patterns.name: Concessive structure in a code explanation
patterns.context: Expected code behavior is described first, followed by “Even when” introducing a case that does not match expectations.

patterns.name: Appositive explanation in a scientific abstract
patterns.context: A novel tracer is named and its abbreviation given in parentheses, followed by a comma leading into a description of the study.

patterns.name: Parenthetical comment in an Italian subordinate clause
patterns.context: In formal political discourse, a comma introduces an inserted comment such as “I think” or an expression like “besides.”

patterns.name: Punctuation after a quotation in English news
patterns.context: A line break and paragraph division follow the closing quotation mark in news narration; the content concerns an anti-LGBT leaflet.

9_1724.description: 激活分布于多语种、多领域文本，常落在逗号、句号或换行等边界及其邻近的连接词、插入语、让步结构上；具体触发语境差异较大，另见代码说明、科研命名与新闻引语。

patterns.name: 法语句中转折或问题引出
patterns.context: 激活落在逗号及其后的“问题是……”结构；前文讨论政策或制度问题。
patterns.domain: 法语欧洲议会政治论述

patterns.name: 医学病历中的逗号
patterns.context: 法语临床记录中，描述病史、检查或化验结果的句子以逗号分隔。

patterns.name: 法语评论句中的逗号
patterns.context: 在公共意见或评价性表述中，逗号后接补充的评论短语。

patterns.name: 法语立法句中的逗号与插入语
patterns.context: 法律或议会文本中，逗号标出插入的例外条件或限定语。

patterns.name: 意大利语句中逗号及连接副词
patterns.context: 意大利语正式文本以逗号隔开句首或句中连接副词“inoltre”（此外）。
patterns.domain: 意大利语欧洲议会文本

patterns.name: 法语插入语前后的逗号
patterns.context: 法语议论中，逗号包围句中连接副词“donc”；周围文字表达推论。

patterns.name: 代码说明句中的让步结构
patterns.trigger: « (»1Even« when»5« the»2« code»1 here« says»9 clearly»5
patterns.context: 先描述代码预期行为，随后以“Even when”引出与预期不符的情况。

patterns.name: 科学摘要中的同位说明
patterns.context: 对新型示踪剂命名并以括号给出缩写，随后以逗号转入研究说明。
patterns.domain: 英语生物医学科研摘要

patterns.name: 意大利语从句中的插入评论
patterns.trigger: « suppongo»2«.»5 ... « che»1«,»9« tra»3« le»4« al»2«tre»5 c«ose»4
patterns.context: 正式政治论述中，逗号引出“我想”一类评论或“除此之外”等插入表达。
patterns.domain: 意大利语欧洲议会文本

patterns.name: 英语新闻中的引语后标点
patterns.trigger: experienced public backlash for opposing LGBT equality."«↵»1«↵»2
patterns.context: 新闻叙述中的引号结束后出现换行与段落分隔；内容涉及反 LGBT 宣传单。

en.description: The most stable signal is commas and nearby tokens, especially commas after numbers and years; other local patterns include parliamentary forms of address and institutional terms, and Italian che clauses. Some in-word activations cannot be grouped under one semantic topic.

patterns.name: Commas after decimal numbers
patterns.context: A comma follows numerical expressions such as years, dates, and percentages; activation often falls on the numbers and comma.
patterns.domain: Multilingual parliamentary speeches and medical texts

patterns.name: In-sentence commas and preceding words
patterns.context: Commas mark pauses, parentheticals, or clause boundaries within sentences; no particular language or topic is required.
patterns.domain: Multilingual parliamentary, academic, and legal texts

patterns.name: Forms of address and speech formulas in parliamentary speeches
patterns.context: European Parliament speeches or institutional discussions, often with forms of address, names of parliamentary institutions, and punctuation.

patterns.name: Italian «che» clauses/connections
patterns.context: In Italian sentences, introduces a clause or connects subsequent explanation, with a comma immediately following.

patterns.name: Punctuation in legal citations
patterns.context: Statute numbers are cited in criminal-justice discussions, with a comma after the statutory citation.

patterns.name: Sporadic activations near French word endings and punctuation
patterns.context: Sentence-final periods, line breaks, or in-word token fragments in French prose; aside from punctuation, there is no stable shared semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Medical statistical expressions
patterns.context: A medical description gives the proportion of cases, with activations near the number, percent sign, and comma.

patterns.name: Other isolated multilingual fragments
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across in-word fragments or ordinary words in different languages, with no consistent trigger apparent from the available context.

9_1724.description: 最稳定的信号是逗号及其邻近 token，尤其数字、年份后逗号；另有议会称呼与机构词、意大利语 che 从句等局部模式，部分词内激活无法归为单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 十进制数字后逗号
patterns.context: 年份、日期、百分比等数字表达后接逗号；激活常落在数字和逗号上。
patterns.domain: 多语言议会发言及医学文本

patterns.name: 句中逗号及其前词
patterns.trigger: 逗号，常与前面的词共同激活，如 « que»6«,»10、« arrivée»6«,»8、« che»4«,»8
patterns.context: 逗号用于句中停顿、插入语或从句边界；不要求特定语言或主题。
patterns.domain: 多语言议会、学术及法律文本

patterns.name: 议会演讲中的称呼与发言程式
patterns.trigger: « Monsieur le Président»、« La Présidente»、« Chers collègues»、« Le Parlement»
patterns.context: 欧洲议会演讲或机构讨论，常伴随称呼、议会机构名称及标点。

patterns.name: 意大利语「che」从句/衔接
patterns.context: 意大利语句中引出从句或衔接后续说明，逗号紧随其后。
patterns.domain: 意大利语学术及议会文本

patterns.name: 法律条文引证标点
patterns.context: 刑事司法讨论中引用法规编号，逗号出现在条文引证之后。

patterns.name: 法语词尾与标点附近的零散激活
patterns.context: 法语叙述中句末句点、换行或词内分词片段；除标点外没有稳定的共享词义模式。

patterns.name: 医学统计表达
patterns.context: 医学描述中给出病例比例，数字、百分号及逗号附近激活。

patterns.name: 其他孤立多语种片段
patterns.context: 激活散落于不同语言的词内片段或普通词，现有上下文看不出一致触发条件。
patterns.domain: 意大利语、法语、西班牙语文本

en.description: Activations are scattered across multilingual texts. Relatively stable cues include medial commas, line-break boundaries, and judgment structures introduced by English appears/seems; there are also dashes and several word-level activations that do not fit a unified pattern.

patterns.name: Sentence-final or parenthetical comma
patterns.context: A comma follows a proper name, date, clause, or parenthetical element, often marking discourse continuation rather than sentence termination; activation falls on the comma itself.
patterns.domain: Multilingual parliamentary speeches, news, and web texts

patterns.name: appears in English relative/complement clauses
patterns.context: appears/seems follows the subject and introduces a judgment or inference; common structures include “appears to have been…” or “season that appeared to be…”.

patterns.name: Sentence or clause boundaries in non-English texts
patterns.context: A line break occurs at a paragraph or sentence boundary, especially alongside a new sentence, speaker, or date; not all boundaries activate.

patterns.name: Local formatting marker and dash
patterns.context: A dash in an English sentence introduces an additional explanation followed by a relative clause; activations concentrate on the dash.

patterns.name: Comma after a proper name or date
patterns.context: A comma separates subsequent content after a proper name, date, or institution within a sentence; this matches the general comma pattern, but activation is especially strong.

patterns.name: Token activations not explained by the patterns above
patterns.context: These words span different languages, syntactic positions, and semantic domains, making it difficult to identify a single shared trigger; segment 10 is adjacent to the appears/seems pattern.
patterns.domain: Multilingual parliamentary, legal, news, and web texts

9_1724.description: 激活分散在多语种文本中，较稳定的线索是句中逗号、换行边界，以及英语 appears/seems 引出的判断结构；另有破折号和若干无法统一的词级激活。

patterns.name: 句末或插入性逗号
patterns.trigger: «,»，尤其在句中列举或插入语之后；最强位置包括 «novembre»10、«Commission»10、«arrivée»8、«1995»9、«Irlande»9、«2002»9、«publique»9、«board —»9
patterns.context: 逗号紧接专名、日期、从句或插入性成分，常标记话语继续而非句子结束；激活落在逗号本身。
patterns.domain: 多语种议会发言、新闻及网页文本

patterns.name: 英语关系/补语从句中的 appears
patterns.context: 主语后接 appears/seems，再引出判断或推测内容；常见结构为“appears to have been…”或“season that appeared to be…”。

patterns.name: 非英语文本中的句末或分句边界
patterns.trigger: «↵»及紧邻的句号、逗号；如段1的 «↵»6、段4的 «↵»4，以及段8的 «↵»5
patterns.context: 段落或句子边界处换行，尤其伴随新句、新发言者或新日期；不是所有边界都激活。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 转录及多语种文本

patterns.name: 局部格式标记与破折号
patterns.context: 英语句中破折号引出补充说明，后接关系从句；激活集中在破折号。

patterns.name: 专名或日期后的逗号
patterns.context: 句中专名、日期或机构名后以逗号分隔后续内容；与一般逗号模式相符，但激活尤其强。
patterns.domain: 意大利语及法语议会文本

patterns.name: 无法由上述局部模式解释的分词激活
patterns.context: 这些词分属不同语言、句法位置和语义领域，难以归为单一共同触发条件；其中段10与 appears/seems 模式相邻。
patterns.domain: 多语种议会文本、法律文本、新闻及网页文本

en.description: Activations are scattered across line breaks and punctuation, fragments of proper names and dates, French word forms, paper and code-format markers, and a few contextual words; there is no stable cross-domain semantic or grammatical commonality, making it difficult to assign a single function.

patterns.name: English sentence-final punctuation and line breaks
patterns.context: A line break follows the end of a sentence or paragraph, especially when the text consists of multiple paragraphs or headings
patterns.domain: Various genres, including news, papers, and code repository documentation

patterns.name: Fragments in proper names and dates
patterns.context: Subword fragments within proper names, dates, or words; they occur across languages and formats without a unifying semantic condition
patterns.domain: News, parliamentary speeches, paper metadata, and general English

patterns.name: earlier in expressions of uncertainty
patterns.context: Discusses communication, change, or uncertainty by describing the state of earlier communication

patterns.name: appears in author-submission notes
patterns.context: The phrase «As this appears to have been submitted by the author», used to speculate about the submitter's identity

patterns.name: French word forms and pronoun fragments
patterns.context: Words, inflectional endings, or split word forms in French parliamentary speeches

patterns.name: Formatting markers and code metadata
patterns.context: Structural markers in lists, copyright notices, or YAML/YAML-like paper metadata
patterns.domain: GitHub project documentation, ArXiv paper dumps

patterns.name: Season narrative in sports coverage
patterns.context: News narrative about Boston and Montreal matches and the teams' season prospects

patterns.name: Formula-title separators in scientific text
patterns.context: Formatting structure when the body of a paper transitions to a heading or section

9_1724.description: 激活分散在换行和标点、专名日期片段、法语词形、论文与代码格式标记，以及少数语境词上；跨领域缺乏稳定词义或语法共性，难以归为单一功能。

patterns.name: 英文句末标点与换行
patterns.context: 句子或段落结束后紧接换行，尤其文本由多个段落或标题组成时
patterns.domain: 多种文体，包括新闻、论文、代码库说明

patterns.name: 专名与日期中的片段
patterns.context: 专名、日期或词语内部的子词片段；不同语种和格式中均出现，缺少统一词义条件
patterns.domain: 新闻、议会发言、论文元数据及普通英文

patterns.name: 不确定性表达中的 earlier
patterns.context: 讨论沟通、变化或不确定性时，说明较早沟通的状况

patterns.name: 作者提交说明中的 appears
patterns.context: 短语 «As this appears to have been submitted by the author»，用于推测提交者身份

patterns.name: 法语词形与代词片段
patterns.context: 法语议会发言中的词语、屈折词尾或被切分的词形

patterns.name: 格式化标记及代码元数据
patterns.context: 列表、版权声明或 YAML/类 YAML 论文元数据的结构性标记
patterns.domain: Github 项目说明、ArXiv 论文转储

patterns.name: 体育报道中的赛季叙述
patterns.context: 关于波士顿与蒙特利尔比赛及球队赛季前景的新闻叙述

patterns.name: 科学文本中的公式标题分隔
patterns.trigger: «Basic Formulae»后的 «↵»9 和等号分隔线
patterns.context: 论文正文转入标题或章节时的排版结构

en.description: Activations are scattered across Italian word endings, common English words, academic formulas and title boundaries, legal dates and letter phrasing, and parliamentary forms of address; no single semantic or formatting feature explains all strong activations.

patterns.name: Italian word endings
patterns.context: Word endings in consecutive Italian words are split into subword fragments, particularly near inflectional or affix boundaries; however, the samples also include other languages and text structures, so this alone cannot explain all activations.

patterns.name: Common English words and phrases
patterns.context: Frequent verbs or phrases in English prose; the triggers are not uniform and may reflect lexical items or token boundaries rather than a stable semantic category.

patterns.name: Mathematical text structure markers
patterns.context: Activations occur near formulas, line breaks, section headings, and separator lines in mathematical or theoretical computer science papers.

patterns.name: Dates and legal letter phrasing
patterns.context: The writing, sending, and dating of letters related to an agreement are described in a legal narrative; the two passages have different activation locations and may reflect legal style or local lexical cues.

patterns.name: Italian parliamentary formulaic expressions
patterns.context: A French parliamentary speech title or form of address and nearby paragraph boundaries; these and the Italian parliamentary passages are both from the European Parliament corpus, but the triggering languages differ.

patterns.name: Isolated formula/title boundaries
patterns.context: Near a paper title, abstract keywords, or section boundary; some activations also fall on line-break markers, possibly reflecting formatting structure.

9_1724.description: 激活分散在意大利语词尾、英语常用词、学术公式与标题边界、法律日期和书信措辞及议会称呼等处；没有单一语义或格式特征能解释全部强激活。

patterns.name: 意大利语词尾
patterns.context: 意大利语中连续词的词尾被切成子词片段，特别是词形屈折或词缀边界附近；但样本也包含其他语言和文本结构，不能单独解释全部激活。

patterns.name: 英语高频词及短语
patterns.context: 英语散文中常见动词或短语内部/邻近位置；触发点并不统一，可能是词项或分词边界，而非稳定语义类别。

patterns.name: 数学文本结构标记
patterns.context: 数学或理论计算机科学论文中，公式、换行、章节标题及分隔线附近均有激活。

patterns.name: 日期和法律书信措辞
patterns.context: 法律叙事中的日期、时间间隔及信件陈述；两段触发位置不同，可能是法律文体或局部词汇线索。

patterns.name: 意大利语议会套语
patterns.context: 法语议会发言标题或称呼及邻近段落边界；与意大利语议会段落同属欧洲议会语料，但触发语言不同。

patterns.name: 孤立公式/标题边界
patterns.context: 论文标题、摘要关键词或章节边界附近；部分激活也落在换行标记上，可能与格式结构有关。

en.description: All snippets are academic papers. Activations concentrate around section headings, separators, the start of body text after headings, and metadata; there are also local triggers such as citations, terminology, and subject-specific keywords, while the topics themselves vary widely.

patterns.name: Section-heading boundaries and styles
patterns.context: Activations often fall on a newline, heading text, or separator beneath a heading; the text appears at the start of a paper or at a section transition.
patterns.domain: ArXiv and PubMed Central academic papers

patterns.name: Body text beginning near a heading
patterns.context: Occurs when body text begins after a section heading; activations may fall at the start of the first sentence or on a nearby token. Sentence topics vary.

patterns.name: Paper metadata and abstract-like front matter
patterns.context: The paper title, date, keywords, or front matter between the title and body; the body topic need not be consistent.
patterns.domain: ArXiv paper metadata or preprint format

patterns.name: References and citation markers
patterns.context: Citation or footnote markers appear in the body, near a heading, or in front matter.

patterns.name: Proper nouns, abbreviations, and terminology lists
patterns.context: Near technical terms, abbreviations, or classification keywords; activations may fall on the terms themselves or adjacent structural markers.

patterns.name: Specific keyword cluster: chromosomes and cell imaging
patterns.context: Discusses cell division, chromosome states, or imaging methods.

patterns.name: Specific keyword cluster: tumor cells
patterns.context: The title or opening of a biomedical paper discusses circulating tumor cells and malignant properties.

patterns.name: Specific keyword cluster: quantum and condensed-matter physics
patterns.context: The title or introduction of a physics paper discusses quantum dots, antiferromagnetic spin ladders, or magnetic fields.

patterns.name: Specific keyword cluster: mathematical topology
patterns.context: Discusses preimages of regular values, manifolds, or pseudoholomorphic maps.

patterns.name: Specific keyword cluster: signal processing and error correction
patterns.context: The title and introduction concern signal degradation, error correction, or image restoration.
patterns.domain: Applied mathematics or signal processing papers

patterns.name: Specific keyword cluster: astronomical observation methods
patterns.context: Discusses occultation spectroscopy methods and their data analysis or results.

patterns.name: Formatting noise outside headings
patterns.context: The activation distribution includes newlines, Markdown/LaTeX-like formatting, punctuation, or split subword fragments, which do not necessarily correspond to stable semantic triggers.
patterns.domain: Typesetting and transcription formats in paper corpora

9_1724.description: 所有片段均为学术论文，激活集中在章节标题、分隔线、标题后正文起始及元数据附近；另有引用、术语与各学科主题词等局部触发，主题本身差异很大。

patterns.name: 章节标题边界与标题样式
patterns.trigger: «↵» 后的章节标题，如 “Parity Invariance”“General Remarks”“Results and Discussion”“Introduction”“Pseudo quotient maps”，以及其后的 “=================” 或 “------------”
patterns.context: 激活常落在换行、标题文字或标题下方的分隔线；文本处于论文开篇或章节切换位置。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 与 PubMed Central 学术论文

patterns.name: 标题附近的正文起始
patterns.trigger: 标题或分隔线后首句的开头，如 “A parity transformation”“The final difference spectrum”“Communication between the nucleus”“The corruption of signals by”“Spin ladder systems have been”“The time evolution of”
patterns.context: 章节标题之后进入正文时出现，激活可落在首句开头或其邻近 token；句子内容领域各异。

patterns.name: 论文元数据与摘要式前置材料
patterns.trigger: “title:”“date:”“[Keywords]”“Error-correcting codes and image restoration”“Spin correlations in the two-leg antiferromagnetic ladder”
patterns.context: 论文标题、日期、关键词或标题与正文之间的前置区域；不要求正文主题相同。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文元数据或预印本格式

patterns.name: 参考文献与引用标记
patterns.context: 引用或脚注标记出现在正文、标题附近或前置文本中。

patterns.name: 专名、缩写与术语列表
patterns.context: 技术术语、缩写或分类关键词附近；激活可能落在术语本身或紧邻的结构标记上。
patterns.domain: 跨学科科学论文及术语表

patterns.name: 特定主题词簇：染色体与细胞成像
patterns.context: 讨论细胞分裂过程、染色体状态或成像方法。

patterns.name: 特定主题词簇：肿瘤细胞
patterns.context: 生物医学论文标题或引言开头讨论循环肿瘤细胞及恶性特征。

patterns.name: 特定主题词簇：量子与凝聚态物理
patterns.context: 物理学论文标题或引言讨论量子点、反铁磁自旋梯或磁场。

patterns.name: 特定主题词簇：数学拓扑
patterns.trigger: “inverse images of regular values”“manifolds”“Pseudo quotient maps”
patterns.context: 讨论正则值逆像、流形或伪商映射。

patterns.name: 特定主题词簇：信号处理与纠错
patterns.trigger: “Error-correcting codes and image restoration”“The corruption of signals”
patterns.context: 标题及引言涉及信号受损、纠错或图像恢复。
patterns.domain: 应用数学或信号处理论文

patterns.name: 特定主题词簇：天文观测方法
patterns.context: 讨论掩星光谱方法及其数据分析或结果。

patterns.name: 非标题位置的格式噪声
patterns.trigger: “[@mb:1+1]”“oc”以及日期、标点、分隔符等邻近片段
patterns.context: 激活分布包含换行、Markdown/LaTeX 式格式、标点或被拆分的词片段，未必对应稳定语义触发。
patterns.domain: 论文语料的排版与转写格式

en.description: Activations often occur near titles, section names, and separator lines in structured texts, especially academic documents; scattered triggers also include editorial positions, legal letters, aerospace control, and design commentary, which do not support a single theme.

patterns.name: Section headings and title separator lines
patterns.context: In document structure, a title appears on its own line, followed by a Markdown/plain-text separator line; activations often occur around the title or separator.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, technical documents, and other texts with section structure

patterns.name: Academic terms or topic phrases in titles
patterns.context: Section, paper, or subsection titles are named with domain-specific terms; activations concentrate near the title phrase and often adjoin a title separator line.
patterns.domain: Academic texts in physics, quantum systems, biomedicine, etc.

patterns.name: Journal editor position labels
patterns.context: Editorial listings, position labels, and their layout markers on publication or journal pages.

patterns.name: Dates and legal letter narrative
patterns.context: Describes the writing, sending, and dating of letters related to an agreement; a colon introduces the content of the letter afterward.

patterns.name: Control logic and landing descriptions
patterns.context: Compares the control logic used by boosters or aircraft during ascent, descent, and landing.

patterns.name: Perception and function in design evaluations
patterns.context: Compares product designs, emphasizing that appearance and actual function are not the same thing.

patterns.name: Materials and chemicals subsection headings
patterns.context: Hierarchical headings and separator lines in the methods section of a biomedical paper, followed by information about reagents or chemicals.

patterns.name: Biomedical results subsection headings
patterns.context: Headings in the results section and subsection headings with biomolecules or mechanisms as their subject.

patterns.name: Classification heading for ungrouped rare events
patterns.context: The segment contains a topic heading, classification codes, and “Rare event studies” on the next line; the specific relationship to other triggering patterns is uncertain.

9_1724.description: 激活多出现在结构化文本的标题、章节名和分隔线附近，尤见学术文档；另有编辑职位、法律信函、航天控制及设计评论等零散触发，不能据此认定为单一主题。

patterns.name: 章节标题及标题分隔线
patterns.trigger: 标题后的「↵」与重复的「=」「-」分隔线，如「Executive Editors↵=================」「Introduction↵============」「Results↵=======」
patterns.context: 文档结构标记中，标题单独成行，随后出现 Markdown/纯文本式分隔线；激活常落在标题或分隔线周围。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、技术文档及其他带章节结构的文本

patterns.name: 标题中的学术术语或主题短语
patterns.context: 章节标题、论文标题或小节标题以领域术语命名；激活集中在标题短语附近，且常与标题分隔线相邻。
patterns.domain: 物理、量子系统、生物医学等学术文本

patterns.name: 期刊编辑职位标签
patterns.context: 出版物或期刊页面的编辑名单、职位标签及其排版标记。

patterns.name: 日期与法律信函叙述
patterns.context: 叙述协议相关信件的写作、寄送和日期，正文后以冒号引出内容。

patterns.name: 控制逻辑与着陆描述
patterns.trigger: 「switch」「a different control logic」「slow controlled touchdown procedure」「single control logic」
patterns.context: 比较助推器或飞行器在上升、下降及着陆阶段使用的控制逻辑。
patterns.domain: 科技论坛讨论、航天工程

patterns.name: 设计评价中的感知与功能
patterns.context: 对产品设计作对比，强调外观与实际工作方式并非一回事。
patterns.domain: 产品设计评论、网络文章

patterns.name: 实验材料与化学品小节标题
patterns.context: 生物医学论文中方法部分的层级标题和分隔线，后接试剂或化学品信息。

patterns.name: 生物医学结果小节标题
patterns.context: 结果章节的标题和以生物分子或机制为主语的小节标题。

patterns.name: 未能归入的稀有事件分类标题
patterns.context: 该段同时包含主题标题、分类代码和下一行的「Rare event studies」；与其他触发模式的具体联系不确定。
patterns.domain: 物理学论文分类/主题标题

en.description: Activations are scattered across multilingual corpora: common function words, subword fragments within words, punctuation, and newline separators all occur. There are also dates and numbers, IRC questions, academic terminology, names and place names, and sporadic subword fragments across different styles, without a stable semantic or domain pattern.

patterns.name: French « le/les/une» and similar words after commas
patterns.context: Across languages and genres, short function words or common words appear after commas, sentence boundaries, or phrase structures; trigger positions are not fully consistent.
patterns.domain: Parliamentary speeches, English comments, news, literature

patterns.name: Subword fragments in tokenized words or inflections
patterns.context: Italian, French, English, and other words are split into subword tokens; activations fall on within-word fragments or word-form boundaries, without a single shared semantic condition.
patterns.domain: IRC, parliamentary text, papers, editorial lists

patterns.name: Punctuation, separators, and formatting markers
patterns.context: Near newlines, commas, or title separators made of repeated symbols; several passages also contain other activated words, so the formatting marker cannot be identified as the primary trigger.
patterns.domain: Parliamentary records, academic papers, journal editorial lists

patterns.name: Numeric years and ordinal-like numbers
patterns.context: Numbers appear in dates or year expressions in parliamentary speeches.

patterns.name: Questions and colloquial words in dialogue
patterns.context: In an IRC conversation, a user asks what to do after logging in; a bot explains the steps after entering a username and password.

patterns.name: English nouns and subheadings in technical discussion
patterns.context: Academic text discusses the electroweak field or siRNA design, with newlines and heading separators nearby.

patterns.name: Location information after a name
patterns.context: An editorial list gives a city and country after a name; activations occur on a subword in Tokyo and adjacent formatting markers.

patterns.name: Name and verb fragments in reporting
patterns.context: The former occurs in a date in a parliamentary speech; the latter occurs in a person's name and a news sentence about the economy. They cannot be grouped under a shared semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in English design reviews
patterns.context: The sentence defines design and contrasts appearance with function; activations fall on common English expressions.

patterns.name: Pronoun fragments within a literary sentence
patterns.context: In a literary sentence about how words can comfort and constrain, activations concentrate on fragments of a contraction.

patterns.name: Verb fragments in Portuguese parliamentary phrasing
patterns.context: Discusses moving a vote to the following day and considering the matter; activations fall on verb tokens in Portuguese constructions.

9_1724.concept: 多语种常见子词与边界
9_1724.description: 激活分散于多语种语料：常见功能词、词内子词片段、标点与换行分隔符均有出现；另见日期数字、IRC疑问、学术术语、人名地名及不同文体中的零散词片段，未形成稳定语义或领域模式。

patterns.name: 法语文中逗号后的 « le/les/une» 等词
patterns.trigger: [2] «,»,« une»；[3] «,»,« cet»；[4] «something» 后的 « looks»；[7] « the»；[9] « are»；[10] « ser»
patterns.context: 多种语种与文体中，逗号、句界或短语结构之后出现短功能词或常见词；触发位置不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 议会发言、英文评论、新闻、文学

patterns.name: 分词或词形中的子词片段
patterns.context: 意大利语、法语、英语等词被切成子词 token，激活落在词内片段或词形边界；缺少单一共同语义条件。
patterns.domain: IRC、议会文本、论文、编辑名单

patterns.name: 标点、分隔符及格式标记
patterns.context: 换行、逗号或由重复符号构成的标题分隔线附近；若干段同时含其他激活词，不能确定格式标记是主要触发因素。
patterns.domain: 议会记录、学术论文、期刊编辑名单

patterns.name: 数字年份及序数式数字
patterns.context: 数字出现在议会发言的日期或年份表达中。

patterns.name: 对话中的疑问与口语词
patterns.context: IRC对话中，用户询问登录后该做什么；机器人回答输入用户名和密码后的步骤。

patterns.name: 科技论述中的英文名词与小标题
patterns.context: 学术文本谈及电弱场或 siRNA 设计，附近有换行和标题分隔符。
patterns.domain: 物理学论文、生物医学论文

patterns.name: 姓名后的来自地信息
patterns.context: 编辑名单中姓名后标注城市、国家；激活出现在 Tokyo 的子词和相邻格式标记。

patterns.name: 人名及报道中的动词片段
patterns.context: 前者处在议会发言的日期中，后者处在经济新闻的人名和报道句中；无法归为同一语义触发。

patterns.name: 英文设计评论中的词内片段
patterns.context: 句子定义设计，并对比外观与功能；激活落在常见英文表达中。

patterns.name: 文学句中的代词词内片段
patterns.context: 关于文字具有安慰和约束作用的文学性句子中，激活集中在缩写词片段。

patterns.name: 葡语议会表述中的动词片段
patterns.context: 讨论将投票移至次日并审议该问题；激活落在葡语结构中的动词 token。

en.concept: “Sounds” at the beginning of a reply
en.description: The most prominent commonality is “Sounds” at the start of a reply or quoted reply, often followed by like to introduce a judgment, inference, or suggestion, but it can also be followed by expressions of agreement such as good or about right. Topics and subsequent content vary; activations in the IRC segment are more sporadic.

patterns.name: Reply phrase beginning with “Sounds”
patterns.context: Occurs at the start of a new reply or quoted reply, often after a username, email quote marker, or separator; the following text often uses like or another complement to express agreement, inference, evaluation, or suggestion
patterns.domain: HackerNews comments and Enron emails; weaker local activations also occur in Ubuntu IRC

patterns.name: Evaluative reply followed by like
patterns.context: “Sounds like …” opens a reply, followed by an inference, evaluation, explanation, or suggestion; the content after like varies widely and is not limited to one topic

patterns.name: Reply followed by other complements
patterns.context: Sounds is followed not by like but by an adjective or a structure such as about right, directly expressing agreement, acceptance, or evaluation

patterns.name: Sounds occurring locally in IRC
patterns.context: An Italian IRC conversation containing corrupted characters; activations are not concentrated in a single identifiable Sounds structure and appear as multiple, more sporadic tokens

9_1724.description: 最突出的共同点是回复或引用回复开头的“Sounds”，常接 like 引出判断、推测或建议，也可接 good、about right 等表达认同。主题和后续内容多样；IRC 段的激活较零散。

patterns.name: 句首回应短语“Sounds”
patterns.context: 作为新回复或引用回复的句首，通常位于用户名、邮件引用符或分隔线之后；后文常接 like 或其他补语，表达认同、推断、评价或建议
patterns.domain: HackerNews 评论与 Enron 邮件；另见 Ubuntu IRC 的较弱局部激活

patterns.name: 后接 like 的评价式回应
patterns.context: “Sounds like …”作为回应开头，后接推测、评价、解释或建议；like 后的内容差异很大，并非某一主题所限
patterns.domain: HackerNews 评论与 Enron 邮件

patterns.name: 后接其他补语的回应
patterns.context: Sounds 后不接 like，而以形容词或 about right 等结构直接表示赞同、认可或评价
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件与 HackerNews 评论

patterns.name: IRC 中局部出现的 Sounds
patterns.trigger: « quando»…« ent»ro…« cosa»…« sce»gl»iere»…；随后可见 «>» 与 «?» 等标记
patterns.context: 意大利语夹杂损坏字符的 IRC 对话；激活并不集中于一个可确认的 Sounds 结构，呈现为较零散的多个 token

en.description: Activations occur across genres: line-numbered and formatted legal texts, French parliamentary speeches, technical discussions, descriptions of organizational information, and paper titles. “Sounds like” appears in forums and emails, alongside technical “looks like”; overall, there is no unified topic or stable trigger word.

patterns.name: “Sounds like” evaluative opening
patterns.context: At the beginning of a sentence or new sentence, followed by a brief judgment about preceding content; other passages use “sounds …” evaluatively, but not the same complete phrase.

patterns.name: Legal document structure and numbering
patterns.context: Occurs near court names, rulings, citations, or numbering, especially in formatted legal text after a newline.
patterns.domain: U.S. court decisions and legal documents

patterns.name: Political phrases in French parliamentary speeches
patterns.context: In French parliamentary speeches, addressing colleagues and mentioning terrorist attacks and related people.
patterns.domain: French speeches in the European Parliament

patterns.name: Spaceflight control and landing descriptions
patterns.context: Technically compares control logic during a booster’s descent phase and landing methods.

patterns.name: Organizational information transparency and real-time visibility
patterns.context: Describes information visibility across an organization and its beneficiaries, followed by evaluative language.

patterns.name: “Looks like” similarity expression
patterns.context: In a technical discussion, compares a system or requirement to something else; preceding text discusses NoSQL, complexity, and ACID.

patterns.name: Paper subsection headings and formal notation
patterns.context: After a section heading and separator, variables are defined or mathematical results are stated.

9_1724.description: 激活分布在多种体裁中：法律文本的换行编号与格式、法语议会发言、技术讨论、组织信息描述及论文标题。论坛和邮件中可见“Sounds like”，另有技术类“looks like”；整体缺少统一的主题或稳定触发词。

patterns.name: “Sounds like”评价开头
patterns.context: 句首或新句开头，后接对前述内容的简短判断；另有段落以“sounds …”表达评价，但并非相同的完整短语。

patterns.name: 法律文书结构与编号
patterns.context: 出现在法院名称、裁判说明、引注或编号附近，尤其是换行后的格式化法律文本。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决及法律文书

patterns.name: 法语议会发言中的政治词句
patterns.context: 法语议会演说中称呼同僚、提及恐怖袭击和相关人物。

patterns.name: 太空飞行控制与着陆描述
patterns.context: 对助推器下降阶段的控制逻辑及着陆方式作技术比较。

patterns.name: 组织信息透明与实时可见性
patterns.context: 描述组织范围内的信息可见性及其服务对象，随后带有评价语气。

patterns.name: “looks like”相似性表达
patterns.context: 技术讨论中将某系统或需求与另一事物作类比；其前文谈NoSQL、复杂度与ACID。

patterns.name: 论文小节标题与形式化记号
patterns.context: 章节标题、分隔线之后开始定义变量或陈述数学结果。
patterns.domain: 数学或计算机科学论文

en.description: Primarily responds to inflected forms of sound used to evaluate or compare how something sounds; there is also one activation on the structural description Structurally, one on legal title formatting, and one on the appearance description looks, making these difficult to group under a single lexical pattern.

patterns.name: Evaluative or comparative English construction “sound(s/ed) like”
patterns.context: Different inflected forms of sound introduce an impression, perception, or comparison; this does not necessarily refer to actual sound and can also mean “seems like.”
patterns.domain: HackerNews comments and online discussions; also Pile-CC

patterns.name: Structural description in a scientific context
patterns.context: A sentence-initial adverb introduces a description of viral structure; activation falls on Structurally, not on the preceding featureless or distinct.

patterns.name: Formatted heading in a court document
patterns.context: Formal court letterhead and case-number layout; activations appear on line breaks and near the case number, with no clear lexical trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Appearance-evaluation word “looks”
patterns.context: Describes a ring as looking cool; the activated token is looks, not awesome.

9_1724.concept: 感官印象与描述性表达
9_1724.description: 主要对 sound 的屈折形式在“听起来像、听感如何”的评价或类比用法起反应；另有一次对 Structurally 的结构描写、一次法律标题排版，以及一次 looks 外观描述激活，难以归入同一词汇模式。

patterns.name: 英语系词形式“sound(s/ed) like”的评价或类比
patterns.context: 用 sound 的不同屈折形式引入对某事物的听感、印象或类比；不一定指实际声音，也可表示“听起来像/似乎”。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 评论及网络讨论；另见 Pile-CC

patterns.name: 科学语境中的结构描述
patterns.context: 句首副词引出对病毒结构的描述；激活落在 Structurally，而非前文的 featureless 或 distinct。

patterns.name: 法院文书中的格式化标题
patterns.trigger: “Fourth Judicial Department”后的换行及案号格式
patterns.context: 正式法院抬头与编号排版；可见激活落在换行及案号附近，未形成清晰的词汇触发模式。

patterns.name: 外观评价词“looks”
patterns.context: 描述戒指看起来很酷；激活 token 是 looks，而非 awesome。

en.description: Primarily activates on words such as sounds/sounded and look/looks that express auditory impressions or appearance; there are also discrete patterns involving Spanish word forms, fragments in French discussion of Irish, and legal document formatting symbols.

patterns.name: Sound or auditory impression
patterns.context: Sounds/sounded follows a sound subject or described object to express how it sounds; it is sometimes followed by an adjective or a like phrase.
patterns.domain: Reviews, product discussions, music, narrative; includes [2], [4], [5], [8], [10]

patterns.name: Appearance or action presentation
patterns.context: Describes how a design looks, or asks to make a dangerous operation look dangerous; the trigger is look/looks, not a sound word.
patterns.domain: Design reviews and software interface suggestions; includes [3], [6]

patterns.name: French verb-form fragments
patterns.context: A word ending or internal fragment of a verb form is marked in a Spanish sentence, with no clear semantic condition shared with other highly activated passages.

patterns.name: Irish name and language status
patterns.context: A French sentence discusses interpretation services for Irish and its recognition as an independent language; activations are scattered across within-word fragments.
patterns.domain: European Parliament interpretation and language policy; includes [1]

patterns.name: Newlines and legal formatting markers
patterns.context: Activations occur on layout markers such as newlines, asterisks, and numbering in court documents; distinct from adjacent legal body text.
patterns.domain: U.S. federal court decision formatting; includes [9]

9_1724.concept: 感知印象表达，兼有离散模式
9_1724.description: 主要对 sounds/sounded 及 look/looks 这类表达听觉印象或外观呈现的词激活；另有西班牙语词形、法语爱尔兰语讨论中的片段，以及法律文件排版符号等离散模式。

patterns.name: 声音或听觉印象
patterns.context: 声音主语或描述对象后出现 sounds/sounded，用来表达听起来如何；有时后接形容词或 like 短语。

patterns.name: 外观或动作呈现
patterns.context: 描述设计看起来如何，或要求让危险操作显得危险；触发词为 look/looks，而非声音词。
patterns.domain: 设计评论与软件界面建议；涵盖 [3]、[6]

patterns.name: 法语动词词形片段
patterns.context: 西班牙语句子中动词词形的词尾或内部片段被标记，未见与其他高激活段共享的明显语义条件。
patterns.domain: 西班牙语哲学论述；涵盖 [7]

patterns.name: 爱尔兰语名称及语言地位
patterns.context: 法语句子讨论爱尔兰语的解释服务及其作为独立语言获承认；激活分散在词内片段。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会口译与语言政策；涵盖 [1]

patterns.name: 换行及法律格式标记
patterns.context: 法院文件中的换行、星号和编号等排版标记处激活；区别于相邻法律正文。
patterns.domain: 美国联邦法院判决格式；涵盖 [9]

en.description: Activations are scattered across boundary markers such as line breaks and punctuation, English sensory evaluations using sound/looks/look, and legal-document contexts; there is also one instance of just. The trigger types are not entirely consistent and may combine formatting boundaries with lexical features.

patterns.name: Formatting or structural markers after line breaks
patterns.context: The line break itself is marked; examples occur in speech paragraphs, web article separators, forum quotes, and legal documents, possibly reflecting text boundaries or formatting.

patterns.name: Sentence-final punctuation
patterns.context: Punctuation appears as a sentence or clause boundary; examples occur in legal documents, parliamentary speeches, and web texts.

patterns.name: English sound-description word sound
patterns.context: Describes music, recordings, or similarities; sometimes appears alongside sensory evaluations such as look or sounds huge.

patterns.name: Appearance or situation judgment words look/looks
patterns.context: Means looks like, seems, or describes appearance; often followed by an adjective or a like-clause. It relates to nearby sound evaluations but can also occur on its own.
patterns.domain: Technical articles, product reviews, forum discussions

patterns.name: Colloquial minimizer or qualifier
patterns.context: Used as a colloquial qualifier or in a comparative expression, such as “just as short as weeds”; only one example is observed so far.

patterns.name: Judgments, procedures, and vaccine-dispute vocabulary in legal documents
patterns.context: Court procedures or vaccine injury dispute texts; these phrases themselves have few markers and do not clearly match the other frequent trigger forms.

9_1724.description: 激活分散在换行与标点等边界标记、英语 sound/looks/look 感官评价，以及法律文书语境；另有单例 just。各类触发不完全一致，可能兼有格式边界和词汇特征。

patterns.name: 换行符后的排版或结构标记
patterns.trigger: «↵»，常与页眉、段落或分隔符相邻
patterns.context: 换行符本身被标记；出现于演讲稿段落、网页文章分隔、论坛引用和法律文书中，可能与文本边界或格式有关。

patterns.name: 句末标点
patterns.context: 标点作为句子或从句边界出现；法律文书、议会发言及网页文本中均有例子。

patterns.name: 英语声音描述词 sound
patterns.trigger: «sound»9，及“they sound as good as they look”中的 «sound»9
patterns.context: 描述音乐、录音或相似之处；有时和 look、sounds huge 等感官评价并列。

patterns.name: 外观或情况判断词 look/looks
patterns.context: 表示看起来、似乎或外观评价，常接形容词或 like 从句；与声音评价的邻近语境有关，但也可单独出现。
patterns.domain: 技术文章、商品评论、论坛讨论

patterns.name: 口语化轻描淡写或限定词
patterns.context: 用于口语式限定或比较表达，如“just as short as weeds”；目前仅见一例。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的判决、程序与疫苗争议词汇
patterns.trigger: “Joint Stipulation of Dismissal”“order concluding proceedings”“this ruling contains a reasoned explanation”“vaccine-related”
patterns.context: 法院程序或疫苗伤害争议文本；这些短语本身的标记较少，且与其他高频触发形式不明显一致。

en.description: Primarily activates on auditory evaluations with sound/sounds and “Sounds like”-style inferences or analogical reactions. There are also adjacent appearance and impression words, as well as activation on a time word in an encyclopedia passage, which does not fit the stable primary pattern.

patterns.name: Sound judgment or evaluation
patterns.context: sound/sounds is used as a sensory or evaluative verb, followed by an adjective, comparative construction, or evaluative phrase; it may refer to actual auditory impressions or serve as a “sounds good/cool” type of response.
patterns.domain: Music reviews, everyday conversation, forum discussions

patterns.name: “Sounds like” inference or analogy
patterns.context: Sounds/sound is followed by like, introducing an inference, impression, possibility, or similar object.

patterns.name: Evaluative/perceptual expressions near sound-related words
patterns.context: Occurs in the same passage as a sound judgment, often describing appearance, impressions, or conjecture before or after it; these words are not stable triggers shared by all passages.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, reviews of products or objects

patterns.name: Time-narrative word
patterns.context: A time phrase in a historical account; it has no clear connection to the sound evaluations or sounds-like constructions in the other passages.

9_1724.description: 主要对 sound/sounds 的听感评价及“Sounds like”式推断或类比反应。另有相邻的外观、印象词，以及一段百科时间词激活，不能归入稳定主模式。

patterns.name: 声音判断或评价
patterns.trigger: “sounds huge”“Sounds good to me”“Sounds really cool”“they sound as good as they look”
patterns.context: sound/sounds 作感官或评价动词，后接形容词、比较结构或评价短语；既可指实际听感，也可作“听起来不错/很酷”式回应。
patterns.domain: 音乐评论、日常对话、论坛讨论

patterns.name: “Sounds like”推断或类比
patterns.trigger: “Sounds like a job”“sound like a chain saw”“tgethr sounds like T gethr”“Sounds like it might be a little more expensive”“Sounds like non-drivable”
patterns.context: Sounds/sound 后接 like，引出推断、印象、可能性或相似对象。
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、产品讨论、邮件

patterns.name: 声音相关词附近的评价/感知表达
patterns.context: 与声音判断同段出现，常在声音评价前后描述外观、印象或推测；这些词并非各段共有的稳定触发项。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、对产品或物件的评论

patterns.name: 时间叙述词
patterns.context: 历史说明中的时间短语；与其余段落的声音评价或 sounds like 结构无明显联系。
patterns.domain: 百科全书式技术史叙述

en.description: Strong activations mainly occur on looks and sounds, which convey descriptions or evaluations of appearance and how something sounds. Two further examples, it seems and sentence-initial Seems, express judgments or conjectures about effects.

patterns.name: Appearance or visual impression
patterns.context: Discussing how something looks, whether it is cheap or ordinary, or how it differs from something else; the trigger may be followed by an adjective or comparative description.

patterns.name: Auditory description
patterns.context: Discussing how an object, name, or music sounds, often followed by an adjective or analogy.

patterns.name: Perception expression with the pronoun it as subject
patterns.context: Using it to introduce a judgment or impression; in this example, activation falls on seems rather than the primary looks/sounds pattern.

patterns.name: Judgment expressed by sentence-initial Seems
patterns.context: Sentence-initial “Seems to make” omits the subject and conveys a judgment about the effect of a software setting; it is not a looks/sounds expression.

9_1724.description: 强激活主要落在 looks 与 sounds：在谈论外观、听感时承接描述或评价；另有 it seems 与句首 Seems 两例，表示判断或效果推测。

patterns.name: 外观或视觉印象
patterns.context: 谈论某物看起来如何、是否便宜、普通或与其他事物不同；触发词后可接形容词或比较描述。

patterns.name: 听觉上的声音描述
patterns.context: 谈论物体、名称或音乐听起来如何，常接形容词或类比。

patterns.name: 不定代词 it 作主语的感知表达
patterns.context: 以 it 引出判断或印象；本例激活落在 seems，而非主要的 looks/sounds。

patterns.name: 句首 Seems 的判断表达
patterns.context: 句首省略主语的 Seems to make，表达对软件设置效果的判断；不属于 looks/sounds。

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to the evaluative expression “looks”: commenters judge how something appears based on context, followed by an adjective or like phrase. It also responds to the evaluative expression “Sounds like,” meaning something sounds or gives an impression of being a certain way.

patterns.name: Evaluating appearance or impression
patterns.context: The subject is often it; judges a product, price, project, school, photo, or work, followed by an adjective or a judgment introduced by like.
patterns.domain: HackerNews comment threads, covering tech products, work and life, education, images, and art

patterns.name: How something sounds
patterns.context: Begins with Sounds to express an impression of a team or app, followed by a like phrase.

9_1724.description: 主要对评价性表达“looks”强烈响应：评论者依据上下文判断事物看起来如何，后接形容词或 like 短语；另对“Sounds like”这一听起来像/给人印象的评价表达响应。

patterns.name: 评价外观或观感
patterns.context: 主语多为 it；对产品、价格、项目、学校、照片或作品作判断，后接形容词或 like 引出的判断内容。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 评论对话，涵盖科技产品、就业与生活、教育、图片及艺术

patterns.name: 声音听起来如何
patterns.context: 以 Sounds 开头表达对团队或应用的印象，后接 like 短语。

en.description: Primarily responds to looks like or sounds like in comments, which introduce uncertain judgments, impressions, or predictions; also responds to the temporal phrase shortly after in scientific narrative. Segment 10 is a negative sounds like evaluation.

patterns.name: “looks like” judgment
patterns.context: The speaker infers, evaluates, or predicts based on visible information, followed by a noun, clause, or judgment.
patterns.domain: HackerNews comments; topics include education, purchases, hardware, economics, and software

patterns.name: “sounds like” auditory inference
patterns.context: An impression, analogy, or inference based on how a team, name, suggestion, or design sounds.

patterns.name: “shortly after” temporal expression
patterns.context: Describes the sequence of events in a scientific paper introduction; strong activation falls on shortly.

patterns.name: Negative “sounds like” evaluation
patterns.context: sound(s) like is followed by an evaluation of a function or design; this example has the negation doesn't before it, meaning that it is not easy to discover.

9_1724.description: 主要响应评论中用 looks like 或 sounds like 引出非确定性判断、印象或预测；也响应科研叙述中的 shortly after 时间短语。第10段是带否定的 sounds like 评价。

patterns.name: “looks like”判断
patterns.context: 说话者基于可见信息作推断、评价或预测，后接名词、从句或判断内容。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 评论；涉及教育、购买、硬件、经济、软件等

patterns.name: “sounds like”听感推断
patterns.context: 对某个团队、名称、建议或设计作听感印象、类比或推断。

patterns.name: “shortly after”时间表达
patterns.context: 科研论文引言中描述事件发生后的时间顺序；强激活落在 shortly。

patterns.name: “sounds like”否定评价
patterns.context: sound(s) like 后接对功能或设计的评价；本例前有否定词 doesn't，语义为不易发现。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 评论，产品交互设计

en.description: Strong activations cluster on perception or inference verbs such as sounds/sounded, looks, and seems, especially when used in comments to introduce an evaluation, impression, or speculation; these may be followed by like, to, or a direct evaluation.

patterns.name: “Sounds like” evaluation or inference
patterns.context: Introduces an auditory judgment, summary, or inference about a previously mentioned view, project, or situation; may also convey sarcasm or skepticism.
patterns.domain: HackerNews comments, IRC dialogue, and narrative text

patterns.name: “Looks like” evaluation or inference
patterns.context: The subject is often a project, product, or applicant; evaluates its appearance, expected characteristics, or likelihood, followed by a like-clause or a direct evaluation.

patterns.name: “Seems like” inference
patterns.context: A tentative judgment based on available information; followed by an action description or a negative evaluation of something.

9_1724.description: 强烈激活集中在 sounds/sounded、looks、seems 等感知或推断动词，尤其是用于评论中引出评价、印象或推测的表达；后接 like、to 或直接评价语。

patterns.name: “Sounds like”评价或推断
patterns.context: 用来引出对前文所述观点、项目或情境的听感判断、概括或推测；也可带有讽刺或质疑意味。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 评论、IRC 对话及叙事文本

patterns.name: “Looks like”评价或推断
patterns.context: 主语多为项目、产品或申请者；评价其外观、预期特征或可能性，后接 like 从句或直接接评价语。

patterns.name: “Seems like”推断
patterns.context: 根据已有信息作出暂时判断；后接动作描述，或对某事作负面评价。

en.description: Primarily responds to colloquial phrases that express inference, impression, evaluation, or agreement in dialogue, especially “Sounds like,” “sounds good,” and “seems to”; it also responds to “Immediately after” in technical descriptions.

patterns.name: Sounds like evaluation or inference
patterns.context: A judgment or inference about preceding information, meaning it sounds or looks like something; followed by a noun phrase, evaluation, or suggestion.
patterns.domain: HackerNews, Ubuntu IRC, and forum-style online conversations

patterns.name: Sounds + evaluative word
patterns.context: Sounds is followed directly by an adjective as a positive evaluation, without like.

patterns.name: Sounds good
patterns.context: Uses sounds good to express agreement or acceptance of a proposal.

patterns.name: Looks like inference
patterns.context: Makes an inference based on current information, followed by a clause.

patterns.name: Seems to as inference
patterns.context: Uses seem to to introduce a conjecture about a property or state.

patterns.name: After outside dialogue
patterns.context: The time adverb immediately modifies after, introducing the period following glass-fiber drawing.

9_1724.description: 主要响应对话中表达推断、印象、评价或赞同的口语短语，尤以“Sounds like”“sounds good”“seems to”为主；另响应技术说明里的“Immediately after”。

patterns.name: Sounds like 评价或推断
patterns.context: 对前文信息作出听来像是、看起来像是的判断或推断；后接名词短语、评价或建议。
patterns.domain: HackerNews、Ubuntu IRC 和论坛式网络对话

patterns.name: Sounds + 评价词
patterns.context: Sounds 后直接接形容词作积极评价，不带 like。

patterns.name: Sounds good
patterns.context: 以 sounds good 表示赞同或接受提议。

patterns.name: Looks like 推断
patterns.context: 依据当前信息作出推断，后接从句。

patterns.name: Seems to 表推断
patterns.context: 用 seem to 引出对性质或状态的推测。

patterns.name: 非对话中的 after
patterns.context: 时间副词 immediately 修饰 after，引出玻璃纤维拉制后的时间阶段。

en.description: Primarily responds to seems and sounds like expressions of inference or evaluation, as well as temporal connectives such as shortly/immediately after and looks like descriptions of appearance. Their commonality is loose: they are all common relational or judgment phrases.

patterns.name: Judgment clause following seems
patterns.context: Activation occurs on seems and its subsequent judgment expression, including “seems to be,” “seems that,” and standalone “Seems they...”; it is not limited to one following structure.

patterns.name: sounds like judgment expression
patterns.context: Activation falls on the stem or suffix of sounds, followed by an evaluation or analogy introduced by like; capitalization and context vary.

patterns.name: “shortly after” temporal phrase
patterns.context: Activates when describing the sequence of events shortly after an event; segment 5 has “Since shortly after its discovery,” and segment 7 has “shortly after yEnc gained popularity”.

patterns.name: Immediately after temporal phrase
patterns.context: Describes a time immediately following a process; activation concentrates on Immediately, which is followed by after.

patterns.name: looks like appearance comparison
patterns.context: The subject is an interface theme, followed by a description of its appearance; the same segment also has “resembles the image,” but activation is mainly on looks.

9_1724.description: 主要响应表示推断或评价的 seems、sounds like，也响应 shortly/immediately after 这类时间衔接表达，以及描述外观的 looks like。共同点较松散，都是常见的关系或判断短语。

patterns.name: seems 后接判断从句
