patterns.context: 评价超对称理论方案、规范微子质量假设及 μ→eγ 衰变的有效性。

patterns.name: 科研论文中的显著介词结构
patterns.context: 高激活落在实验地点、时间/进展或尺度短语中的常见介词，而非某个稳定的物理名词；具体语义随段落变化。

en.description: Primarily responds to structures in particle physics papers where at introduces a collider or experimental facility, often alongside names such as CERN and LHC; also covers topics such as Higgs, electroweak physics, dark matter, hadrons, electron colliders, and theoretical calculations, as well as paper titles and citation formats.

patterns.name: The location marker at in particle physics contexts
patterns.context: In high-energy physics papers, the preposition at introduces an experimental facility, collider, or experimental site; the same local structure recurs across passages.
patterns.domain: High-energy particle physics and experimental physics papers

patterns.name: Collider and experimental facility names
patterns.context: Activations appear near facility names when particle experiments or colliders are mentioned; some names follow at, while others appear in descriptions of experimental projects.

patterns.name: Higgs and Standard Model particle phenomena
patterns.context: Discusses the Higgs boson, its mass, discovery, and electroweak symmetry breaking, usually in the context of particle searches, theory, or experiments.
patterns.domain: Particle physics theory and experimental papers

patterns.name: LHC searches and dark matter analyses
patterns.context: Discusses dark matter searches and collider analyses within an effective field theory framework; co-occurs with facility-location structures.

patterns.name: Descriptions of experimental results and theoretical exclusions
patterns.context: Uses experimental constraints or particle discoveries to evaluate or exclude theoretical possibilities.

patterns.name: Hadron studies at high transverse momentum
patterns.context: Introduces hadron production and scaling behavior at high transverse momentum; not clearly centered on specific facility names.

patterns.name: Collider experiments and collision processes
patterns.context: Describes experimental plans, accessible reactions, or vector-boson production at electron–positron colliders.

patterns.name: Higher-order calculations for DY and Higgs
patterns.context: Introduces higher-order theoretical calculations for Drell–Yan dileptons and Higgs production.
patterns.domain: Perturbative quantum field theory, particle physics calculations

patterns.name: Abstract and section-heading formats
patterns.context: Activations occur near the abstract or Introduction heading and its separators at the start of a document, but also appear in particle-physics phrases in the main text.
patterns.domain: ArXiv paper formatting and section structure

patterns.name: Reference citation markers
patterns.context: ArXiv/journal citation markers occur near the main text; this appears to be an accompanying signal of paper formatting rather than an independent semantic trigger.
patterns.domain: Academic paper citations and reference formatting

9_1732.concept: 高能粒子物理实验语境
9_1732.description: 主要响应粒子物理论文中 at 引出对撞机或实验设施的结构，并常伴随 CERN、LHC 等名称；同时覆盖 Higgs、电弱、暗物质、强子、电子对撞机及理论计算等主题，也见论文标题和引文格式。

patterns.name: 粒子物理语境中的地点标记 at
patterns.context: 在高能物理论文中，介词 at 引出实验设施、对撞机或实验地点；同一局部结构在多段重复出现。
patterns.domain: 高能粒子物理、实验物理学术论文

patterns.name: 对撞机与实验设施名称
patterns.context: 提及粒子实验或对撞机时，设施名称附近出现激活；部分名称紧跟 at，部分位于实验项目叙述中。

patterns.name: Higgs与标准模型粒子现象
patterns.context: 讨论 Higgs 粒子、质量、发现及电弱对称性破缺，通常处于粒子搜索、理论或实验背景中。
patterns.domain: 粒子物理理论与实验论文

patterns.name: LHC搜索与暗物质分析
patterns.context: 在有效场论框架下讨论暗物质搜索及其对撞机分析；与设施地点结构同现。
patterns.domain: 暗物质现象学、粒子物理

patterns.name: 实验结果与理论排除的叙述
patterns.context: 用实验约束或粒子发现来评价、排除理论可能性。

patterns.name: 强子高横动量研究
patterns.context: 介绍强子产生及高横动量下的标度行为；未明显围绕具体设施名称。

patterns.name: 对撞机实验项目与碰撞过程
patterns.context: 描述电子正负电子对撞机的实验计划、可达反应或矢量玻色子产生。

patterns.name: DY与Higgs高阶计算
patterns.context: 介绍 Drell–Yan 双轻子和 Higgs 产生的高阶理论计算。
patterns.domain: 微扰量子场论、粒子物理计算

patterns.name: 摘要与章节标题格式
patterns.context: 文档开头的摘要或 Introduction 标题、分隔符附近有激活，但其激活也落在正文中的粒子物理词句上。

patterns.name: 参考文献引文标记
patterns.context: 正文附近带有 ArXiv/期刊引文标记；看起来可能是论文文本格式的伴随信号，而非独立语义触发。
patterns.domain: 学术论文引文与参考文献格式

en.description: Overall, the text is biased toward ArXiv high-energy physics papers: particles, decays, colliders, experimental searches, and theoretical frameworks recur; there is also an astrophysics passage on Comptonization. General academic prose may also contribute to activation. The topic of segment 10 is weak and difficult to explain through a specific physics pattern.

patterns.name: Proper nouns and symbols in high-energy particle physics
patterns.context: High-energy physics terms appear, including particle names, decay channels, masses or energy scales, scattering processes, and theoretical models; activation is distributed around these terms rather than tied to a single particle or process.
patterns.domain: Particle physics, phenomenology, and experimental high-energy physics papers

patterns.name: Experimental facilities and searches
patterns.context: Occurs when discussing experimental apparatus, colliders, experimental searches, or measurements, usually in paper background or descriptions of experiments.

patterns.name: Theoretical frameworks, methods, and corrections
patterns.context: Introduces theoretical symmetries, effective theories, computational approaches, and systematic uncertainties or higher-order corrections.
patterns.domain: Theoretical physics and nuclear physics papers

patterns.name: Astrophysical radiation processes
patterns.context: Describes radiation sources, seed photons, and processes in which photons are scattered to higher energies.

patterns.name: Citations and arguments in papers
patterns.context: Cites prior research or continues an argument, using academic discourse vocabulary such as “approach” and “analysis and interpretation”; may accompany the physics topics above but is not specific to them.

patterns.name: Possible triggers from general academic vocabulary
patterns.context: These words occur in specialist paper prose and are insufficient on their own to form a stable, distinct topic; activation may reflect a joint contribution from domain vocabulary and writing templates.

9_1732.concept: 高能物理论文语境
9_1732.description: 整体偏向 ArXiv 高能物理论文：粒子、衰变、对撞机、实验搜索及理论框架反复出现；另有天体物理康普顿化段落。通用学术行文也可能贡献激活。第10段主题较弱，难以由具体物理模式解释。

patterns.name: 高能粒子物理中的专名与符号
patterns.context: 出现粒子名称、衰变道、质量或能标、散射过程及理论模型等高能物理术语；激活分布在这些术语周边，并非单一粒子或单一过程。
patterns.domain: 粒子物理、现象学与实验高能物理论文

patterns.name: 实验设施与实验搜索
patterns.context: 讨论实验装置、对撞机、实验搜索或测量结果时出现；通常处于论文背景或实验介绍中。

patterns.name: 理论框架、方法与修正
patterns.trigger: “SU(3) symmetry”“effective field theory (EFT)”“power counting scheme”“loop-corrections”“higher order terms”
patterns.context: 介绍理论对称性、有效理论、计算方案及系统误差或高阶修正。
patterns.domain: 理论物理与核物理论文

patterns.name: 天体物理辐射过程
patterns.context: 描述辐射源、种子光子及光子被散射到更高能量的过程。

patterns.name: 论文中对既有工作的引述与论证
patterns.context: 引用先前研究或承接论证，出现“approach”“analysis and interpretation”等学术论述语汇；可能伴随上列物理主题，但不是专属主题。

patterns.name: 可能的通用学术词汇触发
patterns.context: 这些词出现在专业论文叙述中，单独不足以形成稳定的独立主题；可能只是领域词汇与行文模板共同贡献激活。

en.description: Primarily responds to descriptions of colliders, experimental searches, and Higgs/electroweak phenomena in ArXiv particle physics papers; also covers dark matter and cosmology, experimental exclusions and discoveries, with weaker responses to effective field theory, nuclear-force calculations, and abstract formatting.

patterns.name: High-energy physics experiments and colliders
patterns.context: Discusses particle production, decay channels, searches, or experimental measurements, often alongside experimental facility names.

patterns.name: Higgs and electroweak physics
patterns.context: Discusses the Higgs boson, electroweak symmetry breaking, or gauge couplings, and related experimental tests.
patterns.domain: Particle physics, the Standard Model and its extensions

patterns.name: Dark matter and cosmology
patterns.context: Dark matter appears as a particle or a cosmological component, involving models, searches, or experimental constraints.

patterns.name: Descriptions of experimental exclusions and discoveries in papers
patterns.context: Uses experimental results, discoveries, or detector searches to constrain theories or candidate particles.

patterns.name: Effective field theory and nuclear-force calculations
patterns.context: Introduces theoretical frameworks, systematic calculation methods, and correction orders; not entirely aligned with collider and Higgs topics.

patterns.name: Distinctive paper abstract formatting
patterns.context: Text formatting and indentation markers at the beginning of an abstract trigger activation, followed by electroweak physics content.

9_1732.concept: 粒子物理研究语境
9_1732.description: 主要响应 ArXiv 粒子物理论文中对撞机、实验搜索及希格斯/电弱现象的叙述，也覆盖暗物质与宇宙学、实验排除和发现；另对有效场论、核力计算及摘要格式有较弱响应。

patterns.name: 高能物理实验与对撞机
patterns.trigger: “at the CERN Large Electron-Posit…”, “at the Fermilab Tevatron”, “at the LHC”, “at LEP200”；以及 “direct search”“production”“colliders”
patterns.context: 讨论粒子产生、衰变通道、搜索或实验测量时，常伴随实验设施名称。
patterns.domain: 高能粒子物理、实验论文

patterns.name: 希格斯与电弱物理
patterns.trigger: “Higgs boson”“electroweak symmetry breaking sector”“triple and quartic couplings”
patterns.context: 讨论希格斯粒子、电弱对称性破缺或规范耦合，以及相关实验检验。
patterns.domain: 粒子物理、标准模型及其扩展

patterns.name: 暗物质与宇宙学
patterns.trigger: “DM”“Dark Matter”“cosmological structure”“Lambda Cold Dark Matter”；“unknown particles”
patterns.context: 暗物质作为粒子或宇宙学成分出现，涉及模型、搜寻或实验限制。

patterns.name: 论文中实验排除与发现的表述
patterns.trigger: “ruled out by the current experiments”“after the discovery of a 125 GeV Higgs boson”“looking for”
patterns.context: 以实验结果、发现或探测器搜索来约束理论或候选粒子。

patterns.name: 有效场论与核力计算
patterns.trigger: “effective field theory (EFT) approach”“nuclear forces”“power counting scheme”“higher order terms”
patterns.context: 介绍理论框架、系统计算方法及修正阶数；与对撞机和希格斯主题并不完全相同。

patterns.name: 独特的论文摘要格式
patterns.context: 摘要开头的文本格式与缩进标记触发，后接电弱物理内容。

en.description: Primarily responds to high-energy particle physics paper contexts: terminology for models, particles, decays, experiments, and energy scales, as well as paper introductions, citations, and LaTeX formatting; some passages focus on hyperon/baryon decays.

patterns.name: Introduction to physics paper body text
patterns.context: Introduces research background, theoretical framework, experimental status, or motivation at the beginning of a paper or paragraph; typically accompanied by sentence-initial capitalization and domain terminology
patterns.domain: High-energy particle physics and phenomenology papers

patterns.name: Particle physics terminology and naming
patterns.context: When discussing particles, interactions, theoretical models, experiments, or decay processes; not limited to a single specific term

patterns.name: Experimental and energy-scale statements in papers
patterns.context: States experiment location, collision energy range, particle mass, or calculation precision

patterns.name: Citations and LaTeX mathematical typesetting
patterns.context: Cites prior work in the text or uses LaTeX to typeset particle symbols, coupling constants, and reaction equations

patterns.name: Specific particle decays and baryon context
patterns.context: Discusses hyperons, baryons, or specific decay channels; not a shared theme across the other passages

patterns.name: Activation near sentence beginnings and title markers
patterns.context: Activation sometimes falls on title/paragraph-initial formatting markers or common introductory words immediately following them; these co-occur with physics content and are not necessarily independent triggers

9_1732.concept: 高能粒子物理论文语境
9_1732.description: 主要响应高能粒子物理论文语境：模型、粒子、衰变、实验与能标等术语，以及论文引入、引用和LaTeX排版；个别段落聚焦超子/重子衰变。

patterns.name: 物理学论文正文导入
patterns.context: 论文开头或段落开头介绍研究背景、理论框架、实验现状或研究动机；通常伴随句首大写词和领域术语
patterns.domain: 高能粒子物理、现象学论文

patterns.name: 粒子物理术语与命名
patterns.context: 在讨论粒子、相互作用、理论模型、实验或衰变过程时；不仅限于特定单一术语

patterns.name: 论文中的实验与能标表述
patterns.trigger: “at the Fermilab Tevatron”“at the CERN LHC”“at LEP200”“125 GeV”“Next to Next to leading order”等
patterns.context: 陈述实验地点、碰撞能区、粒子质量或计算精度

patterns.name: 引用文献和 LaTeX 数学排版
patterns.context: 文中引用既有研究，或用 LaTeX 排版粒子符号、耦合常数和反应式

patterns.name: 特定粒子衰变与重子语境
patterns.context: 讨论超子、重子或具体衰变道；不是其余段落共同的主题

patterns.name: 句首及标题标记附近激活
patterns.trigger: “Introduction”“Abstract”前后的换行、标题分隔线，以及句首“The”“From”等
patterns.context: 激活有时落在标题/段首格式标记或紧邻其后的常见引入词；与正文物理内容共同出现，未必是独立触发因素

en.description: Primarily responds to the Standard Model, Higgs, electroweak symmetry, and new physics in high-energy physics papers; also covers dark matter, hadron resonances, quantum corrections, and collider processes. It may additionally be sensitive to the style of ArXiv introduction openings.

patterns.name: Standard Model background and limitations
patterns.context: Introduces the successes, predictions, or limitations of the Standard Model of particle physics, often motivating new physics; also includes the context of the Higgs discovery in the Standard Model.

patterns.name: Higgs and electroweak physics
patterns.context: Discusses the Higgs boson, Higgs decays, or electroweak symmetry breaking and related collision processes.

patterns.name: Dark matter and cosmology
patterns.context: Studies dark matter as a component of the universe, in structure formation, or in simplified dark matter models.

patterns.name: Particle states, resonances, and hadron processes
patterns.context: Discusses hadrons, charmonium, resonances, or specific particle decay and production cross sections.

patterns.name: Theoretical corrections and effective actions
patterns.context: Discusses the effects of quantum corrections, derivative terms, or gauge-field terms on properties such as degeneracy.

patterns.name: Colliders and dilepton observations
patterns.context: Discusses production processes at colliders and their use in luminosity monitoring or searches for new physics.
patterns.domain: Experimental/phenomenological high-energy physics abstracts and introductions

patterns.name: Formatting of introduction headings and openings
patterns.context: At the beginning of ArXiv paper introductions, headings, paragraph boundaries, and overview sentences may jointly enhance activation.
patterns.domain: ArXiv paper structure and academic style

patterns.name: Possible off-main-line named-entity triggers
patterns.context: These proper nouns or formulas each occur in different theoretical contexts; aside from belonging to theoretical physics, they show no stable shared content trigger.
patterns.domain: Particle physics or technical field theory discussions

9_1732.concept: 高能物理论文语境
9_1732.description: 主要响应高能物理论文中标准模型、希格斯、电弱对称性及新物理背景，也覆盖暗物质、强子共振、量子修正和碰撞机过程；对ArXiv引言开篇可能另有文体敏感性。

patterns.name: 标准模型背景与局限
patterns.context: 介绍粒子物理标准模型的成功、预测或局限，常引出新物理；也包括标准模型中的希格斯发现背景。

patterns.name: 希格斯与电弱物理
patterns.context: 讨论希格斯粒子、希格斯衰变或电弱对称性破缺及相关碰撞过程。
patterns.domain: 高能物理、粒子碰撞论文

patterns.name: 暗物质与宇宙学
patterns.context: 将暗物质作为宇宙组成、结构形成或简化暗物质模型的研究对象。
patterns.domain: 粒子宇宙学、暗物质论文

patterns.name: 粒子态、共振与强子过程
patterns.context: 讨论强子、粲偶素、共振或粒子衰变、产生截面等具体过程。

patterns.name: 理论修正与有效作用量
patterns.context: 关于量子修正、导数项或规范场项对简并等性质的影响。

patterns.name: 碰撞机与双轻子观测
patterns.context: 讨论碰撞机中的产生过程及其作为亮度监测或探测新物理的用途。
patterns.domain: 实验/现象学高能物理摘要与引言

patterns.name: 格式性引言标题与开篇
patterns.trigger: “Introduction”及其后的论文开篇句式，如“The standard model…”、“Despite the broad success…”
patterns.context: ArXiv论文引言开头；标题、段落边界和概述句可能共同增强激活。

patterns.name: 可能的非主线专名触发
patterns.context: 这些专名或公式各出现于不同理论语境，除同属理论物理外看不出稳定的共同内容触发。
patterns.domain: 粒子物理或场论技术讨论

en.concept: Domain terminology and mechanisms in scientific papers
en.description: Primarily responds to particles, bosons, mass, quarks, and other terminology in particle physics papers, as well as Standard Model theory and collider searches, production, and decay contexts; also includes hadron transverse momentum, paper structure markers, and activation in a passage about renal glucose/drug text.

patterns.name: Particle and mechanism terminology in physics
patterns.context: In high-energy or particle physics texts, discusses particle types, mass, production, decay, interactions, symmetry, or representations; activation is distributed across terms and nearby words
patterns.domain: Particle physics, theoretical physics, and experimental physics papers

patterns.name: Collider experiments and search statements
patterns.context: Describes particle production, detection, reconstruction, or searches at colliders, often alongside words such as Higgs, boson, and quark

patterns.name: Standard Model and beyond-the-Standard-Model theory context
patterns.context: Discusses theoretical frameworks such as the Standard Model, effective field theory, dark matter, or supersymmetry; activation sometimes falls on model names and nearby theoretical terms

patterns.name: Particle physics experimental institutions and energy context
patterns.context: Prepositional phrases preceding experiment or facility names; appears only in particle physics experimental contexts

patterns.name: Hadron and transverse-momentum phenomena
patterns.context: Discusses hadron production at high transverse momentum and its scaling behavior or particle ratios

patterns.name: Renal glucose reabsorption and drugs
patterns.context: Introduces glucose reabsorption in the proximal renal tubule and mentions SGLT inhibitors or clinical trials

patterns.name: Abstract or paper structure markers
patterns.context: Formatting boundaries in paper abstracts or introductions; activation sometimes appears on the markers themselves and nearby content

patterns.name: Incidental activation near proper names and citations
patterns.context: Near theoretical physicists' names, references, or experimental facility names; activation does not necessarily cover the full proper name

9_1732.concept: 科学论文中的领域术语与机制
9_1732.description: 主要响应粒子物理论文中的粒子、玻色子、质量、夸克等术语，以及标准模型理论和对撞机搜索、产生、衰变语境；另有强子横动量、论文结构标记和一段肾脏葡萄糖/药物文本中的激活。

patterns.name: 物理学粒子与机制术语
patterns.trigger: “particle(s)”, “boson(s)”, “Higgs boson”, “mass”, “quark”, “fermions”, “gauge bosons”, “hyperon”及其周边物理术语
patterns.context: 高能物理或粒子物理文本中，讨论粒子种类、质量、产生、衰变、相互作用、对称性或表示时；激活分布在术语及其邻近语词上
patterns.domain: 粒子物理、理论物理与实验物理论文

patterns.name: 对撞机实验与搜索表述
patterns.context: 描述粒子在对撞机中的产生、探测、重建或搜索，常与 Higgs、boson、quark 等词共同出现

patterns.name: 标准模型及超出标准模型的理论语境
patterns.trigger: “electroweak symmetry breaking”, “effective field theory”, “DM searches”, “beyond standard model”, “SM”, “soft masses”
patterns.context: 讨论标准模型、有效场论、暗物质或超对称等理论框架；激活有时落在模型名称及邻近理论术语上

patterns.name: 粒子物理实验机构与能量语境
patterns.trigger: “at”及其后接实验设施或能量相关名称，如 “at the CERN Large Electron-…”, “at the Fermilab Tevatron”
patterns.context: 实验地点或装置名称前的介词短语；仅在粒子物理实验语境中出现

patterns.name: 强子与横动量现象
patterns.context: 讨论高横动量下强子产生及其标度行为或粒子比值
patterns.domain: 高能核物理/强子物理论文

patterns.name: 肾脏葡萄糖重吸收与药物
patterns.context: 介绍近端肾小管葡萄糖重吸收，并提及 SGLT 抑制剂或临床试验

patterns.name: 摘要或论文结构标记
patterns.context: 论文摘要或引言的格式边界；标记本身及其附近内容有时出现激活

patterns.name: 专名与引文中的偶发激活
patterns.context: 理论物理学者姓名、参考文献或实验设施名称附近，激活不一定覆盖完整专名

en.concept: High-energy physics and related scientific terminology
en.description: Primarily sensitive to particles, Higgs, the Standard Model, LHC, dark matter, and related theoretical terminology in high-energy physics papers; also includes hadron decays and one HIV compound record.

patterns.name: Particles and theory in high-energy physics
patterns.context: Discusses particles, mass, colliders, the Standard Model, and extensions, often in paper abstracts or introductions; activation often falls on scientific terms and neighboring words.
patterns.domain: High-energy physics, particle physics, and cosmology papers

patterns.name: Specific hadrons and decays
patterns.context: Discusses coupling constants under SU(3) symmetry, hyperon masses, or baryon decays.

patterns.name: Compounds in HIV-infected cells
patterns.context: Describes synthetic lipopeptides and their occurrence in HIV-infected cells; differs from the other high-energy physics passages.

9_1732.concept: 高能物理及相关科学术语
9_1732.description: 主要对高能物理论文中的粒子、Higgs、标准模型、LHC、暗物质及相关理论术语敏感；另见强子衰变和一条 HIV 化合物记录。

patterns.name: 高能物理中的粒子与理论
patterns.trigger: “elementary particle physics”“Higgs boson”“standard model”“LHC”“new physics”“dark matter”“supersymmetry”等
patterns.context: 讨论粒子、质量、碰撞器、标准模型及其扩展，常见于论文摘要或引言；激活往往落在科学术语及其前后词上。
patterns.domain: 高能物理、粒子物理及宇宙学论文

patterns.name: 特定强子与衰变
patterns.context: 讨论 SU(3) 对称性下的耦合常数、超子质量或重子衰变。

patterns.name: HIV 感染细胞中的化合物
patterns.trigger: “one of the first compounds to appear in HIV-infected cells”
patterns.context: 描述合成脂肽及其在 HIV 感染细胞中的出现；与其余高能物理段落不同。

en.description: Primarily responds to high-energy physics paper contexts, especially the Standard Model, Higgs, electroweak symmetry breaking, colliders, and new physics; also covers dark matter, supersymmetry, hyperon hadron physics, and reacts to abstract and introduction formatting markers.

patterns.name: Standard Model particle physics terminology
patterns.context: Terms appear in the main text of particle physics research, often alongside theory, particles, mass, or models; no specific sentence pattern is required.

patterns.name: Colliders and experimental processes
patterns.context: Discusses collider experiments, collision processes, runs, or searches; activation near “at” is especially strong.

patterns.name: Higgs and electroweak symmetry
patterns.context: Mentions the Higgs boson, its discovery, or electroweak symmetry breaking; may concern searches, production, or research.

patterns.name: Dark matter and physics beyond the Standard Model
patterns.context: Identifies shortcomings of the Standard Model or discusses dark matter candidates, theoretical extensions, and new physics.

patterns.name: Supersymmetric soft-mass alignment
patterns.context: Discusses a specific supersymmetric model or theoretical proposal, independently of the main collider and Higgs patterns.

patterns.name: Hyperon masses and SU(3) couplings
patterns.context: Discusses specific hadron processes, coupling constants, and hyperon mass relations.

patterns.name: Paper structure and abstract markers
patterns.context: Formatting markers in a paper abstract or introduction, distinct from the main text topic and absent from some passages.

9_1732.concept: 高能物理研究文本
9_1732.description: 主要响应高能物理论文语境，尤其标准模型、希格斯、电弱破缺、对撞机及新物理；也覆盖暗物质、超对称、超子强子物理，并对摘要和引言格式标记有反应。

patterns.name: 标准模型粒子物理术语
patterns.context: 术语出现在粒子物理研究的正文中，常与理论、粒子、质量或模型并列；不要求特定句式。

patterns.name: 对撞机与实验过程
patterns.trigger: “at the”后接对撞机或实验设施名称，如“at the CERN Large Electron-Posit...”、“at present collider Tevatron”；另有“colliders”
patterns.context: 讨论对撞机实验、碰撞过程、运行或搜索；“at”附近激活尤其强。

patterns.name: 希格斯与电弱对称性
patterns.context: 提及希格斯粒子、其发现或电弱对称性破缺；可以是搜索、产生或研究。

patterns.name: 暗物质与标准模型之外的新物理
patterns.trigger: “dark matter (DM)”, “no clear DM candidates”, “new physics ... beyond the SM”, “extensions”
patterns.context: 指出标准模型的不足，或讨论暗物质候选、理论扩展及新物理。
patterns.domain: 宇宙学与粒子物理现象学

patterns.name: 超对称软质量对齐
patterns.context: 讨论特定超对称模型或理论提案，不依赖对撞机、希格斯等主模式。

patterns.name: 超子质量与 SU(3) 耦合
patterns.context: 讨论特定强子过程、耦合常数及超子质量关系。

patterns.name: 论文结构与摘要标记
patterns.context: 论文摘要或引言的格式标记，与正文主题不同，且未在所有段落出现。

en.description: Activation is concentrated on theoretical and experimental particle physics terminology, and also covers dark matter, supersymmetry, cosmological inflation, and hadron physics; the shared theme is academic discussion of fundamental particles, models, or cosmic components in physics papers.

patterns.name: Particle physics and the Standard Model
patterns.context: Discusses particles, particle properties, interactions, or classifications in the Standard Model; activation often appears at sentence endings or paragraph truncations
patterns.domain: High-energy theoretical and experimental particle physics

patterns.name: Dark matter and its searches
patterns.context: Mentions dark matter and its searches at the LHC, its cosmological role, or related models

patterns.name: Supersymmetric particles and masses
patterns.context: Discusses superpartners and their mass alignment in supersymmetric theories

patterns.name: Cosmology and inflation
patterns.context: Introduces inflation and its role as a supplement to the standard cosmological model

patterns.name: Hadrons, hyperons, and SU(3)
patterns.context: Discusses baryons, hyperon masses, or hadronic coupling constants

9_1732.concept: 粒子物理学术文本
9_1732.description: 激活集中于理论与实验粒子物理术语，也覆盖暗物质、超对称、宇宙学暴胀及强子物理；共同点是物理学论文中关于基本粒子、模型或宇宙成分的学术叙述。

patterns.name: 粒子物理与标准模型
patterns.context: 讨论粒子、粒子性质、相互作用或标准模型中的分类；多处在句子末尾或段落截断处出现激活
patterns.domain: 高能理论与实验粒子物理

patterns.name: 暗物质及其搜寻
patterns.context: 提及暗物质及其在 LHC 的搜寻、宇宙学作用或相关模型

patterns.name: 超对称粒子与质量
patterns.context: 讨论超对称理论中的超伴粒子及其质量对齐

patterns.name: 宇宙学与暴胀
patterns.context: 介绍暴胀及其作为标准宇宙学模型补充的作用

patterns.name: 强子、超子与 SU(3)
patterns.context: 讨论重子、超子质量或强子耦合常数

en.description: Responds to formal background and research statements in ArXiv particle physics papers, especially the Standard Model, electroweak/Higgs physics, particle decays, and quark flavor processes; also covers dark matter, cosmology, experimental facilities, group representations, and specific hadronic formalisms.

patterns.name: Introduction structure in particle physics papers
patterns.context: Moves into the Introduction after the title or abstract, or formally states background, theory, and research motivation in the introduction; this structural cue appears across multiple passages.
patterns.domain: ArXiv academic papers, mainly high-energy physics

patterns.name: Standard Model and electroweak/particle physics terminology
patterns.context: Discusses the Standard Model, electroweak symmetry, particle types, interactions, or theoretical corrections; activation occurs on the terms themselves and nearby explanatory sentences.
patterns.domain: High-energy theoretical and experimental particle physics

patterns.name: Particle decays and final-state processes
patterns.context: Describes particle decays, production channels, final-state particles, or corresponding corrections, especially involving Higgs bosons, quarks, and leptons.
patterns.domain: Particle physics phenomenology and collider experiments

patterns.name: Quarks, flavor, baryons, and hadrons
patterns.context: Includes particle physics entities such as quark generations, flavor changes, neutral currents, strangeness, or hadronic states; not limited to one type of process.

patterns.name: Dark matter and cosmological observations
patterns.context: Discusses dark matter searches and effective field theory interpretations, or determines dark matter density from astrophysical or cosmological observations and simulations.

patterns.name: Theoretical models, searches, and experimental facilities
patterns.context: Introduces theoretical frameworks for explaining or searching for new physics, or discusses colliders and their physics measurement capabilities.

patterns.name: Representations and gauge group classification statements
patterns.context: Explanatory or contrastive statements defining Lorentz, spin, or gauge-group representations of fermions and gauge bosons.

patterns.name: Specific spin formalism and photoproduction amplitudes
patterns.context: Discusses photoproduction involving strange baryon resonances and uses a specific formalism to handle spin-3/2 states.

patterns.name: Isolated discussion of heavy-particle masses
patterns.context: After noting that one effect is not closely related to another discussion, shifts to a heavy-particle mass scale; the local excerpt is insufficient to determine a more specific topic.
patterns.domain: Particle physics paper body text; specific subfield unclear

9_1732.concept: 粒子物理学术语境
9_1732.description: 响应ArXiv粒子物理论文中正式背景与研究陈述，尤对标准模型、电弱/Higgs、粒子衰变及夸克味过程敏感；也覆盖暗物质、宇宙学、实验设施、群表示和特定强子形式体系。

patterns.name: 粒子物理论文的引言结构
patterns.context: 论文标题或摘要之后进入 Introduction，或引言中以正式学术语句陈述背景、理论和研究动机；该结构线索在多个段落中出现。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文，主要为高能物理

patterns.name: 标准模型与电弱/粒子物理术语
patterns.context: 讨论标准模型、电弱对称性、粒子种类、相互作用或理论修正；术语本身及其邻近说明语句激活。
patterns.domain: 高能理论与实验粒子物理

patterns.name: 粒子衰变与末态过程
patterns.context: 描述粒子衰变、产生道、末态粒子或相应修正，尤其提及 Higgs、夸克、轻子等。
patterns.domain: 粒子物理现象学与碰撞实验

patterns.name: 夸克、味与重子/强子
patterns.context: 出现夸克代际、味变化、中性流、奇异数或强子态等粒子物理对象；不限于同一种过程。

patterns.name: 暗物质与宇宙学观测
patterns.context: 讨论暗物质搜寻、有效场论解释，或以天体、宇宙学观测和模拟确定暗物质密度。
patterns.domain: 暗物质现象学与宇宙学

patterns.name: 理论模型、搜索与实验设施
patterns.context: 介绍用于解释或搜寻新物理的理论框架，或讨论对撞机及其物理测量能力。
patterns.domain: 粒子物理现象学与实验

patterns.name: 表象与规范群的分类陈述
patterns.context: 以定义或对比句解释费米子和规范玻色子的洛伦兹、自旋或规范群表示。
patterns.domain: 粒子物理理论背景说明

patterns.name: 特定自旋形式体系及光产生振幅
patterns.context: 讨论含奇异重子共振的光产生过程，并采用特定形式体系处理自旋 3/2 态。

patterns.name: 孤立的重粒子质量讨论
patterns.context: 在谈及某效应与另一项讨论关系不大之后，转入重粒子质量尺度；给出的局部片段不足以确定更具体主题。
patterns.domain: 粒子物理论文正文，具体子领域不明

en.description: Primarily responds to the Standard Model and its extensions, particle processes, and new-physics contexts in particle physics papers; also covers supersymmetry, dark matter effective field theory, compositeness, and hadronic photoproduction; commonly found in introductions.

patterns.name: Standard Model introduction and limitations
patterns.context: Introduces the Standard Model, its predictions or limitations, and raises new physics, model extensions, or dark matter in particle physics paper introductions
patterns.domain: ArXiv high-energy physics and particle physics papers

patterns.name: Particle physics terminology and processes
patterns.context: Discusses fundamental particles, particle decays, production processes, interactions, or particle properties; does not necessarily use Standard Model introductory phrasing
patterns.domain: ArXiv particle phenomenology and theoretical physics

patterns.name: Supersymmetry and soft-mass alignment
patterns.context: Discusses supersymmetric theory and its soft-mass problem in an abstract

patterns.name: Effective field theory and dark matter searches
patterns.context: Explains the use of effective field theory to analyze and interpret dark matter searches at the Large Hadron Collider

patterns.name: Compositeness and coupling constant definitions
patterns.context: Discusses coupling constants based on particle-state compositeness and applies them to specific spin-particle interaction vertices

patterns.name: Hadronic photoproduction and spin formalism
patterns.context: Constructs photoproduction amplitudes and uses the Rarita–Schwinger formalism to describe spin-3/2 particles

patterns.name: Introduction heading and line-break formatting
patterns.context: Formatting of the Introduction heading at the start of an ArXiv paper body; the heading marker itself also activates

9_1732.concept: 粒子物理新物理语境
9_1732.description: 主要响应粒子物理论文中的标准模型及其扩展、粒子过程和新物理语境，也覆盖超对称、暗物质有效场论、复合性与强子光产生等细分内容；常见于引言。

patterns.name: 标准模型引言与局限
patterns.trigger: “standard model”/“Standard Model”、“SM”，以及“beyond the SM”“extensions to the SM”等
patterns.context: 粒子物理论文引言中介绍标准模型、其预测或局限，并引出新物理、模型扩展或暗物质问题
patterns.domain: ArXiv 高能物理与粒子物理论文

patterns.name: 粒子物理术语与过程
patterns.trigger: “Higgs-boson decay”“flavour-changing neutral current”“massive $Z^0$ and $W^\pm$ particles”“di-lepton production”“spin-3/2”“strangeness-bary”
patterns.context: 讨论基本粒子、粒子衰变、产生过程、相互作用或粒子性质；不一定出现标准模型引言句式
patterns.domain: ArXiv 粒子现象学与理论物理

patterns.name: 超对称与软质量对齐
patterns.trigger: “Dimopoulos and Giudice”“dynamically aligning the soft masses”“sfermions”“supersymmetric”
patterns.context: 摘要中讨论超对称理论及其软质量问题
patterns.domain: ArXiv 理论粒子物理摘要

patterns.name: 有效场论与暗物质搜索
patterns.trigger: “effective field theory (EFT)”“DM searches at the LHC”
patterns.context: 说明用有效场论分析、解释大型强子对撞机上的暗物质搜索

patterns.name: 复合性与耦合常数定义
patterns.context: 基于粒子态的复合性讨论耦合常数，并用于特定自旋粒子相互作用顶点

patterns.name: 强子光产生与自旋形式体系
patterns.context: 构造光产生振幅并采用 Rarita–Schwinger 形式体系描述自旋 3/2 粒子

patterns.name: 引言标题与换行格式
patterns.context: ArXiv 论文正文开头的 Introduction 标题格式；标题标记本身也有激活

en.concept: The Standard Model and its extensions in high-energy physics
en.description: All activations come from high-energy physics papers and commonly appear in introductions and discussions of the Standard Model and new physics; specific topics include the Higgs, flavor physics, particle representations, gauge symmetries, supersymmetry, and collider processes.

patterns.name: Introduction and motivation for new physics
patterns.context: At the start of a paper, introduces the successes of the Standard Model, unresolved problems, and motivations for new physics beyond it; some triggers cluster around the introduction heading and opening sentence.

patterns.name: Particle discovery and the Higgs
patterns.context: Discusses the existence, mass, experimental search for, or discovery of the Higgs boson.

patterns.name: Flavor physics and meson decays
patterns.context: Involves heavy-flavor quarks, meson decays, flavor-changing neutral currents, or neutral-meson oscillations.

patterns.name: Standard Model particle classification and gauge representations
patterns.context: Describes the spin, Lorentz representation, or gauge-group representation of fermions and gauge bosons.

patterns.name: Gauge symmetry and unitarity
patterns.context: Discusses the unitarity problem and additional gauge symmetries and their mediator particles as a solution.
patterns.domain: New physics models / theoretical particle physics

patterns.name: Supersymmetric candidate theories
patterns.context: Introduces candidate foundational theories for the Standard Model, especially supersymmetry.

patterns.name: Dilepton production at colliders
patterns.context: Describes lepton or Higgs production and the experimental use of dilepton processes at hadron colliders.

9_1732.concept: 高能物理中的标准模型及其扩展
9_1732.description: 激活均来自高能物理论文，常见于引言及标准模型、新物理讨论；细分涉及希格斯、味物理、粒子表示、规范对称性、超对称和对撞机过程。

patterns.name: 引言与新物理动机
patterns.context: 论文开头介绍标准模型的成功、未解问题及超出标准模型的新物理动机；部分触发集中在引言标题与开篇句。

patterns.name: 粒子发现与希格斯
patterns.context: 谈论希格斯粒子的存在、质量、实验搜寻或发现。
patterns.domain: 粒子物理与实验现象学

patterns.name: 味物理与介子衰变
patterns.trigger: “CP violation”“Lambda_b … decays”“flavour-changing neutral current”“neutral K”“D”“B”“B_s mesons”
patterns.context: 涉及重味夸克、介子衰变、味改变中性流或中性介子振荡。

patterns.name: 标准模型粒子分类与规范表示
patterns.context: 说明费米子与规范玻色子的自旋、洛伦兹表示或规范群表示。

patterns.name: 规范对称性及幺正性
patterns.trigger: “restore unitarity”“spin-1 mediator”“gauge boson”“additional U(1)' gauge symmetry”
patterns.context: 讨论幺正性问题，并以额外规范对称性及其中介粒子作为解决方案。
patterns.domain: 新物理模型／理论粒子物理

patterns.name: 超对称候选理论
patterns.context: 介绍标准模型的基础理论候选，特别提及超对称理论。

patterns.name: 对撞机上的双轻子产生
patterns.trigger: “leptons and Higgs boson production”“di-lepton production”“luminosity monitor”“collider Tevatron”
patterns.context: 说明强子对撞机中的轻子或希格斯产生及双轻子过程的实验用途。

en.concept: Standard Model background in particle physics
en.description: Primarily responds to Standard Model background and its limitations in particle physics paper introductions, often accompanied by beyond-the-Standard-Model, new-physics, and Higgs terminology; also covers related background statements about dark matter, supersymmetric soft masses, coupling constant definitions, and experimental exclusions.

patterns.name: Particle physics Standard Model introduction
patterns.context: Introduces the Standard Model and its successes, limitations, or research background in a paper introduction; often followed by particle physics terminology.
patterns.domain: Theoretical and phenomenological particle physics papers

patterns.name: New physics beyond the Standard Model
patterns.context: Identifies problems unexplained by the Standard Model or discusses searches and phenomena beyond it.

patterns.name: Higgs boson and its properties
patterns.context: Introduces the Higgs discovery, production, decay, mass, or electroweak symmetry breaking; not every passage focuses primarily on the Higgs.

patterns.name: Dark matter candidates and Standard Model gaps
patterns.context: Points out in a cosmological or particle physics context that the Standard Model has no clear dark matter candidate.
patterns.domain: Dark matter and particle physics papers

patterns.name: Specific supersymmetric models and soft masses
patterns.context: Discusses the dynamical alignment of soft masses in supersymmetric models and related concerns; unlike most passages, this is not a Standard Model overview.

patterns.name: Basic introduction to theoretical terms or physical quantities
patterns.context: Defines basic physical quantities in explanatory text and notes that parameters in the Standard Model are determined experimentally.
patterns.domain: Popular-science-style or background text in particle physics papers

patterns.name: Experimental constraints on the Standard Model
patterns.context: Summarizes theoretical proposals excluded or constrained by current experiments, especially mentioning the Higgs discovery.

9_1732.concept: 粒子物理标准模型背景
9_1732.description: 主要响应粒子物理论文导言中的标准模型背景及其局限，常伴随超越标准模型、新物理和希格斯术语；也覆盖暗物质、超对称软质量、耦合常数定义及实验排除等相关背景表述。

patterns.name: 粒子物理标准模型导言
patterns.context: 论文导言中介绍标准模型及其成功、局限或研究背景；常接粒子物理术语。
patterns.domain: 理论与现象粒子物理论文

patterns.name: 超越标准模型的新物理
patterns.context: 指出标准模型未解释的问题，或讨论超出标准模型的搜索与现象。

patterns.name: 希格斯玻色子及其性质
patterns.context: 介绍希格斯发现、产生、衰变、质量或电弱对称性破缺；并非每段都以希格斯为主旨。

patterns.name: 暗物质候选与标准模型缺口
patterns.context: 在宇宙学或粒子物理背景下指出标准模型没有清晰暗物质候选。
patterns.domain: 暗物质与粒子物理论文

patterns.name: 特定超对称模型与软质量
patterns.context: 讨论超对称模型中软质量的动态对齐及相关担忧；不像多数段落那样是标准模型概述。

patterns.name: 理论术语或物理量的基础介绍
patterns.context: 以说明性文字定义基本物理量，并提及标准模型中参数由实验确定。
patterns.domain: 粒子物理科普式或论文背景文字

patterns.name: 标准模型遭实验约束
patterns.context: 概述理论方案受到当前实验排除或限制，特别提及希格斯发现。

en.concept: Particle physics paper background and new physics
en.description: Primarily responds to the introduction context of high-energy particle physics papers: the Standard Model and its limitations, Higgs physics, electroweak physics, and new physics; also covers dark matter, flavor-physics decays, supersymmetry abstracts, and collider processes.

patterns.name: Paper introduction opening and formatting markers
patterns.context: Moves into the introduction after the title or abstract and begins presenting background, current status, or a problem; also activates on common English introductory words

patterns.name: Standard Model and its limitations
patterns.context: Discusses the successes or unresolved problems of the Standard Model, or new physics beyond it

patterns.name: Higgs and electroweak physics
patterns.context: Discusses the discovery, decay, or mass of the Higgs boson, or electroweak symmetry breaking

patterns.name: Dark matter candidates and models
patterns.context: Notes the lack of a dark matter candidate in the Standard Model or discusses simplified dark matter models
patterns.domain: Particle physics and dark matter phenomenology

patterns.name: Rare B-meson decays and CP violation
patterns.context: Uses B-meson or baryon decays to test the Standard Model and search for new physics
patterns.domain: Flavor physics and experimental particle physics

patterns.name: Supersymmetric soft masses and fermions
patterns.context: Discusses the dynamical alignment of superpartner soft masses in a supersymmetric model abstract

patterns.name: Collider processes and experimental facilities
patterns.context: Discusses collider production processes as a means of luminosity monitoring or probing physics beyond the Standard Model

9_1732.concept: 粒子物理论文背景与新物理
9_1732.description: 主要响应高能粒子物理论文的引言语境：标准模型及其局限、希格斯、电弱物理和新物理；也覆盖暗物质、味物理衰变、超对称摘要与对撞机过程。

patterns.name: 论文引言开篇与格式标记
patterns.context: 标题或摘要后进入引言，开始介绍研究背景、现状或问题；对常见英文引言起始词也有激活

patterns.name: 标准模型及其局限
patterns.context: 讨论标准模型的成功、未解决问题或模型之外的新物理
patterns.domain: 粒子物理理论与现象学

patterns.name: 希格斯与电弱物理
patterns.context: 谈希格斯粒子的发现、衰变、质量或电弱对称性破缺

patterns.name: 暗物质候选与模型
patterns.context: 指出标准模型缺乏暗物质候选，或讨论简化暗物质模型
patterns.domain: 粒子物理与暗物质现象学

patterns.name: B介子稀有衰变与CP破坏
patterns.trigger: “Direct CP violation”“Lambda_b decays”“rare decays of B-mesons”“FCNC”
patterns.context: 以B介子或重子衰变检验标准模型、寻找新物理
patterns.domain: 味物理与实验粒子物理

patterns.name: 超对称软质量与费米子
patterns.context: 摘要中讨论超对称模型及超伴子软质量的动力学排列

patterns.name: 对撞机过程与实验设施
patterns.context: 讨论对撞机产生过程作为亮度监测或探测超出标准模型物理的手段

en.concept: Particle physics research context (including one biomedical example)
en.description: Primarily responds to Standard Model, new physics, particle decay, and collider research contexts in particle physics papers; also covers supersymmetry, gauge symmetry, and B-meson CP violation; includes one biomedical passage on glaucoma receptor therapy.

patterns.name: Particle physics introduction
patterns.context: Introduces the limitations of the Standard Model, new physics beyond it, and research motivation in an introduction or background passage.
patterns.domain: High-energy theoretical and phenomenological particle physics; academic papers

patterns.name: Particle physics technical terminology and calculations
patterns.context: Discusses Standard Model particles, decays, loop corrections, or perturbative orders.
patterns.domain: Particle physics calculations and phenomenology; academic papers

patterns.name: Supersymmetry and soft masses
patterns.context: Discusses supersymmetric models and theoretical issues concerning particle mass parameters.

patterns.name: Leptons, Higgs, and colliders
patterns.context: Explains collider production processes and their use in luminosity monitoring or as probes of new physics.

patterns.name: New particles and gauge symmetry
patterns.context: Introduces additional new physics to restore unitarity and interprets the mediator particle as a gauge boson of a new gauge symmetry.
patterns.domain: Particle physics model building; academic papers

patterns.name: Rare B-meson decays and CP violation
patterns.context: Uses B-meson or baryon decays to test the Standard Model and search for new physics, or studies direct CP violation.

patterns.name: Glaucoma receptor therapy
patterns.context: Describes the therapeutic potential suggested by receptor and gene-expression manipulation; differs from the particle physics context.

9_1732.concept: 粒子物理研究语境（含一例生物医学）
9_1732.description: 主要响应粒子物理论文中的标准模型、新物理、粒子衰变与对撞机研究语境，也涉及超对称、规范对称性及B介子CP破坏；另有一段青光眼受体疗法生物医学文本。

patterns.name: 粒子物理引言
patterns.context: 引言或背景段落中介绍标准模型的局限、标准模型之外的新物理及研究动机。
patterns.domain: 高能理论与唯象粒子物理；学术论文

patterns.name: 粒子物理技术术语与计算
patterns.context: 讨论标准模型粒子、衰变、圈图修正或微扰阶数等计算问题。
patterns.domain: 粒子物理计算与现象学；学术论文

patterns.name: 超对称与软质量
patterns.context: 讨论超对称模型及其粒子质量参数的理论问题。

patterns.name: 轻子、希格斯与对撞机
patterns.context: 说明对撞机产生过程及其作为亮度监测或新物理探针的用途。
patterns.domain: 对撞机唯象学；学术论文

patterns.name: 新粒子与规范对称性
patterns.context: 为恢复幺正性而引入额外新物理，并将媒介粒子解释为新规范对称性的规范玻色子。
patterns.domain: 粒子物理模型构建；学术论文

patterns.name: B介子稀有衰变与CP破坏
patterns.trigger: “rare decays of B-mesons”“Direct CP violation in Λb decays”
patterns.context: 以B介子或重子衰变检验标准模型并寻找新物理，或研究直接CP破坏。

patterns.name: 青光眼受体疗法
patterns.context: 描述受体及基因表达操控所提示的潜在治疗前景；与粒子物理语境不同。

en.description: Primarily responds to the Standard Model and its limitations, and new-physics searches, in particle physics papers; also broadly responds to the Higgs, electroweak processes, B decays, supersymmetry, unitarity, and particle/accelerator proper names.

patterns.name: The Standard Model and physics beyond it
patterns.context: In introductions or discussions in particle physics papers, describes the Standard Model, its limitations, or searches for new physics beyond it.

patterns.name: Higgs and electroweak physics
patterns.context: Discusses the Higgs boson, Higgs decays, or its mass and electroweak symmetry breaking.

patterns.name: B-meson decays and CP violation
patterns.context: Introduces B-meson or baryon decays as a way to test the Standard Model and search for new physics.

patterns.name: Supersymmetric soft masses and sfermions
patterns.context: Abstracts discuss soft-mass alignment in supersymmetric models and related theoretical concerns.

patterns.name: Gauge invariance and restoration of unitarity
patterns.context: First identifies indications of new physics, then proposes additional gauge bosons/gauge symmetries to restore unitarity.

patterns.name: Local activations on particle physics proper names and symbols
patterns.context: Specific particles, mass scales, or accelerator names appear in particle physics contexts; these local terms cannot be grouped into a narrower topic on their own.

9_1732.concept: 粒子物理与新物理
9_1732.description: 主要响应粒子物理论文中标准模型及其局限、新物理搜索，并广泛响应希格斯、电弱过程、B衰变、超对称、幺正性及粒子/加速器专名。

patterns.name: 标准模型及超越标准模型
patterns.context: 粒子物理论文介绍或讨论中，说明标准模型、其不足，或寻找超出标准模型的新物理。

patterns.name: 希格斯与电弱物理
patterns.context: 谈论希格斯粒子、希格斯衰变或其质量与电弱对称性破缺。

patterns.name: B介子衰变与CP破坏
patterns.trigger: “CP violation”、“Lambda_b decays”、“B meson factories”、“rare decays of B-mesons”
patterns.context: 介绍B介子或重子衰变及其作为检验标准模型、寻找新物理的途径。

patterns.name: 超对称软质量与sfermion
patterns.context: 摘要中讨论超对称模型的软质量对齐及相关理论顾虑。

patterns.name: 规范性与幺正性恢复
patterns.context: 先指出新物理迹象，再提出额外规范玻色子/规范对称性以恢复幺正性。

patterns.name: 粒子物理专名与符号的局部激活
patterns.context: 在粒子物理语境中出现具体粒子、质量尺度或加速器名称；这些局部词项无法单独归并为更窄主题。

en.description: Strongly responds to Standard Model, new physics, and phenomenology terminology in particle physics papers, especially Higgs physics, particle decays, flavor physics, and colliders; also covers supersymmetry, additional gauge symmetries, and ψ(3770) production.

patterns.name: New physics beyond the Standard Model
patterns.context: Discusses shortcomings of the Standard Model, experimental constraints, or possible extensions

patterns.name: Higgs and electroweak symmetry
patterns.context: Involves the Higgs particle, its mass or decay, or symmetry breaking
patterns.domain: Particle physics and high-energy collision phenomenology

patterns.name: Rare decays, flavor physics, and CP violation
patterns.context: Discusses B-meson or Higgs decays, flavor-changing neutral currents, CP violation, and their sensitivity to new physics

patterns.name: Loop-level processes
patterns.context: States that a process occurs at loop level in the Standard Model, or mentions related decays in context

patterns.name: Supersymmetric soft-mass alignment
patterns.context: Discusses supersymmetric models and dynamical soft-mass alignment in an abstract

patterns.name: Additional gauge symmetry and spin-1 mediator
patterns.context: Uses an additional U(1)' gauge boson as a mechanism to restore unitarity

patterns.name: Lepton colliders and dilepton production
patterns.context: Introduces lepton/Higgs production at colliders and the use of dilepton processes

patterns.name: Charmonium resonance and cross section
patterns.context: Discusses resonant and nonresonant production around the ψ(3770) energy region

9_1732.concept: 粒子物理现象学术语
9_1732.description: 对粒子物理论文中的标准模型、新物理及其现象学术语有较强反应，尤其涉及希格斯、粒子衰变、味物理与对撞机；也覆盖超对称、额外规范对称性和ψ(3770)产生。

patterns.name: 标准模型之外的新物理
patterns.trigger: “new physics”“beyond the SM”“extensions to the SM”
patterns.context: 讨论标准模型的不足、实验约束或可能的扩展

patterns.name: 希格斯与电弱对称性
patterns.context: 涉及希格斯粒子、其质量、衰变或对称性破缺
patterns.domain: 粒子物理与高能碰撞现象学

patterns.name: 稀有衰变、味物理与 CP 破坏
patterns.context: 讨论 B 介子或希格斯衰变、味变中性流、CP 破坏及其对新物理的敏感性

patterns.name: 回圈级过程
patterns.context: 说明标准模型中过程发生于回圈级，或上下文提及相关衰变

patterns.name: 超对称软质量排列
patterns.context: 摘要中讨论超对称模型及其软质量的动力学排列

patterns.name: 额外规范对称性与自旋1媒介子
patterns.context: 以额外 U(1)' 规范玻色子作为恢复幺正性的机制

patterns.name: 轻子对撞机与双轻子产生
patterns.context: 介绍对撞机上的轻子/希格斯产生及双轻子过程的用途

patterns.name: 粲偶素共振与截面
patterns.context: 讨论 ψ(3770) 能区的共振与非共振产生

en.description: Activations cluster in the introduction and abstract contexts of ArXiv particle physics papers: the Standard Model, motivations for new physics, and topics such as the Higgs, decays, supersymmetry, and dark matter; also responds to introduction headings and descriptions of experimental constraints.

patterns.name: Opening language in scientific paper introductions
patterns.context: An introduction heading follows the paper title or abstract, beginning a statement of background, problems, or research motivation.

patterns.name: Standard Model and new physics background
patterns.context: Introduces Standard Model predictions and limitations, or motivations for physics beyond the Standard Model.

patterns.name: Higgs and electroweak physics
patterns.context: Discusses the Higgs boson, symmetry breaking, decays, or mass scales.

patterns.name: Specific particle processes and rare decays
patterns.context: Describes particle production, decays, rare processes, and their significance for testing the Standard Model.

patterns.name: Supersymmetric soft masses and superpartners
patterns.context: Abstracts discuss supersymmetric models and the dynamical alignment of superpartner soft masses.

patterns.name: Absence of a dark matter candidate
patterns.context: States that the Standard Model cannot provide a viable dark matter candidate, following related literature citations.

patterns.name: Unitarity and additional gauge symmetries
patterns.context: Motivated by restoring unitarity, proposes additional gauge bosons or gauge symmetries.

patterns.name: Heavy Higgs and strong-interaction scenarios
patterns.context: Discusses strong-interaction scenarios according to Higgs mass and experimental search results.

patterns.name: Literature citations and experimental constraints
patterns.context: Cites previous studies and uses experimental results or the Higgs discovery to illustrate constraints on a model.
patterns.domain: ArXiv paper main text and reference context

9_1732.concept: 粒子物理引言语境
9_1732.description: 激活集中于粒子物理 ArXiv 论文的引言与摘要语境：标准模型、新物理动机，以及希格斯、衰变、超对称、暗物质等主题；也响应引言标题和实验约束表述。

patterns.name: 物理学术论文引言起始语
patterns.trigger: Introduction / introduction，常伴随“Despite”“The”“It is known”等引入句
patterns.context: 论文标题或摘要后出现引言标题，并开始背景、问题或研究动机的陈述

patterns.name: 标准模型及新物理背景
patterns.context: 介绍标准模型的预测、局限，或超出标准模型的新物理动机

patterns.name: 希格斯与电弱物理
patterns.context: 讨论希格斯粒子、对称性破缺、衰变或质量尺度

patterns.name: 特定粒子过程与稀有衰变
patterns.context: 描述粒子产生、衰变、稀有过程及其用于检验标准模型的意义

patterns.name: 超对称软质量与超粒子
patterns.context: 摘要中讨论超对称模型及超粒子软质量的动力学对齐

patterns.name: 暗物质候选者缺失
patterns.context: 指出标准模型不能提供明确暗物质候选者，且置于相关文献引用之后

patterns.name: 幺正性与新规范对称性
patterns.context: 以恢复幺正性为动机，提出额外规范玻色子或规范对称性

patterns.name: 重希格斯与强相互作用情景
patterns.context: 按希格斯质量及实验搜寻结果讨论强相互作用情景

patterns.name: 文献引用与实验约束
patterns.context: 引用既有研究，并以实验结果或希格斯发现说明模型受到约束
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文正文及参考文献语境

en.description: Activations are scattered across soul, medical term fragments, and several local lexical items; they also occur in headline-style structures. There is no stable shared semantic or stylistic condition across passages, suggesting a superposition of several weak patterns.

patterns.name: soul lexical item
patterns.context: Directly triggered by soul; once as an abstract noun and once referring to a singer’s music genre.

patterns.name: Salient subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments of medical terms, especially ischemic/ischemia and sympatho-excitation; boundary segmentation may affect triggering.

patterns.name: Local responses to domain terms or phrases
patterns.context: Activation falls respectively on a research-model term, direct in a comparison of treatment pathways, and job in a phrase about the labor market; the three have no clear shared meaning.
patterns.domain: Biomedicine, health services research, news headlines

patterns.name: Local responses in headlines, quotations, or emphasis structures
patterns.context: Occurs in headline-style sentences or news headlines; apart from these positional features, the trigger words and semantics are inconsistent.

9_1924.description: 激活分散于 soul、医学术语片段及若干局部词项；另在标题式结构中出现。不同段落间缺少稳定的共同语义或文体条件，可能是多个弱模式叠加。

patterns.name: soul 词项
patterns.context: 直接触发词 soul；一次是抽象名词，一次指歌手的音乐类型。

patterns.name: 显著的子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在医学术语的片段上，尤其 ischemic/ischemia 和 sympatho-excitation；边界切分可能影响触发。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、心血管研究

patterns.name: 领域词项或短语的局部响应
patterns.context: 激活分别落在研究模型术语、治疗路径比较中的 direct，以及就业市场短语中的 job；三者没有明显共同语义。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、卫生服务研究、新闻标题

patterns.name: 标题、引用或强调结构中的局部响应
patterns.context: 出现在标题式句子或新闻标题中；除这些位置特征外，触发词及语义不一致。
patterns.domain: 散文、格言式文字、技术新闻

en.description: Activations are scattered across soul, title- or sentence-initial capitalized words, and local subword fragments in several medical, technical, and social texts (scratch, ische(m), knock-out, ex, direct, job); no unified semantic or stable lexical pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: soul and related vocabulary
patterns.context: Appears in “requires soul” in paragraph 1 and in the singer description “US soul singer” in paragraph 8.

patterns.name: Specific English capitalized forms
patterns.context: Activations fall on capitalized words at sentence beginnings or in titles, including common words and proper-name fragments; “To” in paragraph 3 is strongest.

patterns.name: scratch
patterns.context: Appears in “rewrite Java from scratch,” meaning to rewrite from the beginning.

patterns.name: ische(m) in medical terms
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on the segmented, word-initial fragments “I” and “schem”; the words are “ischemic” and “ischemia.”

patterns.name: knockout
patterns.context: Appears in the compound term “knock-out models.”

patterns.name: Heart-failure-related word fragment
patterns.context: Occurs within “sympatho-excitation,” describing sympathetic excitation in heart failure.

patterns.name: direct clinic treatment
patterns.context: Appears in a discussion of treatment methods and cost-effectiveness, contrasted with “parent training.”

patterns.name: job market
patterns.context: Appears in a news headline about young men leaving the labor market.

9_1924.description: 激活分散于 soul、标题或句首大写词，以及若干医学/科技/社会文本中的局部词片段（scratch、ische(m)、knock-out、ex、direct、job）；未见统一语义或稳定词法模式。

patterns.name: soul 及相关词汇
patterns.context: 段1中出现在“requires soul”中；段8中出现在歌手描述“US soul singer”中。

patterns.name: 特定英文大小写词形
patterns.context: 激活落在句首或标题式大写词上，包含常见词与专名片段；段3的“To”最强。

patterns.name: scratch
patterns.context: 出现在“rewrite Java from scratch”中，表达从头重写。

patterns.name: 医学词内的 ischem
patterns.context: 激活集中在被切分标注的词首片段“I”“schem”，词分别为“ischemic”和“ischemia”。

patterns.name: knockout
patterns.context: 出现在“knock-out models”这一复合术语中。

patterns.name: 心衰相关词片段
patterns.context: 处于“sympatho-excitation”一词中，描述心衰中的交感兴奋。

patterns.name: direct clinic treatment
patterns.context: 与“parent training”对照，出现在治疗方式及经济性讨论中。

patterns.name: job market
patterns.context: 出现在年轻男性退出就业市场的新闻标题中。

en.description: Activation clues are sporadic: they include sentence-initial “I/To,” soul (including its musical sense), the medical form ischemic, and several technical terms and fixed phrases. The different domains and usages lack a stable shared trigger.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial I / To and other pronouns or infinitives
patterns.context: At the start of statements or slogan-like text, followed by an action, identity, or expression of a position; may also simply be an ordinary sentence-initial function word.

patterns.name: soul / soul syllable
patterns.context: An abstract noun in “requires soul” and a music-style modifier in a music introduction; the semantic uses differ.

patterns.name: Specific forms in technical terminology
patterns.context: Appears in software reviews, biomedical models, or mechanical patent descriptions; the shared trigger is unclear.

patterns.name: job phrase
patterns.context: Combines with “market” to form “job market,” describing changes in the labor market.

patterns.name: direct clinic treatment phrase
patterns.context: Contrasts parent training with direct clinical treatment and discusses the cost-effectiveness of treatment delivery methods.

patterns.name: ischemic form
patterns.context: The word-initial portion is split into tokens; used to describe markers of necrosis, atrophy, or cardiovascular risk.

9_1924.description: 激活线索零散：包括句首“I/To”、soul（含音乐语义）、医学 ischemic 词形及若干技术词、固定短语；不同领域与用法缺乏稳定共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 句首 I / To 等代词与不定式
patterns.context: 位于陈述或口号式文本中的句首，后接动作、身份或立场表达；也可能只是普通句首功能词

patterns.name: soul / soul 音节
patterns.context: 在“requires soul”中为抽象名词，在音乐介绍中为音乐风格修饰语，语义用途不同

patterns.name: 技术术语中的特定词形
patterns.context: 出现在软件评论、生物医学模型或机械专利叙述中；共同触发条件不明确
patterns.domain: 科技新闻、生物医学、专利

patterns.name: job 短语
patterns.context: 与“market”构成“job market”，描述就业市场变化

patterns.name: direct clinic treatment 短语
patterns.context: 对比家长培训与直接临床治疗，并讨论治疗提供方式的成本效益

patterns.name: ischemic 词形
patterns.context: 词首被拆成 token；用于描述坏死、萎缩或心血管风险标志物

en.description: Activations are scattered across word-initial I, To, Trans, and other word-initial or subword fragments, as well as title case, medical terms, and several proper nouns and content words. The examples span domains and have inconsistent trigger positions, making them difficult to attribute to a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: “I” followed by a verb or the beginning of a technical term
patterns.context: A first-person statement begins with I, or a professional medical term begins with I; the two contexts differ.

patterns.name: Headline-style To
patterns.context: To appears as a salient initial token in titles, slogans, or sentence-internal infinitives; in some examples it is followed by a verb.

patterns.name: In-word subword fragment “Trans”
patterns.context: Trans begins longer words and is followed by different morphemes; one is a proper noun, the other a biomedical term.

patterns.name: Title and headline-style capitalization
patterns.context: Initial capitals or all caps appear in titles or email subjects; activations are distributed across multiple words, with no single fixed position.

patterns.name: Brief news-headline wording
patterns.context: News-headline-style expressions report claims about technological rewrites or social trends; activations fall on several common words in the headlines.

patterns.name: “soul” and expressions about lacking valuable resources
patterns.context: An aphoristic sentence says that worthwhile work requires soul, followed by a tokenization of lackluster; both co-occur in the same passage.

patterns.name: Disease and risk-marker terminology
patterns.context: Pathology, organ, or biomarker terms in medical abstracts; apart from fragments related to initial I, the terms themselves also activate.

patterns.name: Java rewrite and quotation attribution
patterns.context: A quotation and attribution about rewriting Java from scratch, in a technology news headline or paraphrase.

patterns.name: Proper name of a St. Petersburg cathedral
patterns.context: An architectural proper name in a parenthetical location, with «Trans» appearing again at the end of the line.

patterns.name: Transgenic and knockout models
patterns.context: Model types in research on DNA repair; activation is concentrated on knock-out and related terms.

patterns.name: Labor market and alternate reality
patterns.context: A news-headline-style statement that young men are leaving the labor market and entering another reality.

patterns.name: Revised-draft marker in an email subject
patterns.context: “REVISED DRAFT” in an all-caps email title or subject, marked by subword fragments.

9_1924.description: 激活分散在句首 I、To、Trans 等词首或子词片段，以及标题大小写、医学术语和若干专名、内容词上。跨领域且触发位置不一致，难以归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: “I”后接动词或专业术语开头
patterns.context: 句首第一人称后接陈述，或专业医学术语以 I 开头；两种上下文不同。

patterns.name: 标题式 To
patterns.context: 标题、口号或句中不定式中，To 作为显著的词首 token；部分例子后接动词。

patterns.name: 词内子词片段“Trans”
patterns.context: Trans 是较长词的开头，后接不同词素；一个为专名，另一个为生物医学术语。

patterns.name: 标题与标题式大小写
patterns.context: 标题或邮件主题中使用首字母大写或全大写；激活分布于多个词，未显示唯一固定位置。

patterns.name: 短促新闻标题用语
patterns.context: 新闻标题式表达，报告技术重写主张或社会趋势；激活落在标题中的若干普通词。

patterns.name: “soul”及缺乏相关资源的表达
patterns.context: 格言式句子谈有价值的事业需要灵魂，随后出现 lackluster 的分词切分；两者在同段共现。

patterns.name: 疾病与风险标志物术语
patterns.context: 医学摘要中的病理、器官或生物标志物术语；除开头 I 相关片段外，术语本身也有激活。

patterns.name: Java 重写及引文署名
patterns.context: 技术新闻标题或转述中，关于从头重写 Java 的引述与署名。

patterns.name: 圣彼得堡大教堂专名
patterns.context: 地点括注中的建筑专名，且行末再次出现 «Trans»。

patterns.name: 转基因与基因敲除模型
patterns.context: 研究 DNA 修复的模型类型；激活集中于 knock-out 及相关术语。

patterns.name: 就业市场与替代现实
patterns.context: 新闻标题式陈述年轻男性离开就业市场并投入另一种现实。

patterns.name: 邮件主题中的修订稿标记
patterns.context: 全大写邮件标题或主题中的 “REVISED DRAFT”，按子词片段标记。

en.description: The most consistent trigger across the paragraphs is the capital letter J, especially at the beginning of words, names, or identifiers; it may be followed by different letters, numbers, or punctuation, and contexts and styles vary widely.

patterns.name: Words or names beginning with J
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on the initial letter J, which may form an English word, a name, or a foreign name; it often appears at the beginning of a line or list item.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, web text, and other prose

patterns.name: J in legal case identifiers
patterns.context: J occurs at the beginning of a legal case or section identifier, followed by hyphens, letters, and numbers; the identifier is often followed by a line break.

patterns.name: J in ordinary English words
patterns.context: J is the initial letter of an ordinary word, appearing within a sentence rather than in a case identifier or prominent name format.

patterns.name: Sentence-internal word-initial J and adjacent text
patterns.context: A sentence contains a fragment beginning with J and followed by a hyphen; in this example the activation extends to subsequent words.

9_1924.description: 各段最一致的触发是大写字母 J，尤其词首、姓名或编号开头；后续可为不同字母、数字或标点，语境与文体差异很大。

patterns.name: J 开头的词或姓名
patterns.context: 激活集中在词首字母 J；后续可组成英文词、姓名或外来姓名，常处于行首或列表项开头。
patterns.domain: 百科、网页文本及其他散文

patterns.name: 法律条文编号中的 J
patterns.context: J 位于法律案号或条文编号开头，后接连字符、字母与数字；编号后常有换行。

patterns.name: 普通英文词语中的 J
patterns.context: J 是普通词的词首，出现在句中而非案号或显著姓名格式。

patterns.name: 句中词首 J 与相邻文本
patterns.context: 句子中出现以 J 开头、后接连字符的片段；该例激活延伸到后续词语。

en.concept: Polysemous activations across multilingual and symbolic fragments
en.description: Primarily responds to minus signs, negative numbers, and variables in mathematical expressions; it also activates on email hyphens, Gujarati characters, code identifiers, medical citation abbreviations, and individual English word fragments, showing several scattered patterns.

patterns.name: Negative numbers and algebraic variables in mathematics
patterns.context: Variables and signed numbers appear in algebraic expressions, lists of negative integers, or math problems; activations fall on variables, minus signs, and number fragments

patterns.name: Hyphen in email
patterns.context: A hyphen appears alone after the name “Bob”, followed by a line break

patterns.name: Gujarati letters
patterns.context: A continuous sequence of Gujarati characters, with multiple letters and diacritics activated

patterns.name: Code identifiers and underscores
patterns.context: Uppercase environment variables or macro identifiers separated by underscores, as well as package lookup statements

patterns.name: Medical journal citation abbreviations
patterns.context: Journal name and its abbreviation, followed by year and volume/issue information

patterns.name: Specific word fragments in English prose
patterns.context: “soul” and “lackluster” occur in aphoristic English prose; the two triggers are difficult to unify

9_1924.concept: 多语种与符号片段的多义激活
9_1924.description: 主要在数学式中响应负号、负数及变量；另对邮件连字符、古吉拉特字符、代码标识符、医学引文缩写和个别英语词片段激活，呈现多种分散模式。

patterns.name: 数学中的负数与代数变量
patterns.context: 代数式、负整数列表或数学题中出现变量和带负号的数；激活落在变量、负号及数字片段上

patterns.name: 邮件中的连字符
patterns.context: 姓名“Bob”后单独出现连字符，随后换行

patterns.name: 古吉拉特文字母
patterns.context: 连续的古吉拉特文字符序列，多个字母及附标被激活
patterns.domain: Github 内容中的古吉拉特文字

patterns.name: 代码标识符与下划线
patterns.context: 代码中由下划线分隔的大写环境变量或宏标识符，以及包查找语句

patterns.name: 医学期刊引文缩写
patterns.context: 期刊名及其缩写，后接年份、卷期信息
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 医学文献引文

patterns.name: 英语散文中的特定词片段
patterns.context: 格言式英语散文中出现“soul”及“lackluster”；两处触发彼此难以归并

en.description: Primarily responds to problem wording and symbols in generated algebra problems; sporadic activations also occur on medical table labels, Swedish report titles, particle physics terms, and kana in Japanese poetry.

patterns.name: Specific template words in math problems
patterns.context: Appears as an instruction or question in a math problem after an algebraic expression, equation, or numerical operation; often accompanied by a short answer and line break.
patterns.domain: Automatically generated math question-and-answer text in DM Mathematics

patterns.name: Symbols and variables in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: These symbols are embedded in polynomials, equations, fractions, or factorization problems; activation is distributed across the calculations and adjacent problem wording, not restricted to a particular variable.
patterns.domain: Algebra problems and their text-formatted equations

patterns.name: Table column headers and group labels
patterns.context: Headers and column labels in a medical cohort data table, preceded by a discussion of cohort and clinical assessment.

patterns.name: Swedish proper nouns and report titles
patterns.context: Appears in a report title or attribution-style phrase and includes Swedish diacritic letters and EU-related vocabulary.

patterns.name: Particle physics terms and symbols
patterns.context: Discusses the Standard Model, quantum chromodynamics, and the effects of new physics on asymmetries.
patterns.domain: High-energy particle physics abstracts in PubMed Abstracts

patterns.name: Specific kana in a Japanese poem
patterns.context: Appears in a user-help discussion about a classical Japanese sentence; the poem is written in Japanese, and activation is concentrated on the kana and nearby text.
patterns.domain: StackExchange Japanese language discussion and classical Japanese quotation

9_1924.concept: 多领域文本中的局部词符模式
9_1924.description: 主要响应生成式代数题中的题面词和符号；另对医学表格标签、瑞典语报告标题、粒子物理术语及日语诗句中的假名有零散激活。

patterns.name: 特定数学题面模板词
patterns.context: 在代数表达式、方程或数字运算之后，作为数学题目指令或问句出现；常伴随短答案和换行。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 中的自动生成数学问答文本

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的符号与变量
patterns.context: 这些符号嵌在多项式、等式、分数或求因式题中；激活分布于算式和相邻题面，不局限于某个变量。
patterns.domain: 代数题及其文本化公式

patterns.name: 表格列标题和分组标签
patterns.context: 医学队列数据表的表头与列标签，前文提及 cohort 和临床评估。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 医学论文表格

patterns.name: 瑞典语专名及报告标题
patterns.context: 出现在报告标题或署名式短语中，包含瑞典语变音字母及欧盟相关词汇。

patterns.name: 粒子物理术语与符号
patterns.trigger: “Z pole”“next-to-leading order”“QCD”“SM asymmetry”“top-quark forward-backward asymmetry”“M(NP)≲150 GeV”
patterns.context: 围绕标准模型、量子色动力学和新物理对不对称性的影响展开。
patterns.domain: PubMed Abstracts 中的高能粒子物理摘要

patterns.name: 日语诗句中的特定假名
patterns.context: 出现在用户求助讨论古典日语句子的上下文中，诗句以日文书写；激活集中于该假名及附近文字。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 日语语言讨论与古典日语引文

en.description: Activations occur in compact alphanumeric and punctuation strings in code fields, identifiers, citations, formulas, and technical scientific notation; they also appear in URL paths and experimental data.

patterns.name: Structured identifiers and code fields
patterns.context: In code/configuration field names, names and numbers separated by @, or numbered lists, letters, digits, underscores, and punctuation form compact structured strings; activations fall on several components of these strings.

patterns.name: Literature citations and bracketed numbers
patterns.context: Bracketed citation markers, reference numbers, and mixed alphanumeric strings in medical or scientific texts.

patterns.name: Numerical and symbolic strings in scientific text
patterns.context: In formulas or technical notation, numbers, operators, and element/ion symbols occur adjacent to one another; activations may fall on fragments of numbers and symbols.

patterns.name: Numbers in scientific measurements and experimental data
patterns.context: Numbers and combinations of units or chemical names associated with samples, isotopes, concentrations, or experimental quantities in biomedical research.

patterns.name: URL paths and hyphen-separated words
patterns.context: English phrases in URL paths, separated by slashes and joined by hyphens, followed by Markdown links.

9_1924.description: 激活分布于代码字段、标识符、引用、公式和专业科学记号中的紧凑字母数字及标点串；也出现在 URL 路径与实验数据中。

patterns.name: 结构化标识符与代码字段
patterns.context: 在代码/配置字段名或以 @ 分隔的名称、编号列表中，字母、数字、下划线和标点构成紧凑的结构化字符串；激活落在这些字符串的多个组成部分上。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码、ArXiv 结构化文本

patterns.name: 文献引用与方括号编号
patterns.context: 医学或科学文本中的方括号引用标记、文献编号及其混合字母数字串。
patterns.domain: ArXiv、PubMed Central 科学/医学文献

patterns.name: 科学文本中的数值与符号串
patterns.context: 公式或专业记号中，数字、运算符、元素/离子符号相邻；激活可落在数字和符号的片段上。
patterns.domain: 数学、凝聚态物理、生物医学

patterns.name: 科学测量与实验数据中的数字
patterns.context: 生物医学研究中与样本、同位素、浓度或实验量相关的数字及单位/化学名称组合。

patterns.name: URL路径与连字符分词
patterns.context: 网址路径中由斜杠分隔、以连字符连接的英文词组，后接 Markdown 链接。
patterns.domain: GitHub 中的 URL/Markdown 链接

en.description: Activations are distributed across programming Q&A and code snippets, especially regex character classes, index/array identifiers, string splitting, and data-column selection; they also appear in physics LaTeX, academic citations, HTML extraction, and forum help requests. There is no single stable semantic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Letter ranges and character-set regular expressions
patterns.context: Regular expressions constrain input using character ranges, optional whitespace, or negated character classes; often accompanied by validation contexts such as minLength, pattern, and Regex.

patterns.name: Index and array-dimension identifiers in code
patterns.context: C-style code declares an image-channel array, with uppercase, underscore-separated dimension constants forming a multidimensional array type.

patterns.name: Dynamic indexing into a validator collection and ID selectors
patterns.context: Discusses how to retrieve a control’s validators; code indexes a page validator array and constructs a jQuery ID selector.

patterns.name: String splitting and key-value object construction
patterns.context: Splits an input string by a delimiter, extracts two parts, and constructs an object with identifier/value fields.

patterns.name: Prediction and label column selection
patterns.context: Selects specified columns from prediction and label data frames in data-processing code, then uses them to calculate metrics.

patterns.name: Particle physics symbols in LaTeX
patterns.context: LaTeX mathematical typesetting for reactions and related particle states.

patterns.name: Literature citations and questionnaire methodology suggestions
patterns.context: Discusses survey respondents and questionnaire item formats, and cites methodological recommendations.

patterns.name: Extracting HTML link results
patterns.context: Asks how to extract a specific string from a character object or link-list output; the example contains an HTML anchor.

patterns.name: Help-seeking questions and thanks
patterns.context: Uses first person to say the problem seems complicated and asks forum readers for a simpler approach or suggestions.

9_1924.description: 激活分布在多种编程问答与代码片段中，突出正则字符类、索引/数组标识符、字符串拆分和数据列选择；另见物理 LaTeX、学术引用、HTML 抽取及论坛求助语句。没有单一稳定的语义触发模式。

patterns.name: 字母范围与字符集正则表达式
patterns.context: 正则表达式中用字符范围、可选空白或取反字符类约束输入；常伴随 minLength、pattern、Regex 等校验语境。

patterns.name: 代码中的索引与数组维度标识符
patterns.context: C 风格代码声明图像通道数组，以大写下划线命名的维度常量构成多维数组类型。

patterns.name: 验证器集合的动态索引与 ID 选择器
patterns.context: 讨论如何取得控件的验证器，代码通过页面验证器数组索引并构造 jQuery ID 选择器。

patterns.name: 字符串拆分与键值对象构造
patterns.context: 把输入字符串按分隔符切分，再提取两个部分并构造带 identifier/value 字段的对象。

patterns.name: 预测与标签列筛选
patterns.context: 在数据处理代码中从预测及标签数据表选出指定列，随后用于指标计算。

patterns.name: LaTeX 中的粒子物理符号
patterns.context: 反应式以及相关粒子态的 LaTeX 数学排版语境。

patterns.name: 文献引用与问卷方法建议
patterns.context: 谈调查回应者及问卷题目格式，并援引方法学建议。

patterns.name: 抽取 HTML 链接结果
patterns.context: 询问如何从字符对象或链接列表输出中提取特定字符串，示例包含 HTML 锚点。

patterns.name: 求助式提问与致谢
patterns.trigger: Could you guys help me out or shoot some pointers. Thanks.
patterns.context: 以第一人称表达觉得问题复杂，向论坛读者请求更简单的做法或建议。

en.description: Activations span legal judgments and litigation wording, code identifiers and symbols, computer vision paper citations, and semantic terminology; sporadic words also appear in sports and personal narratives, with no unified trigger condition.

patterns.name: Court rulings and legal procedure
patterns.context: Legal case narratives, court judgments, or contexts involving the attribution of parties and judges.

patterns.name: Structured identifiers and bracket symbols in code
patterns.context: Code, variable names, struct fields, or array/index expressions; activations are distributed across identifier fragments and symbols such as brackets and underscores.

patterns.name: Local punctuation and words that follow it
patterns.context: Words or phrases near punctuation in ordinary narratives; trigger positions are scattered, with no stable specific syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Sports reporting, personal narratives, and other webpage text (Pile-CC)

patterns.name: Computer vision paper citations and metric names
patterns.context: Authors, years, conference abbreviations, and evaluation metrics listed together in paper references or research metric lists.

patterns.name: Semantic terminology and discussion of meaning
patterns.context: Academic discussion of situation semantics, propositional meaning, and possible-world alternatives.

9_1924.description: 激活覆盖法律判决与诉讼措辞、代码标识符和符号、计算机视觉论文引用及语义学术语；另见体育和个人叙述中的零散词语，缺乏统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 法庭裁判与法律程序
patterns.trigger: “motion to suppress”, “Before:”, “Plaintiffs and Appellants”, “Defendant and Respondent”, “J.”
patterns.context: 法律案件叙述、法院判决或当事人及法官署名语境。

patterns.name: 代码中的结构化标识与括号符号
patterns.context: 代码、变量名、结构体字段或数组/索引表达式；激活分布在标识符片段及括号、下划线等符号上。

patterns.name: 句末或局部标点及其后续词语
patterns.context: 普通叙述中标点附近出现的词或短语；触发位置分散，未见稳定的特定句法条件。
patterns.domain: 体育报道、个人叙述等网页文本（Pile-CC）

patterns.name: 计算机视觉论文引用与指标名称
patterns.context: 论文参考文献或研究指标列表中，作者、年份、会议缩写与评价指标并列。

patterns.name: 语义学术语与意义讨论
patterns.context: 讨论情境语义、命题意义及可能世界替代方案的学术论述。

en.concept: Eyewitness reports and judgments of knowledge
en.description: Primarily responds to the eyewitness verbs saw/seen/seeing and their report or testimony frames, covering what witnesses, informants, and observers saw; sporadic activations also occur on know/knowing, mechanistic explanations, and hyphenated webpage links, which cannot all be attributed to the same pattern.

patterns.name: Perfect forms of witnessing or observing
patterns.context: A narrator, witness, or informant reports having witnessed a person, object, or event; common structures include see/seeing + object or the perfect had/has seen. Activation does not always fall on the complete “saw” token and also includes adjacent terms such as “that”, “reported”, and “know”
patterns.domain: Legal testimony and affidavits, news or public event reports, encyclopedia narratives

patterns.name: Reporting that someone witnessed something
patterns.context: Describes an event or evidence observed by someone within a report, testimony, or paraphrase; activation may fall on “that”, “reported”, or an eyewitness verb
patterns.domain: Legal documents, news reports, encyclopedia narratives

patterns.name: Cognitive judgments about intention, causality, or mechanism
patterns.context: Concerns knowing, understanding, or explaining the mechanisms, intentions, or consequences of things; does not require an eyewitness context
patterns.domain: Commentary, fictional narratives, health or sex education discussions

patterns.name: Testimony and case details in legal texts
patterns.context: Quotes statements by witnesses, defendants, or informants in legal narratives; usually accompanied by saw/seen, though the main testimony in paragraph 6 does not directly contain the activated saw/seen

patterns.name: Hyphenated technical terms and tokenization in links
patterns.context: Hyphen-connected webpage titles or URLs; activation is distributed across split word fragments and terms such as “know” and “about”, with no clear eyewitness meaning

patterns.name: Strategic knowledge in fiction
patterns.context: A character arranges a situation so that an opponent knows their circumstances; “know just” resembles the cognitive judgment pattern but does not involve witnessing

9_1924.description: 主要响应目击动词 saw/seen/seeing 及其报告、证词框架，覆盖证人、线人和观察者所见；另对 know/knowing、机制解释及连字符网页链接有零散激活，不能完全归为同一模式。

patterns.name: 目击或观察的完成式
patterns.trigger: “saw”+宾语（如“saw appellant”“saw no knife”“saw "some big dude"”“saw cocaine”“seeing a motorcycle police officer”“seeing both”）；另有“had seen”“has seen”
patterns.context: 叙述者、证人或线人报告曾目击某人、物或事件；常见结构为 see/seeing + 宾语，或完成式 had/has seen。激活位置不总是完整的“saw”，也包括与目击报告相邻的“that”“reported”“know”
patterns.domain: 法律证词与宣誓书、新闻或公共事件报道、百科叙述

patterns.name: 报告某人目击某事
patterns.trigger: “reported seeing”“reported seeing both”“Witnesses … testified that they saw”“informant saw”“maid … had seen”
patterns.context: 嵌入报告、证词或转述中，描述某人观察到的事件或证据；激活可能落在“that”“reported”或目击动词上
patterns.domain: 法律文书、新闻报道、百科叙述

patterns.name: 意图、因果或机制的认知判断
patterns.trigger: “knows exactly”“know just”“[know]ing the mechanism”“mechanism to explain”
patterns.context: 围绕知道、理解或解释事物的机制、意图或后果；不要求出现目击语境
patterns.domain: 评论、小说叙述、健康或性教育讨论

patterns.name: 法律文本中证词与案件细节
patterns.context: 法律叙事中引用证人、被告或线人陈述；通常伴随 saw/seen，但第6段的核心证词并未直接出现激活的 saw/seen
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 法律判决与宣誓书

patterns.name: 连字符技术词与链接中的分词
patterns.context: 由连字符连接的网页标题或 URL；激活分布于拆分后的词片段及“know”“about”等处，没有明显目击含义

patterns.name: 小说中的策略性知情
patterns.trigger: “plotters would know just how much worse off they’d be”
patterns.context: 角色安排情势，使对手知道其处境；“know just”与认知判断模式相似，但并非目击

en.description: Activations occur mainly in two types of expressions: know(s) exactly followed by what is known, and witnesses in case or police narratives having saw/seen a person or key evidence. There is also one instance of claimed/reported introducing an observation report; “Who knows what lurks” in paragraph 9 does not fully fit.

patterns.name: know exactly / know with certainty
patterns.context: know(s) is followed by exactly and then a fact, intention, or action; also includes the negative form “does not even know exactly what”.
patterns.domain: Parliamentary debate, commentary, music reviews, online discussions

patterns.name: Witnesses see key facts
patterns.context: A narrator or witness reports having personally seen a person, object, or event, often in case testimony or police-investigation narratives introduced by saw/seen.
patterns.domain: Legal decisions, police reports, and news coverage

patterns.name: Claim/report followed by eyewitness content
patterns.context: After a speech verb such as report, claim, or call the police, an observation about the police or an incident is recounted; adjacent to eyewitness narratives, but saw/seen is not always present.

9_1924.description: 主要激活于两类表达：know(s) exactly 后说明所知内容；以及案件、警方叙事中目击者 saw/seen 某人或关键证据。另有一次 claimed/reported 引出观察报告；第9段的“Who knows what lurks”不完全符合。

patterns.name: know exactly / 正确知道
patterns.context: know(s) 后接 exactly，再说明所知道的事实、意图或行动；也包括否定式“does not even know exactly what”。
patterns.domain: 议会辩论、评论、音乐评论、网络讨论

patterns.name: 目击者看见关键事实
patterns.context: 叙述者或证人报告亲眼看见某人、物品或事件，常见 saw/seen 引出的案件证词或警方调查叙事。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、警务与新闻报道

patterns.name: 声称／报告后接目击内容
patterns.context: 报告、声称或报警等言说动词之后，转述对警方或事件的观察；与目击叙事相邻，但不总有 saw/seen。

en.description: Activations are concentrated in two types of local collocations: past-tense saw followed by a description of witnessing, observing, or discovering; and exactly followed by a question word, expressing precise knowledge or determination.

patterns.name: Verb see followed by saw/saw it
patterns.context: Narrates someone seeing, discovering, or observing something firsthand; often appears in past-tense factual statements.
patterns.domain: Legal testimony, case narratives, and news anecdotes

patterns.name: Exactly followed by a question word
patterns.context: Emphasizes precisely knowing, identifying, or determining something, commonly in the structure “know exactly what/where/which/when”.
patterns.domain: Parliamentary discussions, technical explanations, commentary, and practical advice
