9_1924.description: 激活集中在两类局部搭配：过去时 saw 后描述目击、观察或发现；以及 exactly 后接疑问词，表达精确知道或确定。

patterns.name: 动词 see 后接 saw/saw it
patterns.context: 叙述某人亲眼看到、发现或观察到某事；常出现在过去时的事实陈述中。
patterns.domain: 法律证词、案件事实叙述及新闻轶事

patterns.name: exactly 后接疑问词
patterns.context: 强调精确知道、辨认或确定某事，常见结构为“know exactly what/where/which/when”。
patterns.domain: 议会讨论、技术说明、评论及实用建议

en.description: Most paragraphs activate the combination of know/knows and exactly, followed by what, who, when, which, and similar terms, expressing precise knowledge of an action, person, time, or content; there is also know/knowing in legal texts and one police-investigation narrative, where the pattern is weaker or different.

patterns.name: know exactly: precise knowledge/object
patterns.context: know/knows is immediately followed by exactly and then what/who/when/which or another question word, specifying the known object, time, or content; sometimes an intensifier intervenes.
patterns.domain: General discussion, life advice, commentary, music reviews

patterns.name: Knowing what one is doing
patterns.context: know exactly what someone is doing, often emphasizing that an action is intentional and deliberate, or warning those who lack understanding of an operation.

patterns.name: know in a judicial context
patterns.context: know occurs in a quotation or argument in a legal document; one instance asks about a person, and another is a split participial form of knowledge.

patterns.name: Investigation vocabulary in criminal narratives
patterns.context: Describes witness statements, suspects, and police surveillance; the know exactly construction is absent.

9_1924.description: 多数段落激活 know/knows 与 exactly 的组合，后接 what、who、when、which 等，表达精确知道行为、对象、时间或内容；另有法律文本中的 know/knowing，以及一段警方侦查叙述，模式较弱或不同。

patterns.name: know exactly：精确知识/对象
patterns.trigger: «know»6« exactly»10« what»1；«know»7« exactly»9 who；«know»4« exactly»9« when»1；«knows»6« exactly»9 which
patterns.context: know/knows 后紧接 exactly，再接 what/who/when/which 等疑问词，说明精确知道对象、时间或内容；有时中间夹有强调成分
patterns.domain: 一般论述、生活建议、评论、音乐评论

patterns.name: 知道自己在做什么
patterns.trigger: «know»6↵«what»1 they are doing；«know»7« exactly»9« what»1« they»1 are doing；«know»4« exactly»8 what you are doing
patterns.context: know exactly what someone is doing，常用于强调行为是有意且有把握的，或警告对操作缺乏了解者

patterns.name: 司法语境中的 know
patterns.trigger: «Service»2« wanted»4« to»1« know»9« to»5 whom；«[»1«know»8«ing»6« the»2« mechanism»2
patterns.context: know 出现在法律文书的引述或论证中；一处是询问对象，另一处为 knowledge 的分词拆分

patterns.name: 刑事叙述中的侦查词汇
patterns.trigger: « talked»3« with»2 a« man»2…« officers»1« established»4 a« surveillance»2« and»2« saw»8
patterns.context: 叙述证人陈述、嫌疑人及警方监视行动；未见 know exactly 构式
patterns.domain: 法律判决中的事实陈述

en.description: Most passages emphasize know/knows exactly followed by what, who, or which, expressing clear knowledge of specific content; sporadic patterns include URL headline words, legal questions, and deciding whether to do something.

patterns.name: Explicitly knowing and stating the content of one’s knowledge
patterns.context: Indicates that someone clearly knows what they are doing, their identity, or their task; “exactly” is followed by content introduced by what/who/which.
patterns.domain: Argumentation, character descriptions, and general expository prose

patterns.name: Phrases and lexical items in URLs
patterns.context: Activation falls on URLs or readable titles and phrases within URLs; there is no complete syntactic environment matching the main pattern.

patterns.name: Question sentences in legal judgments
patterns.context: Introduces and states the question under review by the court, concerning whether there was an abuse of discretion.

patterns.name: Deciding whether to do something
patterns.context: Discusses choosing whether to accept a certain practice; this passage does not contain the “know exactly” structure.

9_1924.description: 多数段落突出 know/knows exactly 后接 what、who 或 which，表达明确知道具体内容；另有网址标题词项、法律问题句和决定是否采取某事等零散模式。

patterns.name: 明确知道并说明认知内容
patterns.context: 表示某人清楚知道自己在做什么、身份或任务；“exactly”后接 what/who/which 引导的内容。
patterns.domain: 议论、人物描写及一般说明文

patterns.name: URL 中的短语与词项
patterns.context: 激活落在网址或网址中的可读标题、词组上；没有与主模式相同的完整句法环境。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的问题句
patterns.context: 引出并陈述法院审查的问题，涉及是否滥用裁量权。

patterns.name: 决定是否采取某事
patterns.context: 谈及选择是否接受某种做法；本段并未出现“know exactly”结构。

en.description: Mainly responds to combinations of know/knows with exactly and question words such as what, who/whom, and where, covering knowledge of intentions, inquiries about people, and URLs; it also responds to see-led verification clauses, legal citation formats, and one instance of far too much/doubt.

patterns.name: know exactly what someone is doing
patterns.context: know/knows combines with exactly and what/which to describe someone being aware of their actions, intentions, or impact.
patterns.domain: Prose such as commentary, news, and music descriptions

patterns.name: know whom or about whom
patterns.context: know is introduced by an infinitive and followed by whom/who, asking about a person or related people.

patterns.name: know what resource or information
patterns.context: know what is followed by an object to be looked up, especially resources in a particular area.

patterns.name: know where in a URL
patterns.context: know and where appear together in a web link or path rather than an ordinary sentence.

patterns.name: Clause following see
patterns.context: see is followed by a clause introduced by that or if, indicating verification of whether records are sufficient or checking whether there are attackers.

patterns.name: Abbreviated markers in statutes and case citations
patterns.context: Formatted text in US case citations, including U.S., volume and page numbers, and years.

patterns.name: much collocation and distant doubt
patterns.context: far too much appears at the beginning, with activation later on doubt; this may relate to a cross-token spelling or syntactic pattern.

9_1924.description: 主要响应 know/knows 与 exactly、what、who/whom、where 等疑问成分的搭配，涵盖知晓意图、查询对象及URL；另响应 see引导的核查从句、法律引文格式，以及一处 far too much/doubt。

patterns.name: know exactly what someone is doing
patterns.trigger: «know»6 «what»1 «they»2 are doing；«know»7 «exactly»10 «what»2 «they»2 «are»1 doing；«knows»7 «exactly»10 which buttons to push；«knows»5 «exactly»9 what he’s doing
patterns.context: know/knows 与 exactly、what/which 搭配，描述某人清楚自己的行为、意图或影响。
patterns.domain: 评论、新闻与音乐描述等散文

patterns.name: know whom或about whom
patterns.context: know 由不定式引出，后接 whom/who，询问对象或相关人员。

patterns.name: know what资源或信息
patterns.context: know what 后接需要查询的对象，尤其是特定区域内的资源。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、军事通信技术

patterns.name: URL中的 know where
patterns.context: know 与 where 连写在网页链接或路径文本中，而非普通句子。

patterns.name: see后接从句
patterns.context: see 后接 that 或 if 引导的从句，表示核实记录是否充分或查看是否有袭击者。

patterns.name: 法条与判例引文中的缩写标记
patterns.context: 美国判例引用中的 U.S.、卷页码及年份等格式化文本。

patterns.name: much搭配及远距离 doubt
patterns.trigger: «far»4 «too»1 much of a benefit of … «d»1oubt.« Let»2
patterns.context: 开头出现 far too much，后续标记跨越到 doubt，可能与跨 token 的拼写或句法模式有关。

en.description: Covers mathematical derivations, judgments of knowledge or intent involving know/exactly, legal procedure and rights arguments, as well as long-running conflicts in news and medical screening language. Trigger cues are scattered across domains, with no consistent dominant pattern.

patterns.name: “Suppose” and formal derivation
patterns.context: Introduces an assumption in a formula, variable assignment, or proposition derivation, followed by further equations; strong activation sometimes falls on a minus sign, number, or variable in the equation rather than only on the introductory word.
patterns.domain: Mathematical text, especially machine-generated or formalized algebraic derivations

patterns.name: know/exactly in judgments of knowledge or intent
patterns.context: Describes whether a person or institution clearly knows something, or intends to manipulate an outcome; activation concentrates on forms of know and nearby elements.

patterns.name: Procedural and rights language in legal arguments
patterns.context: Legal materials discuss a defendant’s capacity, an assessment, or whether an error in a pleading affected substantive rights. Trigger words vary across passages, but all occur in arguments about legal judgments or standards.

patterns.name: Prolonged or enduring conflict
patterns.context: A news headline describes the war on terror as a long battle; a single example, with activation mainly on long.
patterns.domain: News headlines / news summaries in email

patterns.name: Regular breast examinations
patterns.context: Discusses regular screening for people who have not had bilateral mastectomies; activation falls on regular and near mammogram.

9_1924.description: 覆盖数学推演、know/exactly 的知情或意图判断、法律程序与权利论证，以及新闻中的长期冲突和医学筛查措辞。不同领域触发线索分散，主导模式并不统一。

patterns.name: “Suppose”与形式推演
patterns.trigger: «Suppose»4；«Let»3；数学段中反复出现的« = »、«*»、变量和数值
patterns.context: 公式、变量赋值或命题推演中，引出假设后继续列式；强激活有时落在算式里的负号、数字或变量，而非只落在引导词上。
patterns.domain: 数学文本，尤其是机器生成或形式化的代数推演

patterns.name: know/exactly 与能力或意图判断
patterns.context: 描述人物或机构是否清楚了解某事，或是否有意操纵结果；激活集中在 know 的词形及其紧邻成分。

patterns.name: 法律论证中的程序与权利措辞
patterns.context: 司法材料中讨论被告能力、评估，或诉状错误是否影响实质权利。不同段落触发词不完全相同，但都出现在法律判断或法律标准的论证中。

patterns.name: 长时段或持久冲突
patterns.context: 新闻标题中把反恐斗争称作长期战斗；单例，激活主要落在 long。
patterns.domain: 新闻标题／邮件中的新闻摘要

patterns.name: 定期乳房检查
patterns.context: 讨论未接受双侧乳房切除者的定期筛查；激活落在 regular 及 mammogram 附近。

en.concept: Mixed response to linguistic fragments and structures
en.description: Activations are distributed across several text types: notably exactly emphasizing that someone knows what they are doing; there are also sporadic patterns involving a sports compound, URL parameters, Dutch word fragments, how constructions, IRC strings, and legal markers.

patterns.name: Emphatic cognition or intention following exactly
patterns.context: A person is described as knowing exactly what they are doing or how to affect others; exactly emphasizes certainty in English sentences.

patterns.name: Hyphenated regular-season phrase
patterns.context: In a sports context, regular and season form a hyphenated compound; activation falls on regular.

patterns.name: Database paths and query parameters in URLs
patterns.context: URL paths and query strings contain database result pages, names, and filtering parameters; activations are distributed across parameter fields and symbols.

patterns.name: Dutch internal word fragments and related forms
patterns.context: Activations occur within words in continuous Dutch text, involving accounts of finding something similar or getting away from something; no clear English pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Manner or degree expressions introduced by how
patterns.context: how occurs in questions or manner expressions, or in no matter how concessive constructions; activations also occur on adjacent content words such as people and cause.

patterns.name: Ping and alphanumeric strings in chat
patterns.context: IRC conversations contain ping messages and alphanumeric sequences resembling abbreviations or code; the two have no clear connection to the other patterns.

patterns.name: Argumentation and paragraph markers in decisions
patterns.context: Activations occur in legal text when procedural facts are stated, paragraphs cited, or sections separated.

9_1924.concept: 语言片段与结构的混合响应
9_1924.description: 激活分布在多类文本中：显著见于 exactly 后强调人物明知其行为；另有体育复合词、网址参数、荷兰语词片段、how 结构、IRC 字符串及法律标记等零散模式。

patterns.name: exactly 后接强调认知或意图
patterns.context: 人物被描述为清楚知道自己在做什么、知道如何影响他人；英语句中 exactly 强调其认知确定性。
patterns.domain: 评论、HackerNews 讨论、叙述性散文

patterns.name: regular-season 连字符词组
patterns.context: 体育语境中，regular 与 season 构成连字符复合词，激活落在 regular。

patterns.name: 网址中的数据库路径与查询参数
patterns.context: URL 路径和查询字符串包含数据库结果页、姓名及筛选参数；激活分布在参数字段和符号上。
patterns.domain: 网页链接、体育招募数据

patterns.name: 荷兰语词内片段及相关词形
patterns.context: 激活出现在荷兰语连续文本的词内片段，涉及寻找相似之物、摆脱某物等叙述；没有明显的英语模式。

patterns.name: how 引出的方式或程度表达
patterns.context: how 位于疑问/方式表达或 no matter how 让步结构中；激活还出现在 people、cause 等相邻内容词。

patterns.name: 聊天中的 ping 与字母数字字符串
patterns.context: IRC 对话中出现 ping 消息，以及类似缩写或代码的字母数字序列；两者与其他模式缺少明确联系。

patterns.name: 判决书的论证与段落标记
patterns.context: 法律文本在陈述程序事实、引用段落或分隔章节时激活。

en.concept: Procedural and adjudicative language in U.S. legal documents
en.description: Primarily responds to litigation procedure, court rules, and case citations in U.S. legal opinions, including appellate relief, rights, legal tests, and summary judgment language; also shows activation around an emphasis on intent in “knows exactly” in one piece of general commentary.

patterns.name: Litigation review, applications, and rights language
patterns.context: In criminal appeals or post-conviction relief documents, describes attorney ineffectiveness, an application for relief, the trial record, or a defendant’s procedural rights; trigger words often occur in legal terminology and syntactic structures.

patterns.name: Court rules and legal tests
patterns.context: Courts state the applicable legal standard, test, or rule of decision, especially concerning conviction and summary judgment.

patterns.name: Case citations and citation format
patterns.context: Case names, legal reporter citations, and nearby references to cases; activation falls on citation elements and punctuation.

patterns.name: General emphasis on causation or intent
patterns.context: Explains that someone deliberately took an action capable of attracting attention or producing an effect; no legal context.

9_1924.concept: 美国司法文书中的程序与裁判表述
9_1924.description: 主要响应美国法律意见中的诉讼程序、法院规则与判例引注，包括上诉救济、权利、法律测试及简易判决用语；另对一处一般评论中的“knows exactly”意图强调激活。

patterns.name: 诉讼审查、申请与权利表述
patterns.trigger: «appellate counsel»、«failed»、«petition for discretionary review»；«the petitioner is entitled to no»；«right»
patterns.context: 刑事上诉或定罪后救济文书中，描述律师失职、救济申请、审理记录或被告程序权利；触发词常在法律术语和句法结构中

patterns.name: 法院裁判规则与法律测试
patterns.context: 法院陈述适用的法律标准、测试或裁判规则，尤其涉及罪名认定和简易判决

patterns.name: 判例引注和裁判引用格式
patterns.trigger: «Slack» v. «McDaniel», «529» U.S. «473»；«Miller» v. «Cockrell»；法院名、卷号、记者名、页码及年份
patterns.context: 判例名称、法律报告引注与相邻的判例援引；激活标记落在引注成分及标点上

patterns.name: 一般性的因果／意图强调
patterns.context: 说明某人有意采取能引起关注或产生效果的做法；没有法律语境

en.description: The clearest concentration pattern is case citations and judicial determinations or legal-test phrasing in US legal opinions. Other activations are scattered across place-reference links, proper-name or abbreviation fragments, sports coverage, and online commentary, with no shared semantic condition.

patterns.name: Legal citations and statutory analysis
patterns.context: Case citations, court review, or legal tests appear in US cases or legal opinions; activations fall on citation fragments and analytical wording.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within names or words
patterns.context: Activations occur in components of proper names, institutional abbreviations, or colloquial abbreviations, in varied surrounding text; no unified semantic condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, interview links, narratives, or online commentary

patterns.name: Regular-season and matchup phrasing
patterns.context: Sports coverage mentions a player starting against the same opponent and regular-season appearances.

9_1924.description: 最明确的集中模式是美国法律意见中的判例引注及法院判断、法律测试措辞。其余激活分散在地名参考链接、专名或缩写片段、体育报道和网络评论中，缺少共同语义条件。

patterns.name: 法律引文与法条分析
patterns.context: 美国判例或法律意见中出现案件引注、法院审查或法律测试；激活落在引注片段及分析性措辞上。

patterns.name: 名称或词语内部的子词片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在专名、机构缩写或口语缩写的组成部分，周围文本类型不一；未见统一语义条件。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、访谈链接、叙述或网络评论

patterns.name: 常规赛与对阵措辞
patterns.context: 体育报道谈到球员作为首发面对同一对手及常规赛出场。

en.description: Primarily responds to expressions in legal texts where a court or agency determines a whether proposition, applies a standard, and reaches a decision; also appears in statements of people’s decisions or intentions, statistics on everyday activities, and truncated legal citations.

patterns.name: Courts making legal determinations
patterns.context: Legal arguments describe a court, trial court, or administrative agency needing to decide a question of law or fact; often appears in clauses containing whether.
patterns.domain: Cases and legal opinions, especially FreeLaw

patterns.name: Legal standards and adjudicative conclusions
patterns.context: Describes a jury or court applying a legal standard, deciding a dispute, or making a procedural ruling; activation occurs in contexts involving legal tests and adjudicative relations.

patterns.name: Expressions of decision or intent
patterns.context: Narrates a person making a decision or claiming that someone clearly knew the intent behind their actions; not a legal-judgment context.

patterns.name: Activity statistics and daily-life categories
patterns.context: Reports the proportion of service recipients receiving assistance and lists activities of daily living and instrumental activities of daily living.

patterns.name: Truncated citations or incomplete legal text
patterns.context: Case citations, names, or legal text are truncated; strong activation may partly overlap with legal adjudicative language in the citation, but the fragments themselves do not show a complete judgment pattern.

9_1924.description: 主要响应法律文本中法院或机构判定 whether 命题、适用标准并形成裁判的表达；也见于人物决定或意图表述、日常生活活动统计及截断的法律引文。

patterns.name: 法院作出法律判断
patterns.context: 在法律论证中描述法院、审判法院或行政机构需要判定某项法律或事实问题；常见于含 whether 的从句。
patterns.domain: 判例与法律意见，尤其是 FreeLaw

patterns.name: 法律标准及裁判结论
patterns.context: 说明陪审团或法院适用法律标准、判断争议或作出程序性裁决；激活落在法律测试及裁判关系的语境中。

patterns.name: 决定或意图的表达
patterns.context: 叙述人物作出决定，或声称某人清楚知道自己的行为意图；不是法律判断语境。

patterns.name: 统计活动与日常生活分类
patterns.trigger: “activity of daily living”“instrumental activity of daily living”
patterns.context: 报告服务对象接受的帮助比例，并列举日常生活及工具性日常生活活动。
patterns.domain: 医学或社会服务研究摘要

patterns.name: 引文中断或不完整法律文本
patterns.trigger: “Wilson N. Jones Mem’l Hosp.”、“Att’y Gen. U.S.”、“Gonzales”
patterns.context: 判例引文、人名或法律文本被截断；强激活可能与引文中的法律裁判措辞部分重叠，但这些片段本身未呈现完整判断模式。

en.description: Activations are scattered across legal cases and procedural terms, case numbers and contract identifiers, and the segmented spelling of GPS. There is also an isolated colloquial evaluation, a WTF exclamation, and Danish discussion of an epidemic. No unified semantic trigger is apparent; some similarities may stem from tokenization of abbreviations or proper names.

patterns.name: G “PS” letter tokenization
patterns.context: GPS is split into multiple tokens and appears in examples of devices or communications services; activation concentrates on G and often co-occurs with Global Positioning System.
patterns.domain: Patent background technology, electronic devices, and communications

patterns.name: Case/procedural terminology in legal documents
patterns.context: Appears in court captions, case numbers, and judicial-review arguments; several high activations fall on DC in case numbers or verbs describing ALJ decision procedures.
patterns.domain: US legal decisions and administrative appeals

patterns.name: LLC in legal names
patterns.context: Legal-entity suffix in a company or party name.

patterns.name: Conversational interjections and subjective evaluations
patterns.context: Colloquial sentences commenting on humor or expressing personal preferences or attitudes.

patterns.name: Danish epidemic and international movement
patterns.context: Danish sentences discuss international trade, mobility, and disease outbreaks; activations involve a segmented disease word and related terms.

patterns.name: Online abbreviation WTF
patterns.context: An uppercase exclamatory abbreviation expressing surprise after a surprising or absurd event is recounted.

patterns.name: Government supply contract identifiers
patterns.context: Appears in US government procurement or supply contract numbers and descriptions.

9_1924.description: 激活散见于法律案件与程序词、案号和合同编号，也覆盖 GPS 的拆分拼写；另有单例口语评价、WTF 感叹及丹麦语疫情论述。未见统一语义触发，部分相似处可能来自缩写或专名的分词形式。

patterns.name: G「PS」字母分词
patterns.context: GPS 被拆成多个 token，出现在设备或通信服务举例中；激活集中在 G，且常伴随 Global Positioning System。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术、电子设备与通信

patterns.name: 法律文书中的案件／程序术语
patterns.context: 法院标题、案号和司法审查论述中；若干高激活落在案号的 DC 或 ALJ 判断程序的动词上。
patterns.domain: 美国法律判决与行政上诉

patterns.name: 法律名称中的 LLC
patterns.context: 公司名称或当事人名称中的法律实体后缀。

patterns.name: 闲谈语气词与主观评价
patterns.context: 评论幽默、表达个人偏好或态度的口语化句子。

patterns.name: 丹麦语流行病与国际流动
patterns.context: 丹麦语句子讨论国际贸易、流动性与传染病暴发；激活涉及被拆分的疾病词及相关词。
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会文本／公共卫生

patterns.name: 网络缩写 WTF
patterns.context: 叙述意外或荒诞事件后，用大写感叹缩写表达惊讶。

patterns.name: 政府供应合同编号
patterns.context: 美国政府采购或供应合同编号与合同说明中。

en.concept: Structural and syntactic markers across text types
en.description: Activation is distributed across multiple text types: connectors, pronouns, and judgment/state predicates in natural-language sentences, as well as parenthetical abbreviations and structured field labels. Shared cues are weak, with no single clear semantic theme.

patterns.name: Function words and syntactic links
patterns.context: Serves as part of a connection, complement, or relational structure in continuous natural language; often appears mid-sentence.
patterns.domain: News, commentary, legal opinions, email, and general prose

patterns.name: Personal pronouns and subjects
patterns.context: A pronoun occurs in a statement or quotation, often linked to a following verb or clause.
patterns.domain: Commentary, dialogue, legal narrative, news reporting

patterns.name: Predicates expressing judgment or state
patterns.context: Declarative sentences describing attitudes, evaluations, judgments, or states.
patterns.domain: Commentary, legal texts, news, and public-health narratives

patterns.name: Abbreviations and parenthetical technical markers
patterns.context: Technical-term abbreviations are expanded or labeled in parentheses; letters may be split into multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Structured fields and identifiers
patterns.context: A field name, header, or code identifier is followed by a value, type, or email content.

9_1924.concept: 多类文本中的结构与句法标记
9_1924.description: 激活分布在多类文本中：自然语言句内连接词、代词和判断/状态谓语，以及括号缩写和结构化字段标识。共同线索较弱，未见单一明确语义主题。

patterns.name: 功能词与句法连接
patterns.context: 在连续自然语言中充当连接、补语或关系结构的一部分；常出现在句子中段
patterns.domain: 新闻、评论、法律判决、邮件及一般 prose

patterns.name: 人称代词与主语
patterns.context: 代词位于陈述或引语中，常与后续动词或从句相连
patterns.domain: 评论、对话、法律叙述、新闻报道

patterns.name: 表达判断或状态的谓语
patterns.context: 围绕态度、评价、判断或状态描述的陈述句
patterns.domain: 评论、法律文本、新闻及公共卫生叙述

patterns.name: 缩写与括号内技术标记
patterns.context: 技术术语缩写在括号中展开或标注，字母可能被分成多个 token
patterns.domain: 无障碍技术说明、光谱学论文

patterns.name: 结构化字段与标识符
patterns.context: 字段名、标头或代码标识符后接值、类型或邮件内容

en.description: Most samples come from legal texts and involve findings of fact, procedural analysis, and case citations; the rest include Danish discussion of infectious disease, online colloquial speech, and an abstract truncation marker. Trigger words vary, with no unified lexical or semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Actions and judgments in legal narratives
patterns.context: Legal case narratives describe the actions of parties, officers’ judgments, or matters communicated by the court to parties; activations fall on pronouns, verbs, and surrounding common words.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw, factual and procedural narratives in decisions

patterns.name: Review and waiver in legal opinions
patterns.context: An appellate court explains that a party failed to meet the burden of proof or respond to an argument and therefore waived appellate review.

patterns.name: Legal citations and case identifiers
patterns.context: Case numbers, contract identifiers, or legal-database citations in decisions; high activations fall on identifier and citation-marker fragments.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw, legal citations and administrative procurement records

patterns.name: Danish phrasing of infectious-disease risk
patterns.context: A sentence mentions international trade and increased human mobility as risks for cross-border outbreaks of infectious disease; activations concentrate on a word fragment in the Danish word for “contagious.”

patterns.name: Subjective humor and colloquial evaluation
patterns.context: Informal expressions discuss comedy preferences or use an exclamation to express surprise; the trigger words in the two fragments differ.

patterns.name: Paper abstract truncation marker
patterns.context: A fixed truncation notice at the end of a biomedical abstract; activations concentrate on fragments indicating truncation and word count.

9_1924.concept: 法律文本偏好，具体触发不明
9_1924.description: 多数样本来自法律文本，涉及事实认定、程序分析及案号引文；其余是丹麦语传染病论述、网络口语和摘要截断标记。触发词各异，未见统一词汇或语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 法律叙事中的行为与判断
patterns.context: 法律案件叙述中描述当事人行为、警员判断，或法院告知当事人事项；激活落在代词、动词及周边常用词上。

patterns.name: 法律意见中的审查与弃权
patterns.context: 上诉法院说明当事人未满足举证要求、未回应理由，因而放弃上诉审查。

patterns.name: 法律引文与案件标识
patterns.context: 判决中的案号、合同编号或法律数据库引文；高激活落在编号及引文标记的片段上。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw，法律引文与行政采购记录

patterns.name: 丹麦语传染病风险表述
patterns.context: 句子提及国际贸易、人员流动增加传染病跨国暴发风险；激活集中于丹麦语“传染性”一词的词片段。

patterns.name: 主观幽默与口语评价
patterns.context: 非正式表达中谈论喜剧偏好，或以感叹语表达惊讶；两个片段的触发词并不相同。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC，评论性散文与口语叙事

patterns.name: 论文摘要截断标记
patterns.context: 生物医学摘要末尾的固定截断提示，激活集中在“截断”和字数标记片段。

en.description: Activation cues are scattered: Danish sm- word beginnings, narrative pronouns, legal rulings and citation abbreviations, and technical abbreviations. Apart from the shared sm- in the first two passages, most are isolated words or abbreviations.

patterns.name: Danish sm- word beginnings
patterns.context: A Danish word begins with “sm”; one example is a word related to infectious disease, and another refers to small businesses.

patterns.name: Decisions and intentions in narrative
patterns.context: A character reports that a group has decided they want to return; activation falls on words such as “decided” and “they.”

patterns.name: Person reference and quotations in reporting
patterns.context: The pronoun “she” stands out in a report recounting allegations of employment discrimination and related quotations.

patterns.name: Work-capacity finding in a disability case
patterns.context: An administrative law judge assesses whether a claimant can perform sedentary work.

patterns.name: Judgment in a law-enforcement investigation
patterns.context: An officer stops a car and investigates whether the driver is intoxicated.

patterns.name: Statements of court functions
patterns.context: A legal opinion describes the functions of a reviewing body and limits on its authority.

patterns.name: WL in case citations
patterns.context: A Westlaw reporter number appears in a case citation.

patterns.name: Text-to-speech abbreviation
patterns.context: The abbreviation for text-to-speech appears in a description of reading text aloud.

patterns.name: Court-rule abbreviation
patterns.context: Cites the U.S. Court of Federal Claims rules and related provisions.

9_1924.description: 激活线索分散：丹麦语 sm- 词首，以及叙事代词、法律裁定用语和引注缩写、技术缩写等；除前两段共享 sm- 外，其余多为孤立词或缩写。

patterns.name: 丹麦语 sm- 词首
patterns.context: 丹麦语词中以“sm”开头；一处是传染病相关词，另一处是指小型企业的词。

patterns.name: 叙事中的决定与意愿
patterns.context: 人物报告一群人已经决定想要回去，激活落在“decided”和“they”等词上。

patterns.name: 报道中的人物指代与引语
patterns.context: 报道转述就业歧视指控及相关引语时，代词“she”突出。

patterns.name: 残障案件中的工作能力认定
patterns.context: 行政法官评估当事人是否能从事久坐工作。
patterns.domain: 美国社会保障法律判决

patterns.name: 执法调查中的判断
patterns.context: 警员停车后调查司机是否醉酒。

patterns.name: 法院职能陈述
patterns.context: 法律意见描述审查机构职能及其权限限制。

patterns.name: 判例引注中的 WL
patterns.context: 判例引注中出现 Westlaw 报告编号。

patterns.name: 文字转语音缩写
patterns.context: 介绍朗读文本时出现 text-to-speech 的缩写。

patterns.name: 法院规则缩写
patterns.context: 引用美国联邦索赔法院规则及相关条款。

en.concept: Local patterns in legal texts, including formatting and function words
en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly on common function words, citation formats, and procedural or adjudicative terms in legal texts. Case names and name fragments also appear, along with a few sporadic triggers in colloquial speech and fictional narratives; the pattern cannot be reduced to a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: Function-word prediction in judicial documents
patterns.context: In legal narratives or ruling statements, activations fall on common conjunctions, prepositions, and clause introducers; the triggered words vary across passages.

patterns.name: Legal citations and statutory formatting
patterns.context: Citation formats involving statutes, case numbers, case citations, or judicial records; activations are scattered across formatting fragments.

patterns.name: Local fragments in case or personal names
patterns.context: Near court headings, judge signatures, or case names; activations fall within names or on neighboring tokens, with no consistent semantic category.

patterns.name: Syntactic words in ordinary English narratives
patterns.context: Activations also occur outside legal contexts, respectively after colloquial exclamations and in narrative sentences where characters recount decisions.

patterns.name: Other legal terms and procedural expressions
patterns.context: Content involving judicial rulings, criminal charges, trial procedures, or social-security determinations; these terms do not share a single specific topic.

9_1924.concept: 法律文本局部模式，兼含格式与功能词
9_1924.description: 激活主要集中于法律文本中的常见功能词、引证格式及程序或裁判词语；也有案名、人名片段，并在口语和小说叙事中出现少量零散触发，不能归结为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 司法文书中的功能词预测
patterns.trigger: « to»、« determine»、« whether»、« for»、« of»、« that»等
patterns.context: 法律叙述或判决语句中，激活落在常见连接词、介词和从句引导词上；各段触发词不完全相同

patterns.name: 法律引证与法条格式
patterns.context: 法规、案号、判例引证或司法记录的缩写与数字格式；激活散落在格式片段中

patterns.name: 案名或人名中的局部片段
patterns.context: 法院抬头、法官署名或判例名称附近；激活的是名字内部或邻近 token，缺少一致语义类别

patterns.name: 普通英语叙事中的句法词
patterns.context: 非法律语境中也出现激活，分别位于口语惊叹后、叙事中人物转述决定的句子里

patterns.name: 其他法律术语与程序表达
patterns.context: 司法判决的裁判、刑事指控、审判程序或社保裁定内容；这些词语彼此并非同一具体主题

en.description: Activation is concentrated mainly in case numbers, court locations, and legal argument language; it also appears in clause structures involving decisions, judgments, and pronouns, as well as a passage of sports commentary.

patterns.name: Pronouns in clauses about decisions, intentions, and judgments
patterns.context: Verbs expressing decisions, intentions, or judgments are followed by clauses introduced by that/whether/interrogative words and by pronouns; this pattern appears in fiction, legal narrative, and jokes.

patterns.name: Case-number punctuation and numbering in legal documents
patterns.context: Numbers and abbreviations are separated by punctuation such as periods and hyphens in the heading, case number, or citation information of court-of-appeals documents.
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions and docket headings

patterns.name: Matters and reasons in legal arguments
patterns.context: Legal arguments state whether a contract, reason, cause of action, or matter is significant, using causal or judgment language.

patterns.name: Words related to sports commentary
patterns.context: Discusses sports commentary, ESPN, and Favre’s knowledge of offensive tactics; activation falls on related commentary wording.

patterns.name: Tokens in court-jurisdiction names
patterns.context: A court heading gives the place of trial in the format “county, state”; the relevant words are split into marked subword fragments.

9_1924.description: 激活主要集中于法律文本中的案号、法院地点及法律论证措辞；也见于从句中的决定、判断及代词结构，以及一段体育评论。

patterns.name: 决定、意愿及从句中的代词
patterns.context: 出现表达决定、意愿或判断的动词，后接 that/whether/疑问词引出的从句及代词；该模式在小说叙述、法律叙述和笑话中均有体现。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的案号标点与编号
patterns.context: 法院上诉文书的标题、案号或引用信息中，数字与缩写以句点、连字符等标点分隔。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决及案卷标题

patterns.name: 法律论证中的事项与理由
patterns.context: 法律论证中陈述合同、理由、诉因或某事项是否重要，并使用因果或判断表达。

patterns.name: 表达与体育评论相关的词
patterns.context: 谈论体育评论、ESPN及 Favre 对进攻战术的了解；激活落在相关评论措辞中。

patterns.name: 法院管辖地名称中的分词
patterns.context: 法院标题中以“某县，某州”格式标出审理地点；相关词被拆成带标记的子词。

en.concept: they in discourse and features of legal texts
en.description: Activations most consistently fall on the pronoun they in clauses or continuous discourse. There are also notable responses in legal texts to appellate case headings, case-number formats, and a few legal-analysis terms (determine and good in good faith).

patterns.name: they in subordinate clauses
patterns.context: they serves as the subject, often in clauses introduced by that, who, and similar words, or refers to plural people in continuous discussion; activations concentrate on the pronoun itself, though neighboring words are sometimes marked as well.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including fictional narratives, argumentation, email, news, and online discussions

patterns.name: Appellate court headings and case numbers
patterns.context: Appears on title pages or case headings in state appellate cases, often alongside party names, judicial districts, county names, and trial court cause number.

patterns.name: determine in evidence review
patterns.context: In a legal opinion discussing whether evidence is sufficient to support a conviction, appears before “whether any rational trier of fact could have”.
patterns.domain: Legal analysis in criminal appeal opinions

patterns.name: good in labor-negotiation language
patterns.context: In discussion of union majority status and bargaining conduct, the phrase is “good faith doubt”; activation falls on good.

9_1924.concept: 语篇中的 they 及法律文本特征
9_1924.description: 激活最稳定地落在从句或连续语篇中的代词 they；另在法律文本中，对上诉案标题、案号格式，以及少数法律分析用词（determine、good faith 中的 good）有明显响应。

patterns.name: 从句中的 they
patterns.trigger: «they»9；常与前面的 «decided»10、«want»2、«who»4 相邻，或与后续 «are»5、«'re»5、«want» 相连
patterns.context: they 作主语，常位于 that、who 等引导的从句中，或在连续论述中指代复数人物；激活集中于代词本身，邻近词有时也被标记
patterns.domain: 小说叙述、议论、邮件、新闻及网络讨论等多种文体

patterns.name: 上诉法院标题与案号
patterns.context: 出现在州上诉案件的标题页或案情抬头，常与当事人姓名、司法区、县名及 trial court cause number 并列

patterns.name: 证据审查中的 determine
patterns.context: 法律意见书讨论证据是否足以支持定罪时，出现在“whether any rational trier of fact could have”之前
patterns.domain: 刑事上诉判决中的法律分析

patterns.name: 劳资谈判用语中的 good
patterns.context: 讨论工会多数地位及谈判行为时，短语为“good faith doubt”；激活落在 good

en.description: Activations span legal citations, case numbers, and disability opinions, as well as texts on comment norms, rules and self-acceptance, trust in judgments, exclamatory abbreviations, and characters' decisions. They reflect multiple local lexical or formatting triggers, with no single stable semantic meaning.

patterns.name: Volume, page, and reporter abbreviations in legal citations
patterns.context: Case-citation format consisting of a numerical volume number, court reporter abbreviation, page number, and year.

patterns.name: Legal case headings and case-number formats
patterns.context: Names, party roles, court levels, case numbers, and other elements in legal-document headings or case-information fields; activations fall within names and on case-number characters.

patterns.name: Work-capacity statements in social-security disability opinions
patterns.context: Ruling discussions of disability status, administrative law judge findings, and types of work a person can perform.

patterns.name: Negative-behavior words in comment-section guidelines
patterns.context: A comment-policy statement allows inappropriate comments to be deleted; activations concentrate on words describing comment attitudes or rule-breaking behavior.

patterns.name: Discussion of following rules and accepting oneself
patterns.context: Reflects on when people stop resisting and accept their identity or circumstances.

patterns.name: Trust in others' judgments or decisions
patterns.context: Expresses trust in a coach's professional judgment when commenting on a decision.

patterns.name: Colloquial abbreviation for surprise
patterns.context: A strong reaction of surprise while recounting an absurd or unexpected experience.

patterns.name: Characters making decisions and expressing intent
patterns.context: Characters in a narrative make a decision as a group and explain what action they want to take.

9_1924.description: 激活跨法律引文、案号与残疾判决，以及评论规范、规则与自我接纳、信任判断、惊叹缩写和人物决定等文本；呈现多个局部词汇或格式触发，缺少单一稳定语义。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的卷页与报告简称
patterns.context: 数字卷号、法院报告简称、页码及年份构成的判例引文格式

patterns.name: 法律案件标题与案号格式
patterns.trigger: «W»ESLEY «M»ORRISON、«LC» No. 18-1003993-«FH»；“DENNIS S. FAULKNER, Appellee”“Trial Court Cause No. DC-10-08489”
patterns.context: 姓名、当事人身份、法院层级、案件编号等法律文书标题或案情栏；激活落在姓名内部及案号字符上

patterns.name: 社会保障残疾判决中的工作能力表述
patterns.trigger: “you were disabled”“ALJ’s determination”“could perform sedentary work”，尤以“sedentary”突出
patterns.context: 讨论残疾状态、行政法官认定及可从事工作类型的判决论述
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 社会保障/残疾案件

patterns.name: 评论区文明规范中的负面行为词
patterns.trigger: “civil, informative and constructive”“defamatory, rude, insulting to others, hateful, off-topic”
patterns.context: 评论政策说明允许删除不当评论；激活集中在描述评论态度或违规行为的词上

patterns.name: 遵守规则与接纳自我的讨论
patterns.trigger: “Disobeying or not following the rules”“accept who they are”
patterns.context: 反思人们何时停止抗争、接受自身身份或处境

patterns.name: 对他人判断或决定的信任
patterns.trigger: “trust the new OL coach to decide”“he certainly knows what he’s doing”
patterns.context: 评论教练决定时表达信任其专业判断

patterns.name: 惊讶反应的口语缩写
patterns.context: 讲述荒诞或意外经历时的强烈惊讶反应

patterns.name: 人物作出决定并表达意愿
patterns.trigger: “the men have decided that they want to go back”
patterns.context: 叙事中人物群体作出决定并说明想要采取的行动

en.concept: Judgment and case-record formatting in legal texts
en.description: Activation occurs in legal-document case numbers and front-page fields, matter/judgment language in legal arguments, and administrative review decisions; it also appears in a fictional character’s decision, know in religious discussion, and punctuation in rule citations.

patterns.name: Numbering and case-number format in legal-document headings
patterns.context: Court opinions or case-record front pages contain dense fields such as court, date, and case number; activation falls on punctuation, numbers, and case-number abbreviation fragments.

patterns.name: Matter(ed) and judgment language in opinions
patterns.context: Legal arguments concern whether a claim is valid, a factual determination, or whether something is significant; appears sensitive to matter and language related to judgment or significance.

patterns.name: Determinations in judicial review
patterns.context: Reviews an administrative law judge’s decision on whether a claimant’s impairment meets listed criteria; activation concentrates on determines.

patterns.name: Collective decision by characters in a narrative
patterns.context: In a novel plot, characters tell someone that a group has decided to return.

patterns.name: Trial-court field in appellate-court docket information
patterns.context: The first page of an opinion lists the court of origin, county, and trial-court case number; activation occurs after the case-number prefix DC.

patterns.name: Conversational challenge to a religious group
patterns.context: Directly asks or accuses the person being addressed about whether they know the Muslim community and related events.

patterns.name: Punctuation and letters in appellate-rule citations
patterns.context: A procedural filing statement on the first page of an opinion cites a circuit court local appellate rule number; strong activation falls on the period.

9_1924.concept: 法律文本中的判断与案卷格式
9_1924.description: 激活分布在法律文书案号与首页字段、法律论证中的 matter/判断措辞、行政审查决定等处；另见小说人物决定、宗教议论中的 know，以及规则引注标点。

patterns.name: 法律文书标题中的编号与案号格式
patterns.context: 法律判决或案卷首页，法院、日期、案号等字段密集出现；激活落在标点、数字及案号缩写片段上
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 法律文书标题/案号

patterns.name: 判决书中的 matter(ed) 及判断措辞
patterns.trigger: «matter»9[«ed»6«]»5；« but»9« to»2« determine»7 whether；« matters»9« little»2
patterns.context: 法律论证语境，围绕主张是否成立、事实判断或某事是否重要；似乎对 matter 及判断/重要性相关措辞敏感

patterns.name: 司法审查中的 determinations
patterns.trigger: the ALJ«2« determines»9 whether；«the»2« claimant»5«’»1«s»3« impairment»2
patterns.context: 审查行政法官对申请人损害是否符合列举标准的决定，激活集中在 determines

patterns.name: 叙事中的人物集体决定
patterns.trigger: the« men»3« have»4« decided»9« that»5« they»9« want»2
patterns.context: 小说情节中，人物告知他人一群人已经决定返程

patterns.name: 上诉法院案头信息中的审判法院字段
patterns.trigger: On Appeal from the 162nd Judicial District Court；Trial« Court»1« Cause»2« No»2«.»5« DC»9-
patterns.context: 判决书首页列出上诉来源法院、县、审判案号；激活位于案号前缀 DC 后

patterns.name: 对宗教群体的对话式质问
patterns.trigger: «you»5« know»9« what»3 every single Muslim living on this Earth
patterns.context: 直接向对话对象发问或指责，谈论其是否了解穆斯林群体及相关事件

patterns.name: 上诉法院规则引注中的标点和字母
patterns.context: 判决首页的程序性提交说明，引用巡回法院地方上诉规则编号；显著激活落在句点

en.concept: Legal documents and local word-form triggers
en.description: The most prominent activations occur in U.S. legal documents, especially court headings, case numbers, and military-court opinions. Other activations occur in appellate legal language, discussion of women in interviews, Danish word forms related to disease transmission, and a narrative about characters deciding to return.

patterns.name: Legal case numbers and court headings
patterns.context: Headings in opinions or appellate documents containing case numbers, judges, courts, and procedural information; triggers cluster near formatted court names and numbers.

patterns.name: Military justice case information
patterns.context: Headings of military-court cases or records of rulings and sentences; often includes rank, service branch, UCMJ, prison term, and military rank.

patterns.name: Procedural and substantive-issue language in legal documents
patterns.context: Legal analysis describing appellate issues, evidentiary sufficiency, termination of parental rights, and counsel's motion to withdraw.

patterns.name: Language urging women to accommodate men in interviews
patterns.context: Critiques the view that an interviewer being male is an unchangeable fact and that women should downplay their femininity.

patterns.name: Danish word forms related to infectious-disease transmission
patterns.context: A Danish sentence discusses international trade, population movement, and the risk of international disease outbreaks; activation falls on a subword fragment within “smitsomme”.

patterns.name: Decisions and dialogue in a narrative
patterns.context: Characters make a decision in narrative dialogue and express their intention to return; activations concentrate on “decided” and nearby words.
patterns.domain: English historical fiction or screen narrative

9_1924.concept: 法律文书及局部词形触发
9_1924.description: 最突出的是美国法律文书，尤其法院抬头、案号及军法判决；另有上诉法律措辞、女性面试议题、丹麦语疾病传播词形，以及叙事中人物决定返程。

patterns.name: 法律案号与法院抬头
patterns.trigger: “(D.C. No.”、“No.”、“District Judge: Honorable”、“Submitted Under Third Circuit”及“Jackson Circuit Court”
patterns.context: 判决或上诉文书的案号、法官、法院和程序信息抬头；触发集中于格式化的法院名称与编号附近。

patterns.name: 军事司法判决信息
patterns.trigger: “UNITED STATES OF AMERICA v.”、“U.S. MARINE CORPS”、“Military Judge”、“sentence”、“dishonorable discharge”、“confinement”和“reduction to”
patterns.context: 军法案件的标题或对判决、刑罚的记载；常出现军衔、军种、UCMJ、服刑年限与军阶。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的程序与实体争点措辞
patterns.trigger: “challenges the sufficiency of the evidence”、“termination of her parental rights”、“no-merit appeal”
patterns.context: 描述上诉争点、证据充分性、亲权终止及律师请求退出的法律论述。

patterns.name: 访谈中要求女性迎合男性的措辞
patterns.trigger: “interviewers are men”、“immutable fact”、“Telling women they need to be less womanly”
patterns.context: 批评把面试官为男性视作不可改变事实、并要求女性淡化女性气质的观点。

patterns.name: 丹麦语中关于传染病传播的词形
patterns.context: 丹麦语句子谈国际贸易、人员流动与国际疾病暴发风险；激活落在“smitsomme”内部的子词片段。
patterns.domain: 欧盟公共卫生文本（丹麦语）

patterns.name: 叙事中的决定与引语
patterns.context: 人物在叙事对话中作出决定并表达返回意愿；激活集中于“decided”及其邻近词。
patterns.domain: 英语历史小说或影视叙事

en.concept: Words related to judgments and statements
en.description: Activations are scattered across words for judgments, conclusions, and legal language in opinions, as well as know/knows, expressions of intent, good-faith disputes, proper-name fragments, and ordinary function words; this is not a single lexical pattern.

patterns.name: “know/knows” after modal verbs
patterns.context: The subject refers to a person or institution and is followed by it or a knowledge complement; know/knows is marked, often alongside emphasis on a judgment.

patterns.name: Expressions of decision and intent
patterns.context: A person or group makes a decision or expresses intent, followed by an action (such as go back).

patterns.name: “determines” in judicial findings
patterns.context: A court or administrative judge decides a legal issue, fact, or whether a standard is met; commonly appears in the reasoning section of an opinion.

patterns.name: Existential “there is” in judicial conclusions
patterns.context: An adjudicator states whether an error, dispute, or other legal fact exists.

patterns.name: Cognitive/conclusion predicates in judicial reasoning
patterns.context: A court or reviewer reaches a conclusion after reviewing the record; appears adjacent to or in the same passage as judicial statements using there is.

patterns.name: Proper-name fragments in case headings and court names
patterns.context: In proper names in legal-document headings, judge signatures, or court/military-court case numbers, activations fall on segmented name fragments.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and military-court documents

patterns.name: Litigation claims and legal-rights terminology
patterns.context: Discusses constitutional rights being denied or a party making a claim; specific activated words are scattered across fixed legal phrases.

patterns.name: Good-faith disputes in labor negotiations
patterns.context: The parties dispute immediate return to work, resumption of negotiations, or a collective-bargaining agreement, and discuss one party's good faith.

patterns.name: High-frequency function words in legal documents
patterns.context: Ordinary prepositions, articles, or conjunctions in opinions, without local conditions sufficient to group them into a shared semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Residual activations not grouped above
patterns.context: Ordinary words or phrases occurring locally, with no stable, independent, and interpretable triggering condition.
patterns.domain: Legal texts, literary texts, and online discussions

9_1924.description: 激活分散在判决中的判断、结论及法律用语，也见 know/knows、决定意愿、诚信争议、专名碎片与普通功能词；并非单一词义模式。

patterns.name: 情态动词后的「know/knows」
patterns.context: 主语表示个人或机构，后接 it 或知识宾语；know/knows 本身被标记，常伴随强调判断

patterns.name: 决定与意愿表达
patterns.context: 人物或群体决定、表示意愿，后续接行动（如 go back）

patterns.name: 司法判断中的「determines」
patterns.context: 法院或行政法官判断法律争点、事实或是否符合标准；常处于判决理由段落

patterns.name: 裁判结论中的存在式「there is」
patterns.context: 裁判者陈述是否存在错误、争议或其他法律事实

patterns.name: 裁判理由中的认知／结论谓词
patterns.context: 法院或审查者在回顾记录后给出结论；与 there is 的裁判表述相邻或同段

patterns.name: 案件标题与法院名称中的专名碎片
patterns.context: 法律文书标题、法官署名或法院/军法庭案号等专名中，激活落在被切分的名称片段
patterns.domain: 美国判例及军事法庭文书

patterns.name: 诉讼主张与法律权利术语
patterns.context: 讨论宪法权利被拒或当事人提出主张；具体激活词散布在固定法律短语中

patterns.name: 劳动谈判中的诚信争议
patterns.context: 争议双方涉及立即复工、恢复谈判或集体谈判合同，并讨论一方的诚信

patterns.name: 法律文书中的高频功能词
patterns.context: 判决文本中的普通介词、冠词或连词，缺乏足以归为同一语义模式的局部条件

patterns.name: 未能归入上述模式的残余激活
patterns.context: 局部出现的普通词或短语，未显示稳定、独立且可解释的触发条件
patterns.domain: 法律文本、文学文本及网络讨论

en.description: Activations fall on specific words in varied grammatical positions: has in judicial sentences, they as the subject of several clauses, did in questions, direct address you, know, to in military-court phrases, and a fragment in a Danish term for “small and medium-sized enterprises.” Legal-opinion templates are the most stable pattern; other cases are scattered across genres and difficult to group under a single semantic function.

patterns.name: has in judicial opinions
patterns.context: The subject is a party's name, and the sentence describes a court finding that the party failed to meet a legal requirement; activation concentrates on has rather than surrounding legal terms.

patterns.name: they in embedded clauses
patterns.context: The pronoun they serves as the subject of a clause expressing a group's intent (“want to go back”) or attributed knowledge (“know best”, “know what…”).

patterns.name: did in a question
patterns.context: In the conversational question “how did the studies and exams go”, did is the simple-past auxiliary.

patterns.name: you in a women's advocacy context
patterns.context: Comments on interviews and gender norms, directly advising women readers; weaker activations also occur in “believe you are like them”.

patterns.name: Danish term for small businesses
patterns.context: In Danish, a term split into subwords, “små og mellemstore virksomheder” (small and medium-sized enterprises), occurs in political-economic discussion.

patterns.name: to in a military sentencing phrase
patterns.context: A military-court opinion lists sentences and states a reduction to a particular military rank.

patterns.name: know in predicate position
patterns.context: Expresses that a subject possesses or is attributed certain knowledge; texts respectively concern economic managers, an audience's judgment of facts, leaders claiming to know best, and criticism related to Muslims.
patterns.domain: Political commentary, poetic social criticism, and online argument

9_1924.description: 激活落在多种语法位置的具体词：判决句中的 has，若干从句主语 they、问句助动词 did、直接称呼 you、know、军法短语中的 to，以及丹麦语“中小企业”词组片段。法律判决模板最稳定；其余分散于不同文体，难以归并为单一语义功能。

patterns.name: 司法判决中的 has
patterns.context: 主语为案件当事人姓名，描述法院认定其未满足某项法律要求；激活集中在 has，而非周围法律术语

patterns.name: 嵌入句中的 they
patterns.trigger: «they»9 或 «they»6，周围常见“that they…”，分别接决定或认知类谓语
patterns.context: 代词 they 作从句主语，表达群体意愿（“want to go back”）或被归因的知识（“know best”“know what…”）

patterns.name: 问句里的 did
patterns.context: 口语问句“how did the studies and exams go”，did 为一般过去时助动词

patterns.name: 女性倡议语境中的 you
patterns.context: 评论面试与性别规范，直接向女性读者提出建议；较弱处也出现在“believe you are like them”

patterns.name: 丹麦语小型企业词汇
patterns.context: 丹麦语中被分词标记拆开的“små og mellemstore virksomheder”（中小企业），处于政治经济论述中

patterns.name: 军法量刑短语中的 to
patterns.trigger: «to»9，位于“a reduction to the grade of E-1”
patterns.context: 军事法庭判决列举刑罚，并说明降至某军阶

patterns.name: know 的谓语位置
patterns.context: 表示主体掌握或被归因于掌握某种知识；文本分别涉及经济管理者、受众对事实的判断、领导者自称最了解以及对穆斯林议题的指责
patterns.domain: 政治评论、诗性社会批评及网络论辩

en.description: Activation appears in statements, decisions, or wishes following personal pronouns; questions about experiences; internal fragments of several words in Danish policy texts; and review conclusions in legal opinions. The passages share no stable single word form or semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Third-person plural subjects and decision verbs
patterns.context: “they” is the subject, followed by modal or auxiliary verbs such as have/need and then predicates expressing decisions, intentions, or actions; also appears in “players they need to participate”.

patterns.name: Judgments or statements following personal pronouns
patterns.context: A personal pronoun is followed by a verb or auxiliary and a statement about a judgment, experience, or completion; forms vary.

patterns.name: Recipients of wishes and positive evaluations
patterns.context: Wishes someone well in the future; the pronoun “them” is adjacent to the evaluative phrase “good luck”.

patterns.name: Asking about experiences in questions
patterns.context: A question beginning with how asks about another person’s experience or progress.

patterns.name: Internal fragment in Danish word smitsomme
patterns.context: In a Danish EU text, activation concentrates on an internal character fragment in a context about infectious disease and coordinated action.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in Danish business terms
patterns.context: Danish words are split into marked subwords; activation falls on partial forms related to store and virksomheds, in a context mentioning small and medium-sized enterprises.

patterns.name: Conclusions or judgments in legal documents
patterns.context: An opinion states the court’s conclusion after reviewing the record; other examples involve legal-review language such as “substantive reasonableness” and “circumstances,” but no common trigger word is apparent.

9_1924.description: 激活分布于人称代词后的陈述、决定或祝愿，疑问句中的经历询问，丹麦语政策文本的若干词内片段，以及法律意见中的审查结论。各段没有稳定共享的单一词形或语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 第三人称复数主语与决策动词
patterns.trigger: “they have decided that they want to go back”
patterns.context: “they”作主语，后接 have/need 等情态或助动词，再接决定、意愿、行动等谓语；也见“players they need to participate”。

patterns.name: 人称代词后的判断或陈述
patterns.context: 人称代词后接动词或助动词，并引出判断、经历或完成的陈述；形式并不完全一致。

patterns.name: 祝愿对象及正向评价
patterns.trigger: “wish all of them good luck with their future”
patterns.context: 祝愿某人未来顺利，代词“them”与评价短语“good luck”相邻。

patterns.name: 疑问句中询问经历
patterns.trigger: “how did the studies and exams go”
patterns.context: 以 how 引导疑问，询问对方某项经历或进展。

patterns.name: 丹麦语词内片段 smitsomme
patterns.context: 丹麦语欧盟文本中，激活集中在词内字符片段；上下文谈传染病及协调行动。

patterns.name: 丹麦语企业词内片段
patterns.context: 丹麦语词被拆分标注，激活落在 store 与 virksomheds 相关词形的部分片段；语境提到中小企业。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的结论或判断
patterns.trigger: “conclude that Anderson has not made the requisite showing”
patterns.context: 判决书在审查记录后陈述法院结论；另见“substantive reasonableness”“circumstances”等法律审查语句，但未见同一触发词。

en.description: Activations occur across varied corpora. More stable local cues include question words, negative conclusions and formatting in judicial documents, and the Danish stem “små”; the rest mostly resemble sporadic word-boundary or subword triggers that cannot be reduced to a single semantic meaning.

patterns.name: Highlighted triggers at sentence or word boundaries
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on particular tokens at local word boundaries or within phrases, often not explained by the sentence topic; some examples include spaces, subwords, or punctuation boundaries.

patterns.name: Interrogative and question-answer contexts
patterns.context: Occurs in direct questions, conversational question-and-answer exchanges, or questions about identity; the locally highlighted tokens vary.

patterns.name: Negative conclusions in judicial rulings
patterns.context: In appellate rulings or record review, negative language states that there is no error or basis for relief; only some highlighted activations fall on the negative construction.

patterns.name: Danish stem “små”
patterns.context: A stem segmented into subwords in Danish text; both passages come from the European Parliament corpus.

patterns.name: Opinion layout and legal terminology
patterns.context: Near citations, court-document formatting, or judicial conclusions; highlighting may be affected by abbreviations and punctuation layout.

patterns.name: Education and judgments about facts
patterns.context: Discusses education, learning, facts, and officials or leaders claiming to be informed; the highlighted activations themselves are sporadic.

patterns.name: Social greetings and coffee conversation
patterns.context: IRC small talk about coffee, the time, and how studies and exams went.

patterns.name: Rules, identity, and acceptance
patterns.context: A question in prose discusses defying rules, giving up resistance, and accepting people as they are.

9_1924.description: 激活分布于多种语料，较稳定的局部线索包括问句词、司法文书中的否定结论与格式，以及丹麦语“små”词干；其余多像零散的词界或子词触发，无法归结为单一语义。

patterns.name: 句末或词界的高亮触发
patterns.context: 激活集中在局部词边界或短语中的特定 token，往往无法由句子主题解释；有些例子同时包含空格、子词或标点边界。

patterns.name: 疑问及问答语境
patterns.context: 出现在直接提问、对话问答或关于身份的疑问句中；局部高亮 token 不完全一致。

patterns.name: 司法裁判中的否定结论
patterns.context: 上诉裁判或审查记录时，以否定措辞陈述不存在错误或理由；仅部分高亮落在否定结构上。

patterns.name: 丹麦语中的“små”词干
patterns.context: 丹麦语文本中，被分成子词的词干部分；两段都来自欧盟议会语料。

patterns.name: 判决书版式及法律术语
patterns.context: 判决书引注、法院文书格式或裁判结论附近；高亮可能受缩写和标点版式影响。

patterns.name: 教育与事实判断
patterns.context: 讨论教育、学习、事实及官员或领导者自称知情；高亮本身较零散。

patterns.name: 社交寒暄与咖啡对话
patterns.context: IRC 中围绕咖啡、时间及学习考试情况的闲聊。

patterns.name: 规则、身份与接受
patterns.context: 散文疑问句讨论违抗规则、放弃抗争以及接受人们本来的身份。

en.description: Activations occur mainly in record-review language, conclusion formulas, and case-law/statutory citations in U.S. appellate opinions. Other cases include an internal fragment in a Danish European Parliament policy term, “luck” in an institutional wish, and remand-for-hearing language at the end of a state opinion.

patterns.name: Record-review formula in federal appellate opinions
patterns.context: The court states that after reviewing the record, it reaches a conclusion about whether a party has met a legal requirement, often immediately followed by a case citation.

patterns.name: Independent-review language in legal documents
patterns.context: An appellate court describes its review duty; although similar to the repeated standard-review formula, this passage does not contain its full conclusion sentence.

patterns.name: Case and statutory citations
patterns.context: Case and statute references, volume and page numbers, and provision numbers in legal arguments.

patterns.name: Danish internal fragments and EU policy vocabulary
patterns.context: Long Danish words appear in the text with line breaks, segmentation, or subword splitting; activation falls on internal fragments.

patterns.name: luck in a well-wishing phrase
patterns.context: An informal phrase wishing institutional staff success in their future work.

patterns.name: Hearing and remand language at the end of an opinion
patterns.context: At the end of an opinion, the disposition is listed in uppercase, followed by “ AFFIRMED”.

9_1924.description: 主要激活于美国上诉判决的记录审查、结论公式及判例法条引注；另见丹麦语欧盟政策词内片段、机构祝愿语中的“luck”，以及州判决结尾的发回听证措辞。

patterns.name: 联邦上诉判决的记录审查公式
patterns.trigger: “independently reviewed the record”及“conclude”“has not made the requisite showing”
patterns.context: 法院说明审查记录后，对当事人是否达到法律要求作出结论，常紧接判例引文

patterns.name: 法律文书中的独立审查措辞
patterns.context: 上诉法院自述审查职责；虽与重复出现的标准审查公式相近，但此段未出现其完整结论句

patterns.name: 判例与法条引注
patterns.trigger: 例如“Ornelas v. United States”“Slack, 529 U.S. at 484-85”“§ 1227(a)(2)(A)(iii)”
patterns.context: 法律论证中的判例、法规引用及卷页、条款编号

patterns.name: 丹麦语中的词内碎片与欧盟政策词汇
patterns.context: 丹麦语正文出现带断行、分词或子词切分的长词；激活落在词内片段

patterns.name: 祝愿语中的 luck
patterns.context: 祝愿机构人员未来工作顺利的非正式语句

patterns.name: 判决结尾的听证与发回措辞
patterns.context: 判决末尾以大写格式列出裁判结果，后接“ AFFIRMED”

en.description: Activation locations are scattered: in legal texts, they include determine, People, and fragments of hearing language; in European Parliament texts, sm; in Pile-CC, words such as best, they, and decide. Some examples correspond only to local or character fragments and cannot be explained by a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: determine in legal rulings
patterns.context: Appears in constructions such as “determine whether” or “determining that”, discussing a court, judge, or lawyer reaching a finding on a legal question, evidence, the record, or counsel's judgment; the word itself is marked in each example.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal opinions, especially summary judgment, appellate review, and trial procedure

patterns.name: sm in European Parliament texts
patterns.context: Activation falls on the segmented English character fragment “sm”, embedded respectively in “små” and the Danish “smitsomme”; both occur in European Parliament texts.
patterns.domain: EuroParl, multilingual European Parliament texts; one passage concerns small businesses, the other infectious diseases

patterns.name: HE in a hearing order
patterns.context: Appears in the uppercase judicial disposition “REVERSE AND REMAND FOR EVIDENTIARY HEARING”, with activation covering the beginning of the segmented word “HEARING”.
patterns.domain: Uppercase disposition section of a U.S. appellate opinion

patterns.name: References to or discussions of findings, truth, and facts
patterns.context: Appears in discussions of who knows best, whether facts are ignored, or how truth is judged; activations respectively fall near “know best” and “facts and … truth”.
patterns.domain: Pile-CC, personal commentary or social criticism

patterns.name: Question about accepting others' identities
patterns.context: In “accept who they are?”, the pronoun “they” occurs in a reflective question about whether to accept others as they are.

patterns.name: People's in a possessive construction
patterns.context: Appears in the judicial formula “the People’s appeal is dismissed as moot”; activation falls on “People” rather than an obviously generic legal term.

patterns.name: Deciding to share a residence
patterns.context: In a film synopsis, describes two divorced men deciding to share an apartment in New York.
patterns.domain: Pile-CC, film description or entertainment copy

9_1924.description: 激活位置分散：法律文本中有 determine、People 和听证语句片段；欧洲议会文本中是 sm；Pile-CC 中落在 best、they、decide 等词。部分例子仅有局部或字符片段对应，无法由单一语义模式解释。

patterns.name: 法律裁判中的 determine
patterns.context: 出现在“determine whether”或“determining that”等结构中，讨论法院、法官或律师对法律问题、证据、记录或律师判断作出认定；各例中该词本身受标记。
patterns.domain: 美国法律判决，尤其简易判决、上诉审查与审理程序

patterns.name: 欧洲议会文本中的 sm
patterns.context: 激活落在分词后的英文字符片段“sm”，分别嵌在“små”以及丹麦语“smitsomme”中；均处于欧洲议会文本。
patterns.domain: EuroParl，多语种欧洲议会文本；一处谈小型企业，一处谈传染病

patterns.name: 听证令中的 HE
patterns.context: 出现在全大写司法处分语句“REVERSE AND REMAND FOR EVIDENTIARY HEARING”中，激活覆盖被拆分的“HEARING”开头。
patterns.domain: 美国上诉法院判决的全大写结论部分

patterns.name: 引述或讨论认定、真相与事实
patterns.context: 出现在对谁最了解、是否忽视事实或判断真相的讨论中；激活分别落在“know best”及“facts and … truth”附近。

patterns.name: 关于接受他人身份的疑问
patterns.context: 在“accept who they are?”中，代词“they”处于关于是否接受他人本来面貌的反思性问句中。

patterns.name: People 所有格
patterns.context: 出现在“the People’s appeal is dismissed as moot”这一司法句式中，激活落在“People”而非显然通用的法律术语上。

patterns.name: 决定共享住所
patterns.context: 出现在电影剧情简介中，描述两名离婚男子决定合住纽约公寓。

en.description: The main pattern involves judgment, findings, and whether constructions in legal cases; other local patterns include Swedish activity words in European Parliament texts, Danish small-business and infectious-disease stems, English knowledge claims, and chat questions.

patterns.name: Findings and judgments in legal decisions
patterns.context: Appears when a court reviews evidence, determines whether there is substantial evidence or an issue for trial, assesses whether counsel’s judgment was correct, or addresses error and case outcomes; in passage [6], the strong activation on «but» is near «determine».

patterns.name: Swedish activity stems
patterns.context: When Swedish text discusses information systems, visas, related activities, or delays, activation concentrates inside the segmented word for “activity,” especially «he».

patterns.name: Danish small-business stems
patterns.context: When Danish text discusses small and medium-sized enterprises, strong activation falls on the stem «sm» in the word for “small,” accompanied by business-related words.

patterns.name: Danish infectious-disease suffix
patterns.context: When mentioning infectious diseases requiring a coordinated response, «sm» is strongly activated; other stems are also segmented.

patterns.name: English assertions and knowledge claims
patterns.context: When criticizing officials or leaders for claiming to know best and using that claim to override facts or educational judgment, «they» and «know» are strongest.

patterns.name: Question words in coffee chat
patterns.context: An IRC conversation asks about someone’s studies and exam progress; activation appears at the start of the question, surrounded by coffee chat.

9_1924.description: 主要模式是法律判例中判断、认定及 whether 结构；另有欧洲议会文本中瑞典语活动词、丹麦语中小企业与传染病词干，以及英语知识主张和聊天问句等局部模式。

patterns.name: 法律裁判中的认定与判断
patterns.context: 出现在法院审查证据、判断是否有实质证据或审理问题、认定律师判断是否正确、认定错误及判决结果的语境；段[6]中强激活词«but»邻近«determine»。

patterns.name: 瑞典语活动词干
patterns.context: 瑞典语中谈及信息系统、签证或相关活动及延误时，激活集中落在被拆分标注的“活动”词内部，尤其«he»。

patterns.name: 丹麦语小型企业词干
patterns.context: 丹麦语谈到小型和中型企业时，强激活落在“小”词的词干«sm»，并伴随企业相关词。

patterns.name: 丹麦语传染病词尾
patterns.context: 提及需要协调应对的传染性疾病时，«sm»强激活；其余词干也被拆分标注。

patterns.name: 英语断言与知识主张
patterns.context: 批评官员或领导者声称自己最懂、并以此压过事实或教育判断时，«they»和«know»最强。

patterns.name: 咖啡闲聊中的问句词
patterns.context: 在IRC对话中询问对方学习和考试进展；激活出现在问句开头，周围是咖啡闲聊。

en.description: High activations often fall on they, verbs of deciding or determining, and legal citation formats. Other cases include internal fragments in Danish words, fragments of uppercase disposition headings, and various sporadic English words. The shared mechanism is unclear.

patterns.name: Third-person plural subject they
patterns.context: they serves as the subject in a clause or narrative, followed by predicates involving identity, intent, or decisions; activations are not limited to a fixed semantic domain.

patterns.name: Internal fragments of decision/determination predicates
patterns.context: Verbs related to deciding, determining, or judging; activations sometimes fall on internal word segments, and nearby context often includes court, whether, or a subject.
patterns.domain: Primarily legal opinions, also film synopses

patterns.name: Legal citations and citation formats
patterns.context: Scattered activations near statutes, case citations, and citation punctuation in legal arguments; no single fixed trigger word is apparent.

patterns.name: Sporadic activations on English function and general words
patterns.context: Scattered across different syntactic positions; these examples alone do not establish a shared condition narrower than general word frequency, syntax, or context.

patterns.name: Danish compounds and internal fragments
patterns.context: High activations occur within segmented Danish words; the fragments concern small and medium-sized enterprises, but it is unclear whether the trigger is language, meaning, or segmentation boundaries.

patterns.name: Internal fragment in a disposition heading
patterns.context: Located in the uppercase disposition “REMAND FOR EVIDENTIARY HEARING”; activation covers only part of a word.

patterns.name: unclear
patterns.context: Activation may relate to syntax, segmentation, or text formatting, but there is insufficient evidence to distinguish among them.

9_1924.description: 高激活多落在 they、决定/认定类动词及法律引证格式上；也见丹麦语词内片段、大写裁判标题片段和多种零散英语词。共同机制不明确。

patterns.name: 第三人称复数主语 they
patterns.context: they 在从句或叙述中作主语，后接身份、意愿或决定等谓语；激活并不局限于某个固定语义领域。
patterns.domain: 叙述、法律文本、论坛文字

patterns.name: 决定/认定类谓语的词内片段
patterns.context: 围绕决定、认定或判断的动词；有时激活落在词内分段上，且相邻语境常出现 court、whether 或主语。
patterns.domain: 以法律判决为主，也见小说简介

patterns.name: 法律引文与引证格式
patterns.context: 法律条文、判例引用及引证标点附近出现的零碎激活；未见单一固定触发词。

patterns.name: 英语功能词及一般词语的零散激活
patterns.context: 分散在不同句法位置，单凭这些例子无法确认比一般词频、句法或上下文更窄的共同条件。

patterns.name: 丹麦语复合词及词内片段
patterns.context: 高激活出现在丹麦语词语的分段内部；片段谈及小型及中型企业，但无法判断触发点是语言、词义还是分词边界。

patterns.name: 裁判标题中的词内片段
patterns.context: 位于大写裁判处置语“REMAND FOR EVIDENTIARY HEARING”中，激活只覆盖词的一部分。
patterns.domain: 美国上诉法院裁判标题

patterns.name: unclear
patterns.trigger: 未见可与其他高激活模式可靠归并的触发点
patterns.context: 激活可能与句法、分词或文本格式有关，但样本不足以辨明。

en.concept: Judgment and long-word fragments across heterogeneous contexts
en.description: Activation occurs mainly around determine and court-review or finding language in U.S. cases; it also appears in internal fragments of long Swedish and Danish business/activity words. An IRC question about studies, a sports-forum discussion about trusting a coach, and a sentencing argument are isolated examples with unclear shared patterns.

patterns.name: Emphasis on determine in cases and judicial judgment
patterns.context: A court or appellate court evaluates evidence, reviews the record, decides a legal question, or considers whether error occurred; activation often falls on determine and nearby judgment language.

patterns.name: Fragments of Swedish business-activity word forms
patterns.context: In Swedish EU documents discussing business/operator activities, information systems, or related obligations, activation falls on character fragments inside long words.
patterns.domain: EuroParl, Swedish policy or legislative text

patterns.name: Fragments of Danish business-activity word forms
patterns.context: In Danish text discussing business development or measures targeting small and medium-sized enterprises, activation falls on long business-related words and “små”.

patterns.name: Questions and casual interaction in speech
patterns.context: An IRC conversation directly asks about another person’s studies and exams, preceded by coffee chat.

patterns.name: Trust in a coach in a sports forum
patterns.context: Discusses whether a team’s new offensive-line coach can make decisions and expresses trust in his judgment.

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.context: An isolated legal sentencing argument discusses denying a reduction for “acceptance of responsibility”; this alone is insufficient to confirm that it shares a pattern with the other legal passages.

9_1924.concept: 异质语境中的判断与长词片段
9_1924.description: 主要激活于美国判例中的 determine 与法院审查、认定措辞；另见瑞典语和丹麦语企业活动相关长词的内部片段。IRC 学业询问、体育论坛信任教练及一段量刑论述各为孤例，彼此模式不明。

patterns.name: 案件与司法判断中 determine 的强调
patterns.trigger: “determine”及“determine whether”；也包括“reviewed the record”“independent evaluation”“found no patent error”等司法审查、认定表达
patterns.context: 法院或上诉法院评估证据、审查记录、判断法律问题或是否存在错误；激活往往落在 determine 及附近的判断性措辞

patterns.name: 瑞典语企业活动词形片段
patterns.context: 瑞典语欧盟文件谈及企业/经营者的活动、信息系统或相关义务时，激活落在长词内部的字符片段
patterns.domain: EuroParl，瑞典语政策或立法文本

patterns.name: 丹麦语企业活动词形片段
patterns.context: 丹麦语文本谈企业发展或针对小型、中型企业的行动时，激活落在企业相关长词及“små”

patterns.name: 口语中的问句与闲聊互动
patterns.trigger: “how did the studies and exams go”
patterns.context: IRC 对话中对他人学业、考试情况的直接询问，前文是咖啡闲聊

patterns.name: 体育论坛中对教练的信任判断
patterns.trigger: “he certainly knows what he’s doing”及“decide on that”
patterns.context: 讨论球队新进攻线教练是否有能力作决定，表达对其判断的信任

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.trigger: 未见能与其他段稳定对应的明确触发项；本段只有“for”被标记
patterns.context: 单独的法律量刑论述，谈拒绝给予“acceptance of responsibility”减刑；无法仅据此确认与其他法律段落的模式相同
patterns.domain: 美国判例、量刑上诉意见

en.description: The strongest responses cluster on the Character subword: it appears mainly at the start of title-style “Characterization of …” phrases and spans multiple biomedical entities; it also responds to the word forms Character-based and Characterizing.

patterns.name: Characterization in titles
patterns.context: At the beginning of a research paper title or abstract: “Characterization of …”; the word is split into two tokens, Character and ization, with the former activating most strongly.
patterns.domain: PubMed biomedical abstracts, NIH project titles

patterns.name: Character-based compounds
patterns.context: Character followed by a hyphen and based, describing games or interactive theater; not part of Characterization.

patterns.name: Characterizing research statements
patterns.context: Character followed by izing, describing a relationship between research subjects at the beginning of a sentence.

9_2040.description: 最强响应集中于 Character 子词：主要出现在标题式“Characterization of …”开头，涵盖多类生物医学对象；另响应 Character-based 及 Characterizing 两种词形。

patterns.name: 标题中的 Characterization
patterns.context: “Characterization of …”科研论文标题或摘要开头；该词被拆成 Character 与 ization 两个 token，前者激活最强。
patterns.domain: PubMed 生物医学摘要、NIH 项目标题

patterns.name: Character-based 复合词
patterns.context: Character 后接连字符和 based，描述游戏或互动戏剧；不属于 Characterization。

patterns.name: Characterizing 研究表述
patterns.context: Character 后接 izing，句首描述研究对象之间的关系。

en.description: All passages show the strongest activation at the word-initial fragment Character-: nine passages contain Characterization, with others containing Character-based and Characterizing. Topics and styles vary; the phrase often appears in titles or at sentence beginnings.

patterns.name: Word-initial fragment of Characterization
patterns.context: A title-like phrase beginning with Characterization; activation is concentrated on the initial fragment, with weaker activation on the following suffix. Passage 10 instead contains the word-initial fragment of Characterizing.
patterns.domain: Mostly paper titles or abstract openings; spans biomedicine, chemistry, and other fields

patterns.name: Character in a compound
patterns.context: Character is followed by a hyphen and based, forming a compound modifier describing games or interactive drama; Character is strongly activated, while the following component is weaker.
patterns.domain: Patent background; games and interactive drama

patterns.name: Characterizing at the beginning
patterns.context: A sentence begins with the gerund Characterizing, followed by a relationship between research subjects; its form differs slightly from title-like Characterization.

9_2040.description: 所有段落都在 Character- 词首处出现最强激活：九段为 Characterization，另有 Character-based 和 Characterizing。主题与文体多样，常见于标题或句首。

patterns.name: Characterization 的词首
patterns.context: 以 Characterization 起始的标题式短语；激活集中在词首片段，后续词缀激活较弱。段10则是 Characterizing 的词首。
patterns.domain: 主要为论文标题或摘要开头；涵盖生物医学、化学及其他领域

patterns.name: 复合词中的 Character
patterns.context: Character 后接连字符和 based，构成描述游戏或互动戏剧的复合修饰语；词首 Character 强激活，后续成分较弱。
patterns.domain: 专利背景；游戏、互动戏剧

patterns.name: Characterizing 开头
patterns.context: 句子以动名词 Characterizing 开头，后接研究对象之间的关系；与标题式 Characterization 略有形态差异。

en.concept: Character forms and its characterization/role senses
en.description: Primarily responds to openings with Characterization of in paper or project titles; also responds to Character-based in a gaming context and Characterizing in NIH text.

patterns.name: “Characterization of” in paper titles
patterns.context: A title-like phrase beginning with “Characterization of …”; activation is concentrated on Character, with secondary activation on the split fragment ization, followed by the research subject.
patterns.domain: PubMed abstracts and NIH project text, especially biomedical titles

patterns.name: Character-related gaming expressions
patterns.context: Character is a noun modifying based in descriptions of games or interactive drama, rather than part of the word Characterization.

patterns.name: Characterizing research relationships
patterns.context: Characterizing is used as a verb, followed by a relationship between research variables.

9_2040.concept: Character 词形及其表征/角色语义
9_2040.description: 主要响应论文或项目标题中 Characterization of 的开头；也响应游戏语境中的 Character-based，以及 NIH 文本中的 Characterizing。

patterns.name: 论文标题中的“Characterization of”
patterns.context: 以“Characterization of …”开头的标题式短语；激活集中在 Character，次强落在拆分出的 ization，后接研究对象。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要及 NIH 项目文本，尤以生物医学标题为主

patterns.name: 角色类游戏表述
patterns.context: Character 作名词修饰 based，处于关于游戏或互动戏剧的描述中，而非 Characterization 一词。

patterns.name: Characterizing 研究关系
patterns.context: Characterizing 作动词，后接研究变量之间的关系。

en.description: Strongly responds to the word-initial “Character” token, especially in title-style openings like “Characterization of …”; also covers same-root forms such as “Character-based” and “Characterizing,” whose subsequent topics span multiple fields.

patterns.name: Opening “Characterization”
patterns.context: “Characterization of …” appears at the beginning of a sentence, title, or abstract; activation centers on the subword-tokenized “Characterization,” and most examples are followed by “of”
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper titles or abstracts; also some nonmedical text

patterns.name: “Character-based” compounds
patterns.context: “Character” and “based” form a compound modifier followed by game-related text; “of” is not required

patterns.name: “Characterizing” form
patterns.context: “Character” is followed by “-izing,” forming a gerund at the beginning of a sentence or title, followed by a description of relationship research
patterns.domain: NIH project abstracts or research descriptions

9_2040.description: 强烈响应词首“Character”（分词 token），尤其在“Characterization of …”标题式开头；也覆盖“Character-based”和“Characterizing”等同词根词形，后续主题横跨多种领域。

patterns.name: “Characterization”开头
patterns.context: 句首或标题/摘要开头出现“Characterization of …”；激活集中于被分词切开的“Characterization”，且多数例子紧接“of”
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文标题或摘要；也有非医学文本

patterns.name: “Character-based”复合词
patterns.context: “Character”与“based”组成复合修饰语，后接游戏相关表述；不要求出现“of”
patterns.domain: 专利背景、互动游戏/戏剧

patterns.name: “Characterizing”词形
patterns.context: “Character”后接“-izing”，构成句首或标题中的动名词形式，后接关系研究描述

en.concept: Character string and its local context
en.description: Most samples activate in the academic title-like phrase “Characterization of”, followed by various research subjects; there is also “Character-based” in a patent and strong isolated activation on of in mathematical text.

patterns.name: Characterization in paper titles
patterns.context: A title-like opening followed by of and the subject of study; activation is concentrated on Character and often extends to the split suffix ization and of.
patterns.domain: Biomedical and other academic paper titles

patterns.name: Character-based phrase
patterns.context: Character is followed by a hyphen and based, forming a modifier rather than Characterization; later text mentions games or interactive drama.
patterns.domain: Patent background text concerning games or interactive drama

patterns.name: Sporadic activation in mathematical text
patterns.context: of receives strong activation in a math problem or formal text; nearby are numbers, line breaks, and tokens such as False and Is, but no Character trigger is evident.

9_2040.concept: Character 字符串及其局部语境
9_2040.description: 多数样本在学术标题式短语“Characterization of”中激活，后接各类研究对象；另有专利中的“Character-based”及数学文本中孤立的 of 强激活。

patterns.name: 论文标题中的 Characterization
patterns.context: 以标题式短语开头，后接 of 和被研究对象；激活集中在 Character，且常延伸至分词后缀 ization 与 of。
patterns.domain: 生物医学及其他学术论文标题

patterns.name: Character-based 短语
patterns.context: Character 后接连字符和 based，构成修饰语，而非 Characterization；后文提到 games 或 interactive drama。
patterns.domain: 专利背景文本，涉及游戏或互动戏剧

patterns.name: 数学文本中的零散激活
patterns.context: 数学题目或形式化文本中，of 获得强激活；附近有数字、换行及 False、Is 等 token，但未见 Character 触发。

en.description: Strongly responds to the word-initial token Character, especially title-style “Characterization of” phrasing; subjects include antimicrobial agents, cell markers, proteins, and chemical interactions. Also responds to Character-based and Characterizing.

patterns.name: “Characterization of” in paper titles
patterns.context: “Characterization of” is a set phrase at the beginning of a title or abstract; activation centers on Character, with weaker activation on subsequent tokens. Followed by the object of study.
patterns.domain: Primarily PubMed biomedical abstracts; also NIH project text

patterns.name: Other expressions beginning with “Character”
patterns.context: Related forms or phrases do not use the full “Characterization of”: one instance is “Character-based,” another “Characterizing the relationship.”

9_2040.description: 强烈响应 Character 的词首 token，尤其是论文式标题中的“Characterization of”；对象涵盖抗菌物、细胞标记、蛋白质、化学相互作用等。也响应 Character-based 与 Characterizing。

patterns.name: 论文标题中的“Characterization of”
patterns.context: “Characterization of”作为标题或摘要开头的固定措辞；激活集中在 Character，后续 token 也有较弱激活。后接研究对象。
patterns.domain: 主要为 PubMed 生物医学摘要；也见 NIH 项目文本

patterns.name: “Character”-开头的其他表达
patterns.context: 相关词形或短语不采用完整的“Characterization of”：一处为“Character-based”，另一处为“Characterizing the relationship”。
patterns.domain: 专利背景；NIH 项目文本

en.description: The most prominent activation cues are Before (in multiple grammatical positions) and try; it also covers technical support, code identifiers, legal documents, tutorial links, news reports, similar webpage entries, and email formatting. The content varies widely, with no unified semantics explaining all passages.

patterns.name: Before / try forms
patterns.context: Capitalized and lowercase forms of Before occur before names/legal titles, in the code method name insertBefore, or in exception text; try appears in support posts, URL paths, and near code keywords. The trigger words vary in meaning and grammatical position.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, StackExchange technical Q&A and code

patterns.name: Technical support and troubleshooting
patterns.context: Describes software compatibility, code, or database errors and asks for a solution; includes technical details such as commands, version numbers, and exception stacks.

patterns.name: Code snippets and identifiers
patterns.context: Identifiers in code, class names, or method names; activation falls within camel-case words or on tokens adjacent to code.

patterns.name: Legal document structure
