patterns.context: Judges’ titles, hearing/ruling dates, statutory citations, and sentence openings in court rulings; formatted titles, citations, and line breaks are prominent.

patterns.name: Tutorial sites and URLs
patterns.context: Mentions a tutorial site and includes a link to a sample page, followed by a description of a code problem.

patterns.name: Joint airstrikes in news reports
patterns.context: Reports joint Russian-Turkish airstrikes against ISIL in Syria; activation centers on entities and action phrases in the news sentence.

patterns.name: Similar links and video titles
patterns.context: Webpage or forum content lists similar entries and includes linked titles of videos/articles.

patterns.name: Email headers and forwarded-style content
patterns.context: After email formatting such as address, CC, and subject, a body appears with a separator line and email service promotional text.

9_2040.description: 激活最突出的线索是 Before（多种语法位置）和 try；此外覆盖技术求助、代码标识符、法律文书、教程链接、新闻报道、网页相似条目及邮件格式。各类内容差异较大，未见能解释全部段落的统一语义。

patterns.name: Before / try 词形
patterns.context: 大小写形式的 Before 出现在姓名/法律标题之前、代码方法名 insertBefore 中或异常文本中；try 出现在求助正文、URL 路径及代码关键字附近。触发词的语义和语法位置并不一致。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、StackExchange 技术问答与代码

patterns.name: 技术求助与故障排查
patterns.trigger: «could not solve the problem»、«compatibility issue»、«You have to roll back»、«help me»
patterns.context: 描述软件兼容性、代码或数据库错误，并请求解决办法；有命令、版本号、异常栈等技术细节。

patterns.name: 代码片段与标识符
patterns.context: 代码、类名或方法名中的标识符；激活落在驼峰词内部或与代码相邻的 token 上。

patterns.name: 法律文书结构
patterns.trigger: «Joseph Magistrate Judge.»、«ARGUED APRIL 5, 2018—DECIDED AUGUST 24, 2018»、«U.S.S.G. § 2A6.2(a)»、«If the offense»
patterns.context: 法院判决的法官称谓、审理/裁决日期、法规引文及正文句首；格式化标题、引文和换行明显。

patterns.name: 教程网站与 URL
patterns.context: 提及教程网站并粘贴示例页面链接，随后描述代码问题。

patterns.name: 新闻报道中的联合空袭
patterns.trigger: «Russian and Turkish jets»、«joint air raids»、«ISIL fighters»
patterns.context: 报道俄土战机在叙利亚针对 ISIL 的联合空袭；激活集中于新闻句中的实体和行动表达。

patterns.name: 相似链接与视频标题
patterns.context: 网页或论坛内容列出相似条目，并包含指向视频/文章的标题链接。

patterns.name: 邮件抬头与转发式内容
patterns.context: 邮件地址、抄送和主题等邮件格式之后，出现带分隔线的正文及邮件服务宣传语。

en.description: Activation is scattered across papers, legal documents, emails, Q&A, and code; it favors Before, asterisk comment markers, all-caps headings, and structured text fragments such as code identifiers, paths, headers, and URLs.

patterns.name: Before as a document label or code identifier
patterns.context: Appears before a judge/date field in a court document, or in a Before identifier or method name in code.

patterns.name: Asterisk comment markers in documents and code
patterns.context: Asterisks occur in comments after line breaks or in document separator areas; seen both near paper titles and in code documentation comments.
patterns.domain: Paper formatting, legal email text, software code comments

patterns.name: All-caps or block-capital headings and headers
patterns.context: Uppercase words are often split into subwords and appear in paper titles, court letterheads, or legal document date/section headings.

patterns.name: Paths, names, and assertions in structured code
patterns.context: Paths, class/constant names, call chains, and configuration mappings in code; activation falls near identifiers and their structural boundaries.
patterns.domain: GitHub software tests and configuration code

patterns.name: URL and domain fragments
patterns.context: Email body lists online project documentation links, with the domain and path split into multiple fragments.

patterns.name: IDs and row fields in data tables
patterns.context: Discusses updating records in a dataset and displays table column headers.

9_2040.concept: 结构化文本标记与边界
9_2040.description: 激活分散于论文、法律文书、邮件、问答和代码；偏好 Before、星号注释标记、全大写标题，以及代码标识符、路径、表头和网址等结构化文本片段。

patterns.name: Before 作为文档标签或代码标识符
patterns.context: 出现在法院文书的法官/日期栏前，或出现在代码中的 Before 标识符、方法名中。

patterns.name: 文档与代码中的星号注释标记
patterns.context: 星号位于换行后的注释或文档分隔区域；既见于论文标题附近，也见于代码文档注释。
patterns.domain: 论文排版、法律邮件文本、软件代码注释

patterns.name: 全大写或分块大写的标题与表头
patterns.context: 大写词常被子词切分，出现在论文标题、法院抬头或法律文书日期/章节标题中。

patterns.name: 结构化代码中的路径、名称与断言
patterns.context: 代码中的路径、类/常量名、调用链及配置映射；激活落在标识符及其结构边界附近。
patterns.domain: Github 软件测试与配置代码

patterns.name: 网址与域名片段
patterns.context: 邮件正文列出在线项目文档链接，域名和路径被分词成多个片段。

patterns.name: 数据表中的 ID 与行字段
patterns.context: 讨论更新数据集中的记录，并展示表格列标题。

en.concept: Formatting and code markers in structured text
en.description: The main pattern is local markers in varied code and formatted text: Enron logs and Windows paths recur most clearly; other examples include PHP assertions, conditions, Swift lifecycle methods, jQuery calls, Markdown bold, and paper author metadata. Segment 5 contains only punctuation and whitespace formatting.

patterns.name: Enron logs and paths
patterns.context: Repeated log fragments with hours, auxiliary plans, and “variances detected” reports, followed by a file parsing prompt and a Windows path; structure is nearly identical across three passages.

patterns.name: assert method names in code
patterns.context: In PHP test code, the trigger is a PHPUnit-style assertion method name and its call.

patterns.name: PHP conditionals and password variables
patterns.context: PHP code snippet opening with a conditional keyword and password variable comparison; preceded by a blank line and version number.

patterns.name: Swift lifecycle methods
patterns.context: Near a UIViewController subclass’s method declaration and lifecycle implementation; a dark mode note also appears, but activation falls on code tokens.

patterns.name: jQuery fade-in call
patterns.context: An HTML fragment is followed by a jQuery chained call: first appendTo, then fadeIn with a duration argument on the target element.

patterns.name: Markdown bold and a list of maxims
patterns.context: A multi-line list of wishes/maxims in Markdown bold, followed by an asterisk separator and a transition to a SQLite extension description.

patterns.name: YAML author field and bold markers
patterns.context: Document header or metadata list, with an author entry marked up in Markdown bold after the author field.

patterns.name: Typography sequence of punctuation, whitespace, and backticks
patterns.context: Activation centers on a highly formatted multi-line character sequence, with no recognizable natural-language semantics; its function cannot be determined from the fragment.
patterns.domain: Possible table, ASCII formatting, or dump text in Enron email

patterns.name: Code/text boundary after a line break
patterns.context: Strong activation first falls on consecutive line breaks and only then on PHP code; this does not consistently correspond to the local triggers in other segments.

9_2040.concept: 结构化文本中的格式与代码标记
9_2040.description: 主要模式是多种代码和格式化文本中的局部标记：Enron 日志与 Windows 路径重复最明显；另见 PHP 断言、条件、Swift 生命周期、jQuery 调用、Markdown 粗体及论文作者元数据。第5段只呈现标点与空白排版。

patterns.name: Enron日志与路径
patterns.context: 带有小时、辅助计划及“variances detected”报告的重复日志片段，随后出现解析文件提示和 Windows 路径；在三段中结构近乎相同。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的机器生成报告/日志

patterns.name: 代码中的 assert 方法名
patterns.context: PHP 测试代码中，触发点是 PHPUnit 风格的断言方法名及其调用。

patterns.name: PHP 条件判断与密码变量
patterns.context: PHP 代码片段开头，包含条件关键字和密码变量比较；前方有空行及版本号。
patterns.domain: Hacker News 中的代码片段

patterns.name: Swift 生命周期方法
patterns.context: UIViewController 子类的方法声明与生命周期实现附近；同时出现 dark mode 说明，但激活落在代码 token 上。

patterns.name: jQuery 淡入调用
patterns.context: HTML 片段后接 jQuery 链式调用，先 appendTo，再对目标元素执行带时长参数的 fadeIn。

patterns.name: Markdown 粗体与箴言列表
patterns.context: 多行 Markdown 粗体文本组成的祝愿/箴言列表，随后以星号分隔并转入 SQLite 扩展说明。

patterns.name: YAML 作者字段与粗体标记
patterns.context: 文档头部或元数据列表，作者字段后出现带粗体 Markdown 标记的作者条目。

patterns.name: 标点、空白与反引号的排版序列
patterns.context: 激活集中在高度格式化的多行字符序列，缺少可辨认的自然语言语义；无法从片段确定其功能。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的疑似表格、ASCII 排版或转储文本

patterns.name: 换行后的代码/文本边界
patterns.context: 强激活首先落在连续换行，之后才进入 PHP 代码；这一现象与其他段的局部触发并不稳定对应。
patterns.domain: Hacker News 文本/代码混排

en.description: Activation is distributed across programming identifiers, Italian software discussions, gene and materials terminology, statistical tables, and exhortative text; although capitalization or tokenization boundaries occur in several places, no stable semantic or formal feature covers all samples.

patterns.name: get-related calls
patterns.context: In code or technical discussions, get appears as a method name or ordinary verb; not every instance of get triggers

patterns.name: Collection and container identifiers
patterns.context: In Java generic code, Set/HashSet appear as types or variable names

patterns.name: Unity settings UI terms
patterns.context: Italian-language IRC discusses Unity operation and desktop settings; activation falls on unity

patterns.name: MYC-related gene symbols
patterns.context: Gene names and nearby hyphens in biomedical text

patterns.name: AuSn solder and NiP layer
patterns.context: In patent descriptions of semiconductor chip bonding and metal-layer materials

patterns.name: Phrasing about reviewing failures
patterns.context: Training or management advice discusses failures, processes, and role-playing; activation is scattered across several common words

patterns.name: it in pronouns and auxiliary constructions

9_2040.description: 激活分布在口语代词和功能词、引语中的结果或感受表达，以及代码标识符子词；多数片段可由局部句法或语境解释，但未见贯穿全部样例的单一主题。

patterns.name: 代词与助动结构中的 it

patterns.name: 引语中的 we/you 与结果表达

patterns.name: 话语连接与从句结构
patterns.context: 出现在从句、引述或连续动作表达中；单独看可能只是高频功能词

patterns.name: 代码中的类型及协议缓冲区标识符
patterns.context: 代码标识符被拆成子词，邻接类、类型描述符或命名空间

patterns.name: 残缺或分词边界处的 token
patterns.context: 处于代码标识符的子词边界；无法仅凭片段确定其独立语义

patterns.name: 引语中的情绪或体验结果

patterns.name: 口语中的第一人称经历
patterns.context: 个人陈述愿望、经历或判断，常见于第一人称叙述

patterns.name: 性别与婚约语境中的所有格代词
patterns.context: 讨论未婚夫佩戴订婚戒指及其反应

patterns.name: 视频内容警告

en.description: All excerpts show strong activation on the capitalized sentence-initial pronoun «It», followed by a be-verb, contraction, or lexical verb. It usually refers back to a preceding situation or thing and introduces a description, evaluation, or explanation across diverse genres.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial capitalized pronoun It
patterns.context: The pronoun It at the start of a sentence or utterance refers to a preceding situation, event, or thing; it is followed by a be-verb (such as “It was”), the contraction “It’s”, or a lexical verb (such as “It made” or “It scares”).
patterns.domain: Various genres, including news reports, interviews, encyclopedia biographies, blogs, and forums; contexts often evaluate, describe, or explain a previously mentioned experience or thing.

9_2040.description: 所有片段都在句首大写代词 «It» 处强激活，后接 be 动词、缩写或实义动词；它通常回指前文情境或事物，并引出描述、评价或说明，跨越多种文体。

patterns.name: 句首大写代词 It
patterns.context: 句子或话语中句首的代词 It，指代前文情境、事件或事物；后接 be 动词（如 “It was”）、缩写 “It’s”，或实义动词（如 “It made”“It scares”）。
patterns.domain: 新闻报道、人物访谈、百科传记、博客、论坛等多种文体；语境常为对前述经历或事物作评价、描述或说明。

en.description: All passages mark It at the beginning of a sentence or new sentence; it is followed by was, ’s, or a verb, referring back to prior events and evaluating them, explaining their impact, or describing a state. The main trigger is sentence-initial use of the English pronoun It; its semantic functions vary.

patterns.name: Predicate structures after sentence-initial It
patterns.context: Mostly standalone sentences in quotations or narration; activation often falls on It and sometimes extends to the following copula
patterns.domain: News, sports reporting, personal quotations, and online essays

patterns.name: It was / It’s + evaluation or state
patterns.context: It refers to a prior event, experience, outcome, or situation, followed by an evaluation, explanation, or statement of state
patterns.domain: Sports reporting, interview quotations, personal narration

patterns.name: It + verb: outcome, feeling, or impression
patterns.context: It refers to a prior situation or experience and introduces its function, impact, feeling, or demonstrated outcome
patterns.domain: Sports reporting, personal essays, online discussions

patterns.name: Referential continuation and narrative with It’s
patterns.context: It refers back to an earlier thing or situation; used separately in comparative descriptions and analogies

patterns.name: Incomplete It-introduced sentences
patterns.context: The excerpt cuts off mid-sentence, so the following syntax or semantics cannot be confirmed; strong activation after It is still present

9_2040.description: 所有片段都在句首或新句开头标记 It；后接 was、’s 或动词，承接前文事件并作评价、说明其影响或描述状态。主要触发线索是英语代词 It 的句首用法，语义功能多样。

patterns.name: 句首 It 后的谓语结构
patterns.trigger: 句首或新句开头的 “It” 后，紧接 “was” 或 “‘s”
patterns.context: 多为引述或叙述中的独立句；激活常落在 It，而后续系动词有时也标记
patterns.domain: 新闻、体育报道、人物引述及网络随笔

patterns.name: It was / It’s + 评价或状态
patterns.trigger: “It was” （如 “It was just kind of a whirlwind”“It was extremely significant”）及 “It’s” （如 “It’s just incredible”“It’s definitely something”）
patterns.context: It 指代前文事件、经历、结果或状况，随后给出评价、解释或状态判断
patterns.domain: 体育报道、采访引语、个人叙述

patterns.name: It + 动词：结果、感受或印象
patterns.trigger: “It allowed”“It made”“It felt”“It scares”“It just showed”
patterns.context: It 指代前文情境或经历，并引出其作用、影响、感受或所显示的结果
patterns.domain: 体育报道、个人随笔、网络讨论

patterns.name: It’s 的指代衔接与延续叙述
patterns.trigger: “It’s not Waterloo Bridge”及 “It’s kind of like a holiday”
patterns.context: It 承接上文事物或情形；分别用于对比描述和类比说明
patterns.domain: 游记随笔、体育人物引述

patterns.name: 不完整的 It 引导句
patterns.trigger: “It …” 后接尚未完成的句子，如 “It was just kind of a whirl…”、“It’s something we…”、“It was Winter and Spring…”
patterns.context: 摘录截断在句中，无法确认后续句法或语义；仍出现 It 后的强激活

en.description: The most stable pattern is a sentence-initial “It / It’s / It was” evaluative or summarizing statement in quoted speech or narration, appearing across topics such as sports, personal recollections, and news. A few activations fall on an opening quotation mark or line break, with other activations on nearby function words.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial “It” emphatic statement
patterns.context: In quoted speech or narration, a sentence begins with “It was… / It’s…”, usually following earlier context and evaluating, expressing a feeling about, or summarizing something; activation is concentrated on It, often followed by was or ’s.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including news quotes, interviews, and personal narratives

patterns.name: Opening quotation marks and line breaks
patterns.context: A new quotation begins after a line break or paragraph boundary; in some examples, the marker falls on a quotation mark or line break rather than lexical content.
patterns.domain: Online news text containing direct quotations

patterns.name: Function words in evaluative statements
patterns.context: Appears near evaluative expressions such as “It was a lot of pressure”, “It’s incredible”, and “It was such a unique game”; likely an extension of the sentence-initial “It” pattern rather than an independent semantic theme.

9_2040.description: 最稳定的模式是引语或叙述中句首“It / It’s / It was”式评价、总结句；跨体育、个人回忆、新闻等题材出现。少数激活落在引语开头的引号或换行，另有邻近功能词激活。

patterns.name: 句首“It”强调句
patterns.context: 引述或叙述中，以“It was… / It’s…”起句，通常承接前文，对某事作评价、感受或总结；激活集中在 It，句后常接 was 或 ’s。
patterns.domain: 新闻引语、访谈、个人叙述等多种文体

patterns.name: 句首引号及换行
patterns.context: 新引语在换行或段落边界开始；有些例子中标记落在引号或换行，而非词汇内容上。
patterns.domain: 带直接引语的网页新闻文本

patterns.name: 评价句中的功能词
patterns.context: 出现在评价性表达附近，如“It was a lot of pressure”“It’s incredible”“It was such a unique game”；较可能是句首“It”模式的延伸，而非独立语义主题。

en.description: All passages highlight sentence-initial It in quotations or narration, usually followed by is/was/’s; subsequent text often evaluates a prior event, experience, or situation, and also includes metaphors, exclamations, and referential judgments.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial It + copula in reported speech
patterns.context: In quotations or direct speech, the sentence begins with It, followed by a be verb and then an evaluation, state, or explanation; activation centers on It and often continues to ’s in contractions.
patterns.domain: Direct quotations in news reports, sports interviews, personal assessments, and personal narration

patterns.name: Evaluative complements following It
patterns.context: It refers to a prior event, experience, or situation; be is followed by an adjective or noun phrase expressing an evaluation. The complement may be modified by a degree adverb.
patterns.domain: Feelings, evaluations, or summaries in interview and news quotations

patterns.name: It referring to a prior situation
patterns.context: Sentence-initial It refers back to a previously described game, experience, or scene; it is not always a direct evaluation and may form a metaphor or negative comparison.

patterns.name: Narrative state after “It was”
patterns.context: A direct quotation begins with It was and states the nature of something; the complement ranges from positive evaluations to mixed emotions.

patterns.name: Atypical It openings
patterns.context: Also begins with It + be, but the continuation is a referential judgment or exclamation rather than a simple It was + adjective evaluation; the sentence is truncated.

9_2040.description: 所有段都突出引语或叙述中的句首 It，通常接 is/was/’s；后续多为对前文事件、经历或情形作评价，也包括比喻、感叹及指代性判断。

patterns.name: 报道引语中的句首 It + 系动词
patterns.context: 引语或直接引语中，句子以 It 开头，后接 be 动词，再接评价、状态或说明；激活点集中在 It，常延续到缩写中的 ’s。
patterns.domain: 新闻报道、体育采访、人物评价及个人叙述中的直接引语

patterns.name: It 后接评价性补语
patterns.trigger: «It»…« was»…« special»、«It»…« was»…« extremely significant»、«It»…«’s»…« an amazing»、«It»…«’s»…« good»、«It»…« is»…« a great»
patterns.context: It 指代前文事件、经历或情形，be 后接形容词或名词短语作评价；补语可被程度副词修饰。
patterns.domain: 访谈与新闻引语中的感受、评价或总结

patterns.name: It 指代前文情形
patterns.trigger: «It»« was» just kind of a whirlwind；«It»’s not Waterloo Bridge
patterns.context: 句首 It 承接前文描述的比赛、经历或景象；并非每次都是直接评价，也可能构成比喻或否定比较。

patterns.name: “It was”后的叙述性状态
patterns.context: 在直接引语中以 It was 起句，陈述某事的性质；具体补语从积极评价到混合情绪不等。

patterns.name: 非典型的 It 起句
patterns.trigger: «It»10«'s» definitely something；«It»10«’»3«s» just incredible what a year can
patterns.context: 同样以 It + be 起句，但后续是指代性判断或感叹，而非简单的 It was + 形容词评价；句子截断。

en.description: All passages contain capitalized sentence-initial “It” followed by an explanatory or evaluative predicate; the most common forms are “It was/It’s”, with “It really helped” also appearing.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial evaluative “It” clause
patterns.context: Sentence-initial “It” refers to a preceding event, experience, or situation, then evaluates, describes, or explains it; no particular emotional polarity is required.
patterns.domain: English narratives and conversational styles, including news quotes, interviews, reviews, personal blogs, and testimonials

9_2040.description: 所有段落都出现句首大写“It”并接续说明或评价性谓语；最常见的是“It was/It’s”，也包括“It really helped”。

patterns.name: 句首评价性“It”分句
patterns.trigger: 句首大写 «It»，尤其后接 «was»、«'s» 或 «’s»，如 «It was special»、«It’s definitely»、«It really helped»
patterns.context: 句首以“It”指代前文事件、经历或情况，随后对其作评价、描述或说明；不要求特定情感极性。
patterns.domain: 新闻引语、访谈、评论、个人博客与推荐语等英语叙述或口语化文体

en.description: All snippets activate sentence openings such as It was/It's in quotations or spoken responses, followed by an immediate evaluation of an experience, performance, or event; evaluative meanings vary, with sports interviews predominating.

patterns.name: Evaluative It’s sentences in quotations
patterns.context: In a quotation or spoken response adjacent to a quotation, starts with It was / It's and evaluates an event, expresses a feeling, or summarizes; the evaluation may concern pressure, wonder, performance, a return, nearing the end, or special significance.
patterns.domain: Sports news interview quotations and general news quotations

9_2040.concept: 引语中的 It 评价句
9_2040.description: 所有片段都在引语或口语回答中激活 It was/It's 一类句首，随后给出对经历、表现或事件的即时评价；评价语义各异，体育采访居多。

patterns.name: 引语中的 It’s 评价句
patterns.context: 引号内或紧邻引语的口语回答中，以 It was / It's 开头，对事情作评价、表达感受或总结；评价内容可为压力、惊叹、表现、回归、接近结束或特殊意义。
patterns.domain: 体育新闻采访引语及一般新闻引语

en.description: All passages highlight statement structures with “It/it” as the subject of a clause, often followed by a copula or auxiliary; the content spans emails, personal narratives, and sports coverage. Other local themes include thanks, evaluations, recollections, growth, weather, and sporting events, which do not share a single semantic trigger.

patterns.name: “It” and copular structures at the start of a sentence or clause
patterns.context: In an independent clause or quotation, “It/it” serves as the subject, followed by a statement of evaluation, result, or state; activation is concentrated on “It” itself, with copulas or auxiliaries also activated in several examples.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including sports interviews, thank-you emails, personal narratives, and blogs

patterns.name: First-person plural and team-performance accounts
patterns.context: In team interviews, recounting match performance, conceding a goal, and subsequent judgments; need not occur immediately beside an “It” construction.

patterns.name: Expressions of thanks and acknowledgment
patterns.context: Thanking a recipient or others for help, a speech, effort, or guidance; common in emails or acknowledgment quotes.

patterns.name: Learning, growth, and takeaways
patterns.context: Describing learning, reflection, and personal change resulting from an experience or guidance.
patterns.domain: Personal-growth narratives, sports interviews, or education interviews

patterns.name: Positive evaluation or emotional summary
patterns.context: Strongly positive evaluation of performance, experiences, people, or outcomes; the specific subject varies across passages.

patterns.name: Recollections and personal feelings
patterns.context: First-person recollections, feelings, or judgments, often followed by personal experiences; need not involve thanks or evaluation.

patterns.name: Weather and outdoor activity descriptions
patterns.context: Describing local weather, wind, or rain and its effects in travel or sporting contexts.

patterns.name: Competition and sporting-event contexts
patterns.context: Match progress, performance, or evaluation in events such as team sports, tennis, golf, or motocross.

patterns.name: Email formatting and polite greetings
patterns.context: Email exchanges with quoted replies, salutations, or signatures; this pattern may not share the same trigger as the core high-activation words.

patterns.name: A sense of belonging or returning home
patterns.context: Describing a girl returning to a familiar environment and feeling at ease.

patterns.name: Holiday leisure activities
patterns.context: Recounting a week of travel or leisure activities.

9_2040.description: 所有段都在分句中突出“It/it”作主语的陈述式结构，常接系词或助动词；内容跨邮件、个人叙述和体育报道。另有感谢、评价、回忆、成长、天气与赛事等局部主题，彼此并非统一语义触发。

patterns.name: 句首或分句中的“It”及系词结构
patterns.trigger: “It”后接“’s/’”或“was/has”，如“It’s definitely”“It gave”“It was”“It has been”“It’s appreciated”“It’s just incredible”“It was just”“it made”
patterns.context: 独立分句或引语中，以“It/it”作主语，后续陈述评价、结果或状态；激活集中在“It”本身，多个例子中系词或助动词也激活。
patterns.domain: 体育采访、致谢邮件、个人叙述、博客等多种文体

patterns.name: 第一人称复数及球队表现叙述
patterns.trigger: “We came out”“We’re disappointed”“we gave up”“we can”
patterns.context: 球队采访中回顾比赛表现、失球和后续判断；不要求“It”句式紧邻。

patterns.name: 感谢与致谢表达
patterns.context: 感谢收信人或他人的帮助、演讲、投入与指导，常见于邮件或致谢引语。

patterns.name: 学习、成长与收获
patterns.trigger: “learnt a lot”“learn a lot more”“helped me to turn inwards”“light bulb moment”“how much had changed”
patterns.context: 叙述一段经历或指导带来的学习、反思和个人变化。
patterns.domain: 个人成长叙述、体育或教育采访

patterns.name: 正面评价或情绪性总结
patterns.context: 对表现、经历、人物或结果作强烈正面评价；各段具体对象不同。
patterns.domain: 体育采访、邮件、旅行博客

patterns.name: 回顾经历与个人感受
patterns.trigger: “I loved it”“I drew from those moments”“I think”“I’m home”“I’m sure”
patterns.context: 第一人称回忆、感受或判断，常接个人经历；不必涉及感谢或评价。

patterns.name: 天气与户外活动描述
patterns.trigger: “hot hot hot down here”“15-mile an hour wind”“sprinkled a bit”
patterns.context: 旅行或赛事语境中描述当地天气、风雨及其影响。

patterns.name: 比赛及赛事情境
patterns.trigger: “second half”“goal”“17th straight win”“best kick”“four from over 60”“locker room”“second moto”“good racing”
patterns.context: 球队、网球、高尔夫或摩托越野等赛事的比赛经过、表现或评价。
patterns.domain: 体育报道与运动员引语

patterns.name: 邮件格式与礼貌寒暄
patterns.trigger: “Hi,”“Thanks for your presentation today.”“-- Shirley Henderson”“-- Joyce Krawiec”
patterns.context: 带回复引用、称呼或署名的邮件往来；此模式与核心高激活词可能并非同一触发因素。

patterns.name: 家庭般归属感或归来
patterns.context: 描述女孩回到熟悉环境、感到亲切安适。

patterns.name: 假期休闲活动
patterns.trigger: “relaxed”“played in the ocean”“made new friends”“ate some amazing meals”“brains rest”
patterns.context: 回顾一周旅行或休息活动。

en.description: All snippets strongly activate sentence-initial or locally focal “It,” typically forming an anaphoric sentence of the form “It is/was/It’s + evaluation or judgment”; evaluations cover praise, wonder, pressure, importance, and complex feelings. The register is primarily quotations, but emails also occur.

patterns.name: It + is/was copular construction
patterns.context: Activation focuses on sentence-initial “It” in reported or direct quotations, followed by the copula is/was/’s and then an evaluation, judgment, or explanation; [10] is a weaker instance of “It.”
patterns.domain: News quotations, sports reporting, personal emails

patterns.name: Positive evaluation or emotional judgment
patterns.context: “it” refers to an event, experience, match, or situation mentioned earlier, and the following predicate provides praise, expresses wonder or emotion, or evaluates its importance; some sentences are incomplete at the excerpt boundary.
patterns.domain: Sports news quotations, travel narratives, thank-you emails

patterns.name: Summary judgment about an experience or situation
patterns.context: It refers back to a match, the pressure of playing, or another experience mentioned earlier, then summarizes its nature, impact, or the speaker’s feelings; the evaluation is not necessarily positive.

patterns.name: Fixed spoken opening with It’s
patterns.context: A contracted copular construction is followed by an intensifier or adjective, forming a colloquial exclamation/evaluation; [4] is followed by the repeated word “hot.”

patterns.name: It as an anaphoric subject in non-direct speech
patterns.context: In an email, It refers back to material or an experience mentioned earlier and expresses a feeling after giving thanks; this is not a news interview quotation.
patterns.domain: Personal expressions of thanks in Enron emails

9_2040.description: 所有片段都强烈激活句首或局部焦点词“It”，通常构成“It is/was/It’s + 评价或判断”的回指句；评价涵盖赞美、惊叹、压力、重要性及复杂感受，语域以引语为主，也见邮件。

patterns.name: It + is/was 系词句式
patterns.context: 激活集中在引述或直接引语中的句首“It”，后接系词 is/was/’s，再接评价、判断或说明；段[10]是较弱的“It”。
patterns.domain: 新闻引语、体育报道、个人邮件

patterns.name: 积极评价或情感判断
patterns.context: “it”指代前文事件、经历、比赛或情形，后续谓语给出赞许、惊叹、情感或重要性评价；部分句子在摘录处未完。
patterns.domain: 体育新闻引语、旅行叙述、感谢邮件

patterns.name: 对经历或情形的总结判断
patterns.context: It 承接前文所述比赛、踢球压力或其他经历，随后概括其性质、影响或感受，不一定是正面评价。

patterns.name: It’s 固定口语起句
patterns.context: 缩写系词结构后接程度词或形容词，形成口语化的惊叹/评价句；[4]后接重复的“hot”。
patterns.domain: 新闻引语、旅行博客式叙述

patterns.name: It 作回指主语的非直接引语
patterns.context: 邮件中用 It 回指前文提及的材料或经历，表达感谢后的感受；并非新闻采访引语。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的个人感谢语

en.description: All passages highlight sentence-initial It, often introducing an evaluation or state with It’s, It was, or It has. Evaluations are mostly positive; other contexts involve learning, heat, sleepiness, gratitude, sports performance, and life recollections.

patterns.name: Descriptive sentence following sentence-initial It
patterns.context: A sentence begins with It and then describes a state, result, or evaluation; samples often begin with It’s, It has, It was, or It’ll.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including web narratives, reviews, news quotes, and emails

patterns.name: Positive experiences and evaluations
patterns.context: Expressing positive feelings about a holiday, course, season, workday, acknowledgment, or memorial event; in many passages, the evaluation follows an It opening.
patterns.domain: Personal blogs, testimonials, news quotes, thank-you replies, and sports coverage

patterns.name: Learning and growth
patterns.context: Discussing introspection prompted by a course or players’ learning and progress over time; occurs mainly near It sentences.
patterns.domain: Yoga course reviews and sports interviews

patterns.name: Repeated emphasis on hot weather
patterns.context: At the end of a holiday narrative, a repeated adjective emphasizes the local heat; introduced by «It’s».

patterns.name: Caffeine and sleepiness
patterns.context: Discussing caffeine and sleepiness, then turning to the day’s circumstances and evaluating the workday.

patterns.name: Thanks and recollection
patterns.context: Acknowledging or recalling others’ contributions, followed by an It-initial evaluative sentence; expressions of thanks may also be repeated.

patterns.name: Sports performance and mistakes
patterns.context: Describing a team’s second-half performance, scoring, and disappointment at conceding soon after; followed by a judgment beginning with It’s.

patterns.name: Seasonal and everyday recollections
patterns.context: Recalling morning gatherings with a son at a café and the season in which they occurred; the excerpt cuts off before the continuation.

9_2040.description: 所有段都突出句首 It，并常以 It’s、It was、It has 等引出评价或状态。评价多为正面；上下文另涉及学习、炎热、困倦、感谢、体育表现和生活回忆。

patterns.name: 句首 It 后的描述句
patterns.context: 句子以 It 开头，随后描述某事的状态、结果或评价；在样本中经常以 It’s、It has、It was、It’ll 起句。
patterns.domain: 网页叙述、评论、新闻引语、邮件等多种文体

patterns.name: 正面体验与评价
patterns.trigger: 如« amazing»、« enjoyed»、« incredible»、« pleased»、« wonderful»、« helpful»、« great»
patterns.context: 表达对假期、课程、赛季、工作日、致谢或纪念活动的积极感受；其中多段评价紧跟 It 起句。
patterns.domain: 个人博客、推荐语、新闻引语、感谢回复及体育报道

patterns.name: 学习与成长
patterns.context: 谈课程带来的内省，或队员在一段时间内的学习与进步；主要在 It 句附近出现。
patterns.domain: 瑜伽课程评价、体育采访

patterns.name: 天气炎热的重复强调
patterns.context: 假期叙述末尾，以重复形容词强调当地炎热；并由«It’s»引出。

patterns.name: 咖啡因与困倦
patterns.context: 先谈咖啡因和困倦，再转入当天情况及对工作日的评价。

patterns.name: 感谢与回忆
patterns.context: 致谢或回顾他人贡献，随后出现 It 开头的评价句；感谢语也可能重复出现。

patterns.name: 体育表现与失误
patterns.context: 描述球队下半场表现、进球及很快丢球的失望；后接 It’s 开头的判断。

patterns.name: 季节与日常回忆
patterns.context: 回忆与儿子在咖啡馆的早晨聚会及其发生的季节；片段截断于后续叙述。

en.concept: Statements and evaluations in everyday communication
en.description: The most stable feature is sentence-initial “It” introducing a statement, evaluation, or result in everyday narratives or communication; there is also a response to several words in “learned a lot” and thank-you or feedback contexts, as well as sporadic local activations.

patterns.name: It followed by an evaluation or feeling
patterns.context: Sentence-initial or within a sentence, “It” refers to a previously mentioned thing, activity, or experience, followed by a copula, auxiliary, or evaluative predicate; in multiple examples, positive activation focuses on It.
patterns.domain: Informal narratives in web reviews, blogs, forum posts, emails, etc.

patterns.name: Learning a lot
patterns.context: Expresses having learned a lot from a person or experience; activation falls around a lot. The context often involves thanks, training, or personal introductions.

patterns.name: Thanks and positive evaluation
patterns.context: After thanking someone, evaluates their help, sharing, or content; common in replies, acknowledgments, or feedback.
patterns.domain: Emails, forum exchanges, and user reviews

patterns.name: Other local expressions
patterns.context: Occurs respectively in the initial letters of an email address, diary-like expressions of tiredness and challenge, and a statement of the duration of a toilet-training experience; no distinct pattern is supported by shared context.
patterns.domain: Web contact information, personal logs, parenting forums

9_2040.concept: 日常交流中的陈述与评价
9_2040.description: 最稳定的特征是日常叙述或交流中句首“It”引出后续陈述、评价或结果；另对“学到很多”及感谢、反馈语境中的若干词有响应，也有零散局部激活。

patterns.name: It 后接评价或感受
patterns.context: 句首或句中以“It”指代前文事物、活动或经历，随后接系词、助动词或评价性谓语；多个例子中正激活集中于 It。
patterns.domain: 网页评论、博客、论坛发言、邮件等非正式叙述

patterns.name: 学习获得很多
patterns.trigger: «learnt»7« a»10« lot»；«learned»6« a»9« lot»；«learned»4« a»9« lot»
patterns.context: 表达从人或经历中学到很多，激活落在 a lot 一带；语境常包含感谢、训练或个人介绍。
patterns.domain: 网页叙述、论坛自述、博客

patterns.name: 感谢与正面评价
patterns.context: 感谢他人后评价对方的帮助、分享或内容；常见于回复、致谢或反馈。
patterns.domain: 邮件、论坛交流及用户评论

patterns.name: 其他局部表达
patterns.context: 分别出现在邮箱地址首字母、疲倦与挑战的日记式表达，以及如厕训练经历的时长说明中；缺少可由共同上下文支持的独立规律。
patterns.domain: 网页联系信息、生活记录、育儿论坛

en.description: Activation often falls on the article a, sentence-initial words such as It/I, and the phrases that follow; collocations such as a lot, a little, and a good goal recur, alongside conversational evaluations and sports narratives. Triggers are dispersed, without a fully unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: a in a lot
patterns.context: Often occurs after the indefinite article a, especially in the fixed phrase a lot; the trigger position varies relative to surrounding words.
patterns.domain: Blogs, forums, sports reports, and everyday narratives

patterns.name: It’s as an opening
patterns.context: At the start of a sentence or new sentence, followed by a copula, description, or evaluation; passage 3 also has “Weather is nice”, which may reflect a boundary-segmentation cue.
patterns.domain: Weather, travel writing, sports, and evaluative text

patterns.name: a before high-degree adjectives
patterns.context: The article is followed by an intensifier, noun phrase, or evaluative phrase; related to but not identical with the a lot pattern.
patterns.domain: Sports reports, weather descriptions, and sports interviews

patterns.name: I after a paragraph or sentence boundary
patterns.context: Sentence-initial first-person narration or evaluation, often after a line break, quotation mark, or period.
patterns.domain: Blogs, forums, personal experiences, and evaluative text

patterns.name: Conversational evaluations and emotion words
patterns.context: Positive evaluations, feelings, or descriptions of performance; marked tokens vary, with no single stable trigger word.
patterns.domain: Travel narratives, sports interviews, and personal evaluations

patterns.name: Specific compound phrase “a bit more”
patterns.context: A sports-report context describing reducing pressure on players and helping them grow; only one instance.

9_2040.description: 激活常落在冠词 a、It/I 等句首词及其后续短语；a lot、a little、a good goal 等搭配反复出现，也覆盖口语评价和体育叙述。触发分散，未形成完全统一的语义模式。

patterns.name: a lot 后的 a
patterns.trigger: “a lot”后面的“a”，包括“learnt a lot”“learned a lot”“It was a lot”；也见“a little”“a joy”“a good goal”中的“a”
patterns.context: 多出现在不定冠词 a 后，尤其是 a lot 的固定搭配；触发位置与前后词并不完全一致
patterns.domain: 博客、论坛、体育报道、日常叙述

patterns.name: It’s 起始词
patterns.trigger: “It”或“It’s”，如“«It» was a lot”“It’s hot hot hot”“It really helped”
patterns.context: 句子或新句的开头，后接系词、描述或评价；第3段另有“Weather is nice”，可能是边界切分造成的线索
patterns.domain: 天气、游记、体育、评价性文字

patterns.name: 高程度形容词前的 a
patterns.trigger: “a level of maturity”“a little cold”“a good goal”中的“a”
patterns.context: 冠词后接程度词、名词短语或评价性短语；与 a lot 模式相邻但不完全相同
patterns.domain: 体育报道、天气描述、体育采访

patterns.name: 段落/句界后的 I
patterns.trigger: “I love”“I’m sure”“I learned”“I really enjoyed”“I turned down”中的“I”
patterns.context: 第一人称叙述或评价的句首；常在换行、引号或句号之后
patterns.domain: 博客、论坛、个人经历、评价文字

patterns.name: 口语评价与情绪词
patterns.context: 正面评价、感受或表现描述；所标记的具体 token 分散，未见稳定单一触发词
patterns.domain: 旅行叙述、体育采访、个人评价

patterns.name: 特定复合短语“a bit more”
patterns.context: 描述给队员减压、帮助其成长的体育报道语境；仅此一例

en.concept: Common combinations with It and a
en.description: Activation most consistently falls on the sentence-initial or mid-sentence topic-introducing word “It” and the indefinite article “a,” commonly in “It seems/was/’s/can” and “a lot.” It spans varied contexts such as weather, blogs, forums, design, and sports, and is difficult to reduce to a single theme.

patterns.name: It as a sentence-initial topic introducer
patterns.context: It begins a new sentence or paragraph to introduce a statement, evaluation, or weather description; unmarked It is often followed by a strongly activated predicate or degree expression.
patterns.domain: Blogs, forum posts, narratives, and comments

patterns.name: Fixed combination a lot
patterns.context: a lot expresses quantity or degree; it is sometimes completed by subsequent text, as in “learnt a lot off them” and “learned a lot from them,” and also occurs in “a lot of pressure” in an account of pressure.
patterns.domain: Everyday blogs, forum comments, and news narratives

patterns.name: Indefinite article a and neighboring words
patterns.context: Used as an indefinite article before a noun or noun phrase; the passages show no clear shared semantics, and activation is especially concentrated on a.

patterns.name: It after a Wednesday greeting
patterns.context: An everyday blog starts with a greeting about the date or time of day, then uses It to introduce an evaluation of the day.

patterns.name: It’s in a tropical vacation narrative
patterns.context: Describes hot weather while vacationing in South Florida; hot is repeated after It’s.

patterns.name: It can in an everyday climate description
patterns.context: Describes local weather as potentially turning cold or bringing snow; It refers to the weather.

patterns.name: It seems in forum feedback
patterns.context: In a reply to someone’s post, uses It seems like to evaluate their website or approach.

patterns.name: It’s after learning and becoming familiar
patterns.context: A forum user explains gradually coming to like a community; an adjacent “learned a lot” also occurs.

patterns.name: It was narrative
patterns.context: A sports report recounts a challenge in playing and uses It was to introduce an evaluation of pressure.

patterns.name: It in blog praise
patterns.context: Offers friendly praise of a blog author; the main visible triggers are a in noun phrases such as “a unique, inspiring…” and “a joy.”

patterns.name: a in interior design descriptions
patterns.context: Describes the materials, decoration, and overall atmosphere of a kitchen; a appears in an evaluative adjective-plus-noun phrase.

patterns.name: It’s in a sports experience
patterns.context: An athlete talks about experiences such as training with elite players and returning home, and uses It’s to express gratitude.

patterns.name: Pressure phrase in a football match
patterns.context: A report about football accuracy and challenges; the phrase occurs after It was.

patterns.name: Expressions about experience and learning
patterns.context: Discusses bringing in experienced people to reduce pressure and help players develop; a lot expresses having learned a great deal.

9_2040.concept: It 与 a 的常见搭配
9_2040.description: 激活最稳定地落在句首或句中话题引入词“It”及不定冠词“a”，常见“It seems/was/’s/can”和“a lot”。覆盖天气、博客、论坛、设计与体育等多种语境，难以归结为单一主题。

patterns.name: It 作句首话题引入
patterns.context: 在新句或新段开头，以 It 开始陈述、评价或天气描述；未标记的 It 之后常接强激活的谓语或程度表达。
patterns.domain: 博客、论坛帖子、叙述与评论

patterns.name: a lot 固定搭配
patterns.context: a lot 表示数量或程度；有时被后文补足，如 “learnt a lot off them”“learned a lot from them”，也有出现在压力叙述中的 “a lot of pressure”。
patterns.domain: 日常博客、论坛评论与新闻叙述

patterns.name: 不定冠词 a 及其邻近词
patterns.trigger: “a”，包括 “a bit”“a great idea”“a good day”“a nice charm”“a little”
patterns.context: 在名词或形容词短语前用作不定冠词；各段没有明显统一语义，激活尤其集中在 a。

patterns.name: 周三问候后的 It
patterns.context: 日常博客先作日期或时段问候，再用 It 引出当天评价。

patterns.name: 热带度假叙述中的 It’s
patterns.context: 描写在南佛罗里达度假时的炎热天气，It’s 后重复 hot。

patterns.name: 日常气候描述中的 It can
patterns.context: 介绍当地天气可能变冷或下雪；It 指天气。

patterns.name: 论坛反馈中的 It seems
patterns.context: 在回复他人分享后，以 It seems like 对其网站或做法作评价。

patterns.name: 学习与熟悉后的 It’s
patterns.context: 论坛用户说明自己逐渐喜欢某社区；另有相邻的 “learned a lot”。

patterns.name: It was 叙事
patterns.context: 体育报道回顾一次踢球挑战，以 It was 引出压力评价。

patterns.name: 博客称赞中的 It
patterns.trigger: “I love that the blog is a reflection…” 后为 “You are…”；激活片段仍含突出 “a”
patterns.context: 对博客作者作亲切赞美；主要可见触发是名词短语中的 a，如 “a unique, inspiring…”、“a joy”。

patterns.name: 室内设计描述中的 a
patterns.context: 描述厨房的材质、装饰与整体氛围；a 出现在形容词加名词的评价短语中。

patterns.name: 体育经历中的 It’s
patterns.context: 运动员谈到与精英球员训练、回家等经历，并以 It’s 作感恩评价。

patterns.name: 足球比赛中的压力短语
patterns.context: 关于踢球命中率与挑战的报道；短语位于 It was 之后。

patterns.name: 经验与学习表达
patterns.trigger: “the girls have learnt a lot off them”
patterns.context: 谈引入有经验的人减轻压力并帮助队员成长；a lot 表示学到很多。

en.description: All passages show strong activation on “It”, often followed by a copula or auxiliary to introduce a state, evaluation, event, or weather. There are also scattered activations on common function words such as articles and prepositions, as well as a few uses involving greetings, contrast, and project introductions.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial or in-sentence “It” and its following predicate
patterns.context: At the beginning of a sentence or new topic, “It” introduces a state, evaluation, event, or weather; activation is especially concentrated on “It” and the immediately following copula or auxiliary.
patterns.domain: Everyday narratives, emails, forum posts, and news quotes across domains

patterns.name: Indefinite article before common nouns
patterns.context: “a” is followed by a noun or an intensifier plus an adjective or noun phrase, as in “a challenge”, “a very good tired”, “a little cold”, and “a lot”; appears in different contexts.
patterns.domain: English prose, dialogue, and emails across domains

patterns.name: A few adjacent function words and idiomatic expressions
patterns.context: Scattered occurrences among common prepositions, articles, and coordinate structures, with no stable specific collocation or semantic condition; mostly ordinary syntactic contexts.

patterns.name: Independent sentence-initial contrast word “Fighting”
patterns.context: Begins the sentence and is followed by “drowsiness”, describing an effort to resist sleepiness after drinking coffee; only one instance.

patterns.name: Greeting in an introductory email
patterns.context: A formal email opens with a fixed greeting after the salutation; only one instance.

patterns.name: “It’s” in a founder’s acknowledgment of a project
patterns.context: Introduces a product that is still a minimum viable product and adds project updates; the local activation is adjacent to the dominant “It” pattern, but the lowercase form and context are unusual.

9_2040.description: 所有段落均在“It”处强激活，常接系词或助动词以引出状态、评价、事件或天气；另有分散的冠词、介词等常见功能词激活，以及少数问候、转折和项目介绍用法。

patterns.name: 句首/句中“It”及其后续谓语
patterns.context: 在句子或新话题开头，用“It”引出状态、评价、事件或天气；激活尤其集中在“It”及紧随其后的系词/助动词。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的日常叙述、邮件、论坛文字与新闻引语

patterns.name: 普通名词前的不定冠词
patterns.context: “a”后接名词或程度副词加形容词/名词短语，如“a challenge”“a very good tired”“a little cold”“a lot”；不同上下文中均出现。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英语散文、对话、邮件

patterns.name: 少量相邻功能词及惯用搭配
patterns.context: 分散出现在常见介词、冠词和并列结构中，未见稳定的特定搭配或语义条件；多为普通句法环境。

patterns.name: 独立句首转折词“Fighting”
patterns.context: 句首接“drowsiness”，描述喝咖啡后努力抵抗困意；仅此一例。
patterns.domain: 个人日常状态/社交媒体式文字

patterns.name: 介绍邮件中的问候语
patterns.context: 正式邮件称呼后以固定问候句开场；仅此一例。

patterns.name: 项目创始人致谢中的“It’s”
patterns.context: 介绍产品仍为最小可行产品、补充项目进展；该处局部激活与主导的“It”模式相邻，但小写形式和语境特殊。
patterns.domain: Hacker News 创业/产品介绍

en.description: The most stable cue is a, especially in a+evaluative word or noun phrase; several passages also strongly activate sentence-initial It, followed by a state, evaluation, or explanation. Content spans sports, weather, emails, forums, and everyday narratives, without a unified theme.

patterns.name: Content words after the indefinite article a
patterns.context: In an a + noun or adjective+noun construction, a itself is usually the strongest activation point; not every a triggers, as in [10], where “a look” is only weakly activated.
patterns.domain: Everyday narratives, comments, emails, and forum text across domains

patterns.name: Evaluative or state statements beginning with It
patterns.context: Sentence-initial It is followed by a statement of evaluation, state, weather, or project status; the predicates and complements after It vary considerably, and activation may fall on different subsequent words.
patterns.domain: Social posts, emails, weather small talk, forum announcements

patterns.name: Quantity expression a lot
patterns.context: a is strongly activated when expressing quantity or degree; nearby verbs often include learn, help, flourish, and others, but the specific meaning is not fixed.
patterns.domain: Sports reporting, work evaluations, forum discussions

patterns.name: Event performance and match commentary
patterns.context: In sports-related narratives, evaluates team performance, player maturity, or learning outcomes.

patterns.name: Forum and product-related statements
patterns.context: Discusses the Hacker News community, a product, or a release; the activation position may be it or a, with varying strength.

patterns.name: Expressions of tiredness or everyday states
patterns.context: Uses It to describe a person’s feelings or state that day, often with a positive evaluative word.

patterns.name: Thanks and feedback about knowledge gained
patterns.context: In an email, thanks someone and describes what was gained from a presentation.

patterns.name: Service evaluation and affordability
patterns.context: Evaluates a service someone provides, emphasizing convenience, ease of working together, or affordability; the snippet is truncated and context is incomplete.

patterns.name: Weather and outdoor activities
patterns.context: Discusses local weather, lakes, and activities such as skiing; strong activation mainly falls on a in the weather sentence.

patterns.name: Unclear local a triggers
patterns.context: Strong activation on a occurs in different types of noun phrases; the snippet alone cannot confirm whether it is governed by a specific semantic or syntactic condition.

9_2040.description: 最稳定线索是 a，尤其处于 a+评价词或名词短语时；另有多段句首 It 强激活，后接状态、评价或说明。内容涵盖体育、天气、邮件、论坛与日常叙述，主题并不统一。

patterns.name: 不定冠词 a 后的内容词
patterns.context: 在 a + 名词或形容词+名词结构中，a 本身通常是最强激活点；并非所有 a 都触发，如 [10] 的「a look」仅弱激活。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的日常叙述、评论、邮件和论坛文本

patterns.name: It 开启的评价或状态陈述
patterns.trigger: «It»10，后接「was a good day」「can get a little cold/snowy」「's a very good tired」「gave me knowledge」「's only our MVP」等
patterns.context: 句首 It 后陈述评价、状态、天气或项目情况；It 后的谓语和补语差异较大，激活可能落在不同后续词上。
patterns.domain: 社交帖子、邮件、天气闲谈、论坛发布

patterns.name: a lot 数量表达
patterns.context: 在表达数量或程度时，a 强激活；周围常有 learn、help、flourish 等动词，但具体语义不固定。
patterns.domain: 体育报道、工作评价、论坛讨论

patterns.name: 赛事表现与比赛评论
patterns.trigger: 「got «a»10 good goal」「showed … maturity」「the girls have learnt «a»10 lot」
patterns.context: 体育相关叙述中，对球队表现、球员成熟度或学习成果作评价。

patterns.name: 论坛及产品相关陈述
patterns.trigger: 「it’s quickly become my favourite forum」「it’s only our MVP」「a look」
patterns.context: 讨论 Hacker News 社区、产品或发布情况；激活位置可能是 it 或 a，强度并不一致。

patterns.name: 疲倦或日常状态表达
patterns.trigger: 「It’s a very good tired though」「It was a good day」
patterns.context: 以 It 描述个人当天感受或状态，常带正面评价词。

patterns.name: 感谢与知识反馈
patterns.trigger: 「Thanks for your presentation today. It gave me knowledge」
patterns.context: 邮件中感谢他人，并说明演讲带来的收获。

patterns.name: 服务评价及可负担性
patterns.context: 评价某人提供的服务，突出便利、易合作或价格实惠；片段截断，语境不完整。

patterns.name: 天气与户外活动
patterns.trigger: 「It can get «a»10 little cold/snowy」「lakes … power boating」「kind of skiing」
patterns.context: 谈论当地天气、湖泊及滑雪等活动；强激活主要落在天气句的 a。

patterns.name: 局部不明的 a 触发
patterns.context: a 的强激活可出现在不同类型的名词短语中，无法仅凭片段确认是否受特定语义或句法条件支配。

en.description: Strongly responds mainly to It at the beginning of a new sentence or paragraph, especially It’s, It was, and subsequent experiential, state, or evaluative sentences. There are also weak cues from quantity phrases such as a lot/a little; paragraphs 2, 9, and 10 lack a clear It pattern.

patterns.name: It followed by a contraction or copula
patterns.context: It is followed by 's/was in a sentence, introducing an evaluation, state, or event; this is the most stable shared trigger position.
patterns.domain: Informal narratives, emails, blogs, forum comments

patterns.name: Positive evaluations or experiences after It
patterns.context: It refers to a day, the weather, an experience, content, or an activity, often followed by a positive, comfortable, or exciting description; future tense also occurs.
patterns.domain: Everyday life and experience sharing, content reviews

patterns.name: It was evaluative sentences in emails
patterns.context: After a retelling or expression of thanks, It was is used to evaluate something; the evaluation can be positive or emotionally mixed.

patterns.name: It as an impersonal subject introducing an emotion or judgment
patterns.context: It refers to a situation or the weather, followed by an emotion, state, or judgment rather than an explicit person as subject.

patterns.name: It-initial sentences after paragraph boundaries
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated where a new sentence or paragraph begins with It; this occurs across different meanings, topics, and styles.

patterns.name: Lot or quantity expressions in nearby text (not a primary trigger)
patterns.context: These expressions occur in different contexts, but no consistent It structure is apparent; they may be secondary or incidental co-occurrences.
patterns.domain: Dialogue, forums, weather descriptions, and reviews

9_2040.description: 主要对新句或新段开头的 It 强烈响应，尤其 It’s、It was 及其后的体验、状态或评价句。另有 a lot/a little 等数量短语的弱线索；第2、9、10段缺少明显的 It 模式。

patterns.name: It 后接缩写或系词
patterns.context: 句中 It 后接 's/was，再引出评价、状态或事件；这是最稳定的共同触发位置。
patterns.domain: 非正式叙述、邮件、博客、论坛评论

patterns.name: It 后的积极评价或体验
patterns.context: It 指代一天、天气、经历、内容或活动，后续常为积极、舒适、令人振奋的描述；也包括将来时。
patterns.domain: 日常生活与体验分享、内容评论

patterns.name: 邮件中的 It was 评价句
patterns.context: 转述或感谢之后，用 It was 对某事作评价；评价可正面，也可混合情绪。

patterns.name: It 作非人称主语引出情绪或判断
patterns.context: It 指情境或天气，后接情绪、状态或判断，而非明确的人物主语。
patterns.domain: 论坛/博客动态与活动宣传

patterns.name: 分段边界后的 It 开头
patterns.context: 激活集中在新句或新段以 It 起句的位置；不同语义、主题和文体中均出现。

patterns.name: 相邻文本中的 lot 或数量表达（非主触发）
patterns.context: 这些表达本身在不同语境出现，但未见统一的 It 结构，可能是次要或偶然共现。
patterns.domain: 对话、论坛、天气描述及评论

en.description: Activation often occurs in a+quantity/degree expressions in English narratives (with a lot and a bit as prominent examples), and also in constructions where It is the subject followed by a predicate; some hits are simply words in ordinary phrases and show no clear semantic condition.

patterns.name: a lot combination
patterns.context: Expresses quantity or degree in ordinary narratives; it can modify learn, go up, and other words, and may also occur in evaluations or quotations.
patterns.domain: Forums, personal narratives, sports reporting, and comments

patterns.name: a bit combination
patterns.context: Used to express degree, as in “a bit high” and “a bit”; strong activation mainly falls on a.

patterns.name: a + degree or evaluative word
patterns.context: The indefinite article a appears in common noun phrases, followed by an adjective and noun, or in a quantity expression.
patterns.domain: Everyday narratives, forums, and personal blogs

patterns.name: Sentence-initial It and predicate
patterns.context: Sentence-initial or within a clause, it acts as the subject and is followed by a description of weather, an experience, a workday, or a change; activation often extends to the predicate.

patterns.name: Continuation of common English phrases
patterns.context: Activation falls on a specific token in a common function-word sequence or phrase, without showing a unified local semantic trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Technical forums, blogs, and news comments

9_2040.description: 激活常见于英语叙述中的 a+数量/程度表达（尤以 a lot、a bit 为显著例子），也见于 It 作主语并接谓语的句式；部分命中只是普通短语中的词，未呈现清晰语义条件。

patterns.name: a lot 搭配
patterns.context: 在普通叙述中表示数量或程度；可修饰 learn、go up 等，也可出现在评价或引语中。
patterns.domain: 论坛、个人叙述、体育报道与评论

patterns.name: a bit 搭配
patterns.context: 用于程度表达，如“a bit high”“a bit”；强激活主要落在 a 上。

patterns.name: a + 程度或评价词
patterns.trigger: “a”后接程度、评价或状态词，如“a little”“a good”“a great”“a challenge”
patterns.context: 不定冠词 a 出现在常见名词短语中，后接形容词加名词，或数量表达。
patterns.domain: 日常叙述、论坛与个人博客

patterns.name: 句首 It 与谓语
patterns.trigger: “It”及其后续谓语，如“It can get”“It was”“it’s gotten”
patterns.context: 句首或从句中的 it 作主语，随后描述天气、经历、工作日或变化；激活常延伸至谓语。

patterns.name: 英语常见短语续接
patterns.trigger: 如“things are still changing a lot”“Fighting drowsiness”“a trend we’ve seen”
patterns.context: 激活落在常见功能词或短语中的特定 token，未显示统一的局部语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 技术论坛、博客及新闻评论

en.concept: Indefinite article a and following phrases
en.description: Most strong activations center on the indefinite article a, especially colloquial phrases such as a lot, a bit, a ton, a little, and a good; contexts involve degree, quantity, or evaluation. The trigger is not limited to one topic, and some paragraph positions do not fully fit the pattern.

patterns.name: a lot as a degree expression
patterns.context: a lot directly follows predicates denoting change, impact, or quantity, such as changing, gone up, affected, learned; it often indicates a large degree.

patterns.name: a bit as a degree expression
patterns.context: a bit modifies change or degree, as in changed a bit and getting a bit high.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, news, and product discussions

patterns.name: a + degree/quantity phrase
patterns.context: a is followed by a degree, quantity, or evaluative word, forming a common colloquial noun phrase; not limited to lot/bit.
patterns.domain: Forums, weather small talk, work, and personal narratives

patterns.name: a in other a-phrases
patterns.context: High activation falls on the indefinite article a, followed by a noun phrase; if activation spans subsequent words, the phrase as a whole may also be involved.
patterns.domain: Technical discussions, meeting comments, emotional narratives

9_2040.concept: 不定冠词 a 及其后续短语
9_2040.description: 多数强激活集中于不定冠词 a，尤其是 a lot、a bit、a ton、a little、a good 等口语短语；语境涉及程度、数量或评价。触发并非只限某一主题，个别段落位置与该模式不完全吻合。

patterns.name: a lot 的程度表达
patterns.context: a lot 紧接在表示变化、影响或数量的谓语之后，如 changing、gone up、affected、learned；常表示程度很大
patterns.domain: 论坛对话、访谈、个人叙述

patterns.name: a bit 的程度表达
patterns.context: a bit 修饰变化或程度，如 changed a bit、getting a bit high
patterns.domain: 论坛对话、新闻及产品讨论

patterns.name: a + 程度/数量词短语
patterns.context: a 后接程度、数量或评价性词语，构成常见口语名词短语；不仅限于 lot/bit
patterns.domain: 论坛、天气闲聊、工作和个人叙述

patterns.name: 其他 a-短语中的 a
patterns.context: 高激活落在不定冠词 a 上，后接名词短语；若激活跨越后续词，仍可能涉及短语整体
patterns.domain: 技术讨论、会议评论、情绪叙述

en.description: Primarily responds to “a” or “lot” in the phrase “a lot,” often in everyday and forum narratives expressing degree, quantity, frequency, or learning gains; a few isolated activations on “a” are sporadic and difficult to explain with the main pattern.

patterns.name: a lot idiom
patterns.context: “a” followed by “lot” in the phrase is marked as strongly activated; it appears in sentences expressing degree, quantity, frequency, or gains, and may be followed by an adjective, verb, or other content.
patterns.domain: Everyday narratives, forum discussions, work and personal experiences; paragraphs 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10

patterns.name: a lot in expressions of learning gains
patterns.context: “a lot” means learning a great deal; learning experiences, sources, or specific activities often appear nearby.
patterns.domain: Personal experiences and HackerNews discussions; paragraphs 1, 5, 6, 9

patterns.name: a + intensifier outside a lot
patterns.context: In several paragraphs, “a” is marked on its own, without consistently accompanying “lot”; local contexts include evaluations of a day, statements about change, or the degree of an increase.
patterns.domain: Social-media diaries, technical forums, tourism discussions; paragraphs 2, 3, 7

patterns.name: Frequency expressions in religious contexts
patterns.context: “a lot” indicates that a personal experience occurs frequently; God is explicitly mentioned.

9_2040.description: 主要对短语“a lot”中的“a”或“lot”起反应，常见于表示程度、数量、频率或学习收获的日常与论坛叙述；少数“a”单独激活，零散且难由主模式解释。

patterns.name: a lot 习语
patterns.trigger: “a lot”及其变体：如 “a lot more”“a lot”“a lot doing it”“happening a lot”
patterns.context: 短语中 “a” 后的 “lot” 被标记为强激活；出现在表达程度、数量、频率或收获的句子中，后面可接形容词、动词或其他内容。
patterns.domain: 日常叙述、论坛讨论、工作与个人经历；段 1、2、4、5、6、7、8、9、10

patterns.name: 学习所得表达中的 a lot
patterns.trigger: “learnt a lot”“learned a lot”“learned a lot from them”“learned a lot doing it”
patterns.context: “a lot”表示学到很多；前后常出现学习经历、来源或具体活动。
patterns.domain: 个人经历与 HackerNews 讨论；段 1、5、6、9

patterns.name: 非 a lot 的 a + 强调成分
patterns.trigger: 段 2：“It was a good day”；段 3：“a lot”之外的 “a changing a lot”结构中，强标记为 “a”；段 7：“gone up a lot”
patterns.context: 在若干段中 “a” 单独被标记，未稳定伴随 “lot”；局部上下文分别是对日子的评价、变化陈述或上升幅度。
patterns.domain: 社交媒体日记、技术论坛、旅游业讨论；段 2、3、7

patterns.name: 宗教语境中的频率表达
patterns.context: “a lot”表示某种个人体验频繁发生；明确提及与 God 的关系。

en.description: The main pattern involves a lot combinations in contexts of degree and change; there are also It was narrative frames, a little, some subword fragments at word-internal boundaries, and local runs of high activation.

patterns.name: “a lot” quantity expression
patterns.context: In expressions such as “learned/have learnt/changed/affected/improved … a lot,” describes degree, quantity, or magnitude of change; sometimes the marked token is the adjacent “a” or “lot.”

patterns.name: “It was a …” narrative frame
patterns.context: Uses it to introduce a past event or evaluation; activation falls on the pronoun, copula, and nearby article, and does not always continue with “lot.”

patterns.name: “a little” degree expression
patterns.context: a little modifies an adjective to express a slight degree.
patterns.domain: Weather small talk, colloquial forum text

patterns.name: Suspected split-word fragments
patterns.context: The marked activation falls on subword fragments spanning tokenized spellings: the contexts respectively form “puts the” and “meant”; no stable independent semantic trigger condition is evident.

patterns.name: Other local high activations
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on consecutive words in descriptions of change or everyday evaluative sentences, which cannot be assigned to a stable phrase pattern from the short snippets alone.

9_2040.description: 主模式是 a lot 及其程度、变化语境中的搭配；另有 It was 叙述框架、a little，以及少数词内分词边界和局部连续高激活。

patterns.name: “a lot”数量表达
patterns.context: 在“learned/have learnt/changed/affected/improved … a lot”等表达中，描述程度、数量或变化幅度；有时被标记的是紧邻的“a”或“lot”。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、个人叙述、博客

patterns.name: “It was a …”叙述框架
patterns.trigger: “It”与“was”，及附近的“a”；如 “It»9 was»7 a»8 good”
patterns.context: 以 it 引出过去发生的事或评价，激活落在代词、系动词及附近冠词上；并不总是接“lot”。

patterns.name: “a little”程度表达
patterns.context: a little 修饰形容词，表达轻微程度。

patterns.name: 疑似断词的词内片段
patterns.context: 标记落在跨 token 拼写的词片段中：上下文分别组成 “puts the” 与 “meant”；未见稳定的独立语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 论坛文本、分词边界现象

patterns.name: 其他局部高激活
patterns.trigger: “things»5 are»5 still»5 changing»4”；“It»9 was»7 a»8 good»5 day”
patterns.context: 在无法仅凭短片段归入稳定词组模式的情况下，激活集中于变化描述或日常评价句中的连续词。

en.concept: Local collocations of the indefinite article a
en.description: Strong responses center on the article a in a lot, a ton, and a little; the first two indicate a large degree or quantity, while a little expresses a small degree, so the triggered meanings and collocations are not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: Fixed collocation a lot
patterns.context: The indefinite article a is followed by lot or ton, forming a collocation denoting a large quantity or high degree; common expressions include “changed a lot,” “helps a lot,” and “enjoying life a ton.”
patterns.domain: Colloquial speech, forum discussions, and personal narratives

patterns.name: a little as a degree expression
patterns.context: a little is followed by an adjective, modifying the weather or a state; [7] is “get a little cold,” where little is not part of an a lot collocation.

patterns.name: Fixed collocation a ton
patterns.context: a ton means “a large amount” or “very much,” modifying the extent of help and enjoyment of life, respectively; it is semantically similar to a lot but has different lexical collocations.

9_2040.concept: 不定冠词 a 的局部搭配
9_2040.description: 强响应集中在 a lot、a ton 及 a little 中的冠词 a；前两者表示程度大或数量多，a little 则用于轻微程度，触发词义和搭配并不完全一致。

patterns.name: a lot 固定搭配
patterns.context: 不定冠词 a 后接 lot 或 ton，构成表示大量、程度很高的搭配；常见于“changed a lot”“helps a lot”“enjoying life a ton”等表达。
patterns.domain: 口语、论坛讨论与个人叙述

patterns.name: a little 程度表达
patterns.context: a little 后接形容词，修饰天气或状态；[7] 为“get a little cold”，此处 little 不是 lot 搭配。

patterns.name: a ton 固定搭配
patterns.context: a ton 表示“大量、非常”，分别修饰帮助程度和生活享受；与 a lot 语义相近，但有不同的词汇搭配。
patterns.domain: 非正式网络语言、个人叙述

en.concept: a lot and other quantity/degree expressions
en.description: The most stable trigger is the degree or quantity phrase “a lot,” covering change, learning, impact, quantity, and enjoyment; it also extends to “a bit,” while a few isolated a tokens occur in other indefinite-article phrases.

patterns.name: “a lot” degree phrase
patterns.context: In expressions of quantity, degree, or impact, the neuron primarily activates “a,” sometimes also “lot”; the similar quantity phrase “a bit” also occurs once.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, narratives, reviews, and other styles

patterns.name: Expressions of learning and gains
patterns.context: a lot follows a learning verb, or describes gaining substantial experience from someone or something; overlaps with the quantity-phrase pattern.
patterns.domain: Personal experiences, community discussions, and project narratives

patterns.name: Expressions of degree of change
patterns.context: a lot follows a change or difference verb to indicate degree.

patterns.name: Expressions of price increases
patterns.context: a bit follows a price change to indicate degree; similar to the a lot pattern but with a different word.

patterns.name: Quantity of goals and things
patterns.context: a lot of is followed by a plural noun, indicating a large number of goals or things.

patterns.name: Degree of emotional impact
patterns.context: a lot follows an impact verb to describe the degree to which a person is affected.

patterns.name: “a lot of fun” collocation
patterns.context: a lot modifies fun to express that doing a project was enjoyable.

patterns.name: Isolated activation on “a”
patterns.context: In some paragraphs, a is also marked, but it is not followed by lot or a degree expression and cannot be explained by the main pattern.

9_2040.concept: a lot 等数量/程度表达
9_2040.description: 最稳定的触发是程度或数量短语“a lot”，涵盖变化、学习、影响、数量和趣味；也延伸到“a bit”，少数孤立的 a 出现在其他不定冠词短语中。

patterns.name: “a lot”程度短语
patterns.trigger: “a”后接“lot”，如 “a»10 lot”“a»10 lot»2 off them”“a»9 lot”“a»5 downer”“a»9 bit”
patterns.context: 在数量、程度或影响表达中，神经元主要激活“a”，有时也激活“lot”；相近数量短语“a bit”也出现一次。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、叙述、评论等多种文体

patterns.name: 学习与收获表达
patterns.trigger: “learned a lot”“learnt a lot”“learned a lot doing it”
patterns.context: 学习动词后接 a lot，或描述从某人/某事中获得大量经验；与数量短语模式重叠。
patterns.domain: 个人经历、社群交流与项目叙述

patterns.name: 变化程度表达
patterns.trigger: “changing a lot”“changed a lot”“differs a lot”
patterns.context: 变化或差异动词后用 a lot 表示程度。

patterns.name: 价格上涨表达
patterns.context: 价格变化后接 a bit，表达程度；与 a lot 模式相似但词项不同。

patterns.name: 目标与事物数量
patterns.trigger: “a lot of goals”“a lot of things”
patterns.context: a lot of 后接复数名词，表示大量目标或事物。

patterns.name: 情绪影响程度
patterns.context: 影响动词后接 a lot，说明个人受影响程度。

patterns.name: “a lot of fun”搭配
patterns.context: a lot 修饰 fun，表达做项目很有趣。

patterns.name: 孤立的“a”激活
patterns.trigger: 未标记相邻 lot 的“a”，如“with a regular expression”“a reflection”“a joy”
patterns.context: 在部分段落中 a 也被标记，但后面并非 lot 或程度表达，无法由主模式解释。

en.description: Every paragraph highlights the standalone article “a,” commonly in phrases such as a lot, a bit, and a little; a few internal letter sequences are also marked. Other meanings, such as learning and quantity, occur only in some paragraphs and do not replace the shared article pattern.

patterns.name: Indefinite article a
patterns.context: The string a functions as a standalone indefinite article followed by a noun or adjective phrase; activation sometimes extends to several following words, as in a lot, a bit, and a little.
patterns.domain: Various styles, including sports reporting, forum posts, personal narratives, and technical discussions

patterns.name: Learning or gaining experience
patterns.context: Narratives mention learning, changing, or gaining knowledge or experience; these co-occur with the main article-a trigger but do not necessarily constitute a separate trigger pattern.
patterns.domain: Personal experiences, technical learning, and forum discussions

patterns.name: Quantity and degree phrases
patterns.context: a combines with a quantity or degree word to form a phrase describing degree, quantity, or a slight change.

patterns.name: Non-article string a
patterns.context: a occurs inside a word rather than as a standalone article; these sporadic examples show no stable independent pattern.
patterns.domain: Technical names, spelling, or text noise

patterns.name: Other fragments adjacent to a
patterns.context: The article a is followed by a time expression, quantity, evaluative noun, or adjective phrase; the specific meanings vary, with no shared condition more specific than the article pattern.

9_2040.description: 所有段落都突出独立冠词“a”，常见于 a lot、a bit、a little 等短语；少数内部字母串也被标记。其他学习、数量等语义只在部分段落出现，不能取代冠词这一共同模式。

patterns.name: 不定冠词 a
patterns.context: 字母串 a 作为独立不定冠词，后接名词或形容词短语；激活有时延续到其后若干词，如 a lot、a bit、a little。
patterns.domain: 多种文体，包括体育报道、论坛发帖、个人叙述和技术讨论

patterns.name: 学习或获得经验
patterns.trigger: “learnt a lot”“changed a lot”“learned a lot”“learning a lot”“learned a lot”“tips”“expertise”
patterns.context: 出现学习、改变、获得知识或经验的叙述；与冠词 a 的主触发同时出现，但不一定构成独立触发模式。
patterns.domain: 个人经历、技术学习及论坛讨论

patterns.name: 数量及程度短语
patterns.context: a 与表示数量或程度的词构成短语，描述程度、数量或轻微变化。
patterns.domain: 口语化个人叙述与描述

patterns.name: 非冠词字母串 a
patterns.context: a 出现在单词内部而非独立冠词；这些零星例子未显示稳定的独立模式。
patterns.domain: 技术名称、拼写或文本噪声

patterns.name: 其他与 a 相邻的片段
patterns.trigger: “a while”“a lot of fun”“a downer”“a pretty zen guy”
patterns.context: 冠词 a 后接时间、数量、评价名词或形容词短语；具体语义各异，未见比冠词模式更具体的共同条件。

en.description: Multiple passages activate on “a lot” and contexts of learning, reading, and sharing experience; there are also degree expressions for duration, change, and warm or cold weather. Sporadic activations on pronouns are difficult to explain independently.

patterns.name: “a lot” combination
patterns.context: A quantity or degree expression appears, especially “a” followed by “lot”; activation often falls on “a,” and also occurs on neighboring tokens such as “lot” and “little.”
patterns.domain: Forum posts, Q&A, personal narratives, and everyday discussions

patterns.name: Familiarity and learning experience
patterns.context: Describes gaining experience or knowledge from others, documentation, reading, or practice; often co-occurs with “a lot.”
patterns.domain: Sharing experiences in forums and technical Q&A

patterns.name: Duration and degree of change
patterns.context: Describes duration, rapid change, or a difference from the past, sometimes adjacent to a degree expression.
patterns.domain: Hacker News posts and website descriptions

patterns.name: Weather and temperature
patterns.context: After “get,” describes the weather turning cold, with “a little” expressing degree.

patterns.name: Sporadic pronouns and syntactic fragments
patterns.context: Visible in the activation contexts, but there is insufficient evidence that these pronouns themselves form a consistent, independent trigger pattern.

9_2040.description: 多段在“a lot”及学习、阅读、经验分享语境中激活；另有持续时间、变化和天气冷暖等程度表达。代词等零散激活难以独立解释。

patterns.name: “a lot”搭配
patterns.trigger: “a lot”及其紧邻上下文中的“learned/learnt … a lot”“help … a lot”“affected me a lot”“get a little …”
patterns.context: 出现程度或数量表达，尤其是“a”后接“lot”；激活常落在“a”，也出现在 “lot”“little”等邻近 token。
patterns.domain: 论坛帖子、问答、个人叙述及日常讨论

patterns.name: 熟悉与学习经验
patterns.trigger: “been around training”“learned a lot”“learnt a lot”“read about”“look through their docs”“learning a lot”
patterns.context: 描述从他人、文档、阅读或实践中获得经验或知识；常与“a lot”同现。
patterns.domain: 论坛和技术问答中的经验分享

patterns.name: 时间与变化程度
patterns.trigger: “for a while”“quickly become”“changed a lot since then”“for a long time”
patterns.context: 叙述持续时间、快速变化或相较过去的差异，部分与程度表达相邻。
patterns.domain: Hacker News 帖子与网站介绍

patterns.name: 天气及冷暖程度
patterns.context: “get”后描述天气变冷，并由“a little”表示程度。

patterns.name: 零散代词与句法片段
patterns.trigger: “it”“I”“they”“them”等高频代词及其周围的功能词
patterns.context: 在激活上下文中可见，但没有足够证据表明这些代词本身构成一致、独立的触发模式。

en.concept: a and the a lot collocation
en.description: The most stable local cue is a, especially in learn/learnt a lot and a lot expressions of quantity or degree; there are also scattered activations on pronouns and line breaks that do not form a clear independent pattern.

patterns.name: learned a lot collocation
patterns.context: The first or third person mentions learning a great deal from people, experiences, reading, or doing things; common structures include learn/learnt + a lot + from/of/doing.

patterns.name: a lot describing degree or change
patterns.context: a lot indicates quantity or degree and often collocates with prices, change, enjoyment of life, and similar expressions; “a bit high” also occurs.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, personal narratives, business reporting

patterns.name: Local activation on the article a
patterns.context: Activation falls on the indefinite article a, followed by varying nouns or phrases; some examples are adjacent to “a lot,” but it also occurs in collocations such as “a trend.”

patterns.name: Sporadic activation on function words or punctuation
patterns.context: A small number of activations are scattered across pronouns, auxiliaries, or line breaks, with no stable independent semantic or syntactic condition.

9_2040.concept: a 及 a lot 搭配
9_2040.description: 最稳定的局部线索是 a，尤其是 learn/learnt a lot 与 a lot 表量或程度；另有分散的代词和换行激活，未形成清晰独立模式。

patterns.name: learned a lot 搭配
patterns.context: 第一人称或第三人称提到从人、经历、阅读或做事中学到很多；常见结构为 learn/learnt + a lot + from/of/doing。
patterns.domain: 论坛个人叙述、体育报道

patterns.name: a lot 描述程度或变化
patterns.context: a lot 用于量或程度，常与价格、变化、享受生活等搭配；另有“a bit high”。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、个人叙述、商业报道

patterns.name: 冠词 a 的局部激活
patterns.context: 激活落在不定冠词 a 上，后续名词或短语各异；部分例子与“a lot”相邻，但也出现于“a trend”等非此搭配。

patterns.name: 零散功能词或标点激活
patterns.context: 少量激活分散在代词、助动或换行等位置，未见稳定的独立语义或句法条件。

en.description: The most stable cue is quantity or degree expressions involving a lot/lot/ton across different contexts, often alongside recollections of learning, change, impact, work, and experiences; activation also falls on nearby generic words.

patterns.name: a lot quantity/degree expression
patterns.context: Includes degree or quantity phrases with lot/ton, often meaning learning a great deal, having a large impact, changing a lot, or making good progress in work or activities; marking falls on different words such as a, It, and learned, not only lot itself.
patterns.domain: Forum self-descriptions, technical discussions, sports interviews, everyday blogs

patterns.name: Experience and learning gains
patterns.context: Discusses gaining experience from others, reading, or personal involvement; strong activation appears near “a lot.”

patterns.name: Positive evaluation of a state or situation
patterns.context: Personal recollections or evaluations of recent circumstances or how a day went; activation falls on a or related quantity expressions.

patterns.name: a + lot/length and other quantity structures
patterns.context: a is followed by a quantity or degree expression, covering specific quantities, activity experiences, and informational content; this is not a domain-specific term.
patterns.domain: Sports interviews, technical Q&A, forums, and everyday writing

patterns.name: Local grammatical words or boundary tokens
patterns.context: Activation sometimes falls near generic articles, pronouns, infinitive markers, or line breaks; these local positions alone do not establish an independent semantic trigger condition.

9_2040.description: 最稳定的线索是多种语境中的 a lot/lot/ton 数量或程度表达，常伴随学习、变化、影响、工作和体验的回顾；激活位置也会落在邻近泛用词上。

patterns.name: a lot 的数量/程度表达
patterns.trigger: “a lot”“a lot more”“a lot if”“a lot doing”“a lot reading”“a ton”
patterns.context: 包含 lot/ton 的程度或数量短语，常表示学到很多、影响很大、变化很多、工作或活动进展不错；标记落在 a、It、learned 等不同词上，并非只有 lot 本身触发。
patterns.domain: 论坛自述、技术讨论、体育采访、日常博客

patterns.name: 经验与学习所得
patterns.trigger: “learnt a lot off them”“learned a lot from them”“learned a lot reading”“learned a lot doing it”
patterns.context: 谈论从他人、阅读或亲身参与中获得经验；“a lot”附近出现强激活。
patterns.domain: 论坛自述、博客、体育相关文字

patterns.name: 状态或事情的正面评价
patterns.context: 个人回顾或评价近期状态、一天过得如何；激活落在 a 或相关数量表达上。

patterns.name: a + lot/length 等数量结构
patterns.trigger: “a lot of length”“a lot of caffeine”“a lot of fun”“a lot of docs/stuff”
patterns.context: a 后接数量或程度表达，涵盖具体数量、活动体验及资料内容；不是固定领域词。
patterns.domain: 体育采访、技术问答、论坛与日常文字

patterns.name: 局部语法词或边界 token
patterns.context: 激活有时落在泛用冠词、代词、不定式标记或换行附近；无法仅凭这些局部位置确定独立语义触发条件。

en.description: Every paragraph shows activation near lot, a lot, or related degree expressions, commonly in contexts such as “learning a lot,” “liking/enjoying something a lot,” “being greatly affected,” or “many changes or a large quantity”; specific collocations and meanings vary.

patterns.name: a lot degree expression
patterns.context: Activation centers around lot; a often precedes it, though an adjective or adverb may intervene, and it is followed by content about learning, impact, liking, change, and similar topics.
patterns.domain: Informal texts such as forum discussions, personal narratives, and sports commentary

patterns.name: Learning and benefit
patterns.context: lot indicates gaining substantial knowledge or help from people, experiences, reading, or materials.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, technical Q&A, and personal narratives

patterns.name: Degree of feelings or impact
patterns.context: Expresses strong liking, enjoyment, or negative impact; in some examples a precedes lot, while ton and other similar degree expressions also occur.

patterns.name: Large quantity, length, or amount of change
patterns.context: lot modifies quantity, degree, or change, not necessarily involving learning or emotions.
patterns.domain: Creative experiences, sports commentary, software development discussions

patterns.name: Ordinary lot usage or unclear structure
patterns.context: Similar to the dominant degree-expression pattern, but the specific meaning or segmentation is unclear; paragraph 1’s “a lot off them” may be a nonstandard spelling or tokenization.

9_2040.description: 所有段都在 lot、a lot 或相关程度表达附近激活，常见于“学到很多”“很喜欢/受影响”“很多变化或数量”等语境；具体搭配和语义多样。

patterns.name: a lot 程度表达
patterns.trigger: “a lot”“a … lot”，包括“a lot off them”“a lot doing it”“a lot more”
patterns.context: 激活集中在 lot 附近；前面常有 a，也可能被形容词或副词隔开，后面接学习、影响、喜欢、变化等内容。
patterns.domain: 论坛对话、个人叙述、体育评论等非正式文本

patterns.name: 学习与获益
patterns.trigger: “learnt a lot”“learned a lot”“help you a lot”
patterns.context: lot 表示从他人、经历、阅读或资料中获得很多知识或帮助。
patterns.domain: 论坛交流、技术问答与个人叙述

patterns.name: 感受或影响的程度
patterns.trigger: “enjoying life a ton”“liked him a lot”“affected me a lot”“a downer”
patterns.context: 表达强烈的喜爱、享受或负面影响；部分例子中 lot 前有 a，另有 ton 等近义程度表达。

patterns.name: 数量、长度或变化很多
patterns.trigger: “a lot of fun”“a lot of length”“changing a lot”
patterns.context: lot 修饰数量、程度或变化，未必涉及学习或情感。
patterns.domain: 制作经历、体育评论、软件开发讨论

patterns.name: 普通 lot 用法或结构不清
patterns.context: 与主导的程度表达相近，但具体语义或断句不够明确；第1段的“a lot off them”可能是非标准拼写或分词。

en.description: Every passage contains an “a lot” construction expressing high quantity or degree, across contexts of learning, enjoyment, liking, impact, help, and change; the third passage uses the near-synonym “a ton.”

patterns.name: “a lot” quantity/degree phrase
patterns.context: “a” typically precedes “lot,” expressing a large quantity or high degree; it can describe learning, liking, help, impact, change, and other things. Activation mainly falls on “a,” but neighboring words are also activated.
patterns.domain: Forum conversations, personal narratives, and general expository writing

9_2040.description: 各段都出现表示高数量或高程度的“a lot”结构，覆盖学习、享受、喜欢、影响、帮助和变化；第3段以近义表达“a ton”出现。

patterns.name: “a lot”数量/程度短语
patterns.trigger: «a»后接“lot”，如“a lot”“learnt a lot”“learned a lot”“liked him a lot”“help you a lot”；另有近义表达“a ton”
patterns.context: “a”通常位于“lot”前，表示数量多或程度高；可描述学习、喜欢、帮助、影响、变化等。激活主要落在“a”上，也有相邻词激活。
patterns.domain: 论坛对话、个人叙述及一般说明文

en.description: All paragraphs contain the quantity or degree expression “a lot,” and nearby words are often activated; it can mean learning a great deal, providing substantial help, liking something very much, or strengthening thanks. Some passages also feature first-person personal narratives.

patterns.name: a lot phrase
patterns.context: When expressing quantity or degree, it often occurs in structures such as “learned/enjoyed/help/help … a lot”; in some examples, annotation boundaries or a few modifiers intervene
patterns.domain: Forum posts, technical Q&A, and general online text

patterns.name: Personal feelings and state statements
patterns.context: First-person narratives describe personal states, preferences, or feelings; these co-occur with the core high-frequency phrase but are not necessarily independent triggers

patterns.name: Expressions of learning or gains
patterns.context: Learning, reading, or experiences yield substantial gains; “a lot” follows a learning verb

patterns.name: Thank-you formula
patterns.context: a lot intensifies an expression of thanks, appearing at the end of a Q&A post

patterns.name: Degree of help or usefulness
patterns.context: a lot modifies help, usefulness, or degree

patterns.name: Expression of degree of liking
patterns.context: a lot modifies the degree of affection for someone; the same paragraph also contains personal emotional expressions

9_2040.description: 所有段都出现“a lot”这一数量或程度表达，且其附近词常被激活；它可表示学到很多、帮助很大、喜爱很多或用于感谢。部分片段还呈现第一人称个人叙述。

patterns.name: a lot 词组
patterns.context: 在表达数量或程度时，常出现在 “learned/enjoyed/help/help … a lot” 等结构中；个别例子中间有标注边界或少量修饰
patterns.domain: 论坛发帖、技术问答及一般网络文字

patterns.name: 个人感受与状态陈述
patterns.trigger: “I”及其后续第一人称谓语或情绪词，如 “I’m generally a pretty zen guy”[1]、“I really enjoy”[2]、“I’m usually a positive one”[10]
patterns.context: 第一人称叙述个人状态、偏好或感受；与核心高频词组并存，但不一定是独立触发因素
patterns.domain: 非正式个人叙述、论坛交流

patterns.name: 学习或收获表达
patterns.trigger: “learned a lot”[2][4][8]、“learnt a lot”[3]、“learning a lot”[6]
patterns.context: 学习、阅读或经历带来较多收获；“a lot”承接学习动词

patterns.name: 感谢套语
patterns.context: 以 a lot 加强感谢语气，出现在问答帖结尾

patterns.name: 帮助或效用程度
patterns.context: a lot 修饰帮助、效用或程度
patterns.domain: 推荐/说明文字、技术问答

patterns.name: 喜爱程度表达
patterns.context: a lot 修饰对人的喜爱；同段另有个人情绪表达

en.description: All passages prominently activate a; the most salient and recurring pattern across contexts is a lot (including expressions of learning, help, and impact), with a few instances of a bit, a few, a couple, and ordinary article usage. Learning experiences are a common collocation, not a distinct unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Activation of a in “a lot”
patterns.context: No fixed subject or sentence structure is required; a is especially prominent when followed by lot in phrases expressing degree, quantity, or learning outcomes.
patterns.domain: Forum posts, personal narratives, comments, and web text

patterns.name: A few other uses of the article a
patterns.context: a does not precede lot but still occurs in an ordinary English indefinite article phrase; activation strength and consistency are lower.
patterns.domain: Colloquial narratives and general web text

patterns.name: Expressions about learning experiences and outcomes
patterns.context: Describes the speaker or another person learning a lot from an experience, reading, or project; co-occurs with a lot, with no evidence that the other words consistently trigger activation themselves.
patterns.domain: HackerNews posts and personal experience narratives

patterns.name: a lot with positive or negative degree evaluations
patterns.context: a lot/ton intensifies the degree of impact, help, or enjoyment; this is adjacent to, but semantically different from, the use about learning outcomes.
