patterns.domain: Personal evaluations, experience narratives, and recommendation text

patterns.name: a in quantifier phrases
patterns.context: a combines with a quantifier rather than “a lot”; these are sporadic instances.

9_2040.description: 所有段都突出激活 a；最显著且跨语境重复的是 a lot（含学习、帮助、影响等表达），另有少数 a bit、a few、a couple 及普通冠词用法。学习经历是常见搭配而非独立的统一语义触发。

patterns.name: “a lot”中 a 的激活
patterns.trigger: «a»，常见于“a lot”，也出现于“a bit”“a few”
patterns.context: 不要求固定主语或句式；在表达程度、数量或学习收获的短语中，a 后接 lot 时尤其突出。
patterns.domain: 论坛帖子、个人叙述、评论及网页文本

patterns.name: 少数其他冠词 a 的用法
patterns.trigger: «a»，如“a positive one”“a pretty zen guy”“a downer”“a couple of months”
patterns.context: a 不接 lot，但仍处于普通英语不定冠词短语中；激活强度和一致性较低。
patterns.domain: 口语化叙述与一般网页文本

patterns.name: 学习经历与收获表达
patterns.trigger: “learned a lot”“learnt a lot”“learning a lot”
patterns.context: 描述说话者或他人从经历、阅读或项目中学到很多；与 a lot 同现，未见其余词本身稳定触发。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 帖子及个人经历叙述

patterns.name: 带有积极或消极程度评价的 a lot
patterns.trigger: “affected me a lot”“helps a lot”“enjoying life a ton”
patterns.context: a lot/ton 用来强化影响、帮助或享受程度；与学习收获用法相邻但语义并不相同。
patterns.domain: 个人评价、经历叙述和推荐文本

patterns.name: 量词短语中的 a
patterns.context: a 与数量词搭配，而非“a lot”；属于零星用例。
patterns.domain: 一般口语及说明性文本

en.concept: Rare subwords and symbols in specialized texts
en.description: Activations are scattered across numbers and punctuation, abbreviations and capitalized proper nouns, segmented technical terms, and mathematical symbols. They span legal, medical, technical Q&A, mathematical, and multilingual academic texts, with no single stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: Numbers, identifiers, or numeric strings
patterns.context: Numbers or numeric fragments appear in legal citations, mathematical expressions, years, or item numbers; activations often fall on the numbers and adjacent punctuation.
patterns.domain: Legal texts, math problems, encyclopedia biographies

patterns.name: Medical terms and paper title fragments
patterns.context: Technical vocabulary in medical paper titles or abstracts, especially terms segmented into multiple subwords.

patterns.name: Abbreviations and uppercase letter strings
patterns.context: Uppercase letters or abbreviations appear in organization names, technical names, or specialized texts.
patterns.domain: NIH project abstracts, math or technical Q&A

patterns.name: Technical product names and construction operations
patterns.context: A questioner discusses constructing a Bitmap from scratch and drawing content, or mentions DirectX.

patterns.name: Names, proper nouns, and tokenization boundaries
patterns.context: Names or place names are split into subwords; may also be associated with uppercase letters and proper-noun forms.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols, variables, and terms for differential forms
patterns.context: Instructions for differentiation, variables, and formulas in math problems, or terms from differential geometry in papers.

patterns.name: French word forms and clustering terms
patterns.context: Word forms split by the tokenizer in French academic texts, involving cluster analysis and similar individuals.

patterns.name: Rare English words and morphological fragments
patterns.context: Long or technical English words are split into subwords; paragraph types vary, with no consistent semantic condition.

9_2056.concept: 专业文本中的稀有子词与符号
9_2056.description: 激活分散于数字与标点、缩写和大小写专名、被切分的专业词及数学符号；涵盖法律、医学、技术问答、数学和多语种学术文本，未见单一稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: 数字、编号或数值串
patterns.context: 数字或数值片段出现在法律引文、数学表达式、年份或条目编号中；激活常落在数字及其邻近标点上。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、数学题、百科人物条目

patterns.name: 医学术语与论文标题片段
patterns.context: 医学论文标题或摘要中的专业词汇，尤其是被切分成多个子词的术语。

patterns.name: 缩写及大写字母串
patterns.context: 大写字母或缩写出现在组织名称、技术名或专业文本中。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要、数学或技术问答

patterns.name: 技术产品名与构造操作
patterns.context: 提问者讨论从头构造 Bitmap 并绘制内容，或提及 DirectX。

patterns.name: 姓名、专名及分词边界
patterns.context: 姓名或地名被拆成子词；也可能与大写字母及专名形式相关。
patterns.domain: 百科人物条目、医学标题

patterns.name: 数学符号、变量与微分形式术语
patterns.context: 数学问题中的求导指令、变量和公式，或论文中的微分几何术语。

patterns.name: 法语词形与聚类术语
patterns.context: 法语学术文本中被分词器拆开的词形，涉及聚类分析和相似个体。

patterns.name: 罕见英文词及形态片段
patterns.context: 较长或专业英文词被拆分成子词；段落类型不一，未见一致语义条件。

en.concept: Rare words and symbol fragments across domains
en.description: Activations are scattered across subword fragments in legal citations, medical terminology, mathematical symbols and numbers, proper names, programming terms, and French academic vocabulary; the triggering conditions vary across these segments.

patterns.name: Legal citation numbers and abbreviations
patterns.context: Citation content in legal passages, such as volume numbers, court abbreviations, page numbers, and years

patterns.name: Term fragments in biomedical titles
patterns.context: In medical or bioengineering titles, specialized terms, compounds, and rare words are split into multiple tokens; no specific syntax is required

patterns.name: Numbers and differentiation terms in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Numbers, variables, and differentiation-related words in formulas or derivative problems

patterns.name: Spanish athletes’ names and nationality words
patterns.context: Names split into fragments in biographical profiles, and contexts describing someone as being from Spain

patterns.name: APIs and object names in graphics programming
patterns.context: Questions about creating a bitmap and drawing on it, involving graphics-programming terminology

patterns.name: Government project abbreviations
patterns.context: Project or institution names appearing as uppercase abbreviations, followed by descriptions of online support

patterns.name: Differential forms and geometric terms
patterns.context: Mathematical symbols, terms, and numerals are highlighted in discussions of volume-preserving maps, differential forms, and symplectic geometry

patterns.name: Subword fragments in French machine-learning terminology
patterns.context: In French academic sentences, within-word fragments of machine-learning terms and common words are highlighted; the semantics center on unsupervised clustering

9_2056.concept: 多领域罕见词与符号片段
9_2056.description: 激活分散在法律引注、医学术语、数学符号与数字、专名、编程词和法语学术词的子词片段；各段触发条件并不一致。

patterns.name: 法律引注数字与缩写
patterns.context: 法律文段中的卷号、法院缩写、页码和年份等引注内容

patterns.name: 生物医学标题中的术语片段
patterns.context: 医学或生物工程标题中，专业词、复合词及罕见词被拆成多个 token；不要求特定句法

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的数字与微分术语
patterns.context: 公式或求导题中出现的数字、变量和微分相关词

patterns.name: 西班牙运动员姓名与国籍词
patterns.context: 人物简介中姓名被拆分，以及介绍其来自西班牙的语境

patterns.name: 图形编程中的 API 与对象名
patterns.context: 提问如何创建位图并绘制到其上，涉及图形编程术语

patterns.name: 政府项目缩写
patterns.context: 项目或机构名称以大写字母缩写出现，后接其在线支持描述

patterns.name: 微分形式与几何术语
patterns.context: 讨论保体积映射、微分形式及辛几何时，数学符号、术语和数词被突出

patterns.name: 法语机器学习术语的子词片段
patterns.context: 法语学术句子中，机器学习术语及常见词的词内片段被突出；语义集中于非监督聚类

en.description: Activations appear most consistently in terms and their split fragments in medical and research titles, and also in number strings, mathematical expressions, French machine-learning descriptions, and word-initial fragments in news headlines. Trigger forms vary considerably, with no single semantic feature explaining all instances.

patterns.name: Local tokens in numbers or numeric strings
patterns.context: Numbers appear near legal citations, math problems, or article titles; activation is not limited to one numeric format.
patterns.domain: Legal texts, math problems, academic literature

patterns.name: Word-initial or internal fragments in English medical titles
patterns.context: Activations fall on consecutive word fragments in medical titles, including terms related to diseases, incidence, or clinical manifestations.

patterns.name: Split specialized or rare terms
patterns.context: Terms are split by the tokenizer, or are specialized abbreviations and rare medical words; some activations fall on fragments of common words.

patterns.name: Algorithm terms and internal word fragments in French clustering descriptions
patterns.context: French sentences discuss unsupervised clustering and grouping similar individuals; activations are distributed across cross-lingual word forms and split fragments.

patterns.name: “Leaked” in a headline
patterns.context: A news headline begins with a word describing leaked content, followed by themes of a North Korean documentary and propaganda.

patterns.name: Function words and punctuation in medical or research titles
patterns.context: Adjacent to medical, research, or technical titles, but the triggering tokens themselves range across common function words, hyphens, punctuation, and numbers, making them difficult to classify under a single semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Tokens adjacent to operations or variables in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Formulas alternate with written instructions in math problems; activations occur on variables, operators, and tokens around expressions.

9_2056.concept: 专业文本中的显著片段
9_2056.description: 激活最稳定地出现在医学与研究标题的术语及其拆分片段中，也出现在数字串、数学表达式、法语机器学习描述和新闻标题词首；各处触发形式差异较大，未见单一语义特征能解释全部实例。

patterns.name: 数字或数值串中的局部 token
patterns.context: 数字出现在法律引文、数学题或文献题名附近；触发并不只限于一种数字格式。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、数学题、学术文献

patterns.name: 英文医学标题中的词首或词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在医学题名中连续的词片段上，包括疾病、发病率或临床表现相关词语。

patterns.name: 拆分的专业或罕见术语
patterns.context: 术语被 tokenizer 拆分，或是专业缩写与罕见医学词；有些激活落在普通词片段上。
patterns.domain: 生物医学与 NIH 项目摘要

patterns.name: 法语聚类描述中的算法词及词内片段
patterns.context: 法语句子讨论无监督聚类及相似个体分组，激活分布在跨语言词形和拆分片段上。
patterns.domain: 法语学术文本／机器学习

patterns.name: 标题中的 Leaked
patterns.context: 新闻标题开头为描述泄露内容的词，后接朝鲜纪录片及宣传主题。

patterns.name: 医学或研究标题中的功能词与标点
patterns.context: 与医学、研究或技术标题相邻，但触发词本身横跨普通功能词、连字符、标点和数字，难以归为同一种语义触发。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的运算或变量邻接 token
patterns.context: 数学题的公式与文字指令交替出现；激活分布在变量、运算符及表达式周围。

en.description: Activations occur on local tokens in medical titles and terminology, legal citations, institutional abbreviations, names in emails, news headlines, research positions, and Spanish accented spellings; there is no unified semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Title-initial Inc in medical titles
patterns.context: Incidence of appears at the beginning of a sentence or title, followed by a disease, exposure, or epidemiological subject.

patterns.name: Internal subword fragments in medical terms
patterns.context: Medical terms or disease names are split into multiple tokens; high activations fall on internal fragments, especially spelling fragments such as bowel and Colchis.

patterns.name: Numbers and punctuation in legal citations
patterns.context: Combinations of numbers, letter abbreviations, and periods in statutory or case-style citations.

patterns.name: Segmented letters in project-name abbreviations
patterns.context: The abbreviation or proper name DCCPS is followed by explanatory text such as supports.

patterns.name: Name fragments and email salutations
patterns.context: A name or salutation at the beginning of an email, followed by a dash and the body text.

patterns.name: Leak-related word in headlines
patterns.context: Leaked at the beginning of a headline, followed by a description of an event or material.

patterns.name: doctoral in position titles
patterns.context: Position titles such as postdoctoral positions in descriptions of research grants or training programs.

patterns.name: Spanish accented spelling
patterns.context: Accented letters and tokenized spellings in Spanish proper nouns or phrases.

9_2056.description: 激活分散在医学标题与术语、法律引文、机构缩写、邮件人名、新闻标题、科研职位及西班牙语重音拼写的局部 token 上；没有统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 医学标题中的词首 Inc
patterns.context: 句首或标题开头出现 Incidence of，后接疾病、暴露或流行病学对象

patterns.name: 医学术语的内部子词片段
patterns.context: 医学术语或疾病名称被切分成多个 token；高激活落在术语内部片段，尤其是 bowel、Colchis 一类拼写片段

patterns.name: 法律引文中的编号与标点
patterns.context: 法规或判例式引文中的数字、字母缩写和句点组合

patterns.name: 项目名缩写中的分段字母
patterns.context: 缩写或专名 DCCPS 后接 supports 等说明性文字

patterns.name: 人名片段及邮件称呼
patterns.context: 邮件开头的人名或称呼后接破折号及正文

patterns.name: 标题中的泄露相关词
patterns.context: 标题句首的 Leaked，后接事件或材料说明

patterns.name: 职位名称中的 doctoral
patterns.context: 科研经费或培训计划描述中，postdoctoral positions 一类职位名称

patterns.name: 西班牙语重音拼写
patterns.context: 西班牙语专名或短语中的带重音字母与分词拼写

en.concept: Local word forms and formatting fragments in diverse texts
en.description: Activations are scattered across fixed sentence-initial phrases, words in medical titles, token fragments within proper names, and legal citation and bibliographic formats; no single semantic theme covers all segments.

patterns.name: The “el” fragment within a proper name or term
patterns.context: Activations fall within names or words split by tokenization, often on a final fragment; examples include personal names, medical terms, or proper nouns, with no common semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Multilingual encyclopedias, medical abstracts, news headlines

patterns.name: “Incidence” openings and epidemiological titles
patterns.context: The sentence begins with “Incidence of,” introducing a disease- or exposure-related research subject, followed by a disease, population, or exposure factor.

patterns.name: “Based on” openings
patterns.context: The opening phrase “Based on” is followed by a basis or condition; one example concerns transaction flows, another goal completion.

patterns.name: Dates and legal citation numbers
patterns.context: Activations occur on numbers, abbreviations, and years in legal statute or case citation formats.

patterns.name: Spanish word forms and accented characters
patterns.context: Words with accented characters in Spanish text, followed by a line break and “«El»…«á»…”; activations concentrate on tokenized fragments.

patterns.name: Award titles and personal names
patterns.context: A headline-style phrase includes a title identifying a Nobel Peace Prize laureate, followed by a person’s name.

patterns.name: Medical disease terms and recurrence
patterns.context: The disease name “Dysbiosis” appears with “Functional Bowel Disorders”; the disease category is repeated later.
patterns.domain: Medical abstract titles and body text

patterns.name: Journal names and publication-year formats
patterns.context: A journal name is followed by a year in parentheses and page-like information.

9_2056.concept: 多样文本中的局部词形与格式片段
9_2056.description: 激活分散于句首固定短语、医学标题词语、专名内部的分词片段，以及法律引文和书目格式；没有单一语义主题可覆盖全部段落。

patterns.name: 专名或术语内部的「el」片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被分词切开的名称或词语内部，常处于词尾片段；对应人名、医学术语或专名，未见统一语义条件。
patterns.domain: 多语种百科、医学摘要、新闻标题

patterns.name: Incidence 开头及流行病学标题
patterns.context: 句首以“Incidence of”引出疾病或暴露相关研究对象，后接疾病、人群或暴露因素。

patterns.name: Based on 开头
patterns.context: 句首短语“Based on”，后接依据或条件；一个是交易流，一个是目标完成情况。
patterns.domain: 商业邮件、机构计划文本

patterns.name: 日期及法律引文编号
patterns.context: 激活出现在法条或判例引文的数字、缩写和年份组成的引用格式中。

patterns.name: 西班牙语词形及重音字符
patterns.context: 西班牙语文本中含重音字符的词语，后接换行及“«El»…«á»…”；激活集中于分词片段。

patterns.name: 奖项称号与人物名称
patterns.context: 标题式短语中出现诺贝尔和平奖获奖者称号，随后接人物姓名。

patterns.name: 医学疾病术语及复现
patterns.context: 疾病名称“Dysbiosis”与“Functional Bowel Disorders”同现；后续重复该疾病类别。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要标题及摘要正文

patterns.name: 期刊名称与出版年份格式
patterns.context: 期刊名后接括号中的年份及页码样式信息。

en.description: Activations occur in driver code, technical documentation and Q&A, as well as biomedical texts and place names. There is no stable cross-passage lexical or grammatical trigger pattern; the feature appears to respond broadly to specialized terminology, identifiers, and their segmented subword fragments.

patterns.name: Physical device driver code
patterns.context: C code creates or configures a device object, checks a pointer, and registers a driver; there are also driver probe functions and header inclusions.

patterns.name: Specialized terminology in biomedical papers
patterns.context: Molecules, physiological processes, or disease names in medical or biological abstracts.

patterns.name: Token fragments in proper nouns
patterns.context: The French place name Col de Pelouse is split into multiple word fragments; no clear semantic association is apparent.

patterns.name: Technical documentation terms and identifiers
patterns.context: Documentation sentences explaining namespaces and schema definitions and types.

patterns.name: Neural regeneration research terminology
patterns.context: Research background describing axonal regeneration in the central nervous system after injury.

patterns.name: Nginx configuration terminology
patterns.context: A tutorial explains how Nginx matches virtual hosts based on listen and server_name.

patterns.name: Pixels and tiles in graphics programming
patterns.context: The fractional part of tile coordinates is used to select a pixel region within a tile.

9_2056.concept: 专业术语与标识符片段
9_2056.description: 激活分布于驱动代码、技术文档与问答，以及生物医学文本和地名；没有跨段稳定的词义或语法触发模式，较像对专业术语、标识符及其细分词片段的广泛响应。

patterns.name: 物理设备驱动代码
patterns.context: C 代码中创建或配置设备对象，检查指针并注册驱动；另有驱动 probe 函数和头文件包含

patterns.name: 生物医学论文中的专业术语
patterns.context: 医学或生物学摘要中的分子、生理过程或疾病名称

patterns.name: 专名中的分词片段
patterns.context: 法国地名 Col de Pelouse 被拆成多个词片段；未见明确语义关联

patterns.name: 技术文档术语与标识符
patterns.context: 解释命名空间及 schema 定义、类型的文档句子

patterns.name: 神经再生研究用语
patterns.trigger: «central» nervous« system» axons« can» reg«row» following« lesion»
patterns.context: 描述损伤后中枢神经系统轴突再生的研究背景

patterns.name: Nginx 配置术语
patterns.context: 教程说明 Nginx 如何根据 listen 和 server_name 匹配虚拟主机

patterns.name: 图形编程中的像素与瓦片
patterns.context: 用瓦片坐标小数部分选择瓦片内的像素区域

en.description: All passages show strong activation on generate. The word is used for causing physical results, forming problems or data, and building models, inducing cells, or developing production methods. Objects and domains vary, but the lexical item is consistent.

patterns.name: Producing or forming
patterns.context: The verb generate appears in contexts expressing causation, production, construction, induction, or output; objects include problem, heat, knockout mouse, force, sheet, memory T cells, stable receptors, method, light, and knock-in mice.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; biomedical research plans, patent backgrounds, academic abstracts, and technical documentation

patterns.name: Experimental construction in academic research
patterns.context: generate is followed by experimental models, stable cell/receptor constructs, or genetically modified animals, describing planned or completed experimental procedures.

patterns.name: Induction/preparation of biomedical products or cells
patterns.context: Describes inducing a specific cell phenotype or developing cell culture methods for producing biological products.
patterns.domain: Immunology research plans, cell and bioproduct manufacturing

patterns.name: Producing physical quantities, force, or light
patterns.context: A physical process or device produces heat, force, light, or other results, commonly in causal or engineering descriptions.
patterns.domain: Semiconductor device patents, molecular motion research

patterns.name: Producing abstract results or data
patterns.context: The object of generate is an abstract problem category or an organized data table, rather than an experimental entity or physical quantity.
patterns.domain: Health systems academic texts, molecular biology data organization

9_2056.description: 所有片段都在 generate 处强激活。该词用于造成物理结果、形成问题或数据，也用于构建模型、诱导细胞及开发生产方法；宾语和领域多样，但词项一致。

patterns.name: 产生或形成
patterns.context: 动词 generate 出现在表示因果、制作、构建、诱导或产出的语境中；宾语包括 problem、heat、knockout mouse、force、sheet、memory T cells、stable receptors、method、light、knock-in mice 等。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；生物医学研究计划、专利背景、学术摘要及技术文档

patterns.name: 学术研究中的实验构建
patterns.trigger: «generate»10 a« knockout»1 mouse model；«generate»10 stable« D»12L；«generate»10« knock»-«in mice
patterns.context: generate 后接实验模型、稳定细胞/受体构建体或基因改造动物，描述研究者计划或已进行的实验操作。
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学研究计划

patterns.name: 生物医学产物或细胞的诱导/制备
patterns.trigger: «generate»10 memory« T»2 cells；«generate»10 an« efficient»1«,»2« suspension»2« cell»-«based»4 method
patterns.context: 描述诱导特定细胞表型，或开发用于生产生物制品的细胞培养方法。
patterns.domain: 免疫学研究计划、细胞与生物制品制造

patterns.name: 产生物理量、力或光
patterns.trigger: «generate»10« larger»1 amounts« of»6 heat；«generate»10 force；«generate»10« the»4 light
patterns.context: 某物理过程或器件导致热、力、光等结果，常见因果或工程描述。
patterns.domain: 半导体器件专利、分子运动研究

patterns.name: 产生抽象结果或数据
patterns.context: generate 的宾语是抽象问题类别或整理出的数据表，而非实验实体或物理量。
patterns.domain: 健康系统学术文本、分子生物学数据整理

en.description: The most prominent repeated triggers are fragments of all, vaginal, and the proper name Netco; there are also newline tokens and several sporadic word fragments. Triggers span Q&A, medical, biological, email, and web texts, with no unified semantic explanation yet.

patterns.name: all
patterns.context: In phrases such as “all option(s)” or “all over the world”; the word itself is marked, and surrounding words may also activate.

patterns.name: all as a quantifier
patterns.context: Appears in “all countries,” followed by a plural noun, emphasizing scope.

patterns.name: vaginal
patterns.context: Modifies “delivery” in a medical context or appears in the species name “Trichomonas vaginalis.”

patterns.name: Netco
patterns.context: At the beginning of the proper name Netco in a business email; the following “co” is also marked.

patterns.name: Opening formatting marker
patterns.context: A newline token is marked at the beginning of a passage or in consecutive blank lines; when it does not appear elsewhere, it is unclear whether this is an independent trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Sporadic highlighted words
patterns.context: These words or word fragments are marked in their respective contexts, but share no obvious meaning or local syntactic condition.

9_2056.description: 最明显的重复触发是 all、vaginal 和商业专名 Netco 的词片段；此外有换行及若干零散词片段激活。触发分散于问答、医学、生物学、邮件和网页文本，尚无统一语义解释。

patterns.name: all
patterns.context: 在短语“all option(s)”或“all over the world”中；该词自身被标记，周围词也可能激活。

patterns.name: all 作为数量限定词
patterns.context: 出现在“all countries”中，后接复数名词，强调覆盖范围。

patterns.name: vaginal
patterns.context: 在医学语境中修饰“delivery”或构成物种名“Trichomonas vaginalis”。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、Wikipedia 生物学条目

patterns.name: Netco
patterns.context: 作为专名 Netco 的开头，出现在商业邮件中；后续“co”也被标记。

patterns.name: 开头的格式标记
patterns.context: 段首或连续空行处的换行 token 被标记，未见于其他位置时不确定是否为独立触发模式。

patterns.name: 零散高亮词
patterns.context: 这些词或词片段在各自语境中被标记，但彼此没有明显共同词义或局部句法条件。

en.description: The most stable pattern is recommending or explaining how to avoid risks and adverse outcomes, often triggered by avoid across dietary, safety, teaching, marketing, stress, and clinical contexts. There are also activations related to cognitive development trajectories and mental health recognition.

patterns.name: Avoiding or reducing a risk
patterns.context: Advice, explanations, or assurances describe how to steer clear of adverse choices, behaviors, ingredients, or consequences; activations concentrate on avoid across different contexts.
patterns.domain: Health and diet, jewelry safety, teaching advice, marketing assurances, stress self-help, clinical care, and medical surgery

patterns.name: Social cognition development trajectory
patterns.context: Discusses the development of adult social and nonsocial cognition over time; high activation falls on trajectories.

patterns.name: Recognizing and addressing health problems
patterns.context: Discusses health awareness, identifying individual needs, and the possibility that friends, relatives, or neighbors have mental illness; avoid does not appear here.
patterns.domain: Mental health advocacy or public health education

9_2056.description: 最稳定的模式是建议或说明如何避免风险与不良结果，触发词多为 avoid，涵盖饮食、安全、教学、营销、压力及临床场景。另有认知发展轨迹和精神健康识别相关激活。

patterns.name: 避免或降低某种风险
patterns.context: 在建议、解释或保证中，说明如何避开不良选择、行为、成分或后果；激活集中在 avoid 一词，不同语境中均出现。
patterns.domain: 健康与饮食、珠宝安全、教学建议、营销保证、压力自助、临床照护及医学手术

patterns.name: 社会认知的发展轨迹
patterns.context: 讨论成年人社会与非社会认知随时间的发展；高激活落在 trajectories。

patterns.name: 健康问题识别与关注
patterns.context: 谈健康意识、识别个体需求，以及亲友或邻居可能患有精神疾病；此处未出现 avoid。
patterns.domain: 精神健康倡导或公共健康科普

en.concept: Local word forms and quantity structures
en.description: Activations span reviews, technical, health, and parenting texts, with no unified semantic theme. More prominent local cues include word-final fragments in segmented words (ed, er), each with time/meal units, and quantity structures; other highlighted collocations are scattered.

patterns.name: Word-final fragments at internal segmentation points
patterns.context: Activations fall within segmented words, especially the final “ed” or comparative suffix “er”; meanings and syntax vary, so it is unclear whether the suffix itself is the trigger.
patterns.domain: Mixed: reviews, technical text, audio, etc.

patterns.name: Daily actions and meal frequency
patterns.context: “each” combines with day or meal to describe repeated daily movement, eating, or scheduling.

patterns.name: Quantity or degree expressions
patterns.context: Numbers, ratios, or quantities appear in plans, goals, or advice; triggers are distributed across numbers and nearby words, with weak evidence.
patterns.domain: Personal plans, promotional copy, health advice

patterns.name: of in quantity structures
patterns.context: A noun or quantifier is followed by “of” and its complement; the three collocations differ, but may indicate a local syntactic cue.
patterns.domain: Technical explanations, advertising technology descriptions, parenting interviews

patterns.name: Varied local word forms and collocations
patterns.context: The highlighted items involve habitual expressions, purpose constructions, and bodily movement, with insufficient evidence to group them under one stable trigger condition.

9_2056.description: 激活跨评论、技术、健康与育儿文本，未呈现统一语义主题。较明显的局部线索是拆分词的词尾片段（ed、er）、each与时间/餐食单位，以及数量结构；其余高亮搭配分散。

patterns.name: 词内切分处的词尾片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分书写的词内部，尤其是词尾的「ed」或比较级后缀「er」；上下文词义和句法不一致，尚不能确定是否由后缀本身触发。

patterns.name: 逐日行动与餐食频率
patterns.context: 「each」与 day 或 meal 结合，描述按日重复的移动、进食或安排。

patterns.name: 数量或程度表达
patterns.context: 数字、比例或数量出现在计划、目标或建议中；触发点分布在数字和邻近词上，证据较弱。
patterns.domain: 个人计划、宣传文案、健康建议

patterns.name: 数量结构中的 of
patterns.context: 名词或量词后接「of」及其补足语；三处搭配不同，可能是局部句法线索。
patterns.domain: 技术说明、广告技术介绍、育儿访谈

patterns.name: 各异的局部词形与搭配
patterns.trigger: [4] gets «used»6 to it；[8] allowing us« to»4« create»4；[10] «your»6 pants «up»5
patterns.context: 这些高亮分别涉及习惯化表达、目的结构和身体动作，没有足够证据归为同一个稳定触发条件。
patterns.domain: 技术说明、广告、育儿访谈

en.concept: Internal fragments in long words and proper nouns
en.description: Activations are most prominent on internal fragments of long words, compounds, or proper nouns, often in biomedical terminology but also in product names, advertising copy, and other web text; one passage of disordered text shows scattered activations.

patterns.name: Biomedical terminology or word boundaries
patterns.context: Activations fall on internal word fragments, especially the latter parts of long, compound, or proper-noun terms; in passage 3, they also appear in a context correcting a product name spelling.
patterns.domain: Biomedical texts, web content, and product names

patterns.name: Genetics and molecular biology content
patterns.context: Passages discuss antibody production, gene expression, epigenetics, gene analysis, or organism regeneration; activations occur on local fragments of related terms rather than consistently on a single biological word.

patterns.name: Color correction and image portfolios
patterns.context: Introduces tutorials and demonstration images for color correction, and explains the role of color balance in a portfolio or online gallery.

patterns.name: Scattered activations in noisy text
patterns.context: Word meanings and contexts are disjointed, with no identifiable shared trigger; activations are scattered across several common words.
patterns.domain: Pile-CC concatenations or low-coherence web text

patterns.name: Internal word fragments in advertising copy
patterns.context: Promotes commercial business card printing; activations concentrate on segmented word fragments, unlike in research contexts.

patterns.name: Website titles and archive text
patterns.context: Political text follows a webpage title and archive page; no clear shared semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Product renaming and label correction
patterns.context: Discusses the renaming of a Microsoft product and asks to change an old label to the new name; high activation occurs on an internal fragment of “onedrive.”

9_2056.description: 激活最醒目地落在长词、复合词或专名的内部片段，常见于生物医学术语，但也出现在产品名、广告词和其他网页文本；另有一段杂乱文本呈分散激活。

patterns.name: 生物医学术语或词组边界
patterns.context: 激活落在词内片段，尤其是较长、复合或专名词的后半部分；第3段还出现在纠正产品名称拼写的语境中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学文本、网页及产品名称

patterns.name: 遗传与分子生物学相关内容
patterns.trigger: “genetic technology”“DNA technology”“antibodies”“cloned”“expressed in bacteria”“demethylation”“histone deacetylase”“gene expression profiling”“genes”“Organisms”“regeneration”
patterns.context: 段落讨论抗体制备、基因表达、表观遗传、基因分析或生物体再生；激活本身分布在相关术语的局部片段，而非稳定落在某个统一生物学词上。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要与科研文本

patterns.name: 颜色校正与图像作品集
patterns.trigger: “color correct”“color balance”“images”“portfolio”“online gallery”，尤以“portfolio”处激活最高
patterns.context: 介绍教程、示范图像校色，并说明色彩平衡对作品集或在线画廊的作用。

patterns.name: 噪声文本中的分散激活
patterns.context: 词语语义和上下文彼此杂乱，缺乏可确认的共同触发条件；激活分散于若干常见词。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC拼接或低连贯网页文本

patterns.name: 广告文案中的词内片段
patterns.context: 促销商业名片印刷，激活集中在被拆分的单词片段；与科研语境不同。

patterns.name: 网站标题与归档文字
patterns.context: 网页标题和归档页之后接续政治性文字；未见清楚的共同语义触发词。

patterns.name: 产品名称重标与标签纠正
patterns.context: 讨论微软产品更名，并要求把旧标签改成新名称；高激活出现在“onedrive”内部片段。

en.description: Activations are scattered across mixed web corpora: sporadic patterns include “of” and quantity expressions, generation or creation, “to” constructions, commercial services, and narrative descriptions. There is no stable cross-segment trigger, and segment 5 is unexplained.

patterns.name: Preposition “of” and possession/part-whole relations
patterns.context: “Of” appears in sentences or in possession or part-whole relations within noun phrases about institutions, products, quantities, and similar topics; however, only a few markers directly support this trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Emergence, birth, and generational change
patterns.context: Discusses the rise of a technological revolution, the birth of population generations, or music sounding better across generations.

patterns.name: Purpose or action constructions with a verb after “to”
patterns.context: “To” connects to a subsequent action or beneficiary, but the semantics vary across instances.

patterns.name: Numbers or quantity descriptions
patterns.context: Numbers or quantitative contexts occur in descriptions of quantities, categories, generations, or objects; triggering word forms are unstable.
patterns.domain: Miscellaneous descriptions, population economics, film and product texts

patterns.name: Commercial marketing and consumer services
patterns.context: Texts related to company operations, brand supply, orders, or customer support.

patterns.name: Descriptions of entities in narrative or cultural content
patterns.context: Describes a fictional expedition and people or places, or cultural products such as films and military watches.
patterns.domain: Science fiction narratives, film and product reviews

patterns.name: Word-form fragments in erroneous or fragmented text
patterns.context: Web-scraped text contains breaks, spelling anomalies, or concatenated sentences; activations may relate to local word forms rather than stable semantics.

9_2056.description: 激活分散于混合网页语料：可见of及数量、代际/生成、to结构、商业服务和叙事描写等零散模式；缺少跨段稳定触发条件，第5段无法解释。

patterns.name: 介词“of”及所属/部分关系
patterns.trigger: « of»（如“Other «to»« arrange”前后的“the seducing marriage”处未清楚对应；另有“infrastructure”等）
patterns.context: 句中出现of，或机构、产品、数量等名词短语中的所属或部分关系；不过只有少数标记能直接支持这一触发模式。

patterns.name: 生成、出生与代际变化
patterns.context: 谈及技术革命的兴起、人口世代出生，或音乐听感跨代改进。

patterns.name: to 后接动词的目的或动作结构
patterns.trigger: « to»8« arrange»10（1）；« to»5« you»（7，周边是交付语境）
patterns.context: to 与后续动作或受益对象相连；但各处语义并不一致。

patterns.name: 数字或数量描述
patterns.context: 数量、分类、代际或器物描述中出现数字或量化语境，触发词形式并不稳定。
patterns.domain: 杂项说明、人口经济学、电影与商品文本

patterns.name: 商业营销与消费者服务
patterns.trigger: « of»9« most»（2）；« each»8« brand»（7）；« of»8« customer»（8）
patterns.context: 公司业务、品牌供货、订单或客户支持相关文字。

patterns.name: 叙事或文化内容中的实体描写
patterns.context: 描述虚构远征与人物/地点，或电影、军事手表等文化商品。
patterns.domain: 科幻叙事、电影与产品评论

patterns.name: 错误或碎片化文本中的词形片段
patterns.trigger: «of»（1，原文分词边界杂乱）；« of»8« each»（7）；« of»8« customer»（8）
patterns.context: 网页抓取文本存在断裂、拼写异常或句段拼接，激活可能与局部词形而非稳定语义有关。

en.description: Activations are distributed across ordinary function words and common narrative words in varied web and forum texts, with topics ranging from beards and writing to businesses, technology, and products. There is no stable single semantic trigger pattern; a few anomalous word fragments are difficult to explain.

patterns.name: Short function words in unnatural text
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across function words and adjacent words in sentences, without always recurring on the same fixed word; some text is grammatically disordered or has anomalous token boundaries.
patterns.domain: Multidomain English web, forum, and academic texts

patterns.name: Descriptions of organization, process, and scale
patterns.context: Discusses the formation, promotion, development, or scale of groups, organizations, projects, or technologies; triggers are scattered across these expressions, with no unified lexical item.

patterns.name: Audience and content adaptation
patterns.context: Mentions content directed at an audience, or modifying or recommending content; there is no stable local grammatical pattern shared with other activations.

patterns.name: Discussion of technology and emerging applications
patterns.context: Topics include technology, industry adoption, or digital platforms; activation falls on ordinary narrative words, without a consistent technical proper-name trigger.

patterns.name: Beard-related terms
patterns.context: Focuses on beard types and facial hair growth; the passage also activates many general words, so it is uncertain whether this is related to the topic itself.

patterns.name: Anomalous word fragments in corrupted or concatenated text
patterns.context: Context is semantically broken, mixed, or apparently corrupted; multiple adjacent fragments are marked, making the trigger condition difficult to determine.

patterns.name: Waterproof watch sentence about the military
patterns.context: The sentence describes a waterproof watch designed for the Swiss military; “were” activates most strongly, a single instance that may simply be a general syntactic word.

patterns.name: surrender in an exaggerated expression
patterns.context: Appears in the unnatural guide copy phrase “will certainly surrender to end up”; the meaning and collocation are anomalous, with no recurrence.

patterns.name: agility in a shipwreck metaphor
patterns.context: Describes a large company as difficult to turn like an aircraft carrier and sinking; occurs only in this metaphorical context.

9_2056.description: 激活分布于多种网页与论坛文本的普通功能词及常见叙述词，主题横跨胡须、写作、企业、技术和产品；未见稳定的单一语义触发模式，少数异常词片段难以解释。

patterns.name: 不自然文本中的短功能词
patterns.context: 激活散布于句中功能词及其相邻词，并不总是同一个固定词；部分语料语法混乱或 token 边界异常。
patterns.domain: 多领域英语网页、论坛及学术文本

patterns.name: 组织、过程与规模描述
patterns.trigger: “assembly of”“employees”“Companies”“cluster-fuck”“dozens of managers”“process of development”“wide adoption”“billion-dollar business”
patterns.context: 谈论群体、组织、项目或技术的形成、推广、发展及规模；触发分散在这些表达中，未显示统一词项。

patterns.name: 受众与内容适配
patterns.context: 提及内容面向受众、修改或推荐内容；与其他激活词并无稳定的局部语法模式。
patterns.domain: 写作建议、娱乐网页、指南

patterns.name: 技术与新兴应用论述
patterns.context: 出现技术、行业采用或数字平台相关话题；激活点落在普通叙述词上，缺少一致的技术专名触发模式。

patterns.name: 胡须主题词
patterns.context: 围绕胡须类别及面部毛发生长展开；该段同时也激活大量一般词，是否与主题本身有关不确定。

patterns.name: 损坏或拼接文本中的异常词片段
patterns.context: 上下文语义断裂、混杂或疑似损坏，多个相邻片段被标记，难以确定触发条件。

patterns.name: 军事手表防水句
patterns.context: 句子谈及为瑞士军方设计的防水手表；其中“were”激活最强，单例且可能只是一般句法词。
patterns.domain: 产品或军事相关网页文案

patterns.name: 夸张表达中的 surrender
patterns.context: 在不自然的指南文案中出现在“will certainly surrender to end up”一段，含义和搭配异常，未见复现。
patterns.domain: 指南或 SEO 式网页文案

patterns.name: 沉船比喻中的 agility
patterns.context: 描述大型企业像航空母舰一样转向困难、正在下沉；只在该比喻语境出现。

en.description: Activations are scattered across contexts involving development, expansion, shifts from abstract to concrete, progressive word forms, and quantity enumeration; a beard-related theme and various proper names and domain-specific terms also appear, with no single semantic rule explaining them.

patterns.name: Abstract concepts becoming concrete things
patterns.context: Describes a product, idea, or technology developing from an abstract state into a concrete or mature form

patterns.name: Development, expansion, or progress
patterns.context: An organization, technology, or plan develops continuously and advances toward a goal; some contexts involve a long time span

patterns.name: The “-ing” word fragment / ongoing processes
patterns.context: Appears in words describing actions, processes, or ongoing states; activations are scattered and may favor process-related expressions
patterns.domain: News, business, explanatory writing, web texts

patterns.name: Quantities, categories, and enumeration structures
patterns.context: Lists quantities, categories, catalogs, or options, often alongside structured web content
patterns.domain: Web pages, explanatory writing, competition announcements

patterns.name: Facial-hair theme
patterns.context: Directly discusses beards and their growth or types

patterns.name: Specific names, domain terms, or tokenization anomalies
patterns.context: Activations occur on proper names or domain-specific terms without consistent local semantic conditions; segment 1 also contains the anomalously split words “relocating” and “seducing”
patterns.domain: News, energy, technology business, medical research, and mixed web texts

9_2056.description: 激活分散在发展、扩张、抽象到具体的转变、进行性词形及数量枚举等语境；另见胡须主题和多种专名、领域词，无法由单一语义规则解释。

patterns.name: 抽象概念转化为具体事物
patterns.context: 描述产品、想法或技术从抽象状态发展、转变为具体或成熟形态

patterns.name: 发展、扩张或推进
patterns.context: 组织、技术或计划持续发展并向目标推进；部分语境中伴随长期时间跨度

patterns.name: 词形片段 -ing / 进行过程
patterns.context: 出现在描述动作、过程或进行状态的词中；触发分散，可能偏向过程性表达
patterns.domain: 新闻、商业、说明文、网页文本

patterns.name: 数量、类别与枚举结构
patterns.trigger: “one or more times”“1,480”“five winning designs”“5 categories”“Table of Contents”
patterns.context: 列举数量、类别、目录或选项，常伴随结构化网页内容

patterns.name: 面部毛发主题
patterns.trigger: “Beards”“assembly of hairs”“growing out of your face”
patterns.context: 直接讨论胡须及其生长或类别

patterns.name: 特定名称、领域词或分词异常
patterns.trigger: “Jenni Watson”“rock inspired opera”“teenagers”“Alliance To save Energy”“Power Transformed”“cloud provider”“VAM”“rehabilitation”
patterns.context: 专名或领域术语处出现激活，但未见一致的局部语义条件；第1段还含异常断词“relocating”“seducing”
patterns.domain: 新闻、能源、科技商业、医疗科研及混杂网页文本

en.description: Activations span genres without a single stable theme. In several passages, “of” followed by a group, quantity, or fixed expression is prominent. Other local patterns include concretizing abstract concepts, descriptions of disadvantaged people, poetry, and commercial promotion; web fragments are difficult to interpret.

patterns.name: Abstract concepts becoming concrete things
patterns.context: Describes abstract ideas gradually developing into visible, usable, or purchasable objects; activations concentrate on “from abstract ideas into” and the subsequent concretization process.
patterns.domain: Business, product, and startup explanatory texts

patterns.name: Possessive of and following noun phrase
patterns.context: The preposition “of” appears in noun phrases or fixed collocations, followed by a group, a time/state expression, or a quantity noun; this form occurs in several passages, but activation strength and meaning vary.
patterns.domain: Literature, web articles, academic texts, and general explanatory prose

patterns.name: Fixed phrase of course
patterns.context: “of” combines with “course” as a parenthetical meaning certainly or adding a comment; both instances follow a concessive or process explanation within a sentence.

patterns.name: of constructions in poetry
patterns.context: In a line of poetry, “of” introduces a noun phrase and occurs near meter and line breaks; “of” activates strongly, along with the following material.

patterns.name: Disadvantaged or poor groups
patterns.context: Moral narrative about helping the vulnerable and pitying the poor; activation falls on “of” and “pities,” rather than being limited to a fixed word.

patterns.name: Descriptions of groups and travelers
patterns.context: Describes group composition, nationality, or travelers’ living conditions; activations concentrate on “of” and the following group description.

patterns.name: bits in quantum computing
patterns.context: Academic titles and introductions discuss the number of bits in quantum computers; “of” is followed by a numeral and a technical noun.

patterns.name: Scattered vocabulary and web noise
patterns.context: Fragmented web or scraped text contains disjointed content about mailing, webpages, and car brands; no unified semantic meaning can be inferred from context.

patterns.name: Activation in product or service promotion
patterns.context: A business emphasizes continually seeking better solutions, reducing costs, and showcasing its inventory network; high activation falls on the function word “they,” not on a clear industry term.

9_2056.concept: 不稳定的词汇与句法触发
9_2056.description: 激活跨体裁而不呈现单一稳定主题。若干段落中“of”及其后接的群体、数量或固定表达较突出，也出现抽象概念具体化、弱者描写、诗歌和商业宣传等局部模式；网页碎片难以解释。

patterns.name: 抽象概念转化为具体事物
patterns.context: 描述由抽象想法逐渐发展为可见、可用或可购买的具体对象；激活集中在“from abstract ideas into”及其后的具体化过程。
patterns.domain: 商业、产品与创业说明文

patterns.name: 所有格 of 及其后续名词短语
patterns.trigger: “of the weak”“of all nations”“of course”“of today”“of two bits”
patterns.context: 介词“of”出现在名词短语或固定搭配中，后接群体、时间/状态表达或数量名词；多段都有此形式，但激活强度与语义并不一致。
patterns.domain: 文学、网络文章、学术文本及一般说明文

patterns.name: 固定短语 of course
patterns.context: “of”与“course”组成插入语，表示当然或补充说明；两处均在句中承接让步或过程说明。

patterns.name: 诗歌中的 of 结构
patterns.context: 诗行中“of”引出名词短语，与韵律和诗句断行相邻；“of”强激活，后续成分也有激活。

patterns.name: 弱势或贫困群体
patterns.context: 关于帮助弱者、怜悯贫困者的道德性叙述；激活落在“of”和“pities”，而非只限于某个固定词。

patterns.name: 人物群体与旅行者描写
patterns.context: 描写人群构成、国籍或旅行者的生活状态；激活集中于“of”及其后的群体描述。

patterns.name: 量子计算中的 bits
patterns.context: 学术标题和引言谈量子计算机的比特数量；“of”后接数词和技术名词。

patterns.name: 零散词汇与网页噪声
patterns.trigger: “of our source”“of Subaru’s”“able”“not sent at 175 POSTAGE”
patterns.context: 碎片化网页或抓取文本，包含邮寄、页面、汽车品牌等不连贯内容；难以从上下文推出统一语义。

patterns.name: 激活出现在产品或服务推销描述
patterns.context: 商家强调持续寻找更好方案、降低成本并展示库存网络；高激活落在关系词“they”而非明确行业术语上。

en.description: The most consistent signal is “of” and its complement, especially “of course,” “of all sizes,” and “of + noun/quantity.” Other high activations are scattered across product evolution, UI, hotel descriptions, and collective effort, with no unified theme.

patterns.name: “Of” followed by an emphatic complement
patterns.context: Activations often fall on “of,” especially in the fixed expression “of course” or in noun phrases of the form “of + quantity/determiner/noun.” In different contexts, the preposition may continue the preceding text or introduce a complement.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain prose, forum posts, poetry, and web content

patterns.name: An abstract idea becoming a product or thing
patterns.context: “From … into …” describes an abstract idea gradually developing into a product that can be bought or used.

patterns.name: UI and ideas for something new
patterns.context: Discusses UI designers trying different approaches to create something new and unlike today’s UI; the activation falls on “of” in “of today.”

patterns.name: Narrative of personal achievement and process
patterns.context: The parenthetical phrase “of course” occurs in an account of personal writing experience, recognition, and an ongoing process.

patterns.name: Parenthetical phrase in an entrepreneurial account
patterns.context: An entrepreneur uses “of course” when discussing setbacks; the same passage also includes a title and nonstandard spelling.

patterns.name: Counting, quantities, and other miscellaneous fragments
patterns.context: “Of” appears in fragments about DNA, quantities, plants, art, or relationships that are difficult to unify under one theme; some text may be noisy or garbled.
patterns.domain: Scraped web texts with mixed topics and styles

patterns.name: “Of” constructions in poetry
patterns.context: In lines following a stanza break, “of” introduces something provided by a publisher; the same passage also has “of” followed by “there.”

patterns.name: Parenthetical phrase in a collaboration discussion
patterns.context: “Of course” is used as a concession or addition while discussing weekend traffic distribution and coordination issues.

patterns.name: Describing hotel amenities
patterns.context: A travel accommodation description uses “from” to introduce amenities provided by a hotel; the same passage also mentions a song and hotel name.
patterns.domain: Travel or hotel promotional web pages

patterns.name: Government IT business opportunities
patterns.context: When describing government IT policies and business opportunities, the phrase “companies of all sizes” is used.
patterns.domain: Government technology news or industry reporting

patterns.name: Life’s ups and downs and collective effort
patterns.context: Motivational or supportive writing emphasizes everyone’s shared effort to cope with life’s ups and downs; this segment contains no salient “of.”
patterns.domain: Life advice or personal development web pages

9_2056.description: 最稳定的线索是“of”及其补语，尤以“of course”“of all sizes”和“of + 名词/数量”为显著；其余高激活分散于产品演化、UI、酒店介绍及共同努力等语境，缺少统一主题。

patterns.name: “of” 后接强调性补语
patterns.context: 激活常落在 “of” 上，尤其是固定搭配 “of course” 或名词短语中的 “of + 数量/限定词/名词”。不同语境里介词可能承接前文，也可能开启补语。
patterns.domain: 跨领域散文、论坛文字、诗歌及网页内容

patterns.name: 抽象构想转为产品或事物
patterns.context: “from … into …” 描述由抽象想法逐渐发展成可购买或可使用的产品。
patterns.domain: 创业、商业或产品开发说明

patterns.name: UI 与新事物的构想
patterns.context: 谈论 UI 设计者尝试不同方案，形成与当今 UI 不同的新东西；激活落在 “of today” 中的 “of”。

patterns.name: 关于个人成就与过程的叙述
patterns.context: 在个人写作经历、获得认可及持续过程的叙述中，出现插入语 “of course”。

patterns.name: 创业经历中的插入语
patterns.context: 创业者谈到遇到挫折时使用 “of course”；同段还含标题和非标准拼写。

patterns.name: 计数、数量及其他杂乱片段
patterns.context: “of” 出现在 DNA、数量、植物、艺术或关系等彼此难以连成统一主题的片段中；部分文本疑似噪声或错乱。
patterns.domain: 网页抓取文本，主题与文体混杂

patterns.name: 诗歌中的 “of” 结构
patterns.context: 诗歌分节后的诗句中，“of” 引出出版者提供的事物；同段另有 “of” 后接 “there”。

patterns.name: 协作问题中的插入语
patterns.context: 讨论周末流量分布与协调问题时，以 “of course” 作让步或补充。

patterns.name: 介绍酒店设施
patterns.context: 旅游住宿介绍中，用 “from” 引出酒店提供的设施；同段还出现歌曲及酒店名称。

patterns.name: 政府 IT 商业机会
patterns.context: 介绍政府 IT 政策与企业机会时，使用 “companies of all sizes”。
patterns.domain: 政府技术新闻或行业报道

patterns.name: 生活起伏与共同努力
patterns.context: 励志或互助语气的文字中，强调大家共同尽力应对生活起伏；此段不含显著的 “of”。
patterns.domain: 生活建议或个人发展网页

en.description: Activation appears fairly consistently near “of” and the preceding word, especially in those of. Other sporadic patterns include abstract-to-concrete from constructions, web copy, all-caps title subwords, and code identifiers; they cannot be grouped under a single semantic function.

patterns.name: Demonstratives/determiners followed by of
patterns.context: A phrase contains of and the preceding element; sometimes spans a line break or is embedded in a longer sentence

patterns.name: Abstract concepts developing into concrete things
patterns.context: Describes ideas or products gradually developing from an abstract stage into something purchasable or concrete

patterns.name: Product promotions and cluttered web copy
patterns.context: Promotional or search-keyword-stuffed web text; trigger words are scattered and semantically incoherent
patterns.domain: Web advertisements or low-quality web corpora

patterns.name: Letter strings and spelling segmentation in titles
patterns.context: All-caps titles are split into multiple subword tokens, forming a family-crisis title

patterns.name: Domain names and proxy strings in code
patterns.context: Code identifiers are split into subwords near host addresses and DIRECT/PROXY strings

9_2056.description: 激活较一致地出现在“of”及其前接词附近，尤见 those of；另有抽象到具体的 from 结构、网页文案、全大写标题子词和代码标识符等零散模式，无法归并为单一语义功能。

patterns.name: 后接 of 的指示词/限定词
patterns.context: 词组中出现 of 及其前接成分；有时跨行或嵌在更长句中

patterns.name: 由抽象概念演变为具体事物
patterns.context: 描述想法、产品从抽象阶段逐步发展为可购买或具体的东西

patterns.name: 产品宣传与杂乱网页文案
patterns.context: 促销式或搜索关键词堆叠的网页文本；触发词分散，语义不连贯
patterns.domain: 网页广告或低质量网页语料

patterns.name: 标题中的字母串与拼写分词
patterns.context: 全大写标题被拆成多个子词 token，组成家庭危机标题

patterns.name: 代码中的域名与代理字符串
patterns.context: 代码标识符被切分为子词，邻近主机地址、DIRECT/PROXY 字符串

en.concept: Possible preference for “of” and neighboring collocations
en.description: High responses often fall on “of” and nearby positions across business, technology, reviews, and literary texts. Other local high responses include “own,” “my,” and a miscellaneous fragment with nearly the entire sentence broadly activated; these cannot be grouped into one clear syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Collocations following the preposition “of”
patterns.context: Includes possessive/relational expressions and “of + noun phrase” in various ordinary syntactic contexts; however, activation is unstable and often extends to neighboring tokens

patterns.name: Local continuation in incomplete or anomalous text
patterns.context: Nearly every token shows positive activation; the text is semantically and syntactically disorganized, possibly concatenated or corrupted, making it difficult to identify a single trigger condition

patterns.name: Describing an abstract idea becoming a product
patterns.context: Discusses startups and products gradually developing from abstract ideas into concrete items for sale

patterns.name: “Of” phrases describing influence or constraints on people
patterns.context: Discusses Instagram users’ dependence on the platform’s service provider and refers to providers as “overlords of choice”

patterns.name: “Of” in expressions of business scale
patterns.context: Government IT partnership opportunities are open to companies of different sizes

patterns.name: “Of” in expressions of business flexibility
patterns.context: Uses an aircraft carrier as a comparison to discuss the difficulty large companies face in transforming or changing direction

patterns.name: “Own” in family relationships
patterns.context: Describes a woman’s close relationship with her partner’s son and compares it with her biological children

patterns.name: “Of” contraction in colloquial plural possessives
patterns.context: Colloquial, dialectal phrasing in a nautical narrative, meaning a servant in the forecastle

patterns.name: “My” in an interview response
patterns.context: Answers an interview question about Auschwitz and Holocaust memory

patterns.name: “Of” in a discussion of horse experiments
patterns.context: Commentators discuss human intervention in animals and the consequences of irrigation projects around the Aral Sea; “of course” is a fixed expression here

patterns.name: “Of” in a quantum computing paper
patterns.context: Introduces the implementation of a two-qubit quantum computer

9_2056.concept: 可能偏好 of 及其邻近搭配
9_2056.description: 高响应常落在“of”及其邻近位置，跨商业、科技、评论和文学文本；其他局部高响应包括 own、my，以及一段几乎全句广泛激活的杂乱碎片，无法归入同一明确句法模式。

patterns.name: 介词“of”后的搭配
patterns.trigger: «of»，尤其是后接实词或所属成分时，如 “of»9« choice”、“of»8 two bits”、“of»8« all sizes”、“of»8« an aircraft carrier”、“o'»8« the foc'sle”
patterns.context: 多种普通句法环境中，包含所有格/关系表达和“of + 名词短语”；但激活并不稳定，且常延伸到相邻 token

patterns.name: 残缺或异常文本中的局部续接
patterns.trigger: [1]中的 « '»7«ve»、« expelled»、« size»、« minutes»、« Your»、« neutron»、« driven»、« loved»、« beautifully»、« tag»、«etes»、« battle»；[1]其余多个相邻 token 也被标记
patterns.context: 近乎每个 token 都出现正激活，文本语义和句法杂乱、疑似拼接或损坏；难以确定单一触发条件

patterns.name: 描述抽象想法转化为产品
patterns.context: 讨论初创企业、产品从抽象构想逐步发展成可出售的具体对象

patterns.name: 对人物施加影响或约束的“of”短语
patterns.context: 谈论 Instagram 用户对平台服务方的依赖，并以“overlords of choice”指称服务提供者

patterns.name: 商业规模表达中的“of”
patterns.context: 政府 IT 合作机会面向不同规模的公司

patterns.name: 商业灵活性表达中的“of”
patterns.context: 以航空母舰作比，讨论大型企业转型或改变方向的难度

patterns.name: 家人关系中的“own”
patterns.context: 叙述女性与伴侣之子的亲密关系，并将其与亲生子女作比较

patterns.name: 口语化复数所有格中的“of”缩约
patterns.context: 航海叙事中的口语化、方言式表达，意为船首楼里的杂役

patterns.name: 采访回答中的“my”
patterns.context: 回答有关奥斯维辛与大屠杀记忆的采访问题

patterns.name: 马匹实验讨论中的“of”
patterns.context: 评论者讨论人为干预动物及咸海灌溉工程后果；此处“of course”为固定表达

patterns.name: 量子计算论文中的“of”
patterns.context: 介绍双比特量子计算机的实现情况

en.concept: Mixed subword fragments and formatting responses
en.description: Activation covers common prepositions and function words, internal word fragments, and formatting fragments such as punctuation, line breaks, numbering, and all-caps titles. Sporadic content words from different sources also trigger, with no unified semantic condition apparent.

patterns.name: Preposition of and following noun phrase
patterns.context: Appears between nouns or quantity expressions, especially in “of + noun/pronoun” constructions; also includes “o' the” in abbreviated possessives.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain prose, fictional dialogue, and fragmentary text

patterns.name: Internal or initial word fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls inside segmented words or on fragments at the beginning or end of words; text often has unusual tokenization, OCR/typesetting, or capitalization.
patterns.domain: Heterogeneous text including news, fiction, poetry, titles, and advertisements

patterns.name: Formatting, title, and table-of-contents fragments
patterns.context: Appears near line breaks, punctuation, numbering, tables of contents, or all-caps titles, often alongside incoherently concatenated text.
patterns.domain: Web news, tables of contents, advertisements, and mixed-format text

patterns.name: Syntactic function words and common collocations
patterns.context: Appears sporadically in ordinary sentences, often near infinitives, articles, coordination, or copular constructions; there is no stable specialized semantic context.
patterns.domain: Web prose, news, expository text, and fiction

patterns.name: Phrase-final or local lexical fragments
patterns.context: Individual content words or word fragments are marked in their respective sentences, with no consistent semantic or syntactic condition apparent.
patterns.domain: Mixed; including web prose, lists, and poetry

9_2056.concept: 混合的词片段与格式响应
9_2056.description: 激活覆盖常见介词与功能词、词内分片，以及标点、换行、编号和全大写标题等格式碎片；不同来源中零散内容词也会触发，未见统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 介词 of 及后续名词短语
patterns.context: 出现在名词或数量表达之间，尤其是“of + 名词/代词”结构；也包括缩写所有格中的“o' the”。
patterns.domain: 跨领域散文、小说对话及残缺文本

patterns.name: 词内或词首分片
patterns.context: 激活落在被切分的词内部，或词的开头、结尾等片段；文本常有异常分词、OCR/排版或大小写格式。
patterns.domain: 新闻、小说、诗歌、标题与广告等异质文本

patterns.name: 格式、标题与目录碎片
patterns.context: 出现在换行、标点、编号、目录或全大写标题附近，往往伴随不连贯的拼接文本。
patterns.domain: 网页新闻、目录、广告及格式混杂文本

patterns.name: 句法功能词及常见搭配
patterns.context: 零散出现在普通句子中，常与不定式、冠词、并列或系动词结构相邻；没有稳定的专门语义场景。
patterns.domain: 网页散文、新闻、说明文与小说

patterns.name: 短语尾部或局部词汇片段
patterns.context: 个别内容词或词片段在各自句子中被标记，未显示一致的语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 混合；包括网页散文、列表和诗歌

en.description: The most reproducible cue is the preposition “of,” especially “of course,” although it also appears in various other phrases. A few activations also occur on “a,” the reader address “your,” and uppercase title fragments, which are difficult to explain with a single rule.

patterns.name: The preposition “of” and its following constituents
patterns.context: Appears before nouns, adjectives, or parentheticals in various syntactic contexts; “of course” recurs across several segments, but activations also occur in other “of” phrases.
patterns.domain: Commentary, news, technical texts, poetry, and web texts

patterns.name: Indefinite article “a”
patterns.context: The article occurs before a noun phrase; there are only a few examples, so it is unclear whether this is an independent, stable pattern.

patterns.name: Second-person possessive “your”
patterns.context: Direct address to readers or advice contexts; the strongest activation positions differ, with no further matching contexts observed.

patterns.name: Uppercase letter sequences in section headings
patterns.context: An all-uppercase section heading in a patent-style document; this may relate to uppercase heading formatting or may be coincidental.

patterns.name: Miscellaneous words and local collocations
patterns.context: These positions show activation but lack a clear shared trigger; the available samples are insufficient to infer a stable pattern.
patterns.domain: Web texts, poetry, and promotional copy

9_2056.description: 最可重复的线索是介词“of”，尤其“of course”，但也出现在多种其他短语中。另有少量“a”、读者称呼“your”及全大写标题片段的激活，难以由单一规则解释。

patterns.name: 介词“of”及其后接成分
patterns.trigger: «of»，包括“of course”“of the past”“of scalping”“of the Stuff”“kind of”
patterns.context: 在多种句法环境中出现在名词、形容词或插入语前；“of course”在若干段中重复出现，但激活也见于其他 of 短语。
patterns.domain: 评论、新闻、技术文本、诗歌及网页文本

patterns.name: 不定冠词“a”
patterns.context: 冠词置于名词短语前；目前仅有少数例子，无法确定是否为独立稳定模式。

patterns.name: 第二人称所有格“your”
patterns.context: 面向读者的直接称呼或建议语境；强激活位置不同，未见更多相同上下文。

patterns.name: 章节标题中的大写字母序列
patterns.trigger: “BACKGROUND OF THE INVENTION”中被拆分标记的“IN”“VEN”“IT”“ON”
patterns.context: 专利式文档中全大写的章节标题；可能与大写标题格式有关，也可能是偶然。

patterns.name: 零散词语与局部搭配
patterns.trigger: 如“your methods”“Calendars”“Are you interested?”及“a kind of amazing book”
patterns.context: 这些位置有激活，但彼此缺乏明确共同触发条件，现有样本不足以归纳稳定模式。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、诗歌及宣传文案

en.description: The most stable high activation is «of», commonly in “of course” and also in collocations such as “of value.” Sporadic anomalies include «Pas» inside Pascal and «your» in promotional copy; some fragments may be truncated or misaligned.

patterns.name: of in “of course”
patterns.context: Often appears in the phrase “of course”; segments 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, and 9 also contain highly activated “of,” but lack following context or are not fixed phrases.

patterns.name: Pas inside the proper name Pascal
patterns.context: Appears in the proper name “Pascal”; occurs in only this segment.

patterns.name: Degree adverb most
patterns.context: Segment 3 contains fragmentary text such as “of … scalping”; segment 6 contains “the most fulfilling,” but the actual activation annotation is «of»9 rather than most, possibly due to truncation or annotation misalignment.

patterns.name: Contextual noise or misalignment
patterns.context: Appears in segment 7’s “and of value,” segment 8’s “this of course,” and segment 9’s “that is, of course.” Segment 7 does not form “of course,” indicating that triggering is not limited to the fixed phrase.

patterns.name: your in immersive promotional copy
patterns.context: Appears only in the imperative promotional copy “Immerse your senses”; may be unrelated to the other patterns.

9_2056.description: 最稳定的高激活是«of»，常见于“of course”，也见于“of value”等搭配；另有Pascal内部的«Pas»及宣传语«your»等零散异常，部分片段可能截断或错位。

patterns.name: of course 后的 of
patterns.context: 多出现在短语“of course”中；第1、3、4、5、6、8、9段也有高激活的“of”，但缺少后续语境或并非固定短语。

patterns.name: 专名 Pascal 内的 Pas
patterns.context: 出现在专名“Pascal”中，只有该段出现。

patterns.name: 程度副词 most
patterns.context: 第3段出现“of … scalping”等零碎文本；第6段出现“the most fulfilling”，激活标注实际为«of»9而非 most，可能是截断或标注错位。

patterns.name: 上下文噪声或错位
patterns.context: 第7段“and of value”、第8段“this of course”、第9段“that is, of course”中出现；其中第7段不构成“of course”，显示触发不只限于固定短语。

patterns.name: 沉浸式宣传语中的 your
patterns.context: 祈使式宣传文案“Immerse your senses”，仅此处突出，可能与其他模式无关。

en.description: Activations are scattered across common words, phrases, and subwords, including “of” phrases, web language, spelling fragments, and topics from different domains; there is no clear semantic feature spanning all samples.

patterns.name: Constituents following the preposition “of”
patterns.context: Activations fall on words or phrases after “of,” often in prepositional phrases; the complements are not fixed syntactically or semantically

patterns.name: Function words and phrase continuations
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across common function words, auxiliaries, and neighboring content words, with no stable specific lexical collocation
patterns.domain: Web, parliamentary, news, academic, and literary texts

patterns.name: Web copy and download language
patterns.context: Web instructions, online services, or marketing-style copy include directions for downloading, accounts, devices, or saving images; the strongest activation points for [1][3][6] do not fully align

patterns.name: Spelling fragments and token boundaries
patterns.context: Words are split into subwords or deliberately spelled out in parts, as in “kva,” “surfing,” and segmented greetings
patterns.domain: Web texts, signs, or decorative uppercase text

patterns.name: Within-word splits in poetry
patterns.context: Words in poetic lines are split into subword fragments; activations concentrate on the split parts

patterns.name: Expressions related to “brain of the gut”
patterns.context: A popular-science or abstract context about the enteric nervous system uses “brain of the gut” as a metaphor

patterns.name: Notation in periodic and generational models
patterns.context: An economic or demographic model discusses a generation born in each period and includes mathematical-style variable notation

patterns.name: Generic vocabulary in garbled web text
patterns.context: Web text with incoherent grammar and semantics; no stable theme can be inferred locally

patterns.name: Electricity bills and appliances
patterns.context: Discusses device activity and its effects on electricity bills or energy use
patterns.domain: Web popular science or life advice

patterns.name: Relations between organizations and policy
patterns.context: Discusses staff regulations for European Union institutions and proposes that organizations and policy are interrelated

patterns.name: Phrases in historical and economic narratives
patterns.context: Common topical words appear separately in news trade reporting or economic models, with no shared, specific semantic trigger yet identified

patterns.name: Body parts and anatomical descriptions
patterns.context: Describes sensory nerves in the gut and autonomic control

patterns.name: Historical events and military narratives
patterns.context: A historical account related to the American Civil War is followed by economic model content

patterns.name: New Year, publication, and calendar imagery
patterns.context: A poem mentions the New Year, artists, calendars, and publishers

patterns.name: Miscellaneous content that cannot be clearly categorized
patterns.context: One passage discusses cycling and games; another is a segmented, uppercase greeting. Aside from local form, no shared trigger pattern is evident

9_2056.description: 激活分散在多种常见词、短语及子词上，含 of 短语、网页用语、拼写切分和不同领域主题；没有贯穿所有样本的明确语义特征。

patterns.name: 介词 of 的后续成分
patterns.trigger: “of”后接“the past”“60 minutes”“course”“a generation”“the Publisher”等；尤以 [1]“of their”、[2]“of course”、[5]“of the past”、[9]“of a generation”、[10]“of the”明显
patterns.context: 激活落在 of 之后的词或短语上，常见于介词短语；所接成分与句法、语义并不固定

patterns.name: 功能词与短语延续
patterns.trigger: “are their”“can be”“take up”“has been”“in the”“a generation”等短语中的普通词
patterns.context: 激活分散在常见功能词、助动词及相邻内容词上，没有稳定的特定词汇搭配
patterns.domain: 网页、议会、新闻、学术及文学文本

patterns.name: 网页文案与下载用语
patterns.context: 网页说明、在线服务或营销式文案中，出现下载、账户、设备或保存图片的指引；[1][3][6]各自最强点并不完全相同

patterns.name: 拼写碎片与分词边界
patterns.context: 单词被拆为子词或刻意逐段拼写时出现，如“kva”“surfing”及分块的欢迎语
patterns.domain: 网页文本、招牌或装饰性大写文字

patterns.name: 诗歌中的词内切分
patterns.context: 诗行中词语被拆分成子词片段；激活集中于切分后的部分

patterns.name: “brain of the gut”相关表述
patterns.context: 肠神经系统的科普或摘要语境中，以“brain of the gut”作比喻

patterns.name: 周期与代际模型的记号
patterns.context: 经济或人口模型讨论每个时期出生的一代，且含数学式样的变量记号
patterns.domain: 经济学教材或模型说明

patterns.name: 杂乱网页文本中的泛化词汇
patterns.context: 语法和语义不连贯的网页拼接文本；难以从局部恢复稳定主题
patterns.domain: 低质量或拼接式网页内容

patterns.name: 电力账单与用电设备
patterns.context: 讨论设备活动及其对电费或用电量的影响

patterns.name: 组织与政策的关系
patterns.context: 讨论欧盟机构职员规章，并提出组织与政策相互关联

patterns.name: 历史与经济叙述中的词组
patterns.context: 新闻贸易报道或经济模型中分别出现的普通主题词，尚无共同的专属语义触发条件

patterns.name: 身体部位及解剖描述
patterns.context: 描述肠道的感觉神经及自主控制

patterns.name: 历史事件与军事叙述
patterns.context: 美国内战相关历史叙述，随后转入经济模型内容

patterns.name: 新年、出版与日历意象
patterns.context: 诗句提及新年、艺术家、日历及出版者

patterns.name: 无法明确归类的零散内容
patterns.trigger: “No need”“real bike”“games”“Welcome to One Earth Bristol”
patterns.context: 前者谈骑车与游戏，后者为大写分块的欢迎语；除了局部形式特征，未见共同触发模式

en.description: The most stable signal is of (typically 8–9 in each segment); other highlighted function words and verbs are scattered and lack consistent semantic or stylistic conditions.

patterns.name: Phrase or clause boundary after of
patterns.context: Occurs after the preposition of, introducing a complement or a longer noun phrase/clause; stable across multiple contexts with different surrounding words and topics

patterns.name: Other high-frequency function words and syntactic continuation
patterns.context: Common function words or verbs in sentences are marked, but trigger positions and local structures vary, with no more specific common condition than general syntactic continuation
patterns.domain: Miscellaneous web text, expository text, and prose

9_2056.description: 最稳定的信号是 of（各段多为8–9）；此外有分散的高亮虚词和动词，缺乏一致语义或文体条件。

patterns.name: of 后的短语或分句边界
patterns.context: 在介词 of 后、引出补语或较长的名词短语/分句时；多个语境中稳定出现，周边词和主题各异

patterns.name: 其他高频虚词与句法续接
patterns.context: 句中常见虚词或动词被标记，但触发位置和局部结构并不统一，未显示出比一般句法续接更具体的共同条件
patterns.domain: 杂项网页文本、说明文及散文

en.concept: Word fragments and miscellaneous text features
en.description: Activations are distributed across within-word subword fragments, word beginnings, uppercase title fragments, and a few quantity expressions; they span biomedical, legal, social science, marketing, poetry, and Spanish texts. Frequent words, noise, and tokenization anomalies are also marked, with no unified semantic trigger pattern overall.

patterns.name: Subword fragments spanning word boundaries
patterns.context: Activations often fall on scattered subwords within or at the beginning of words, especially technical and academic terms split by the tokenizer; however, many ordinary words are also activated, so this alone cannot explain all instances.
patterns.domain: Biology, medical, research, and mixed web texts

patterns.name: English prefixes and common word fragments
patterns.context: Many activations fall on the beginnings or internal fragments of English words; sometimes several adjacent words activate, with no stable syntactic position or semantic category observed.
patterns.domain: Mixed web, social science, financial marketing, and literary texts

patterns.name: Proper names, titles, and uppercase strings
patterns.context: Uppercase words in titles or formal names are split into subword fragments and activated; the fragments occur in English court titles and Spanish institutional names.
patterns.domain: Legal document titles, academic publications, or institution names

patterns.name: Numbers and quantity expressions
patterns.context: A few activations occur in expressions involving quantities, counts, or numbers; not all numbers are marked.
patterns.domain: Medical discussion and mixed web texts

patterns.name: Tokenization anomalies or noisy activations
patterns.context: Some highlights are frequent function words, fragments near punctuation, or suspected garbled text/tokenization errors; consistent semantic trigger conditions are difficult to infer from local context.
patterns.domain: Various corpora, especially text with messy formatting, truncation, or tokenization anomalies

9_2056.concept: 词片段及杂项文本特征
9_2056.description: 激活散布于词内子词片段、词首、标题大写片段及少量数量表达中；涵盖生物医学、法律、社会科学、营销、诗歌和西班牙语文本。高频词、噪声与分词异常也被标记，整体缺乏统一语义触发模式。

patterns.name: 跨词边界的子词片段
patterns.context: 激活常落在词内或词首的零碎子词上，尤其是被分词器拆开的技术词、学术词；但也有大量普通词被激活，不能仅凭此解释所有实例。
patterns.domain: 生物、医学、科研文本及混杂网页文本

patterns.name: 英文词前缀与常见词片
patterns.trigger: « development»、« season»、« believe»、« getting»、« bed room»相关的« bedroom»、« global»、« remod»…«eled»、« pursu»«its»、« qualified»、« shorter»、« appell»«ation»、« bread»
patterns.context: 较多激活落在英语词的开头或词内片段；有时多个相邻词都激活，未见稳定的句法位置或语义类别。
patterns.domain: 混合网页、社会科学、金融营销和文学文本

patterns.name: 专名、标题与大写字母串
patterns.context: 标题或正式专名中的大写词被拆成子词片段并激活；片段跨越英语法院标题与西班牙语机构名称。
patterns.domain: 法律文书标题、学术出版物或机构名称

patterns.name: 数字与数量表达
patterns.context: 少量激活出现在数量、计数或数字相关表达中；并非所有数字都标记。
patterns.domain: 医学论述与混杂网页文本

patterns.name: 分词异常或噪声式激活
patterns.context: 部分高亮是高频功能词、标点附近片段或疑似乱码/错分词；难以从局部上下文归纳一致的语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 多种语料；尤其是格式杂乱、截断或分词异常的文本

en.description: Activation is heterogeneous: there are several examples involving segmented uppercase abbreviations, titles, and fragments of technical long words, as well as sporadic occurrences in quotations, ordinary grammatical words, and academic prose. There is no stable cross-segment semantic condition, and some responses cannot be attributed.

patterns.name: Segmented uppercase technical terms
patterns.context: Patent titles or technical terms appear in uppercase and are split into multiple subword tokens; uppercase proper nouns also occur in ordinary English contexts, but this segment is most prominent.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within academic terms
patterns.context: Long words related to medicine or neuroscience are split into multiple subword tokens; tokenization of an initial capitalized phrase also appears nearby.
patterns.domain: NIH project descriptions, medical research text

patterns.name: Initial or title-style all-caps fragments
patterns.context: Prominent all-caps phrases in advertising quotations, with words also split into multiple tokens; may also respond to other title-like all-caps strings.

patterns.name: Emphatic capitalization in sentence openings/quotations
patterns.context: Capitalized initial words or emphatically capitalized words appear in ordinary sentences or quotations, without a consistent technical topic nearby.

patterns.name: Boundary subwords in proper nouns or abbreviations
patterns.context: Names, abbreviations, model names, or mixed-case proper nouns are decomposed into uppercase or mixed-case tokens; no stable lexical or topical condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: Mixed corpus: scientific abstracts, forums, and NIH text

patterns.name: Spelling and typographic segmentation in quotations
patterns.context: In fictional dialogue, proper nouns, words, or abbreviated forms are split into subword tokens, alongside typographic markers such as quotation marks and line breaks.

patterns.name: Scattered grammatical and common cross-corpus words
patterns.context: These ordinary words activate in sentences from multiple fields, with no consistent local collocation; may reflect incidental context-dependent responses.

patterns.name: Research synthesis and knowledge-application statements
patterns.context: Academic text discussing application of research findings and integration of different perspectives; the main triggers remain scattered common words rather than stable terminology.

9_2056.concept: 大写/子词边界线索（不稳定）
9_2056.description: 激活呈现异质性：对被切分的大写缩写、标题及专业长词片段有若干例子，也零散出现在引文、普通语法词和学术表述中；缺少跨段稳定语义条件，部分响应无法归因。

patterns.name: 拆分大写技术术语
patterns.context: 专利标题或技术名词以大写形式出现，且被切分为多个子词 token；普通英文语境中也可见大写专名，但此段最突出。

patterns.name: 学术术语内部子词片段
patterns.context: 医学或神经科学相关的长词被切成多个子词 token；相邻还出现句首大写短语的分词。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目说明、医学科研文本

patterns.name: 句首或标题式全大写片段
patterns.context: 广告引文中的醒目全大写短语，词语还被分割为多个 token；也可能对其他全大写标题式字符串有响应。
patterns.domain: 法律材料中的广告引文

patterns.name: 句首/引文中强调性大写词
patterns.context: 普通句子或引文中出现句首大写、强调式大写词，周围并没有一致的技术主题。

patterns.name: 专名或缩写的边界子词
patterns.context: 姓名、缩写、模型名称或混合大小写专名被分解为大写/混合大小写 token；未见稳定的词义或主题条件。
patterns.domain: 混合语料：科学摘要、论坛及 NIH 文本

patterns.name: 引文中的拼写及排版切分
patterns.context: 小说对白中专名、单词或缩写形式被切成子词 token，并伴随引号与换行等排版标记。

patterns.name: 零散语法词与多语料常见词
patterns.context: 这些普通词在多个不同领域的句子中激活，未显示一致的局部搭配；可能反映上下文相关的偶发响应。

patterns.name: 研究综合与知识应用表述
patterns.context: 讨论研究成果应用、整合不同视角的学术文字；主要触发点仍是分散的常用词，而非稳定术语。

en.description: Activations appear across texts about medical neural engineering, financial loans, corporate political economy, Spanish academic titles, plant breeding, Mars interviews, encyclopedia entries, and casino promotions; there is no clear shared semantic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Medical papers and neural engineering vocabulary
patterns.context: Medical or bioengineering context; paragraph 1 is damaged, garbled, or concatenated text, while paragraphs 2 and 3 concern nervous system treatments and neural tissue repair.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, neural engineering, and research texts

patterns.name: Finance, banking, and loan vocabulary
patterns.context: Discusses banking services, credit checks, or loans; the text itself contains obvious garbling or unnatural concatenation.
patterns.domain: Personal finance and banking web text

patterns.name: Corporate and political economy discussion
patterns.context: Discusses corporations, nations, and principles of distribution; activations are distributed across several adjacent words.
patterns.domain: HackerNews discussion and political economy quotations

patterns.name: Spanish academic institution titles
patterns.context: Spanish-language institutional or academic titles, mainly uppercase university names, departments, and art or aesthetics names.

patterns.name: Plant breeding traits
patterns.context: Describes crop breeding goals and traits, and mentions selection or breeding methods.
patterns.domain: Plant breeding and patent background texts

patterns.name: Expressions about traveling to Mars
patterns.context: Interviewees discuss experiences with simulated Mars missions and their hopes of going to Mars.
patterns.domain: Popular science interviews or space exploration reporting

patterns.name: Entry headword segmentation
patterns.context: An isolated entry title is split into subword fragments, followed by “may refer to”.

patterns.name: Casino promotional copy
patterns.context: Seasonal promotional copy for a casino or pool event; “anagram” may occur near concatenated or garbled text.

9_2056.description: 激活散见于医学神经工程、金融贷款、企业政治经济、西班牙语学术标题、植物育种、火星采访、百科词条和赌场促销等文本；没有明确共享的语义触发模式。

patterns.name: 医学论文及神经工程词汇
patterns.trigger: “therapeutic”“transgene”“could badly be”；“technologies and device-based therapies”“restore function”“nervous system”“Each year”
patterns.context: 医学或生物工程语境；段1为受损、乱码或拼接文本，段2、3是神经系统治疗及神经组织修复相关内容
patterns.domain: 生物医学、神经工程与科研文本

patterns.name: 金融、银行与贷款词汇
patterns.context: 谈银行服务、信用审查或贷款；文本本身有明显乱码或不自然拼接
patterns.domain: 个人金融与银行相关网页文本

patterns.name: 企业与政治经济论述
patterns.trigger: “companies will succeed”“corporation”“From each”“according to his ability”“to each”
patterns.context: 讨论企业、国家及分配原则；激活分布在若干相邻词上

patterns.name: 西班牙语学术机构标题
patterns.trigger: “de Filosofía y Letras”“LA ESTÉTICA Y EL ARTE”“UNIVERSIDAD AUTÓNOMA BENEMÉRITA”
patterns.context: 西班牙语机构或学术标题，以大写校名、院系及艺术美学名称为主
patterns.domain: 西班牙语学术目录或标题

patterns.name: 植物育种性状
patterns.trigger: “higher seed yield”“resistance to diseases and insects”“drought”“heat”“agronomic quality”“breeding or selection”
patterns.context: 描述作物育种目标及性状，并提及选择或育种方法
patterns.domain: 植物育种、专利背景文本

patterns.name: 火星旅行表达
patterns.trigger: “Mars-analogue site”“real mission”“go to Mars”“of course I would love”
patterns.context: 受访者谈模拟火星任务体验及希望前往火星
patterns.domain: 科普采访或太空探索报道

patterns.name: 词条词形拆分
patterns.context: 孤立词条标题被拆成子词片段，后接“may refer to”

patterns.name: 赌场促销文案
patterns.context: 赌场或泳池活动的季节性宣传文案；“anagram”附近可能有拼接或乱码

en.concept: Local word fragments in anomalous contexts
en.description: Activation is scattered across various web texts and abstracts, often on short function words, internal word substrings, and broken or incoherent text; there is no stable thematic semantics, and it is especially prominent in noisy concatenations and unusual word forms.

patterns.name: Function words and subwords in broken or unusual English fragments
patterns.context: Primarily occurs in grammatically or semantically incoherent text, fragmented spelling, or apparent noisy concatenations; highlights often fall on short function words or internal word substrings rather than stable, complete semantic words.
patterns.domain: Pile-CC web text and mixed corpora

patterns.name: Text resembling corrupted or low-coherence text
patterns.context: Occurs when surrounding word order or word forms are clearly abnormal and sentences are difficult to interpret coherently; activation falls on unusual word forms or adjacent short words.
patterns.domain: Web-crawl noise, concatenated text, or anomalous generated text

patterns.name: Common words after proper nouns, technical terms, or titles
patterns.context: Appears in titles, sentence openings, questions, or terminology-dense passages, but these words also activate in other kinds of text, so no specialized semantic condition can be confirmed.
patterns.domain: Educational introductions, academic/medical materials, news websites

patterns.name: Unusual lexical sequences in literary style
patterns.context: Word-internal fragments and short words activate in poetic, deliberately grotesque, or difficult-to-parse wording.

patterns.name: Local word fragments in neuroscience and medical corpora
patterns.context: Near terms related to neural tissue, neural injury, or the nervous system; activation does not consistently fall inside the terms or on adjacent common words.

patterns.name: Short words near web titles/links
patterns.context: Web fragments near titles, links, or line breaks; apart from «of», title entities themselves activate weakly.

9_2056.concept: 异常上下文中的局部词片段
9_2056.description: 激活分散在多类网页与摘要中，常落于短功能词、词内子串及破碎或不连贯文本；没有稳定的主题语义，噪声拼接和异常词形中尤为显著。

patterns.name: 破碎或异常英语片段中的功能词与子词
patterns.context: 主要在语法或语义不连贯、拼写被切碎、疑似噪声拼接的文本里；高亮常落在短功能词或词内子串，而不是稳定的完整语义词。

patterns.name: 疑似乱码/低连贯度文本
patterns.context: 周围词序或词形明显异常、句子难以连贯解释时出现；激活点落在不寻常词形或相邻短词上。
patterns.domain: 网页抓取噪声、拼接或生成式异常文本

patterns.name: 专名、术语或标题后的常见词
patterns.context: 出现在标题、句首、疑问句或术语密集段落中，但这些词在其他类型文本里也激活，无法确认专门的语义条件。
patterns.domain: 教育介绍、学术/医学材料、新闻网页

patterns.name: 文艺风格的异常词汇序列
patterns.context: 诗性、刻意怪诞或难以解析的措辞中，词内片段与短词获得激活。

patterns.name: 神经科学与医学语料中的局部词片段
patterns.context: 神经组织、神经损伤或神经系统相关术语附近；激活并不一致地落在术语内部或相邻常见词上。

patterns.name: 网页标题/链接附近的短词
patterns.context: 标题、链接或换行附近的网页片段；除 «of» 外，标题实体本身激活较弱。

en.description: Activations are distributed across fragmented subwords, anomalous tokens, and ordinary words, as well as texts about agriculture, education, finance, marketing, poetry, biomedicine, and economic history; there is no stable semantic or syntactic pattern across passages.

patterns.name: Token fragments at pseudo-word boundaries
patterns.context: Activations fall on subwords inside words or segmented word fragments, often with adjacent fragments also activated; no fixed semantic context is required.
patterns.domain: Mixed corpora, technical texts, and garbled or anomalously tokenized text

patterns.name: Rare or anomalous token sequences
patterns.context: Token sequences are clearly fragmented, containing non-English characters, sporadic letters, whitespace, or punctuation; activations are difficult to explain from coherent semantics.
patterns.domain: EuroParl texts and legal document extraction/formatting noise

patterns.name: Local activations on function words and common words
patterns.context: Common words activate sporadically in their respective contexts, with no stable syntactic position or semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Mixed webpages, prose, and institutional texts

patterns.name: Around science and engineering terminology
patterns.context: Appears in mixed web text about genetic engineering, scientific value, or aerodynamics; activations cluster on terms and neighboring words, but the context is quite noisy.

patterns.name: Plant breeding traits and methods
patterns.context: Discusses crop traits, resistance, agronomic quality, and breeding or selection methods.

patterns.name: Name recognition and personalized learning
patterns.context: Introduces personalized learning and states that every student is known by name.

patterns.name: Mixed text about banking and loan inquiries
