patterns.name: 词首被切分后的续接片段
patterns.context: 激活落在一个词的开头或词内片段；有些例子呈现较强的分段效应，但这些子串在词义和位置上不统一。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本与网页文本

patterns.name: 名词前置修饰语或程度表达
patterns.trigger: «dark»4 matter、«dark»5 energy、«raw»9 nature、«raw»9 materials、«soft»9 drink、«green»9 field、«lower»3 achievement
patterns.context: 较高激活偶见于名词前的修饰词或复合词前半；也有非此类例子，不能视为稳定的句法触发条件。
patterns.domain: 新闻、百科、商业、问答等说明性文本

patterns.name: 动物与栖息地词汇
patterns.context: 描述动物、植物、分布或生态特征的定义句中出现相关词汇；强激活主要落在 live。

patterns.name: 分级阅读与重复句子
patterns.context: 介绍儿童初级阅读材料时，描述文本特征的词获得激活。

patterns.name: 贫困与少数群体儿童
patterns.trigger: «income»7 and« low»5 academic achievement、«Deep»9«est»2 poverty、«higher»5 rates
patterns.context: 讨论经济困难与儿童学业或群体差异；激活涉及经济状况、程度或比较表达。

patterns.name: 环境与绿色产业
patterns.context: 介绍企业环境表现及工业开发；高激活主要在 greenfield 的分词片段。

patterns.name: 视觉障碍与未治疗后果
patterns.context: 说明儿童弱视、治疗与视力损害后果；最高激活落在 untreated。

patterns.name: 空间尺度与宇宙主题
patterns.context: 宇宙距离及暗物质、暗能量的新闻说明；突出片段出现在距离单位与天文词汇中。

patterns.name: 企业或产品名称中的特殊词形
patterns.context: 专名、品牌或场馆名称附近出现激活，但不同例子的共同词形或语义条件不明确。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、体育商业文本

patterns.name: 问答中的原材料与金额
patterns.context: 询问美国从中国进口额及原材料时，raw 在相邻片段中激活。

patterns.name: 旅游住宿与自然体验
patterns.context: 描述度假地的简陋住宿及自然体验；高激活落在 raw。

en.description: Activation is distributed across heterogeneous text and often targets word fragments at tokenization boundaries. Examples occur in group categories, sports, cybersecurity, game enemies, dining proper names, and Polish-language contexts, with no stable single semantic or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Suffixes or fragments within segmented words
patterns.context: Activation often falls on word-final or internal subwords in segmented words, covering proper names, common words, and category names; it does not depend on a single meaning or fixed syntax.
patterns.domain: Mixed corpus, proper names and ordinary text

patterns.name: People, entities, and category labels
patterns.context: Descriptions of population groups, users, athletes, or organizations; some examples are simply category-directory labels.
patterns.domain: News, electricity emails, medical abstracts, encyclopedia directories

patterns.name: Sports and athletics
patterns.context: Contexts involving sports, athletic participation, or team rosters.

patterns.name: Cybersecurity and information theft
patterns.context: Discusses industrial espionage, personal information, and cybercrime.

patterns.name: Powerful enemies and game difficulty
patterns.context: Describes game-character enemies and increasing strength with level progression.

patterns.name: Event and dining proper names
patterns.context: Promotional text for a Sydney dining event, containing an event or brand name.

patterns.name: Polish fragments and diacritic characters
patterns.context: Polish verse or lyric-like text; activation is scattered across segmented word fragments.

patterns.name: Energy customers and costs
patterns.context: Email context about a Southern California electricity company helping customers manage costs.

patterns.name: Social impact and health behaviors
patterns.context: Discusses how adolescents' exercise habits develop during childhood and adolescence.

patterns.name: Emergencies and social conditions
patterns.context: News narration about the effects of the pandemic and lockdown on people's circumstances.

patterns.name: Directory formatting
patterns.context: Consecutive listings of encyclopedia categories or person-entry labels.

9_2290.description: 激活分布于异质文本，常命中分词边界上的词片；可见于人群类别、体育、网络安全、游戏敌人、餐饮专名及波兰语等语境，缺乏稳定的单一语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 分段词内部的后缀或词片
patterns.context: 激活常落在被切分的词尾或词内子词上，覆盖专名、普通词及类别名称；不依赖单一语义或固定句法
patterns.domain: 混合语料、专名和普通文本

patterns.name: 人群、实体及类别标签
patterns.context: 人口、用户、运动员或组织类别的描述；部分例子只是类别目录标签
patterns.domain: 新闻、电力邮件、医学摘要、百科目录

patterns.name: 体育与运动
patterns.context: 体育运动、运动参与或球队阵容语境
patterns.domain: 新闻、PubMed 摘要、体育报道

patterns.name: 网络安全与信息窃取
patterns.context: 讨论工业间谍、个人信息及网络犯罪
patterns.domain: 百科与网络安全说明文

patterns.name: 强敌与游戏难度
patterns.context: 描述游戏角色敌人及随关卡提升的强度

patterns.name: 活动与餐饮专名
patterns.context: 悉尼餐饮活动的宣传性文字，含活动或品牌专名

patterns.name: 波兰语词片及重音字符
patterns.context: 波兰语诗句或歌词式文本；激活散布在切分的词片中

patterns.name: 能源客户与成本
patterns.context: 南加州电力公司帮助客户应对成本的邮件语境

patterns.name: 社会影响与健康行为
patterns.context: 讨论青少年运动习惯在童年及青春期形成

patterns.name: 突发事件与社会处境
patterns.trigger: mood or environment for celebration；poor people；surging outbreak of coronavirus
patterns.context: 疫情及封锁对民众处境的新闻叙述

patterns.name: 分类目录格式
patterns.context: 连续列出百科分类或人物条目标签

en.description: Activation is scattered across in-word token fragments, become and its following structure, the possessive world's, and paper-title boundaries. There is also a monogamous example and a personal age-and-experience context, with no single stable semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Word-initial fragments split within words
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal fragments of segmented words; target words and positions vary, and may be surrounded by common words or proper names.
patterns.domain: General text, including forums, medical text, and institutional descriptions

patterns.name: Words after become
patterns.context: In descriptions of institutional or personal development, identity, or scale, become is marked; in some examples the immediately following article is also marked.
patterns.domain: Institutional descriptions, grant applications, and career advice

patterns.name: Possessive structure with world's
patterns.context: world is followed by 's and then by a superlative describing a person or thing.

patterns.name: Cue words near paragraph or section boundaries
patterns.context: Near the title, section markers, or opening of a medical paper; activation is distributed across words in the title and the following structure.

patterns.name: Phrase monogamous relationships
patterns.context: In a discussion of contraceptive products and relationship types, monogamous is segmented and its initial fragment is strongly activated.

patterns.name: Age and time expressions in an author's experience
patterns.context: A forum reply mentions when they began working professionally and compares their age with the other person.

9_2290.description: 激活分散在词内分词片段、become 及其后续结构、world's 所有格和论文标题边界等位置；另有 monogamous 与个人年龄经历语境，未见单一稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: 词内切分的词首片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被分词切开的词的内部片段上；目标词及其位置并不一致，周围还可能有常见词或专名
patterns.domain: 通用文本，包含论坛、医学及机构介绍

patterns.name: become 后的词
patterns.trigger: «grown»7« to»6« become»10« the»5« Group»2；«grown»6« to»5« become»9« the»4« largest»6；«become»9« academ»2icians
patterns.context: 在描述机构或个人发展、身份或规模变化时，become 被标记；部分例子中紧邻其后的冠词也标记
patterns.domain: 机构介绍、资助申请及职业建议

patterns.name: world's 的所有格结构
patterns.context: world 后接 's，并继续以最高级描述人物或事物

patterns.name: 段落或章节边界附近的引导词
patterns.context: 医学论文的标题、章节标记或引言开头附近；激活分布在标题词内部及其后续结构

patterns.name: 短语 monogamous relationships
patterns.context: 在讨论避孕产品及关系类型时，monogamous 被分词切开且显著激活其首片段

patterns.name: 作者经历中的年龄与时间表达
patterns.context: 论坛回复中谈及开始职业工作的时间及与对方年龄的比较

en.description: Activations are concentrated in healthcare text: diseases, patients, care, specialties and institutions, as well as medical research and diagnosis. Other contexts include insurance risk sharing, contraceptive products, drug application areas, and research applications.

patterns.name: Medical and healthcare context
patterns.context: Concerns diagnosis and treatment, patients, healthcare services, or medical institutions; can trigger in different syntactic positions.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, public health, and healthcare-related discussion

patterns.name: Insurance and risk sharing
patterns.context: Discusses the definition of insurance or a specific insurance type and the sharing of risk.

patterns.name: Contraceptive products and monogamous relationships
patterns.context: Discusses the use of contraceptive products and connects them to relationship types.

patterns.name: Morphemes in specialty or field names
patterns.context: Medical specialties or application-area names, including oncology, obstetrics and gynecology, and agriculture among parallel application areas.
patterns.domain: Medical, healthcare technology, or related academic text

patterns.name: Medical study design and trial reporting
patterns.context: Describes study analyses, comparison groups, trial design, or outcomes.

patterns.name: Geriatric and end-of-life care
patterns.context: Discusses nursing-home physicians, geriatrics, and end-of-life care, comparing countries or work arrangements.

patterns.name: Mental health and trauma-related services
patterns.context: Describes people with trauma histories and compares psychiatric hospitals with community-service settings.

patterns.name: Cancer and disease perception
patterns.context: Discusses perceptions of cancer as fatal, patient symptoms, and changes in the screening era.
patterns.domain: Disease discussion in a medical paper

patterns.name: Insurance reimbursement mechanism
patterns.context: Explains a fixed copayment in a health-insurance entry.

patterns.name: Medical and agricultural uses listed in parallel
patterns.context: Explains that a compound or product has multiple application areas.

patterns.name: Pediatric oncology organization and institutional scale
patterns.context: Grant application materials describe a pediatric oncology organization's activities and the scale of its host institution.

patterns.name: Ultrasound diagnosis and examination sites
patterns.context: Lists body sites for which an ultrasound diagnostic system is intended and mentions obstetric and gynecological applications.

patterns.name: Prenatal care and obstetric outcomes
patterns.context: Describes a randomized controlled trial of pregnancy weighing and dietary advice, along with obstetric outcomes.

9_2290.description: 激活集中于医疗健康文本：疾病、患者、照护、专科与机构，以及医学研究和诊断。另涵盖保险风险分担、避孕产品、药物应用领域及科研申请等不同语境。

patterns.name: 医疗与健康照护语境
patterns.context: 围绕诊疗、患者、医护服务或医疗机构展开；在不同句法位置均可触发
patterns.domain: 医学论文、公共卫生及医疗相关讨论

patterns.name: 保险及风险分担
patterns.context: 讨论保险的定义或具体险种、共同承担风险

patterns.name: 避孕产品与单配偶关系
patterns.context: 谈及避孕产品的用途，并将其与性关系类型联系起来

patterns.name: 领域或专科名称中的词素
patterns.context: 医学专科或应用领域名称出现时，包括肿瘤学、妇产科以及农业等并列应用领域
patterns.domain: 医学、医疗技术或相关学术文本

patterns.name: 医学研究设计与试验报告
patterns.context: 描述研究分析、比较对象、试验设计或研究结局

patterns.name: 老年照护与生命末期照护
patterns.context: 讨论养老院医生、老年医学及生命末期照护，并比较国家或工作安排
patterns.domain: 老年医学与医疗服务研究

patterns.name: 精神健康及创伤相关服务
patterns.context: 描述创伤经历者，并比较精神科医院与社区服务场景

patterns.name: 癌症及疾病认知
patterns.context: 谈论癌症的致命性认知、患者症状及筛查时代的变化
patterns.domain: 医学论文中的疾病叙述

patterns.name: 保险赔付机制
patterns.context: 健康保险条目中解释固定共付额
patterns.domain: 百科全书式健康保险说明

patterns.name: 医疗用途与农业用途并列
patterns.context: 说明一种化合物或产品具有多个应用领域
patterns.domain: 药理学或农药研究摘要

patterns.name: 儿科肿瘤组织与机构规模
patterns.context: 机构申请材料中介绍儿科肿瘤组织活动及所在机构规模

patterns.name: 超声诊断及检查部位
patterns.context: 列举超声诊断系统适用的身体部位，并提及妇产科应用

patterns.name: 产前照护与产科结局
patterns.context: 描述孕期称重和饮食建议的随机对照试验及产科结局

en.description: The most prominent recurring clue is become/becoming followed by an identity or state, but other strong activations are scattered across insurance, individual in-word fragments, and medical and career contexts; no single pattern explains all passages.

patterns.name: Identity, state, or degree following become
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the article and identity, occupation, state, or degree word following become/becoming; not every instance of become is equally strong.
patterns.domain: General narration, career and personal experience

patterns.name: In-word fragment of monogamous
patterns.context: Occurs in a sentence about condoms and relationships; activation mainly falls within the segmented word.

patterns.name: Health insurance terminology
patterns.context: Clear activation occurs near a health-insurance entry subheading and terminology explanation; “In” reaches the highest intensity in this batch.

patterns.name: Nursing-home care and country comparison
patterns.context: A study of end-of-life care in nursing homes transitions to a comparison of doctors' work arrangements in Norway and the Netherlands; the strongest activation falls on Norway.

patterns.name: Job search and work experience of an entrepreneur
patterns.context: An HN help-seeking post describes a solo entrepreneur looking for consulting work; activation falls on been, working, and nearby words.
patterns.domain: Hacker News, entrepreneurship and career advice

patterns.name: Innovation/disruption phrasing in a Doctor of Nursing Practice
patterns.context: The title and abstract opening of a nursing education paper; activation is distributed across subword fragments of professional and institutional names.

9_2290.description: 最突出的重复线索是 become/becoming 后接身份或状态，但其余强激活分散于保险、单个词内片段、医学与职业语境；没有一个模式能解释全部段落。

patterns.name: become 后接身份、状态或程度
patterns.trigger: “become”及其后的补语，如 “become an independent investigator”“becoming an unbalanced workaholic”“become a little obsessed”
patterns.context: 激活集中在 become/becoming 后面的冠词及身份、职业、状态或程度词；并非每个 become 都同样强。
patterns.domain: 一般叙述、职业与个人经历

patterns.name: monogamous 的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在关于避孕套及关系的句子中，激活主要落在被拆分的词内部。

patterns.name: 健康保险术语
patterns.context: 健康保险条目小标题和术语说明附近有明显激活；“In”达到本批最高强度。

patterns.name: 养老护理与国家对比
patterns.context: 养老院临终护理研究中转入挪威与荷兰医生工作安排的比较；最强激活落在 Norway。

patterns.name: 创业者求职与工作经历
patterns.context: HN 求助帖描述单人创业者寻找咨询工作；激活落在 been、working 及其附近。

patterns.name: 护理实践博士的创新／颠覆表述
patterns.context: 护理教育论文标题及摘要开头；激活分布在专业名称和机构名称的词片段上。

en.concept: Mixed response to function words and subword fragments
en.description: Activations are scattered across common function words, line breaks, and within-word subword fragments; content includes relationship status, care, insurance, family careers, cosmetics, and Portuguese word forms, without a stable unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Article-preposition combinations after relationship/domain terms
patterns.context: Function words are marked within noun phrases when discussing relationships, care, insurance, or social organizations; the nouns themselves vary across domains.
patterns.domain: Academic abstracts, encyclopedic descriptions, and general narrative

patterns.name: Portuguese morphology and within-word segmentation
patterns.context: Appears in Portuguese philosophical text or lists of language names; activations fall on within-word fragments, with no apparent shared semantics.

patterns.name: Expressions related to single status/relationship status
patterns.context: Appears respectively in contexts about a contraceptive product and a monogamous relationship, entrepreneurial identity, and doctor-patient relationships.

patterns.name: Become followed by identity or state
patterns.context: First-person accounts describe work experience or a change in state; trigger positions do not fully match.

patterns.name: Grammatical segmentation and fragment triggers
patterns.context: Activations occur at line breaks, sentence-initial function words, and across subword boundaries; they may reflect positional or tokenization features and cannot be explained by a common topic.

patterns.name: Cosmetics and personal interests
patterns.context: A personal account shifts from starting to buy lipstick to becoming obsessed with collecting it; the topic has little apparent connection to other paragraphs.

patterns.name: Insurance definitions and categories
patterns.context: An encyclopedia text defines insurance and risk sharing, then introduces health insurance and copayments.

patterns.name: Balancing babies, family, and careers
patterns.context: Discusses trade-offs among childcare, a spouse staying home to provide care, and personal career development.

patterns.name: Trailing fragment and low-relevance content
patterns.context: A hockey player entry followed by a personal-life section; markers mainly fall on common function words, with no clear topic trigger.

9_2290.concept: 功能词与子词片段的混合响应
9_2290.description: 激活散见于常见功能词、换行和词内子词片段；内容涉及关系状态、照护、保险、家庭职业、妆品及葡语词形，未形成稳定统一语义。

patterns.name: 关系／领域词后的冠词介词组合

patterns.context: 说明关系、照护、保险或社会组织时，功能词在名词短语中被标记；不同领域的名词本身不一致
patterns.domain: 学术摘要、百科说明及一般叙述

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语形态与词内分段
patterns.context: 出现在葡萄牙语哲学文本或语言名称列表中；激活落在词内片段，未显现共同语义

patterns.name: 单身／关系状态相关表达
patterns.context: 分别出现在避孕产品的单一伴侣关系、创业者身份及医患关系语境中

patterns.name: become 后接身份或状态
patterns.trigger: “I’ve been working”“becoming an unbalanced workaholic”“I’ve become a little obsessed”
patterns.context: 第一人称叙述中描述工作经历或状态变化；触发位置并不完全相同
patterns.domain: 论坛及个人博客风格叙述

patterns.name: 语法性切分及碎片触发
patterns.trigger: “↵”“in”“In”等高频短 token，以及词内片段如“mon”“hist”“ins”
patterns.context: 激活分布于换行、句首功能词和跨子词切分处，可能反映位置或分词特征，不能由主题统一解释

patterns.name: 妆品与个人兴趣
patterns.context: 个人叙述从开始购买口红转向着迷收藏；与其他段落的主题联系不明显

patterns.name: 保险定义及类别

patterns.name: 婴儿、家庭与职业平衡
patterns.context: 谈论育儿、配偶居家照护及个人职业发展之间的取舍

patterns.name: 末尾残片与低相关内容
patterns.context: 冰球球员条目及随后个人生活小节；标记主要落在常见功能词，未见明确主题触发词

en.description: The strongest common clue is a transition in career identity or status (becoming, started working, turned professional), especially an independent research career. Other activation is scattered across medical research, occupational categories, language names, and Portuguese historical terms, without a unified meaning.

patterns.name: becoming/career identity
patterns.context: Strong responses cluster around “becoming an …” and the following noun phrase denoting an identity, occupational role, or status; contexts concern career development, career choices, or research careers.
patterns.domain: Personal career narratives, research career development

patterns.name: Narrative of age and starting work
patterns.context: First-person conversation introduces the experience of starting work through an age comparison; activation falls near “was”.

patterns.name: Doctor–patient relationship research wording
patterns.context: An academic abstract discusses doctor–patient relationships, communication, or research design; notable activation occurs around “in many”.

patterns.name: Institutional personnel category terms
patterns.context: A list or regulatory context enumerates business categories such as manufacturers, assemblers, importers, and distributors; activation is concentrated on the in-word fragment “Im”.

patterns.name: Representation in medical professions
patterns.context: Discusses the underrepresentation of population groups in medicine, dentistry, allied health fields, and academia; strong activation falls on “dental”.

patterns.name: Portuguese place/language name
patterns.context: A page listing languages and their local written names in HTML language preferences; activation falls on “Rom”.

patterns.name: Portuguese word form for “historical interweaving”
patterns.context: Portuguese philosophical discussion describes an unintended result formed by the interweaving of many historical actions; activation falls on “hist”.

patterns.name: Becoming a professional player in a biography
patterns.context: A biography narrates an athlete's birth information and early career before becoming a professional; activation is concentrated on “turned”.

9_2290.description: 最强共同线索是职业身份或状态的转变（becoming、started working、turned professional），尤其科研独立职业；其余激活分散于医学研究、职业类别、语言名和葡语历史词等局部片段，缺乏统一语义。

patterns.name: becoming／career身份
patterns.trigger: becoming an unbalanced workaholic；becoming a successful independent researcher；to become an independent investigator
patterns.context: 强响应集中在“becoming an …”及其后表示身份、职业角色或状态的名词短语；上下文谈职业发展、职业选择或研究生涯。
patterns.domain: 个人职业叙述、科研职业发展

patterns.name: 年龄与工作起步叙述
patterns.trigger: older than you and started working professionally when I was your age
patterns.context: 第一人称对话中以年龄比较引出开始工作的经历；激活落在“was”附近。

patterns.name: doctor–patient关系研究措辞
patterns.trigger: in many studies, doctors and patients
patterns.context: 学术摘要中讨论医生与患者关系、沟通或研究设计；明显激活出现在“in many”一带。
patterns.domain: 医学／健康服务研究摘要

patterns.name: 机构人员类别词
patterns.context: 列表或法规语境中列举制造商、装配商、进口商、经销商等商业类别；激活集中在词内片段“Im”。

patterns.name: 医疗职业代表性
patterns.trigger: underrepresented in medical and dental professions
patterns.context: 讨论人口群体在医疗、牙科、相关健康领域及学术界的代表性不足；强激活落在“dental”。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生／人口统计论述

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语地名／语言名
patterns.context: HTML语言偏好页面中列举语言及其本地书写名称；激活落在“Rom”。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语“历史交织”词形
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语哲学论述中，描述由众多历史行动交织形成的非预期结果；激活落在“hist”。

patterns.name: 人物传记中的转为职业球手
patterns.context: 传记以出生信息和早期生涯叙述运动员成为职业选手；激活集中在“turned”。

en.description: Activations are scattered across within-word subwords, common function words, and varied narrative or technical contexts; a few fragments show becoming, first-person experience, or domain-specific phrases, but they cannot be explained by a unified trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Within-word becoming
patterns.context: First-person narratives describe gradual changes in state or identity; become/becoming often appears near the present perfect or progressive tense.

patterns.name: Verb phrases about experience and growth
patterns.context: First-person accounts reflect on growing up or describe ongoing experience; activation falls on a verb or auxiliary.

patterns.name: Embedded Portuguese character fragments
patterns.context: In an HTML list of language names, activations cover character fragments in segmented language names.
patterns.domain: GitHub page source, language/media preference settings

patterns.name: Middle of a monogamous relationship term
patterns.context: Describes relationship type; activation is concentrated across multiple adjacent subword fragments within the word.

patterns.name: Month phrase
patterns.context: A personal-information section in an encyclopedia biography begins with a month phrase.

patterns.name: Routine/dental phrases in titles and abstracts
patterns.context: Titles and abstracts describe dental visits, tooth loss, and oral health among older adults; activations fall on technical terms and population words.

patterns.name: Result connective in technical text
patterns.context: Explains difficulties in device processing and their consequences; activation occurs in a result-introducing phrase.

patterns.name: Blog author self-introduction
patterns.context: Introduces personal identity, family role, and place of residence in the first person.

patterns.name: No stable local trigger pattern
patterns.context: Words occur across negative sentences, Q&A titles, dietary narratives, and ordinary phrases, with no shared local semantic or syntactic condition.

9_2290.description: 激活分散在词内子词、常见功能词及不同叙述/技术语境中；少数片段呈现 becoming、第一人称经历或特定领域词组，但无法解释为统一触发规律。

patterns.name: 词内 becoming
patterns.trigger: “become”后的«become»、«becoming»；另有“become a little obsessed”“I’m becoming much smarter”
patterns.context: 第一人称叙述状态或身份逐渐转变，become/becoming 常处于现在完成时或进行时附近

patterns.name: 经历与成长的动词短语
patterns.trigger: «grew»“I grew up surrounded by the arts”；«been»“I’ve been working”
patterns.context: 第一人称回顾成长或描述持续经历，激活落在动词或助动词

patterns.name: 嵌入式葡萄牙语字符片段
patterns.context: HTML 语言名称列表中，激活覆盖被拆分的语言名字符片段
patterns.domain: GitHub 页面源码、语言/媒体偏好设置

patterns.name: 单偶关系词中段
patterns.context: 描述关系类型，激活集中在单词内部多个相邻子词片段

patterns.name: 月份短语
patterns.context: 百科人物传记的个人信息段落，以月份时间短语开头

patterns.name: 标题与摘要中的 routine/dental 词组
patterns.context: 标题及摘要描述老年人牙科就诊、牙齿损失和口腔健康；激活落在专业术语和人群词上

patterns.name: 技术文本中的结果连接词
patterns.context: 说明设备处理困难及其后果，激活在结果引导语中

patterns.name: 博客作者自我介绍
patterns.trigger: «I'm»«a»“I’m Whitney and I’m a blogger, mother and wife”
patterns.context: 以第一人称介绍个人身份、家庭角色与居住地

patterns.name: 未见稳定局部触发模式
patterns.context: 各词分布于否定句、问答标题、饮食叙述及普通短语，未显示共同的局部语义或句法条件

en.description: Activations commonly occur in personal accounts and biographies, and also cover Portuguese or language names, web-format markers, and contexts such as relationship health, biography, and mental health policy. No clear, unified semantic trigger is apparent across samples.

patterns.name: Self-introductions and personal experiences
patterns.context: First-person accounts of personal identity, upbringing, work experience, or seeking advice; common in Q&A, interviews, and personal biographies.

patterns.name: Portuguese and other-language text
patterns.context: Occurs in Portuguese body text or webpage language selectors; activations fall on subword fragments of words with diacritics and language names.

patterns.name: Layout and formatting boundaries
patterns.context: Near page line breaks, section headings, or post titles, including webpage structure or text segmentation.

patterns.name: Relationship and sexual health discussions
patterns.context: Discusses contraceptive products and their use in committed relationships.

patterns.name: Biographical accounts of historical figures
patterns.context: Describes a person's identity, aliases, and personal relationships.

patterns.name: Mental health policy terminology
patterns.context: Discusses the community mental health services market and related policy administration.

9_2290.description: 激活常见于个人自述与简介，也覆盖葡萄牙语或语言名称、网页格式标记，以及关系健康、传记和心理健康政策等语境；不同样本间未见统一的明确语义触发点。

patterns.name: 自我介绍与个人经历
patterns.trigger: “I'm a struggling single-founder”“I am asking”“I grew up”“I was”
patterns.context: 第一人称叙述个人身份、成长背景、工作经历或寻求建议；常见于问答、访谈和个人简介。
patterns.domain: Hacker News、访谈、博客个人简介

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语及其他语言文本
patterns.context: 出现在葡萄牙语正文或网页语言选择器中；激活落在带变音符号的词及语言名称的子词上。

patterns.name: 版面与格式边界

patterns.name: 关系与性健康讨论
patterns.context: 讨论避孕产品及其在固定伴侣关系中的用途。

patterns.name: 历史人物传记叙述
patterns.context: 描述人物身份、别名及人生关系。

patterns.name: 心理健康政策术语
patterns.context: 讨论社区心理健康服务市场及相关政策管理。

en.description: Activations commonly occur in first-person personal bios and accounts of growing up, as well as author biographies, teaching introductions, relationship discussions, and soccer-player biographies; scattered triggers also appear in blog navigation, reading, home decor, interviews, and help-seeking text, without a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: “I’m/I am” identity statements in personal bios
patterns.context: Personal bios or self-introductions use the first person to state age, interests, family role, or professional/entrepreneurial status; often follows a heading such as About Me.
patterns.domain: Blog bios, interviews, HackerNews help-seeking posts

patterns.name: Background on growing up
patterns.context: Uses grow up to describe personal upbringing or early interests.

patterns.name: About biography
patterns.context: A webpage About section begins with a name, followed by a third-person biography or identity information.

patterns.name: English teaching and learning outcomes
patterns.context: Introduces tutoring children, learning progress, or English skills training, often listing structured teaching activities.

patterns.name: Monogamous in a relationship and contraception context
patterns.context: Monogamous appears in discussion of contraceptive products and relationship types; activation is concentrated on fragments within the word.

patterns.name: Biography of a Greek soccer player
patterns.context: In a Wikipedia biography, a compound nationality/ethnicity adjective describes a soccer player after birth information.

patterns.name: Web navigation and greetings not assigned to a clear pattern
patterns.context: Scattered occurrences in a blog header, navigation, or greeting, with no confirmed shared triggering context nearby.

patterns.name: Book reviews and reading not assigned to a clear pattern
patterns.context: Blog writing about collecting and rereading classic works; its relation to other high-activation patterns is unclear.

patterns.name: Interview opening not assigned to a clear pattern
patterns.context: An interviewer thanks the interviewee and asks about their artistic background; there is insufficient evidence to treat it as the same trigger mechanism as the growing-up narratives.

patterns.name: Nostalgic home-decor description not assigned to a clear pattern
patterns.context: In home-decor writing, materials and textures evoke memories of the countryside.

patterns.name: Entrepreneurship consulting request not assigned to a clear pattern
patterns.context: An HN help-seeking post asks about short-term consulting work; although the same paragraph contains personal details, the question itself has no clear pattern.

patterns.name: Blog sign-off not assigned to a clear pattern
patterns.context: A reading wish after a blog comment disclosure.

patterns.name: Greek identity and occupational word fragments not assigned to a clear pattern
patterns.context: A biography contains birth date, nationality/ethnicity, and soccer-career information, but there are only two examples and the more specific triggering boundary is unclear.

9_2290.description: 激活常见于第一人称个人简介与成长叙述，也出现在作者履历、教学介绍、关系讨论及足球运动员传记；另有博客导航、读书、家居、访谈和求助文本等零散触发，未形成统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 个人简介中的“I’m/I am”身份介绍

patterns.name: 成长背景叙述
patterns.trigger: “I grew up surrounded by the arts”“that grew up”
patterns.context: 以 grow up 描述个人成长经历或早年兴趣

patterns.name: About 人物简介
patterns.context: 网页 About 区块以姓名开头，随后给出第三人称履历或身份信息

patterns.name: 英语教学与学习成效
patterns.trigger: “working with children”“helping them to make progress and achieve”“Improving English skills”
patterns.context: 介绍辅导儿童、学习进步或英语技能训练，常列出结构化教学活动

patterns.name: 关系与避孕语境中的 monogamous
patterns.context: 讨论避孕产品及关系类型时出现 monogamous，激活集中于该词内部片段

patterns.name: 希腊裔足球运动员传记
patterns.context: 维基百科人物条目中，出生信息之后以国籍/族裔复合形容词描述足球运动员

patterns.name: 未能归入明确模式的网页导航及问候
patterns.context: 博客页眉、导航或问候语中零散出现，周围没有可确认的共同触发语境

patterns.name: 未能归入明确模式的书评与阅读
patterns.context: 关于收藏并重读经典作品的博客文字；与其余高激活模式关联不明

patterns.name: 未能归入明确模式的访谈开场
patterns.trigger: “Hi Sascha, thank you for speaking with us”“your background in the arts”
patterns.context: 采访者向受访者致谢并询问其艺术背景；未见足够证据将其与成长叙述视为同一触发机制

patterns.name: 未能归入明确模式的家居怀旧描述
patterns.trigger: “evokes for them memories of the Tuscan countryside”
patterns.context: 家居装修文字中，材质与质感唤起对乡村的回忆

patterns.name: 未能归入明确模式的创业咨询请求
patterns.trigger: “Any tips on finding short term consulting gigs?”
patterns.context: HN求助帖询问短期咨询工作机会；虽同段含个人自述，问题句自身模式不明

patterns.name: 未能归入明确模式的博客阅读结束语
patterns.context: 博客评论说明后的阅读祝语

patterns.name: 未能归入明确模式的希腊裔身份与职业词片段
patterns.context: 传记条目包含出生日期、国籍/族裔及足球职业信息，但仅两例且更具体触发边界不明

en.description: Primarily responds to “I’m a” in first-person self-introductions, followed by descriptions of identity, age, or interests; also activates after become followed by an identity or relationship, and on the initial fragment of Improve. The Linda biography in segment 4 has no clear corresponding trigger.

patterns.name: “I'm a” self-introductions
patterns.context: First-person copula in a personal biography or account; often followed by descriptions of identity, age, interests, or personality. There are also examples of “Im” and “proving” split across words, whose relation to self-introductions is uncertain.
patterns.domain: Personal biographies, blog accounts, forum posts; also investment news

patterns.name: Age expressions
patterns.context: An age number is linked to “year old,” “older,” or an age range to describe the speaker.

patterns.name: Statements about identity or interests
patterns.context: First-person descriptions of personality, identity, or hobbies; partially overlaps with age expressions in biographies.
patterns.domain: Dating profiles, blog biographies, forums, interest blogs

patterns.name: Identity or relationship after become
patterns.context: In historical accounts, describes a person's social recognition or relationship status after the copula become.

patterns.name: Initial Im/Im-prove fragment
patterns.context: Improve/improvements are split across tokens, with activation on the initial fragment; subsequent forms and contexts differ, possibly reflecting tokenization or spelling-boundary effects.

9_2290.concept: 自我介绍中的身份陈述
9_2290.description: 主要响应第一人称自我介绍中的“I’m a”及身份、年龄、兴趣描述；另在become后接身份或关系、以及Improve词首片段上激活。段4的Linda简介没有明显对应触发。

patterns.name: “I'm a”自我介绍
patterns.context: 个人简介或自述中出现第一人称系词；多段后续描述身份、年龄、兴趣或性格。另有“Im”“proving”跨词切分的例子，不能确定与自我介绍同因。
patterns.domain: 个人简介、博客自述、论坛发言；另有投资新闻

patterns.name: 年龄表达
patterns.context: 年龄数字与“year old”“older”或年龄段相连，描述本人。

patterns.name: 身份或兴趣自述

patterns.name: become 后接身份或关系

patterns.name: 词首 Im/Im-prove 片段
patterns.context: Improve/improvements 被跨 token 拆分，激活落在词首片段；后续词形和语境不同，可能是分词或拼写边界效应。
patterns.domain: 英语学习宣传；公司业绩新闻

en.description: Primarily occurs in copular self-descriptions in personal bios, especially “I’m/I am a” followed by identity, age, hobbies, and other descriptions; there are also local fragment activations in an English-improvement word, monogamous, and within Darmstadt.

patterns.name: “I am/a” structure in personal bios
patterns.context: In a blog sidebar, About Me, self-introduction, dating profile, or other personal bio, a copula introduces identity, age, occupation, hobbies, or personality.

patterns.name: Ongoing English-skills word
patterns.context: The word is marked as segmented; occurs in a context about learning English and improving skills.

patterns.name: Letter fragment within a word
patterns.context: Activation falls within the segmented “monogamous,” near “relationships.”
