patterns.name: Letter fragment within a proper noun
patterns.context: Activation occurs within a German city name in a paper's materials and methods description.

9_2290.description: 主要出现在个人简介的系动词自述结构中，尤其是“I’m/I am a”及后续身份、年龄、爱好等描述；另有提高英语词、monogamous和Darmstadt内部的局部片段激活。

patterns.name: 个人简介中的“I am/a”结构
patterns.trigger: “I’m a”“I am a”“Linda is a”及其后的身份或自我描述，如“blogger, mother and wife”“29 year old bookworm”“huge coffee fan”
patterns.context: 博客侧栏或 About Me、自我介绍、交友档案等个人简介中，以系动词引出身份、年龄、职业、爱好或性格
patterns.domain: 博客、个人主页、交友档案

patterns.name: 进行中的英语技能词
patterns.context: 词被拆分标记；位于英语学习、提高技能的语境中

patterns.name: 单词内部的字母片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的“monogamous”内部，邻近“relationships”

patterns.name: 专名中的字母片段
patterns.context: 激活位于德国城市名内部，出现在论文材料与实验方法描述中

en.description: Most segments activate near “I am/I’m a” in first-person introductions, followed by a personal identity or characteristic; other activations occur within a token, on a Portuguese legal word fragment, and on numbers in LaTeX fractions.

patterns.name: “I am a…” in self-introductions
patterns.context: First-person self-introductions followed by age, identity, interests, or personal traits; also includes state descriptions such as “I’m a struggling…”.
patterns.domain: Personal blogs, dating profiles, job-seeking/startup forums, lawyer biographies

patterns.name: Within a word spelled letter by letter
patterns.context: A word is split into multiple tokens, with activation on the initial substring “Im” rather than the complete word; here it forms “Improving”.

patterns.name: Portuguese legal vocabulary
patterns.context: Portuguese sentences discuss provisions related to fair trials, with multiple words split into subword tokens; strong activations cover fragments of “relativas,” “julgamentos,” “justos,” and other words.

patterns.name: Numbers and fraction structures in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: In LaTeX mathematical formulas, fraction commands and numbers occur within nested radical and fraction expressions.

9_2290.description: 多数段落在第一人称介绍中于“I am/I’m a”附近激活，后接个人身份或特点；另有分词内部、葡语司法词片段及LaTeX分数数字激活。

patterns.name: 自我介绍中的“I am a…”
patterns.context: 第一人称自我介绍，随后给出年龄、身份、兴趣或个人特点；也包括“I’m a struggling…”等状态描述。
patterns.domain: 个人博客、交友资料、求职/创业论坛、律师简介

patterns.name: 逐字母拼出的词内部
patterns.context: 词被分成多个 token，激活落在词首子串“Im”而非完整词上；此处构成“Improving”。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语司法词汇
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语句子谈及公平审判相关规定，多个词被拆分成子词 token；强激活覆盖“relativas”“julgamentos”“justos”等词片段。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会葡萄牙语法律文本

patterns.name: 数学公式中的数字与分数结构
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学公式中，分数命令和数字位于嵌套根式、分式表达式内。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文中的数学排版

en.description: Activations are scattered across within-word segmented fragments (especially English Im- and Portuguese legal word forms); they also occur in self-descriptions with I'm/a and I am, and in name introductions such as Linda is. Other local fragments may reflect tokenization or formatting noise.

patterns.name: Within-word Im- prefix and following word segment
patterns.context: Triggers when a word is split into Im and a following part; in these examples the continuations are improving, improve, and imperfections.
patterns.domain: English education, self-description, business financial reports, synthetic diamond discussion; paragraphs 1, 6, 7, 9

patterns.name: Segmented fragments in Portuguese legal word forms
patterns.context: Sentences in Portuguese EU legal text concerning the right to a fair trial and relevant European provisions; activations fall on multiple within-word fragments and words.

patterns.name: English pronoun and copula combinations
patterns.context: In first-person self-introductions or statements about personal circumstances, I'm/a or I am is followed by an identity, state, or evaluation; especially evident in paragraphs 3, 4, 5, 9, and 10.
patterns.domain: HackerNews posts, personal bios, beauty blogs, coffee reviews

patterns.name: Linda is in a personal bio
patterns.context: An author bio following a home article begins with a name and describes educational background.

patterns.name: Within-word -ments and neighboring preposition
patterns.context: A financial-report quotation includes “Improvements in key areas”; may relate to within-word segmentation or local collocation.

patterns.name: Unclearly grouped word fragments and formatting symbols
patterns.context: Scattered within-word fragments in Portuguese and tildes and spelling fragments in the diamond paragraph; context does not reveal a distinct trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Portuguese parliamentary text; HackerNews formatted discussion

9_2290.description: 激活分散于词内切分片段（尤其英语 Im- 及葡语法律词形），也见自述中的 I'm/a、I am 和姓名介绍 Linda is；其余局部片段可能是分词或格式噪声。

patterns.name: 词内 Im- 前缀及后续词段
patterns.context: 词被切分为 Im 与后续部分时触发；这些例子中后续分别是 improving、improve、imperfections。
patterns.domain: 英语教育、自述、商业财报、合成钻石讨论；段1、6、7、9

patterns.name: 葡语法律词形中的切分片段
patterns.context: 葡语欧盟法律文本中，涉及公平审判权及欧洲相关规定的句子；激活落在多个词内片段及词上。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 葡语法律/政策文本

patterns.name: 英文人称与系词组合
patterns.context: 第一人称自我介绍或个人处境陈述中，I'm/a 或 I am 后接身份、状态、评价；段3、4、5、9、10尤其明显。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 帖文、个人简介、美妆博客、咖啡评论

patterns.name: 人物简介中的 Linda is
patterns.context: 家居文章的作者简介中，以姓名开头介绍教育背景。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 家居博客人物简介

patterns.name: 英语词内 -ments 及邻近介词
patterns.context: 财报引述中出现“Improvements in key areas”这一表达；可能与词内切分或局部搭配有关。

patterns.name: 未能明确归并的词片段与格式符
patterns.context: 零散的葡语词内片段，以及钻石段中的波浪线和拼写片段；难以从上下文确定独立触发条件。
patterns.domain: 葡语议会文本；HackerNews 的格式化讨论

en.concept: Local word forms and phrase collocations
en.description: Activations show several local patterns: Im- tokenization boundaries, I’m a descriptions in self-introductions, become state phrases, Portuguese legal phrasing, patent trend statements, and more than quantity comparisons. Common words also show sporadic activations.

patterns.name: Tokenization boundary at the Im- prefix
patterns.context: Im is followed by improving or improvements; activations fall on the split initial word part and subsequent morphemes.
patterns.domain: English personal introductions, educational copy, and financial news

patterns.name: First-person self-description after be
patterns.context: In self-introductions or personal accounts, I’m/Im is followed by a and a description of identity, personality, or state; activation spans adjacent words.

patterns.name: State or credential after become
patterns.context: Describes a gradually developing state or a formal credential after become/becoming; activation covers become and the following phrase.

patterns.name: European Parliament Portuguese legal phrasing
patterns.context: Portuguese text discusses fair trials and related provisions, with recurring legal terms and Portuguese word segmentation.

patterns.name: Trend adverbial phrase in patent background
patterns.context: States that home computer processing power is increasing, in comparison with mainframes and workstations; activations concentrate at the sentence beginning and on degree adverbs.

patterns.name: Geographic quantity comparison phrase
patterns.context: Uses more than to introduce the number of regions covered in a media program or copyright business description.
patterns.domain: Film and television business promotional copy

patterns.name: Cross-segment general word-form cues
patterns.context: Common function words and tokenization boundaries occur in different contexts; apart from local collocations, there is no consistent semantic condition across all segments.

9_2290.description: 激活呈现多种局部模式：Im-分词边界、自我介绍中的 I’m a 描述、become 状态短语，以及葡语法律措辞、专利趋势陈述和 more than 数量比较；高频词也有零散激活。

patterns.name: 辅音前缀 Im- 的分词边界
patterns.context: Im 后接 improving 或 improvements；激活落在被拆分的词首及后续词素上。
patterns.domain: 英语个人介绍、教育文案和财经新闻

patterns.name: be 动词后的第一人称自我描述
patterns.trigger: «I»«'m»« a»« struggling»« single»-«founder»；«I»«'m»« a»« lot» older；«Im»« a»« fun»« guy»
patterns.context: 自我介绍或个人经历叙述中，I’m/Im 后接 a 与身份、性格或状态描述；激活横跨相邻词。

patterns.name: become 后接状态或资历
patterns.trigger: «become»« a»« little»« obsessed»；«becoming»« officially»« trained»« and»« qualified»
patterns.context: become/becoming 后描述逐渐形成的状态，或取得正式资历；激活覆盖 become 及后续短语。
patterns.domain: 美妆博客、职业服务介绍

patterns.name: 欧洲议会葡语法律措辞
patterns.context: 葡语谈论公平审判及相关规定，带有重复的法律术语和葡语词素拆分。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会法律／政策文本

patterns.name: 专利背景中的趋势副词短语
patterns.trigger: «As»« the»« average» processing power« of» home computers« has»« increased»« tremend»«ously»
patterns.context: 陈述家用计算机处理能力提高，并与大型机、工作站比较；激活集中在句首及程度副词。

patterns.name: 地理数量比较短语
patterns.trigger: air«ing»« in»« more»« than»« 160»« territories»« worldwide»
patterns.context: 媒体节目或版权业务介绍中，用 more than 引出覆盖地区数。

patterns.name: 跨文段的泛化词形线索
patterns.context: 不同语境中出现的高频功能词及分词边界；除局部搭配外，没有在全部片段中一致的语义条件。

en.concept: Irregular word fragments and local collocations
en.description: Activations most prominently occur within segmented forms of improve; other local patterns include help-seeking self-descriptions, corporate signatures, in in technical contexts, fragments of long medical words, and Linda bios. The latter categories lack unified semantics or syntax.

patterns.name: Segmented Improv(e) forms within words
patterns.context: Activations fall within tokenized forms of improve/improving/improvements/Improvely; they occur at sentence openings, in quotations, or in proper nouns, without requiring fixed syntax.
patterns.domain: Educational introductions, business financial reports, technology blogs

patterns.name: Help-seeker self-description after an article
patterns.context: In a forum title or help-seeking post, I’m is followed by a struggling single-founder; activation is concentrated on the article and adjacent self-description.

patterns.name: Corporate communication compound segmentation
patterns.context: Corporate Communications in a formal signature is split into within-word fragments; adjacent to company role and sender signature.

patterns.name: In in contexts of increase or prevalence
patterns.context: The preposition in indicates the field in which something grows, a basis for comparison, or prevalence in technical descriptions; strong activation falls on in, while neighboring collocations vary.

patterns.name: Within-word segmentation of medical proper nouns
patterns.context: Activation occurs on internal subword fragments of long medical terms, respectively in an occupation introduction and a biography's account of medical training.

patterns.name: Linda in a personal bio
patterns.context: An author bio after home-related content begins with the name Linda and notes her graduation background.

9_2290.concept: 不规则词片段与局部搭配
9_2290.description: 激活最显著地出现在被切分的 improve 词形；另涉及求助帖自述、企业署名、技术语境中的 in、医学长词片段及 Linda 简介等局部模式。后几类缺乏统一语义或句法。

patterns.name: 词内切分的 Improv(e) 词形
patterns.context: 激活落在跨 token 切分的 improve/improving/improvements/Improvely 词形内部；出现在句首、引文或专名中，不要求固定句法。
patterns.domain: 教育介绍、商业财报、科技博客

patterns.name: 冠词后的求助者自述
patterns.context: 论坛标题或求助帖中，I’m 后接 a struggling single-founder；激活集中在冠词及相邻自我描述。

patterns.name: 企业通信复合词切分
patterns.context: 正式署名中的 Corporate Communications 被分成词内片段；与公司职务、发件人署名相邻。

patterns.name: 增加或普及语境中的 in
patterns.context: 技术说明中表示增长所处领域、比较基准或普及程度的介词 in；强激活落在 in，邻近搭配不完全相同。

patterns.name: 医学专名词内切分
patterns.context: 激活出现在医学相关长词的内部子词片段；分别处于职业介绍和传记中的医疗训练叙述。

patterns.name: 个人简介中的 Linda
patterns.context: 家居内容后的作者简介，以姓名 Linda 起句，并说明其毕业背景。

en.description: Activations fall on substrings of various words or on common words: Improving/Improvements, Corporate, become, in, am, and ’m a in forum self-descriptions; increase also appears in company mission copy. Trigger forms and contexts are not consistent.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment “Im”
patterns.context: The trigger occurs at the beginning of a word, with subsequent fragments completing “Improving” or “Improvements”; surrounding text concerns English skills or business improvement.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment “Cor”
patterns.context: Occurs before a company department or job-title signature, forming “Corporate”; adjacent to “Credit and Financial Services” or “Communications”.

patterns.name: “become” and following words
patterns.context: Describes a change in experience or state in a personal account, especially expressions meaning “become a bit…”.

patterns.name: “in” and statements about growth
patterns.context: Describes something as becoming more popular, with the trigger on the preposition “in”.

patterns.name: “am” and self-statements
patterns.context: First-person self-introduction forms such as “I am having Hands-on experience”.

patterns.name: “I’m a”-style opening self-descriptions
patterns.context: Forum posts begin in the first person and state an identity or circumstance, such as “a struggling single-founder” or “a lot older”.

patterns.name: “increase” in company introductions
patterns.context: Describes the benefits of improving healthcare in a company mission statement.

9_2290.description: 激活落在多种词内片段或常见词上：Improving/Improvements、Corporate、become、in、am，以及论坛自述中的’m a；另见公司使命文案中的increase。触发形式和语境并不统一。

patterns.name: 词内片段“Im”
patterns.context: 触发位于单词开头，后续片段继续组成“Improving”或“Improvements”；周边谈英语技能或业务改善。

patterns.name: 词内片段“Cor”
patterns.context: 出现在公司部门或职务署名前，组成“Corporate”；紧邻“Credit and Financial Services”或“Communications”。

patterns.name: “become”及其后续词
patterns.context: 个人叙述中描述经历或状态变化，尤其是“变得有点……”的表达。

patterns.name: “in”及增长表述
patterns.context: 描述某事物的流行度正在上升，触发落在介词“in”上。

patterns.name: “am”及自我陈述
patterns.trigger: «am»，后接第一人称经历或身份陈述
patterns.context: “I am having Hands-on experience”等第一人称自我介绍句式。

patterns.name: “I’m a”类自述开头
patterns.trigger: «'m»后接«a»及个人身份或处境描述
patterns.context: 论坛帖子以第一人称说明自己是某种身份或处境，如“a struggling single-founder”“a lot older”。

patterns.name: 公司介绍中的“increase”
patterns.context: 公司使命陈述中描述提升医疗保健带来的益处。

en.description: Most passages contain increase/increasing/increased or grow, relating to prevalence, demand, quantity, benefits, and projected growth. Other weakly matched examples include a Portuguese reduction cycle, layoff reports, and background on skill improvement and patents.

patterns.name: Growth, increase, and trend expressions
patterns.context: Describes an increase in quantity, demand, prevalence, or degree; sometimes appears in explanations of forecasts, causes, or results.
patterns.domain: Patent background, healthcare, company profiles, education, and general trend descriptions

patterns.name: Portuguese reduction and resource adjustment
patterns.context: Describes shortening a preparation cycle in an account of gradually optimizing resource allocation; directionally opposite to English growth expressions.

patterns.name: Portuguese mass layoff report
patterns.context: Reports mass collective layoffs at a Polish shipyard, with no obvious growth-word trigger.

patterns.name: Local triggers in general introductions or background passages
patterns.context: Near introductions to educational skills or patent-background headings; except for “Increasingly” in [8], the markers do not fall directly on clear growth words and may be unrelated to the growth pattern.

9_2290.concept: 变化趋势词及趋势叙述
9_2290.description: 多数段落含increase/increasing/increased或grow，涉及普及、需求、数量、效益及预测增长；另有葡语减少周期、裁员报道，以及技能改进和专利背景等弱匹配例。

patterns.name: 增长、增加及趋势表述
patterns.trigger: “increase/increasing/increased”（[1] “increasing … in popularity”；[3] “increase the benefits”；[5] “number of handoffs has increased”；[6] “predicted to increase”；[8] “Increasingly”；[10] “demand … is increasing”），以及“grow … in popularity”（[7]）
patterns.context: 描述数量、需求、普及度或程度上升；有时位于预测、原因或结果的说明中。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、医疗健康、企业介绍、教育及一般趋势说明

patterns.name: 葡语减少及资源调整
patterns.context: 在资源分配逐步优化的叙述中，描述缩短准备周期；与英语增长表达方向相反。

patterns.name: 葡语集体裁员报道
patterns.trigger: “anúncios de planos de despedimentos colectivos”；并出现“80 000 trabalhadores”及“estaleiros polacos”（[2]）
patterns.context: 报道波兰船厂的大规模集体裁员，未见明显的增长词形触发。
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语欧洲议会文本

patterns.name: 一般介绍或背景段落中的局部触发
patterns.context: 教育技能介绍或专利背景标题附近；除[8]的“Increasingly”外，标记未直接落在明确的增长词上，可能与增长模式无关。
patterns.domain: 个人简介/教育介绍、专利文本

en.description: Strong activations fall on substrings of unrelated words, such as As, est, in, ir, and Im, across Portuguese and English and multiple genres. Some occur only once; no stable semantic or syntactic pattern explains them as a whole.

patterns.name: As at sentence start or mid-sentence
patterns.context: In English company introductions or promotional copy, As introduces company identity, affiliation, or a subsequent explanation; capitalization varies with syntactic position.

patterns.name: Initial est in Portuguese estaleiros
patterns.context: In a Portuguese sentence about collective layoffs, estaleiros (shipyards) is segmented, with activation on the initial substring est.
patterns.domain: European Parliament employment and industry topics

patterns.name: Est in Portuguese Grupo Estudos
patterns.context: Within the proper name “Grupo de Estudos Kinosophia,” Estudos (studies) is segmented, with activation on the initial substring Est.

patterns.name: Preposition in in sentence-final position
patterns.context: English patent background text describes the rapid growth of VoIP's popularity, with in introducing a popularity phrase.

patterns.name: Preposition in in a time adverbial
patterns.context: English medical text describes a growing osteoporosis problem, with in introducing a recent-years time adverbial.

patterns.name: Within-word segmentation of irre
patterns.context: In English discussion of employees losing the relevance of prior jobs, activation falls on the initial substring ir in irrelevant.
patterns.domain: Technology industry employment discussions, forum text

patterns.name: Segmentation of initial Improving
patterns.context: In English-learning promotional text, initial Improving is segmented, with activation on the initial substring Im.

patterns.name: Within-word ir in a verb meaning decrease
patterns.context: In Portuguese discussion of resource allocation and preparation periods, ir is part of the ending of dimin(u)ir (decrease); annotation covers only this within-word substring.
patterns.domain: European Parliament policy or administrative texts

patterns.name: Weak, scattered activations in common words and phrases
patterns.context: Across different languages and syntactic environments, activations are distributed over substrings of common words, function words, and word-form fragments, with no stable, recurring local trigger.
patterns.domain: Mixed: news, corporate copy, patents, medicine, education, and forums

9_2290.description: 强激活落在多种不相干词的子串上：As、est、in、ir、Im 等，跨葡语与英语及多种文体。部分仅单例；未见足以统一解释的稳定语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 句首或句中 As
patterns.context: 英语企业介绍或宣传文案中，As 引出公司身份、归属或后续说明；大小写因句法位置不同。
patterns.domain: 企业网站介绍、公司宣传

patterns.name: 葡语 estaleiros 前的 est
patterns.context: 葡语关于集体裁员的句子中，estaleiros（船厂）被切分，激活落在词首子串 est。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会就业与产业议题

patterns.name: 葡语 Grupo Estudos 中的 Est
patterns.context: 专名“Grupo de Estudos Kinosophia”内，Estudos（研究）被切分，激活落在词首子串 Est。

patterns.name: 介词 in 的句末位置
patterns.context: 英语专利背景文字描述 VoIP 流行度迅速上升，in 引出 popularity 短语。

patterns.name: 介词 in 的时间状语
patterns.context: 英语医学文字描述骨质疏松问题增长时，in 引出近期年份时间状语。

patterns.name: 词内 irre 的切分
patterns.context: 英语关于员工前职失去相关性的讨论中，激活落在 irrelevant 的词首子串 ir。
patterns.domain: 技术行业就业讨论、论坛文字

patterns.name: 词首 Improving 的切分
patterns.context: 英语学习宣传文字中，句首 Improving 被切分，激活落在词首子串 Im。
patterns.domain: 教育宣传、学习服务文案

patterns.name: 递减动词中的词内 ir
patterns.context: 葡语谈资源配置和准备周期时，ir 是 dimin(u)ir（减少）词尾的一部分；标注仅覆盖该词内子串。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会政策或行政文本

patterns.name: 一般词语或短语中的弱分散激活
patterns.trigger: 如“«cent»6ros”“«trabal»6had«ores»5”“«in»9 popularity”“«in»9 recent years”之外的多种词内切分；本组较弱而无明确共同词项
patterns.context: 不同语言和句法环境中，激活分布在普通词的子串、功能词及词形片段上，未显示稳定复现的局部触发条件。
patterns.domain: 混合：新闻、企业文案、专利、医学、教育及论坛

en.description: Activation mainly falls on segmented strings: English words for increase and words related to anesthesiology/aesthetic; there is also a Portuguese Est segment across parliamentary, academic, and bibliographic texts, with no clear semantic link.

patterns.name: anesthesiology and its intra-word segmentation
patterns.context: Names of medical specialties or related adjectives are split into multiple subwords in English; examples include paper author affiliations, descriptions of research subjects, and discussions related to plastic surgery.
patterns.domain: Medicine, anesthesiology papers, and medical news

patterns.name: Intra-word segmentation of the English verb increase
patterns.context: English forms of increase/increasingly are split into subwords and occur sentence-initially or in contexts describing growth or improvement.

patterns.name: Est segment in Portuguese
patterns.context: The string Est appears within Portuguese words across different forms and meanings; the current data is insufficient to confirm a unified semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Parliamentary text, academic profiles, bibliographic citations

9_2290.description: 激活主要落在被切分的字符串上：英语增加词及 anesthesiology/aesthetic 相关词；另有葡萄牙语 Est 词段，分布于议会、学术和书目文本，语义关联不明确。

patterns.name: anesthesiology及其词内切分
patterns.context: 医学专业名称或相关形容词在英语中被分成多个子词；包括论文作者单位、研究对象描述和整形外科相关讨论。
patterns.domain: 医学、麻醉学论文及医疗新闻

patterns.name: 英语动词增加的词内切分
patterns.context: 英语 increase/increasingly 词形被分成子词，出现在句首或描述增长、提升的语境。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、制药公司介绍

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语中 Est 词段
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语词语中出现 Est 字符串，跨不同词形与语义；当前材料不足以确认统一语义条件。
patterns.domain: 议会文本、学术简介、引文书目

en.description: Activation often falls on intra-word segments of Portuguese Est-/est- and Estudos, as well as on English intra-word segments and various Portuguese verb and noun fragments; it spans domains and lacks consistent semantic conditions. Patent passage 10 has no clear corresponding pattern.

patterns.name: Words related to Estudos
patterns.context: The word Estudos (studies/learning) appears in Portuguese text, especially in names of institutions, groups, or bibliographic entries; activation is concentrated on intra-word segmented tokens.
patterns.domain: Academic profiles, bibliographic citations, and Portuguese parliamentary text

patterns.name: Word-initial Est- string
patterns.context: Portuguese words beginning with est-/Est-; following segments may also activate consecutively. Their meanings and syntactic functions vary.

patterns.name: English intra-word -ing/-ingly segmentation
patterns.context: English words are split into multiple subword tokens, with strong activation on later intra-word segments (such as -asing and -ly); the sentences discuss changes in careers/leisure and the growing popularity of golf, respectively.

patterns.name: Specific inflectional segments
patterns.context: Activation occurs at segmentation points between Portuguese verb stems and endings; examples span different syntactic structures, with no stable single meaning or topic.

patterns.name: Intra-word or boundary segmentation peaks
patterns.context: Activation falls on initial or middle-to-later segments of Portuguese words across different parts of speech and meanings; no consistent semantic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Other isolated segmented words
patterns.context: Highly activated fragments are embedded in ordinary Portuguese words, English words, or phrases, with no recurring meaning or contextual condition evident.
patterns.domain: Parliamentary text, patent background technology, and Q&A text

9_2290.description: 激活多落在葡萄牙语 Est-/est- 与 Estudos 的词内分段，也见英语词内分段及多种葡语动词、名词片段；跨领域且缺少一致语义条件，专利段10无明显对应模式。

patterns.name: Estudos 相关词
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语文本中出现 Estudos（研究/学习）一词，尤其与机构、团体或书目名称相连；激活集中在词内分段 token。
patterns.domain: 学术介绍、书目引文及葡萄牙语议会文本

patterns.name: 词首 Est- 字符串
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语中以 est-/Est- 开头的词，其后续词段也可能接连激活；词义和句法功能不同。

patterns.name: 英语词内 -ing/-ingly 分段
patterns.context: 英语词被拆成多个子词 token，词内后段（如 -asing、-ly）强激活；所处句子分别谈职业/休闲变化和高尔夫普及。

patterns.name: 特定屈折词段
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语动词的词干与词尾分段处出现激活；分布于不同句法结构，没有稳定的单一词义或主题。

patterns.name: 词内或边界处分段峰值
patterns.context: 激活落在葡萄牙语词的前段或中后段，且跨越不同词类与词义；未见一致语义条件。

patterns.name: 其他孤立分段词
patterns.context: 高激活片段分别嵌在普通葡萄牙语词、英语词或短语中，未显示可重复的词义或上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 议会文本、专利背景技术及问答文本

en.concept: Within-word letter fragments and word forms
en.description: Primarily activates on fragments such as est within Portuguese words, common word endings, and verb forms; it also responds to English -ing forms and short fragments in a few English words or proper names. Triggers span multiple genres, with no unified thematic semantics.

patterns.name: Plural words and within-word endings
patterns.context: Mostly word endings or continuous letter fragments within Portuguese words, commonly in plurals, verb conjugations, or noun/adjective suffixes; can also occur within words in other languages.
patterns.domain: Primarily Portuguese political texts, also philosophy, technical texts, and English word forms

patterns.name: Within-word fragment est
patterns.context: Strongly responds to the letter fragment est inside words; examples do not involve the same complete word or require a specific syntactic function.
patterns.domain: Portuguese European Parliament and philosophy texts; also academic titles

patterns.name: English progressive verb forms
patterns.context: English -ing forms, especially initial or within-word fragments connected to the -ing ending; occurs in different sentences and contexts.

patterns.name: Portuguese progressive verb forms
patterns.context: Portuguese progressive verb forms; fragments occur within complete verbs.

patterns.name: Fragments in names
patterns.context: Occurs near names of Portuguese institutions/research groups and personal names; the names themselves are not marked, and activations may arise from letter fragments within them.

patterns.name: Within-word Portuguese fragment ar
patterns.context: A within-word letter substring that does not constitute a clear, independent semantic unit.

patterns.name: Unclassified sporadic within-word activations
patterns.context: Short letter fragments in a small number of English words or proper names; their relationship to the word-form patterns above is uncertain.

9_2290.description: 主要对葡萄牙语词内的 est 等片段、常见词尾及动词词形激活；也对英语 -ing 形式和少数英语/专名中的短片段响应。触发跨越多种文体，未见统一主题语义。

patterns.name: 复数词及词内词形结尾
patterns.context: 多为葡萄牙语词中的词尾或词内连续字母片段，常见于复数、动词变位或名词/形容词后缀；也可能跨语言出现在词中。
patterns.domain: 以葡萄牙语政治文本为主，另见哲学、技术文本及英文词形

patterns.name: 词内片段 est
patterns.context: 对单词内部的字母片段 est 强烈响应；这些例子并非同一个完整词，也不要求特定句法功能。
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语欧洲议会与哲学文本；另见学术标题

patterns.name: 英语进行时词形
patterns.context: 英语 -ing 形式中，特别是词首或词内片段与 -ing 结尾相连；出现于不同句子和语境。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语进行时词形
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语动词进行时词形；片段分散在完整动词内部。

patterns.name: 姓名中的片段
patterns.context: 出现在葡萄牙语机构/研究组名称与人名附近；姓名本身未标记，触发可能来自名称中的字母片段。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词内片段 ar
patterns.context: 词内字母子串，不构成明确独立语义单位。

patterns.name: 未能归类的零散词内激活
patterns.context: 少量英语或专名中的短字母片段；与上述词形模式关系不确定。
patterns.domain: 邮件、技术论坛、医学摘要

en.description: Activation often falls on intra-word subword fragments, especially Portuguese/Spanish words beginning with “Est”; sporadic patterns also occur in “ut” within URLs or words, English becoming, Aesthetic, and Portuguese missile-related terms. The main commonality across passages may be segmentation fragments rather than stable semantics.

patterns.name: Portuguese stem «Est»
patterns.context: Portuguese words are split across subword fragments, especially words beginning with “Est”; examples across different forms include “Estudos”, “estruturas”, “estaleiros”, “Está”, and “Estudios”.
patterns.domain: Portuguese academic profiles, EU parliamentary text, and Spanish bibliographies

patterns.name: «ut» in place names or URLs
patterns.context: In English text, the substring “ut” occurs within a URL domain or ordinary word; no stable semantic or syntactic condition is evident.

patterns.name: English verb becoming
patterns.context: The complete English word “becoming” means gradually turning into or starting to be; it occurs in a sentence describing the rising popularity of organic materials.

patterns.name: «Aest» in a proper name
patterns.context: The subword fragment spans a spelling boundary in the name of the English cosmetic surgery organization “British Association of Aesthetic Plastic Surgeons”.

patterns.name: Word forms related to “missile(s)”
patterns.context: Appears in Portuguese discussions of missile technology; activation is scattered within the word and is not at the strongest position.

patterns.name: Portuguese employment-related phrase
patterns.context: Discusses collective layoffs and affected workers; salient activation is concentrated on “Estaleiros” in the same passage.
patterns.domain: EU parliamentary employment and economic issues

patterns.name: Portuguese parliamentary security narrative
patterns.context: Describes public spaces in parliament and gendarmerie control; activation falls near “Está” and “gendarmer”, with uncertain semantic links.
patterns.domain: EU parliamentary on-site or political narratives

patterns.name: Proper name Kinosophia
patterns.context: Name of a group in a Portuguese academic publishing introduction; activation is concentrated on “Estudos”.

patterns.name: Estudios in a Spanish bibliography
patterns.context: Name of a Spanish institution in a bibliographic entry; activation is concentrated on “Estudios” and adjacent fragments.

patterns.name: Cross-lingual intra-word substring collisions
patterns.context: Activation often falls on letter fragments spanning languages and word forms; most fragments cannot be unified into one semantic category.
patterns.domain: Multilingual web pages, parliamentary text, science and technology, and bibliographic corpora

9_2290.description: 激活多落在词内子词片段，尤以葡语/西语“Est”开头词为突出；另有网址或单词中的“ut”、英文 becoming、Aesthetic 及葡语导弹词等零散模式。跨段主要共性可能是分词片段，而非稳定语义。

patterns.name: 葡语词干 «Est»
patterns.context: 葡语词语跨子词片段切分，尤其是以“Est”开头的词；在不同词形中出现，包括“Estudos”“estruturas”“estaleiros”“Está”“Estudios”。
patterns.domain: 葡语学术介绍、欧盟议会文本及西语书目

patterns.name: 地名或网址中的 «ut»
patterns.context: 英文文本中，子串“ut”位于网址域名或普通单词内部；未见稳定的语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 技术论坛帖子、企业邮件

patterns.name: 英文动词 becoming
patterns.context: 完整英文词“becoming”表示逐渐变得或正在成为，出现在描述有机材料受欢迎程度上升的句子中。

patterns.name: 专名中的 «Aest»
patterns.context: 英文医美机构名称“British Association of Aesthetic Plastic Surgeons”中，子词片段跨拼写切分。

patterns.name: “missile(s)”相关词形
patterns.context: 葡语讨论导弹技术时出现；激活分散在词内，并非最强位置。

patterns.name: 葡语就业相关词组
patterns.context: 讨论集体裁员及受影响工人；显著激活集中在同一段的“Estaleiros”。
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会就业与经济议题

patterns.name: 葡语议会安保叙述
patterns.context: 议会公共空间及宪兵控制的叙述；激活落在“Está”“gendarmer”附近，语义关联不确定。
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会现场或政治叙述

patterns.name: Kinosophia 专名
patterns.context: 葡语学术出版介绍中的团体名称；激活集中于“Estudos”。

patterns.name: 西语书目中的 Estudios
patterns.context: 书目条目中的西语机构名；激活集中在“Estudios”及其相邻片段。

patterns.name: 跨语言词内子串碰撞
patterns.trigger: 各段均有激活的子词片段，如“«Est»”“«ut»”“«Aest»”
patterns.context: 激活常落在跨语言、跨词形的字母片段上；多数片段不能统一归为一个语义类别。
patterns.domain: 多语种网页、议会文本、科技及书目语料

en.description: The most stable tendency is activation on Portuguese Est/est word-initial segments and their cross-segmentation fragments, though these span multiple unrelated word forms. Other examples include intra-word fragments in English I’m, becoming, and smarter, hyphens in compound comparisons, and several isolated Portuguese and English fragments; no unified semantic theme is apparent.

patterns.name: Portuguese word-initial/intra-word fragment “Est”
patterns.context: Activation falls inside words beginning with Est/est, possibly across segmentation boundaries; examples include “Estudos”, “estaleiros”, “estruturas”, “Estadual”, “Estamos”, and “Está”. The pattern is not limited to a single meaning or part of speech.
patterns.domain: Primarily Portuguese, including parliamentary text, educational résumés, dictionary definitions, and academic/publishing information; also “Estudios” in an English reference.

patterns.name: Portuguese first-person plural inflected form
patterns.context: In the complete word “Estamos”, both the initial Est and the suffix/ending amos activate strongly; this occurs only here and is adjacent to the context “preocupados”.
patterns.domain: Portuguese parliamentary speech expressing concern about the development of missile technology.

patterns.name: First-person contraction in English speech
patterns.context: The m in the English first-person contraction I’m is marked; the sentence is a personal account about gradually accepting a way of life.

patterns.name: English present participle ending
patterns.context: Activation occurs on a final fragment of becoming in the progressive predicate “I’m becoming much smarter”; other conspicuous endings in the same sentence are not marked.

patterns.name: English comparative ending
patterns.context: Activation falls on the comparative suffix -er in smarter, adjacent to becoming; similar comparative structures in other English fragments do not show this marker.

patterns.name: Hyphens in English compound comparative structures
patterns.context: Both hyphens occur in repeated higher-than-X compound comparative structures; the same marker appears in both places, but the latter is weaker.
patterns.domain: Reports on utility revenue and asset valuations in Enron emails.

patterns.name: Other isolated intra-word fragments
patterns.context: Scattered within Portuguese words or phrases: como/… (passage 1), gendarmer… (passage 9), sabem/tecnologia (passage 6); there is insufficient evidence to assign them to a common morphological or semantic category.

patterns.name: Opaque English and number-adjacent fragments
patterns.context: Activation involves a middle fragment of English utility, sentence-initial Due, number-adjacent table content, and sentence-initial O; they have no apparent shared trigger condition.
patterns.domain: English Enron emails; StackExchange Portuguese dictionary/table content.

9_2290.description: 最稳定的倾向是激活葡语 Est/est 词首及其跨分词片段，但覆盖多个无关词形。另有英语 I’m、becoming、smarter 的词内片段，复合比较词连字符，以及若干葡语和英语孤立片段；未见统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 葡语词首/片段“Est”
patterns.trigger: 「Est」及其续接片段，如« Est»10«ud»3«os»4、« est»9«ale»2«i»3«ros»4、« est»9«rut»6«uras»5、« Est»9«ad»1«ual»2、«Est»8«amos»7、«Est»8«á»5
patterns.context: 激活落在以 Est/est 开头的词内，可能跨分词边界；涵盖“Estudos”“estaleiros”“estruturas”“Estadual”“Estamos”“Está”等不同词形，并非仅一种词义或词性。
patterns.domain: 以葡萄牙语为主，含议会文本、教育履历、词典释义和学术/出版信息；另见英语参考文献中的 “Estudios”。

patterns.name: 葡语第一人称复数屈折形式
patterns.context: 完整词形“Estamos”中，词首 Est 和后缀/词尾 amos 都强激活；仅见于该处，且邻接“preocupados”等语境。
patterns.domain: 葡语议会发言，谈及对导弹技术发展的担忧。

patterns.name: 英语口语中的第一人称缩写
patterns.context: 英语第一人称缩写 I’m 中的 m 被标记；句子是个人叙述，谈论逐渐接受某种生活状态。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 英语个人/生活类散文。

patterns.name: 英语现在分词词尾
patterns.context: 激活出现在 becoming 的词尾片段，位于 “I’m becoming much smarter” 的进行时谓语中；未标记同句其他明显词尾。

patterns.name: 英语比较级词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在形容词比较级 smarter 的词尾 -er，紧邻 becoming；其他英语片段中的同类比较结构不呈现这一标记。

patterns.name: 英语复合比较结构中的连字符
patterns.context: 两个连字符都位于重复的 higher-than-X 复合比较结构中；两处相同标记，但后一个强度较低。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的公用事业收入和资产估值报道。

patterns.name: 其他孤立词内片段
patterns.trigger: “« com»1« o»1«ito»3”、“« g»7endar»3”及“« sab»4«em»1 a« te»4«cn»4«ologia»2”
patterns.context: 分散在葡语词或词组的内部：como/…（第1段）、gendarmer…（第9段）、sabem/tecnologia（第6段）；没有足够证据归为共同的形态或语义类别。
patterns.domain: 葡语学术简介、议会文本。

patterns.name: 不透明的英语与数字邻接片段
patterns.context: 激活涉及英语 utility 的中间片段、句首 Due，以及表格数字邻接和句首 O；彼此无明显共享触发条件。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件英语；StackExchange 葡语词典/表格内容。

en.concept: Preference for the est spelling fragment
en.description: High activation in multiple passages is concentrated on the letter sequence est or its segmentation variants, especially in Portuguese proper names, institutions, and infrastructure terms; however, fragments in emails and medical terms, and activations on become, the, and Increasing, are difficult to explain with the same rule.

patterns.name: EST/est letter sequence
patterns.context: An est letter sequence, with varying capitalization, appears near the trigger position; it may be split across subwords as est, Est, or estale.
patterns.domain: Portuguese parliamentary text, academic text, and personal résumés

patterns.name: English est substring
patterns.context: The word infra-estrutura contains est in a mixed English/Portuguese EU text.

patterns.name: -est spelling fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls within a segmented proper name or medical term and may form a spelling fragment with adjacent letters.

patterns.name: become near a time expression
patterns.context: Personal, conversational narrative describes a habit or state gradually developing; no obvious est letter sequence is present.

patterns.name: High activation with unclear semantics or segmentation
patterns.context: Appears respectively on the definite article in a dental review and at the beginning of a new paragraph in patent background material; no clear spelling relationship with other highly activated fragments is evident.

9_2290.description: 多段高激活集中在 est 字母序列或其切分变体，尤其见葡语专名、机构及基础设施词；但邮件、医学术语中的片段和 become、the、Increasing 等激活难以由同一规律解释。

patterns.name: EST/est 字母序列
patterns.context: 触发位置附近出现大小写变化的 est 字母序列；可能跨子词切分成 est、Est 或 estale 等
patterns.domain: 葡语议会文本、学术文本及个人履历

patterns.name: 英语 est 子串
patterns.context: 在英语/葡语混合的欧盟文本中，基础设施一词 infra-estrutura 内出现 est

patterns.name: -est 拼写片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被切分的专名或医学术语内部，可能与相邻字母构成拼写片段

patterns.name: 时间表达附近的 become
patterns.context: 个人化、口语化叙述中，描述逐渐形成的习惯或状态；未见明显的 est 字母序列

patterns.name: 语义或切分不明的高激活
patterns.context: 分别出现在牙科综述中的定冠词和专利背景部分的新段落开头，未显示与其他高激活片段一致的明显拼写关系

en.description: Activations occur on subword fragments and common words in multilingual, multidomain text: within-word segmentation in formal Portuguese texts, initial English fragments, function words in business and patent contexts, and domain-name lists. Trigger conditions are not consistent.

patterns.name: Initial fragments in Portuguese/tokenized text
patterns.context: Activations fall within words or near word boundaries, often in Portuguese political, parliamentary, and academic texts; the same type of subword segmentation appears repeatedly, but the specific triggering fragments vary.

patterns.name: Initial English fragments and subsequent word boundaries
patterns.context: Activations occur at the beginning of English words or at within-word segmentation points, as well as on short function words; contexts include medical terms, personal introductions, and consumer product reviews.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, webpage personal introductions, and lifestyle text

patterns.name: Articles and structural words in business organization contexts
patterns.context: In descriptions of company operations and functions, activations are distributed across common function words, verbs, and business nouns; there is no clear evidence that a particular word alone triggers them.

patterns.name: Short strings after domain separators
patterns.context: Several strings resembling website names or paths appear consecutively after periods; activations concentrate on subword fragments within these strings.

patterns.name: Degree and connective words in patent technical text
patterns.context: In patent background descriptions related to semiconductor manufacturing contamination, activations fall on trend descriptions and common connectives.

9_2290.description: 激活分布于多语种、多领域文本的子词片段和常见词：葡语正式文本的词内切分、英语词首片段、商务与专利语境中的功能词，以及域名列表。触发条件不统一。

patterns.name: 葡语/分词化文本中的词首片段
patterns.trigger: 「Est」「est」「dos」「de」「a」「com」等葡语词被拆成子词；如「Est」后接「amos」「a」，「est」后接「rut」；「dos」后接「est」「ale」
patterns.context: 激活落在词内或词边界附近，常见于葡语政治、议会、学术文本；多处呈现同一类子词切分，但具体触发片段并不完全一致

patterns.name: 英语词首片段及后续词界
patterns.context: 激活出现在英语词语的开头或词内切分处，也有短功能词；语境分别是医学名词、人物介绍、消费品评论等
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、网页个人介绍及生活方式文本

patterns.name: 商业组织语境中的冠词与结构词
patterns.context: 企业运营与职能描述中，激活分散在常见功能词、动词和商业名词上；没有明显只由某个单词触发的证据

patterns.name: 域名分隔符后的短字符串
patterns.context: 点号后连续列出多个类似网站名称或路径的字符串，激活集中在这些字符串内部的子词片段

patterns.name: 专利技术文本中的程度与连接词
patterns.context: 半导体制造污染相关的专利背景说明中，激活落在趋势描述和常见连接词上

en.concept: Continuation of letter fragments at word beginnings/within words
en.description: Most activations fall at the beginning of or within Est- words, across various words in formal Portuguese text, medical terms, and domain-name fragments; there are also word-initial activations on two English personal-narrative words, became and grown. Meanings and syntax are not consistent across instances.

patterns.name: Continuation of Portuguese word-initial Est-
patterns.context: Activation falls at the beginning of or within Portuguese words starting with Est-, especially in formal statements or near sentence boundaries; it is not the same complete word each time.
patterns.domain: Formal EuroParl parliamentary text, PhilPapers academic profiles, and educational experience

patterns.name: English word-initial grown
patterns.context: Activation occurs in the phrases “I've grown to learn” or “I’ve grown as a person”, expressing growth or change after experience.

patterns.name: English word-initial became
patterns.context: Appears in the personal-experience expression “I became a wife and mama”.

patterns.name: English medical-term fragment Anesthes-
patterns.context: Occurs in a list of professionals as part of “Anesthesiologists”.

patterns.name: English estate fragment
patterns.context: Appears in the domain list “photosoft.estate”; activation spans components of the domain name.

9_2290.concept: 词首/词内的字母片段续写
9_2290.description: 多数激活落在 Est- 开头或词内，分布于葡萄牙语正式文本的多种词及医学术语、域名片段；另有 became、grown 两个英语个人叙述中的词首激活。各处词义与句法并不统一。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词首 Est- 的续写
patterns.context: 激活落在葡萄牙语单词 Est- 的开头或词内，尤其在正式陈述或句子边界附近；并非同一完整单词。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 正式议会文本、PhilPapers 学术简介及教育经历

patterns.name: 英语 grown 的词首
patterns.context: 激活出现在短语“I've grown to learn”或“I’ve grown as a person”中，表示经历后的成长或变化。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 个人叙述、生活方式文章

patterns.name: 英语 became 的词首
patterns.context: 出现在“I became a wife and mama”的个人经历表达中。

patterns.name: 英语 Anesthes- 医学术语片段
patterns.context: 位于专业人员名单中，组成“Anesthesiologists”。

patterns.name: 英语 estate 片段
patterns.context: 出现在域名列表“photosoft.estate”中，激活跨越域名组成部分。

en.description: Activation centers on multilingual word-form fragments: English grown/become change expressions, Portuguese est/out fragments and infra-estruturas, the medical title anesthesiologists, and a Hungarian category term. Specific triggers depend on language and style, with no single stable semantics.

patterns.name: grown in English perfect or change expressions
patterns.context: In English narratives, expresses personal growth, becoming more dependent on technology, or change following training; [2] is “I’ve grown as a person”, [7] is “as we become more dependent”, and [10] is “I’ve grown to learn”.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment in Portuguese infra-estruturas
patterns.context: In Portuguese infrastructure-related compound words, the trigger position is in the latter part of infra-; both instances are in EuroParl parliamentary text.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment of Portuguese estar
patterns.context: A first-person Portuguese form of estar appears at the start of the formal statement “Estou ciente de que...”.

patterns.name: Portuguese word-initial out-
patterns.context: Occurs in the Portuguese plural demonstrative “outros”, in a sentence discussing other methods.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment in English occupational noun
patterns.context: Anesthesiologists appears in a list of medical professionals; activation falls on initial and intra-word fragments.

patterns.name: Hungarian nationality adjective
patterns.context: Hungarian repeatedly appears in Wikipedia category labels modifying actor categories.

patterns.name: Portuguese university name Est-
patterns.context: A school name contains “Escola Estadual” in a Brazilian education entry.

9_2290.description: 激活集中于多语种词形片段：英语 grown/become 变化表达、葡语 est/out 片段及 infra-estruturas、医学职称 anesthesiologists、Hungarian 分类词；具体触发依赖语种和文体，未见单一稳定语义。

patterns.name: 英语完成时或变化表达中的 grown
patterns.context: 英语叙述中表示个人成长、变得更依赖技术或经历训练后的变化；[2]为“I’ve grown as a person”，[7]为“as we become more dependent”，[10]为“I’ve grown to learn”。

patterns.name: 葡语 infra-estruturas 的词内片段
patterns.context: 葡语基础设施相关复合词中，触发位置位于 infra- 后半部分；两处均为 EuroParl 议会文本。

patterns.name: 葡语 estar 的词内片段
patterns.context: 葡语第一人称 estar 形式，位于正式陈述“Estou ciente de que...”开头。

patterns.name: 葡语 out- 词首
patterns.context: 葡语复数指示词“outros”中，出现在谈论其他方法的句子里。

patterns.name: 英语职业名词中的词内片段
patterns.context: 医学专业人员列表中的 anesthesiologists；激活落在词首与词内片段。

patterns.name: 匈牙利语国籍形容词
patterns.context: 维基百科分类标签中反复出现 Hungarian，修饰演员类别。

patterns.name: 葡语大学名词 Est-
patterns.context: 巴西教育经历条目中，学校名称含“Escola Estadual”。

en.description: Activation is scattered: clear patterns include est in Portuguese “Estadual” and “infra-estruturas”, English change expressions with grown/becoming, the domain fragment photosoft.est, the, and century ordinal suffixes; evidence is insufficient to group them as a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: Intra-word subword fragment in Portuguese “Estadual”
patterns.context: The word is split into multiple tokens; occurs in “Estadual” within an institution or school name, and adjacent parts may also activate.
patterns.domain: Portuguese résumés, publishing introductions, academic institution addresses

patterns.name: photosoft domain fragment
patterns.context: est appears after “photosoft.”, at the start of a domain suffix or subsequent string.

patterns.name: English grown and subsequent self-change expressions
patterns.context: In the present perfect or similar constructions, grown is followed by descriptions of personal growth or acquired experience.
patterns.domain: Personal recollections, blogs, or opinion writing

patterns.name: State change after English becoming
patterns.context: Describes a person gradually entering a certain state; the following text concerns lifestyle and environmental awareness.

patterns.name: infra-estruturas in fiscal and infrastructure terminology
patterns.context: In a Portuguese public funding context, “est” occurs within the word for infrastructure.
patterns.domain: EU parliamentary, budget, or policy texts

patterns.name: Occurrence of English definite article the
patterns.context: The article occurs in “in the practice”, near discussion of dental practice and clinical matters.

patterns.name: Century marker after an ordinal suffix
patterns.context: An English century ordinal appears in a category label, with the number and suffix split.

9_2290.description: 激活较分散：明显模式包括葡语“Estadual”及“infra-estruturas”中的 est、英语 grown/becoming 的变化表达、域名片段 photosoft.est、the 和世纪序数后缀；不足以归为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 葡语词形“Estadual”内部子词片段
patterns.context: 词被分成多个 token；位于机构或学校名称中的“Estadual”，相邻部分也可能激活
patterns.domain: 葡语简历、出版介绍、学术机构地址

patterns.name: photosoft 域名片段
patterns.context: “photosoft.”之后、域名后缀或后续字符串起始处出现 est

patterns.name: 英语 grown 及后续自我变化表达
patterns.context: 完成时或类似结构中，grown 后接个人成长、习得经验等描述
patterns.domain: 个人回忆、博客或议论文字

patterns.name: 英语 becoming 后的状态变化
patterns.context: 描述人物逐渐进入某种状态；后文涉及生活方式和环保意识

patterns.name: 财政与基础设施词语中的 infra-estruturas
patterns.context: 葡语公共资金分配语境中，“est”位于基础设施一词的词内
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会、预算或政策文本

patterns.name: 英语定冠词 the 的出现
patterns.context: 冠词位于“in the practice”中，邻近牙科实践与临床论述

patterns.name: 序数词 th 后的世纪标记
patterns.context: 类别标签中的英语世纪序数词，数字与后缀被拆分

en.concept: Local strings such as Est and ordinal suffixes
en.description: The most consistent cue is the substring Est/est in Portuguese words; there are also activations on the English century ordinal suffixes th and st, est in the domain name estate, and the phrase keep up. Triggers span languages and genres, with no unified semantics.

patterns.name: Est word forms in Portuguese text
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on words or word parts beginning with Est/est in Portuguese spelling, especially the subword “Est”; capitalization is not fully consistent.
patterns.domain: Portuguese biographies, academic introductions, EU policy texts, and dictionary definitions

patterns.name: English century ordinal format
patterns.context: Occurs in English category entries as the suffix of century ordinal numbers; adjacent to a hyphen and century.

patterns.name: est in website domain names
patterns.context: est is the beginning of the domain suffix estate, located after a period; unlike other fragments, it does not occur in a natural-language sentence.

patterns.name: up in an English phrase
patterns.context: Part of the English phrasal verb keep up in a business advice context.

9_2290.concept: Est/序数后缀等局部字符串
9_2290.description: 最稳定的线索是葡语词中 Est/est 子串；另对英语世纪序数后缀 th、st、域名 estate 的 est 及短语 keep up 有激活。触发线索跨语言、跨文体，未见统一语义。

patterns.name: 葡语文本中的 Est 词形
patterns.trigger: «Est»，以及 «est»；出现在 «Escola Estadual»、«Grupo de Estudos»、«infra-estruturas»、«Estamos»、«Estremadura» 等词中
patterns.context: 激活集中于葡萄牙语拼写中以 Est/est 开头的词或词段，尤其是 «Est» 这一子串；大小写不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 葡语个人简介、学术介绍、欧盟政策文本及词典释义

patterns.name: 英语世纪序数格式
patterns.context: 出现在英语分类条目中，作为世纪序数词的后缀；与连字符和 century 相邻。
patterns.domain: 英语维基百科分类列表

patterns.name: 网站域名中的 est
patterns.context: est 是网址域名后缀 estate 的开头，位于点号之后；不像其他片段那样处于自然语言句子中。

patterns.name: 英语词组中的 up
patterns.context: 作为英语短语动词 keep up 的组成部分，处于商业建议语境。

en.concept: Word-form fragments and intra-word subword detection
en.description: Activation is concentrated on English narratives of growth and change using grown/becoming and on Portuguese Est- fragments; there are also century ordinal suffixes, the word-initial fragment in hyped, and several scattered subwords, with no unified trigger condition.

patterns.name: English grown and subsequent change narratives
patterns.context: In English text, grown or becoming describes personal growth, change, or entering a state; activation falls on the word itself or a following word.

patterns.name: Portuguese Est word-form fragments
patterns.context: Capitalized Est- or lowercase est- occurs within Portuguese word forms, spanning proper names, institutions/state names, and place names; English domain fragments also occur. The meanings are not uniform.
patterns.domain: Portuguese academic profiles, political text, dictionary entries; also domain lists

patterns.name: Ordinal suffixes in English category names
patterns.context: In Wikipedia category names, an ordinal suffix indicating a century (th, st) is followed by a hyphen and century.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment in hyped
patterns.context: In an English marketing/review sentence, describes a product being highly popular; activation is concentrated on the word-initial fragment of hyped.

patterns.name: Portuguese decimal marker after a number
patterns.context: Portuguese decimal notation using a comma in formal text; activation is weak, and surrounding number units and words show no consistent triggering.

patterns.name: Other unexplained subword activations
patterns.context: Local subword activations in different languages or words, without a clear trigger condition supported jointly by the other fragments.
patterns.domain: Portuguese academic text, parliamentary text, and dictionary entries

9_2290.concept: 词形片段与词内子词检测
9_2290.description: 激活较集中于英语 grown/becoming 的成长变化叙述，以及葡语 Est- 片段；另见世纪序数后缀、hyped 词首和若干零散子词，整体触发条件不统一。

patterns.name: 英文 grown 及其后续变化叙述
patterns.context: 英语文本中，grown 或 becoming 用于描述个人成长、变化或形成某种状态；激活落在词本身或其后续词上。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语 Est 词形片段
patterns.context: 大写 Est- 或小写 est- 出现在葡萄牙语词形内部，覆盖专名、机构／州名、地名，也有英语域名片段；具体词义并不统一。
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语学术简介、政治文本、词典条目；另有域名列表

patterns.name: 英语类别名中的序数后缀
patterns.context: Wikipedia 分类名中，表示世纪的序数词缀（th、st）后接连字符和 century。

patterns.name: 单词 hyped 的词内片段
patterns.context: 英语营销／评论句中，描述某产品受到热捧；激活集中于 hyped 的词首片段。

patterns.name: 数字后的葡萄牙语小数标记
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语正式文本中的逗号小数记法；但激活较弱，周围数字单位和词语也未见一致触发。

patterns.name: 未解释的其他子词激活
patterns.context: 不同语种或不同词语中的局部子词激活，缺少能与其他片段共同支持的明确触发条件。
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语学术文本、议会文本及词典条目

en.description: The strongest activations often fall on the “est/ou” fragments (Portuguese estou, Estadual, and domain est), and also respond to English grown, becoming, rising, and hyped. These word meanings and contexts are scattered and cannot be explained by a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Tokenized activation in the verb “estou”
patterns.context: The Portuguese sentence contains the first-person singular form “estou” of estar; activation falls on a subword fragment, followed by different complements.

patterns.name: Personal growth or change
patterns.context: First-person English accounts describe growing or changing over time, through experiences, or through training; nearby text often contains “I’ve/I’ve”.

patterns.name: Expressions of change in progress
patterns.context: In English personal accounts, “becoming” introduces a description of gradually becoming a certain state or improving.

patterns.name: Fragment in a Portuguese educational institution name
patterns.context: In a personal résumé or educational background, a state school name is tokenized; the strongest response falls on the initial fragment of “Estadual”.

patterns.name: “rising” in a market-development context
patterns.context: In a business advice sentence, “rising markets” is listed with new markets, new trades, and industry information.

patterns.name: “est” fragments and domain strings
patterns.context: When domain names are listed consecutively, domain labels include strings beginning with “est”.

patterns.name: “hyp” fragment in a marketing context
patterns.context: When discussing product popularity or consumer interest, the adjective “hyped” is tokenized; this fragment is unrelated to the growth, Portuguese “estou,” or “Estadual” patterns above.

9_2290.description: 最强激活多落在“est/ou”片段（葡语estou、Estadual及域名est），也响应英语grown、becoming、rising和hyped；这些词义与语境分散，无法用单一语义模式解释。

patterns.name: 动词“estou”的分词激活
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语句中出现第一人称单数 estar 形式“estou”；激活落在该词的分词上，后接不同补语
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语议会文本、论坛问答

patterns.name: 个人成长或变化
patterns.context: 英语第一人称叙述中，描述自己经过时间、经历或训练而成长、改变；附近常有“I’ve/I’ve”
patterns.domain: 个人博客、个人经验叙述

patterns.name: 成形中的变化表达
patterns.context: 英语个人叙述中以“becoming”引出逐渐成为某种状态或变得更好的描述
patterns.domain: 生活方式、日常饮食计划

patterns.name: 葡语教育机构名称片段
patterns.context: 个人履历或教育经历中，州立学校名称被分词切分；最强响应落在“Estadual”的开头片段
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语履历/教育背景

patterns.name: 市场发展语境中的“rising”
patterns.context: 商业建议句中，“rising markets”与新市场、新交易及行业信息并列

patterns.name: “est”词片段与域名字符串
patterns.context: 连续列举域名时，域名标签中出现以“est”开头的字符串片段

patterns.name: 营销语境中的“hyp”片段
patterns.context: 谈论产品热度或消费者关注时，形容词“hyped”被分词；该片段不属于上述成长、葡语“estou”或“Estadual”模式

en.description: The strongest commonality is weak: activations fall on short tokens, subword fragments, and quotation marks across varied contexts. Identifiable local patterns include Louise’s tokenized spelling, patent terminology, mathematical symbols, code-comment words, and quoted titles; the domains differ substantially.

patterns.name: Tokenized spelling of the name Lou
patterns.context: The name Louise is split into two tokens, Lou and ise; it can occur in a salutation or sentence, followed by punctuation, a conjunction, or body text.

patterns.name: Patent-style terms
patterns.context: Several common patent terms and technical words activate in fixed headings and technical descriptions in patent background sections.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments in phrases
patterns.context: Near webpage titles or URLs, activations fall on split word fragments and short tokens, with no confirmable shared semantic condition.

patterns.name: Mathematical expression tokens
patterns.context: Near variables, equals signs, numbers, and plus signs in short math problems; activations are concentrated on formula symbols and variables.

patterns.name: Code comments and configuration terms
patterns.context: Parameter explanations, type descriptions, and quoted status values in code comments; also appears on quotation marks in Go import lists.

patterns.name: Song titles and quotation marks
patterns.context: Song titles recur in link text and quotation marks; both title words and quotation marks activate.

patterns.name: Title words in quotation marks
patterns.context: In entertainment-work titles beginning with quotation marks, the quotation mark and opening title word activate; later content does not show the same strength pattern.

9_2480.concept: 短 token 与词片段
9_2480.description: 最强共同点较弱：激活落在多种上下文中的短 token、词片段及引号上。可辨认的局部模式包括 Louise 的分词拼写、专利术语、数学符号、代码注释词和引号内标题；领域彼此差异明显。

patterns.name: 姓名 Lou 的切分拼写
patterns.context: 名字 Louise 被分成 Lou 和 ise 两个 token；可出现在称呼或句中，后接标点、连接词或正文。

patterns.name: 专利文体词语
patterns.context: 专利背景部分的固定标题与技术描述中，若干常见专利术语及技术词被激活。

patterns.name: 短语中的分词 token
patterns.context: 网页标题或网址附近，激活落在被切分的单词片段和短 token 上，缺少可确认的共同语义条件。

patterns.name: 数学表达式 token
patterns.context: 简短数学题的变量、等号、数值和加号附近；激活主要集中在公式符号与变量。

patterns.name: 代码注释与配置词
patterns.context: 代码注释中的参数说明、类型描述及引号括起的状态值；另见 Go 导入列表中的引号。

patterns.name: 歌曲标题及引号
patterns.context: 歌曲标题在链接文字和引号中的重复出现，标题词及引号均激活。

patterns.name: 引号内标题词
patterns.context: 引号开头的娱乐作品标题中，激活引号及标题开头词，后续内容未显示相同强度模式。

en.description: Strong activations are distributed across the name Louise, patent titles, mathematical equations, code comments and imports, song titles, and webpage titles. Some examples involve split names or quotation marks, but no single trigger pattern covers all passages.

patterns.name: Louise name
patterns.context: The name Louise is split into two tokens, Lou and ise, appearing in email bodies or salutations; nearby content includes thanks, recipient lists, or ordinary statements.

patterns.name: Fixed patent-style headings
patterns.context: Headings or section text in patent background sections, especially invention names and their descriptions.

patterns.name: English double quotation marks
patterns.context: Double quotation marks mark the beginning of a title or string; they appear in quoted titles or code strings.

patterns.name: Ritz convergence variable
patterns.context: Fortran-style comments describing a Ritz value as converged once it reaches the required relative accuracy.

patterns.name: See If I Care in a title
patterns.context: Song entries and their descriptions, with the song title repeated in the heading and body.

patterns.name: English word Look
patterns.context: The quoted phrase “Look for candy” appears in a passage about a haunted house and candy.

patterns.name: Go import string
patterns.context: Standard-library package names enclosed in double quotation marks in a Go source import block.

patterns.name: Ritz-related variable name
patterns.context: A Fortran-style comment mentions a Ritz value variable or name; this is not a natural-language heading.

patterns.name: Equals sign in a mathematical expression
patterns.context: A math problem begins with a variable assignment or equation, followed by an expression and a question.

patterns.name: KISSmetrics in a title
patterns.context: The company name KISSmetrics is split in a webpage title about data collection practices.

patterns.name: Hallow in a name
patterns.context: The name Halloween Hunt appears in web text; activation falls on a split part of the name.

9_2480.concept: none
9_2480.description: 强激活分散于 Louise 姓名、专利标题、数学等式、代码注释与导入、歌曲和网页标题等。部分样例涉及被切分的名称或引号，但没有单一触发模式覆盖全部段落。

patterns.name: Louise 名字
patterns.context: 姓名 Louise 被分成 Lou 和 ise 两个 token，出现在邮件正文或称呼中；邻近内容包括致谢、收件人列表或普通陈述。

patterns.name: 专利文体固定标题
patterns.context: 专利背景部分的标题或章节文字，尤其是发明名称及其描述。

patterns.name: 英文双引号
patterns.context: 双引号标记标题或字符串的开头；在标题引用或代码字符串中出现。

patterns.name: Ritz 收敛变量
patterns.context: Fortran 风格注释中，描述 Ritz 值达到所需相对精度后被视为 converged。

patterns.name: 题名中的 See If I Care
patterns.context: 歌曲条目及其介绍，歌曲名在标题和正文重复出现。

patterns.name: 英文单词 Look
patterns.context: 引号内短语“Look for candy”，出现在一段关于鬼屋与糖果的文字中。

patterns.name: Go 导入字符串
patterns.context: Go 源码 import 块中，被双引号括起的标准库包名。

patterns.name: Ritz 相关变量名
patterns.context: Fortran 风格注释中，提到 Ritz 值的变量或名称；该处不是自然语言标题。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的等号
patterns.context: 数学题目中以变量赋值或等式开头，随后给出算式并提问。

patterns.name: 标题中的 KISSmetrics
patterns.context: 网页标题中公司名 KISSmetrics 被切分，标题涉及数据收集实践。

patterns.name: 人名中的 Hallow
patterns.context: 网页文本中出现人名 Halloween Hunt，激活落在被切分的名称部分。

en.description: Activation patterns are scattered: three passages center on the name Louise; the others involve a patent section, quoted text, a Go import block, and mathematical notation, with no unified semantic or formatting feature.

patterns.name: Louise name
patterns.context: The name Louise is split into adjacent subwords; it appears in email bodies or salutations, followed by punctuation, thanks, other names in a list, or sentence content.

patterns.name: Patent headings and paragraph markers
patterns.context: Standard section headings in patent text and the explanatory prose following them; patent terminology such as “electrophotographic image forming apparatus” also activates.

patterns.name: Quotation-mark token
patterns.context: Double quotation marks as standalone tokens enclosing text; they appear in game prompts and work titles.

patterns.name: Go import syntax
patterns.context: Multiline import blocks in Go source code, with package names such as fmt, log, or crypto/rsa.

patterns.name: Specific symbol sequences in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Complex-number/power expressions in math problems or symbolic computation text, and problem fragments where q equals a number plus a variable.

9_2480.concept: none
9_2480.description: 激活模式分散：三段集中于姓名 Louise；其余分别涉及专利章节、被引号括起的文本、Go import 块和数学符号表达式，未见统一的语义或格式特征。

patterns.name: Louise 姓名
patterns.context: 人名 Louise 被拆成相邻子词；出现在邮件正文或称呼中，后接标点、称谢、并列人名或句子内容。

patterns.name: 专利标题与段落标记
patterns.context: 专利文本的标准章节标题及标题后的说明性正文；同时激活了“electrophotographic image forming apparatus”一类专利术语。

patterns.name: 引号 token
patterns.context: 双引号作为独立 token，包围文本；分别出现在游戏提示和作品名称中。

patterns.name: Go import 语法
patterns.context: Go 源码的多行 import 块，包名含 fmt、log 或 crypto/rsa。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的特定符号序列
patterns.context: 数学题或符号计算文本中的复数/幂表达式，及以 q 等于某数加变量的题目片段。

en.concept: Subwords/fragments of proper nouns in split words
en.description: Activations often fall on subwords of split proper nouns or long words: Louise in emails, as well as medical terms, rare proper nouns, titles, and occupational nouns; formatting may also contribute to triggering.

patterns.name: Tokenized name Louise
patterns.context: The personal name Louise is split into multiple subwords at the beginning of a word; it may appear in a salutation, list, or sentence.

patterns.name: In-word biologic/ologic substrings
patterns.context: In scientific terms, biologic/ologic letter sequences occur, with activations concentrated on internal subwords.

patterns.name: Internal subwords of rare proper nouns
patterns.context: Proper or specialized terms are split into subwords, with activation at the beginning or inside the word; contexts include repeated entries, research descriptions, and medical treatment.

patterns.name: Subwords in titles and work names
patterns.context: Work titles recur in quotation marks, or occupational nouns are split; activations fall on title words or internal subwords.

patterns.name: Tokenization in names and list contexts
patterns.context: Names appear in parallel or in email salutations after a colon and line break; beyond Louise, this may also reflect names and list formatting.

9_2480.concept: 拆分词中的子词/专名片段
9_2480.description: 激活常落在拆分后的专名或长词子词上：邮件中的 Louise，以及医学术语、罕见专名、标题和职业名词；格式也可能参与触发。

patterns.name: Louise 名字分词
patterns.context: 人名 Louise 在词首被拆成多个子词；可处于称呼、名单或句中。

patterns.name: 词内 biologic/ologic 子串
patterns.context: 科学术语中出现 biologic/ologic 字母序列，激活集中在词的内部子词。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、科研资助文本

patterns.name: 罕见专名的内部子词
patterns.context: 专名或专业词被拆分为子词，触发位置落在词首或词内部；上下文分别是重复词条、研究描述和医学治疗。

patterns.name: 标题与作品名子词
patterns.context: 作品标题重复出现并带引号，或职业名词被拆分；激活落在标题词或词内子词。

patterns.name: 姓名及列举语境中的分词
patterns.context: 人名并列或冒号后换行的邮件称呼；除 Louise 外，可能也反映姓名和名单格式。

en.description: Activations often fall on short spelling fragments within or at the beginning of words, spanning medical, biological, patent, and encyclopedic vocabulary; Free and illegally also occur, with no unified semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: “ologic” fragment within words
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal fragments of scientific/medical vocabulary, including pharmacologic, biologic, and organisms; in passage 6, the full word activates.
patterns.domain: Medical and biological abstracts or grant text

patterns.name: Other spelling fragments within words
patterns.context: Activation appears at different positions within words or strings: Stock differences, learned, trauma-induced dystonia, infrared, dramatist, and Neisseria gonorrhoeae; fragment lengths and positions vary.
patterns.domain: Scientific abstracts, patent backgrounds, encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Web phrases and formatting
patterns.context: Appears respectively in the advertising-style phrase “Free To Join” and the description “illegally hunted” of an animal under threat; there is no clear shared semantics or stable syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Web text, encyclopedia or natural-history descriptions

9_2480.concept: 词汇拼写片段
9_2480.description: 激活多落在词内或词首的短拼写片段，涵盖医学、生物、专利及百科词汇；另见 Free 与 illegally，缺少统一语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 词内的「ologic」片段
patterns.context: 激活落在科学/医学词汇的内部片段，包括 pharmacologic、biologic 和 organisms；其中第 6 段激活的是完整词
patterns.domain: 医学、生物学摘要或基金文本

patterns.name: 词内的其他拼写片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在词或词串的不同位置：Stock differences、learned，trauma-induced dystonia，infrared，dramatist，以及 Neisseria gonorrhoeae；片段长度和位置不一致
patterns.domain: 科学摘要、专利背景、百科条目

patterns.name: 网页短语及格式
patterns.context: 分别出现在广告式短语“Free To Join”和动物受威胁描述“illegally hunted”中；没有明显共同语义或稳定句法条件
patterns.domain: 网页文本、百科或自然史描述

en.description: Responds to symbolic algebra text in math exercises: function definitions and composition evaluation, polynomials and power coefficients, differentiation, expression simplification, equation solving, and numerical rounding. The main triggers are dense variable–operator–coefficient expressions and adjacent problem instructions.

patterns.name: Polynomial differentiation instructions
patterns.context: Explicitly asks to differentiate a given function, with a polynomial or function expression nearby.

patterns.name: Define functions and evaluate compositions
patterns.context: Defines one or more functions, then asks for a function value or composition value; often adjacent to polynomial coefficients.

patterns.name: Polynomial coefficients and power expressions
patterns.context: Variables, multiplication signs, powers, and signed integer coefficients are written consecutively in a polynomial, often in differentiation or function-definition problems.

patterns.name: Algebraic expression rearrangement and coefficient matching
patterns.context: Asks to rewrite an expansion in a specified form or simplify an expression; involves terms arranged by powers.

patterns.name: Numerical calculation and rounding
patterns.context: First evaluates an expression numerically, then asks for rounding to a specified precision.

patterns.name: Solve an equation
patterns.context: Provides an equation containing an unknown and asks to solve for a specified variable.

patterns.name: Second-derivative-related wording
patterns.context: Natural-language description that a function is the second derivative of another expression; followed by power-function terms.

patterns.name: Isolated coefficient or arithmetic fragment
patterns.context: The fragment is incomplete, possibly clipped across problem sections; there is insufficient information to identify a definite operation or shared structure.

9_2480.concept: 符号化代数题目
9_2480.description: 响应数学练习中的符号化代数文本：函数定义与复合求值、多项式及幂次系数、求导、整理表达式、解方程和数值取整。主要触发因素是密集的变量—运算符—系数表达式及相邻的题目指令。

patterns.name: 多项式求导指令
patterns.context: 明确要求对给定函数求导，邻近内容含多项式或函数表达式。

patterns.name: 定义函数并求复合函数值
patterns.trigger: “Let g(f) = …”“Let j(b) = …”“What is y(j(w))?”“What is g(t)?”
patterns.context: 先定义一个或多个函数，再询问函数值或复合函数值；常与多项式系数相邻。

patterns.name: 多项式系数与幂次表达式
patterns.context: 连续书写变量、乘号、幂次和带符号整数系数的多项式，常出现在求导或定义函数的题目中。

patterns.name: 代数式整理与系数匹配
patterns.trigger: “in the form q*x + p + t*x**3 + z*x**2 and give t.”以及“Rearrange 58*w + 58*…”
patterns.context: 要求将展开式改写成指定形式或整理表达式；涉及按幂次排列的项。

patterns.name: 数值计算与四舍五入
patterns.context: 先由表达式求出数值，再要求按指定精度取整。

patterns.name: 解方程
patterns.context: 给出含未知数的等式并要求解指定变量。

patterns.name: 二阶导数相关表述
patterns.context: 用自然语言描述某函数是另一表达式的二阶导数；后接幂函数项。

patterns.name: 孤立的系数或算式片段
patterns.trigger: “*l - 10 for l.”、“Suppose 3*q - 6”以及负数和系数片段
patterns.context: 片段残缺，可能是题目跨段截取；没有足够信息判定明确操作或共同结构。

en.description: Activations occur across domains, often on token fragments, punctuation, and structural boundaries; in code they favor control flow and callbacks, in math they favor problem prompts, line breaks, and expressions, and in biomedicine they favor internal parts of terms. No unified semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Token fragments and in-word boundaries
patterns.context: Activations often fall on fragments of split words or in-word hyphens, including English natural language and code/math expressions; surrounding context varies widely
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; biomedicine, tech news, math, code

patterns.name: Branch and callback code structures
patterns.context: Occurs in JSX/JavaScript or shell code, especially near control flow, callbacks, component properties, and method chains

patterns.name: Questions and line breaks in math problems
patterns.context: Near questions, problem prompts, and line breaks/answer regions in math problems or derivations; some strong activations also fall on mathematical symbols and numbers

patterns.name: Polynomial derivative expressions
patterns.context: Immediately adjacent to algebraic expressions comprising variables and powers; the specific problem is incomplete

patterns.name: Possible proper nouns or tokenization noise
patterns.context: Occurs in byline/link text fragments following news headlines, with no stable semantic or syntactic condition

patterns.name: Biomedical term fragments
patterns.context: In specialized terms in abstracts about immunology, liposomes, or infection research; activations fall within terms and near hyphens

patterns.name: Neuroscience terms and gene names
patterns.context: Near proper nouns, abbreviations, and specialized terms in descriptions of transcriptional regulation and nematode motor neurons

patterns.name: Number and operator strings
patterns.context: In polynomial coefficients, variables, operators, and answer-number strings in algebra problems; activations are not limited to one operation

9_2480.concept: 文本结构与分词边界
9_2480.description: 激活分布于多领域文本，常落在分词片段、标点和结构边界；代码中偏向控制流与回调，数学中偏向题目提示、换行及表达式，生物医学中偏向术语内部。各处缺少统一语义触发。

patterns.name: 分词片段与词内边界
patterns.trigger: «bum»、«lip»、«ocyte»、«transistor»中的词内片段；以及 «-»、«.»、«/» 等邻接标点
patterns.context: 激活常落在被拆分词的片段或词内连接符上，包含英语自然语言和代码/数学表达；片段前后文差异很大
patterns.domain: 跨领域；生物医学、科技新闻、数学、代码

patterns.name: 分支与回调代码结构
patterns.context: 出现在 JSX/JavaScript 或 shell 代码中，尤其是控制流、回调、组件属性和方法链附近

patterns.name: 数学题中的问句及换行
patterns.context: 数学题目或推导文本中，问句、题目提示与换行/答案区域附近；部分强激活也落在数学符号和数字上

patterns.name: 多项式导数表达式
patterns.context: 紧邻变量与幂次构成的代数表达式，具体题意不完整

patterns.name: 疑似专名或切分噪声
patterns.context: 出现在新闻标题后的署名/链接文本片段中，未见稳定语义或句法条件

patterns.name: 生物医学术语片段
patterns.context: 出现在免疫学、脂质体或感染研究摘要的专业术语中；激活落于术语内部及连字符附近

patterns.name: 神经科学术语与基因名
patterns.context: 转录调控及线虫运动神经元描述中，专名、缩写和专业术语附近

patterns.name: 数字与运算符串
patterns.context: 代数题的多项式系数、变量、运算符及答案数字串中，激活并不局限于某一种运算

en.concept: Numbers and citations in structured text
en.description: Activations occur in three types of text: numbers and abbreviations in legal case citations and rules; numbers, punctuation, and operators in math problems; and literature citations and cell-related terms in patent backgrounds. Each type includes numbers or citation formats, but no single trigger word accounts for all examples.

patterns.name: Numbers and punctuation in legal citations
patterns.context: Legal text contains federal case citations (F.3d, U.S. v.) or circuit court rule notices; activations occur near numbers, abbreviations, and punctuation.

patterns.name: Numbers and operators in math problems
patterns.context: In math exercises or problems, activations occur near values, plus/minus signs, decimal points, arithmetic operators, and number sequences; some examples include questions or rounding instructions.

patterns.name: References and cell terms in patent documents
patterns.context: In patent background sections, cites research reports or papers bibliographically and discusses cellulase, tissue, stem cells, or cell lines.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent backgrounds and biomedical/biotechnology literature

9_2480.concept: 结构化文本中的数字与引用
9_2480.description: 激活分布于三类文本：法律判例与规则引文中的编号缩写；数学题中的数字、标点及运算符；专利背景中的文献引文和细胞相关术语。各类内部均有数字或引用格式，但没有一个具体触发词能解释全部样例。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的编号与标点
patterns.context: 法律文本中出现联邦判例引文（F.3d、U.S. v.）或巡回法院规则通知；数字、缩写和标点附近激活。

patterns.name: 数学题中的数字与运算符
patterns.context: 数学练习或题目中，数值、正负号、小数点、加减运算符及数字序列附近激活；有些样例包含提问或四舍五入指令。

patterns.name: 专利文献中的参考文献与细胞术语
patterns.trigger: «ul»1«ase»4…«Sh»iz«u»«oka»…«Text»ile« Industrial»…«Report»…«1986»；«“»«Human»« Ad»«ip»«ose»« Tissue»…«St»«em» Cells»…«Vol»…«2002»；并出现 «cell»9«ul»…«fungi»、«mouse»« cell»9
patterns.context: 专利背景技术中，引用研究报告或论文的书目信息，并讨论纤维素酶、组织、干细胞或细胞株。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景与生物医学/生物技术文献

en.description: Primarily sensitive to the split-out sub string and its occurrences in code, typesetting commands, and ordinary words; also responds to cell and cell-research phrases. Other local patterns include address codes and subscript symbols.

patterns.name: sub string
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of words or near markers and commands; sometimes following characters are split into tokens, as in “substance,” “subdivision,” “subsequently,” “subsection,” or “sub{sub}.”
patterns.domain: Multidomain text, law, medicine, code, and typesetting

patterns.name: cell string
patterns.context: Appears in cell-related terms or phrases, especially cell line, cell surface, and cell model; some texts split it into subwords.

patterns.name: CSS vertical alignment and subscripts
patterns.context: Co-occurs with CSS properties, values, and brace rules, describing line height, vertical alignment, and subscript/superscript positioning.

patterns.name: Register/address abbreviations in code
patterns.context: Located in tab-indented assembly-like code, near registers, commas, and address-operation comments.

patterns.name: LaTeX heading-spacing commands
patterns.context: Appears in repeated \titlespacing commands and section/subsection level parameters; the command is split into multiple tokens.

patterns.name: sub prefix in legal text
patterns.context: An ordinary English word in the body of a legal document after a page break or line break, not a code command.

patterns.name: Land subdivision terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in contexts of land surveying and subdivision, including plat, lots, and streets.

patterns.name: Word-initial portion of subsequently
patterns.context: In a narrative sentence describing a defendant manager who subsequently proposed selling a car.

patterns.name: Subscripts in technical notation
patterns.context: sub is used as a variable subscript marker, embedded in fault symbols and a list of mathematical expressions.

9_2480.concept: sub 前缀与 cell 术语
9_2480.description: 主要对被切分出的 sub 字符串及其在代码、排版命令和普通单词中的出现敏感；另有对 cell 及细胞研究短语的响应。也覆盖地址代码、上下标符号等局部模式。

patterns.name: sub 字符串
patterns.context: 在单词开头或标记、命令附近出现；有时后续字符被拆成 token，如「substance」「subdivision」「subsequently」「subsection」或「sub{sub}」。
patterns.domain: 多领域文本、法律、医学、代码及排版

patterns.name: cell 字符串
patterns.context: 出现在细胞相关术语或短语中，尤其是 cell line、cell surface、cell model；部分文本中切分为子词。

patterns.name: CSS 垂直对齐与上下标
patterns.context: 与 CSS 属性、值和花括号规则同现，描述行高、垂直对齐及上下标位置。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 CSS 代码

patterns.name: 代码中的寄存器/地址缩写
patterns.context: 位于制表符缩进的类汇编代码中，周围有寄存器、逗号及地址操作注释。

patterns.name: LaTeX 标题间距命令
patterns.context: 出现在重复的 \titlespacing 命令及 section/subsection 层级参数中；命令被拆成多个 token。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 排版问答中的 LaTeX

patterns.name: 法律文本中的 sub 前缀
patterns.context: 分页或换行后接法律文书正文中的普通英文单词，并非代码命令。

patterns.name: 地块细分术语
patterns.context: 出现在 plat、lots、streets 等地块测绘和土地划分语境中。

patterns.name: subsequently 的词首

patterns.name: 网址中的域名与路径

patterns.context: URL、链接预览或软件源地址中，尤其是域名被切分成多个 token 的场景

patterns.name: 邮箱地址及联系人列表

patterns.name: 代码包名与命名空间

patterns.name: 散列或签名中的十六进制串

patterns.context: JSON 样式数据中长十六进制字符串作为签名值出现

en.description: Activation concentrates on punctuation-separated string fragments, especially www, dots, and domain components in URLs and domains; email addresses, dotted qualified names in code, and paths also occur. The topics vary, and no shared specific meaning can yet be confirmed.

patterns.name: www URL domain fragments
patterns.context: Domains following www. appear in URLs or lists of web addresses; triggers may fall on www, within the domain, and on its subword fragments, rather than a fixed character or specific domain.
patterns.domain: URLs in webpages, emails, forums, installation instructions, and travel content

patterns.name: Email addresses and their domains
patterns.context: Multiple email addresses appear consecutively in email headers or recipient lists; activation is distributed across local address fragments.

patterns.name: Dotted qualified names in code
patterns.context: Multiple package names, namespaces, or class names are joined by dots in code import statements or qualified names; identifiers with mixed case also occur.

patterns.name: Paths and command fragments preceding URLs
patterns.context: Paths, software repository addresses, and wget download URLs occur together in shell configuration or command-line text.

patterns.name: Marked place-name components in addresses
patterns.context: Place names in travel and vacation webpage address lists are split into components; nearby URLs are also related to promotion or travel.

patterns.name: Ordinary words and symbols in URL paths
patterns.context: A road-trip-related URL appears in body text or a link; activation covers both the domain and path components.

patterns.name: Unclear locally high-activation fragments
patterns.context: The fragment occurs in a Java import path; the limited examples do not establish whether it is a trigger pattern distinct from dotted qualified names.

9_2480.concept: 点号分隔的地址与标识符
9_2480.description: 激活集中在由标点切分的字符串片段，尤其网址与域名中的 www、点号、域名词素，也见邮箱地址、代码点分限定名及路径；题材各异，尚不能确认共同的具体词义。

patterns.name: www 网址域名片段
patterns.trigger: «www»、«.»、域名中被切分的字母或词素，如「«web»min」「«mex»ico」「«rig»zone」
patterns.context: URL 或网址列表中出现 www. 后的域名；触发可能落在 www、域名内部及其子词片段，并非固定在某个字符或特定域名。
patterns.domain: 网页、邮件、论坛、安装说明与旅游内容中的网址

patterns.name: 邮箱及其域名
patterns.trigger: 邮箱地址内的 «hot»、«mail»、«.»、«com»，以及被拆分的姓名和地址片段
patterns.context: 邮件头或收件人列表中连续出现多个电子邮件地址；激活分布在地址的局部片段上。

patterns.name: 代码中的点分限定名
patterns.trigger: 如「europa.es.ig.dss.simple.certificate.report.jax」「org.openstreetmap.josm.gui.layer」，尤其点号分隔的标识符片段
patterns.context: 代码导入语句或限定类名中，多个包名、命名空间或类名以点号相连；也出现大小写混合标识符。

patterns.name: 网址前的路径及命令片段
patterns.context: shell 配置或命令行文本中，路径、软件仓库地址和 wget 下载 URL 相邻出现。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答/命令示例

patterns.name: 地址中被标记的地名词素
patterns.context: 旅游度假网页地址列表中的地点名称被切分为词素；邻近出现其他推广或旅行相关 URL。
patterns.domain: 旅游网站或旅行推广文本

patterns.name: 网址路径内的普通词及符号
patterns.context: 正文或链接中给出公路旅行相关 URL；激活覆盖域名与路径成分。

patterns.name: 不明的局部高激活片段
patterns.trigger: «jos»、«open»、«street»、«map»等虽处于点分代码名中，但与其他代码片段的对应关系不确定
patterns.context: 片段位于 Java 导入路径中；无法从有限样本确认是否是独立于点分限定名的触发模式。

en.description: Activations often occur in structured string fragments, especially email addresses and URLs/domains; also covers LaTeX commands, shell paths, JSON fields, and source-code comments, licenses, and documentation declarations. patterns.name: 命令行路径与连字符分段
