en.concept: Identifier fragments in URLs and code
en.description: Activates mainly on local string fragments in URLs/domains and code file paths or identifiers, and also on pkg-config arguments in build commands; trigger points are not restricted to a fixed word or semantic category.

patterns.name: Fragments in URLs and domains
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on several character fragments within URLs, especially domains, hostnames, or paths; not all URL characters activate, and activation positions vary.
patterns.domain: Web links, code comments, emails, and encyclopedia reference links

patterns.name: File names and path identifiers
patterns.context: Appears in code paths, header file names, plugin names, or class names; path separators, common prefixes and suffixes, and internal identifier fragments can all trigger.

patterns.name: pkg-config command options
patterns.context: Appears among arguments in shell/autoconf conditional commands.

9_2480.concept: 网址与代码中的标识符片段
9_2480.description: 主要对 URL/域名及代码文件路径、标识符中的局部字符串片段激活，另对构建命令中的 pkg-config 参数激活；触发点并不局限于某个固定词或语义类别。

patterns.name: URL 与域名中的片段

patterns.name: 文件名与路径标识符
patterns.context: 出现在代码路径、头文件名、插件名或类名中；路径分隔符、常见前后缀及标识符内部片段均可触发
patterns.domain: 软件源代码与本地化资源

patterns.name: pkg-config 命令选项
patterns.context: 出现在 shell/autoconf 条件命令的参数中

en.description: Activations occur in fragments of split domains, email addresses, paths, and identifiers; the clearest repeated pattern is hotmail in email addresses. Code identifiers, number formats, and other link fragments lack stable shared trigger conditions.

patterns.name: hotmail email suffix in a domain
patterns.context: hotmail appears in email addresses, usually after @ and before .com.

patterns.name: Specific domain fragments in URLs
patterns.context: Domains in ordinary text or links are split into subwords; activations fall on internal domain fragments, but different domains show no evident shared suffix.

patterns.name: Long path or identifier fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur in code paths, Java package names, or configuration identifiers joined by slashes, underscores, hyphens, or word boundaries; specific high-activation positions vary.
patterns.domain: Code, build configurations, and technical identifiers

patterns.name: Fragmented subwords in technical identifiers
patterns.context: Variables, member accesses, or underscore-joined code identifiers are split into multiple tokens; there is no stable semantic trigger word.

patterns.name: Fragments in email addresses and names
patterns.context: Parts of names, usernames, or email addresses in email headers are split into tokens; unlike the hotmail hit in section 10, no consistent address substring is apparent.

patterns.name: Number and financial-format fragments
patterns.context: Scattered weak activations occur in formats such as numbers, prices, gains, and dates, without a consistent pattern.

patterns.name: Unclear webpage or code boundary fragments
patterns.context: There are local activations but no shared, confirmable trigger form; they may be incidental responses to tokenization boundaries or long identifiers.

9_2480.concept: 碎片化字符串片段
9_2480.description: 激活分布在被拆分的域名、邮件地址、路径及标识符等字符串片段中；最明确的重复是邮件地址里的 hotmail。代码标识符、数字格式及其他链接片段则缺乏稳定的共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 域名中的 hotmail 邮箱后缀
patterns.context: hotmail 出现在电子邮件地址中，通常是 @ 后、.com 前。

patterns.name: URL 中的特定域名片段
patterns.context: 普通文本或链接中的域名被拆成子词；激活落在域名内部片段，但不同域名之间没有明显共同后缀。
patterns.domain: 网页链接及投资相关邮件

patterns.name: 较长的路径或标识符片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在由斜杠、下划线、连字符或词边界连接的代码路径、Java 包名或配置标识符中；具体高激活位置各异。
patterns.domain: 代码、构建配置与技术标识符

patterns.name: 技术标识符中的碎片化子词
patterns.context: 变量、成员访问或下划线连接的代码标识符被拆分为多个 token；没有稳定的语义触发词。

patterns.name: 邮件地址及姓名中的片段
patterns.context: 邮件头中的姓名、用户名或邮箱地址局部被拆分标记；与第10段的 hotmail 命中不同，未见统一的地址子串。

patterns.name: 数字及金融格式片段
patterns.context: 数字、价格、涨幅和日期等格式中出现零散弱激活，未形成一致模式。

patterns.name: 不明确的网页或代码边界片段
patterns.context: 虽有局部激活，但没有共同且可确认的触发形式；可能是分词边界或长标识符带来的偶然响应。
patterns.domain: 混合：网页、代码、技术文本

en.concept: String fragments in URLs and code
en.description: Activation occurs mainly in URLs, domains, and their path fragments, as well as file paths, identifiers, variables, and UUIDs in code; a few English body-text words and numeric path fragments also activate, with no stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: Dots and hostname fragments in domains and URLs
patterns.context: In URLs, hyperlinks, or domains, activation is distributed across hostname segments and nearby separators; some fragments and adjacent paths also activate.
patterns.domain: Code, web links, and webpage text

patterns.name: C/C++ header paths and identifiers
patterns.context: Header references and paths in code; activation concentrates on directory names, underscored file names, and identifier substrings.

patterns.name: JavaScript variables and service calls
patterns.context: Variables, object properties, or service names in code statements; nearby URL fragments also activate.

patterns.name: UUID-style identifiers
patterns.context: Long identifiers in quotation marks, made of hexadecimal characters and hyphens; activation covers multiple character fragments.

patterns.name: Numeric dates and identifiers in URL paths
patterns.context: Dates, numeric identifiers, and other digit strings in URL paths are marked; in the current examples they occur only with URLs, making it difficult to determine whether they trigger independently.

patterns.name: Ordinary words in English link text
patterns.context: English words near body text or links also show weak activation; these examples alone do not establish stable semantic or syntactic conditions.

9_2480.concept: 网址及代码中的字符串片段
9_2480.description: 激活主要出现在网址、域名及其路径片段，也见于代码中的文件路径、标识符、变量和UUID；少数英文正文词及数字路径片段也激活，未显示稳定的语义主题。

patterns.name: 域名与网址中的点及主机名片段
patterns.trigger: 多处连续激活的网址和域名片段，如「eu.europea.esig.dss.simplecertificate.report.jaxb」「www.stellarium.org」「www.sfchronicle.com」「www.nakedcapitalism.com」「westus.api.cognitive.microsoft」
patterns.context: 网址、超链接或域名中，激活分布在主机名各段及分隔点附近；部分片段和相邻路径也激活。
patterns.domain: 代码、网页链接及网页文本

patterns.name: C/C++头文件路径与标识符
patterns.context: 代码中的头文件引用及路径，激活集中在目录名、带下划线的文件名和标识符子串。
patterns.domain: Github 上的 C/C++ 源码

patterns.name: JavaScript变量及服务调用
patterns.context: 代码语句中的变量、对象属性或服务名称；同时附近的网址片段也激活。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 上的 JavaScript 代码

patterns.name: UUID样式标识符
patterns.context: 引号内、由十六进制字符和连字符组成的长标识符；激活覆盖其中多个字符片段。

patterns.name: 网址路径中的数字日期与编号
patterns.context: 网址路径中日期、数字编号等数字串被标记；目前样本中只与网址共同出现，难以判断其是否单独触发。

patterns.name: 英文链接文本中的普通词语
patterns.context: 正文或链接附近的英文词语也有较弱激活；仅凭这些例子无法确定稳定的词义或句法条件。

en.description: Primarily activates on protocols, domains, periods, and path segments in URLs and their Markdown link structure; also activates on include directives and file paths in code, as well as Java dot-separated package names and class identifiers.

patterns.name: URL or link format
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on URL protocols, hostnames, paths, and link markers; links often appear in Hacker News comments or article excerpts, typically following explanatory text.
patterns.domain: Web links, Hacker News posts and comments

patterns.name: Domains and path segments in URLs
patterns.context: URLs contain multi-level domains, compound-word paths, or date and number paths; tokenized text within URLs is more prominent than in ordinary prose.
patterns.domain: Web URLs; links about news, government statistics, finance, travel, blogs, and more

patterns.name: C/C++ include paths
patterns.context: Appears in consecutive preprocessor include directives at the start of code files; trigger points include directive symbols and directory/file names.

patterns.name: Identifiers in Java package and class names
patterns.context: These dot-separated package and class names recur in declarations and import statements and include compound identifiers.
patterns.domain: Java code on GitHub, related to electronic signatures and certificate reports

9_2480.concept: 结构化路径与标识符
9_2480.description: 主要对 URL 及其 Markdown 链接结构中的协议、域名、点号和路径片段激活；另对代码里的 include 指令、文件路径，以及 Java 点分包名和类标识符激活。

patterns.name: 网址或链接格式
patterns.trigger: «http»、«://»、«www»、域名片段以及 Markdown 链接的 «](»
patterns.context: 激活主要集中在 URL 的协议、主机名、路径和链接标记中；链接常出现在 Hacker News 评论或文章摘录里，通常紧随说明性文字。
patterns.domain: 网页链接、Hacker News 帖子及评论

patterns.name: URL 中的域名及路径片段
patterns.trigger: «.»、域名字符片段以及斜杠分隔的 URL 路径，如 «productivity»、«eurostat»、«capitalism»、«financement»
patterns.context: 网址本身含多级域名、复合词路径或日期与数字路径；相较常规正文，URL 内部的分词式文本更突出。
patterns.domain: 网页 URL；包含新闻、政府统计、金融、旅行、博客等链接

patterns.name: C/C++ include 路径
patterns.context: 出现在代码文件开头的连续预处理器 include 指令中，触发点包括指令符号及目录/文件名。
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的 C/C++ 源代码

patterns.name: Java 包名与类名中的标识符
patterns.context: 这些点分包名和类名在声明与 import 语句中重复出现，且含复合标识符。
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的 Java 代码，电子签名与证书报告相关

en.description: Most passages activate on URL protocol, domain, and path tokens, especially repeated or Markdown-embedded links; code identifiers, as well as a few accompanying patterns such as market fields and email unsubscribe text, also occur.

patterns.name: Domains and paths in URLs
patterns.context: Activation occurs mainly within URLs, especially domain, subdomain, and path fragments; it persists when URLs are repeated across passages.
patterns.domain: Web links, forum posts, and links in email

patterns.name: Repeatedly quoted URLs
patterns.context: URLs are repeated in Markdown link form or appear as import/identifier strings in code; they need not be ordinary links in body text.
patterns.domain: HackerNews Markdown, code, and configuration text

patterns.name: Technical identifiers associated with URLs
patterns.context: Proper names, file/class names, or path identifiers adjacent to URLs or code fragments also activate, but activation is scattered across their component tokens and does not form a consistent independent semantic pattern.
patterns.domain: Code, Wikipedia links, and technical webpages

patterns.name: Numeric market data and date fields
patterns.context: Activation occurs near market/investment tables or brief fields in emails; these passages also contain chart URLs, making it difficult to distinguish the contributions of URLs and financial fields.

patterns.name: Newsletter and unsubscribe fields
patterns.context: Activation occurs near unsubscribe instructions, newsletter names, and their URLs in email footers; it falls mainly on URLs and their domain components.

9_2480.concept: 网址与链接文本
9_2480.description: 多数段落在网址的协议、域名及路径 token 上激活，尤其是重复或嵌入 Markdown 的链接；另有代码标识符，以及行情字段和邮件退订文本等少数伴随模式。

patterns.name: 网址中的域名与路径
patterns.context: 激活集中出现在网址本身，尤其是域名、子域名及路径片段；多段网址重复出现时仍激活。
patterns.domain: 网页链接、论坛帖子、电子邮件中的链接

patterns.name: 被重复引用的网址
patterns.context: 网址以 Markdown 链接形式重复呈现，或作为代码中的导入/标识符字符串出现；不要求是普通正文链接。

patterns.name: 网址相关的技术标识符
patterns.context: 与网址或代码片段相邻的专名、文件/类名或路径标识符也出现激活，但激活分散于其组成 token，未形成一致的独立语义模式。
patterns.domain: 代码、维基链接及技术网页

patterns.name: 数字行情与日期字段
patterns.context: 邮件中的行情/投资信息表格或简短字段附近激活；同时该段包含图表网址，难以区分网址与金融字段各自的贡献。
patterns.domain: 金融邮件、股票行情简报

patterns.name: 新闻通讯与退订字段
patterns.context: 邮件页脚中的退订说明、通讯名称及其网址附近激活；激活主要落在网址和其中的域名词段上。
patterns.domain: 电子邮件新闻通讯页脚

en.description: Activations primarily fall on subword fragments in URLs, domains, paths, and adjacent punctuation; they also occur in code import paths, class names, and email addresses. Specific fragments vary with link topic and include EU certificates, software, energy, news, and institutional information.

patterns.name: Character-level decomposition of URL domains and paths
patterns.context: Primarily activates on URLs themselves and adjacent punctuation and path components; URLs often appear in Markdown links, citations, or webpage text.
patterns.domain: Web links, news discussions, email, code repositories, and job postings

patterns.name: EU certificate-related code and URLs
patterns.context: The SimpleCertificateReport class from EU eSignature DSS appears in a Java import statement; «ificate» in the certificate class name has the strongest activation. Similar fragments occur in EU/Europa domain URLs.
patterns.domain: GitHub Java code; EU statistics URLs

patterns.name: Package paths and identifier fragments in code
patterns.context: Appears consecutively as code lexical fragments in Java import statements and near enum constants.

patterns.name: In-word fragments in energy company contact information
patterns.context: Appears in a subscription promotion in Enron email, adjacent to an email address, forming the Energy InfoSource contact address.

patterns.name: Air quality and cycling fragments in links
patterns.context: Appears in a discussion about London's car-free zones and related news links.
patterns.domain: Hacker News discussions and news URLs

patterns.name: Product name fragments in links
patterns.context: Appears in the product path of a Chrome Web Store extension link.

patterns.name: Site name fragments in links
patterns.context: Appears in a link attached to a post about revisiting an old project; activation is concentrated on the domain and filename.
patterns.domain: Hacker News technical discussions and personal project links

patterns.name: Site fragments in energy news links
patterns.context: Appears in news about the South Pars gas field and its Rigzone link.

patterns.name: News site and article path fragments
patterns.context: Appears in the headline of legislative news forwarded in email and in a National Journal URL.

patterns.name: Recruitment agency URL fragments
patterns.context: Appears in the About Us section at the end of a job posting and in the Worcester Food & Active Living Policy Council URL.

9_2480.concept: 网址与技术字符串片段
9_2480.description: 激活主要落在网址、域名、路径及其邻近标点的子词片段上，也见于代码导入路径、类名和邮箱地址；具体片段随链接主题而异，涵盖欧盟证书、软件、能源、新闻及机构信息。

patterns.name: 网址域名及路径的字符级展开
patterns.trigger: «http»、«://»、«.»、域名片段（如 «e»«urop»«a»、«cycl»«ing»«indust»«ry»、«wor»«cester»）以及路径中的词和斜杠
patterns.context: 主要在网址本身及其邻近标点、路径成分中激活；网址常出现在 Markdown 链接、引用或网页文本中。
patterns.domain: 网页链接、新闻讨论、邮件、代码仓库和招聘信息

patterns.name: 欧盟证书相关代码与网址
patterns.context: Java 导入语句中出现 EU eSignature DSS 的 SimpleCertificateReport 类，证书类名中的 «ificate» 激活最强；同类 EU/Europa 域名网址也出现相近片段。
patterns.domain: GitHub Java 代码；欧盟统计网址

patterns.name: 代码中的包路径与标识符片段
patterns.context: 在 Java 导入语句和枚举常量附近，按代码词法片段连续出现。

patterns.name: 能源公司联系信息中的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在 Enron 邮件的订阅宣传语中，紧邻邮箱地址，构成 Energy InfoSource 的联系地址。
patterns.domain: 商业邮件、能源行业宣传

patterns.name: 链接中的空气质量与骑行词片段
patterns.context: 出现在一条关于伦敦无车区域的讨论及相关新闻链接中。

patterns.name: 链接中的产品名称片段
patterns.context: 出现在 Chrome 网上应用店扩展程序链接的产品路径中。

patterns.name: 链接中的站点名称片段
patterns.context: 出现在关于回顾旧项目的帖子所附链接中，激活集中于域名和文件名。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 技术讨论及个人项目链接

patterns.name: 能源新闻链接中的站点片段
patterns.context: 出现在南帕尔斯气田新闻及其 Rigzone 链接中。

patterns.name: 新闻站点与文章路径片段
patterns.context: 出现在邮件转发的立法新闻标题及 National Journal 网址中。

patterns.name: 招聘机构网址片段
patterns.context: 出现在招聘信息末尾的 About Us 段落及 Worcester Food & Active Living Policy Council 网址中。

en.description: Responds to structured strings and their separators: URLs/paths, dot-separated package names and fields, code calls, as well as LaTeX equations and citations. Their shared feature is punctuation-organized technical identifiers.

patterns.name: URLs and URL paths
patterns.context: Domains and path fragments in URLs or Markdown links; [7] also includes an organization-name domain.
patterns.domain: Web links, news comments, organization information

patterns.name: Dot-separated Java package and class names
patterns.context: Repeated dot-separated namespaces/package paths followed by class names or report names.

patterns.name: Build paths and stack information
patterns.context: File system paths in Julia errors or stack information, near function signatures and type information.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical symbols and literature citations
patterns.context: Greek letters, subscripts/superscripts, and LaTeX commands in equations, adjacent to author-year citations.

patterns.name: Repeated field-style code identifiers
patterns.context: Repeated dot-separated field names and struct/resource matcher fields in code.

patterns.name: C code function calls and member access
patterns.context: Struct member access, indexing, and repeated calls in function-call arguments.

9_2480.concept: 结构化技术字符串
9_2480.description: 响应结构化字符串及其分隔符：网址/路径、点分隔包名与字段、代码调用，也包括 LaTeX 公式和引用；共同点是标点组织的技术性标识串。

patterns.name: URL 与网址路径
patterns.context: 网址或 Markdown 链接中的域名、路径片段；[7] 还包括机构名称域名。
patterns.domain: 网页链接、新闻评论、组织信息

patterns.name: 点分隔的 Java 包名与类名
patterns.context: 重复出现的点分隔命名空间/包路径，后接类名或报告名。

patterns.name: 构建路径与堆栈信息
patterns.context: Julia 错误或栈信息中的文件系统路径，邻近函数签名与类型信息。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学符号与文献引用
patterns.context: 公式中的希腊字母、下标/上标及 LaTeX 命令，邻接作者-年份引用。

patterns.name: 重复字段式代码标识符
patterns.context: 代码中反复出现的点分隔字段名与结构体/资源匹配器字段。

patterns.name: C 代码函数调用与成员访问
patterns.context: 函数调用参数中出现结构体成员访问、索引和重复调用。
patterns.domain: 音频/编解码相关 C 代码

en.description: Activations occur across many kinds of split long strings, especially URLs, domains, code paths, and identifiers; they also appear in equations, academic citations, and email addresses. The examples do not share a stable thematic meaning.

patterns.name: European domains and URLs
patterns.context: European domains, EU institution domains, and their hierarchical substrings in URLs or paths; often accompanied by split domain tokens.

patterns.name: Split substrings in code paths and identifiers
patterns.context: Paths, filenames, namespaces, and identifiers are split into multiple tokens in code or structured data; activation falls on the fragments, with no unified semantic requirement.
patterns.domain: GitHub source code, Julia error output, configuration data

patterns.name: road/chose/me fragments in links
patterns.context: A URL follows the body text, and its domain or path contains these letter strings; activation is distributed across link tokens.

patterns.name: London Marathon news links
patterns.context: A link to a London Marathon story on a UK news site follows a mention of a route or year in the text.

patterns.name: β_M superscript in mathematical equations
patterns.context: Paper equations and nearby text about scattering physics; activation is concentrated on split LaTeX/mathematical tokens.
patterns.domain: ArXiv, Compton scattering and spin polarization

patterns.name: Author names and years in citations
patterns.context: Bracketed citations in ArXiv paper text, containing split author surnames, years, or reference numbers.

patterns.name: Energy email in customer contact information
patterns.context: Promotional or customer service notes end with an email address and phone number; activation is concentrated on fragments of the email domain.
patterns.domain: Business email, customer service contact information

9_2480.concept: 长字符串中的切分子串
9_2480.description: 激活出现在多种被切分的长字符串中，尤其 URL、域名、代码路径与标识符；另见公式、学术引用及邮箱。各例没有稳定共享的主题语义。

patterns.name: 欧洲相关域名与 URL
patterns.context: URL 或路径中的欧洲域名、欧盟机构域名及其层级子串；常伴随被切分的域名 token。
patterns.domain: 网页链接、Eurostat 数据文档

patterns.name: 代码路径与标识符中的切分子串
patterns.context: 代码或结构化数据中，路径、文件名、命名空间及标识符被拆成多个 token；激活落在片段上，未见统一语义要求。
patterns.domain: GitHub 源码、Julia 错误输出、配置数据

patterns.name: 链接中的 road/chose/me 片段
patterns.context: 正文后附 URL，URL 的域名或路径包含这些字母串；激活分布在链接 token 上。

patterns.name: 伦敦马拉松新闻链接
patterns.context: 正文提及路线或年份后，附带英国新闻网站的伦敦马拉松链接。
patterns.domain: Hacker News 帖文、新闻链接

patterns.name: 数学公式中的 β_M 上标
patterns.context: 论文公式及其附近的散射物理文字；激活集中在被拆分的 LaTeX/数学 token。

patterns.name: 文献引用中的作者名与年份
patterns.context: ArXiv 论文正文中的方括号引用，含拆分的作者姓氏、年份或文献编号。

patterns.name: 客服联系方式中的能源邮箱
patterns.context: 促销或客服说明末尾提供电子邮件地址与电话；激活集中在邮箱域名片段。
patterns.domain: 商业邮件、客服联系信息

en.description: Mainly activates on URLs and their split domain, protocol, and path fragments across different corpora and link uses; local patterns also include code identifiers, type signatures, academic terminology, and citation years.

patterns.name: Letter sequences in URLs/domains
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across URLs, hyperlinks, and their components, often including the protocol, hostname, and path; links are sometimes quoted or repeated.
patterns.domain: Web links, forum posts, emails, documents

patterns.name: European organization domains and certificate identifiers
patterns.context: European domain fragments occur consecutively and form package names, certificate reports, and XML type names in code identifiers.

patterns.name: Specific terms or citation numbers in professional text
patterns.context: Numbers indicating years occur in terms or literature citations; activation falls on specific terms and citation years, not on year formats in general.

patterns.name: Type signatures and build paths
patterns.context: Appears in code type parameters, generic type declarations, and build environment paths; activation covers type syntax and path fragments.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A, Julia/software build code

patterns.name: JavaScript canvas and image-resource code
patterns.context: Browser code queries a canvas via the DOM and sets an image resource URL; activation mainly falls on resource URLs and code identifier fragments.

patterns.name: Dates and news links in URL paths
patterns.context: News or organization webpage links whose paths contain dates, news categories, or location/event paths.
patterns.domain: News links, news content in emails

9_2480.concept: 网址与结构化文本片段
9_2480.description: 主要对 URL 及其被拆分的域名、协议和路径片段产生激活，涵盖多种语料与链接用途；另有代码标识符、类型签名、学术术语及引文年份等局部模式。

patterns.name: URL/域名中的字母序列
patterns.trigger: 如 «http», «://», «www», 以及域名被拆分的片段；尤其是 «road»«ch»、«eu»«rop»«a»«.»«eu»、«wor»«cester»«food»«policy»
patterns.context: 激活分布在网址、超链接及其域名的多个组成部分中，常见于 URL 的协议、主机名、路径；有时链接被引用或重复出现。
patterns.domain: 网页链接、论坛帖子、邮件、文档

patterns.name: 欧洲机构域名与证书类标识符
patterns.context: 欧洲域名片段连续出现，并在代码标识符中组成包名、证书报告及 XML 类型名称。
patterns.domain: 软件代码、证书/信任链相关技术内容

patterns.name: 专业文本中的特定术语或引用数字
patterns.context: 术语或文献引用中出现数字年份；激活落在特定术语及引文年份上，并非普遍的年份格式。
patterns.domain: 学术论文（核子物理、量子/自旋相关）

patterns.name: 类型签名与构建路径
patterns.context: 代码类型参数、泛型类型声明及构建环境路径中出现；激活覆盖类型语法和路径片段。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答、Julia/软件构建代码

patterns.name: JavaScript 画布与图片资源代码
patterns.context: 浏览器代码以 DOM 查询画布，并设置图片资源 URL；激活主要落在资源网址及代码标识符片段。

patterns.name: URL 路径中的日期与新闻链接
patterns.context: 新闻或机构网页链接的路径包含日期、新闻类别或地点事件路径。
patterns.domain: 新闻链接、邮件中的新闻资讯

en.description: Activations occur in citations, terminology, and equations in physics papers, as well as Java imports, URLs, email links, institutional promotions, and wording in hiring forms; no clear common feature is apparent.

patterns.name: LaTeX citations and reference markers
patterns.context: Activates when academic text cites references, lists bibliography entries, or transitions to a summary; trigger points often neighbor citation markers and punctuation.

patterns.name: Technical terminology and equation symbols
patterns.context: Specialized terms, equations, or theory names in physics discussion; often co-occurs with citations but is not limited to them.
patterns.domain: Theoretical physics and particle physics papers

patterns.name: Java package names and import statements
patterns.context: Consecutive dot-separated lowercase package paths and class names in code import statements.

patterns.name: URLs and URL paths
patterns.context: URLs consisting of domains, paths, or filenames; some appear in forwarded email content or institutional introductions.
patterns.domain: Email, institutional webpage text, and code-related text

patterns.name: Web links and email newsletter text
patterns.context: Web links and newsletter headlines in email; links are near dates and news site paths.
patterns.domain: Enron email and forwarded webpage content

patterns.name: Institutional promotions and contact information
patterns.context: Wording that introduces an organization, provides more information, or directs readers to a website or to send inquiries.
patterns.domain: Institutional webpage copy, email marketing, or contact information

patterns.name: Energy industry markets and consulting contacts
patterns.context: Introduces energy and industrial market trends and construction activity, and provides a consulting email or website.

patterns.name: Hiring form instructions
patterns.context: Brief instructions in a form or hiring process about completing it once a candidate is selected and about the start date.

9_2480.concept: none
9_2480.description: 激活分布于物理论文中的引文、术语与公式，也见 Java 导入、网址、邮件链接、机构宣传及招聘表格措辞；共同特征不明确。

patterns.name: LaTeX 引文与参考文献标记
patterns.context: 学术正文中引用文献、列举参考文献或转入总结时激活；触发点常邻接引文标记和标点。

patterns.name: 技术术语及公式符号
patterns.context: 物理学论述中的专门术语、公式或理论名称；多与文献引用同现，但触发并不局限于引文。
patterns.domain: 理论物理与粒子物理论文

patterns.name: Java 包名与导入语句
patterns.context: 连续的点分隔小写包路径和类名，出现在代码导入语句中。

patterns.name: 网址及 URL 路径
patterns.context: 网址由域名、路径或文件名构成；部分出现在邮件转发内容或机构介绍中。
patterns.domain: 邮件、机构网页文本及代码相关文本

patterns.name: 网页链接与邮件简报文本
patterns.context: 邮件中的网页链接和新闻简报标题，链接附近包含日期及新闻站点路径。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件及转发网页内容

patterns.name: 机构宣传及联系信息
patterns.context: 介绍机构、提供更多信息或引导访问网站、发送咨询的措辞。
patterns.domain: 机构网页文案、邮件营销或联系信息

patterns.name: 能源产业市场与咨询联系
patterns.context: 介绍能源和工业市场趋势、建设活动，并提供咨询邮箱或网站。

patterns.name: 招聘表格指示语
patterns.context: 表格或职位流程中关于候选人确定后填写、起始日期的简短说明。

en.description: Activation is distributed across URLs, domains, emails, academic citations and years, and code package names, with sporadic activations on academic terms and ordinary words as well. The common feature appears to be sensitivity to proper names, identifiers, and their subword fragments rather than a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: URL and domain fragments
patterns.context: Appears near URLs, website addresses, or email addresses; activation may fall on multiple consecutive subword fragments in domains, paths, and protocol symbols.

patterns.name: Bibliographic identifiers and years
patterns.context: Appears in bracketed citations or academic reference strings, often alongside author names, colons, or citation keys.

patterns.name: Subwords in technical terms or compound nouns
patterns.context: The word appears within a technical name or compound term; activation inconsistently falls on part of the word, with no shared semantic condition across passages.

patterns.name: Java package names and certificate identifiers
patterns.context: Appears in repeated dot-separated package paths and Java class names, with many subwords or identifier components activating consecutively.

patterns.name: Account names and organization domains in email addresses
patterns.context: Appears in contact addresses or submission emails, often adjacent to text about sending or contacting.

patterns.name: Energy industry and market phrasing
patterns.context: Appears in industry or market descriptions such as “Power and Energy markets”; activation is weak, and the passage also contains an email address.

patterns.name: Sporadic words in general explanatory text
patterns.context: Appears in job or process descriptions, with no clear shared trigger condition with other passages.

patterns.name: General words and link markers in forum text
patterns.context: In a HackerNews post, activation centers on embedded links and their tokenized URLs, with a few ordinary words also activating.

9_2480.concept: 专名与结构化字符串片段
9_2480.description: 激活分布在网址、域名、邮箱、学术引用及年份、代码包名等结构化字符串，也零散落在学术术语和普通词上；共同特点更像对专名、标识符及其子词片段敏感，而非单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 网址与域名片段
patterns.context: 出现在 URL、网站地址或电子邮件地址附近；激活可落在域名、路径、协议符号等多个连续子词片段上。

patterns.name: 引用文献标识与年份
patterns.context: 出现在方括号引用或学术参考文献串中，通常伴随作者名、冒号或文献键。

patterns.name: 专业术语或复合名词中的子词
patterns.context: 词处于专业名词或复合术语中；激活不稳定地落在词的一部分，缺乏跨段统一语义条件。
patterns.domain: 学术论文，尤其理论物理

patterns.name: Java 包名与证书类标识符
patterns.context: 出现在重复的点分隔包路径和 Java 类名中，许多子词或标识符成分连续激活。

patterns.name: 邮件地址中的账号和机构域名
patterns.context: 出现在联系地址或提交邮箱中，且常与发送、联系等说明文字相邻。

patterns.name: 能量产业与市场表述
patterns.context: 在“Power and Energy markets”等产业或市场描述中；激活较弱，段内也同时出现邮箱地址。

patterns.name: 一般说明文字中的零散词
patterns.context: 出现在职位或流程说明中，未见与其他段共享的明确触发条件。

patterns.name: 论坛文本中的一般词与链接标记
patterns.context: 一段 HackerNews 帖子中，激活集中在嵌入链接及其被分词的 URL，也有少量普通词激活。

en.description: Primarily responds to characters and word fragments in URLs, domains, and paths; it also responds to code identifiers, punctuation, and command-style text. A few activations fall on garbled parameters and symbols in academic text. A possible common feature is that the strings are structured rather than ordinary prose, but evidence across examples is limited.

patterns.name: Domain and path fragments in URLs
patterns.context: Appears in links, link previews, or cited URLs; activation falls on URL components such as protocols, domains, paths, numbers, and extensions, without requiring a particular domain
patterns.domain: Web text, forum posts, job postings, email unsubscribe links, search result lists

patterns.name: Code identifiers and syntax delimiters
patterns.context: In code or code-like identifiers and file paths, package names, namespaces, commands, and delimiters are activated; examples include Java declarations/imports and DLL print commands
patterns.domain: Source code, commands, or filename dumps

patterns.name: Local fragments in special symbols and noisy text
patterns.context: Text interspersed with symbols, mixed-case letters, and seemingly encoded or garbled text; no stable natural-language semantic trigger is evident
patterns.domain: Link parameters or encoded text in email

patterns.name: Symbols and terminology in mathematical/physics papers
patterns.context: Appears in paper sentences about the chiral limit and polarizability, and in their citation markers; there is insufficient evidence that these words alone constitute a primary pattern

9_2480.concept: 结构化字符串片段
9_2480.description: 主要响应网址及其域名、路径中的字符和词片段，也响应代码标识符、标点和命令样式文本；少量激活落在乱码参数及学术文本符号中。共同点可能是结构化、非普通散文的字符串，但跨样例证据有限。

patterns.name: 网址中的域名与路径片段
patterns.trigger: 网址部分的字符或子词，如 «http», «://», «www», «.»、«/»，以及域名/路径词片段
patterns.context: 出现在链接、链接预览或引用网址中；激活落在协议、域名、路径、数字和扩展名等网址组成部分，不要求某个固定域名
patterns.domain: 网页文本、论坛帖子、招聘信息、邮件退订链接、搜索结果列表

patterns.name: 代码标识符与语法分隔符
patterns.context: 代码或类似代码的标识符、文件路径中，包名、命名空间、命令及分隔符被激活；样例包括 Java 声明/导入和 DLL 打印命令
patterns.domain: 源代码、命令或文件名转储

patterns.name: 特殊符号和噪声文本中的局部片段
patterns.context: 夹杂符号、大小写混合字母与看似编码或乱码的文本；未见稳定的自然语言语义触发条件
patterns.domain: 邮件中的链接参数或编码文本

patterns.name: 数学/物理论文中的符号与术语
patterns.context: 出现在关于手征极限、极化率的论文句子及其引文标记中；没有足够证据说明这些词单独构成主模式

en.description: Activations concentrate on tokenized, fragmented web or document structures: URLs and paths, alphanumeric identifiers, Markdown/paper image and citation markers; local patterns also include scientific formulas, paper terminology, lists, and webpage sections.

patterns.name: Symbolic scientific notation and formulas
patterns.context: Mathematical formulas, variables, and technical terminology in scientific papers, especially physics text mixing markup languages.

patterns.name: Letter ratios and time-series descriptions
patterns.context: Biomedical papers describing how metric ratios change over time and citing supplementary figures or tables.

patterns.name: Separators in paths and filenames
patterns.context: Local filesystem paths copied in technical Q&A; paths consist of slashes, directory names, and mixed-case/alphanumeric names.

patterns.name: Topic lists and literature anchors
patterns.context: Academic or policy articles introducing priority topics and supporting claims with numbered citation links.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central／public health or policy papers

patterns.name: URLs and complex alphanumeric strings
patterns.context: Web links, URL paths, or truncated link text; characters often mix hyphens, numbers, and line breaks.

patterns.name: Image markers and paper identifiers
patterns.context: Image references in paper transcriptions or Markdown; filenames consist of journal/paper abbreviations and numeric identifiers, followed by figure labels and formatting attributes.

patterns.name: Job vacancies and institutional promotional text
patterns.context: Vacancy-filling statements in job descriptions, followed by institutional introductions and access URLs.

patterns.name: Automotive review URLs and model names
patterns.context: Car review webpage links followed by model names, driving impressions, or transmission descriptions.

9_2480.concept: 结构化文档与链接标记
9_2480.description: 激活集中于标记化、碎片化的网页或文档结构：网址与路径、字母数字标识、Markdown/论文图像及引用标记；另有科学公式、论文术语、列表和网页栏目等局部模式。

patterns.name: 带符号的科学记号与公式
patterns.context: 科学论文中的数学公式、变量及专业术语，尤其是标记语言混排的物理学文本。

patterns.name: 字母比值与时间序列表述
patterns.context: 生物医学论文中描述指标比值随时间变化，并引用补充图表。

patterns.name: 路径与文件名中的分隔符
patterns.context: 技术问答中复制本地文件系统路径；路径由斜杠、目录名和混合大小写/数字的名称组成。

patterns.name: 主题清单及文献锚点
patterns.context: 学术或政策类文章介绍优先主题，并以带编号的引用链接支持陈述。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central／公共卫生或政策论文

patterns.name: 网址与复杂字母数字串
patterns.context: 网页链接、网址路径或被截断的链接文本；字符中常混有连字符、数字和换行。

patterns.name: 图像标记及论文编号
patterns.context: 论文转写或Markdown中的图片引用，文件名由期刊/论文缩写和数字编号构成，后接图表标签与排版属性。

patterns.name: 职位空缺与机构宣传文本
patterns.trigger: «will be filled when appropriate candidate is identified»、«About Us»、«Food & Active Living Policy Council»
patterns.context: 职位说明中的空缺填补语句，随后转入机构介绍及访问网址。

patterns.name: 汽车评论网址与车型名称
patterns.context: 汽车评论网页链接后接车型、驾驶体验或变速箱描述。

en.concept: Punctuation and delimiters in structured strings
en.description: Activations most often occur on punctuation and delimiter structures in URLs, paths, code identifiers, and Markdown image markers; academic citations also appear frequently. Other sporadic activations occur in ordinary phrases, job descriptions, and mathematical symbols, which cannot be fully explained by a single text feature.

patterns.name: Punctuation boundaries in URLs or paths
patterns.context: Activations often fall in URLs, file paths, or consecutive strings separated by punctuation; text before and after punctuation may both be marked, so this cannot be reduced to one punctuation mark or word.
patterns.domain: Web links, code, file paths, and document markup

patterns.name: ArXiv citations and citation markers
patterns.context: Bracketed or author-year citations in academic text; activation is distributed across multiple components of the citation string.

patterns.name: Markdown image and anchor markers
patterns.context: Image links and the following numbered anchors form a repeated sequence of Markdown captions/image markers.
patterns.domain: Markdown-converted content from PubMed Central medical literature

patterns.name: Fields and identifiers in embedded code
patterns.context: Struct initialization in C code; activation covers field names, underscores, and hyphen-separated identifiers.

patterns.name: Web addresses containing numbers
patterns.context: A link appears in a HackerNews post, with activation on the URL protocol, domain, path, and numbers; it resembles code paths and other formats, but is recorded separately here as a specific trigger form.

patterns.name: Hyphenated filesystem paths
patterns.context: A macOS/Xcode deletion path provided in a StackExchange answer; activation covers directory separators and path components.

patterns.name: Standalone form/job description fragments
patterns.context: These words and phrases are activated, but the available context does not show a clear relation to citations, code, or link formats.

patterns.name: Standalone ordinary text fragments
patterns.context: Ordinary phrases in HackerNews text are marked; although adjacent to a link, it is unclear whether activation is caused by the phrases themselves or nearby URLs/punctuation.

patterns.name: Standalone mathematical symbol
patterns.context: A LaTeX mathematical expression in academic text; the activation marker falls on the exponent `2`, and its relation to other patterns is unclear.

9_2480.concept: 结构化字符串中的标点与分隔符
9_2480.description: 激活最常见于 URL、路径、代码标识符和 Markdown 图像标记中的标点及分隔结构；学术引文也频繁出现。另有普通短语、职位描述和数学符号等零散激活，不能由单一文本特征充分解释。

patterns.name: URL或路径中的标点边界
patterns.context: 激活常落在 URL、文件路径或由标点分隔的连续字符串中；标点前后的文本可能同时被标记，不能归结为某一种标点或词。
patterns.domain: 网页链接、代码、文件路径及文档标记

patterns.name: ArXiv 引用与引文标记
patterns.context: 学术正文中的方括号引用或作者—年份引文，激活分布在引文字符串的多个组成部分。

patterns.name: Markdown 图片与锚点标记
patterns.context: 图像链接及其后续编号锚点连成重复的 Markdown 图注/图像标记序列。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 医学文献的 Markdown 化内容

patterns.name: 嵌入代码的字段与标识符
patterns.context: C 代码中的结构体初始化，激活覆盖字段名、下划线和连字符分隔的标识符。

patterns.name: 带数字的网页地址
patterns.context: 链接出现在 HackerNews 帖文中，URL 的协议、域名、路径和数字均有激活；与代码路径等格式相似，但此处单独记录其具体触发形式。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 中引用的网页链接

patterns.name: 带连字符的文件系统路径
patterns.context: StackExchange 回答中给出的 macOS/Xcode 删除路径；激活覆盖目录分隔符和路径组件。
patterns.domain: 技术问答与文件系统路径

patterns.name: 独立的表格/职位描述片段
patterns.trigger: `be filled when appropriate candidate is identified`、`Start date is ASAP`
patterns.context: 这些词句被激活，但现有上下文没有显示它们与引文、代码或链接格式有明确关系。

patterns.name: 独立的普通文本片段
patterns.context: HackerNews 文字中的普通短语被标记，虽紧邻链接，但无法确定激活由短语本身还是邻近 URL/标点造成。

patterns.name: 独立的数学符号
patterns.context: 学术正文中的 LaTeX 数学表达式；激活标记落在指数 `2`，其与其他模式的联系不明确。

en.description: Activations are distributed across fragments of structured text: URL domains and paths, academic citation years and LaTeX formulas, code identifiers, translation file paths, and Markdown image markers; email unsubscribe templates also trigger. The commonality is sensitivity to markup-dense, delimiter-rich formatted fragments.

patterns.name: Domain and path fragments in URLs
patterns.context: Web links or Markdown links, especially hostnames with www, .com domains, and following paths; both link text and link targets can trigger.

patterns.name: Year and author fields in citations
patterns.context: Years and surrounding punctuation are marked in bracketed author-year citations in ArXiv academic text; not all citation characters activate.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical notation and formula fragments
patterns.context: Appears when variables, subscripts/superscripts, and LaTeX commands occur adjacent to one another in mathematical formulas; superscript «2» also occurs in ordinary text.

patterns.name: Types, identifiers, and member access in C/C++ code
patterns.context: Activates around integer variable declarations, assignments, and long identifiers/function calls connected by a dot.

patterns.name: File paths and markers in translation directories
patterns.context: In gettext translation files, #: source-file location comments, paths, and msgid/msgstr entries are arranged on separate lines.

patterns.name: Markdown image syntax and image filenames
patterns.context: Markdown image embeds followed by image identifiers with numeric/decimal suffixes; multiple consecutive image references.

patterns.name: Email unsubscribe templates and addresses
patterns.context: Email/newsletter unsubscribe instructions asking recipients to send a subject line containing unsubscribe to an address, followed by a website address.

patterns.name: Sporadic ordinary-text numeric superscripts
patterns.context: Appears as a superscript for a mathematical quantity; this marker is very common and cannot by itself explain the activation.

9_2480.concept: 结构化文本标记片段
9_2480.description: 激活分布于结构化文本的碎片：URL域名与路径、学术引文年份和LaTeX公式、代码标识符、翻译文件路径及Markdown图像标记；邮件退订模板也触发。共同点是对标记密集、分隔符多的格式化片段敏感。

patterns.name: URL 中的域名和路径片段
patterns.trigger: 反复出现的 «www», «.», «com», «http», «://»，以及域名/路径内被拆分的字符片段
patterns.context: 网页链接或 Markdown 链接中，尤其是带 www 的主机名、.com 域名和后续路径；链接正文和链接目标均可触发

patterns.name: 文献引用中的年份与作者字段
patterns.context: ArXiv 学术文本的方括号作者-年份引文中，年份及标点周边被标记；并非所有引文字符都激活

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学记号与公式片段
patterns.context: 数学公式中变量、上下标和 LaTeX 命令相邻时出现；另有普通文本中的上标 «2»

patterns.name: C/C++ 代码中的类型、标识符和成员访问
patterns.context: 声明整型变量、赋值及以点号连接的长标识符/函数调用时激活

patterns.name: 翻译目录中的文件路径与标记
patterns.context: gettext 翻译文件中，#: 源文件位置注释、路径及 msgid/msgstr 条目分行排列

patterns.name: Markdown 图像语法与图像文件名
patterns.context: Markdown 图像嵌入后接带编号/小数后缀的图像标识符；连续多个图像引用

patterns.name: 邮件退订模板与地址
patterns.context: 邮件/新闻通讯退订说明，要求向地址发送含 unsubscribe 的主题行，随后附网站地址
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的新闻通讯模板

patterns.name: 零散普通文本数字上标
patterns.context: 作为数学量的上标出现；该标记本身很常见，无法单独解释激活

en.description: The neuron primarily responds to structural characters and domain fragments in URLs and paths, as well as code identifiers, pointer-field access, and academic author-year citations; triggers are mostly delimiters and structured strings.

patterns.name: URL protocol and domain structure
patterns.context: URLs or links appearing in text, often containing a protocol, domain, and path; activation covers multiple URL character fragments, while surrounding prose does not necessarily activate.
patterns.domain: Web links, forum posts, institutional information

patterns.name: Underscore identifiers
patterns.context: Snake-case identifiers in code, especially variable or field names containing multiple underscores.

patterns.name: Path separators and file paths
patterns.context: Path separators connect directories, files, or URL paths; paths may contain hyphens, numbers, and mixed-case fragments.

patterns.name: Citations and literature markers
patterns.context: Author-year citations in academic text, usually at sentence ends or in reference lists.

patterns.name: Code pointer member access
patterns.context: C/C++-style code accessing structure fields through pointers.

patterns.name: Encoded characters and punctuation boundaries in URLs
patterns.context: Link paths contain dates, title words, and hyphens; line breaks or ellipses may interrupt URLs.

9_2480.concept: 结构化字符串分隔符
9_2480.description: 神经元主要响应网址及路径中的结构字符和域名片段，也响应代码标识符、指针字段访问，以及学术作者—年份引文；触发多由分隔符和结构化字符串组成。

patterns.name: URL 协议与域名结构
patterns.context: 网址或链接出现在文本中，常含协议、域名、路径；激活覆盖网址的多个字符片段，链接前后正文不一定激活
patterns.domain: 网页链接、论坛帖子、机构信息

patterns.name: 下划线标识符
patterns.context: 代码中的蛇形命名标识符，尤其带多个下划线的变量或字段名

patterns.name: 路径分隔符与文件路径
patterns.trigger: «/»及后续路径片段，如 «Users»«/»«m»«yn»«ame»«/»«Library»«/»«Developer»«/»«Xcode»«/»、URL 路径中的斜杠
patterns.context: 路径分隔符连接目录、文件或网址路径；路径可能含有连字符、数字和大小写混合片段
patterns.domain: 文件系统路径、网页链接

patterns.name: 引用与文献标记
patterns.trigger: «@»、«:»、年份及参考文献作者片段，如 «@Polyakov»«:»«1978»、«@Walker»«L»«oud»«:»«2012»
patterns.context: 学术文本中的作者—年份引文，通常位于句末或参考文献列表

patterns.name: 代码指针成员访问
patterns.context: C/C++ 风格代码通过指针访问结构体字段

patterns.name: 网址中的编码与标点边界
patterns.trigger: URL 里的 «-»、数字路径片段及被换行截断的路径，如 «2012»«/»«02»、«secret»«-»«google»«-»«x»
patterns.context: 链接路径包含日期、标题词和连字符；换行或省略号可能打断网址

en.description: Activations appear in paper equations and citations, web links, and kernel IRQ identifiers; sporadic academic word fragments and forum comments also trigger. The text forms have no clear shared semantic content.

patterns.name: Mathematical notation and equation symbols in papers
patterns.context: Appears in LaTeX math environments or near equations, including variables, superscripts/subscripts, function notation, and mathematical typesetting commands.

patterns.name: Paper citations and author-year markers
patterns.context: References appear as inline bracketed citations, @author:year, and reference identifiers.

patterns.name: URLs and link text
patterns.context: Full URLs, Markdown links, or URLs in JSON fields; activation is distributed across fragments such as protocols, domains, paths, and delimiters.
patterns.domain: Web discussions, code repository configurations, and Q&A pages

patterns.name: Linux kernel IRQ code identifiers
patterns.context: Underscore-separated device/interrupt handler identifiers and struct member access in C code.

patterns.name: Specific word fragments in academic narrative
patterns.context: Appears in sentences introducing ellipsoidally symmetric solutions and their references; these words do not recur in other paragraphs, so broader triggering conditions are unclear.

patterns.name: Phrases and usernames in web discussions
patterns.context: A short comment follows a short username in a comment-style post, followed by an external link; these triggers do not appear to be URL components.

9_2480.concept: none
9_2480.description: 激活出现在论文公式与引文、网页链接、内核 IRQ 标识符等处；另有零散学术词片段及论坛评论触发。各类文本形态并无明确共同语义。

patterns.name: 论文中的数学排版与公式符号
patterns.context: 出现在 LaTeX 数学环境或公式附近，包含变量、上标/下标、函数记号及数学排版命令。

patterns.name: 论文引文与作者年份标记
patterns.context: 参考文献以内联方括号、@作者:年份及文献标识符形式出现。

patterns.name: 网址及链接文本
patterns.context: 出现完整 URL、Markdown 链接或 JSON 字段中的网址；激活分布在协议、域名、路径和分隔符等片段。
patterns.domain: 网页讨论、代码仓库配置及问答页面

patterns.name: Linux 内核 IRQ 代码标识符
patterns.context: C 代码中由下划线连接的设备/中断处理标识符及结构体成员访问。

patterns.name: 学术叙述中的特定词片段
patterns.context: 出现在介绍椭球对称解及其文献出处的句子中；这组词在其他段落未见，是否有更广泛的触发条件不明。

patterns.name: 网页讨论中的短语及用户名
patterns.context: 评论式帖子中，短用户名后接简短评论，随后出现外链；这些触发未显示为 URL 的组成部分。

en.description: Activations appear sporadically in code identifiers, C/C++ member access, Java package paths, HTML tags, and Markdown/web link formats; they also include sporadic within-word fragments, with no unified semantic theme observed.

patterns.name: `int` lexical fragment
patterns.context: Appears in code as a type or part of an identifier; only segment 1 clearly triggers.

patterns.name: URL protocol separator
patterns.context: `https://` in URLs, usually in link text or a link target.
patterns.domain: Web text, forum posts, and documents

patterns.name: Underscores in C/C++ identifiers
patterns.context: Appears in code identifiers, commonly in multiword names such as `opal_mpool_base_default_priority`, `gpio_power_irqchip`, `default_monitor`.

patterns.name: HTML tag and attribute fragments
patterns.context: HTML tags and attributes appear densely, with indentation and line breaks.

patterns.name: Java package-name fragments
patterns.context: Dot-separated package paths and class names in Java import statements.

patterns.name: Markdown citation and link formats
patterns.context: Paper citation markers or Markdown links, including square brackets and citation information such as authors and years.

patterns.name: Code pointer and member-access operators
patterns.context: Structure members are accessed through pointers in C/C++ code.

patterns.name: Special markers and mixed-format fragments
patterns.context: These local fragments occur in ordinary webpage text or code identifiers, with no stable shared context.

9_2480.concept: 代码与标记语法片段
9_2480.description: 激活散见于代码标识符、C/C++ 成员访问、Java 包路径、HTML 标签及 Markdown/网页链接格式；还包含零散的词内片段，未见统一语义主题。

patterns.name: `int` 词法片段
patterns.context: 出现在代码中，作为类型或标识符的一部分；仅第 1 段明确触发。

patterns.name: 网址协议分隔符
patterns.context: 网址中的 `https://`，通常位于链接文本或链接目标中。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、论坛帖子及文档

patterns.name: C/C++ 标识符中的下划线
patterns.context: 出现在代码标识符中，常见于多个单词组成的名称，如 `opal_mpool_base_default_priority`、`gpio_power_irqchip`、`default_monitor`。

patterns.name: HTML 标签与属性片段
patterns.context: HTML 标签及属性密集出现，包含缩进和换行。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 中的 HTML/CSS 代码

patterns.name: Java 包名片段
patterns.context: Java import 语句中的点分隔包路径和类名。

patterns.name: Markdown 引用与链接格式
patterns.context: 论文引用标记或 Markdown 链接，包含方括号及作者、年份等引用信息。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术文本、网页链接

patterns.name: 代码指针与成员访问符
patterns.context: C/C++ 代码中通过指针访问结构体成员。

patterns.name: 特殊标记与混合格式片段
patterns.trigger: 第 3 段的 `« wor»`、`«cester»`，第 4 段的 `«[»`，第 8 段的 `«ay»`、`«c»`
patterns.context: 这些局部片段分处普通网页文字或代码标识符中，未呈现稳定共同上下文。

en.description: Activations broadly occur on proper names and string fragments in structured text: domains and paths in web URLs, code identifiers, package metadata, commands and file paths, paper citations and formula markers, and dates and entities in encyclopedia entries; the commonality is not very specific.

patterns.name: Domain and path recognition in URLs
patterns.context: Web links appear in body text or Markdown link text and targets; activations often fall on different parts of the URL domain and path, with no fixed position.

patterns.name: Segmentation fragments in code identifiers
patterns.context: Identifiers in code or import statements are split into subwords; activations occur at different positions in package names, variable names, function names, and so on.

patterns.name: npm package URLs and JSON fields
patterns.context: Dependency resolution metadata and package addresses in npm lockfile JSON objects.

patterns.name: rsync command arguments and paths
patterns.context: Source/target paths and options occur consecutively in backup commands.

patterns.name: Authors, years, and citation keys in paper citations
patterns.context: References in academic paper text, with names, years, or citation keys split into marked fragments; one example only partially fits.

patterns.name: Scientific symbols and formula markers
patterns.context: LaTeX mathematical expressions embedded in body text; activations occur near macro names and formula markers.

patterns.name: Dates, election entries, and citation labels
patterns.context: A Wikipedia-style entry describes a Wisconsin ballot measure and includes citation links; dates and the state name are split into fragments.

9_2480.concept: 结构化文本中的字符串片段
9_2480.description: 激活广泛落在结构化文本中的专名与字符串片段：网页 URL 的域名和路径、代码标识符、包元数据、命令及文件路径、论文引文和公式标记、百科条目的日期与实体；共同点不够专一。

patterns.name: URL 中的域名与路径识别
patterns.trigger: 如«http»、«://»，以及域名/路径片段«john»«polace»«k»、«travel»«ne»«v»«ada»、«commun»«ities»«-»«dom»«inate»；有些 URL 中数字、连字符和斜杠也激活
patterns.context: 网页链接出现在正文或 Markdown 链接文本、目标地址中；激活常落在 URL 的域名和路径各部分，具体位置并不固定

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的切分片段
patterns.context: 代码或导入语句中的标识符被拆成子词；激活分布于包名、变量名、函数名等不同位置

patterns.name: npm 包 URL 与 JSON 字段
patterns.context: npm 锁文件 JSON 对象中的依赖解析元数据和包地址

patterns.name: rsync 命令参数与路径
patterns.context: 备份命令中，源/目标路径与选项连续出现

patterns.name: 论文引用中的作者、年份与引文键
patterns.context: 学术论文正文的参考文献引用，姓名、年份或引用键被拆分标记；有一例仅部分符合

patterns.name: 科学符号与公式标记
patterns.context: 正文嵌入 LaTeX 数学表达式；激活出现在宏名及公式标记附近

patterns.name: 日期、选举条目与引用标签
patterns.context: 维基式标记中描述威斯康星州选票措施，并附带引用链接；日期和州名被拆分

en.description: Activations are distributed across structured strings such as URLs, domains, code repositories and dependency configurations, HTML localization paths, email footers, and academic citations; there is no single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Colons in structured text
patterns.context: Colons appear after timestamps or short labels; in some examples, they are followed by website names and URLs. Triggers are not limited to colons; related URLs and identifiers also often activate.

patterns.name: URL and domain fragments
patterns.context: Web links, repository addresses, or domains; activation may fall on URL separators, domain words, and paths.
patterns.domain: Web, email, and code repository metadata

patterns.name: Software dependency coordinates and component names
patterns.context: Package coordinates, artifact names, and version numbers in dependency configurations.

patterns.name: Git repository fields
patterns.context: Repository objects and their Git URL fields in JSON configuration.

patterns.name: Year identifiers in literature citations
patterns.context: Years occur in ArXiv literature citation markers, usually after author names.

patterns.name: Portuguese localization paths
patterns.context: HTML links pointing to Portuguese (Portugal or Brazil) preference pages.

patterns.name: Page footers and organizational contact information
patterns.context: Contact/access information provided at the end of organizational introductions or announcements.

patterns.name: Cosmology and particle-physics terminology
patterns.context: Physics paper body text; apart from citation years, these terms do not clearly correspond to a unified word-form pattern.

patterns.name: Email unsubscribe templates
patterns.context: Newsletter unsubscribe instructions at the end of emails, with a contact email and website.

9_2480.concept: 结构化标识符与链接片段
9_2480.description: 激活分散于 URL、域名、代码仓库及依赖配置、HTML 本地化路径、邮件页脚和学术引用等结构化字符串；没有单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 结构化文本中的冒号
patterns.trigger: 冒号字符「:」，如 [8] 的「20:49:」以及 [3] 的「online:」；[3] 中强激活还覆盖「worldenergyonline」和网址内容
patterns.context: 冒号出现在时间戳或短标签后；部分样例中紧接网站名、URL。触发并不局限于冒号，相关网址与标识符也常有激活
patterns.domain: 网页/邮件文本及结构化数据

patterns.name: 网址与域名片段
patterns.context: 网页链接、仓库地址或域名；激活可落在 URL 分隔符、域名词段及路径上
patterns.domain: 网页、邮件和代码仓库元数据

patterns.name: 软件依赖坐标与组件名
patterns.context: 依赖配置中的包坐标、artifact 名称及版本号

patterns.name: Git 仓库字段
patterns.context: JSON 配置中的 repository 对象及其 Git URL 字段

patterns.name: 文献引用中的年份标识
patterns.context: 年份出现在 ArXiv 文献引用标记内，通常置于作者名之后

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语本地化路径
patterns.context: HTML 链接指向葡萄牙语（葡萄牙或巴西）偏好设置页面
patterns.domain: GitHub 文档的 HTML 导航

patterns.name: 页面页脚与组织联系信息
patterns.context: 组织介绍或公告末尾提供联系/访问信息

patterns.name: 宇宙学与粒子物理术语
patterns.context: 物理学论文正文；除引用年份外，这些术语本身未明显对应统一的词形模式

patterns.name: 邮件退订模板
patterns.trigger: 「To unsubscribe」「please send a message」「unsubscribe in the subject line」
patterns.context: 邮件末尾的新闻通讯退订说明，附带联系邮箱和网站

en.concept: Proper names and identifiers in technical text
en.description: Activations are scattered across academic citation keys, URLs/email addresses, Maven configuration versions and dependency paths, and jQuery submenu identifiers. Energy industry contact information or the string continental appears in several segments, but there is no unified trigger pattern.

patterns.name: continental in a domain
patterns.context: “continental” is split into subword fragments in the URL http://continentalairlines.rsc01.net; activation is strongest on “ental”.
patterns.domain: Privacy policy or webpage link in Enron email

patterns.name: Academic citation numbers and adjacent letters
patterns.context: In physics paper citations, citation-key letters or characters following four-digit years are also often marked; the discussions concern dark matter, the matter power spectrum, Faddeev-AGS equations, or the Higgs boson.
patterns.domain: ArXiv academic papers and their citations

patterns.name: continental in a domain or URL
patterns.context: “ental” in the split “intercontinental” is marked within “intercontinental ballistic missiles”; a Wikipedia link also appears in the same paragraph, but the link itself is not marked.

patterns.name: Versions and paths in Maven dependency configuration
patterns.context: Spring Cloud Maven repository paths and version strings in XML configuration are marked in segments; configuration tags and the jar:// prefix are also marked.

patterns.name: Contact address in unsubscribe email
patterns.context: In a newsletter email's unsubscribe instructions and brand URL, the email address and the text worldenergyonline in the URL are marked.
patterns.domain: Energy industry newsletter in Enron email

patterns.name: jQuery submenu code
patterns.context: In JavaScript/jQuery code, submenu variables, CSS selectors, and navigation menu identifiers are marked.

patterns.name: Energy industry contact address
patterns.context: Promotional text about the electricity, energy, and industrial markets ends with a contact email; all parts of the email are prominently marked.
patterns.domain: Energy industry promotional content in Enron email

9_2480.concept: 技术文本中的专名与标识符
9_2480.description: 激活分散于学术引用键、网址/邮箱、Maven 配置版本与依赖路径、jQuery 子菜单标识符；多段出现能源行业联系信息或 continental 字样，但缺少统一触发模式。

patterns.name: 域名中的 continental
patterns.context: “continental”被拆成子词片段，出现在网址 http://continentalairlines.rsc01.net 中；强激活集中于“ental”。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的隐私政策或网页链接

patterns.name: 学术引用编号及相邻字母
patterns.context: 物理学论文的文献引用中，四位年份后的引用键字母或字符也常被标记；具体论述涉及暗物质、物质功率谱、Faddeev-AGS 方程或希格斯玻色子。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文及其文献引用

patterns.name: 域名或网址中的 continental
patterns.context: “intercontinental”拆分处的“ental”被标记，位于“intercontinental ballistic missiles”中；同段还出现维基百科链接，但链接本身未标记。

patterns.name: Maven 依赖配置中的版本与路径
patterns.context: XML 配置中的 Spring Cloud Maven 仓库路径及版本字符串被分段标记；同时标记了配置标签和 jar:// 前缀。

patterns.name: 退订邮件中的联系地址
patterns.context: 邮件简报的退订说明及品牌网址中，邮箱地址和网址里的 worldenergyonline 字样被标记。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的能源行业简报

patterns.name: jQuery 子菜单代码
patterns.context: JavaScript/jQuery 代码中，子菜单变量、CSS 选择器及导航菜单相关标识符被标记。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 网页开发问答代码

patterns.name: 能源行业联系地址
patterns.context: 介绍电力、能源和工业市场的宣传文字，以联系邮箱为结尾；邮箱各部分显著标记。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的能源行业宣传内容

en.description: Primarily responds to structure and word fragments in URLs, domains, and links, and also appears in email domains; there is also one activation on HTML/CSS border-style code and one on a GPIO power-simulator code identifier.

patterns.name: URLs and domains
patterns.context: Activates in web links, URL paths, or domains around URLs; also includes domains in email addresses and link-description text.
patterns.domain: Email, webpage content, papers, forum posts, web resource configuration

patterns.name: HTML/CSS border styles
patterns.context: Appears in HTML tag attributes and CSS/MSO style declarations, especially border properties and values.

patterns.name: GPIO power simulator identifiers
patterns.context: In function names, variable names, or driver identifiers in C code; the segment also contains function-related words such as «probe» and «remove».
patterns.domain: Linux kernel or driver source code

9_2480.concept: 网址与技术文本标记
9_2480.description: 主要响应网址、域名及链接中的结构和词片段，也出现在邮件域名中；另有一次 HTML/CSS 边框样式代码和一次 GPIO 电源模拟器代码标识符激活。

patterns.name: 网址与域名
patterns.context: 在网页链接、URL 路径或网址周围的域名中激活；也包括邮件地址中的域名和链接说明文字。
patterns.domain: 邮件、网页内容、论文、论坛帖子、网页资源配置

patterns.name: HTML/CSS 边框样式
patterns.context: 出现在 HTML 标签属性及 CSS/MSO 样式声明中，尤其是边框属性和值。

patterns.name: GPIO 电源模拟器标识符
patterns.context: 在 C 代码的函数名、变量名或驱动标识符中；该段还出现 «probe»、«remove» 等函数相关词。

en.description: Activations are distributed across web/email addresses, academic citations and connectives, code identifiers, and XML configuration; sporadic occurrences also include medical terminology and institutional copy. The main commonality may be special boundaries and punctuation in structured text, but this does not unify all fragments.

patterns.name: Web addresses with punctuation
patterns.context: Forms URLs in body text or link lists, often with domain names, paths, and segmented URL tokens; may be preceded by prompts such as “visit” or “at”.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, medical papers, institutional introductions, and other webpage text

patterns.name: Email addresses
patterns.context: Addresses consist of text fragments, @, and a domain suffix, embedded in contact information or promotional copy.

patterns.name: ArXiv literature citations and reference markers
patterns.context: Author-year citations, reference entries, or cross-references in paper text; often accompanied by square brackets, semicolons, and abbreviations.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, especially physics and related fields

patterns.name: Identifiers and syntax boundaries in code
patterns.context: Types, function declarations, and identifiers in Go code; activation occurs on code tokens and structural positions such as parentheses and spaces.

patterns.name: XML dependency configuration and package names
patterns.context: Tag boundaries and long Maven package names in XML dependency declarations.

patterns.name: Connectives in academic prose
patterns.context: Connects parallel concepts or forms “as well as”; in paper discussions, connects physical quantities or computational methods.

patterns.name: Unexplained sporadic pattern
patterns.context: Embedded at the beginning of a drug name, surrounded by discussion of COVID-19 study registration; a single example makes it difficult to infer a distinct trigger condition.

patterns.name: Unexplained diverse recruitment and institutional copy
patterns.context: Job information, institutional introductions, and promotional language for policy committees, with no stable local pattern shared with other fragments.

9_2480.concept: 结构化文本边界与标记
9_2480.description: 激活分散于网页/邮箱地址、学术引文与连接词、代码标识符及XML配置；另有医学术语和机构文案等零散现象。主要共同点可能是结构化文本中的特殊边界与标点，但不足以统一全部片段。

patterns.name: 带标点的网页地址
patterns.context: 在正文或链接列表中形成网址，常见域名、路径和网页地址的分段 token；周围可能有“visit”“at”等引导词。
patterns.domain: 百科、医学论文、机构介绍及其他网页文本

patterns.name: 邮箱地址
patterns.context: 地址由若干文本片段、@ 和域名后缀组成，嵌在联系信息或宣传文案中。

patterns.name: ArXiv 文献引用与参考文献标记
patterns.context: 论文正文中的作者—年份引文、参考文献条目或交叉引用；常伴随方括号、分号和缩写词。
patterns.domain: 学术论文，尤其物理及相关领域

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符与语法边界
patterns.context: Go 代码中的类型、函数声明和标识符；激活落在代码 token 及其括号、空格等结构位置。

patterns.name: XML 依赖配置与包名
patterns.context: XML 依赖声明中的标签边界与较长 Maven 包名。
patterns.domain: Github 配置文件（Spring Cloud / Maven）

patterns.name: 学术文体中的连接词
patterns.context: 连接并列概念或构成“as well as”；在论文论述中连接物理量或计算方法。

patterns.name: 未解释的零散模式
patterns.context: 嵌在药物名称开头，周围讨论 COVID-19 研究注册；难以从单例判断独立触发条件。

patterns.name: 未解释的多样化招聘与机构文案
patterns.context: 职位信息、机构介绍和政策委员会宣传语，未见与其他片段稳定共享的局部模式。

en.concept: Identifiers and links in web and software text
en.description: Activations are distributed across configuration, code, styles, web resources, and institutional or business contact text; they often mark URLs, emails, plugin names, and technical identifiers, but the specific formats vary considerably.

patterns.name: Maven dependency XML
patterns.context: Dependency elements and Spring Boot test component names in Maven configuration.

patterns.name: Food policy organization URL
patterns.context: A URL provided after an organizational introduction for access or further information.

patterns.name: Energy mailing-list unsubscribe information
patterns.context: Newsletter unsubscribe instructions and site link.

patterns.name: CSS layout properties
patterns.context: Border, font-unit, and Microsoft Office-specific properties in style declarations.

patterns.name: CPU time function identifier
patterns.context: A function name in C code, surrounded by timespec-to-nanoseconds conversion and preprocessing code.

patterns.name: Translation forum URL
patterns.context: A request for help translating strings, linking to a project forum for submitting revised files.

patterns.name: Industrial energy business contact information
patterns.context: A consultation email and website provided after an introduction to energy and industrial markets.

patterns.name: External reference links
patterns.context: URLs listed under Wikipedia entry headings such as References and External links.

patterns.name: Contact information fields and email
patterns.context: Contact details such as phone, email, and fax listed by field after a company address.

patterns.name: Bootstrap date picker resources
patterns.context: Bootstrap plugin resources mentioned in HTML comments and script references.

9_2480.concept: 网页与软件中的标识及链接
9_2480.description: 激活分布于配置、代码、样式、网页资源及机构或商务联系文本；常标出 URL、邮箱、插件名和技术标识符，但各段具体格式差异较大。

patterns.name: Maven 依赖 XML
patterns.context: Maven 配置中，依赖元素及 Spring Boot 测试组件名称

patterns.name: 食品政策机构网址
patterns.context: 机构简介后提供访问或查找信息的网址

patterns.name: 能源邮件列表退订信息
patterns.context: 新闻邮件的退订说明和站点链接

patterns.name: CSS 排版属性
patterns.context: 样式声明中出现边框、字体单位及 Microsoft Office 特有属性

patterns.name: CPU 时间函数标识符
patterns.context: C 代码中的函数名，周围有 timespec 转纳秒及预处理代码

patterns.name: 翻译论坛网址
patterns.context: 请求协助翻译字符串，并指向项目论坛提交修订文件

patterns.name: 工业能源业务联系方式
patterns.context: 能源与工业市场介绍后提供咨询邮箱和网站
patterns.domain: Enron Emails；商业宣传/联系信息

patterns.name: 外部参考链接
patterns.context: 百科条目 References、External links 标题下列出的 URL

patterns.name: 联系信息字段与邮箱
patterns.context: 公司地址后按字段列出电话、邮箱、传真等联系资料

patterns.name: Bootstrap 时间选择器资源
patterns.context: HTML 注释和 script 引用中提及 Bootstrap 插件资源

en.concept: Structured strings in code and URLs
en.description: Primarily responds to protocols, punctuation, and string fragments in URLs and domains; it also activates near XML tag indentation, error records with hexadecimal addresses, and underscore-separated C identifiers.

patterns.name: Punctuation and strings in URLs and domains
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across URL protocols, hostnames, domains, and paths; sometimes the same link appears both in the body text and in a parenthetical link.
patterns.domain: Links in webpages, email, forums, and documents

patterns.name: HTML/XML tags and indentation adjacent to URLs
patterns.context: Appears near XML tags, attributes, or code indentation in dependency declarations; activation is not limited to URLs.

patterns.name: Address numbers in compressed-file error stacks
patterns.context: Repeatedly appears in the ZipFile.ZipInfo object address `0x1004ca`, near Bad password error text.

patterns.name: IRQ/power-related C identifiers
patterns.context: Identifiers are split into multiple tokens within underscore-separated kernel-style function and parameter names.

patterns.name: Resource statistics identifiers in C code
patterns.context: Appears in the function declaration `spx_resource_stats_cpu_time`, surrounded by C code and preprocessor directives.

9_2480.concept: 代码与网址中的结构化字符串
9_2480.description: 主要响应网址及域名的协议、标点和字符串片段；另在 XML 标签缩进、带十六进制地址的错误记录，以及下划线分隔的 C 标识符中激活。

patterns.name: 网址与域名中的标点和字符串
patterns.context: 激活分布在网址的协议、主机名、域名和路径中；有时同一链接在正文和括号链接中重复出现。
patterns.domain: 网页、邮件、论坛与文档中的链接

patterns.name: URL 邻接的 HTML/XML 标记与缩进
patterns.context: 出现在依赖声明的 XML 标签、属性或代码缩进附近，激活并非只限于网址。

patterns.name: 压缩文件错误栈中的地址数字
patterns.context: 重复出现在 ZipFile.ZipInfo 对象地址 `0x1004ca` 中，邻近 Bad password 错误文本。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 错误输出/调试记录

patterns.name: IRQ/电源相关 C 标识符
patterns.context: 在下划线分隔的内核风格函数名和参数名内部，标识符被切分为多个 token。
patterns.domain: Github C 代码/驱动程序

patterns.name: C 代码中的资源统计标识符
patterns.context: 出现在函数声明 `spx_resource_stats_cpu_time` 中，周围是 C 代码和预处理指令。

en.description: Primarily activates on URLs, domains, and their segmented subword fragments, and also appears in email unsubscribe/contact information; it has separate responses to XML dependency tags, GPIO driver identifiers, and Unity serialized fields and GUIDs. General informational prompts occasionally activate; the remaining garbled link fragments in segment 3 are difficult to interpret.

patterns.name: URL and domain fragments
patterns.context: When URLs or domains in web or email addresses are split into multiple tokens, especially readable domain words; also appears in links in body text.
patterns.domain: Web text, email, forum posts, paper body text

patterns.name: Email contact and subscription information
patterns.context: Unsubscribe instructions or contact information in emails; email and website addresses are the main trigger locations.

patterns.name: XML dependency configuration markers
patterns.context: Tags and dependency coordinates in XML/Maven configuration; also contains many angle brackets, slashes, and tag names.

patterns.name: GPIO/IRQ identifiers in C code
patterns.context: Underscore-separated hardware driver identifiers, function calls, and array indexing in C-style code.

patterns.name: Unity serialized fields and GUIDs
patterns.context: YAML-style Unity asset serialization records, with file IDs or GUIDs following field names.

patterns.name: General informational prompts
patterns.context: Prompts introducing information or directing readers to websites in page or email text; activations are scattered and often co-occur with URLs.

patterns.name: Fragmented subwords within short words
patterns.context: When ordinary words or domains are split into multiple fragments by the tokenizer, the fragments can activate independently; they occur sporadically in texts on different topics.

9_2480.concept: 网址及结构化文本片段
9_2480.description: 主要对网址、域名及其拆分子词片段激活，也见邮件退订/联系信息；另对 XML 依赖标签、GPIO 驱动标识符、Unity 序列化字段与 GUID 有独立响应。一般信息导引语偶有激活；第3段其余乱码链接难以解释。

patterns.name: 网址与域名片段
patterns.context: 网址或邮箱地址中的 URL/域名被拆成多个 token 时，尤其是可读的域名词段；也出现在正文链接中。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、邮件、论坛帖子、论文正文

patterns.name: 邮件联系方式与订阅信息
patterns.context: 邮件中的退订说明或联系信息，邮箱和网站地址是主要触发处。

patterns.name: XML 依赖配置标记
patterns.context: XML/Maven 配置中的标签和依赖坐标；同时包含大量尖括号、斜杠及标记名。

patterns.name: C 代码中的 GPIO/IRQ 标识符
patterns.context: C 风格代码中包含下划线分隔的硬件驱动标识符、函数调用及数组索引。

patterns.name: Unity 序列化字段与 GUID
patterns.trigger: «m_Enabled»、«m_EditorHideFlags»、«m_Script»、«guid»及其后拆分的十六进制字符
patterns.context: YAML 风格 Unity 资源序列化记录，字段名后跟文件 ID 或 GUID。

patterns.name: 一般性信息导引语
patterns.trigger: «For»« more»« information»« on»、«visit»« us»，以及«About»« Us»
patterns.context: 介绍页面或邮件中的信息说明、访问网站等导引语；激活较分散，且常与网址同现。

patterns.name: 短词内部的碎片化子词
patterns.context: 普通单词或域名被分词器拆成多个片段时，片段本身可分别激活；在不同主题文本中零星出现。

en.concept: Boundaries and identifiers in structured technical text
en.description: High activations primarily occur in structured technical text such as code, configuration, markup, and URLs, especially delimiters, tag/attribute boundaries, and identifiers composed of multiple word fragments. Specific domains and terms vary; occasional webpage copy and email links also appear.

patterns.name: Delimiters and markup in structured technical text
patterns.context: These symbols appear in consecutive technical strings, separating URLs, code identifiers, XML attributes, or style declarations; they usually neighbor longer word fragments, numbers, or keywords. The specific highly activated symbols differ by segment, with no single fixed symbol consistently prominent across all segments.
patterns.domain: Software code, configuration files, HTML/XML/CSS, URLs, and links in email

patterns.name: Compound identifiers in code and configuration
patterns.context: Technical names joined by capitalization, underscores, or hyphens; activation may fall on multiple word fragments and joining characters in an identifier.

patterns.name: URL and domain paths
patterns.context: When domain components, periods, slashes, and paths occur consecutively in a URL; domain word fragments in segment 1 are especially strongly activated.
patterns.domain: Web links, news links in email

patterns.name: XML/HTML tag and attribute structure
patterns.context: Markup syntax consisting of angle brackets, tag names, attribute names, quotation marks, and attribute values; comments and tag/attribute boundaries also trigger responses.
patterns.domain: XML, HTML, and similar markup languages

patterns.name: Object-oriented and package name paths
patterns.context: Dot-separated package names or qualified names followed by class/repository names; appears in Java imports and dependency configuration.

patterns.name: CSS variables and declaration syntax
patterns.context: Variables beginning with `@`, hyphenated compound names, and colon-separated properties and values, with style declarations ending in semicolons.

patterns.name: Specific technical word fragments
patterns.context: Field names, component names, and domain identifiers in code or configuration; these terms occur in different project contexts and do not form a single stable semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Food policy domain in business webpage copy
patterns.context: Appears as the website address in institutional introductions and contact information for a local food and active living policy council.

patterns.name: Media names in email news links
patterns.context: A news recommendation headline and URL at the end of an email, with the media domain adjacent to the link path.

patterns.name: Hardware interrupts and probe flow in code
patterns.context: Identifiers, struct members, and jump labels for a GPIO power interrupt chip and probe flow in kernel driver code.

patterns.name: Android state color resources
patterns.context: An Android XML selector specifies drawable or color resources by control state.

patterns.name: Time picker plugin references
patterns.context: A Bootstrap time picker plugin is mentioned in an HTML comment and script `src` path.

patterns.name: Legacy border attributes in table styles
patterns.context: Inline styles on HTML table cells, including Word-related `mso-` attributes and length units.

patterns.name: Functional code and jump syntax
patterns.context: Struct member access, bitwise operations, and label jumps in C code; symbols and identifiers are interspersed.

patterns.name: Weak word items explained only by structured code/markup context
patterns.context: Appear respectively as XML attribute values, CSS keywords, or filename fragments near markup/links; they do not form a unified semantic trigger by themselves.

9_2480.concept: 结构化技术文本的边界与标识符
9_2480.description: 高激活主要出现在代码、配置、标记语言和网址等结构化技术文本中，尤其是分隔符、标签/属性边界及由多词片段组成的标识符；具体领域和词项多样，偶见网页文案与邮件链接。

patterns.name: 结构化技术文本中的分隔符与标记
patterns.context: 这些符号出现在连续的技术字符串中，用来分隔网址、代码标识符、XML属性或样式声明；通常邻接较长的词片段、数字或关键字。各段中具体高激活符号不同，未见单一固定符号在所有段一致突出。
patterns.domain: 软件代码、配置文件、HTML/XML/CSS、网址及邮件中的链接

patterns.name: 代码与配置中的复合标识符
patterns.context: 大小写、下划线或连字符连接的技术名称；激活可落在标识符的多个组成词片段及连接符上。

patterns.name: 网址与域名路径
patterns.context: URL 中域名各组成部分、句点、斜线及路径连续出现时；第1段域名词片段激活尤其强。
patterns.domain: 网页链接、邮件中的新闻链接

patterns.name: XML/HTML标签与属性结构
patterns.context: 尖括号、标签名、属性名、引号和属性值构成的标记语法中；注释及标签/属性边界也有响应。

patterns.name: 面向对象及包名路径
patterns.context: 由点号连接的包名或限定名，后接类名/仓库名；Java代码导入语句及依赖配置中出现。

patterns.name: CSS变量与声明语法
patterns.context: 以 `@` 开头的变量、连字符复合名，以及冒号分隔的属性和值、分号结尾的样式声明。

patterns.name: 特定技术词片段
patterns.context: 代码或配置中的字段名、组件名和领域标识符；这些词分别出现于不同项目上下文，未形成单一稳定词义模式。

patterns.name: 业务网页文案中的食品政策域名
patterns.context: 机构介绍及联系信息中，作为地方食品与积极生活政策委员会的网站地址。

patterns.name: 邮件新闻链接中的媒体名称
patterns.context: 邮件末尾的新闻推荐标题及网址中，媒体域名与链接路径相邻。

patterns.name: 代码中的硬件中断与探测流程
patterns.context: 内核驱动代码中，GPIO电源中断芯片及探测流程的标识符、结构体成员和跳转标签。

patterns.name: Android状态颜色资源
patterns.context: Android XML选择器中，按控件状态指定 drawable 或颜色资源。

patterns.name: 时间选择器插件引用
patterns.context: HTML注释及脚本 `src` 路径中提及 Bootstrap 时间选择器插件。

patterns.name: 表格样式中的旧式边框属性
patterns.context: HTML表格单元格的内联样式，含 Word 相关 `mso-` 属性及长度单位。

patterns.name: 函数式代码与跳转语法
patterns.context: C代码中的结构体成员访问、位运算及标签跳转；符号与标识符交错。

patterns.name: 仅由结构化代码/标记上下文解释的弱词项
patterns.context: 分别作为XML属性值、CSS关键字或文件名片段出现在标记/链接附近；本身并不构成统一语义触发。

en.description: Activation is concentrated mainly on the literal fragment “Pad”: it commonly occurs in iPad names and also as a typographic fill character; it also appears as an incidental substring in foreign words or proper names, without a consistent meaning.

patterns.name: Substring within iPad
patterns.context: Appears in Apple iPad names or related models, filenames, and app names; sometimes preceded by a word boundary or with different capitalization.

patterns.name: Fill / placeholder token
patterns.context: Appears as fill content or an alignment placeholder in tables or text, not necessarily referring to a device.

patterns.name: Pad substring in foreign words
patterns.context: May have no semantic relation to iPad; it may result from tokenization or text encoding.
patterns.domain: Latvian parliamentary text, Italian proper names

9_2521.description: 激活主要集中于字面片段“Pad”：常见于 iPad 名称，也出现为排版填充符；另有外语词或专名中的偶然子串，语义并不统一。

patterns.name: iPad 词内片段
patterns.context: 出现 Apple iPad 名称或相关型号、文件名、应用名；有时前面带有分词边界或大小写变化。

patterns.name: 填充/填充符 token
patterns.context: 作为表格或文本中的填充内容、对齐占位符出现，不一定指设备。

patterns.name: 外语词中的 Pad 子串
patterns.trigger: “Pad”出现在非英语词语或断裂的分词片段中，如“Padome”“Padova”
patterns.context: 未必与 iPad 有语义关联，可能是分词或文本编码造成的偶合。
patterns.domain: 拉脱维亚语议会文本、意大利语专名

en.description: Most segments contain Pad/iPad strings, especially iPad device names and their URLs, code, and filenames; others contain fragments of the surname Padmanabhan and Pad fragments in multilingual text. Some segments also activate locally unrelated tokens.

patterns.name: iPad strings
patterns.context: Appears in device names, product names, URLs, filenames, or code data strings; sometimes split into multiple subword tokens.

patterns.name: Pad substring in Padmanabhan citations
patterns.context: Bracketed citations to literature authors in physics papers; Pad is the beginning of an author's surname, not a device name.

patterns.name: Padding/truncation marker Pad
patterns.context: Appears near text in different languages, tables, and citations, seemingly due to a special token or tokenization boundary; has no consistent semantic context.
patterns.domain: Patents, parliamentary text, medical tables, encyclopedia text

patterns.name: Other activations not labeled Pad
patterns.context: These words or substrings are activated in their respective sentences, but have no clear, consistent relation to Pad/iPad strings; they may reflect independent local patterns.
patterns.domain: Antibody patents, Java code, iOS configuration

9_2521.description: 多数段包含 Pad/iPad 字符串，尤以 iPad 设备名及其 URL、代码、文件名为主；另有 Padmanabhan 姓氏片段和多语种文本中的 Pad 片段。部分段还激活了局部无关 token。

patterns.name: iPad 字符串
patterns.context: 出现于设备名称、产品名、URL、文件名或代码数据字符串中；有时被拆分为多个子词 token。
patterns.domain: 网页、论坛、代码、软件配置

patterns.name: Padmanabhan 引文中的 Pad 子串
patterns.context: 物理学论文对文献作者的方括号引用；Pad 是作者姓氏开头的一部分，并非设备名。

patterns.name: 填充/截断标记 Pad
patterns.context: 出现在不同语种文本及表格、引文附近，像是特殊 token 或分词边界造成的片段；没有一致的语义上下文。
patterns.domain: 专利、议会文本、医学表格、百科文本

patterns.name: 未标记为 Pad 的其他激活
patterns.trigger: « CD»5«R»33、« heavy»、« CD»5«R»33 amino acid residues；以及 « new»、« Data»、« iPhone»、« icon»、« <»
patterns.context: 这些词或子串在各自句中有激活，但与 Pad/iPad 字符串没有清楚的一致关系；可能反映独立的局部模式。
patterns.domain: 抗体专利、Java 代码、iOS 配置

en.concept: Pad strings and their occurrence within words
en.description: Activation is concentrated on the literal fragment Pad10, including standalone strings, within-word fragments, and proper names; it also appears in iPad and numpad. It occurs across varied contexts, is absent from segment 4, and remains unexplained.

patterns.name: Pad10 label or subword
patterns.context: The literal string Pad10 appears in text; it may be a product name, filename, proper name, or a fragment within a word.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text, code, papers, and email; segments [1], [3], [6], [8], [9]

patterns.name: iPad product name
patterns.context: Pad combines with the prefix i to form Apple's tablet product name, appearing in code data, resource filenames, or URL paths.
patterns.domain: StackExchange code, Github configuration, HackerNews links

patterns.name: numpad identifier
patterns.context: Pad is the latter part of the compound identifier numpad, referring to a numeric keypad position.
patterns.domain: Github source code comments and enums

9_2521.concept: Pad 字符串及其词内出现
9_2521.description: 激活主要集中在字面片段 Pad10：包括独立字符串、词内片段及专名；也出现在 iPad 和 numpad 中。多种语境共现，段4未见该片段，无法解释。

patterns.name: Pad10 标记或子词
patterns.context: 字面字符串 Pad10 在文本中出现；可能是产品名、文件名、专名或词语内部片段。

patterns.name: iPad 产品名
patterns.context: Pad 与前缀 i 连成 Apple 平板产品名，出现在代码数据、资源文件名或网址路径中。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 代码、Github 配置、HackerNews 链接

patterns.name: numpad 标识符
patterns.context: Pad 是复合标识符 numpad 的后半部分，指数字键盘位置。

en.description: Activation is scattered across medical, encyclopedic, news, and web text, often falling on subword boundaries within words or fragments of proper names. Other local patterns include CD identifiers, left-right comparisons, repeated table fields, headlines, and purpose statements.

patterns.name: Tokenization boundaries in words or headlines
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on internal subword fragments in English words or proper names, especially across tokenizer subword boundaries; some occur in headlines, links, or tables.
patterns.domain: Various styles, including medical papers, encyclopedia entries, news headlines, web links, and tables

patterns.name: CD in medical abbreviations
patterns.context: CD is followed by a numeric or alphanumeric identifier as part of a marker, molecule, or project name.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts and NIH project descriptions

patterns.name: Left-right comparison
patterns.context: Explicitly compares differences between two groups, sites, or directions; one instance is in a headline, another in a left-right comparison in body text.

patterns.name: Repeated fields in structured tables
patterns.context: The same institution, location, and disease names recur across aligned table rows, with extensive whitespace.

patterns.name: News section headlines
patterns.context: Several section or category terms form a short headline, followed by a region and a colon.
patterns.domain: News digest headlines in Enron emails

patterns.name: Encyclopedia entry titles and definition openings
patterns.context: An entry title is a term or biological name; it may be followed by a blank line or the start of a defining sentence.

patterns.name: Product names and teardown links
patterns.context: A product name or teardown topic appears in a headline and URL path.

patterns.name: Research-purpose phrasing
