en.description: Activations are widely dispersed: several code identifiers containing window are the most concentrated; English this, a specific link number, a blaswrap header, and numbers in mathematical expressions also occur, with no clear shared condition.

patterns.name: window identifiers
patterns.context: Appears in code as an object or variable name; may occur in different identifiers such as window.require, mainwindow, c_nn_window, and t_window, and need not be a standalone word.

patterns.name: this phrases
patterns.context: this appears in English sentences, followed by week’s or message; activation is on this.

patterns.name: Specific URL number string
patterns.context: Near the end of a HackerNews link path, preceded by a slashdot.org/story/... URL structure.

patterns.name: Blaswrap header fragment
patterns.context: Appears in a C/C++ #include header filename, in the form blaswrap.h.

patterns.name: Mathematical numeric fragment
patterns.context: Numbers appear as values in expressions that include subtraction and an equals sign.

9_2831.description: 激活分布很散：代码中多处含 window 的标识符最集中；另见英语 this、特定链接数字、blaswrap 头文件和数学算式中的数字，彼此缺少明确共同条件。

patterns.name: window 标识符
patterns.context: 在代码中作为对象/变量名出现；可位于 window.require、mainwindow、c_nn_window、t_window 等不同标识符中，未必是独立单词。

patterns.name: this 短语
patterns.context: 英文句子中出现 this，后接 week’s 或 message；激活标在 this。

patterns.name: 特定网址数字串
patterns.context: 位于 HackerNews 链接路径末尾附近，前有 slashdot.org/story/... 的 URL 结构。

patterns.name: Blaswrap 头文件片段
patterns.context: 出现在 C/C++ 的 #include 头文件名中，形式为 blaswrap.h。

patterns.name: 数学数值片段
patterns.context: 数字作为算式中的数值出现，包含减法及等号。

en.description: Activations are dispersed across internal subwords, proper-name fragments, code paths and function names, and words related to walking; they span varied corpora and semantics and are difficult to group under a single theme.

patterns.name: Character/subword fragment segmentation
patterns.context: Activations fall on specific subword fragments inside proper names, English words, or inflected forms; fragments typically follow different prefixes or suffixes, with no consistent semantic condition observed
patterns.domain: Tokenization and text in mixed corpora

patterns.name: Paths and file extensions in code
patterns.context: Code imports a relative-path CSS file; activations occur near both the path separator and the filename/extension

patterns.name: R data-processing code
patterns.context: R code deduplicates string factors or data columns; activations also cover adjacent punctuation and code markers

patterns.name: Expressions related to walking
patterns.context: One context describes a bear moving near traffic, while another discusses redirected walking; the meanings and styles differ

patterns.name: Title-style academic phrase
patterns.context: Proper-name/title fragments in abstracts or paper titles, adjacent to technical terminology; there is insufficient evidence that a shared theme drives activation

patterns.name: Internal fragments of personal or proper names
patterns.context: Fragments occur in personal names, institution names, or proper names, including uncommon transliterations or spellings

9_2831.description: 激活分散在词内子词、专名片段、代码路径与函数名，以及 walking 相关词上；覆盖多种语料和语义，难以归为单一主题。

patterns.name: 字符/子词片段切分
patterns.context: 激活落在专名、英文词或词形内部的特定子词片段上；片段通常紧接不同前缀或后缀，未见一致的词义条件
patterns.domain: 混合语料中的分词与文本

patterns.name: 代码中的路径与文件扩展名
patterns.context: 代码里导入相对路径的 CSS 文件，路径分隔符和文件名/扩展名附近均有激活

patterns.name: R 语言数据处理代码
patterns.context: R 代码中对字符串因子或数据列执行去重；激活也覆盖相邻的标点和代码标记

patterns.name: 行走相关表达
patterns.context: 一个上下文描述熊在交通附近活动，另一个讨论 redirected walking；词义和文体不同

patterns.name: 标题式学术短语
patterns.context: 摘要或论文标题中的专名/标题词片段，邻接专业术语；没有充分证据表明触发来自某个共同主题

patterns.name: 人名或专名内部片段
patterns.context: 片段出现在人名、机构名或专名中，包括转写/拼写不常见的名称

en.description: Activations are mainly distributed across segmented words, names, abbreviations, and name fragments, often involving case boundaries; they also cover ordinary English word fragments and a string of encoded characters. The examples differ substantially in semantics and style, making a single lexical explanation difficult.

patterns.name: Token-by-token concatenation of uppercase letters and word fragments
patterns.context: Activations concentrate inside names or words split into multiple tokens, especially initial letters of fragments and subsequent subword fragments; visible fragments need not belong to the same word category.
patterns.domain: Multilingual text, people/proper names, ordinary prose

patterns.name: Specific fragments in personal names or title-style names
patterns.context: Segmented word fragments in proper names, work titles, or names; sometimes followed by a parenthesized year, possessive, or title formatting, but these conditions are not shared by all examples.

patterns.name: Tokenization structure in ordinary English sentences
patterns.context: The sentence-initial “A” and subsequent segmented English word fragments can also activate; the content concerns research proposals and neuroanatomy, respectively, with no shared semantic theme observed.

patterns.name: Fragments of all-caps abbreviations/proper names
patterns.context: Capitalized initial fragments or mixed-case abbreviation and name fragments, possibly followed by ordinary words; no specific format is required.
patterns.domain: Corporate emails, European Parliament text, and other prose

patterns.name: Long string of encoded characters
patterns.context: A continuous string of uppercase and lowercase letters and digits, forming an encoded or possibly Base64 string; it contains almost no natural-language vocabulary.

9_2831.description: 激活主要分布于被切分的词、姓名、缩写及名称片段，常含大小写边界；也覆盖普通英语词片段与一段编码字符。各例语义和文体差异明显，难以用单一词义解释。

patterns.name: 大小写字母与词片段的逐 token 拼接
patterns.context: 激活集中在被拆分成多个 token 的名字或词语内部，尤其是片段的首字母及后续子词片段；可见片段不要求构成同一类词。
patterns.domain: 多语种文本、人物/专名、普通正文

patterns.name: 人名或标题式名称中的特定片段
patterns.context: 专名、作品名或名称中的拆分词片段；有时后接括号年份、所有格或标题格式，但这些条件并非各段共有。
patterns.domain: 标题、传记条目、歌词/作品名

patterns.name: 普通英语句子的分词结构
patterns.trigger: «A»6« major»6« goal»8« of»4« this»9« proposal»4；«A»6« neuronal»9« projection»5
patterns.context: 句首的“A”及随后拆分的英语词片段也能激活；内容分别涉及科研提案和神经解剖，未见共同语义主题。

patterns.name: 全大写缩写/专名片段
patterns.context: 大写起始片段或混合大小写的缩写、名称片段，后续可接普通词；不要求特定格式。
patterns.domain: 企业邮件、欧盟议会文本及其他正文

patterns.name: 长串编码字符
patterns.context: 连续的大小写字母与数字组成的编码/疑似 Base64 字符串；几乎没有自然语言词汇。

en.description: Mainly responds to LaTeX mathematical typesetting structures in math papers and Q&A, including formulas, symbols, environments, and labels; it also responds to filenames, macros, and compilation identifiers in a programming text.

patterns.name: Formula boundaries and structures in mathematical LaTeX
patterns.context: Activations fall on formulas, formula environments, or text tokens adjacent to formulas; content covers diverse mathematical objects such as kernel functions, fractional derivatives, partitions, piecewise functions, trees, operators, integrals, and series.
patterns.domain: ArXiv math and theory papers; StackExchange math Q&A

patterns.name: Formula labels and numbers
patterns.context: LaTeX labels or numbers appear near formulas; strong activations fall on tokens such as closing parentheses in labels.
patterns.domain: LaTeX source of ArXiv math papers

patterns.name: Code filenames and preprocessor symbols
patterns.context: Appears in code-related text resembling file lists or build configurations, including file extensions, macros, or compilation-option-style identifiers.

9_2831.description: 主要响应数学论文及问答中的 LaTeX 数学排版结构，涵盖公式、符号、环境和标签；另在一段编程文本中响应文件名、宏和编译标识符。共同线索可能是结构化技术文本。

patterns.name: 数学 LaTeX 中的公式边界与结构
patterns.trigger: 如 «=»、«$$»、«\sum»、«\label»、«\begin»、«\frac»、«\phi» 等数学记号及其周围的 LaTeX 结构
patterns.context: 激活落在公式、公式环境或紧邻公式的文本 token 上；内容涉及核函数、分数阶导数、分区、分段函数、树、算子、积分和级数等多类数学对象。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学与理论论文；StackExchange 数学问答

patterns.name: 公式标签与编号
patterns.context: 公式附近出现 LaTeX 标签或编号；强激活落在标签结尾的括号等 token 上。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学论文的 LaTeX 源文

patterns.name: 代码文件名与预处理器符号
patterns.context: 出现在类似文件列表或构建配置的代码相关文本中，包含文件扩展名、宏或编译选项式标识符。

en.description: Mainly responds to the structure, symbols, variables, and multiline formatting of LaTeX math and scientific formulas, spanning mathematics, physics, and statistics; it also activates on a few local features such as code configuration, piecewise definitions, thermal descriptions, and wavenumber spectra.

patterns.name: LaTeX math environments and formula-structure markers
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on LaTeX formulas, formula labels, and alignment structures in math papers or math Q&A; formulas from different fields are represented.
patterns.domain: ArXiv math/physics papers, StackExchange math content

patterns.name: Punctuation separating or introducing expressions in formulas
patterns.context: Appears within formula environments, often separating formula parts, introducing equations, or marking alignment positions; it is not specific to a particular field.

patterns.name: Greek letters and mathematical variables
patterns.context: Appear as variables or parameters in formulas, often with subscripts, superscripts, function arguments, or differential operators; the physical quantities and mathematical objects differ across examples.

patterns.name: Multiline formulas and line breaks
patterns.context: Formulas are typeset as multiline alignments, continuations, or standalone displays; activations may fall on environment markers, line breaks, and nearby formula tokens.

patterns.name: Configuration keys and resource initialization in code
patterns.context: Ruby-style code checks platform configuration and initializes resources; activations fall near configuration values and method calls, rather than LaTeX math content.

patterns.name: Piecewise definitions in irregular mathematical expressions
patterns.context: A random variable or function is defined piecewise, followed by inequalities related to boundedness or expected values.

patterns.name: Formula variables adjacent to scientific terminology
patterns.context: Explanatory text about thermal signals or temperature responses is adjacent to formulas for time constants and temperature changes.

patterns.name: Power-law expressions for wavenumbers and spectra
patterns.context: Describes a spectrum or power relationship as a function of wavenumber in a low-wavenumber range.

patterns.name: Field equations and geometric operators
patterns.context: A scalar field’s field equation is written using differential operators, a cosmological constant, and field variables.

9_2831.concept: 学术 LaTeX 公式与符号
9_2831.description: 主要响应 LaTeX 数学与科学公式的结构、符号、变量和跨行排版，覆盖数学、物理及统计内容；也对代码配置、分段定义、热学说明和波数谱等少数局部特征激活。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学环境与公式结构标记
patterns.context: 激活集中在数学论文或数学问答中的 LaTeX 公式、公式标签和对齐结构；不同领域的公式均出现。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学/物理论文、StackExchange 数学内容

patterns.name: 公式中分隔或开启表达式的标点
patterns.trigger: 「\qquad」「:」「=」「&=&」等公式中的标点与关系符号
patterns.context: 出现在公式环境内，常用于分隔公式部分、引入等式或标记对齐位置；不是特定领域专属。

patterns.name: 希腊字母与数学变量
patterns.context: 作为公式中的变量或参数出现，常伴随下标、上标、函数自变量或微分算子；各段所指物理量和数学对象并不相同。
patterns.domain: 数学、物理及统计类文献

patterns.name: 跨行公式与换行
patterns.context: 公式以多行对齐、续行或独立展示形式排版；激活可落在环境标记、换行及邻近公式 token 上。

patterns.name: 代码中的配置键与资源初始化
patterns.context: Ruby 风格代码中检查平台配置并初始化资源；激活落在配置值和方法调用附近，而非 LaTeX 数学内容。

patterns.name: 不规则数学表达式中的分段定义
patterns.context: 随机变量或函数以条件分段形式定义，随后给出有界性或期望值相关不等式。

patterns.name: 科学术语邻近的公式变量
patterns.context: 热学信号或温度响应的说明文字紧邻用公式表示的时间常数和温度变化。

patterns.name: 波数与谱的幂律表达
patterns.context: 描述小波数区间的谱或功率随波数变化关系。

patterns.name: 场方程及几何算子
patterns.context: 标量场的场方程以微分算子、宇宙学常数和场变量写出。
patterns.domain: 数学物理/引力理论论文

en.description: Most segments activate when a longer or technical noun phrase follows an; other patterns involve matrices and formula markers. The segments span multiple fields, and a few triggers cannot be grouped into a stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: Noun phrase onset after the indefinite article an
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on the indefinite article an, especially when followed by a longer, technical, or compound noun phrase; no particular semantic field is required.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain technical, academic, and news text

patterns.name: Matrix-related words and mathematical typesetting
patterns.context: The word matrix is split across tokens or appears with matrix brackets, trigonometric functions, and formula typesetting; segment 4 also includes biological matrices.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, linear algebra, and biomaterials research

patterns.name: ILM product suite/announcement wording
patterns.context: First states that there is no single ILM product, but rather a suite of components, then introduces an HP announcement from that day.

patterns.name: Pedestrian behavior modeling and simulation
patterns.context: Discusses individual pedestrian behavior models and uses them as a starting point for computer simulation.

patterns.name: Video capsule vision system
patterns.context: Introduces imaging technology in video capsules and the embedded active vision system used in the Cyclope project.
patterns.domain: Medical imaging and embedded systems abstracts

patterns.name: Kalman filter inverse problem
patterns.context: Uses uncertain measurements and a Kalman filter to determine variables or parameters; the title lists material parameters and bone diffusion.
patterns.domain: Inverse problems and parameter estimation papers

patterns.name: Inhalation-based aerosol sampler

patterns.domain: Environmental and public health research plans

patterns.name: Cell adhesion and cell cycle
patterns.context: Extracellular matrix, integrin signaling, and FAK are involved in regulating cell adhesion and the cell cycle; the strongest activations remain on an.

patterns.name: HEPA intervention study design
patterns.context: Evaluates HEPA strategies and their costs, comparing immediate intervention with the standard plan for a waitlist group.
patterns.domain: Public health/healthy eating and physical activity research plans

patterns.name: Matrix materials and tumor-derived matrix
patterns.context: Compares defined collagen, laminin, and fibronectin with complex biological matrices, including lung tissue-derived matrix and tumor-associated matrix.

patterns.name: Network dynamics and information-theoretic methods
patterns.context: Proposes an information-theoretic method to quantify interactions between unit dynamics and network topology in a non-perturbative, unified manner.

9_2831.description: 多数段落在 an 后出现较长或专业名词短语时激活；另有矩阵及公式标记模式。各段分属多种领域，少数触发点不能归并为稳定的语义主题。

patterns.name: 不定冠词 an 后的系统／方法名词起始
patterns.trigger: «an»10 inducible；«an»10 immediate；«an»10 announcement；«an»9 EHS-tumor；«an»9 information；«an»9 ideal；«an»9 embedded；«an»9 inverse；«an»9 inhalable

patterns.name: 矩阵相关词及数学排版

patterns.name: ILM 产品组合／公告表述

patterns.name: 步行者行为建模与仿真

patterns.name: 视频胶囊视觉系统

patterns.name: 卡尔曼滤波逆问题

patterns.name: 吸入式气溶胶采样器

patterns.name: HEPA 干预研究设计

patterns.name: 网络动力学与信息论方法

patterns.domain: 复杂系统／网络科学论文

en.description: All segments mark the indefinite article «an», with strength around 9–10; the following content and domains vary, with no stable topic or semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Activation of the indefinite article an
patterns.context: The trigger is an; following words vary, including EHS-tumor, inhaled, answer, embedded, analysis, example, inducible, elastic, and operad. The syntactic environments before and after an also vary, with no stable semantic category.
patterns.domain: Academic texts across NIH, philosophy, mathematics, patents, and biomedicine

9_2831.description: 所有段都标记了不定冠词 «an»，强度约为 9–10；其后内容和领域各异，未见稳定的主题或语义模式。

patterns.name: 不定冠词 an 的激活
patterns.context: 触发点是 an；其后词语多样，包括 EHS-tumor、inhaled、answer、embedded、analysis、example、inducible、elastic 和 operad。各段在 an 前后的句法环境并不一致，也没有稳定的语义类别。
patterns.domain: 跨 NIH、哲学、数学、专利及生物医学等学术文本

patterns.context: In LaTeX source, command parameters, or code-line boundaries, closing braces, right parentheses, line breaks, and colons are marked; segments 1, 2, and 3 are especially concentrated here.

patterns.name: LaTeX document and package templates
patterns.context: Activation appears near LaTeX commands and their parameters in document preambles or minimal examples generated to show equations or graphics.
patterns.domain: LaTeX documents, typesetting Q&A, and source code accompanying papers

patterns.name: Code block/configuration and line-structure markers
patterns.context: In code or configuration snippets with line-based indentation, activation appears near line starts, list items, and key-value separators; also includes stack traces and SQL lines.
patterns.domain: Technical code, logs, and configuration text

patterns.name: SQL syntax fragments
patterns.context: In SQL queries, activation occurs when keywords are adjacent to subqueries, aliases, and ordering clauses.

patterns.name: TeX mathematical equation typesetting
patterns.context: In mathematical papers or equation examples, equations and surrounding TeX source and document wrappers appear together.

patterns.name: Android log stack-trace format
patterns.context: In Android runtime logs containing timestamps, process/component identifiers, and Java call locations.

patterns.name: CI deployment YAML structure
patterns.context: Near job names, key-value colons, list items, and step fields in indented deployment configuration.

patterns.name: Brackets and punctuation in templates
patterns.context: Punctuation appears as a code syntax boundary or LaTeX parameter-closing symbol; its activation also occurs in non-TeX code such as SQL and logs.

9_2831.description: 激活分散于结构化技术文本：LaTeX/TikZ 与公式、法律引文、程序日志/代码、科学软件名称及天体物理符号；部分实例靠近括号或标点闭合处，但未形成统一的窄触发条件。

patterns.name: LaTeX/TikZ绘图指令
patterns.context: 出现在 TikZ 图形源码中，包含命令、节点选项和边定义；激活落在命令或结构标记附近。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学排版；StackExchange 技术问答

patterns.name: 数学公式与集合记号
patterns.context: 出现在 LaTeX 数学表达式、公式对齐环境中，激活靠近运算符、命令或公式结构。

patterns.name: 引号或括号闭合附近的标记
patterns.context: 多个片段在括号、方括号或花括号闭合处附近激活；但出现环境各异，无法确定单一精确条件。

patterns.name: 法律引文与法规编号
patterns.context: 法律文本中列出表格名称、法条、判例或诉讼结论，激活出现在引文和缩写周边。

patterns.name: 软件日志、堆栈与版本字符串
patterns.context: 程序错误堆栈或日志、带版本号的文件名，以及紧邻代码的数据记录；信号落在字符串、标点或字段附近。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术内容；日志和代码

patterns.name: 蛋白质结构解析软件名称
patterns.context: 科学论文中以程序名标注结构求解、精修步骤，名称多以斜体或标记包围。

patterns.name: 天体物理术语与符号
patterns.context: 描述类星体核、红外辐射、黑洞吸积与爱丁顿率的论文段落。

en.description: Activation occurs in code and legal documents, often inside identifiers, at punctuation or syntax boundaries, in paths and version fragments, and in legal citation abbreviations and numbers; the specific semantics vary across domains, with no common trigger word observed.

patterns.name: Markup character boundaries
patterns.context: Present in both code and legal text; activation often falls on part of a word or punctuation adjacent to a structural boundary rather than on a complete semantic unit.

patterns.name: Code calls and structural delimiters
patterns.context: Appears near parentheses and statement boundaries in function calls, control flow, class definitions, or stack traces; the example contexts vary.

patterns.name: Legal citation numbers and abbreviations
patterns.context: Appears in docket numbers, statute/case citations, and legal document references, often adjacent to digits, periods, or hyphens.

patterns.name: Path, file, and version identifiers
patterns.context: Directories, file names, software components, or configuration keys in technical text; activation often falls on fragments of compound identifiers.

patterns.name: Connection/error handling in database code
patterns.context: PHP code links database connection parameters with failure handling.

patterns.name: Git branch names and commands
patterns.context: Clones a repository, switches to a temporary directory, and runs a code block.

patterns.name: Python version checks and container configuration
patterns.context: A Docker template checks the Python version with startswith and sets the environment.

patterns.name: Java stack traces
patterns.context: Java package names, class names, and method-call stacks in exception logs.

patterns.name: C# Web API declarations
patterns.context: Class and method declarations, parameters, and code-block boundaries.

patterns.name: Legal entities and statutory content
patterns.context: Describes legal remedies, appointments, or statutory amendments, with statute numbers.

patterns.name: Python lines and string-prefix checks
patterns.context: Reads file lines and checks whether they begin with a specific string.

patterns.name: Dates and docket records in legal documents
patterns.context: Records case assignments, transfer dates, and docket numbers.

9_2831.description: 激活落在代码和法律文书中，常见于标识符内部、标点/语法边界、路径与版本片段，以及法律引文缩写和编号；具体语义跨领域，未见统一触发词。

patterns.name: 标记字符边界
patterns.trigger: 激活集中在字符串或标识符内部的单个字符/子词，如 «host»、«name»、«sw»，以及标点 «)»、«{»、«.»
patterns.context: 代码和法律文本中均有；激活常落在词的一部分或紧邻结构边界的标点上，而不是完整语义单位。

patterns.name: 代码调用与结构分隔符
patterns.context: 出现在函数调用、控制流、类定义或堆栈跟踪的括号与语句边界附近；各例语境并不相同。

patterns.name: 法律引用编号与缩写
patterns.context: 出现在案卷编号、法规/判例引文和法律文书引用中，常与数字、句点或连字符相邻。

patterns.name: 路径、文件及版本标识
patterns.context: 技术文本中的目录、文件名、软件组件或配置键；激活常在复合标识符片段中。

patterns.name: 数据库代码中的连接/错误处理
patterns.context: PHP 代码将数据库连接参数与失败处理相连。

patterns.name: Git 分支名与命令
patterns.context: 克隆仓库后切换到临时目录并执行代码块。

patterns.name: Python 版本判断与容器配置
patterns.context: Docker 模板中通过 startswith 判断 Python 版本并设置环境。

patterns.name: Java 堆栈跟踪
patterns.context: 异常日志中的 Java 包名、类名与方法调用栈。

patterns.name: C# Web API 声明
patterns.context: 类与方法声明、参数及代码块边界。

patterns.name: 法律实体与法条内容
patterns.context: 叙述法律救济、任职或法规修订，并附法条编号。

patterns.name: Python 行与字符串前缀判断
patterns.context: 读取文件行并检查是否以特定字符串开头。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的时间与案卷记录
patterns.context: 记载案件分派、转交日期及案卷编号。

en.description: Activation broadly falls on punctuation, parentheses, and sentence or passage endings, and also involves numbers, citation boundaries, and code/log structures; there are also several tokenized intra-word fragments and «sw» instances, with no stable semantic or domain-level commonality.

patterns.name: Punctuation and code delimiters
patterns.context: Punctuation occurs in citations, sentence endings, function calls, code statements, or log fragments; activation positions are not limited to any one language.
patterns.domain: Legal texts, scientific texts, programming Q&A and code, logs, news texts

patterns.name: Sentence or fragment endings
patterns.context: Fragments end at sentence endings, parenthesized expressions, method calls, or statements; especially apparent in segments 4, 5, 6, 8, and 9.
patterns.domain: Legal citations, programming Q&A, stack traces, code

patterns.name: Numbers, version numbers, and numbering formats
patterns.context: Numbers appear within structures such as legal citations, page numbers, versions/logs, parameters, or chart settings, often adjacent to punctuation.
patterns.domain: Legal texts, programming, logs, and technical Q&A

patterns.name: Split intra-word fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls inside English words split by tokenization, especially subwords in code identifiers, ordinary words, or technical terms; some instances are hard to explain through shared meaning.
patterns.domain: Research abstracts, medical texts, programming code, and technical Q&A

patterns.name: Code and machine-generated technical text
patterns.context: In technical formats such as code snippets, method calls, and exception stacks, code keywords, identifier fragments, and structural symbols may all activate.
patterns.domain: StackExchange programming Q&A, Java stack logs

patterns.name: Citations, parentheses, and reference markers
patterns.context: Punctuation marks boundaries in legal provisions and statute citations, parenthetical content, academic references, or quoted text.

patterns.name: Word-initial fragment «sw» at truncation points
patterns.context: Cross-word fragments near corpus segment edges: one appears to be a tokenized intra-word fragment, while another falls at the start of a word in news narration; their commonality is uncertain.

9_2831.description: 激活广泛落在标点、括号与句段收尾，也涉及数字、引文边界及代码／日志结构；另有若干分词切开的词内片段和 «sw» 实例，缺乏稳定语义或领域共性。

patterns.name: 标点与代码边界符
patterns.context: 标点出现在引文、句末、函数调用、代码语句或日志片段中；触发位置并不局限于某一种语言。
patterns.domain: 法律、科研文本、编程问答与代码、日志、新闻文本

patterns.name: 句末或片段收尾
patterns.context: 片段在句子、括号表达式、方法调用或语句结束处收尾；第4、5、6、8、9段尤为明显。
patterns.domain: 法律引文、编程问答、堆栈跟踪、代码

patterns.name: 数字、版本号与编号格式
patterns.context: 数字嵌在法规引用、页码、版本／日志、参数或图表设置等结构中，常与标点相邻。
patterns.domain: 法律、编程、日志与技术问答

patterns.name: 拆分的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被分词切开的英文词内部，尤其是代码标识符、普通词或专业词中的子词；有些实例难以由共同词义解释。
patterns.domain: 科研摘要、医学文本、编程代码与技术问答

patterns.name: 代码及机器生成技术文本
patterns.context: 代码片段、方法调用、异常堆栈等技术性格式中，代码关键词、标识符片段和结构符号均可能激活。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答、Java 堆栈日志

patterns.name: 引文、括号与引用标记
patterns.context: 标点用于法律条文与法规引用、括号内容、论文文献引用或引号内文字的边界。

patterns.name: 截断处的词首片段 «sw»
patterns.context: 出现在语料片段边缘附近的跨词片段：一个疑似词内分词，另一个落在新闻叙述中的词首；共同点不确定。
patterns.domain: NIH 研究摘要、新闻叙述

en.concept: Subwords and code structures in mixed text
en.description: Activations are distributed across code and its punctuation structure, help-seeking questions, and patent/forum text; many markers fall on in-word subword fragments, with inconsistent fragments and meanings, so there is no single reliable semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Specific subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation markers fall on subword fragments inside words rather than stable whole words; trigger words appear in varied contexts including shifting, startswith, rerouted, rewrite, locals, tsk, jar, validate.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: code, patent text, error logs, questions and answers, and forum text

patterns.name: Code and punctuation/structural tokens
patterns.context: Appears in Python/Jinja configuration, Java stacks, OpenCV examples, Python code, and JavaScript code, often near statement boundaries, parentheses, or template syntax; markers do not always occupy the same syntactic role.

patterns.name: Questions and requests for help
patterns.context: Appears in question titles or body text describing camera access, URL rewriting, failure to find an example, or expected behavior; activations are scattered across ordinary question text.

patterns.name: Gear-transmission patent wording
patterns.context: Describes torque being temporarily rerouted through another gear train during shifting, surrounded by technical patent language.

patterns.name: Sonar Java stack trace
patterns.context: Stack lines composed of Java classes, methods, line numbers, and jar files; activation markers appear near parentheses and log structure.

patterns.name: Rapid change in descriptions of social unrest
patterns.context: Discusses how society can shift from peace to terror quickly; activations fall inside ordinary English words.

9_2831.concept: 混合文本中的子词与代码结构
9_2831.description: 激活分布在代码及其标点结构、问答求助语句和专利/论坛文本中；不少标记落在词内子词片段，片段和语义并不一致，尚无单一可靠语义触发器。

patterns.name: 特定子词片段
patterns.context: 激活标记落在词内部的子词片段，而非稳定的完整词；触发词分别出现在 shifting、startswith、rerouted、rewrite、locals、tsk、jar、validate 等不同上下文。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：代码、专利文本、错误日志、问答及论坛文本

patterns.name: 代码与标点/结构 token
patterns.context: 出现在 Python/Jinja 配置、Java 堆栈、OpenCV 示例、Python 代码和 JavaScript 代码中，常处于语句边界、括号或模板语法附近；标记并不总落在相同语法角色。

patterns.name: 问答中的疑问与求助表达
patterns.context: 出现在问题标题或正文，描述访问相机、重写 URL、未能找到示例或预期行为；激活位置分散于普通问句文本。

patterns.name: 齿轮传动专利措辞
patterns.context: 描述换挡时扭矩暂时经另一齿轮系重新路由，周围有技术性专利表述。

patterns.name: Sonar Java 堆栈追踪
patterns.context: Java 类、方法、行号和 jar 文件组成的堆栈行；激活标记出现在括号及日志结构附近。

patterns.name: 社会动荡叙述中的快速变化
patterns.context: 谈论社会由和平转向恐怖可能迅速发生；激活落在普通英语单词内部。

en.concept: Failure and Operational Instructions in Technical Questions
en.description: Activation concentrates on couldn’t (unable to resolve) in technical Q&A, and also occurs on question words and terms such as how, rewrite, sync, host, Kotlin currency, and database join; a startwith prefix check in code and crystallographic software method entries also trigger it.

patterns.name: couldn't expressions of confusion
patterns.context: Indicates an unsuccessful attempt to solve or understand something in a problem description; often occurs with tried, figure out, or how.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A about URL rewriting, synchronization, server configuration, Kotlin, and database queries

patterns.name: Crystallographic software entry template
patterns.context: A list of structure-determination methods or software citations, including software names, references, and purpose fields; strong activation falls on punctuation, fields, and template words.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central, crystallography paper methods or software descriptions

patterns.name: startwith string method
patterns.context: A string-prefix check in code, followed by a version or task-type prefix string.

patterns.name: English question word how
patterns.context: Appears in technical questions asking how to perform an operation; overlaps with the couldn’t pattern but is not the same trigger.

patterns.name: URL rewriting phrase
patterns.context: Asks how to rewrite a URL from one form to another; the term appears in both the title and body.

patterns.name: Data synchronization and Firebase
patterns.context: Asks about bidirectional data synchronization between Google Sheets and Firebase, particularly a tutorial for reverse synchronization.

patterns.name: Hosting multiple sites on a server
patterns.context: Describes a server that can already serve one site, with an unsuccessful attempt to host a second.

patterns.name: Kotlin currency data type
patterns.context: A beginner asks for the best data type for representing currency in Kotlin and says that consulting the documentation did not resolve the issue.

patterns.name: Python interpreter version configuration
patterns.context: A template checks the distribution's Python version prefix and configures the interpreter.

patterns.name: Task-type and extension branches
patterns.context: When the task type is nonempty and the target is empty, code branches on the task-type prefix to handle the extension.

patterns.name: Database foreign keys and join queries
patterns.context: Asks how to query models and their counts through related fields; also contains couldn’t figure out.

9_2831.concept: 技术问题中的失败与操作说明
9_2831.description: 激活集中于技术问答里的 couldn’t（未能解决），另有 how、rewrite、sync、host、Kotlin 货币、数据库 join 等问答词；代码中的 startwith 前缀判断，以及晶体学软件方法条目也会触发。

patterns.name: couldn't 困惑表达
patterns.context: 问题描述中表示尝试后未能解决或弄清楚；常与 tried、figure out、how 连用。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答，涉及 URL 重写、同步、服务器配置、Kotlin、数据库查询

patterns.name: 晶体学软件条目模板
patterns.context: 结构解析方法或软件引用清单中，包含软件名、引文及用途字段；强激活落在标点、字段及模板词上。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central，晶体学论文的方法或软件说明

patterns.name: startwith 字符串方法
patterns.context: 代码中调用字符串前缀判断方法，后接版本或任务类型前缀字符串。
patterns.domain: Github 代码（Python/Docker 模板及脚本）

patterns.name: 英文疑问词 how
patterns.context: 出现在技术问题中，询问如何完成某项操作；与 couldn’t 模式有重叠但并非同一触发词。

patterns.name: URL 重写词组
patterns.context: 询问把 URL 从一种形式改写为另一种形式，标题和正文重复出现该词。

patterns.name: 数据同步与 Firebase
patterns.context: 询问 Google Sheets 与 Firebase 间的数据双向同步，特别是反向同步教程。

patterns.name: 多站点服务器托管
patterns.context: 描述一台服务器已能访问一个站点，尝试再托管第二个站点失败。

patterns.name: Kotlin 货币数据类型
patterns.context: 新手查询 Kotlin 中表示货币的最佳数据类型，并称查阅文档仍未弄清。

patterns.name: Python 解释器版本配置
patterns.context: 模板按发行版 Python 版本前缀判断并配置解释器。

patterns.name: 任务类型与扩展名分支
patterns.context: 代码在任务类型非空、目标为空时，按任务类型前缀分支处理扩展名。

patterns.name: 数据库外键与连接查询
patterns.context: 询问如何通过关联字段查询模型及其数量；同时出现 couldn’t figure out。

en.description: Strong responses are scattered: several segments contain couldn’t in help-seeking descriptions; there are also strong responses to ways (attempted methods or treatments) and two local strings containing sw. Code, proper names, and medical contexts differ. Segment 9 is uninterpretable.

patterns.name: couldn substring in couldn’t
patterns.context: In first-person help-seeking contexts, means being unable to understand, find, or accomplish something; followed by expressions such as to, figure, or find.

patterns.name: ways
patterns.context: Appears in “tried several ways,” describing attempts to solve a problem without success.

patterns.name: Python version condition check
patterns.context: A string-method call in a code template, checking whether the distribution's Python version begins with 3.

patterns.name: swamps
patterns.context: John Swamps is mentioned in a Lisp discussion; this is a personal name or signature.

patterns.name: ways in ways to treat
patterns.context: In a cancer research institute mission statement, refers to finding better ways to treat, control, and cure cancer.

9_2831.description: 强响应分散：多段在求助叙述中出现 couldn’t；另对 ways（尝试办法或治疗方法）及两个含 sw 的局部字符串强响应；代码、专名和医学语境彼此不同。第9段无法解释。

patterns.name: couldn’t 的 couldn 子串
patterns.context: 在第一人称求助语境中，表示没能弄懂、找到或完成某件事；后接 to、figure、find 等表达。

patterns.name: ways
patterns.context: 出现在“tried several ways”中，描述尝试多种办法仍未解决问题。

patterns.name: Python 版本条件判断
patterns.context: 代码模板里的字符串方法调用，用于判断发行版 Python 版本是否以 3 开头。

patterns.name: swamps
patterns.context: Lisp 讨论中提到 John Swamps，属于人名或署名。

patterns.name: ways to treat 的 ways
patterns.context: 癌症研究机构使命陈述中，表示寻找更好的治疗、控制和治愈癌症的方法。

en.concept: Structure and Common Word Fragments in Mixed Text
en.description: Activation is distributed across code calls, property access, and statement endings; it also occurs in legal document formatting, patent information-processing vocabulary, and evaluative or speed expressions in forum text. No clear common trigger is apparent, and code fragments are also diverse.

patterns.name: Calls, member access, and statement boundaries in code
patterns.context: Code statements contain function calls, chained member access, assignments, or call endings; activation often falls near closing parentheses, semicolons, or property names.

patterns.name: Procedural and citation formats in legal documents
patterns.context: Legal opinions or case-background paragraphs contain dates, procedural terms, rule citations, and docket page numbers.

patterns.name: Information processing and technical terms
patterns.context: A patent background section introduces information growth and approaches to processing, storage, or device pairing.

patterns.name: way and semantic expressions in ordinary text
patterns.context: Informal or evaluative text expresses opinions, assessments, or speed; activation is strong near “way” and “slow.”

9_2831.concept: 混合文本中的结构与常见词片段
9_2831.description: 激活分布于代码的调用、属性访问和语句结束处，也出现在法律文书格式、专利信息处理词汇及论坛文本中的评价或速度表达。共同触发特征不明显，代码片段内部亦较多样。

patterns.name: 代码中的调用、成员访问与语句边界
patterns.context: 代码语句中出现函数调用、链式成员访问、赋值或调用结束；激活常落在闭括号、分号或属性名附近。
patterns.domain: Github 与 StackExchange 代码片段

patterns.name: 法律文书中的程序与引证格式
patterns.context: 法律判决或案件背景段落中出现日期、程序术语、规则引证及案卷页码。

patterns.name: 信息处理与技术主题词
patterns.context: 专利背景部分介绍信息增长及处理、存储或设备配对方案。

patterns.name: 普通文本中的 way 与语义性表达
patterns.context: 非正式或评论性文字中表达观点、评价或速度；其中「way」和「slow」附近激活较强。

en.description: The pattern is dominated by legal text: rules, statutes, and case-file citations, as well as appellate procedure terminology; it also covers log call stacks, patent background terminology, scientific parameter definitions, and book publication-page typesetting. Activations often fall on abbreviations, punctuation, numbers, and formatted phrases.

patterns.name: Rule abbreviations in legal citations
patterns.context: Legal texts contain abbreviations and numbers for court or evidence rules; activations often fall on letters, periods, and digits

patterns.name: Statutory numbers and section formatting
patterns.context: Abbreviations, chapter numbers, colons, hyphens, or parenthetical numbers in state-law citations

patterns.name: Citation locator information
patterns.context: A rule-like marker in a decision or case-file citation is followed by a page number, range, or locator

patterns.name: Legal procedure and appellate terminology
patterns.context: Describes appeals, motions, post-trial proceedings, or litigation claims; may not include a rule citation

patterns.name: Software stack-trace format
patterns.context: Filenames, package paths, method calls, and line numbers in exception or error logs

patterns.name: Information-processing terminology in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: Patent background paragraphs introduce devices, information processing, and related technical applications

patterns.name: Parameter descriptions in scientific formulas
patterns.context: Formula variables are defined in text, followed by parameter values and units

patterns.name: Typesetting of book publication locations
patterns.context: Centered uppercase typesetting and decorative asterisks in book front matter or publication information

9_2831.description: 模式以法律文本为主：规则、法规和案卷引证，以及上诉程序用语；另覆盖日志调用栈、专利背景术语、科学参数定义和书籍出版页排版。激活常落在缩写、标点、编号及格式化短语上。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的规则缩写
patterns.context: 法律文本中出现法院规则或证据规则的缩写及编号；激活常落在字母、句点和数字上

patterns.name: 法规编号与条款格式
patterns.context: 州法引用中的缩写、章节号、冒号、连字符或括号编号

patterns.name: 引证定位信息
patterns.context: 判决或案卷引证中，规则式标记后跟页码、范围或定位信息

patterns.name: 法律程序与上诉用语
patterns.trigger: “motion to dismiss his appeal”“dismiss the appeal”“post-sentence motion”“claim”
patterns.context: 描述上诉、动议、审判后程序或诉讼主张；未必伴随规则引文

patterns.name: 软件堆栈跟踪格式
patterns.context: 异常或错误日志中的文件名、包路径、方法调用与行号

patterns.name: 专利背景中的信息处理词汇
patterns.trigger: “information handling system”“wireless pairing”“process and store information”“ways to”
patterns.context: 专利背景段落介绍设备、信息处理及相关技术用途

patterns.name: 科学公式中的参数说明
patterns.trigger: “spectral index”“normalization constant”“maximum energy at the source”
patterns.context: 公式变量以文字定义，随后给出参数取值和单位

patterns.name: 书籍出版地址排版
patterns.trigger: “LONDON: CHAS. J. THYNNE, GREAT QUEEN STREET, KINGSWAY, W.C.”及星号分隔
patterns.context: 书籍前置页或出版信息中的居中大写排版、装饰性星号

en.description: Primarily appears in legal opinions, especially Tennessee appellate rule citations and wording about decisions and appeals; it also responds to other legal citations and case-specific legal statements. Parentheses, punctuation, and structural symbols in two code segments also activate, possibly as a separate pattern.

patterns.name: Tennessee appellate case citations
patterns.context: A Tennessee appellate procedure rule citation appears in the body or conclusion of an opinion; activation falls on components of the citation and nearby words.

patterns.name: Periods and abbreviated citations in legal text
patterns.context: Abbreviated citations to courts, rules, statutes, or prior decisions in legal opinions; multiple jurisdictions are involved, and not all examples follow the Tennessee rule format.

patterns.name: Legal conclusions and appellate decision wording
patterns.context: An opinion describes the outcome, grounds for appeal, or affirmance by the court; may co-occur with citation passages.

patterns.name: Other legal dispute wording
patterns.context: Evidence standards, damages discussions, or witness relationships in specific cases; apart from legal style, there is no clear shared topic.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw, family law, damages, and criminal/evidence opinions

patterns.name: Code and structural symbols
patterns.context: Code snippets contain dense punctuation, parentheses, indexing, properties, or API names; the two code segments are unrelated in content.
patterns.domain: StackExchange, mathematical expressions and programming Q&A

9_2831.concept: 法律引证及结构化文本标记
9_2831.description: 主要出现在法律判决中，尤其是田纳西州上诉规则引证及裁判、上诉措辞；也响应其他法律引证和个案法律表述。另有两段代码中的括号、标点和结构化符号激活，可能是独立模式。

patterns.name: 田纳西州上诉判例引证
patterns.trigger: “Tenn. R. App. P.”，常接“Appeal as of Right”或规则编号
patterns.context: 判决正文或结尾出现田纳西州上诉程序规则引证；激活落在引证各组成部分及邻近词上

patterns.name: 法律文本中的句点与缩写引证
patterns.trigger: “U.S.”、“R. 9”、“Pa. R.A.P.”、“Id. at”等缩写和点号分隔的引证
patterns.context: 法律判决中法院、规则、法规或先前判决的缩写引证；涉及多种司法辖区，并非都属于田纳西州规则格式

patterns.name: 法律结论与上诉裁判用语
patterns.context: 判决叙述裁判结果、上诉理由或法院维持原判；也与引证段落并存

patterns.name: 其他法律争议措辞
patterns.trigger: “abandonment by clear and convincing evidence”、“compensation by the Federal Government”、“best friends”
patterns.context: 特定案件中的证据标准、赔偿论述或证人关系；除法律文体外没有明确共同主题
patterns.domain: FreeLaw，家庭法、赔偿及刑事/证据类判决

patterns.name: 代码与结构化符号
patterns.context: 代码片段中密集出现标点、括号、索引、属性或 API 名称；两段代码内容互不相同
patterns.domain: StackExchange，数学表达式与编程问答

en.description: Activation is distributed across legal citations, publication title pages, chair discussions, housing research, software code documentation, and digital health terminology; there is no clear shared lexical meaning or syntactic pattern spanning all segments.

patterns.name: Medical and health-related terminology
patterns.context: Lists telehealth, digital health, and related concepts, and discusses healthcare services in definitional or descriptive sentences.
patterns.domain: Medical and digital health academic texts

patterns.name: Legal citations and opinions
patterns.context: U.S. military references, opinion page numbers, citations, and federal-government-related wording appear in legal case facts or case citations.

patterns.name: Publication title pages and typographic symbols
patterns.context: A book title page or publication details presented with asterisks, all-caps place names, personal names, and address-like formatting.

patterns.name: Chairs, posture, and comfort discussions
patterns.context: Compares chair comfort and quality, mentioning posture, or a chair being tilted or wobbling.

patterns.name: Software tools, code, and technical descriptions
patterns.context: Describes software functionality or discusses parameters, interpreters, exceptions, functions, and data access in code, templates, or comments.

patterns.name: Housing and homelessness research terms
patterns.context: Discusses housing values, living conditions, and research data and samples concerning people experiencing homelessness.

9_2831.description: 激活分布于法律引证、出版题名页、椅子讨论、住房研究、软件代码文档及数字健康术语等不同语境；没有贯穿全部片段的明显共同词义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 医学健康相关术语
patterns.context: 并列列举远程医疗、数字健康等概念，并以定义或描述性语句讨论医疗服务。
patterns.domain: 医学、数字健康学术文本

patterns.name: 法律引文与判决文本
patterns.context: 法律案件事实或判例引文中出现美国军队、判决页码、引证与联邦政府相关表述。

patterns.name: 出版物题名页与排版符号
patterns.context: 书籍题名页或出版信息，以星号、全大写地名、人名及地址式排版呈现。
patterns.domain: 旧式书籍／古腾堡电子文本

patterns.name: 椅子、坐姿与舒适度讨论
patterns.context: 比较椅子的舒适程度和质量，提到坐姿、椅子歪斜或摇晃。

patterns.name: 软件工具、代码与技术说明
patterns.context: 介绍软件功能或在代码、模板、注释中描述参数、解释器、异常、函数与数据访问。

patterns.name: 住房与无家可归研究术语
patterns.context: 讨论住房价值、居住情况及无家可归群体的研究数据与样本。
patterns.domain: 社会科学／住房研究摘要

en.description: Activation is distributed across English intra-word fragments, code identifiers and syntax symbols, LaTeX mathematical structures, and local strings such as numbers and legal citations; it spans domains, with no single stable semantic trigger condition observed.

patterns.name: English word-final and contiguous letter fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on ordinary English words or contiguous substrings within them; fragments often reflect local intra-word spelling rather than complete semantic units.
patterns.domain: Legal, academic, and general technical texts

patterns.name: Code identifiers and API calls
patterns.context: Appears in JavaScript or Java code, especially near camel-case identifiers, method names, property names, and call chains.

patterns.name: Parentheses, braces, and closing structures in code
patterns.context: Activation occurs near code syntax structures, including function calls, callbacks, and object/class structures.

patterns.name: Mathematical and LaTeX symbol structures
patterns.context: Activation falls around mathematical typesetting, variables, and formula delimiters rather than in continuous natural-language sentences.

patterns.name: Numbers and adjacent punctuation
patterns.context: Activation occurs near numbers, identifiers, or formula values; the semantic contexts differ across segments.

patterns.name: Directional/left-right-related text
patterns.context: Appears in coordinate-axis direction labels or direction-arrow commands in formulas; examples are sporadic.

patterns.name: Common English function words and word-form fragments
patterns.context: Appears as short words or intra-word substrings in natural-language sentences, with no stable specific semantic condition.

patterns.name: Legal citation formats
patterns.context: Appears near case citations, quotations, or legal-document abbreviations; activation is sparse and not concentrated on a single word.

9_2831.concept: 局部字符串／符号模式检测
9_2831.description: 激活分布于英文词内片段、代码标识符与语法符号、LaTeX数学结构，以及数字和法律引文等局部字符串；跨领域，未见单一稳定语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 英文词尾与连续字母片段
patterns.context: 激活落在普通英文单词或其内部的连续子串上；片段常呈现词内局部拼写，而不是完整语义单位。
patterns.domain: 法律、论文及一般技术文本

patterns.name: 代码标识符与 API 调用
patterns.context: 出现在 JavaScript 或 Java 代码中，尤其是驼峰标识符、方法名、属性名及调用链附近。

patterns.name: 代码中的括号、花括号与闭合结构
patterns.context: 代码语法结构附近有激活，包含函数调用、回调和对象／类结构。

patterns.name: 数学与 LaTeX 符号结构
patterns.context: 激活落在数学排版、变量及公式分隔符周围，而非连续自然语言句子。
patterns.domain: 天体物理／宇宙学论文中的 LaTeX

patterns.name: 数字及其邻接标点
patterns.context: 数字、编号或公式数值附近出现激活；各段语义环境不同。

patterns.name: 方向／左右相关文本
patterns.context: 出现在坐标轴方向标签或公式中的方向箭头命令中；仅有零散例子。
patterns.domain: 图表代码及 LaTeX 公式

patterns.name: 英语常见功能词和词形片段
patterns.context: 在自然语言语句中作为短词或词内子串出现，未显示稳定的特定语义条件。

patterns.name: 法律引文格式
patterns.context: 出现在判例引文、引述或法律文书缩写附近；激活稀疏且不集中于单一词。

en.description: Activations are scattered across legal citations, housing-research terminology, physics terminology, and several types of programming code; code segments include method chains, properties, APIs, and declarations. No clear semantic or morphological trigger spans all the text.

patterns.name: R in legal decision citations
patterns.context: Appears in case-file citations or procedural rule numbers in decisions, often in forms such as R., numbers, and at page references.

patterns.name: SVG/D3 chart method chain
patterns.context: D3/SVG selection, data binding, and axis or tick configuration in JavaScript chart code; segment 4 also contains multiple method calls and properties.

patterns.name: Web-automation call chain
patterns.context: Code locates elements using CSS and invokes browser automation actions.

patterns.name: Java array and adapter declarations
patterns.context: Declaring a string array and creating or overriding an adapter in Java code.

patterns.name: Canvas drawing operations
patterns.context: Canvas drawing code sets line width and color, then draws an image or strokes a path.

patterns.name: Spectral parameters and maximum energy
patterns.context: Equations or paper text define a spectral index, normalization constant, and maximum energy at the source.

patterns.name: Higgs mass condition
patterns.context: A particle-physics paper states the light Higgs mass condition required for an equation to hold.

patterns.name: NIH housing-research terminology
patterns.context: Describes longitudinal data and sample characteristics in research on homelessness, housing values, and occupancy.

9_2831.concept: 异质技术与结构化文本片段
9_2831.description: 激活分散于法律引证、住房研究术语、物理术语及多类编程代码；代码段含方法链、属性、API和声明。没有贯穿全部文本的明确语义或词形触发器。

patterns.name: 法律判决引用中的 R
patterns.context: 出现在判决书的案卷引证或程序规则编号中，常见 R.、数字与 at 页码等形式。

patterns.name: SVG/D3 图表方法链
patterns.context: JavaScript 图表代码中，D3/SVG 选择、绑定数据并设置坐标轴或刻度；段4还出现多个方法调用和属性。

patterns.name: 网页自动化调用链
patterns.context: 代码通过 CSS 定位元素并调用浏览器自动化动作。

patterns.name: Java 数组与适配器声明
patterns.context: Java 代码中声明字符串数组并创建或覆写适配器。

patterns.name: Canvas 绘图操作
patterns.context: Canvas 绘图代码中设置线宽、颜色并绘制图像或描边。

patterns.name: 能谱参数与最高能量
patterns.context: 公式或论文正文定义谱指数、归一化常数及源处最大能量。

patterns.name: 希格斯质量条件
patterns.context: 粒子物理论文中陈述方程成立所需的轻希格斯质量条件。

patterns.name: NIH 住房研究术语
patterns.context: 研究无家可归者、住房价值与入住情况时描述纵向数据和样本特征。

en.description: Activation is scattered across legal citations, code camel-case identifiers, scientific formula symbols, and array numbers; commonality is weak. It often falls on abbreviations, identifiers, or number fragments in structured text, which is insufficient to establish a single semantic function.

patterns.name: Legislative or judicial citation markers
patterns.context: Near volume numbers, court reporter abbreviations, page numbers, and case names in legal documents or tax case citations; the passage also contains the all-caps heading “BACKGROUND”.

patterns.name: Code identifier and property-name fragments
patterns.context: Camel-case APIs, properties, or method names in code, especially positions where identifiers are split into subwords; code formatting, parentheses, and assignment contexts are evident.
patterns.domain: JavaScript/D3/SVG code in StackExchange technical Q&A

patterns.name: Mathematical or physical symbols/parameters
patterns.context: Variables, units, subscripts, and parameter names in formulas, LaTeX, or scientific notation appear alongside numbers, exponents, and equations.

patterns.name: Arrays and number markers
patterns.context: Numbers appear as array elements, indices, or values; activation falls on number tokens surrounded by square brackets, commas, and row/column arrangements.

9_2831.description: 激活分散在法律引文、代码驼峰式标识符、科学公式符号及数组数字中；共同点较弱，常落在结构化文本里的缩写、标识符或数字片段，不能据此确定单一语义功能。

patterns.name: 立法或司法引文标记
patterns.context: 法律文书或税务判例引用中，卷号、法院报告缩写、页码及案件名称周围；段中还出现全大写标题“BACKGROUND”。
patterns.domain: 美国法律意见/判例引文

patterns.name: 代码标识符与属性名片段
patterns.context: 代码里的驼峰式 API、属性或方法名，尤其标识符内部按子词切分的位置；代码格式、括号与赋值语境明显。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答中的 JavaScript/D3/SVG 代码

patterns.name: 数学或物理符号/参数
patterns.context: 公式、LaTeX 或科学记号中，变量、单位、下标和参数名与数字、指数、等式相邻。
patterns.domain: 物理/天体物理/高能物理论文

patterns.name: 数组及数字标记
patterns.context: 数字作为数组元素、索引或数值出现；激活落在数字 token 上，周围有方括号、逗号和行列排列。

en.description: Activations cover legal documents and citations, research data and scientific explanations, code identifiers and method calls, medical procedures, and colloquial complaints and self-reflection; each group has a clear domain context, but trigger words and styles differ markedly.

patterns.name: Procedural and judicial terminology in legal documents
patterns.context: Appears in legal text such as case facts, grounds for appeal, procedural rules, or case citations; includes headings, legal terminology, and citation formats.
patterns.domain: Legal decisions, appellate briefs, and case citations

patterns.name: Descriptions of data, methods, and research subjects
patterns.context: Describes research design, data needs, samples, or findings, with activations distributed across methodological and data-related expressions.

patterns.name: Change, interpretation, and conclusions in scientific papers
patterns.context: Paper-style language explains observations, compares datasets, and describes the beginning or end of a scientific process.

patterns.name: Declarations, calls, and identifiers in code
patterns.context: Embedded in Java or JavaScript code, involving object/variable declarations, method calls, class names, and identifiers; activations are not limited to one syntactic position.
patterns.domain: Code snippets in StackExchange programming questions and answers

patterns.name: Medical procedures and instrument use
patterns.context: Describes treatment or surgical procedures under anesthesia, emphasizing completion of the procedure, tissue fixation, and rapid implementation.
patterns.domain: Medical-device and surgical-procedure background in patents

patterns.name: Colloquial vulgar complaints and personal reflection
patterns.context: Informal first-person expression that first complains about tedious work, then reflects on wishing to have understood a concept earlier.

9_2831.concept: 领域语境中的结构化表达
9_2831.description: 激活覆盖法律文书与引注、研究数据和科学解释、代码标识符与方法调用、医疗操作流程，以及口语抱怨和自我反思；各组均有明确领域语境，但触发词和文体差异明显。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的程序与裁判术语
patterns.trigger: «BACKGROUND»；«judgments»、«Proced»ural« Background»；«weight» of the evidence；«claim»；«trial court»；«sentence» motion；«R»«.»…«P»；«Commissioner»
patterns.context: 出现在法院案件事实、上诉理由、程序规则或判例引注等法律文本中；包括小标题、法律术语及引注格式。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、上诉文书与判例引注

patterns.name: 数据、方法与研究对象表述
patterns.context: 描述研究设计、数据需求、样本或研究结果，激活分布在方法论与数据相关表达中。
patterns.domain: 社会科学研究摘要或报告

patterns.name: 科学论文中的变化、解释与结论
patterns.context: 以论文式语言解释观测结果、比较数据集并叙述科学过程的起始或结束。

patterns.name: 代码中的声明、调用与标识符
patterns.context: 嵌在 Java 或 JavaScript 代码中，涉及对象／变量声明、方法调用、类名与标识符；激活点并不局限于单一语法位置。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答中的代码片段

patterns.name: 医学手术流程与器械操作
patterns.context: 描述麻醉状态下的治疗或手术操作，强调完成操作、组织固定及快速实施。
patterns.domain: 专利背景中的医疗器械与手术流程

patterns.name: 口语化粗俗抱怨与个人反思
patterns.context: 非正式第一人称表达，先抱怨乏味工作，再反思自己较早理解某个概念的愿望。

en.concept: George at the beginning of a person-name heading
en.description: The most stable pattern is “George” at the beginning of Wikipedia biographical headings; activation also occurs on “academic” in two medical passages and on unrelated words such as Clemens, expert, and tasks, with no clear shared semantic pattern.

patterns.name: George in person names/headings
patterns.context: George occurs at the beginning of a passage or entry heading, often immediately followed by a surname; several entries are separated by line breaks, and some include a parenthetical occupation.

patterns.name: Academic-related words
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of institutions or audiences, modifying “institutions” or “medical center”.

patterns.name: Specific fragments in proper names or domain terms
patterns.context: Each occurs in a different context: a historical account of a church council, SEO promotional copy, or patent-style technical description.

patterns.name: Heading and entry-boundary markers
patterns.context: Appears near biographical entry headings, but strong activation is mainly on “George”, not on the line break itself.

9_2929.concept: George 人名标题开头
9_2929.description: 最稳定模式是 Wikipedia 人物标题开头的 “George”；另在两段医学文本的 “academic” 及 Clemens、expert、tasks 等互不相同的词上激活，暂无法归为同一语义模式。

patterns.name: George 人名/标题
patterns.context: George 位于片段开头或条目标题处，常紧接姓氏；若干条目以换行分隔，部分带职业括注。

patterns.name: Academic 相关词
patterns.context: 出现在机构或受众的描述中，修饰 “institutions” 或 “medical center”。

patterns.name: 专名或领域词中的特定片段
patterns.context: 各自出现在教会会议历史叙述、SEO 宣传文案、专利式技术描述中；上下文彼此不同。
patterns.domain: 历史、商业宣传、专利文本

patterns.name: 标题与条目边界标记
patterns.context: 人物条目标题附近出现，但强激活主要落在 “George”，并非换行本身。

en.concept: Lexical triggers for specific subword fragments
en.description: Strong activations fall on several specific subword fragments: the beginning of the name George, the name fragment Clemens, and expert, tasks, and academic. These words occur respectively in biographical entries, historical names, marketing, patents, and academic medical contexts.

patterns.name: George at the start of a name
patterns.context: George appears at the beginning of an entry or title, usually followed by a surname; it may also be followed by a job description or a repeated entry after a line break.

patterns.name: Clemens within proper names
patterns.context: In German historical names or place names, the name is segmented into subword fragments; activation concentrates on the Clem- fragment.

patterns.name: expert
patterns.context: Describes a service team in SEO promotional copy; nearby words include company, offers, and SEO service.

patterns.name: tasks
patterns.context: Appears in the phrase perform certain tasks when describing the configuration of computing devices through graphical interface elements.

patterns.name: academic
patterns.context: Appears in academic institutions or academic medical center, referring to academic institutions or medical centers.
patterns.domain: Academic publishing ethics statements; medical research abstracts

9_2929.concept: 特定词片段的词汇触发
9_2929.description: 强激活落在若干特定词片段上：George 人名开头、Clemens 姓名片段，以及 expert、tasks、academic；这些词分别出现在人物条目、历史人名、营销、专利和学术医学语境中。

patterns.name: 人名中的 George
patterns.context: George 位于条目或标题开头，通常后接姓氏；也可能接职务说明或换行后的重复条目。

patterns.name: 专名内部的 Clemens
patterns.context: 德语历史人名或地名中，名称被分词片段切分；激活集中在 Clem- 片段。

patterns.name: expert
patterns.context: SEO 服务宣传文案中，形容服务团队；周围有 company、offers、SEO service 等词。

patterns.name: tasks
patterns.context: 描述图形界面元素配置计算设备时，出现在 perform certain tasks 的搭配中。

patterns.name: academic
patterns.context: 出现在 academic institutions 或 academic medical center 中，指学术机构或医疗中心。
patterns.domain: 学术出版伦理说明、医学研究摘要

en.concept: George at the start of a biographical entry
en.description: The strongest pattern is the name George and its name fragments at the beginning of Wikipedia entries; other sporadic activations occur respectively on expert in SEO copy, the historical proper name Ems, resulting in research contexts, and weekend and attend in emails. No shared local trigger form is apparent.

patterns.name: The name George
patterns.context: A personal name beginning with George at the start of an entry or title; some examples are followed by a parenthetical description of the person's role, a line break, or a repeated name.

patterns.name: Adjective expert
patterns.context: Appears in SEO service advertising copy, describing team members.

patterns.name: Proper name Ems
patterns.context: The name of a historical event, followed by a description of the meeting and its participants.

patterns.name: resulting
patterns.context: In a research plan, modifies DNA complexes in a description of experimental subjects to be studied.

patterns.name: weekend
patterns.context: In an email, refers to scheduling when discussing an event being held on another weekend.

patterns.name: attend
patterns.context: In promotional email copy, describes a winner traveling to Florida to attend an event.

9_2929.concept: George 人名条目开头
9_2929.description: 最强模式是维基百科条目开头的 George 人名及姓名片段；其余零散激活分别落在 SEO 文案的 expert、历史专名 Ems、科研语境的 resulting，以及邮件中的 weekend、attend，未见共同局部触发形式。

patterns.name: 人物名 George
patterns.trigger: «George»；其后跟姓名组成部分，如 « Se»ay、« B»«aird»、« H.»« W»inner Jr.、« Oliver»、« Dust»«an»
patterns.context: 条目或标题开头，以 George 开始的人名；部分例子后接人物身份括注、换行或重复姓名。
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科人物条目

patterns.name: 形容词 expert
patterns.context: 出现在介绍 SEO 服务的广告文案中，修饰团队成员。

patterns.name: 专名 Ems
patterns.context: 历史事件名称，后接关于会议及与会者的说明。

patterns.name: resulting
patterns.context: 科研计划说明中，修饰 DNA complexes，处于将被研究的实验对象描述里。

patterns.name: weekend
patterns.context: 邮件中讨论活动若安排在另一个周末时，表示时间安排。

patterns.name: attend
patterns.context: 邮件广告中描述中奖者前往佛罗里达参加活动。

en.concept: George at the beginning of a person’s name
en.description: The strongest activation is concentrated on the English name “George” at the start of entries; weaker activations are scattered across patent quantity phrases, mathematical multiplication signs, medical comparisons, auditory encoding, and date formats, with no shared local trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Person names beginning with George
patterns.context: The first word of an English Wikipedia entry or section; followed by a surname, middle name, and occasionally a title or occupation.

patterns.name: Quantity expressions in technical phrases
patterns.context: In patent background text, describes the minimum amount of information required by a device; nearby qualifiers include “minimum” and “required”.

patterns.name: Multiplication sign in a mathematical formula
patterns.context: Numbers multiplied by variables in an algebraic expression, within a formula or mathematical expression after a line break.

patterns.name: “direct” in a comparison structure
patterns.context: Contrasts parent training with direct clinic treatment in a sentence comparing two interventions.
patterns.domain: Medical research abstract or grant text

patterns.name: “encoded” in descriptions of sound encoding
patterns.context: Describes how the cochlea encodes sound, followed by an agent or mechanism.

patterns.name: Month names in dates
patterns.context: In a date heading format, a month, day, and year follow the weekday.

9_2929.concept: George 人名开头
9_2929.description: 最强激活集中于条目开头的英文人名“George”；其余较弱激活分散在专利数量短语、数学乘号、医学比较、听觉编码和日期格式中，未见共同局部触发模式。

patterns.name: George 开头的人名
patterns.context: 作为英文维基百科条目或小节开头的人名首词；其后接姓氏、姓名中间部分，偶尔接头衔或职业说明。

patterns.name: 技术短语中的数量表达
patterns.context: 专利背景文本中，描述设备需要的最少信息量；附近有“minimum”“required”等限定词。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的乘号
patterns.context: 代数式中数字与变量相乘，处于公式及换行后的数学表达中。

patterns.name: 比较结构中的 direct
patterns.context: 与 parent training 对照 direct clinic treatment，出现在比较两种干预方式的句子中。
patterns.domain: 医学研究摘要或资助文本

patterns.name: 声音编码表述中的 encoded
patterns.context: 描述耳蜗如何编码声音，后接施事或机制说明。

patterns.name: 日期中的月份名
patterns.context: 日期标题格式中，星期后接月份、日期和年份。

en.description: Primarily responds to the name George at the beginning of entries; it also responds to the suffix -ased within Released and Increased, the latter occurring in a biomedical research results description.

patterns.name: Name George
patterns.context: George appears at the beginning of an entry or passage, often as the title of a biographical entry; activation also appears again on George within the same passage.

patterns.name: Word ending -ased
patterns.context: The word-internal suffix -ased is marked separately, forming Released.

patterns.name: Word ending -ased
patterns.context: The word-internal suffix -ased is marked separately, forming Increased; it is followed by research results or biomedical subjects.

9_2929.concept: 特定词形片段
9_2929.description: 主要响应条目开头的人名 George；另响应词内后缀 -ased，出现在 Released 和 Increased 中，后者见于生物医学研究结果描述。

patterns.name: 名字 George
patterns.trigger: «George»；有时后接 « B»«aird»、« H»、« Oliver»，或未标记姓氏
patterns.context: George 位于条目或片段开头，常为人物条目标题；激活也会在同一片段再次出现在 George

patterns.name: 词尾 -ased
patterns.context: 词内后缀 -ased 被单独标记，构成 Released

patterns.name: 词尾 -ased
patterns.context: 词内后缀 -ased 被单独标记，构成 Increased；后接研究结果或生物医学对象

en.description: Strong activation primarily occurs on the name fragment George at the beginning of entries; Category in code or encyclopedia categories, French place-name entry formatting, and a mathematical expression also appear, showing several distinct local patterns.

patterns.name: George at the beginning of a person’s name
patterns.context: Entry fragments begin with George, followed by a surname or middle-name initial; sometimes the name is repeated or an occupation is added parenthetically.

patterns.name: Category XML marker
patterns.context: A category name used as tag content or a processing target in XML/template code.

patterns.name: Wikipedia category term
patterns.context: A category marker at the end of an encyclopedia entry, followed by the category name.

patterns.name: French place names and entry formatting
patterns.context: A French place-name entry begins with the name, followed by administrative details and fields such as population.

patterns.name: Mathematical formula operator
patterns.context: An equation or function expression followed by an instruction to solve.

9_2929.concept: 局部词形与标记模式
9_2929.description: 主要对条目开头的 George 人名片段强烈激活；另见代码或百科分类中的 Category、法语地名条目格式，以及一段数学表达式，呈现数种彼此差异的局部模式。

patterns.name: George 人名开头
patterns.context: 条目片段以 George 开头，后接姓氏或中间名缩写；有时重复一次，或附职业括注

patterns.name: Category XML 标记
patterns.context: XML/模板代码中作为标签内容或处理对象的类别名称

patterns.name: Wikipedia 分类词
patterns.context: 百科条目末尾的分类标记，后接分类名称

patterns.name: 法语地名及条目格式
patterns.context: 法语地名条目开头，后接行政区说明和人口等栏目

patterns.name: 数学公式运算符
patterns.context: 方程/函数表达式后接求解指令

en.description: Activation occurs in NIH aims sections, neuropharmacological terminology, paper table markers, and various proper names in papers and encyclopedias; no stable semantic or word-form pattern spans all the passages.

patterns.name: Grant-project aims section marker
patterns.context: In NIH project abstracts or research aims text, OBJECTIVE: is followed by a sentence stating the research objective.

patterns.name: “neuromodulators” in neuropharmacology terminology
patterns.context: When listing noradrenergic or serotonergic modulators, the word neuromodulators is marked across subword fragments.

patterns.name: Table references and captions
patterns.context: Near text correcting or citing a table in the paper, or near table markers.

patterns.name: Nelson Stepanyan in a person’s name
patterns.context: A person’s name appears in heading- or entry-like form, with the name marked across subword fragments.

patterns.name: Song-title phrase
patterns.context: A song title appears in a heading and body text; “Me” in the title phrase is marked.

patterns.name: Fracture-risk heading terminology
patterns.context: Terms for non-ossifying fibroma and fracture risk are marked in a medical paper title.

patterns.name: Chemical names of silicon hydrides
patterns.context: A chemical substance name or category entry, with several names containing silicon/sil- roots listed consecutively.

patterns.name: Crystallographic captions and data labels
patterns.context: A crystal-structure caption describes ellipsoid probability levels and omitted hydrogen atoms, adjacent to a crystal data table label.

9_2929.concept: none
9_2929.description: 激活分布于 NIH 目标段、神经药理术语、论文表格标记及多种论文/百科专名中；未见贯穿所有片段的稳定语义或词形模式。

patterns.name: 基金项目目标段落标记
patterns.context: NIH 项目摘要或研究目标文本中，OBJECTIVE: 后接研究目的句

patterns.name: 神经药理学术语中的 neuromodulators
patterns.context: 列举去甲肾上腺素能或血清素能调节物时，词语 neuromodulators 被拆分标记

patterns.name: 表格引用及表格标题
patterns.context: 论文正文更正表格、引用表格，或表格标记附近
patterns.domain: 学术论文的表格相关文本

patterns.name: 人名中的 Nelson Stepanyan
patterns.context: 人名以标题式或词条式形式出现，名字被分词片段标记

patterns.name: 歌曲标题短语
patterns.context: 歌曲名在标题和正文中出现；标题词组中的“Me”被标记

patterns.name: 骨折风险标题术语
patterns.context: 医学论文标题中，非骨化性纤维瘤与骨折风险的术语被标记

patterns.name: 硅氢化物化学名称
patterns.context: 化学物质名称或类别条目，多个含 silicon/sil- 词根的名称连续列举

patterns.name: 晶体学图注与数据标签
patterns.context: 晶体结构图注描述椭球概率水平、氢原子省略，并邻接晶体数据表标签

en.description: The most prominent recurring cue is the English proper name Richard, found across several text types; some numbers, dates, abbreviations, and technical word fragments also activate, but their trigger positions and contexts are inconsistent.

patterns.name: Fragments related to the name Richard
patterns.context: The proper name Richard appears in English text; activation falls on the name, while the surname or remaining parts of the full name are usually not equally activated.
patterns.domain: Various English texts, including papers, encyclopedias, legal documents, and forums

patterns.name: Numeric or date expressions
patterns.context: Strong activation occurs in local expressions of numbers, years, dates, measurements, or quantities, but trigger positions vary.

patterns.name: Other proper names and terminology fragments
patterns.context: A few passages activate on local subwords within names, abbreviations, or technical terms; no consistent contextual condition is apparent.

9_2929.concept: Richard 字符串及局部片段
9_2929.description: 最显著的重复线索是英文专名 Richard，分布于多类文本；此外，若干数字、日期、缩写及专业词片段也激活，触发位置和语境不一致。

patterns.name: Richard 名字相关片段
patterns.context: 英文文本中出现专名 Richard；激活落在该名字上，名字后的姓氏或姓名其余部分通常未同等激活。
patterns.domain: 论文、百科、法律文书、论坛等多种英文文本

patterns.name: 数字或日期表达
patterns.context: 数字、年份、日期、测量值或数量的局部表达中出现较强激活，但触发位置不一致。
patterns.domain: 科研摘要、百科、法律文书

patterns.name: 其他专名与术语片段
patterns.context: 少数段落在姓名、缩写或专业词中的局部子词上激活；未见统一的上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、百科、法律文书

en.description: Most activations center on descriptions of doping in materials or systems, especially doped materials and their electronic, spin, optical, superconducting, molecular-device, or catalytic properties; accelerator experiments and bacterial adhesion also occur and are difficult to explain through this theme.

patterns.name: Material doping and doped states
patterns.context: Descriptions of doping in materials, systems, or compounds; often adjacent to elements, carrier types, bands, or physical properties.
patterns.domain: Condensed matter physics, materials science, chemistry, and related abstracts

patterns.name: Superconductivity and electronic states
patterns.context: Discusses carrier doping, density of states, Fermi level, or structural stability in superconducting materials.

patterns.name: Optical and band properties of doped materials
patterns.context: In-gap sub-bands and ultraviolet or visible luminescence in doped oxides.

patterns.name: Spintronics and transport timescales
patterns.context: Discusses electron scattering, spin polarization, and spintronic applications in doped multilayer systems.

patterns.name: Alkali-metal doping of fullerenes
patterns.context: Fullerenes doped with alkali metals, associated with electron transfer and excitation spectra.
patterns.domain: Molecular materials, spectroscopy, and electron-transfer research

patterns.name: Organic semiconductors and molecularly doped devices
patterns.context: Doping in molecular nanowires or polymers, along with field effects and hole transport.

patterns.name: Doped supports as catalyst supports
patterns.context: Gadolinium-doped titanium dioxide nanocrystals used as supports for gold nanoparticles; catalytic activity and diffusion limitations are discussed.

patterns.name: Description of a non-doping high-energy physics experiment
patterns.context: Neutrino beams, accelerator beamlines, and hadron production; no clear doping theme.

patterns.name: Bacterial binding to extracellular matrix
patterns.context: Compares bacterial strain binding to extracellular matrix proteins and its variation; no clear materials-doping theme.

9_2929.concept: 科学文本中的掺杂
9_2929.description: 多数激活集中在材料或体系的掺杂表述，尤其掺杂材料及其电子、自旋、光学、超导、分子器件或催化性质；另有加速器实验和细菌黏附语境，难以由该主题解释。

patterns.name: 材料掺杂与掺杂态
patterns.context: 材料、系统或化合物的掺杂描述；常与元素、载流子类型、能带或物性相邻。
patterns.domain: 凝聚态物理、材料科学、化学及相关摘要

patterns.name: 超导与电子态
patterns.context: 讨论超导材料的载流子掺杂、态密度、费米能级或结构稳定性。

patterns.name: 掺杂材料的光学与能带性质
patterns.context: 掺杂氧化物的能隙内亚带及紫外、可见发光。
patterns.domain: 材料光学、光致发光研究

patterns.name: 自旋电子学与输运时间尺度
patterns.context: 以掺杂多层体系为对象，讨论电子散射、自旋极化和自旋电子学应用。
patterns.domain: 自旋电子学、纳米器件物理

patterns.name: 富勒烯的碱金属掺杂
patterns.context: 富勒烯受碱金属掺杂，关联电子转移与激发光谱。
patterns.domain: 分子材料、光谱与电子转移研究

patterns.name: 有机半导体与分子掺杂器件
patterns.context: 分子纳米线或聚合物中的掺杂及场效应、空穴输运。

patterns.name: 掺杂载体作为催化剂载体
patterns.context: 钆掺杂二氧化钛纳米晶作为金纳米颗粒载体，讨论催化活性与扩散限制。

patterns.name: 非掺杂的高能物理实验描述
patterns.context: 中微子束、加速器束线及强子产生；没有明显掺杂主题。

patterns.name: 细菌与细胞外基质结合
patterns.context: 比较菌株与细胞外基质蛋白的结合及其变异；没有明显材料掺杂主题。
patterns.domain: 微生物学、生物医学摘要

en.concept: Probability and sequence questions in math problems
en.description: Primarily responds to probability problems involving drawing letters without replacement: sampling descriptions, letter-frequency tables, probability questions, and specified-letter or sequence events; weaker activation also occurs on the wording of sequence problems asking for the next term or the kth term.

patterns.name: Probability problems drawing letters without replacement
patterns.context: Describes drawing several letters from a set of letters or a letter-count table, followed by a probability question; sometimes continues across passages, with the preceding passage giving an answer or ending the problem.

patterns.name: Probability questions and target events
patterns.context: Asks for the probability of drawing a specified letter, letter combination, or sequence, often using a template for sampling without replacement.

patterns.name: Letter-frequency table notation
patterns.context: Uses curly braces to list letters and their counts as the sampling population; counts and letter combinations vary.
patterns.domain: Data representation in DM Mathematics probability problems

patterns.name: Specified letter strings or sequences
patterns.context: The probability event concerns a particular letter, consecutive string of letters, or ordered sequence; not every problem uses a frequency table.

patterns.name: Finding the next term in a sequence
patterns.context: Presents an integer sequence and asks for the next term, with negative numbers and likely sequence data nearby.

patterns.name: Finding the kth term of a polynomial
patterns.context: Provides several values and asks for the kth term of an expression or sequence; algebraic expressions appear in the context.

9_2929.concept: 数学题中的概率与数列提问
9_2929.description: 主要响应不放回抽取字母的概率题：抽样描述、字母频数表、概率提问及指定字母或序列事件；另对数列求下一项和求第k项的题目措辞有较弱激活。

patterns.name: 不放回抽字母的概率题
patterns.context: 描述从字母集合或字母计数表中抽取若干字母，后续询问概率；有时跨段延续，前段给答案或题目结尾

patterns.name: 概率提问与目标事件
patterns.context: 询问抽到指定字母、字母组合或序列的概率，常与不放回抽样题模板连用

patterns.name: 字母频数表记法
patterns.context: 用花括号列出字母及其数量，作为抽样总体；频数和字母组合变化
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 概率题中的数据表示

patterns.name: 指定字母串或序列
patterns.context: 概率事件指向特定字母、连续字母串或有序序列；并非每题都用频数表

patterns.name: 数列求下一项
patterns.context: 给出整数序列并要求推断后续项，周围含负数及疑似数列数据

patterns.name: 求多项式的第 k 项
patterns.context: 给出若干数值，询问某表达式或数列的第 k 项；上下文含代数式

en.description: Activation is scattered across papers in multiple disciplines: fragments following after, terms and abbreviations with internal subwords, academic syntactic words, and formulas, numbers, and a few domain-specific terms are all marked. Trigger positions are unstable, making a single semantic pattern difficult to identify.

patterns.name: Substrings following after
patterns.context: Words or phrases following after are marked in varied contexts, especially in prepositional phrases or descriptions of time and processes. The triggering words themselves are inconsistent.
patterns.domain: Academic body text and abstracts across disciplines

patterns.name: Internal fragments of terms and proper names
patterns.context: Activation falls on subwords in scientific terms, abbreviations, Latin species names, or formatting markers; many words are split into subword fragments, and the markings do not cover the full term.
patterns.domain: Biomedical science, microbiology, astrophysics, materials physics, and paper formatting

patterns.name: Connective and structural words
patterns.context: Several function words and common verbs are marked in academic sentences about methods, results, or formulas; the same word behaves inconsistently across passages.

patterns.name: Mathematics and formula formatting
patterns.context: In passages containing mathematical symbols, formula environments, or LaTeX formatting, activation appears on formula variables and nearby environments.

patterns.name: Number and unit formats
patterns.context: Numbers, units, or formatted expressions with units appear in experimental data or descriptions of paper layout.

patterns.name: Local words in proper names
patterns.context: Terms occur inside method names or abbreviations; trigger positions are fragmented and cannot be reduced to a single stable word meaning.

patterns.name: Walking and group behavior descriptions
patterns.context: Describes mobile subjects walking together and entering a crowded place.
patterns.domain: Behavioral data research on mobile agents

patterns.name: Body parts and irradiation
patterns.context: Medical descriptions of partial-body irradiation and its effect on hematopoietic stem-cell migration.

patterns.name: Biological experimental subjects and membrane proteins
patterns.context: Describes heterologous expression of a plant plasma-membrane proton pump in yeast and transport assays.

patterns.name: Astrophysical phenomenon
patterns.context: Bright X-ray flares in gamma-ray burst afterglows.

9_2929.concept: 学术文本局部片段
9_2929.description: 激活分散于多学科论文文本：after 后续片段、术语及缩写内部子词、学术句法词，以及公式、数字和少数领域专属词均有标记。各片段触发位置不稳定，难以用单一语义模式解释。

patterns.name: after 后的子串
patterns.trigger: «after» 后紧接的 token 或子串，如 «continuous»、«glow»、«cTBS»、«heter»、«subjects»、«a»、«expanding»、«the»、«various»
patterns.context: 不同上下文中，after 后的词或词组被标记；尤其出现于介词短语或时间/过程描述中。触发词本身并不一致。
patterns.domain: 跨学科论文正文及摘要

patterns.name: 术语及专名内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在科学名词、缩写、拉丁学名或排版标记的若干子词上；许多词被分词拆开，标记并不覆盖完整术语。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、微生物学、天体物理、材料物理及论文排版

patterns.name: 片段衔接与结构词
patterns.context: 在方法、结果或公式说明等学术句子中，若干功能词和普通动词被标记；同词在不同片段中的表现并不一致。

patterns.name: 数学与公式排版
patterns.context: 含数学符号、公式环境或 LaTeX 排版的片段中，公式变量及环境附近出现激活。

patterns.name: 数值与单位格式
patterns.context: 数字、单位或带单位的排版片段出现在实验数据或论文版式描述中。

patterns.name: 专名中的局部字词
patterns.context: 词项位于方法名称或缩写内部，具体触发位置呈碎片化，无法归结为单个稳定词义。
patterns.domain: 生物医学方法及技术缩写

patterns.name: 步行与群体行为描述
patterns.context: 描述移动受试者共同步行并进入拥挤场所的行为。
patterns.domain: 移动主体行为数据研究

patterns.name: 身体部位与照射
patterns.context: 部分身体照射及其对造血干细胞迁移影响的医学表述。
patterns.domain: 放射生物学或医学摘要

patterns.name: 生物实验对象与膜蛋白
patterns.context: 描述植物质膜质子泵在酵母中异源表达及运输测定。
patterns.domain: 植物生理学与生物化学

patterns.name: 天体物理现象
patterns.context: 伽马射线暴余辉中的明亮 X 射线耀发。

en.description: The strongest cross-domain trigger is after within sentences, often introducing circumstances following a prior event, procedure, administration, or stimulus. There are also local activations on the angular expression by 45° and on namely.

patterns.name: Sentence-internal “after” trigger
patterns.context: Appears before a subsequent event, operation, or result in a longer sentence or technical statement; capitalization does not affect the trigger.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: historical narratives, paper abstracts, mathematics, and physics texts

patterns.name: Rescue narrative after a historical event
patterns.context: “after” introduces events following damage to a ship; the preceding text describes the actions of the rescue vessel.

patterns.name: after in a bibliography entry
patterns.context: Appears in a LaTeX/BibTeX-style bibliography entry, next to author or title information.

patterns.name: after in paper results or methods
patterns.context: “after” introduces a signal, field, or result following the completion of a treatment step or operation.
patterns.domain: ArXiv astrophysics and theoretical physics texts; Wikipedia science entries

patterns.name: after in medical research
patterns.context: “after” introduces measurements, changes, or research processes following treatment, administration, an observation period, or stimulation.

patterns.name: Angular description in quantum optics
patterns.context: Describes the angle of rotation of polarization modes by a wave plate; this passage does not contain after, and activation concentrates near the angle and explanatory connective.

9_2929.concept: after及后续事件
9_2929.description: 最强且跨领域的触发是句中 after，常引出此前事件、处理、给药或刺激之后的情况；此外有角度表达 by 45°、namely 的局部激活。

patterns.name: 句中“after”触发
patterns.context: 在较长句子或技术性陈述中，出现在后续事件、操作或结果之前；大小写不影响触发。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：历史叙述、论文摘要、数学与物理文本

patterns.name: 历史事件后的救援叙述
patterns.trigger: «after»10 that high-speed transport had suffered a
patterns.context: “after”引出船只受损之后的事件，前文叙述援助船只行动。

patterns.name: 参考文献条目中的 after
patterns.context: 出现在 LaTeX/BibTeX 风格文献条目中，紧邻作者或标题信息。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学论文参考文献

patterns.name: 论文结果或方法中的 after
patterns.context: “after”引出处理步骤或操作完成后的信号、场或结果。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 天体物理、理论物理文本；Wikipedia 科学条目

patterns.name: 医学研究中的 after
patterns.context: “after”引出治疗、给药、观察期或刺激后的测量、变化或研究过程。

patterns.name: 量子光学中的角度描述
patterns.context: 描述波片对偏振模式的旋转角度；该段未标记 after，激活集中在角度与解释性连接词附近。

en.description: Activation centers on after and the words that follow it, especially structures of the form after + time, event noun, or gerund; these mark sequence, outcomes after an operation, or narrative stages, and occur across scientific and general explanatory texts.

patterns.name: after followed by a time or process stage
patterns.context: Activates when describing event order, a state after an operation, or the progression of a derivation or narrative to a later stage; common structure: after + time/action/process.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: physics, mathematics, astronomy, science news, and formal proof texts

patterns.name: after followed by a gerund or operation
patterns.context: after introduces a preceding operation, followed by a description of the resulting expression, observation, or signal.

patterns.name: after followed by a time or event noun
patterns.context: after is followed by a noun phrase, relational word, or process noun marking a time point, condition, or narrative stage; [10] personifies the proof process.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, astronomy, and proof/encyclopedia narratives

patterns.name: Other nearby contexts
