en.description: The clearest repeated signal is better (comparative or improvement contexts), but highlighted tokens also include it, anomal, Apple, Moving, Books, and numeric fragments, among other dissimilar content; overall, activation is mixed and difficult to unify.

patterns.name: better and comparative contexts
patterns.context: Contains better, often in questions about whether an option is better, comparisons of approaches, or descriptions of improved wages and living conditions; activation falls on better itself.

patterns.name: Better in titles
patterns.context: Contains “better” or a neighboring phrase in a title or title-like sentence; the highlight in paragraph 1 is actually it, not better, in the context “Pretending it isn't there”.

patterns.name: Proper nouns / substrings within words
patterns.context: Words are split into multiple tokens; activation focuses on the anomal substring in anomalous and partial tokenization of the proper noun Devario.

patterns.name: Activation on specific word fragments
patterns.context: Activates in titles or numeric/problem text, without showing the clear conditions associated with better comparative contexts.
patterns.domain: HackerNews titles, math problems, bibliographic text

patterns.name: Unlabeled portions and mixed activation
patterns.context: Strong tokens are scattered across accounts of miners’ strikes and questions about host configurations; a shared trigger is difficult to identify from the fragments.

9_2943.concept: better／比较词相关，但模式混杂
9_2943.description: 较清楚的重复信号是 better（比较、改善语境），但高亮也覆盖 it、anomal、Apple、Moving、Books、数字片段等多种不相似内容；整体呈混合、难以统一的激活。

patterns.name: better 及比较语境
patterns.context: 出现 better，常见于询问某种方案是否更好、比较做法，或描述改善工资与生活条件；激活落在 better 本身。

patterns.name: 标题中的 Better
patterns.context: 标题或标题式短句中出现“better”或紧邻词组；第1段的高亮实际是 it，而非 better，语境为“Pretending it isn't there”。

patterns.name: 专名／词语内部子串
patterns.context: 词被切分为多个 token；激活集中在 anomalous 的 anomal 子串以及专名 Devario 的部分切分上。

patterns.name: 特定词语片段激活
patterns.context: 在标题或数字／题目文本中激活，未显示出与 better 比较语境相同的明确条件。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 标题、数学题、书目文本

patterns.name: 未标记部分及混合激活
patterns.context: 较强 token 分散在矿工罢工叙述和主机配置问答中，难以从片段确认共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 新闻叙述、StackExchange 技术问答

en.description: Activation is distributed across unrelated subword fragments and title formats: the word-initial fragment Dev and anomalous, the name Justice Graham, Books, better, Fine alterations, the proper name Scholars, and easier. There is no consistent semantic or stylistic trigger.

patterns.name: Word-initial fragment Dev
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of words; it may be followed by Devario, Devinen, or Devices, or repeated in a title after a newline.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia, PubMed, patent titles or body text

patterns.name: In-word fragment of anomalous
patterns.context: Appears in phrases such as Devario anomalous, with activation near both the initial title segment and its repeated opening afterward.

patterns.name: Name Justice Graham
patterns.context: The name appears as a title and is repeated on the next line; activation remains at the repeated instance but is relatively weaker.

patterns.name: Books in a book abstract
patterns.context: Appears in the header of a book abstract page alongside information such as Synopsis and page numbers.

patterns.name: better defining collocation
patterns.context: Appears in the progressive expression We are better defining...
patterns.domain: NIH project descriptions or research text

patterns.name: Fine alterations phrase
patterns.context: Appears in a research title or abstract about distortion-product otoacoustic emissions.

patterns.name: Proper names and opportunity-project titles
patterns.context: Appears near a person’s name and a Scholars hip Opportunity title; activation is dispersed across proper names and title fragments.
patterns.domain: Pile-CC web text or project titles

patterns.name: easier
patterns.context: Appears in a feature description about making logistics easier.

9_2943.description: 激活分布于多种不相干词片段与标题格式：Dev 词首及 anomalous、人名 Justice Graham、Books、better、Fine alterations、专名 Scholars 和 easier；没有一致的语义或文体触发条件。

patterns.name: 词首片段 Dev
patterns.context: 出现在单词开头；后续可能接成 Devario、Devinen 或 Devices，也可能在换行后的标题重复出现。

patterns.name: anomalous 的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在 Devario anomalous 一类词组中，且首段标题与其后重复的开头附近均有激活。

patterns.name: 人名 Justice Graham
patterns.context: 人名作为标题出现，并在下一行重复；重复处激活仍在，但相对较弱。

patterns.name: 书籍摘要中的 Books
patterns.context: 出现在带有 Synopsis、页码等信息的书籍摘要页眉中。

patterns.name: better defining 搭配
patterns.context: 出现在 We are better defining... 这一进行时表达中。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目描述或科研文本

patterns.name: Fine alterations 词组
patterns.context: 出现在关于 distortion-product otoacoustic 的科研标题或摘要中。

patterns.name: 专名与机会项目标题
patterns.context: 出现在人名及 Scholars hip Opportunity 标题附近；激活分散在专名和标题词片段上。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 网页文本或项目标题

patterns.name: easier
patterns.context: 出现在描述如何让物流更容易的功能说明中。

en.description: Activation is concentrated mainly on Dev- across different word forms and the preposition of; scattered fragments also include Justice, Graham, anomal, was, in, and ivation, across varied domains and contexts.

patterns.name: Word-initial Dev-
patterns.context: Activation falls on the Dev substring at the beginning of proper nouns or common words; the following word forms vary widely.

patterns.name: of
patterns.context: The preposition of occurs in different syntactic structures; sometimes it appears with a following word or local phrase.
patterns.domain: Mathematical text, web news, medical abstracts

patterns.name: Scattered within-word fragments
patterns.context: Scattered activation on proper nouns, within-word substrings, and common function words, with no stable shared context.

9_2943.description: 激活主要集中在多种词形中的 Dev- 与介词 of；另有 Justice、Graham、anomal、was、in、ivation 等零散片段，跨领域且上下文不一。

patterns.name: 词首 Dev-
patterns.context: 在专名或普通词开头处，激活落在 Dev 子串；后续词形差异很大
patterns.domain: 百科、医学摘要、专利背景

patterns.name: of
patterns.trigger: «of»，包括“uct of 5 and -81.6”“News of the store”“News of the Iraqi arms deal”“Activation of”
patterns.context: 介词 of 出现在不同句法结构中；有时与后续词或局部短语共同出现
patterns.domain: 数学文本、网页新闻、医学摘要

patterns.name: 零散词内片段
patterns.context: 零散激活于专名、词内子串及常见功能词，未显示稳定的共同上下文
patterns.domain: 百科、网页新闻、医学摘要

en.description: Activation often occurs on sentence-initial “We” and “We have,” especially in email expressions about having received something; it also appears on the word-initial “Person” in personality and on several medical or financial fragments, without forming a unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial We
patterns.context: A sentence begins with the first-person plural as subject, followed by a statement; some examples have perfect constructions such as “have received/found.”
patterns.domain: Enron emails and NIH biomedical abstracts

patterns.name: Receipt in the perfect tense
patterns.context: The subject is “We,” followed by received and an object related to a contract or agreement.

patterns.name: Word-initial Person in a medical term
patterns.context: Person is the word-initial fragment of personality, followed by disorder or change.

patterns.name: Other sentence-initial or body-text medical fragments
patterns.context: Examples involve neuropathy, visual signal conversion, and inability to complete financial statements, with no apparent shared local word-form pattern.

9_2943.description: 激活常出现在句首“We”及“We have”，尤见邮件中的完成时收件表达；另见 personality 的词首“Person”及若干医学或财务片段，未形成统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 句首 We
patterns.context: 句首以第一人称复数作主语，后接陈述；部分例子带有“have received/found”等完成时结构。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件及 NIH 生物医学摘要

patterns.name: 完成时的收到
patterns.context: 主语为“We”，后接 received 和合同或协议类宾语。

patterns.name: 医学术语中的词首 Person
patterns.context: Person 是 personality 一词的词首，后接 disorder 或 change。

patterns.name: 其他医学句首或正文片段
patterns.trigger: “New insights”及“Vision begins”；此外有“« are» unable”
patterns.context: 分别涉及神经病变、视觉信号转换及无法完成财务报表，表面上没有共同的局部词形模式。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要与商务邮件

en.description: Primarily responds to along and its collocations: along/accompanying, conveying or advancing, and along the lines of/those lines meaning similar. There are also local activations in a pet-related email fragment and an abstract title that the main pattern does not explain.

patterns.name: along meaning accompanying or along a route
patterns.context: along is followed by a route, direction, thing, or person, meaning along, together with, or accompanied by; also occurs in web descriptions, geographical entries, and emails

patterns.name: along meaning advancing
patterns.context: Collocates with verbs for conveying information or advancing a process; along means passing it on or moving things forward

patterns.name: along those lines / of: approximate example
patterns.context: along is followed by lines to form an idiom meaning similar to a method or along a particular direction

patterns.name: Activity along a route or together with something
patterns.context: along with introduces things done together or included; here it refers to classic content in addition to random trivia

patterns.name: Pet-supply-related email
patterns.context: Discusses a dog crate and its price; the activated fragment does not contain along, so the trigger is unclear

patterns.name: Web promotion template fragment
patterns.context: Promotional content in HTML format, where along with introduces an additional item

patterns.name: Abstract-title fragment
patterns.context: Segmented text from a project abstract title; activation may result from tokenization and its relationship to the other patterns is unclear

9_2943.description: 主要响应 along 及其搭配：沿着/伴随、传递或推进，以及 along the lines of/those lines 表示类似。另有宠物邮件片段与摘要标题局部激活，无法由主模式解释。

patterns.name: along 表示伴随或沿线
patterns.trigger: “along the x-axis” “along its current alignment” “along with”
patterns.context: along 后接路线、方向、事物或人，表示沿着、随同、连同；也见于网页说明、地理条目和邮件

patterns.name: along 表示推进
patterns.context: 与传递信息或推进流程的动词搭配，along 表示传递下去或使事情继续进展

patterns.name: along those lines / of：近似举例
patterns.trigger: “along the lines of Twig” “along those lines”
patterns.context: along 后接 lines，构成惯用表达，表示类似某种做法或沿着某方向

patterns.name: 沿路或伴随活动
patterns.context: along with 引出一起进行或包含的事物；此处指随机趣闻之外还带上经典内容

patterns.name: 宠物用品相关邮件
patterns.context: 谈及狗笼及其价格；激活片段中未见 along，触发关系不明

patterns.name: 网页促销模板片段
patterns.context: HTML 格式的促销内容，along with 引出附加项目

patterns.name: 摘要标题中的抽象片段
patterns.context: 项目摘要标题的拆分文本；可能是 token 切分导致的局部激活，与其他模式关系不明

en.concept: Entities and text boundaries with structural markers
en.description: The main pattern is email addresses in recipient lists, including email domains, angle brackets, and comma boundaries; strong activation also occurs on a rating page, the name of a legal telecommunications organization, the beginning of a web comment, and the body of one email.

patterns.name: Email-address delimiters and recipient-list commas
patterns.context: A comma is followed by an email address in angle brackets, or a recipient entry combines a name and email; strong activation falls mainly on commas and list boundaries.

patterns.name: Email domains and email-header field boundaries
patterns.context: Email headers or address lists contain email addresses, domains, names, and field boundaries; this pattern overlaps with list delimiters, but the activation positions are not identical.
patterns.domain: Enron email headers and email addresses

patterns.name: Downgrades and rating-history email content
patterns.context: Terms such as Upgrades/Downgrades, history, or coverage appear on a stock-rating page, with activation also falling on rating-related phrases.
patterns.domain: Financial news/rating emails or web excerpts

patterns.name: Telecommunications organization names in legal case citations
patterns.context: A legal case excerpt lists organizations such as telecommunications cooperatives and telephone companies.

patterns.name: Narrative transition or development of a viewpoint in a web comment
patterns.context: The body of a comment following a link to a web article begins a point-by-point account with “Firstly”; the remaining activation is weaker and shows no clear shared trigger word.

patterns.name: Email reply attempting to defer something until the weekend
patterns.context: A brief email says the task is not yet complete and that the sender plans to try over the weekend, followed by thanks and an email header.

9_2943.concept: 带结构标记的实体与文本边界
9_2943.description: 主要模式是邮件地址及收件人列表中的邮箱、域名、尖括号和逗号边界；另在评级页面、法律电信机构名称、网页评论开头及一封邮件正文中出现强激活。

patterns.name: 邮件地址分隔符与收件人列表逗号
patterns.context: 逗号后接尖括号包围的邮箱地址，或姓名与邮箱组成的收件人条目；强激活主要落在逗号及列表边界上。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件头、联系人/收件人列表

patterns.name: 邮箱域名与邮件头字段边界
patterns.context: 邮件头或地址列表中出现邮箱、域名、姓名及字段边界；本模式与列表分隔符有重叠，但触发位置不完全相同。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件头与电子邮件地址

patterns.name: 下跌评级及评级历史邮件内容
patterns.context: 出现股票评级页面的 Upgrades/Downgrades、历史或覆盖信息等词，激活也落在评级相关词组上。
patterns.domain: 金融新闻/评级邮件或网页摘录

patterns.name: 法律案例引文中的通信类机构名称
patterns.context: 法律判例摘录中列举电信合作社、电话公司等机构名称。

patterns.name: 网页评论中的叙述转折/观点展开
patterns.context: 网页文章链接之后的评论正文，以“Firstly”开启分点式叙述；其余激活较弱且未呈现明显共同触发词。

patterns.name: 尝试推迟到周末的邮件回复
patterns.context: 简短邮件正文中说明目前尚未完成、打算周末尝试，随后有致谢与邮件头。

en.description: Activation is distributed across code, programming Q&A, and developer documentation, leaning toward technical terms, identifiers, files, and interface navigation; it also occurs in string-null values, compression-library comments, volunteer-service promotion, and module names, without a single semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Lexical fragments in code and identifiers
patterns.context: Appears in code, HTML, comments, or technical Q&A; often occurs with surrounding punctuation, camelCase naming, or code structure.
patterns.domain: Software development, programming Q&A, code comments

patterns.name: Navigation and interface descriptions
patterns.context: Describes navigation, pages, or menus in a website or application interface.
patterns.domain: Web-interface descriptions, website descriptions in legal documents, software documentation

patterns.name: File and path operations
patterns.context: Involves copying files, directories, paths, or test commands; usually in code or development instructions.

patterns.name: String and null checks
patterns.context: Discusses whether a string is empty, an empty string, and related check results.

patterns.name: Compression library and copyright information
patterns.context: Appears in the source-file header and copyright notice of a compression library.

patterns.name: Volunteer-service promotion and questions
patterns.context: Introduces a volunteer-service organization and asks readers a promotional question about volunteer work.

patterns.name: Slack WebSocket module definition
patterns.context: Appears as a module definition and class name; the fragment is very short and lacks enough context to confirm a broader pattern.

patterns.name: Program testing and continuous-integration documentation
patterns.context: Explains test commands and how to run tests, including a documentation heading and a TODO marker.

patterns.name: File-purpose description in a code comment
patterns.context: A source-file header comment describes the library the file belongs to and its purpose.

9_2943.description: 激活分布于代码、编程问答和开发文档，偏向技术词、标识符、文件与界面导航；另见字符串空值、压缩库注释、志愿服务宣传及模块名等内容，未见单一语义触发词。

patterns.name: 代码与标识符中的词法片段
patterns.trigger: 代码中的英文词、标识符及其子词，如 «string»、«return»、«file»、«function»、«module»、«compressed»
patterns.context: 出现在代码、HTML、注释或技术问答中；常与周围的标点、驼峰命名或代码结构共同出现。
patterns.domain: 软件开发、编程问答与代码注释

patterns.name: 导航与界面描述
patterns.context: 描述网页或应用界面中的导航、页面或菜单。
patterns.domain: 网页界面说明、法律文书中的网站描述、软件文档

patterns.name: 文件与路径操作
patterns.context: 涉及文件复制、目录、路径或测试命令；多在代码或开发说明中。

patterns.name: 字符串与空值判断
patterns.context: 讨论字符串为空、空字符串及相关判断结果。

patterns.name: 压缩库及版权信息
patterns.context: 出现在压缩库源文件头部和版权声明中。

patterns.name: 志愿服务宣传与提问
patterns.context: 介绍志愿服务组织，并向读者提出关于志愿工作的宣传性问题。

patterns.name: Slack WebSocket 模块定义
patterns.context: 以模块定义和类名形式出现，片段极短，缺少可确认的更广上下文。

patterns.name: 程序测试与持续集成文档
patterns.context: 说明测试命令和运行测试的方法，包含文档标题及待办标记。

patterns.name: 代码注释中的文件用途说明
patterns.context: 源代码文件头注释描述文件所属库及用途。

en.concept: Local structures and terminology in technical text
en.description: Activation spans several technical text formats: numbers, punctuation, subword fragments, citation markers, and specific terms in instructions, media, code, and patents; no single stable semantic theme is apparent.

patterns.name: Tokens adjacent to numbers and symbols
patterns.context: Near numbers, punctuation, code symbols, or formatting markers; activation often falls on numeric fragments, punctuation, or Markdown/code symbols
patterns.domain: Mixed: academic text, code, technical Q&A, and patents

patterns.name: Function words and phrase continuation in technical text
patterns.context: Between consecutive sentences or steps in instructions, Q&A, or technical descriptions

patterns.name: In-word suffixes or tokenization fragments
patterns.context: A word is split into subwords; the triggering fragment may be a suffix, possessive, or hyphenated segment
patterns.domain: General English, technical text, and patent text

patterns.name: Tables and citation markers
patterns.context: Near table numbers, cross-references, or formatted citation markers

patterns.name: Vector-graphics editing operations
patterns.context: Steps for selecting a graphics object and performing a menu operation

patterns.name: Downloads, files, and media playback
patterns.context: Discusses downloading or playing media and problems such as files not being saved

patterns.name: UI animation and code implementation
patterns.context: Discusses rewriting UI methods, code cleanliness, and animation functions

patterns.name: Publication names and possessives
patterns.context: Lists works, editions, or authors and describes an index being converted to spoken content

patterns.name: HTML5, Flash, and trust judgments
patterns.context: Expresses an opinion about Adobe’s interests and the trustworthiness of its HTML5 applications

patterns.name: Description of an adjustable mechanism in a patent
patterns.context: Continuously describes the mounting and adjustability of a chair, stand, or monitor

patterns.name: Convolution structure and dimension examples
patterns.context: A code comment explains how to decompose an asymmetric convolution and gives example dimensions

patterns.name: Arrangement and alignment of rectangular windows
patterns.context: A patent describes rows of windows on a mask and their alignment

9_2943.concept: 技术文本中的局部结构与术语
9_2943.description: 激活覆盖多种技术文本与格式：数字、标点、子词片段、引用标记，以及操作说明、媒体、代码和专利中的具体术语；未见单一稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: 令牌与数字、符号相邻
patterns.context: 数字、标点、代码符号或格式标记附近；激活常落在数值片段、标点或 Markdown/代码符号上
patterns.domain: 混合：学术文本、代码、技术问答及专利

patterns.name: 技术文本中的功能词和短语延续
patterns.context: 操作说明、问答或技术描述中，处于连续句子或步骤之间

patterns.name: 词内后缀或分词片段
patterns.context: 词被切分为子词，触发片段可能是后缀、所有格或连字符
patterns.domain: 一般英语、技术文本与专利文本

patterns.name: 表格与引用标记
patterns.context: 表格编号、交叉引用或带格式的引用标记附近
patterns.domain: 学术论文与结构化文本

patterns.name: 矢量图形编辑操作
patterns.context: 说明选择图形对象并执行菜单操作的步骤

patterns.name: 下载、文件与媒体播放
patterns.context: 讨论下载或播放媒体，以及文件未保存等问题

patterns.name: UI 动画与代码实现
patterns.context: 讨论重写 UI 方法、代码整洁性和动画函数

patterns.name: 出版物名称与所有格
patterns.context: 列举作品、版本或作者，并描述索引转为口述内容

patterns.name: HTML5、Flash 与信任判断
patterns.context: 对 Adobe 的利益与其 HTML5 应用可信度发表意见

patterns.name: 专利中的可调机构描述
patterns.context: 连续描述椅子、支架或显示器的安装与可调特性

patterns.name: 卷积结构与尺寸示例
patterns.context: 代码注释解释非对称卷积的拆分方式和示例尺寸

patterns.name: 矩形窗口的排列与对齐
patterns.context: 专利描述掩模上成排窗口及其对齐关系

en.description: Activation is distributed across descriptions of operations/tasks, documents and writing, files and editors, interface controls, and various software uses; it also occurs in manual formatting, image processing, keyboard uses, and animal behavior tasks. The broad commonality is that these often appear in contexts listing functions, operations, or outputs.

patterns.name: Performing tasks and operations
patterns.context: Describes a user, object, or device performing an operation, task, or step; often connected to software features, behavioral responses, or interface input.

patterns.name: Written assignments and writing products
patterns.context: Lists writing, creation, editing, or documents and other work products used for evaluation.

patterns.name: Files and content types in an editor
patterns.context: Describes files and content organized by category in an editor or project; also includes editor names in code comments.

patterns.name: Manual formatting and space insertion
patterns.context: Mentions manually inserting spaces and line breaks to format mathematical code or text.

patterns.name: Task lists and keyboard navigation
patterns.context: Describes using a keyboard to navigate a list and perform list operations.

patterns.name: Image-processing operations
patterns.context: Lists image-processing operations such as compositing and warping digital color images.

patterns.name: Interface controls and data input
patterns.context: Describes how graphical-interface controls provide a means of data input or device configuration.

patterns.name: Interface-component names in code comments
patterns.context: An HTML comment lists component or plugin names in a web project; activation falls near the comment markers and names.

patterns.name: Mechanical keyboard and work use
patterns.context: Discusses a keyboard model and its use for work-related tasks rather than gaming.

patterns.name: Operant task in courtship behavior
patterns.context: Female animals’ cognitive behavior guides them to make selective motor responses to males; one listed response is completing an operant task.

9_2943.description: 激活分布于操作/任务、文档与写作、文件及编辑器、界面控件和各类软件使用描述；另见手动排版、图像处理、键盘用途及动物行为任务。共同点较宽泛，常处于列举功能、操作或产物的语境。

patterns.name: 执行任务与操作
patterns.context: 描述用户、对象或设备执行操作、任务或步骤；常与软件功能、行为响应或界面输入相连。

patterns.name: 书面作业与写作产物
patterns.context: 列举书写、创作、编辑或用于评估的文档及其他工作产物。
patterns.domain: 教育、写作、个人工作描述

patterns.name: 编辑器中的文件与内容类型
patterns.context: 描述编辑器或项目中按类别组织的文件及内容；也包括代码注释中的编辑器名称。

patterns.name: 手动格式与空格插入
patterns.context: 提及手工插入空格和换行以整理数学代码或文本格式。

patterns.name: 任务清单与键盘导航
patterns.context: 描述用键盘在列表中导航，并执行列表操作。

patterns.name: 图像处理操作
patterns.context: 列举对数字彩色图片进行合成、变形等图形处理。

patterns.name: 界面控件与数据输入
patterns.context: 描述图形界面控件如何提供数据输入或设备配置机制。

patterns.name: 代码注释中的界面组件名
patterns.context: HTML 注释列出网页项目的组件或插件名称；激活落在注释标记及名称附近。

patterns.name: 机械键盘与工作用途
patterns.context: 谈论键盘型号及其用于工作相关任务，而非游戏。

patterns.name: 求偶行为中的操作性任务
patterns.context: 雌性动物对雄性的认知行为引导其作出选择性运动反应，列举的反应之一是完成操作性任务。

en.description: Most activation occurs in contexts with coordinated lists, multiple objects, or consecutive operations, especially at list junctions and near nouns; other cases include writing-structure advice, manual formatting instructions, and code initialization comments.

patterns.name: Coordinated items, plural nouns, or list content
patterns.context: Activation falls on nouns, list-introducing words, or nearby punctuation in coordinated lists, often in sentences that enumerate several items in succession.
patterns.domain: Technical documentation, software discussions, patent text, and general expository prose

patterns.name: Manual insertion and formatting operations
patterns.context: Describes manually inserting spaces, line breaks, and other formatting characters in mathematical code; activation focuses near “and” and “manual”.

patterns.name: Structural divisions and organization
patterns.context: Recommends splitting longer content and organizing paragraphs and sections logically.

patterns.name: Performing multiple operations
patterns.context: In descriptions of interactive lists or DOM operations, mentions that users can perform several other operations.

patterns.name: Multiple file types in directories
patterns.context: Explains the directory location where Visio searches for specific file types; activation falls on the enumeration of file categories.

patterns.name: Enumeration of examples, supporting materials, and requirements
patterns.context: Lists materials to include in a performance review document.

patterns.name: Steps and countable items in voice-interface development
patterns.context: Describes a voice user interface development process, listing operations such as counting syllables and comparing vowels.

patterns.name: Feature and object lists in task-management systems
patterns.context: Requests recommendations for hosted task-management systems and lists required features and data objects.

patterns.name: Action prompts in code comments
patterns.context: A comment in an assembly code snippet prompting initialization; an isolated imperative-comment pattern.

patterns.name: Enumeration of multimedia types
patterns.context: Patent background on personalized training materials lists multimedia formats.

patterns.name: Enumeration of sources and recommendations
patterns.context: Describes reading various materials to implement an event-rendering approach, then turns to the final decision.

9_2943.description: 多数激活出现在并列列举、多个对象或操作连续出现的语境，尤其落在列表连接处及名词附近；另见写作结构建议、手工格式化说明和代码初始化注释。

patterns.name: 并列项、复数名词或列表内容
patterns.trigger: 例如 “sentences, make sure paragraphs and sections”，“illustrations, examples and requirements”，“video, animation and audio”；以及 “several other operations”“numerous suggestions”
patterns.context: 激活落在并列列表中的名词、列表引导词或相关标点附近，常见于多个项目连续罗列的句子。
patterns.domain: 技术说明、软件讨论、专利文本及一般说明文

patterns.name: 手动插入与格式化操作
patterns.trigger: “manual space inserting and manual inserting of returns”
patterns.context: 描述在数学代码中手工插入空格、换行等格式字符，激活集中于 “and” 及 “manual” 附近。

patterns.name: 结构划分及组织
patterns.trigger: “Split up long sentences, make sure paragraphs and sections are in logical order”
patterns.context: 建议将较长内容拆分，并按逻辑组织段落和章节。

patterns.name: 执行多个操作
patterns.context: 交互式列表或 DOM 操作的说明中，提到用户能执行多项其他操作。

patterns.name: 文件类型与目录中的多类文件
patterns.context: 说明 Visio 查找特定类型文件的目录位置，激活落在文件类别并列处。

patterns.name: 示例、说明材料及要求的罗列
patterns.context: 绩效评估文件中列举应加入的材料。

patterns.name: 语音界面开发中的步骤与计数项
patterns.trigger: “includes counting syllables and comparison of vowels”
patterns.context: 描述语音用户界面开发流程，罗列计数音节与比较元音等处理。

patterns.name: 任务管理系统中的功能或对象清单
patterns.trigger: “tasks, notes with the tasks, file attachments and set priority”
patterns.context: 请求推荐托管任务管理系统，并罗列所需功能和数据对象。

patterns.name: 代码注释中的动作提示
patterns.context: 汇编代码片段中的注释，提示进行初始化；这是孤立的命令式注释模式。

patterns.name: 多媒体类型罗列
patterns.context: 关于个性化培训材料的专利背景中，列举多媒体形式。

patterns.name: 搜索资料与建议的列举
patterns.context: 描述为实现事件渲染方案而阅读的多类资料，随后转向最终决定。

en.description: Activation is distributed across additive elaboration, degree or quantity expressions, product and code markers, and local contexts involving music, interiors, landscapes, and error handling; no stable cross-topic common trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Explanatory elaboration after a function or attribute
patterns.context: When listing several functions, contents, or attributes, activation often falls on and, commas, or nearby nouns being further specified; it typically depends on the surrounding context forming a list or extension.
patterns.domain: Technical documentation, software discussions, encyclopedic descriptions, product and service descriptions

patterns.name: Degree, quantity, and emphasis expressions
patterns.context: When frequency, quantity, scale, comparison, or emphasis is involved, activation may occur near numbers, degree words, and their modified terms; the specific role differs across contexts.
patterns.domain: Narratives, music descriptions, training introductions, accommodation descriptions, software reviews

patterns.name: Technical or product names and accompanying descriptions
patterns.context: Software, tools, or product names appear in code documentation, instructions, or reviews, often alongside downloads, features, or usage contexts.
patterns.domain: Software development documentation and technical discussions

patterns.name: Code and technical markers
patterns.context: Near code snippets or code comments; activation does not consistently fall on the code itself and may instead occur in adjacent natural-language explanations.

patterns.name: Musical works and music-theory descriptions
patterns.context: Appears when introducing works, movements, styles, and instrumental motifs at the beginning.

patterns.name: Spatial, interior, and landscape descriptions
patterns.context: Describes rooms, furniture, flooring, and the view outside along a spatial route.

patterns.name: Login failures and error handling
patterns.context: Describes how the expected error message does not appear after invalid information is entered, emphasizing that the problem recurs.

9_2943.description: 激活分散在并列补充、程度或数量表达、产品与代码标记，以及音乐、室内景观和错误处理等局部语境；跨主题的稳定共同触发因素不明显。

patterns.name: 功能或属性后的说明性展开
patterns.trigger: “and issues”“and data source omitted”“and charts”“and templates”“and audible pronunciations”“and even printed materials”“handles large files better”
patterns.context: 在列举若干功能、内容或属性时，激活常落在 and、逗号或被补充说明的名词附近；通常需要前后文构成并列或扩展。
patterns.domain: 技术文档、软件讨论、百科说明、产品与服务介绍

patterns.name: 程度、数量与强调表达
patterns.trigger: “every single time”“five-note”“four movements”“one-to-one”“double-bed”“most of the problems”“large files”
patterns.context: 涉及频率、数量、尺度、比较或强调时，数词、程度词及其修饰对象附近可能激活；不同语境中具体作用不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 叙述、音乐说明、培训介绍、住宿描述、软件评论

patterns.name: 技术或产品名及其配套说明
patterns.trigger: “Visual Studio Code”“.NET Core downloads”“Professional C#”“Visio”“Sublime Text 3”
patterns.context: 软件、工具或产品名称出现在代码文档、操作说明或评论中，常伴随下载、功能或使用情境。
patterns.domain: 软件开发文档与技术讨论

patterns.name: 代码与技术标记
patterns.context: 代码片段或代码注释附近；片段中激活并不稳定地落在代码本身，也可能落在相邻的自然语言说明。

patterns.name: 音乐作品与乐理描述
patterns.context: 介绍作品、乐章、风格及开头的器乐动机时出现。

patterns.name: 空间、室内陈设与景观描写
patterns.context: 沿空间路线描写房间、家具、地面与窗外景观。

patterns.name: 登录失败及错误处理
patterns.trigger: “log-in with nonsense”“never displays the error message”“skipped every single time”
patterns.context: 描述输入无效信息后预期错误提示没有出现，并强调问题反复发生。

en.description: Activation favors words such as small, short, brief, single, and one, which denote small scale, brevity, or singularity; it also occurs with repeated small actions and specific quantity structures. Several scattered vocabulary responses cannot be reliably grouped into the same pattern.

patterns.name: CSS style rule
patterns.context: Discusses using a single CSS rule to control webpage text styling; activation clusters near “single CSS rule”.

patterns.name: Small template interface elements
patterns.context: Describes a menu-screen template and its layout; «small» is the strongest trigger.
patterns.domain: GitHub template or interface code comments

patterns.name: Small examples or brief materials
patterns.context: Describes the brevity or small scale of examples or materials; occurs across different contexts.
patterns.domain: Machine-learning code documentation, programming Q&A, business documents

patterns.name: Repeated or small movements
patterns.context: Describes small, repetitive finger and hand movements during prolonged computer use; “repetitive” is the strongest trigger.
patterns.domain: Patent background, ergonomics or computer-use contexts

patterns.name: Small-scale units in quantities or structures
patterns.context: Occurs in specific descriptions of structure, quantity, or increments; some words also fit the sense of “small scale”.
patterns.domain: Music encyclopedias, web discussions, database Q&A

patterns.name: Other local word forms and collocations
patterns.context: For several fragments, activation cannot be adequately explained by shared syntactic, semantic, or domain conditions; they may reflect local vocabulary in different collocations.
patterns.domain: Dictionary introductions, XML comments, experimental abstracts, and other text

9_2943.description: 激活偏向 small、short、brief、single、one 等表示小规模、简短或单一的词，也见于重复细小动作和具体数量结构；另有若干零散词汇响应，不能可靠归入同一模式。

patterns.name: CSS 样式规则
patterns.context: 讨论用单个 CSS 规则控制网页文本样式；激活集中在“single CSS rule”附近。

patterns.name: 小型模板界面元素
patterns.context: 描述菜单屏幕模板及其布局；«small»是最强触发词。
patterns.domain: Github 模板或界面代码注释

patterns.name: 小型示例或短篇材料
patterns.context: 说明示例或材料的篇幅、规模较小；不同上下文中出现。
patterns.domain: 机器学习代码说明、编程问答、业务文档

patterns.name: 重复或细小动作
patterns.context: 描述长时间使用电脑时手指、手部的细小重复动作；“repetitive”最强。
patterns.domain: 专利背景，人体工学或计算机使用情境

patterns.name: 数量或结构中的小规模单位
patterns.context: 出现在结构、数量或增量的具体说明中；部分词同时也符合“小规模”用法。
patterns.domain: 音乐百科、网页讨论、数据库问答

patterns.name: 其他局部词形与搭配
patterns.context: 若干片段中，无法由共同的句法、词义或领域条件充分解释激活；可能包括不同搭配下的局部词汇响应。
patterns.domain: 词典介绍、XML 注释、实验摘要及其他文本

en.description: Activation is scattered across function words, punctuation, and paragraph structures in English expository writing; more noticeable local tendencies include scale words such as small/short, chapter and step organization, and procedural guidance, but there are also cross-domain proper names and isolated expressions, with no unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: Function words and punctuation in sentences or paragraphs
patterns.context: Activation is distributed near sentence connections, noun phrases, and paragraph boundaries, with no single fixed lexical item.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English prose, technical text, expository writing

patterns.name: Small things and their details
patterns.context: Describes small, sporadic, or repetitive actions, objects, or scale; paragraph 1 contains «small video preview» below a menu, paragraph 2 has «small and incidental» actions and «small repetitive motions», and paragraph 7 has «small tutorial».
patterns.domain: Interface templates, ergonomics patent background, technical Q&A

patterns.name: Classification, chapters, and organization
patterns.context: Text describes the components and ordering of a document, content, or operation; paragraph 3 discusses textbook chapters, paragraph 5 points to the next figure, and paragraph 10 lists writing steps.
patterns.domain: Textbook introductions, software instructions, educational course descriptions

patterns.name: Tutorial or procedural guidance
patterns.context: Explains to readers how to use software, development tools, or hardware, often with imperatives or instructional phrasing.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A and software documentation

patterns.name: Degree, quantity, and evaluative descriptions
patterns.context: Describes the length, quality, or quantity of content; across different paragraphs, it modifies chapters, definitions, and film bonus material, among other things.
patterns.domain: Textbook introductions, app reviews, film descriptions

patterns.name: Local activations on specific nouns or proper names
patterns.context: These words have strong activation in their own contexts, but share no semantic category or stable collocation across paragraphs.
patterns.domain: Interfaces, ergonomics, chemistry, dictionaries, software, hardware, etc.

9_2943.description: 激活散布于英文说明文中的功能词、标点与段落结构；较明显的局部倾向包括 small/short 等尺度词、章节步骤组织和操作指导，但也有跨领域专名及孤立表达，缺少统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 句子或段落中的功能词与标点
patterns.trigger: 多处标记在常见词和标点上，如 « the»、« of»、« in»、«,»、«.»；以及 «↵»
patterns.context: 激活分布在句子连接、名词短语和段落边界附近，并无单一固定词项。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英文散文、技术文本、说明文

patterns.name: 小型事物及其细节
patterns.context: 描述细小、零散或重复的动作、物件或规模；第1段是菜单下方的 «small video preview»，第2段是 «small and incidental» 动作及 «small repetitive motions»，第7段是 «small tutorial»。
patterns.domain: 界面模板、人体工学专利背景、技术问答

patterns.name: 分类、章节与组织结构
patterns.context: 文本说明文档、内容或操作的组成部分及先后安排；第3段谈教材章节，第5段引导下一张图，第10段列写作步骤。
patterns.domain: 教材介绍、软件操作说明、教育课程描述

patterns.name: 教程或操作指导
patterns.trigger: «Click»、«You can»、«Here is a small tutorial»、«how to use»、«sample code»
patterns.context: 面向读者解释如何操作软件、开发工具或硬件，常用祈使句或指导性表述。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答与软件说明

patterns.name: 程度、数量与评价性描述
patterns.context: 描述内容的长度、质量或数量；在不同段落里分别修饰章节、定义、影视附加内容等。
patterns.domain: 教材介绍、应用评论、影视介绍

patterns.name: 具体名词或专名的局部激活
patterns.context: 这些词在各自语境中带有较强激活，但跨段缺少共同的语义类别或稳定搭配。
patterns.domain: 界面、人体工学、化学、词典、软件、硬件等

en.description: Activation is distributed across interface menus, programming code, and operation tutorials, and also occurs in expressions of quantity or segmentation, spatial locations, and literary or music reviews; no clear shared trigger is apparent, and a few noun and title contexts are difficult to generalize.

patterns.name: Small interface elements and menus
patterns.context: Descriptions of screen layouts, menu bars, or context menus commonly mention interface components, their locations, and functions.
patterns.domain: Software interface documentation and UI templates

patterns.name: Programming code and technical operations
patterns.context: Technical Q&A contexts involving code, code snippets, or explanations of code behavior.

patterns.name: Interface operation tutorials
patterns.context: Step-by-step instructions for using software, describing options, panels, or visual themes.

patterns.name: Ordinal, numeric, and segmented expressions
patterns.context: Describes quantities, sequences, or compound modifiers containing numbers; appears across different topics.
patterns.domain: General narratives, music analysis, literary reviews, and jokes

patterns.name: Descriptions of spatial location and scope
patterns.context: Describes the location or scope of objects or interface elements, or the current focus; overlaps with both interface and general spatial descriptions.

patterns.name: Literary and music-style reviews
patterns.context: Evaluates the style, melody, or poetic form of works.

patterns.name: Nouns and category headings
patterns.context: Includes section labels, email subject lines, or names of spaces being introduced; it is unclear whether these phrases are the triggers.
patterns.domain: Forum conversations, emails, and personal narratives

9_2943.description: 激活分布于界面菜单、编程代码和操作教程，也见于数量/分段表达、空间位置及文学音乐评论；共同触发特征不明确，少数名词与标题语境难以归纳。

patterns.name: 小型界面元素与菜单
patterns.trigger: “menu template”, “small video preview”, “menus and options”, “menu bar”
patterns.context: 在描述屏幕布局、菜单栏或上下文菜单时，常出现界面部件及其位置、功能
patterns.domain: 软件界面说明与 UI 模板

patterns.name: 编程代码与技术操作
patterns.context: 代码、代码片段或解释代码行为的技术问答语境
patterns.domain: 编程与 StackExchange 技术问答

patterns.name: 界面操作教程
patterns.trigger: “Click on the Style tab”, “left pane”, “next image”
patterns.context: 按步骤指导用户操作软件，并描述选项、面板或视觉主题

patterns.name: 序数、数字与分段表达
patterns.context: 描述数量、序列或带数字的复合修饰语；出现于不同主题中
patterns.domain: 一般叙述、音乐分析、文学评论与笑话

patterns.name: 空间位置与范围描述
patterns.context: 叙述物件或界面元素的位置、范围或当前焦点；与界面和一般空间描述都有交集

patterns.name: 文学与音乐风格评论
patterns.context: 评价作品的风格、旋律或诗句形式

patterns.name: 名词与类目标题
patterns.context: 出现章节标签、邮件主题或被介绍的空间名称；触发是否来自这些短语并不明确
patterns.domain: 论坛对话、邮件与个人叙述

en.description: Activates across multiple genres, often on phrase continuations, content following function words, and transitions between sentences and paragraphs; also appears around line breaks, code, and structural markers. Individual passages have local themes such as music and literature, websites, fonts, jokes, and corporate instructions, making them difficult to group into a single semantic category.

patterns.name: Phrase continuation after function words such as articles and prepositions
patterns.context: Often occurs within a phrase or sentence, where a noun, adjective, or verb follows a function word; not limited to specific words or positions

patterns.name: Sentence-initial and contrastive transition words
patterns.context: At sentence or discourse transitions, activation occurs at the beginning of sentences and paragraphs, as well as in continuation expressions

patterns.name: Structural boundaries in line breaks and marked text
patterns.context: Near line breaks, comments, tags, or code structures; in some examples, activation falls on formatting symbols rather than content words

patterns.name: Program code and technical identifiers
patterns.context: Appears in code statements, comments, or explanations of code; specific programming languages and identifiers vary

patterns.name: Order, quantity, and enumeration in formal descriptions
patterns.context: When describing the composition or form of a work, numbers and ordinal numbers modify units, items, or features
patterns.domain: Music descriptions, literary criticism, website discussions

patterns.name: Descriptions of style, appearance, and design
patterns.context: Describes the style and presentation of art, fonts, music, or website text

patterns.name: HTML/XML template and menu layout descriptions
patterns.context: Template comments or interface layout descriptions include components such as menus, headings, and previews

patterns.name: Teachers and students in joke narratives
patterns.context: Short jokes in which a teacher asks a question in class and a student responds

patterns.name: Prompts and programming Q&A about removing spaces
patterns.context: Explains how to iterate over a string and skip spaces, preceded by a command-line prompt and code

patterns.name: Objective-C table row selection callback
patterns.context: A row selection method in UITableView uses conditional branches to handle different tables

patterns.name: Specific font families and typography terms
patterns.context: Introduces a type designer, monospaced variants, and the visual characteristics of a font

patterns.name: Links to lists of Iranians and section navigation
patterns.context: A forum reply directs readers to an external list and a specified section

patterns.name: Literary styles and verse features
patterns.context: Discusses literary movements, ballad-like language, sentence length, and rhyme labels

patterns.name: CSS style rules and web readability
patterns.context: Discusses how a site owner can easily style website text with a single CSS rule

patterns.name: Corporate expense allocation rules
patterns.context: Describes a stored procedure for an expense-entry application and rules governing the cost centers employees may claim

9_2943.description: 激活跨多种文体，常落在短语延续、功能词后续内容及句段衔接处；也见于换行、代码和结构标记。各段另有音乐文学、网页、字体、笑话和企业说明等局部主题，难以归为单一语义类别。

patterns.name: 冠词、介词等功能词后的短语延续
patterns.context: 常处于短语或句子中，功能词之后接名词、形容词或动词；并不局限于特定词或位置

patterns.name: 句首与转折衔接词
patterns.context: 句子或话语转接处，激活分布在句首、段落开头及续接表达

patterns.name: 换行及标记文本中的结构边界
patterns.context: 换行、注释、标签或代码结构附近；部分例子中的激活落在格式符而非内容词
patterns.domain: 代码、邮件及结构化文本

patterns.name: 程序代码与技术标识符
patterns.context: 代码语句、注释或对代码的解释中出现；具体编程语言和标识符并不一致

patterns.name: 形式说明中的顺序、数目与列举
patterns.context: 描述作品组成或文本形式时，数词和序数词修饰单位、项目或特征
patterns.domain: 音乐说明、文学评论、网页讨论

patterns.name: 风格、外观及设计描述
patterns.context: 描述艺术、字体、音乐或网页文本的样式与呈现

patterns.name: HTML/XML 模板与菜单布局说明
patterns.context: 模板注释或界面布局描述中，包含菜单、标题和预览等组件

patterns.name: 笑话叙事中的教师与学生
patterns.context: 教师在课堂上提问，随后学生作出反应的短篇笑话

patterns.name: 提示语与删除空格的代码问答
patterns.context: 解释如何遍历字符串并跳过空格，前文有命令行提示与代码

patterns.name: Objective-C 表格行选择回调
patterns.context: UITableView 的行选择方法中，以条件分支处理不同表格

patterns.name: 特定字体家族及字体设计术语
patterns.context: 介绍字体设计师、等宽版本和字体的视觉特征

patterns.name: 伊朗人列表链接与章节跳转
patterns.context: 论坛回复指引读者访问外部列表并跳到指定章节

patterns.name: 文学文体与韵文特征
patterns.context: 谈论文学运动、歌谣式语言、句长及押韵标签

patterns.name: CSS 样式规则与网页可读性
patterns.context: 讨论网站文本易于由站主用单条 CSS 规则设置样式

patterns.name: 企业费用归属规则说明
patterns.context: 介绍用于费用录入应用的存储过程及员工可申报的成本中心规则

en.concept: Structure and temporal markers in descriptive text
en.description: Activation spans multiple genres: music passages especially concern movements, beginnings, and released editions; other cases include code comments, emails, jokes, and the ends of scenes or activities. No single word form explains all passages.

patterns.name: Descriptions of musical structure
patterns.context: Encyclopedic narrative introducing instrumentation, movements, or musical style; number words, nouns, and sentence-final punctuation also commonly activate.

patterns.name: Descriptions of editions and their contents
patterns.context: Describes music editions and accompanying videos, physical packaging, or other contents.

patterns.name: Thanks and replies in English email
patterns.context: In email or Q&A exchanges, thanks someone for a reply and asks which fields need to be added to a table.

patterns.name: HTML theme and template comments
patterns.context: Source-code comments or configuration notes introducing webpage themes, templates, and interface layouts.

patterns.name: Temporal positioning at a scene’s end
patterns.context: Describes what happens, appears, or is recorded when a scene or activity ends.

patterns.name: Character action after an interval
patterns.context: In a joke narrative, a short time passes before a character reacts.

patterns.name: Musical introduction and rhythm description
patterns.context: Describes the opening phrase, instruments, and rhythmic features of a musical work.

9_2943.concept: 描述性文本中的结构与时间标记
9_2943.description: 激活分布于多种文体：音乐段落尤其涉及乐章、开头与发行版本；另见代码注释、邮件、笑话及场景或活动结尾。没有单一词形能解释全部段落。

patterns.name: 乐曲结构描述
patterns.context: 介绍作品编制、乐章或音乐风格的百科叙述；常见数量词、名词及句末标点也同时激活

patterns.name: edition及其内容描述
patterns.context: 描述音乐发行版本及其附带的视频、实体包装或其他内容

patterns.name: 英文邮件的感谢与回复语境
patterns.context: 邮件或问答往来中，感谢回复并提出表格需要补充的字段

patterns.name: HTML主题及模板注释
patterns.context: 源代码注释或配置说明，介绍网页主题、模板及界面布局

patterns.name: 句末场景时间定位
patterns.context: 叙述某个场景或活动结束时发生、呈现或记录的内容

patterns.name: 时间间隔后人物动作
patterns.context: 笑话叙事中，先经过短暂时间，再出现人物反应

patterns.name: 乐曲引入与节奏描写
patterns.context: 说明音乐作品开头的乐句、乐器与节奏特征

en.concept: Structure and list details in explanatory text
en.description: Activates across various explanatory texts: movements, instrumentation, and quantities in musical works; extras in audiovisual releases; film scene narration; and transcription notes, legal facts, software instructions, and license documents. Numbers and list-like details recur across several passages, but no single theme runs through them all.

patterns.name: Musical structure and instrumentation descriptions
patterns.context: Discusses movements, musical styles, instrumentation, or movement tempo terms; activation occurs across adjacent musical terminology and sentence structures.

patterns.name: Release configurations and extras lists
patterns.context: Introduces audiovisual release versions, packaging, or accompanying behind-the-scenes and deleted content, often presented as parallel lists.

patterns.name: Narration and analysis of film scenes
patterns.context: Narrates or evaluates specific scenes in films and their shots, tension, or effect on viewers.

patterns.name: Numbers, quantities, and ordinal expressions
patterns.context: Numbers occur in varied contexts such as counts, instrumentation, duration, frequency, or document structure; they may overlap with other patterns or appear independently.

patterns.name: Scanning and transcription notes; textual variants
patterns.context: An editor's note in an e-book transcription explains how original spelling or hyphenation marks were handled.
patterns.domain: Project Gutenberg e-book forewords or transcription notes

patterns.name: Time and actions in legal fact narratives
patterns.context: Chronologically recounts a defendant's actions, such as driving, parking, and entering a location, and specifies counts or time intervals.
patterns.domain: Legal judgments or case fact records

patterns.name: Software interface instructions
patterns.context: Guides users through windows, tabs, and panes, noting that the interface content changes with the theme.

patterns.name: License citations and document sections
patterns.context: Cites a software or font license and introduces provisions in subsequent sections.
patterns.domain: Licenses or licensing notes in code repositories

9_2943.concept: 说明性文本中的结构与清单细节
9_2943.description: 激活覆盖多种说明性文本：音乐作品的乐章、配器与数量，影音版本的附加内容，电影场景叙述，以及转录说明、法律事实、软件操作和许可证文档。数字与清单式细节在多段中反复出现，但没有单一主题贯穿全部。

patterns.name: 乐曲结构与配器描述
patterns.context: 谈论作品的乐章、音乐风格、乐器编制或乐章速度名称；激活分布在相邻的音乐术语和句子结构中。
patterns.domain: 音乐百科、古典音乐介绍

patterns.name: 版本配置与附加内容清单
patterns.trigger: “special edition”“deluxe edition”“20-page booklet”“bonus DVD”“making of”“deleted scenes”
patterns.context: 介绍影音作品的发行版本、包装物或随附的幕后与删减内容，常以并列清单呈现。

patterns.name: 电影场景的叙述与分析
patterns.trigger: “final scene”“end of scene 5”“wagon passes out of frame”
patterns.context: 叙述或评价电影中的具体场景及其镜头、紧张感或观众感受。

patterns.name: 数字、数量和次序表达
patterns.context: 数字出现在计数、编制、时长、次数或文档结构等不同语境中；可能与其他模式重叠，也可能独立出现。

patterns.name: 扫描录入说明及文本异体
patterns.trigger: “Transcriber's Notes”“Variations in spelling and hyphenation”“left as”
patterns.context: 电子书转录本的编者说明，指出原文拼写或断字符号的处理方式。
patterns.domain: 古登堡计划电子书前言或转录说明

patterns.name: 法律事实叙述中的时间与行动
patterns.trigger: “around the block approximately three times”“Within five minutes”
patterns.context: 按先后顺序陈述被告的驾驶、停车、进入场所等行为，并交代次数或时间间隔。
patterns.domain: 法律判决或案件事实记录

patterns.name: 软件界面操作指引
patterns.trigger: “Click on the Style tab”“software heading”“left pane”
patterns.context: 指导用户在窗口、选项卡和窗格中操作，并说明界面内容会随主题变化。

patterns.name: 许可证引用与文档章节
patterns.trigger: “LaTeX Project Public License”“Below, in three sections”
patterns.context: 引用软件或字体许可证，并引出后续分节规定。
patterns.domain: 代码仓库中的许可证或许可说明

en.concept: Structure and content descriptions in documents
en.description: Covers musical structure, instrumentation, singing and lyrics; the ending position of text or events; included record contents and specifications; software interface operations; and transcription and collation notes. Activation patterns are scattered across genres and vocabulary, with no single stable trigger.

patterns.name: Musical structure and instrumentation descriptions
patterns.context: Introduces movements, instrumentation, style, or the opening of a musical work; [1] also involves the hyphenated word fragment in “five-note”.

patterns.name: Songs, singing, and lyrics
patterns.context: Discusses song lyrics, performers, performance occasions, or song content; often adjacent to “end”, “first”, and positions within a musical work.
patterns.domain: Music encyclopedias and popular music introductions

patterns.name: Endings and terminal positions
patterns.context: Describes events or content occurring at the end of a scene, volume, page, or similar; [2] shows especially strong activation on “end of scene”.
patterns.domain: Film reviews, descriptions of classical book layouts, software documentation comments

patterns.name: Edition contents and duration specifications
patterns.context: Lists materials included in an album edition and specifications such as page count and duration.

patterns.name: Interface operations and settings
patterns.context: Instructs users to select tabs, themes, or panes in a software window.

patterns.name: Transcriber notes and textual variants
patterns.context: Notes accompanying digitized book texts that identify spelling and hyphenation differences.

9_2943.concept: 文档中的结构与内容说明
9_2943.description: 覆盖音乐作品结构、配器、歌曲演唱与歌词；文本或事件的末尾位置；唱片附带内容及规格；软件界面操作；转录校勘说明。激活模式分散于文体与词汇，未见单一稳定触发词。

patterns.name: 乐曲结构与配器说明
patterns.context: 介绍音乐作品的乐章、配器、风格或开头；[1]还涉及“five-note”的连字符词片段。

patterns.name: 歌曲、演唱与歌词
patterns.context: 谈歌曲的歌词、演唱者、演唱场合或歌曲内容；常与“end”“first”及乐曲位置相邻。
patterns.domain: 音乐百科与流行音乐介绍

patterns.name: 末尾、结尾及末端位置
patterns.trigger: “at the end of scene”“at the end of the volume”“page bottom”
patterns.context: 描述事件或内容出现在场景、卷册、页面等末端；[2]对“end of scene”激活尤强。
patterns.domain: 影视评论、古籍编排说明、软件文档注释

patterns.name: 版本附带内容与时长规格
patterns.context: 罗列专辑版本所含材料及其页数、时长等规格。

patterns.name: 界面操作与设置说明
patterns.context: 向用户说明软件窗口中选择选项卡、主题或窗格的操作。

patterns.name: 转录者说明与文本异文
patterns.context: 书籍数字化文本的转录说明，指出拼写和连字符差异。

en.description: Activates in disparate contexts including line breaks, musical work structure, song sections, and document configuration, CSS, website readability, and technical troubleshooting; no single semantic pattern explains all passages.

patterns.name: Line breaks and paragraph boundaries
patterns.context: Explicit line breaks, especially at headings, lists, code blocks, or paragraph transitions; sometimes activation is on the line break itself.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including encyclopedias, book forewords, code, and forum posts

patterns.name: Musical work structure and instrumentation
patterns.context: Describes movements, form, instrumentation, or sections of classical music works.

patterns.name: Songs and film scenes
patterns.context: Mentions a song playing during a film's ending scene; descriptions of the song's emotion also appear.
patterns.domain: Music entries or popular culture introductions

patterns.name: Spelling and word-break notes
patterns.context: Explains spelling or hyphenation differences retained or present in a text transcription.
patterns.domain: Transcriber notes in digitized editions of historical books

patterns.name: Document page generation configuration
patterns.context: Configures document site pages to insert page elements such as an updated timestamp at the bottom.
patterns.domain: Code comments or document generation configuration

patterns.name: CSS styling and typography
patterns.context: Discusses how website text styling can be set through CSS rules.

patterns.name: Installation commands and error troubleshooting
patterns.context: Shows a sequence of terminal commands and explains that an error occurred when the last command was executed.

patterns.name: Website readability and font changes
patterns.context: Reports that a website is difficult to read on an iPad and that the font size repeatedly changes.

patterns.name: Song sections and performer assignments
patterns.context: Introduces the rappers on different verses of a single and their order of performance.

patterns.name: Login error branches and code
patterns.context: Compares program behavior for valid and invalid login details and includes PHP conditional code.

9_2943.description: 激活分散于换行、音乐作品结构、歌曲段落，以及文档配置、CSS、网页可读性和技术排错等语境；没有单一语义模式能解释全部片段。

patterns.name: 换行与段落边界
patterns.context: 显式换行，尤其在标题、列表、代码块或段落切换处；有时激活的是换行符本身。
patterns.domain: 多种文体，包括百科、书籍前言、代码和论坛帖子

patterns.name: 音乐作品结构与配器
patterns.trigger: « first»、« piece»、« movements»、« symphony»、« scored»、« strings»、« Alleg»
patterns.context: 描述古典音乐作品的乐章、曲式、演奏编制或乐曲段落。

patterns.name: 歌曲与电影场景
patterns.context: 提及歌曲在电影结尾场景中播放；同时出现歌曲情感描述。
patterns.domain: 音乐条目或流行文化介绍

patterns.name: 拼写与断词说明
patterns.context: 说明文本转录中保留或存在拼写、连字符差异。
patterns.domain: 历史书籍数字化版本的转录者注释

patterns.name: 文档页面生成配置
patterns.context: 配置文档站点页面底部插入更新时间戳等页面元素。
patterns.domain: 代码注释或文档生成配置

patterns.name: CSS 样式与排版
patterns.context: 讨论网页文本样式如何通过 CSS 规则设置。

patterns.name: 安装命令与错误排查
patterns.context: 展示终端命令序列，并说明执行最后一条命令时出现错误。

patterns.name: 网页可读性与字体变化
patterns.trigger: « site»、« font»、« size»、« every»« few» seconds
patterns.context: 报告网页在 iPad 上难以阅读，字体大小反复变化。

patterns.name: 歌曲段落与演唱者分配
patterns.context: 介绍单曲中不同 verse 的说唱者及演唱顺序。

patterns.name: 登录错误分支与代码
patterns.trigger: « correct»、« nonsense»、« error message»、« skipped»、« if(isset($_
patterns.context: 比较有效与无效登录信息的程序行为，并附带 PHP 条件代码。

en.description: Primarily responds to words marking the beginning, ending, and internal organization of works or texts (opening, introduction, first, final, next); also covers descriptions of chapter counts, legal introductory language, a single CSS rule, and book duration.

patterns.name: Ending position of a segment
patterns.context: Describes a song playing during the final scene of a film, emphasizing its position at the end of a cinematic narrative.

patterns.name: Opening and introductory structure
patterns.context: Introduces the opening of each episode, a work’s introduction, or the organization of an article following its introduction.

patterns.name: Beginning and arrangement within a work
patterns.context: Describes the opening section and arrangement of movements, musical works, or song sections.

patterns.name: Introductory provisions in legal texts
patterns.context: Discusses whether a legal instruction includes introductory language from a provision.

patterns.name: Single rule and formatting
patterns.context: Explains that webpage styling can be controlled with a single CSS rule.

patterns.name: Next steps or image
patterns.context: A tutorial shows the next image after explaining interface settings.

patterns.name: Length or reading time
patterns.context: Summarizes a book as short and quantifies its length by the time required to read it aloud.

patterns.name: Work counts and section enumeration
patterns.context: Counts or orders components of works, such as episodes, movements, or tracks.

9_2943.description: 主要响应作品或文本的开头、结尾及内部编排词（opening、introduction、first、final、next），也覆盖对篇章数量、法律引入语、单条 CSS 规则和书籍时长的描述。

patterns.name: 片段的结尾位置
patterns.context: 描述歌曲在电影最后场景播放，强调影视叙事中的收尾位置

patterns.name: 开场与引言结构
patterns.context: 介绍剧集每集的开场、作品的引言，或文章中引言之后的组织安排

patterns.name: 作品内部的开头与编排
patterns.context: 描述乐曲乐章、音乐作品或歌曲段落的起始部分及其编排

patterns.name: 法律文本的引入条款
patterns.context: 讨论法律指示是否包含某条文中的引入性文字

patterns.name: 单一规则与排版
patterns.context: 说明网页样式可由一条 CSS 规则控制

patterns.name: 后续步骤或图像
patterns.context: 教程说明界面设置后展示下一张图像

patterns.name: 篇幅或阅读时长
patterns.context: 概述书籍篇幅较短，并以朗读所需时间量化

patterns.name: 作品数量与篇章计数
patterns.context: 对剧集、乐章、曲目等作品组成部分进行数量或顺序计数

en.description: Activates around structural transition phrases, especially previews of subsequent sections in papers, and also appears in time and quantity boundaries, entertainment introductions, software operations, legal language, and descriptions of classroom behavior; specific triggers vary across passages.

patterns.name: Paper structure previews
patterns.context: An academic paper first describes its structure or the next section, often using forms such as “outline of the paper is as follows” and “remainder of the paper is structured as follows”.

patterns.name: Time duration or quantity thresholds
patterns.context: When describing rates of change, duration, or quantity boundaries, numbers occur near time units or comparative structures.
patterns.domain: Website comments, book reviews, education/behavior descriptions

patterns.name: Introducing a scene or section
patterns.context: In entertainment narratives, mentions an ending scene, or introduces fixed opening or introductory text when presenting program content.

patterns.name: Procedures and interface elements
patterns.context: Explains software windows, tabs, headings, or interface settings, guiding users through operations step by step.

patterns.name: Legal provisions and citation language
patterns.context: Discusses whether trial instructions are complete and quotes specific statutory language.

patterns.name: Descriptions of classroom behavior
patterns.context: Lists student behaviors in class and how long they have difficulty remaining seated.

9_2943.description: 激活集中于结构性过渡语（尤其论文介绍后续章节），也见于时间/数量边界、影视介绍、软件操作、法律措辞和课堂行为描述；各段的具体触发并不完全一致。

patterns.name: 论文结构预告
patterns.trigger: “The rest of the paper is sketched as follows: in the next section”
patterns.context: 学术论文先交代文章结构或下一节内容，常见形式包括 “outline of the paper is as follows” 和 “remainder of the paper is structured as follows”。

patterns.name: 时间长度或数量阈值
patterns.trigger: “between small and large every few seconds”；“less than nine hours”；“for more than three minutes”
patterns.context: 描述变化频率、时长或数量边界时，数词与时间单位或比较结构相邻。
patterns.domain: 网页评论、书评、教育/行为描述

patterns.name: 场景或章节引出
patterns.trigger: “played over the final scene”；“The introduction to each episode … is as follows”
patterns.context: 叙述影视内容时提到结尾场景，或在介绍节目内容时引出固定的片头/介绍文字。

patterns.name: 操作步骤与界面元素
patterns.trigger: “Click on the Style tab”；“the next image”
patterns.context: 说明软件窗口、选项卡、标题或界面设置，按步骤指导用户操作。

patterns.name: 法律条文及引用措辞
patterns.trigger: “the charge was incomplete”；“introductory language from article 38.23”
patterns.context: 讨论审判指示是否完整，并引用具体法条措辞。

patterns.name: 课堂行为描述
patterns.trigger: “raise their hands in the class”；“fail to sit still for more than three minutes”
patterns.context: 列举学生在课堂中的行为表现及难以保持静坐的时长。

en.description: Activation mainly concerns words for opening and ending positions, as well as guides to paper structure; periodic switching and a single CSS rule are two more isolated triggers.

patterns.name: Opening / introductory position
patterns.context: Points to the beginning of a song or program, or introductory language in a legal text; nearby nouns describe the opening content.
patterns.domain: Music reviews, film entries, legal texts

patterns.name: Ending / concluding position
patterns.context: Describes the part at the end of a song, scene, or performance.
patterns.domain: Music and film reviews, music entries

patterns.name: Paper structure overview
patterns.context: A transition sentence in a paper summarizing the organization of subsequent sections.

patterns.name: Periodic change
patterns.context: Describes font size repeatedly switching between sizes at regular time intervals.

patterns.name: Single style rule
patterns.context: Emphasizes that a website’s style can be adjusted with a single CSS rule.

9_2943.description: 激活主要涉及开篇与末尾位置词，以及论文结构导览；另见周期性切换和单条 CSS 规则这两种较孤立的触发。

patterns.name: 开篇/引入位置
patterns.context: 指向歌曲或节目的开头，或法律文本中的引入语；周围出现描述开场内容的名词。
patterns.domain: 音乐评论、影视条目、法律文本

patterns.name: 末尾/收束位置
patterns.context: 描述歌曲、场景或表演中位于末尾的部分。
patterns.domain: 音乐与影视评论、音乐条目

patterns.name: 论文结构导览
patterns.trigger: “The rest of the paper is sketched as follows” / “The remainder of the paper is structured as follows”
patterns.context: 论文中概述后续章节安排的过渡句。

patterns.name: 周期性变化
patterns.context: 描述字号在大小之间反复切换，且变化有一定时间间隔。
patterns.domain: 技术评论、网页可用性讨论

patterns.name: 单条样式规则
patterns.context: 强调网站样式可由一条 CSS 规则调整。

en.description: Activates across expressions of openings or introductions, endings of works, musical structure, numbers, and durations, and appears sporadically in legal introductory phrases and descriptions of classroom behavior. No single meaning explains all passages.

patterns.name: Titles or opening content related to opening
patterns.context: Describes where a work, chapter, or program begins, often appearing in a title, introduction, or content development; the neuron also activates on adjacent opening-description words.
patterns.domain: Music reviews, encyclopedia entries, book descriptions

patterns.name: Ordinal and quantity expressions
patterns.context: Numbers describe duration, quantity, or order; activation is concentrated on the number and nearby words.
patterns.domain: Education/behavior descriptions, book introductions, encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Final sections or ending events
patterns.context: Refers to the final scene, verse, or section of a work or performance.
patterns.domain: Film reviews, theater reviews, music entries

patterns.name: Descriptions of music and song structure
patterns.context: Mentions a song, vocal style, instrument, or section of a song; not all such words activate strongly.

patterns.name: Introductory wording in legal documents
patterns.context: Describes introductory language contained in legal instructions or provisions.

patterns.name: Children's classroom behavior descriptions
patterns.context: “for more than three minutes” describes how long students have difficulty sitting still.

patterns.name: Reading duration descriptions
patterns.context: Estimates how long it takes to read a book aloud.

patterns.name: Emotional performance descriptions
patterns.context: Describes the mood and performance of a song, performance, or scene.

9_2943.description: 激活横跨开场/引言、作品结尾、音乐结构、数词与时长等表达，也零散出现在法律引导语和课堂行为描述中。没有单一词义能解释全部片段。

patterns.name: opening相关标题或开场内容
patterns.context: 描述作品、章节或节目从何处开始，常位于标题、引言或内容展开处；神经元也激活相邻的开场描述词。
patterns.domain: 音乐评论、百科条目、书籍说明

patterns.name: 序数与数量表达
patterns.context: 数词用于描述时长、数量或次序；激活集中在数词及其紧邻词语。
patterns.domain: 教育行为描述、书籍介绍、百科条目

patterns.name: 最终部分或结尾事件
patterns.context: 指向作品、表演或歌曲的最后场景、诗节或段落。
patterns.domain: 电影评论、戏剧评论、音乐条目

patterns.name: 音乐及歌曲结构描述
patterns.context: 提及歌曲、演唱方式、乐器或歌曲中的段落；并非所有此类词都强激活。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的引导语
patterns.context: 描述法律指示或条文所含的引言性语言。

patterns.name: 儿童课堂行为描述
patterns.context: “for more than three minutes”描述学生难以持续安坐的时间。

patterns.name: 阅读时长描述
patterns.context: 用时长估算一本书朗读所需时间。

patterns.name: 情绪性表演描述
patterns.context: 描述歌曲、演出或场景的情绪与表现。

en.description: Activations are concentrated on references to the beginnings, sections, and subsequent paragraph positions in the structure of text, programs, or music, especially “as follows” and section introductions when outlining a paper’s structure.

patterns.name: Previewing paper structure
patterns.context: In an academic paper paragraph, outlines the structure of what follows; often followed by a section and its number, citation, or brief description.

patterns.name: Opening or introduction heading
patterns.context: Introduces the beginning of a chapter, program, or book section, often adjacent to words such as opening, credits, and section.

patterns.name: Opening passage in a musical work
patterns.context: Describes the opening instrument, verse, or lyric section of a song or recording.

patterns.name: Paragraph position in song structure
patterns.context: Describes structural positions such as a song’s chorus, bridge, or final verse; does not necessarily refer to the opening.

9_2943.description: 激活集中于对文本、节目或音乐结构中开头、章节及后续段落位置的指称，尤其是论文概述结构时的“as follows”及 section 引导语。

patterns.name: 论文结构预告
patterns.trigger: “The remaining paper is organised as follows”, “The paper is organized as follows”, “This paper is organised as follows”, “The rest of the paper is sketched as follows”
patterns.context: 学术论文段落中，概述后文结构；常接 section 及其编号、引用或简述。

patterns.name: 开场或引言标题
patterns.trigger: “Introduction”及“introduction to each episode before the opening credits”；“opening of the section”
patterns.context: 介绍章节、节目或书籍部分的开头，常与 opening、credits、section 等词相邻。

patterns.name: 音乐作品中的开场段落
patterns.context: 描述歌曲或录音中的开场乐器、诗节或歌词部分。

patterns.name: 歌曲结构中的段落位置
patterns.context: 描述歌曲的副歌、桥段或最后诗节等结构位置；不一定指开场。

en.description: In most passages, the neuron responds to descriptions of a work's beginning or opening, especially nouns paired with opening, such as verse, hi-hat, section, credits, and cinema; it also responds to final scene/verse and to open and key-press instructions in technical procedures.

patterns.name: The word opening and related structures
patterns.context: Describes the beginning, opening content, or opening presentation of a work, chapter, song, series, musical piece, or game; “opening” often precedes a noun or functions as a noun, and the verb form “opens with” also occurs
patterns.domain: Music, film, television, games, publications, and work introductions

patterns.name: final in song section structure
patterns.context: Paired with a work's scene or song section to mean the last scene or section; no explicit opening trigger word is present

patterns.name: Paths and key-press instructions in procedures
patterns.context: Step-by-step instructions tell users to open a terminal, enter a path, and press keys; unrelated to the opening-of-a-work sense

9_2943.description: 多数段落中神经元响应作品开头或开场的描述，尤其是 opening 与 verse、hi-hat、section、credits、cinema 等名词搭配；另响应 final scene/verse 及技术步骤里的 open、按键指令。

patterns.name: opening 一词及其近义结构
patterns.trigger: “opening”与其后的名词，如 “opening verse”“opening hi-hat”“opening of the section”“opening credits”“opening cinema”；另见 “introduction”“opens with”
patterns.context: 描述作品、章节、歌曲、剧集、乐曲或游戏的开头部分、开场内容或开场呈现；“opening”常位于名词前，也可作名词，另有动词 “opens with”
patterns.domain: 音乐、影视、游戏、出版物及作品介绍

patterns.name: 歌曲段落结构中的 final
patterns.context: 与作品的场景或歌曲段落搭配，指最后一幕或最后一段；未见明确的 opening 触发词

patterns.name: 操作步骤中的路径与按键指令
patterns.context: 逐步说明用户打开终端、输入路径并按键操作；与作品开场含义无关

en.concept: Beginning and position in a work’s structure
en.description: Primarily responds to beginnings and structural position words in works or passages, such as opening, opens, first verse/track; also covers final scene/song/verse and organizational terms such as introduction and section.

patterns.name: “opening” and opening passages
patterns.context: Appears in a noun phrase or narrative, referring to the beginning, opening, or opening content of a musical work, series, game, or book chapter; typically adjacent to a definite article, ordinal, or component of the work.
patterns.domain: Music reviews, film/game descriptions, encyclopedia entries, book descriptions

patterns.name: First passage, track, or movement of a musical work
patterns.context: Specifies a position or opening musical material in a song, album, or musical piece; activation falls on words indicating an initial position and nearby structural descriptions.
patterns.domain: Music encyclopedias, song/album descriptions and music analysis

patterns.name: Ending or final section
patterns.context: Describes the last part of a film scene, album track, or lyric passage, contrasting positionally with the opening structure.

patterns.name: Structural position words and text organization
patterns.context: Refers to an episode’s introduction/opening credits or the opening position of a book chapter or layout; not necessarily song structure.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic descriptions, tables of contents, or book layout descriptions

9_2943.concept: 作品结构的起始与位置
9_2943.description: 主要响应作品或篇章的开头及结构位置词，如 opening、opens、first verse/track；也覆盖 final scene/song/verse 等末尾位置，以及 introduction、section 等组织用语。

patterns.name: “opening”及开头段落
patterns.context: 出现在名词短语或叙述中，指音乐作品、剧集、游戏、书籍章节等的开头、开场或开篇内容；通常邻接定冠词、序数词或作品组成部分。
patterns.domain: 音乐评论、影视/游戏介绍、百科条目、书籍说明

patterns.name: 乐曲的首段、首轨或乐章
patterns.trigger: [2] “opening verse”；[7] “opening track”；[8] “opens with a five-note instrumental invocation”；[9] “first verse”；[10] “first verse”
patterns.context: 说明歌曲、专辑或乐曲的具体结构位置或起始音乐材料；激活落在表示起始位置的词及其附近结构描述上。
patterns.domain: 音乐百科、歌曲/专辑介绍与音乐分析

patterns.name: 末尾或最终部分
patterns.context: 描述电影场景、专辑歌曲或歌词段落的最后部分，与开头结构形成位置对照。

patterns.name: 结构位置词与篇章组织
patterns.context: 指向剧集的引言/片头内容，或书籍章节、版面中的开篇位置；不一定是歌曲结构。
patterns.domain: 百科说明、目录或书籍编排描述

en.description: Primarily responds to structural position markers in content and adjacent expressions, especially verse and track in songs/albums, and opening or final scenes in film and games; also covers document section positions and a sequence of path-operation instructions.

patterns.name: Passage position in a song or album
patterns.context: When describing song, album, or track structure, activation often falls on ordinals, passage/track names, and nearby words; includes first, final, opening, verse, and track.

patterns.name: Opening and ending of film or game content
patterns.context: When mentioning a film’s final scene, a TV episode’s opening credits, or a game’s opening animation, position words and nearby words such as scene, credits, and cinema activate.
patterns.domain: Film and game descriptions and reviews

patterns.name: Position markers in document sections or layout
patterns.context: Marks where content appears in the beginning, ending, or layout of books, chapters, or explanatory documents.

patterns.name: Pasting a path and confirming in an operation sequence
patterns.context: In tutorial steps, copies a local path, pastes it, and presses Enter; activation also involves action instructions and adjacent words, with no clear connection to the other paragraph-position patterns.

9_2943.description: 主要响应内容的结构位置标记及其邻近表达，尤其歌曲/专辑中的 verse、track，以及影视、游戏的 opening、final 场景；也覆盖文档章节位置和一段路径操作指令。

patterns.name: 歌曲或专辑中的段落位置
patterns.trigger: “first verse”“final verse”“first verse”“opening verse”“opening track”“closing track”
patterns.context: 描述歌曲、专辑或曲目结构时，激活常落在序数、段落/曲目名称及其邻近词；包括 first、final、opening、verse、track。

patterns.name: 影视或游戏内容的开场与结尾
patterns.context: 提及电影中的最后场景、剧集开场片头或游戏开场动画时，相关位置词及 scene、credits、cinema 附近激活。

patterns.name: 文档章节或版面中的位置标示
patterns.trigger: “end of the volume”“opening of the section”“Introduction”
patterns.context: 书籍、章节或说明性文档中标示内容所在的开头、结尾或版面位置。

patterns.name: 操作步骤中的路径粘贴与确认
patterns.context: 教程步骤里复制本地路径、粘贴后按 Enter；激活也涉及动作指令及其相邻词，未见与其他段落位置模式的明确联系。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答、操作说明

en.description: Primarily activates in contexts involving the beginning of works, opening tracks, or title sequences; also occurs with closing tracks, film finales, and “after the jump” on websites. Some musical descriptions and markers in key-press instructions do not fit a single pattern.

patterns.name: Opening, prelude, or introductory section
patterns.context: Introduces the beginning of a work or section, an opening track, or a title sequence in descriptions of music, book chapters, or films; activation is concentrated near opening. [2] is a book contents description
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias and music/film introductions; [2] is a book contents description

patterns.name: Tracks or scenes at the end
patterns.context: Describes a closing track on a music album or a song playing in a film's final scene; activation falls near closing or final.

patterns.name: Sequential expression of endpoint/afterward
patterns.context: In an online music article, jump refers to a link or content below on the page, prompting readers to listen to a track later; activation is near after.

patterns.name: Key-press terms in instructions
patterns.context: Step-by-step terminal instructions prompt users to press the spacebar or Enter in sequence; activation is near then.

patterns.name: Opening structure words
patterns.context: Paragraph beginnings and expressions for the start of a chapter or work in English explanations or reviews; this passage uses only generic descriptions and does not contain opening.

patterns.name: Other word activations outside opening contexts
patterns.context: Markers cover local words describing song lyrics, features, or reviews, not all of which can be explained by opening/closing expressions.

9_2943.description: 主要在作品开头、开场曲或片头的语境中激活，也见于收尾曲、电影终场和网页“after the jump”；若干音乐描述及按键操作中的标记无法归入统一模式。

patterns.name: 开篇、前奏或开场段落
patterns.trigger: “opening”及其邻近词组，如“opening verse”“opening of the section”“opening track”“opening theme song”“opening credits”；另有“Introduction to each episode before the opening credits”
patterns.context: 音乐、书籍章节或影视作品的介绍中，描述作品或段落的开头、开场曲或片头；激活集中在 opening 一词附近。
patterns.domain: 百科全书及音乐、影视介绍；[2]为书籍目录说明

patterns.name: 结尾处的曲目或场景
patterns.context: 描述音乐专辑中的收尾曲，或电影最后场景中播放的歌曲；激活落在 closing、final 附近。

patterns.name: 终点／之后的顺序表达
patterns.context: 网络音乐文章以 jump 指代页面中的链接或下方内容，提示读者在后续处收听曲目；激活靠近 after。

patterns.name: 操作指令中的按键词
patterns.trigger: “then press Space Bar once”“then press Enter”
patterns.context: 分步说明终端操作，按顺序提示按空格键或回车键；激活标在 then 附近。

patterns.name: 开篇结构词
patterns.trigger: “The soothing tones”中的“The”，以及相邻的“opening”“introduction”等开篇语境
patterns.context: 英语说明或评论中的段落起始及章节、作品开头表达；本段只出现泛指描述，未出现 opening 一词。

patterns.name: 其他非开篇位置的词语激活
patterns.trigger: “final”“lyric”“features”“closing”等邻近语境中的标记；各段的标记分布并不完全一致
patterns.context: 标记覆盖了描述歌曲歌词、特色或评论的局部词语，不都能由开篇／结尾表达解释。

en.description: Strongly responds to opening when describing the beginning of content, including book chapters, albums and songs, and game openings; also responds to first or final in a few song contexts. In a technical tutorial passage, verbs such as open, type, then, and paste in terminal-operation steps also activate.

patterns.name: opening / beginning position
patterns.context: Marks the beginning or position of content such as a book chapter, album track, song passage, or game opening before a noun; also involves relative-position words first and final. Activation often falls on opening, with some first/final.
patterns.domain: Bibliographic descriptions, music reviews and song/album entries, game reviews

patterns.name: Command-line operation steps
patterns.context: Explains terminal operations step by step, using commands, key names, and then to indicate operation order; no opening appears.

9_2943.description: 主要在描述内容的开头位置时强烈响应 opening，涉及书籍章节、专辑与歌曲、游戏开场；少数歌曲语境中也响应 first 或 final。另有一段技术教程中，终端操作步骤里的 open、type、then、paste 等动词激活。

patterns.name: opening / 开头位置
patterns.context: 在名词前标示书籍章节、专辑曲目、歌曲段落、游戏开场等内容的开头或位置；也涉及相对位置词 first、final。激活常落在 opening，另有 first/final。
patterns.domain: 书目说明、音乐评论与歌曲/专辑条目、游戏评论

patterns.name: 命令行操作步骤
patterns.context: 逐步说明在终端执行操作，连续使用命令、键名和 then 指示操作顺序；不见 opening。

en.concept: Opening of a work or content
en.description: Primarily responds strongly to opening, especially opening passages in songs and albums; also covers chapter openings, pre-title introductions to episodes, and game opening cutscenes. It also responds to descriptions of musical passages such as first verse.

patterns.name: Opening section of a song, album, or musical work
patterns.context: When discussing a song, album, or musical work, identifies the opening passage, lyrics, or track; context often involves verse, track, song, album, chorus, or theme song.
patterns.domain: Music reviews, artist or work descriptions

patterns.name: Beginning of a chapter or text section
patterns.context: Opening refers to the start of a chapter in a book or historical text, rather than the opening of a musical work.
patterns.domain: Historical descriptions, books, or encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Opening introduction before a television episode’s credits
patterns.context: Describes an introduction or standard opening content before the title credits of each episode.
patterns.domain: Television animation or series encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Opening cutscene in a video game
patterns.context: In a video game review, opening modifies cinema, referring to a cutscene at the beginning of the game.

9_2943.description: 主要对 opening 强烈反应，尤其是歌曲、专辑的开头段落，也涉及章节开头、剧集片头前引言和游戏开场过场；另对 first verse 等音乐段落表述有反应。

patterns.name: 歌曲、专辑或音乐作品的开头部分
patterns.context: 讨论歌曲、专辑或音乐作品时，指明开场的段落、歌词或曲目；上下文常涉及 verse、track、song、album、chorus、主题曲等。
patterns.domain: 音乐评论、音乐人或作品介绍

patterns.name: 章节或文本部分的开头
patterns.trigger: «opening» + «of» + «the» + «section»；另有“«opening» of the volume”相关语境
patterns.context: opening 指书籍或历史文本中的章节起始处，而非音乐作品的开场。
patterns.domain: 历史类说明文字、书籍或百科条目

patterns.name: 剧集片头前的开场介绍
patterns.context: 说明每集片头字幕之前的引言或固定开场内容。
patterns.domain: 电视动画或剧集百科条目

patterns.name: 电子游戏的开场过场动画
patterns.context: 电子游戏评论中，opening 修饰 cinema，指游戏开头的过场动画。

en.description: Repeatedly sensitive to the beginning of a work or chapter, opening, and subsequent content, especially opening verses in songs, pre-title credits in programs, and musical openings; also shows sporadic responses to specific expressions involving song-section order, terminal-operation instructions, citation formats, movement structure, and work or episode counts.

patterns.name: Opening passage or section
patterns.context: Describes the beginning, opening content, or opening sound of a work, chapter, program, or piece of music; sometimes immediately followed by a noun phrase, sometimes within a sentence.
patterns.domain: Music reviews, work descriptions, encyclopedias, and table-of-contents descriptions

patterns.name: Song-section structure and singing order
patterns.context: Discusses song sections such as verses, choruses, and bridges, and their order, number, or performers; [1] also mentions “opening verse”
patterns.domain: Song descriptions, pop music reviews, and casual discussion

patterns.name: Commands and keys in operation steps
patterns.context: A user operates a terminal or interface step by step, with commands and key names appearing in an action sequence.

patterns.name: Quotation format in explanatory text
patterns.context: Explains how to quote and insert line breaks in a specific website’s plain-text format.

patterns.name: Introducing work or chapter headings
patterns.context: Mentions an introduction or the beginning of a section in a work, program, or document; not necessarily related to musical passages.

patterns.name: Movements, style, and instrumental openings in a work
patterns.context: Describes a piece of music in terms of structure or style, including the number of movements and how it opens.

patterns.name: Work counts, episode counts, and adaptation information
patterns.context: Describes the number of episodes in a series, compilation films, or song adaptations; no high-activation words clearly match the other patterns.
patterns.domain: Television series and music work encyclopedia descriptions

9_2943.description: 反复对作品或章节的开头、opening及其后续内容敏感，尤见歌曲开场主歌、节目前置片头和音乐开场；另对歌曲段落顺序、终端操作指令、引用格式、乐章结构及作品集数等具体表述有零散响应。

patterns.name: 开头段落或开场部分
