patterns.trigger: “opening”与紧随其后的 “verse”“credits”“of the section”“hi-hat”等；[1][3][5][7][9]中 “opening” 激活最高
patterns.context: 描述某作品、章节、节目或音乐的开头、开场内容或开场声音；有时紧接名词短语，有时在句中
patterns.domain: 音乐评论、作品介绍、百科全书及目录说明

patterns.name: 歌曲段落结构与演唱顺序
patterns.context: 谈论歌曲的主歌、副歌、桥段等部分及其顺序、数量或演唱者；[1]同时提到 “opening verse”
patterns.domain: 歌曲介绍、流行音乐评论与闲谈

patterns.name: 操作步骤中的命令与按键
patterns.trigger: “type”“press”“Space Bar”“paste”“Enter”；尤其是连续指令 “type … then press”
patterns.context: 用户按步骤操作终端或界面，命令及按键名称出现在动作序列中

patterns.name: 说明文中的引述格式
patterns.context: 说明如何在特定网站的纯文本格式中引用并换行

patterns.name: 篇章或章节标题的引入
patterns.trigger: “Introduction”“The introduction to each episode”；以及 “The opening of the section on General History”
patterns.context: 提到作品、节目或文档中的引言、部分开头；不一定与音乐段落有关
patterns.domain: 百科全书、出版物内容说明

patterns.name: 作品的乐章、风格与乐器性开场
patterns.context: 从结构或风格角度描述一首乐曲，包含乐章数量及其开场方式

patterns.name: 作品数量、集数及改编信息
patterns.context: 描述系列的集数、合辑电影或歌曲改编；没有明显匹配其余段落的高激活词
patterns.domain: 电视系列与音乐作品百科介绍

en.description: Activation is concentrated on beginnings, first/final sections, preludes, and introductions in music, songs, and books; it also occurs in sequence and position expressions in procedures and typography instructions. The common thread is position, order, and the initial stage.

patterns.name: The beginning of a chapter or section
patterns.context: Occurs in sentences describing a book's contents, volumes, or chapter structure, identifying the beginning of a part.

patterns.name: Opening musical passage or song verse
patterns.context: Discusses a song, recording, or specific arrangement and includes opening verse; distinct from contexts referring generally to the start of a musical work.

patterns.name: First section in song structure
patterns.context: Describes the order of a song's sections, especially whether it moves directly to the bridge after the first chorus.

patterns.name: Key operations in terminal commands
patterns.context: Instructions say to enter cd, press the spacebar once, then paste a path; strong activation is near then and press.

patterns.name: Preparation and initial action before performing
patterns.context: A person takes out an instrument and arranges sheet music, then begins to play or practice introductory flourishes.

patterns.name: Marking word positions before and after in typography instructions
patterns.context: Explains transcription or typesetting conventions: a specific marker is placed before and after a word or phrase to indicate italics.

patterns.name: First and final verses in a song
patterns.context: Identifies which singers perform different verses in a song; triggers relate to ordinal numbers for verses and their order.

patterns.name: Follow-up content in song or track promotions
patterns.context: Promotes or introduces music content and prompts readers to follow a link to listen to a track; strong activation is concentrated near after the.

patterns.name: Introducing a lyrics quotation
patterns.context: Introduces a song and then its lyrics, followed by a colon and a lyric quotation.

patterns.name: Opening and section descriptions of a musical work
patterns.context: Discusses the first movement or opening of a work, describing its style, number of notes, and instrumental introduction.

9_2943.description: 激活集中于音乐、歌曲或书籍的开头、第一/最终段、前奏及内容引出，也出现在操作步骤和排版说明中的顺序与定位表达；共同点偏向定位、次序和起始阶段。

patterns.name: 章节或段落的开头
patterns.context: 处于描述书籍目录、卷册或章节结构的句子中，指明某一部分的开头。

patterns.name: 歌曲的开头乐段或歌词段
patterns.context: 谈论歌曲、录音或某首歌的具体编排，出现 opening verse；与泛指乐曲开头的语境不同。

patterns.name: 歌曲结构中的第一段
patterns.context: 叙述歌曲各段落的次序，尤其说明第一遍副歌之后是否直接进入桥段。

patterns.name: 终端命令中的按键操作
patterns.context: 操作说明要求输入 cd 后按一次空格，再粘贴路径；强激活落在 then 与 press 附近。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、电脑操作教程

patterns.name: 演奏前的准备和起始动作
patterns.context: 人物拿出乐器并摆好乐谱后，开始演奏或练习前奏性的装饰音。

patterns.name: 排版说明中标示词语前后位置
patterns.context: 解释转录或排版约定：特定标记放在一个词或短语之前及之后，用于表示斜体。
patterns.domain: 电子文本转录说明、排版规范

patterns.name: 歌曲中的第一段与最终段
patterns.context: 说明一首歌中不同段落由哪些歌手演唱；触发与 verse 的序数及段落次序相连。
patterns.domain: 流行音乐、嘻哈歌曲介绍

patterns.name: 歌曲或曲目发布宣传中的后续内容
patterns.context: 宣传或介绍音乐内容，提示读者点击跳转后收听曲目；强激活集中在 after the 附近。

patterns.name: 歌词引文的引出
patterns.context: 介绍歌曲后引出其歌词，后面接冒号和歌词引文。

patterns.name: 乐曲的开篇及乐段描述
patterns.context: 以作品的第一乐章或开头为对象，描述其风格、音符数量及器乐引子。
patterns.domain: 古典音乐分析、百科条目

en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly on expressions of position and order in musical works, especially combinations such as opening, first, final, and verse/song/track; also covers performance openings, lyrics, and performer information. Also includes the arrangement of book chapters and illustration indexes.

patterns.name: Passage/phrase position in a musical work
patterns.context: When discussing the structure of a song, album, musical piece, or book chapter, describes the opening, first passage, final passage, or other position; common triggers are combinations of opening, first, final, and verse/song/track/section/theme.
patterns.domain: Music reviews, song and album descriptions, book table-of-contents descriptions

patterns.name: Musical opening and performance action
patterns.context: Describes a performer beginning to play, or the instruments, rhythm, and musical motif at a work’s opening; specific instruments or musical terms may appear near opening.
patterns.domain: Narrative literature, music reviews, music analysis

patterns.name: Ordinal and structural markers
patterns.context: Uses ordinals or position words to mark the order of passages, singles, or sections within a work; not all examples involve lyric passages in songs.
patterns.domain: Music work descriptions, tables of contents, and section descriptions

patterns.name: Lyrics, song versions, and performer information
patterns.context: Introduces different versions of a song or its lyric structure, or indicates who sings each section; the seventh section assigns rap performers in order.

patterns.name: Entry positions in a contents list or illustration index
patterns.context: The arrangement of book description materials, illustrations, and chapters within volumes; not the same context as song structure.
patterns.domain: Gutenberg book text or editorial table-of-contents descriptions

patterns.name: The instrument or musical theme itself
patterns.context: Mentions a specific instrument, performance, or television theme music; may not contain explicit lyric-section structure.
patterns.domain: Literary narrative, music reviews, cultural commentary

9_2943.description: 激活主要集中在音乐作品结构的位置与顺序表达，尤以 opening、first、final 和 verse/song/track 等搭配为主；也覆盖演奏开场、歌词及演唱者信息。另有书籍章节与插图索引的排列位置。

patterns.name: 音乐作品中的段落/乐句位置
patterns.trigger: “first verse”“final verse”“opening verse”“first chorus”“opening track/song”“opening of the section”“opening theme”
patterns.context: 谈论歌曲、专辑、乐曲或书籍章节的结构时，出现作品或部分的开头、首段、末段等位置描述；常见触发词为 opening、first、final 与 verse/song/track/section/theme 等搭配。
patterns.domain: 音乐评论、歌曲与专辑介绍、书籍目录说明

patterns.name: 乐曲开场与演奏动作
patterns.trigger: “began to run through a few preliminary flourishes”“opening hi-hat”“opens with a five-note instrumental invocation”
patterns.context: 描述演奏者开始演奏，或作品开场的乐器、节奏及音乐动机；opening 附近可有具体乐器或音乐术语。
patterns.domain: 叙事文学、音乐评论与乐曲分析

patterns.name: 段落序数与结构标记
patterns.context: 以序数或位置词标记作品内部的段落、单曲或分部次序；并非所有例子都涉及歌曲的歌词段落。
patterns.domain: 音乐作品介绍、目录及分节说明

patterns.name: 歌词、歌曲版本及演唱者信息
patterns.trigger: “original version of the song”“more verses”“doesn’t go to the bridge”“rapped”“verse”
patterns.context: 介绍歌曲的不同版本、歌词结构，或说明各段由谁演唱；其中第7段按顺序分配 rap 演唱者。

patterns.name: 目录与插图索引中的条目位置
patterns.trigger: “included at the end”“listed in the Illustrations where their subjects would appear”“opening of the section”
patterns.context: 书籍说明材料、插图及章节在卷册中的排列位置；与歌曲结构并非同一语境。
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 书籍正文或编辑性目录说明

patterns.name: 乐器或音乐主题本身
patterns.trigger: “his handsome flute”“a piece of music”“the opening hi-hat”“opening theme”
patterns.context: 提及具体乐器、演奏或电视主题音乐；未必包含明确的歌词段落结构。
patterns.domain: 文学叙事、音乐评论、文化评论

en.description: Primarily responds to expressions such as opening/first that indicate the beginning, first section, or order of a work, especially in song and film/TV contexts; also covers local patterns involving performance openings, chapter beginnings, and tutorial operation order.

patterns.name: opening sequence in songs or media
patterns.context: “opening” combined with “verse,” “section,” “theme,” “hi-hat,” “credits” and similar terms refers to the opening part, theme song, or opening credits of a work.

patterns.name: first chorus / first verse
patterns.context: Describes song structure, mentioning the first chorus or opening verse and their order.

patterns.name: musical flourishes
patterns.context: Before a character begins playing an instrument, includes “began to run through” and a preparatory musical phrase.

patterns.name: opening credits / introduction
patterns.context: Introduces an episode’s opening, opening credits, or content after the credits.

patterns.name: Operation order in instructions
patterns.context: Gives a sequence of terminal-operation steps, including key presses, entering commands, and pasting a path.

patterns.name: More song sections
patterns.context: Compares the number of sections in different versions of a song or describes the arrangement after the chorus.

patterns.name: Rhythmic elements played at the beginning
patterns.context: Describes an instrumental track using opening hi-hat, shuffle, and bass.

patterns.name: Beginning of an index/chapter
patterns.context: Describes the beginning of a book or historical chapter and its organizational labels.
patterns.domain: Book tables of contents or reference descriptions

patterns.name: Final/last song and lyric position
patterns.context: Introduces album tracks and indicates that the lyrics occur in the song’s first section.

9_2943.description: 主要响应 opening/first 等表示作品开头、首段或先后顺序的表达，尤其在歌曲与影视语境；也覆盖演奏开场、章节开头和教程操作顺序等局部模式。

patterns.name: opening sequence in songs or media
patterns.context: “opening”与“verse,” “section,” “theme,” “hi-hat,” “credits”等搭配，指作品开头部分、主题曲或片头

patterns.name: first chorus / first verse
patterns.context: 描述歌曲结构，提到第一段副歌或开场诗节及其先后关系

patterns.name: musical flourishes
patterns.context: 人物开始演奏乐器前，出现“began to run through”及预备性演奏乐句

patterns.name: opening credits / introduction
patterns.context: 介绍每集开场、片头字幕或片头之后的内容

patterns.name: 操作指令中的步骤顺序
patterns.context: 连续给出终端操作步骤，包含按键、输入命令及粘贴路径

patterns.name: 较多/更多的歌曲段落
patterns.trigger: «many»4« more»4« verses»2；«doesn’t»4« go»2…« after»4« the»9« first»10« chorus»3
patterns.context: 比较歌曲版本的段落数量或说明副歌后的编排

patterns.name: 开头演奏的节奏元素
patterns.context: 以开头的 hi-hat、shuffle、bass 描写器乐曲音轨

patterns.name: 索引/章节的开头
patterns.context: 说明书籍或历史章节的开头及其编排标签
patterns.domain: 书籍目录或参考资料说明

patterns.name: 末尾/最终歌曲及歌词位置
patterns.context: 介绍专辑曲目，并指出歌词位于歌曲第一段

en.description: Primarily responds to the beginning and content of a work, chapter, or track, and also commonly appears in song structure and performance details; additionally covers book indexes, preparation to play in narrative, and a technical-operation instruction.

patterns.name: opening of a work or section
patterns.context: Describes the beginning of a song, episode, book section, musical piece, or other work; often followed by what it contains or how it sounds.

patterns.name: musical structure and performance detail
patterns.context: Mentions a song’s sectional structure or a musical passage’s instrumentation, style, or performance.
patterns.domain: Music reviews, narrative prose, encyclopedic writing

patterns.name: instructions involving a sequence of steps
patterns.context: A procedural sequence of user actions, with commands and interface labels.

patterns.name: historical volume cross-reference and cataloguing
patterns.context: Explains how material or illustrations are organized and cross-referenced in a book.

patterns.name: physical preparation before playing music
patterns.context: A character prepares an instrument and music stand, then starts playing.

patterns.name: proper-name or phrase continuation
patterns.context: Appears in a music-description passage, but the activation is not clearly explained by the broader opening/structure patterns.

9_2943.description: 主要响应作品、章节或曲目的开头及其内容，也常见于歌曲结构、演奏细节；另覆盖书籍索引、叙事中的演奏准备和一段技术操作指令。

patterns.name: opening of a work or section
patterns.context: Describes the beginning of a song, episode, book section, musical piece, or other work; often followed by what it contains or how it sounds.

patterns.name: musical structure and performance detail
patterns.context: Mentions a song’s sectional structure or a musical passage’s instrumentation, style, or performance.
patterns.domain: Music reviews, narrative prose, encyclopedic writing

patterns.name: instructions involving a sequence of steps
patterns.context: A procedural sequence of user actions, with commands and interface labels.

patterns.name: historical volume cross-reference and cataloguing
patterns.context: Explains how material or illustrations are organized and cross-referenced in a book.

patterns.name: physical preparation before playing music
patterns.context: A character prepares an instrument and music stand, then starts playing.

patterns.name: proper-name or phrase continuation
patterns.trigger: «The» in «The B-side» and «The Rhythm The Rebel»
patterns.context: Appears in a music-description passage, but the activation is not clearly explained by the broader opening/structure patterns.

en.description: Primarily responds to song or musical sections, order, and themes, and also activates on instrument performance, musical style, and promotional copy for works; local activations also occur at the beginnings of document sections and in terminal operation instructions.

patterns.name: Musical section structure
patterns.context: Discusses the composition, section order, repetition, and performance arrangement of songs or musical works, often using ordinal numbers, section names, or musical themes.
patterns.domain: Music introductions, reviews, and encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Musical performance and production
patterns.context: Describes musical style, instruments, rhythm, or performance; may not discuss song section structure.
patterns.domain: Music reviews, music-related narratives, and encyclopedias

patterns.name: Music publication and promotional information
patterns.context: Mentions upcoming music releases and how to preorder or listen to them.

patterns.name: Chapter openings outside music contents
patterns.context: «opening» refers to the start of a chapter in a book or document, not a song section.

patterns.name: Software operation steps
patterns.context: Guides users through copying a directory path from account settings and entering a command in the terminal.

9_2943.description: 主要响应歌曲或乐曲的段落、顺序与主题，也对乐器演奏、音乐风格及作品推广文案有激活；另见文献章节开头和终端操作说明中的局部激活。

patterns.name: 乐曲段落结构
patterns.trigger: «the»« opening» … «verse»、«the»« first»« chorus»、«the»« final» … «song»、«movement»、«initial»« melody»；以及 «after»« the»« first»« chorus»
patterns.context: 讨论歌曲或乐曲的组成、段落顺序、重复与演奏安排，常出现序数词、段落名称或音乐主题。
patterns.domain: 音乐介绍、评论及百科条目

patterns.name: 音乐表演与制作
patterns.context: 描述音乐风格、乐器、节奏或演奏过程；不一定谈论歌曲段落结构。
patterns.domain: 音乐评论、音乐相关叙事与百科

patterns.name: 音乐出版与推广信息
patterns.context: 提及即将发行的音乐作品及其预购、收听方式。

patterns.name: 非音乐目录中的章节开头
patterns.context: «opening»指书籍或文献中的章节起始处，而非歌曲段落。

patterns.name: 软件操作步骤
patterns.trigger: «open»« a»« terminal»、«type»« cd»、«press»« Space»« Bar»、«paste»« the»« path»
patterns.context: 按顺序指导用户在账户设置中复制目录路径并于终端输入命令。

en.description: Most passages describe the beginnings of musical works or programs, song sections, movements, and their order; others involve book chapter openings, terminal-operation steps, and flute-playing narratives. A shared tendency is the initial part of a sequence or progression through steps, though not all passages belong to the same topic.

patterns.name: open/opening section
patterns.context: Describes the beginning or introductory section of a book chapter, song/album, musical work, or television program, often followed by a noun specifying its content or position.
patterns.domain: Bibliographic descriptions, music reviews/encyclopedias, television program descriptions

patterns.name: Song sections and singing order
patterns.context: Discusses song structure, lyric sections, and the order of performers; includes versions with more verses and songs that do not go directly into the chorus bridge.

patterns.name: Describing work structure in sequence
patterns.context: Narrates the form, return of themes, and ending of each movement in a musical work in order.

patterns.name: Step-by-step instructions
patterns.context: Uses consecutive imperative steps to guide users through copying a path in account settings and operating in a terminal.

patterns.name: Instrument-playing actions and musical phrases
patterns.context: In a narrative, a character takes out a flute, sets up sheet music, and begins playing a preparatory ornamental phrase.

9_2943.description: 多数段落在描述音乐或节目作品的开头、歌曲段落、乐章及其顺序；另有书籍章节开篇、终端操作步骤和长笛演奏叙事。共同触发倾向是序列中的起始部分或按步骤展开，但并非所有段落都属同一主题。

patterns.name: open/开头部分
patterns.trigger: opening；opening of the section；opening verse；opening hi-hat；opening theme；opening credits
patterns.context: 描述书籍章节、歌曲/专辑、音乐作品、电视节目等的开头或引入部分，常紧接名词说明其内容或位置。
patterns.domain: 书目说明、音乐评论/百科、电视节目介绍

patterns.name: 歌曲段落与演唱顺序
patterns.context: 谈歌曲结构、歌词段落及演唱者先后；包括歌曲版本有更多诗节、歌曲不直接进入副歌桥段等。

patterns.name: 依次描述作品结构
patterns.context: 按顺序叙述音乐作品各乐章的形式、主题回归与结尾。

patterns.name: 逐步操作指令
patterns.trigger: open a terminal and type cd then press Space Bar once then paste
patterns.context: 以连续祈使步骤指导用户在账户设置中复制路径并于终端操作。

patterns.name: 器乐演奏动作与乐句
patterns.trigger: began to run through a few preliminary flourishes
patterns.context: 叙事中人物取出长笛、架好乐谱后开始演奏预备性装饰乐句。

en.description: Primarily responds to expressions for the beginning, first section, final section, and section positions in works or texts, especially song verse, chorus, and movement; also appears in performance preparation, opening instrumentation, operational steps, and technical document sections. The pattern is not fully uniform.

patterns.name: Structural position in a musical work or other work
patterns.context: Describes sections, movements, or sequence in songs, musical works, or other works; ordinal numbers often occur beside structural nouns such as verse, chorus, and movement, and include opening, first, and final.
patterns.domain: Music introductions, work descriptions, and encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Beginnings and sections in documents or books
patterns.context: Describes the chapters, beginning, or divisions of a book, article, or instructional material; nearby triggers include organizational terms such as section and volume.
patterns.domain: Book contents, academic or technical writing

patterns.name: Step-by-step operational instructions
patterns.context: Provides consecutive instructions describing how to open a tool, enter a command, press keys, or paste a path.

patterns.name: Preparation and start of a performance
patterns.context: Narrates someone arranging sheet music and beginning preliminary phrases before performing; activation is concentrated around began to run through and preliminary flourishes.

patterns.name: Assignment of rap parts in a song
patterns.context: Identifies which singers perform different verses in a song and specifies order using terms such as first and final.

patterns.name: Opening sounds or instrumental elements in a work
patterns.context: Uses opening to introduce the rhythm, instruments, or sound characteristics of a musical opening.

patterns.name: Starting item in a list
patterns.context: Mentions a work's opening verse in a record track-side or track-related description; the strong response here is on opening rather than the chapter terms in the main contexts.

9_2943.description: 主要响应表示作品或篇章中的开头、首段、末段及分节位置，尤其是歌曲的 verse、chorus、movement；另见演奏准备、开场配器、操作步骤及技术文档章节。模式并不完全统一。

patterns.name: 乐曲或作品中的结构位置
patterns.trigger: «the»5« first»10« chorus»3；«The»5« opening»10« verse»4；«The»5« first»5« verse»5；«the»6« final»9« verse»4；«the»7« first»9« verse»5；«The»2« first»4 of« the»1 piece«'s»3« four»5« movements»1
patterns.context: 描述歌曲、乐曲或作品的段落、乐章或先后位置，常见序数词与 verse、chorus、movement 等结构名词相邻；涉及 opening、first、final。
patterns.domain: 音乐介绍、作品说明与百科条目

patterns.name: 篇章或书籍的开头及分节
patterns.context: 说明书籍、文章或说明材料的章节、开头或分节；触发点附近出现 section、volume 等篇章组织词。
patterns.domain: 书籍目录说明、学术或技术写作

patterns.name: 按步骤给出的操作指令
patterns.trigger: «open»5« a»6« terminal»3 and»8« type»5 cd»1 then»8 press»5 Space»3 Bar»3 …« paste»4« the»4« path»1
patterns.context: 连续给出操作步骤，描述打开工具、输入命令、按键或粘贴路径。

patterns.name: 演奏前的准备与开始
patterns.trigger: «set»1« up»3« a»3 piece of music…«and»5« began»7« to»7« run»4« through»4« a»6« few»7« preliminary»9 flourishes»1
patterns.context: 叙述人物摆好乐谱并开始演奏前的预备性乐句；激活集中在 began to run through 与 preliminary flourishes 一带。

patterns.name: 歌曲中说唱部分的分配
patterns.context: 说明一首歌由哪些歌手演唱不同的 verse，并标明 first、final 等顺序。

patterns.name: 作品中的开场声音或乐器元素
patterns.context: 以 opening 引出音乐开场的节奏、乐器或声音特征。

patterns.name: 列表中的起始项目
patterns.context: 在唱片曲目侧或曲目相关描述中提到作品的开场 verse；这里的高响应落在 opening，而非主要语境中的章节术语。

en.concept: Proper nouns and formatted text fragments
en.description: Activations occur in conspicuous strings across diverse documents: numbers and base-arithmetic problems, Portuguese journal titles, personal names, headings, URLs/version numbers, and legal citations. There is no single stable semantic meaning; the shared feature appears to be sensitivity to proper nouns, formatted fragments, and heading-like text.

patterns.name: Numerical values in base-arithmetic problems
patterns.context: Numbers, base notation, and problem formatting in math problems or exercises; some numbers also occur in other formats.

patterns.name: Portuguese publication titles and proper nouns
patterns.context: Journal titles, institution names, and words split into subword fragments in bibliographic information for Portuguese-language journals or publications.

patterns.name: Repeated personal names
patterns.context: A personal name repeated consecutively in an entry or page, with line breaks between repetitions.

patterns.name: misconduct in a heading
patterns.context: A scientific misconduct investigation result presented as a heading, followed by a separator line.

patterns.name: Search/tutorial headings
patterns.context: Reader-facing search- or recommendation-style headings introducing tutoring for a Lithuanian precalculus course.

patterns.name: GitHub repository and version strings
patterns.context: A software version number and checksum/hash-like field following a GitHub repository path.

patterns.name: Compound terms and terminology in health insurance headings
patterns.context: A heading lists grandfathered/grandmothered and ACA-compliant health plans and discusses premium equivalence.

patterns.name: Legal citations, case names, and company names
patterns.context: Case/statutory citations, case names, and company names in legal materials; the text then identifies a company as foreign.

patterns.name: Web URLs and music event headings
patterns.context: A webpage excerpt strings together a site name, URL, event heading, and date information.

9_3053.concept: 专名与格式化文本片段
9_3053.description: 激活分布于多种文档中的醒目字符串：数字与进制题、葡语刊名、人名、标题、网址/版本号及法律引文等。没有单一稳定语义；共同点较像对专名、格式化片段和标题式文本敏感。

patterns.name: 进制算术题中的数值
patterns.context: 数学题或练习中的数字、进制表述及题目排版；部分数字也出现在其他格式中。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语刊物标题及专名
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语期刊或出版物书目信息中，刊名、机构名及词语被拆成子词片段。

patterns.name: 人名重复出现
patterns.context: 人名在条目或页面中连续重复，且换行分隔。

patterns.name: 标题中的 misconduct
patterns.context: 以标题形式出现的科学不端行为调查结果，后接分隔线。
patterns.domain: 医学/科研诚信页面标题

patterns.name: 搜索/教程标题
patterns.context: 面向读者的搜索或推荐式标题，介绍立陶宛微积分预备课程辅导。

patterns.name: GitHub仓库与版本字符串
patterns.context: GitHub仓库路径后接软件版本号及类似校验/哈希字段。

patterns.name: 医疗保险标题中的复合词与术语
patterns.context: 标题列举 grandfathered/grandmothered 与 ACA 合规健康计划，并讨论保费等价。

patterns.name: 法律引文、案名与公司名称
patterns.context: 法律材料中的判例/法条引文、案名及公司名称；正文随后说明其为外国公司。

patterns.name: 网页网址与音乐活动标题
patterns.context: 网页摘录把站点名称、网址、活动标题和日期信息串在一起。

en.description: Activations occur across diverse document fragments: prominent numbers and base-conversion problems, proper nouns and title subwords, formal title separators, web search copy, software versions, legal citations, and website activity information; no clear commonality.

patterns.name: Base markers in math problems
patterns.context: In arithmetic problems or exercises, a number follows base, often with a line break and a short numeric expression.

patterns.name: Word fragments in proper nouns or titles
patterns.context: In proper nouns, publication names, or titles, activation falls on subword fragments, often adjacent to mixed-case strings.

patterns.name: Document titles and separators
patterns.context: A formal document begins with a title, followed by a separator made of equal signs.

patterns.name: Search-style webpage titles
patterns.context: A webpage title or promotional phrase in the form “Find a … Tutor”.

patterns.name: Software repository paths and version numbers
patterns.context: A project name and dotted version number follow a code-hosting URL.

patterns.name: Legal citations and company names
patterns.context: A case or statute citation is followed by a company name written in uppercase letters and an explanation of its status.

patterns.name: Proper nouns in webpage links and event titles
patterns.context: Webpage fragments combine people’s names, URLs, event or content titles, and dates.

patterns.name: Number-and-punctuation identifier fragments
patterns.context: Short strings composed of numbers, punctuation, and line breaks; they also occur in legal numbering besides math problems, and their specific semantics are unstable.

9_3053.concept: 文档片段中的醒目字符串
9_3053.description: 激活分布于多种文档片段：突出数字与进制题、专名和标题子词、正式标题分隔线、网页搜索文案、软件版本、法律引文及网址活动信息；共同点不明确。

patterns.name: 数学题中的进制标记
patterns.context: 算术题或练习题中，base 后跟数字，常伴随换行和简短数字表达式。

patterns.name: 专名或标题中的分词片段
patterns.context: 专名、出版物名或标题中，激活落在词的子词片段上，常与大小写混合的字符串相邻。
patterns.domain: 百科、学术书目、医学标题

patterns.name: 文档标题与分隔线
patterns.context: 正式文档以标题起始，标题后接由等号组成的分隔线。

patterns.name: 搜索式网页标题
patterns.context: 以“Find a … Tutor”构成的网页标题或宣传语。

patterns.name: 软件仓库路径与版本号
patterns.context: 代码托管网址后跟项目名和点分版本号。

patterns.name: 法律引文与公司名称
patterns.context: 案件或法规引文后接以大写字母书写的公司名称及其身份说明。

patterns.name: 网页链接与活动标题中的专名
patterns.context: 网页片段混合人名、网址、活动或内容标题及日期。

patterns.name: 数字与标点构成的编号片段
patterns.context: 数字、标点及换行组成的短串；除数学题外也出现在法律编号中，具体语义不稳定。

en.description: Activations are scattered across subword fragments of English words, title openings, math base-conversion problems, Portuguese bibliographies, and medical paper terminology; there is no stable shared semantic theme, though title-like phrases and proper-noun segmentation appear locally.

patterns.name: Proper nouns and adjacent word fragments
patterns.context: Words are split into multiple subword tokens; this can occur in proper nouns, titles, or ordinary words, often with following text or a line break.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia, paper titles, ordinary English text

patterns.name: Numbers and base-conversion math problems
patterns.context: In base-related problems or equations, numbers, base markers, and questions are adjacent; fragments are short and contain line breaks.

patterns.name: Portuguese journal names
patterns.context: Occurs in Portuguese bibliographies or journal titles, with words split across tokens.

patterns.name: Research misconduct title
patterns.context: Presented in title case, followed by a separator and line break.

patterns.name: ANCA and nephritis terminology
patterns.context: Discusses antineutrophil cytoplasmic antibodies and their association with glomerulonephritis.

patterns.name: Antibiotic resistance and pathogens
patterns.context: In a public health context, describes rising resistance and the need to develop new treatments.

patterns.name: Openings of various titles or phrases
patterns.context: The beginning of an English title or body-text phrase; unrelated to a specific topic, and often a noun phrase in form.

9_3053.concept: none
9_3053.description: 激活分散于英文词的子词片段、标题开头、数学进制题、葡语书目及医学论文术语；没有稳定共享的语义主题，局部可见标题式短语和专名切分。

patterns.name: 专名及相邻词片段
patterns.context: 词被拆成多个子词 token；可出现在专名、标题或普通词中，且常伴随后续文本或换行。
patterns.domain: 维基百科、论文标题、普通英文文本

patterns.name: 数字与进制数学题
patterns.context: 进制相关题目或算式中，数字、进制标记及问句相邻；片段短且含换行。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语期刊名称
patterns.context: 出现在葡萄牙语书目或期刊标题中，词语跨 token 切分。

patterns.name: 科研不端标题
patterns.context: 以标题式大小写呈现，后接分隔线和换行。

patterns.name: ANCA与肾炎术语
patterns.context: 讨论抗中性粒细胞胞浆抗体及其与肾小球肾炎的关联。

patterns.name: 抗生素耐药与病原体
patterns.context: 公共卫生语境中阐述耐药上升及开发新疗法的必要性。

patterns.name: 各类标题或短语开头
patterns.context: 英文标题或正文短语的开头；与具体主题无关，形式上常是名词短语。

en.description: Activations are scattered across the initial fragments Autom, Find, Ald, val and Aldjon in names, and the chemical term aldehyde; they also respond to formatted ADA Events headings. Contexts and domains vary, with no unified semantic trigger condition apparent.

patterns.name: val in proper nouns
patterns.context: Occurs in the personal name Dorval, followed by Rodrig, and in the repeated name after a line break; activation is concentrated on a substring within the name.

patterns.name: Find at the beginning
patterns.context: A paragraph begins with Find, followed by a heading or directive phrase; one is a research integrity heading, the other webpage text seeking a tutor.

patterns.name: Autom at the beginning
patterns.context: Autom is a word-initial fragment followed by different words, such as automobile, automation, or automated; contexts are not fixed.

patterns.name: ADA Events heading
patterns.context: Both appear in a short, heading-like text, followed by a brace marker and an equals-sign separator line.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central document headings or formatted sections

patterns.name: Aldjon personal name
patterns.context: Triggered by the name Aldjon Pashaj, with the beginning of the name repeated after a line break.

patterns.name: Chemical term for aldehyde
patterns.context: Together they form aldehyde, followed by chemical terms such as allylation; the trigger is word-initial in technical text.

9_3053.concept: 特定词首与姓名片段
9_3053.description: 激活分散于词首片段 Autom、Find、Ald，以及姓名中的 val、Aldjon 和化学词 aldehyde；也响应 ADA Events 格式化标题。上下文和领域多样，未见统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 专名中的 val
patterns.context: 出现在人名 Dorval 中，后接 Rodrig，以及换行后的重复人名；激活集中在姓名内部的子串。

patterns.name: Find 开头
patterns.context: 段落以 Find 开头，后接标题或指令式短语；一个是研究诚信标题，一个是寻找家教的网页文本。

patterns.name: Autom 开头
patterns.context: Autom 是词首片段，后接 automobile、automation 或 automated 等不同词；上下文并不固定。
patterns.domain: 百科、研究文本、专利背景

patterns.name: ADA Events 标题
patterns.context: 二者出现在简短标题式文本中，随后是花括号标记和等号分隔线。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 文档标题或格式化栏目

patterns.name: Aldjon 人名
patterns.context: 触发于人名 Aldjon Pashaj，且换行后重复姓名开头。

patterns.name: 醛化学术词
patterns.context: 共同组成 aldehyde，后接 allylation 等化学术语；触发位于技术文本中的词首。
patterns.domain: PubMed 化学或生物医学摘要

en.description: Activations often occur on capitalized opening words in titles or phrases and structures linked by “of”; they also appear on title separators, research-progress collocations, and name fragments. Markers sometimes fall within words, and no single clear semantic theme emerges.

patterns.name: Title- or sentence-initial word fragments
patterns.context: Capitalized words at the beginning of titles, phrases, or sentences; may also activate only part of a word or combine with a following word.
patterns.domain: Academic titles, webpage titles, and other text

patterns.name: “of” prepositional phrases
patterns.context: Appears after a noun or title word and connects to a following noun phrase; common in academic titles but not limited to them.

patterns.name: Title case and separators
patterns.context: A title is followed by a line break or a separator made of equal signs; segment 3 also has a line break and repeated text, but the marked word is a name fragment.
patterns.domain: Titles, document formatting, and encyclopedia entries in the corpus

patterns.name: Middle fragment in a person’s name
patterns.context: Appears in the name Dorval, and the same name occurs repeatedly; other parts of the name are unmarked.

patterns.name: Research-progress collocation
patterns.context: A title begins with Progress of Researches on, followed by the research topic.

patterns.name: Special label or abbreviation
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a short document, followed by Events; its specific meaning cannot be determined from the fragment alone.

patterns.name: Irregular within-word or partial-word activation
patterns.context: Activation boundaries do not always align with complete words; besides the name in segment 3, this also occurs in words such as Findings and Knowledge.

9_3053.concept: 标题与词组边界线索
9_3053.description: 激活常见于标题或短语中的大写开头词及“of”连接结构，也见标题分隔符、研究进展搭配和姓名片段；标记有时落在词内，未形成单一明确语义主题。

patterns.name: 标题或句首词片段
patterns.context: 标题、短语或句子开头的大写词；也可能只激活词的一部分，或与后续词合成词。
patterns.domain: 学术标题、网页标题及其他文本

patterns.name: of 介词短语
patterns.context: 出现在名词或标题词之后，连接后续名词短语；常见于学术标题，但并非只限于此。

patterns.name: 标题式大小写与分隔符
patterns.context: 标题后换行或由等号组成的分隔线；段3也有换行和重复文本，但标记的词是姓名片段。
patterns.domain: 语料中的标题、文档格式及百科条目

patterns.name: 人名中间片段
patterns.context: 出现在姓名 Dorval 中，且同一姓名重复出现；其他姓名部分未标记。

patterns.name: 研究进展搭配
patterns.context: 标题中以 Progress of Researches on 开头，后接研究主题。

patterns.name: 特殊标签或缩写
patterns.context: 出现在短文档开头，后接 Events；无法仅凭片段判定其具体含义。

patterns.name: 不规则的词内或部分词激活
patterns.context: 激活边界不总与完整词一致；除段3的人名外，也见于 Findings、Knowledge 等词。

en.description: Activations are scattered across sentence-initial Find requests, mathematical slash and exponent expressions, and specific word fragments in biomedical, VR product, and automotive text; no clear shared trigger feature.

patterns.name: Search or request beginning with Find
patterns.context: Find appears at the beginning of a sentence, followed by a search target or math problem; one example is followed by “ings of Scientific Misconduct,” another by “a Lithonia Precalculus Tutor,” and a third asks in a sentence to “Find the common denominator.”
patterns.domain: Web text, academic text, and math problems

patterns.name: Fraction slashes and exponentiation
patterns.context: Numbers or operation structures on either side of slashes and exponentiation operators in complex algebraic expressions are marked; commonly found in simplification problems or answers spanning line breaks, sometimes with “assuming h/o is positive”.

patterns.name: Numbers in gene/protein family names
patterns.context: In PubMed abstracts, Association appears in an association description introduced by “between ...”; the number 8 occurs at the end of a gene/protein family name.

patterns.name: Virtual reality glasses product description
patterns.context: These words occur in the product description “This is virtual reality vr glasses works with smartphones...”, with the abbreviation VR split into marked fragments.

patterns.name: Internal fragment in Automobile and automotive topics
patterns.context: The word-initial Automobile is split into two marked fragments; one example is an association name, the other a statement about the everyday importance of driving automobiles.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries and NIH project text

9_3053.concept: none
9_3053.description: 激活分散于句首 Find 请求、数学斜杠与幂表达式，以及生物医学、VR 产品和汽车文本中的特定词片段；共同触发特征不明显。

patterns.name: Find 开头的检索或请求
patterns.context: 句首出现 Find，后接检索目标或数学问题；一个例子紧接着是「ings of Scientific Misconduct」，另一个是「a Lithonia Precalculus Tutor」，还有一个在句中要求「Find the common denominator」。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、学术文本及数学题

patterns.name: 分数斜杠及幂运算
patterns.context: 复杂代数表达式中，斜杠和幂运算符两侧的数字或运算结构被标记；常见于换行前后的化简题或答案，有时带有「assuming h/o is positive」。

patterns.name: 基因/蛋白家族名称中的数字
patterns.context: PubMed 摘要中，Association 出现在「between ...」引出的关联描述里；数字 8 出现在基因/蛋白家族名称末尾。

patterns.name: 虚拟现实眼镜产品描述
patterns.context: 这些词出现在「This is virtual reality vr glasses works with smartphones...」的产品描述中，VR 缩写被拆分标记。

patterns.name: Automobile 词内片段及汽车主题
patterns.context: 词首 Automobile 被拆成两个标记片段；一例是协会名称，另一例是汽车驾驶的日常重要性陈述。
patterns.domain: 百科条目与 NIH 项目文本

en.concept: Word-initial Sur subword fragment and digit-letter boundaries
en.description: Strong activations repeatedly fall on the word-initial fragment “Sur,” but the subsequent words have varied meanings. There are also punctuation and numbers in code, digit-letter combinations in medical names, and numeric forms in imaging terminology, with no unified semantic theme apparent.

patterns.name: Word-initial Sur subword fragment
patterns.context: Occurs at the beginning of English words, with subsequent letters completing different words; the following spelling and meaning are not fixed.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, NIH project text, and emails

patterns.name: Numbers and structured code
patterns.context: Braces, line breaks, quotation marks, keys, and numbers occur together in code or JSON-like fragments; activations are distributed across multiple punctuation marks and numbers.

patterns.name: Number and letter fragments in medical terminology
patterns.context: Terms or names contain numbers, separators, and letter fragments; not limited to cases with word-initial Sur.

patterns.name: Numeric imaging and measurement descriptions in medical text
patterns.context: Numbers occur next to letters, hyphens, and technical names in descriptions of imaging, radiotherapy, or examination methods.
patterns.domain: PubMed radiotherapy and medical imaging abstracts

9_3053.concept: 词首 Sur 子词片段及数字字母边界
9_3053.description: 强激活反复落在词首片段“Sur”，但后续词义各异；另见代码中的标点数字、医学名称中的数字字母组合，以及影像术语里的数字化表达，未见统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 词首 Sur 子词片段
patterns.context: 出现在英文单词开头，后续字母将其补成不同单词；后续拼写和语义并不固定。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、NIH 项目文本及邮件

patterns.name: 数字与结构化代码
patterns.context: 代码或类似 JSON 的片段中，花括号、换行、引号、键名和数字相邻；激活分布在多个标点及数字上。

patterns.name: 医学术语中的数字与字母片段
patterns.context: 术语或名称包含数字、分隔符与字母片段；并非只有词首 Sur 的情况。

patterns.name: 医学文本中的数字化影像与测量表述
patterns.context: 影像、放疗或检查方法描述中，数字与字母、连字符及技术名称相邻。
patterns.domain: PubMed 放射治疗与医学影像摘要

en.description: Activations are scattered across academic citation markers, numbers and numeric fragments, biomedical terminology, legal provisions, and mathematical, financial, and cosmological text; there is no stable semantic trigger condition that can explain all fragments.

patterns.name: Academic citations and reference markers
patterns.context: Author-year citations, reference links, and their HTML/XML markup in the body of papers; activations cluster near years, reference numbers, and markup substrings.

patterns.name: Numbering of legal provisions
patterns.context: Provision numbers occur next to legal terminology in discussions of regulations or cases; activation is strongest within the clause numbers.

patterns.name: Numeric fragments within values or identifiers
patterns.context: Numbers are embedded in hyphens, punctuation, words, or structured identifiers; contexts vary, possibly reflecting independent responses to numbers/token fragments.

patterns.name: Biomedical research terminology
patterns.context: Specialized vocabulary in biological, medical, or health research abstracts/papers; this pattern occurs in multiple passages, but the triggering terms vary.

patterns.name: Letter selection in probability problems
patterns.context: Problems ask for a number of letters to be drawn from a set and the probability calculated; letters and numerical values are interspersed.

patterns.name: Pension and financial commentary
patterns.context: Commentary discussing pension liabilities, discount rates, or smoothing.

patterns.name: Cosmology and turbulence descriptions
patterns.context: Theoretical text discussing cosmological perturbations and primordial turbulence.

9_3053.concept: none
9_3053.description: 激活分散在学术引文标记、编号与数字片段、生物医学术语、法律条文，以及数学、财经和宇宙学文本中；没有足以统一解释全部片段的稳定语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 学术引文与参考文献标记
patterns.context: 论文正文中的作者—年份引文、参考文献链接及其 HTML/XML 标记；激活集中在年份、文献编号和标记子串附近。
patterns.domain: 学术论文，尤其生物医学文献

patterns.name: 法律条文编号
patterns.context: 法规或判例讨论中，条文编号与法律术语相邻；激活在条款编号内部最强。

patterns.name: 数值或编号内部的数字片段
patterns.context: 数字嵌在连字符、标点、词语或结构化编号中；各处语境不同，可能是对数字/分词片段的独立响应。

patterns.name: 生物医学研究术语
patterns.context: 生物、医学或健康研究摘要/论文中的专业词汇；该模式在多段出现，但触发词并不一致。

patterns.name: 概率题中的字母抽取
patterns.context: 要求从字母集合中抽取若干字母并计算概率的题目；字母与数值穿插出现。

patterns.name: 养老金与财务评论
patterns.context: 讨论养老金负债、折现率或平滑处理的评论性文字。

patterns.name: 宇宙学与湍流描述
patterns.trigger: “cosmological fluctuations”、“fossilized turbulence”、“static images of primordial turbulence”
patterns.context: 讨论宇宙学扰动及原初湍流的理论性文字。

en.description: Activations are distributed across different academic corpora: numerals, brackets, and terminology fragments in headings, and words for experiments, diseases, development, and mechanisms in body text. No stable, unified semantic trigger condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Numeral several in headings
patterns.context: In academic headings, several precedes a research subject or category, and the token several has the strongest activation.

patterns.name: Numeral three in headings
patterns.context: In headings, three precedes a research subject, such as brain damaged children; also occurs in abstract text describing three particle types.

patterns.name: Numeral a in headings
patterns.context: An indefinite article introduces a quantity or research subject in a heading or body text, as in a mutant or a 4-year pilot study.

patterns.name: Opening brackets and term tokenization in headings
patterns.context: Academic headings beginning with a bracket; numerals and technical terms are split into multiple tokens, with activations on these fragments.

patterns.name: Words describing research subjects or experimental steps
patterns.context: Heading-like noun phrases contain of, method names, or experimental materials; multiple local word fragments show positive activation.

patterns.name: Expressions of developmental time spans
patterns.context: A sequence of time stages describing embryonic development, with several modifying hours.

patterns.name: Academic noun phrases and citations in body text
patterns.context: Paragraph openings or citation narratives describe mutant identification and research history; activating words are scattered across general academic expressions.

patterns.name: Mechanistic descriptions in numbered entries
patterns.context: Numbered entries or experimental result descriptions discuss detection activity, inhibitors, and pathways.

patterns.name: Abstract labels and particle physics expressions
patterns.context: After an abstract label, We study introduces research on the production of gauge bosons.

patterns.name: Treatment and outcome statements in headings
patterns.context: A heading summarizes treatment side effects and outcomes and includes a multi-year pilot study description.

patterns.name: Pathways, cytokines, and phosphorylation mechanisms
patterns.context: Body text describes inflammatory factors in the joints of RA patients and compensatory mechanisms in MAPK signaling pathways.

patterns.name: Receptor regulation and gene expression mechanisms
patterns.context: Body text proposes hypotheses about receptor localization, dimerization, and removal of regulatory regions.

9_3053.concept: 学术文本片段特征
9_3053.description: 激活分布于不同学术语料：标题中的数词、方括号及术语片段，以及正文中的实验、疾病、发育和机制词语；未见稳定统一的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 标题中的数词 several
patterns.context: 学术标题中，several 后接研究对象或类别，且 token several 激活最强。

patterns.name: 标题中的数词 three
patterns.context: 标题中 three 后接研究对象，如 brain damaged children；也见于摘要正文中描述三种粒子。

patterns.name: 标题中的数词 a
patterns.context: 标题或正文中以不定冠词引出数量或研究对象，如 a mutant、a 4-year pilot study。

patterns.name: 标题起始方括号及术语分词
patterns.context: 方括号开头的学术标题；数词、专业词被拆成多个 token，激活落在这些片段上。

patterns.name: 描述研究对象或实验步骤中的词语
patterns.context: 标题式名词短语中出现 of、方法名或实验材料；多个局部词片段均有正激活。

patterns.name: 发育时间跨度的表达
patterns.trigger: « first»6« several»9« hours»2« of»5« its»1« development»2
patterns.context: 描述胚胎发育过程的连续时间阶段，several 修饰 hours。

patterns.name: 正文中的学术名词短语与引用
patterns.trigger: «↵»1↵«The»1« identification»1« of»5« mutants»2；« on»8« the»5« identification»3
patterns.context: 段落开头或引文叙述中，描述突变体鉴定及研究史；激活词分散在一般学术表达中。
patterns.domain: 植物脂质代谢综述/研究背景

patterns.name: 编号条目中的机制说明
patterns.context: 带编号的条目或实验结果描述，谈到检测活性、抑制剂和通路。

patterns.name: 摘要标签与粒子物理表达
patterns.trigger: «abstract»2«:»3；« We»4 study»3« the»4« production»4« of»5« three»9« gauge»4« bosons»2
patterns.context: 摘要标签后以 We study 引入研究内容，涉及规范玻色子产生。

patterns.name: 标题中的治疗与结果表述
patterns.trigger: «Rad»3«iation»4« side»2« effects»3« of»6« neutron»3« and»6« photon»2« therapy»2；« Results»4« of»6« a»9
patterns.context: 标题总结治疗副作用和结果，并带有年限试点研究表述。
patterns.domain: 肿瘤放疗医学摘要标题

patterns.name: 通路、细胞因子与磷酸化机制
patterns.trigger: « two»6« cytokines»3；« elevated»4« in»4« the»3 joints»4；« phosphorylation»2
patterns.context: 正文说明 RA 患者关节中的炎症因子及 MAPK 信号通路补偿机制。

patterns.name: 受体调控与基因表达机制
patterns.trigger: « the»2« regulation»5« of»5« D»2«RE»2« responsive»4« genes»1；« nuclear»2« localization»1
patterns.context: 正文提出受体定位、二聚化及调控区域移除等机制假说。
patterns.domain: 分子内分泌/基因调控项目摘要

en.concept: English articles and local patterns in research text
en.description: Activations most prominently fall on the indefinite article a, and more weakly on the; there are also ArXiv bibliography-format markers and scattered biomedical terminology fragments. The remaining word fragments lack consistent trigger conditions.

patterns.name: Content following an article
patterns.context: Activation falls on the indefinite article a, followed by a noun or noun phrase; the specific nouns vary across passages.

patterns.name: The article the
patterns.context: Activation falls on the definite article the in ordinary English sentences or paper titles; weaker than several instances of a.
patterns.domain: Scientific paper body text and headings

patterns.name: Heading or bibliographic formatting
patterns.context: Activation appears near ArXiv YAML/Markdown-style bibliographic fields, line breaks, quotation marks, and punctuation; whether the formatting itself triggers it is uncertain.

patterns.name: Proper nouns and biomedical terminology fragments
patterns.context: These activations are scattered across contexts involving viral receptors, microscopic analysis, membrane preparation, enzymes, genetic diseases, HLA alleles, and cancer drugs; there is no unified terminology class, and most are internal word fragments.

9_3053.concept: 英文冠词及科研文本局部模式
9_3053.description: 激活最显著地落在不定冠词 a，较弱地落在 the；另见ArXiv书目格式标记及分散的生物医学术语词片段。其余词片段缺少一致触发条件。

patterns.name: 冠词后续内容
patterns.context: 激活落在不定冠词 a 上，后面接名词或名词短语；各段具体名词不同。
patterns.domain: 跨学科论文摘要与元数据

patterns.name: 冠词 the
patterns.context: 激活落在定冠词 the 上，出现在普通英文句子或论文标题中；强度低于若干 a 实例。

patterns.name: 标题或书目信息格式
patterns.context: 激活出现在 ArXiv 的 YAML/Markdown 风格书目字段及换行、引号、标点附近；是否由格式本身触发不确定。

patterns.name: 专名及生物医学术语片段
patterns.context: 这些激活散布于病毒受体、显微分析、膜制备、酶、遗传病、HLA 等位基因及癌症药物等语境；没有统一的术语类别，且多为词内片段。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文摘要与科研文本

en.description: The most prominent cue is and, often occurring in coordination, classification, or method lists in research text; however, high-activation positions are scattered, with isolated phrases such as chemically induced and para-substituted. No recognizable corresponding trigger structure is apparent in passage 10.

patterns.name: Conjunction and
patterns.context: Occurs in coordination, lists, or when linking two research subjects/actions; the strongest activation centers on and itself, with no stable condition involving specific adjacent words.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain research abstracts and project descriptions

patterns.name: Chemical mutagenesis phrase
patterns.context: Describes spontaneous or chemically induced mutations, with or followed by chemically induced mutants.

patterns.name: Cell promoter lists
patterns.context: And links two types of promoters in a comparison of viral and cellular promoters.

patterns.name: Aromatic ring substitution positions
patterns.context: Discusses chemical reactions involving meta- and para-substituted phenols.

patterns.name: Lipoprotein category lists
patterns.context: And links homologous and heterologous lipoprotein particles, which are compared by density category later in the text.

patterns.name: Coordination of tissues and species
patterns.context: Lists mouse and human tissues, as well as normal and diseased tissues.

patterns.name: Coordination of immune response conditions
patterns.context: Discusses antibody responses to T-dependent and T-independent antigens in coordination.

patterns.name: Lists of recent regulatory events
patterns.context: When listing conference topics, and introduces a recent and unexpected FDA inspection report.

patterns.name: Lists of cohorts and statistical methods
patterns.context: Genetic analyses coordinate single-variant analysis with gene-level aggregated analysis.

9_3053.concept: 科研文本中的并列连接
9_3053.description: 最显著线索是 and，常处于科研文本的并列、分类或方法列举中；但高激活位置分散，另有 chemically induced、para-substituted 等孤立短语。第10段未见可辨认的对应触发结构。

patterns.name: 连接词 and
patterns.trigger: and（[1] 中为 «and»10；其余多处也有 «and»）
patterns.context: 出现在并列结构、列举或连接两个研究对象/动作时；最强激活集中在 and 本身，未见稳定的特定邻接词条件。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的科研摘要与项目描述

patterns.name: 化学诱导突变短语
patterns.context: 描述自发突变或化学诱导突变，or 后接 chemically induced mutants。

patterns.name: 细胞启动子列举
patterns.context: 在比较病毒与细胞启动子时，and 连接两类启动子。
patterns.domain: 基因治疗/分子生物学摘要

patterns.name: 芳香环取代位置
patterns.context: 讨论间位与对位取代酚参与的化学反应。

patterns.name: 脂蛋白类别列举
patterns.context: and 连接同源与异源脂蛋白颗粒，后文按密度类别比较。
patterns.domain: 脂质代谢/内分泌研究项目

patterns.name: 组织与物种并列
patterns.context: 列举小鼠与人类组织，以及正常与病变组织。

patterns.name: 免疫应答条件并列
patterns.context: 并列讨论 T 依赖与 T 非依赖抗原的抗体应答。

patterns.name: 近期监管事件列举
patterns.context: 在列举会议议题时，and 引出近期且意外的 FDA 检查报告。
patterns.domain: 药品监管/免疫原性会议记录

patterns.name: 队列与统计方法列举
patterns.context: 遗传学分析中并列单变异分析与基因层面的聚合分析。

en.description: The main pattern is and connecting coordinated research subjects, groups, time points, regions, or modifiers, often with the coordinated items also activating. A few activations fall on subword segments containing and and other local collocations, which cannot be assigned to a unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: Coordinated items linked by and
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on the coordinating conjunction and, especially when it links two research groups, categories, time points, regions, or mutually modifying phrases; sometimes the following coordinated item activates as well.
patterns.domain: Research abstracts, research plans, and scientific papers; also business emails; covers [1]–[10]

patterns.name: and string within specific words
patterns.context: The activated token resembles or is adjacent to the literal form and, but is not always a grammatical coordinating conjunction; it may reflect a local string feature caused by subword segmentation.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research plans and abstracts; covers [1], [5], [6]

patterns.name: Weaker cross-word or contextual activation
patterns.context: These locations do not all correspond to and; activations are scattered across prepositions, common collocations, time expressions, or adjacent contexts, with no stable shared trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Research abstracts, research plans, and business emails; covers [1]–[4], [7]–[10]

9_3053.concept: 并列连接词 and
9_3053.description: 主要模式是 and 连接并列研究对象、组别、时间点、地区或修饰语，常连同并列项激活；另有少数激活落在含 and 的子词切分及其他局部搭配上，无法归入统一的语义条件。

patterns.name: and 连接的并列项
patterns.trigger: “and”及其后紧接的名词或短语，如 “DR and Control”“six- and 15-month”“US and Chinese”“global and tissue-specific”“17 HCCs”“peer-developed and peer-led”
patterns.context: 激活集中在并列连接词 and，尤其连接两个研究组、类别、时间点、地区或相互修饰的短语；有时连同后续并列项一起激活。
patterns.domain: 科研摘要、研究计划、科学论文，也见商业邮件；覆盖 [1]–[10]

patterns.name: 特定词内的 and 字符串
patterns.trigger: “and”嵌在词内或跨 token 拆分处，例如 “rhesus”被标成“r”“hes”“us”、“vertebrate and invertebrate”附近的“in”“verte”“brate”，以及 “Combating”中的“Comb”“ating”
patterns.context: 激活 token 与 and 的字面形式相似或邻近，但不总是语法上的并列连接词；可能是子词切分造成的局部字符串特征。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究计划及摘要；覆盖 [1]、[5]、[6]

patterns.name: 较弱的跨词或上下文激活
patterns.trigger: 零散标记包括 “in this”“course of”“recent and unexpected”“sodium cation interactions with”“over 6 months”及“study on”
patterns.context: 这些位置不都对应 and；激活分散在介词、常见搭配、时间表达或相邻语境中，缺少稳定共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 科研摘要、研究计划及商务邮件；覆盖 [1]–[4]、[7]–[10]

en.concept: Mixed English structures and research contexts
en.description: Activations are scattered across English function words, coordination and quantity expressions, as well as biomedical research, regulation, sports contracts, and mathematical text. Research passages often contain methods, experiments, and technical terminology, but cannot be reduced to a single theme.

patterns.name: English function words and conjunctions
patterns.context: These high-frequency function words occur in varied positions in sentences, phrases, or headings; sometimes they are followed by technical nouns or quantity expressions. The available passages do not establish which specific word or position is necessary.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English prose, abstracts, and headings

patterns.name: Coordination and lists
patterns.context: Coordinates nouns, research subjects, methods, or properties; also occurs in lists of research scope or biological activities.
patterns.domain: Research abstracts, project descriptions, and general English narrative

patterns.name: Quantities, years, and time spans
patterns.context: Numbers or time/money expressions are embedded in narrative; passage 2 emphasizes contract amount and duration, passage 3 describes cell generations, and passage 5 mentions a year.
patterns.domain: Sports business reporting, research plans, and regulatory discussions

patterns.name: Biomedical and life science terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in technical contexts involving cells, diseases, drugs, experiments, or biological mechanisms; terms are widely distributed, with no single unified topic apparent.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts and NIH project text

patterns.name: Research design, methods, and evidence statements
patterns.context: Describes research methods, observations, analyses, experiments, or results; common in grant applications and abstract body text.
patterns.domain: Research project text and paper abstracts

patterns.name: Legal and regulatory expressions
patterns.context: Involves legal issues, regulatory agencies, or inspection records; passage 2 is a boxing contract report, and passage 5 is a drug regulation discussion.
patterns.domain: Sports business reporting and drug regulation abstracts

patterns.name: Adjacent proper nouns or abbreviations
patterns.context: Activation markers fall on proper nouns, abbreviations, or their tokenized fragments; this may reflect word-fragment boundaries or adjacent context, but the available examples are insufficient to establish a shared meaning.

patterns.name: Exponents and symbols in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Occurs in polynomial definitions or algebraic expressions, with activation markers covering exponent symbols, operators, and numeric fragments.

patterns.name: Sports figures and contract narratives
patterns.context: Describes signing, a boxer's age, number of fights, and contract amount; semantically distinct from research text.

9_3053.concept: 英文结构与科研语境混合
9_3053.description: 激活散见于英文功能词、并列和数量表达，以及生物医学科研、监管、体育合同和数学文本；科研段落常含方法、实验与专业术语，但不足以归结为单一主题。

patterns.name: 英语功能词与连接词
patterns.trigger: « of», « and», « in», « to», « on», « as», « over»
patterns.context: 这些高频功能词出现在句子、短语或标题的多种位置；有时后接专业名词或数量表达。仅凭现有片段无法确定哪一个具体词或位置是必要条件。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英文散文、摘要与标题

patterns.name: 并列与列举结构
patterns.trigger: « and»、« as well as»，以及由逗号分隔的并列项
patterns.context: 并列连接名词、研究对象、方法或性质；也见于多项研究范围或生物活性清单。
patterns.domain: 科研摘要、项目说明及一般英文叙述

patterns.name: 数量、年份与时间跨度
patterns.context: 数字或时间/金额表达嵌在叙述中；第2段强调合同金额和年限，第3段描述细胞世代，第5段提及年份。
patterns.domain: 体育商业报道、科研计划与监管讨论

patterns.name: 生物医学与生命科学术语
patterns.trigger: « T»« cells»、« metabol»«omic»、« immun»«ogenicity»、« Kle»«bs»«iella»、« cardiovascular»、« influenza»、« JNK»
patterns.context: 出现在细胞、疾病、药物、实验或生物学机制的专业语境中；词项分布很广，未见统一的单一主题。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要与 NIH 项目文本

patterns.name: 研究设计、方法与证据表述
patterns.trigger: « use»、« monitoring»、« investigate»、« analysis»、« studies»、« experiments»、« results»
patterns.context: 描述研究方法、观察、分析、实验或研究结果；多见于项目申请和摘要正文。
patterns.domain: 科研项目文本与论文摘要

patterns.name: 法律与监管相关表述
patterns.trigger: « history of legal problems»、« US»« FDA»、« Form 483s»
patterns.context: 涉及法律问题、监管机构或检查记录；第2段是拳击合同报道，第5段是药物监管讨论。
patterns.domain: 体育商业报道与药品监管摘要

patterns.name: 专名或缩写邻接
patterns.context: 激活标记落在专名、缩写或其分词片段上；可能反映词片段边界或邻接上下文，现有例子不足以确定共同语义。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的幂与符号
patterns.context: 出现在多项式定义或代数表达式中，激活标记覆盖幂符号、运算符及数字片段。

patterns.name: 体育人物与合同叙述
patterns.trigger: « an»、« a»、« over»，并处于“Mayweather”“contract”“$250 million”等词的邻近语境
patterns.context: 描述签约、拳手年龄、比赛次数和合同金额；与科研文本的语义模式不同。

en.description: The most stable trigger is over, often indicating a span of time, scale, or range (e.g., over time, over a larger scale, over the next weeks); it also appears capitalized as a title word in a novel’s table of contents. The remaining sporadic activations are difficult to unify.

patterns.name: Repeated occurrences of over
patterns.context: The token over itself is marked in various phrases, especially in “over + time/range/scale”; adjacent words vary.
patterns.domain: Across academic abstracts, news, and table-of-contents titles

patterns.name: Chapter title with a plural noun
patterns.context: A chapter title begins with capitalized “OVER”, followed by “THE GARDEN WALL”.

patterns.name: Other activations that cannot be grouped
patterns.context: These sporadic markers occur in literature metadata, cell research, environmental research, project evaluation, and section titles; there is no stable shared local trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Mixed: academic texts, project summaries, news, novel table of contents

9_3053.concept: over（跨越/在……期间）
9_3053.description: 最稳定的触发是 over，常用于表示跨越时间、尺度或范围（如 over time、over a larger scale、over the next weeks）；另在小说目录中大写作标题词。其余零散激活难以统一解释。

patterns.name: over 的重复出现
patterns.context: 词元 over 自身在多种短语中被标记，尤其出现在 “over + 时间/范围/尺度” 中；相邻词并不固定。
patterns.domain: 跨学术摘要、新闻、目录标题

patterns.name: 复数名词的章节标题
patterns.context: 以大写 “OVER” 开头的章节标题，后接 “THE GARDEN WALL”。

patterns.name: 无法归并的其他激活
patterns.context: 这些零散标记分别出现在文献元数据、细胞研究、环境研究、项目评估及分节标题中；没有稳定的共同局部触发条件。
patterns.domain: 混合：学术文本、项目摘要、新闻、小说目录

en.concept: Common words and terminology in academic text
en.description: Activations are scattered across high-frequency function words in academic discourse, infection and medical research vocabulary, trial and research phrases, and also gene terminology, disease abbreviations, and literary catalog headings; they cannot be reduced to a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Fixed phrases in medical papers
patterns.context: These high-frequency function words occur in academic sentences or headings, often near phrases about methods, subjects, relationships, or research results; triggering words vary across passages.

patterns.name: Infection and pathogen research vocabulary
patterns.context: Occurs in discussions of infection, microorganisms, or anti-infective drugs; some triggers may be pathogen names or infection-related words.

patterns.name: Phrases for research subjects and project types
patterns.context: Clinical trial or study protocol contexts describing pilot studies, follow-up validation, or ancillary studies.

patterns.name: Directional word in a chapter heading
patterns.context: Occurs in a book table-of-contents-style chapter heading titled “OVER THE GARDEN WALL”.

patterns.name: Specific term fragment se(v)
patterns.context: Text about Drosophila gene se(v) transcription and genetic research; tokenization makes the term appear fragmented.

patterns.name: Disease abbreviation and symptom phrases
patterns.context: Discusses clinical symptoms of Alzheimer's disease, brain changes, and the relationship to peripheral lipids.

patterns.name: Respiratory rehabilitation driving intervention
patterns.context: Describes whether intervention effects transfer to on-road driving and proposes a Phase III trial.

patterns.name: Lung injury and clinical trial abbreviations
patterns.context: Involves infection-related acute lung injury/ARDS and an ancillary trial study.

patterns.name: Mitochondrial mechanism research
patterns.context: Examines mitochondrial fission and glucose-stimulated insulin secretion following acute Drp1 inhibition.

patterns.name: Retraction notice and literature citation
patterns.context: A retraction notice is followed by citation details for a microarray paper on parasitic infection.

patterns.name: Susceptibility testing and mold terminology
patterns.context: Reviews endpoint data from in vitro antifungal drug susceptibility testing.

patterns.name: Research relationships and interactions
patterns.context: Discusses the relationship between lipids and disease progression, or interactions among virulence factors.

9_3053.concept: 学术文本中的常见词与术语
9_3053.description: 激活分散于学术语篇中的高频功能词、感染与医学研究词汇、试验和研究短语，也包括基因术语、疾病缩写及文学目录标题；无法归结为单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 医学论文中的固定短语
patterns.context: 这些高频功能词出现在学术句子或标题中，常位于方法、对象、关系或研究结果等短语附近；不同段触发词并不一致
patterns.domain: 生物医学及 NIH 项目摘要

patterns.name: 感染与病原体研究词汇
patterns.context: 讨论感染、微生物或抗感染药物时出现，部分触发可能落在病原体名称或感染相关词上
patterns.domain: 感染病学、微生物学、药理学

patterns.name: 研究对象与项目类型短语
patterns.context: 临床试验或研究方案语境，描述试点研究、后续验证或附属研究

patterns.name: 章节标题中的方位词
patterns.context: 出现在书籍目录式章节标题中，标题为“OVER THE GARDEN WALL”

patterns.name: 特定术语片段 se(v)
patterns.context: 围绕果蝇基因 se(v) transcription 及遗传学研究的文字；标记切分使术语呈碎片形式

patterns.name: 疾病缩写与症状短语
patterns.context: 讨论阿尔茨海默病临床症状、脑部改变及外周脂质关系

patterns.name: 呼吸康复驾驶干预
patterns.context: 描述干预效果能否迁移到道路驾驶，并提出 Phase III 试验

patterns.name: 肺损伤与临床试验缩写
patterns.context: 涉及感染相关急性肺损伤/ARDS及试验附属研究

patterns.name: 线粒体机制研究
patterns.context: 急性抑制 Drp1 后考察线粒体分裂与葡萄糖刺激胰岛素分泌
patterns.domain: 细胞生物学与代谢研究

patterns.name: 撤稿通知与文献引文
patterns.context: 撤稿声明后接微阵列寄生虫感染论文的引文信息
patterns.domain: 期刊编辑信息/文献记录

patterns.name: 药敏测试与霉菌术语
patterns.context: 综述抗真菌药物体外药敏测试的终点数据

patterns.name: 研究关系与交互作用
patterns.context: 讨论脂质与疾病进展的关系，或毒力因子的相互作用

en.description: Activations are scattered across prepositions and quantity expressions (on, over, nearly), the academic-context phrase “in this”, and a few with phrases; some passages only show local word-form matches and are difficult to fit to a stable unified rule.

patterns.name: Objects or topics introduced by “on”
patterns.context: The preposition on is followed by a research subject, data material, or technical topic; it is sometimes preceded by a treatment, evaluation, or research description.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, engineering papers, and related technical texts

patterns.name: Degree or range words followed by quantities
patterns.context: Describes nearing a state or covering a quantity, duration, or range; a numerical or quantitative expression immediately follows the trigger word.
patterns.domain: News reports, international affairs, research funding, and medical dosage descriptions

patterns.name: “in this” research context
patterns.context: A fixed academic expression referring to the current study or experimental model; this is especially prominent.

patterns.name: Other local research expressions
patterns.context: Prepositional phrases in research or reporting, but with no stable, consistent following element in the samples.

9_3053.concept: 介词短语与范围表达
9_3053.description: 激活分散于介词与数量表达（on、over、nearly）、学术语境的“in this”，以及少量with短语；部分段落只有局部词形吻合，难以归入稳定统一规则。

patterns.name: “on”引出的对象或主题
patterns.trigger: «on»，如“therapy on influenza”“endpoints on these drugs”“on 89 CT images”“on the attitude control”
patterns.context: 介词 on 后接研究对象、数据材料或技术主题；有时前面是治疗、评估或研究描述。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、工程论文及相关技术文本

patterns.name: 程度或范围词接数量表达
patterns.trigger: «nearly» 后接“un stoppable path”或“six-year”；«over» 后接“9 protocols”或“4 hours”
patterns.context: 描述接近某状态或覆盖一段数量、时长、范围；触发词后紧跟数值或数量性表达。
patterns.domain: 新闻报道、国际事务、科研资助及医学剂量描述

patterns.name: “in this”研究语境
patterns.context: 指向当前研究或实验模型的固定学术表达；this 尤为突出。

patterns.name: 其他局部科研表达
patterns.context: 科研或报道中的介词短语，但在样本中没有稳定一致的后续成分。

en.concept: Signal and framing words in scientific text
en.description: Activation is concentrated on this in research narratives (especially in this study/population), a after a colon in titles, and over in expressions of longer time spans. Several other sporadic local terms appear, with no stable shared context.

patterns.name: this study context
patterns.context: this is marked in phrases such as “in this study” or the extended “in this population” in methods or research-results narratives; study itself does not necessarily activate.

patterns.name: Colon and article in titles
patterns.context: In medical paper titles, the article a after a colon activates most strongly; the colon also activates. The text before the colon is often the topic or study design.

patterns.name: Time span of research results or objectives
patterns.context: over activates in expressions of time span describing long-term follow-up or project duration.

patterns.name: Unexplained local academic collocations
patterns.context: These highly activating words occur in different local collocations, and the samples do not establish a shared trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, imaging studies, and project descriptions

9_3053.concept: 科研文本中的指示与框架词
9_3053.description: 激活主要集中于研究叙述中的 this（尤见 in this study/population）、标题冒号后的 a，以及表示较长时间跨度的 over；另有若干分散的局部词项，未见稳定共同上下文。

patterns.name: this study 上下文
patterns.context: 方法或研究结果叙述中，短语 “in this study” 或扩展的 “in this population” 中的 this 被标记；study 本身未必激活。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文与研究计划

patterns.name: 标题中的冒号与冠词
patterns.context: 医学论文标题中，冒号后的冠词 a 激活最强，冒号也激活；冒号前常是主题或研究设计。

patterns.name: 研究结果或目标的时间跨度
patterns.context: 描述长期随访或项目历时，over 在时间跨度表达中激活。

patterns.name: 未解释的局部学术搭配
patterns.context: 这些高激活词各处于不同局部搭配中，无法从样本确认共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、影像学研究与项目说明

en.concept: Methods and subject descriptions in research abstracts
en.description: Activations are scattered across medical abstracts and project descriptions: they include “in this study”, research-design/context phrases in titles, prepositional structures introducing target subjects, fungal susceptibility testing, and disease-intervention titles; no single stable trigger pattern is evident.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase “in this study” in research literature
patterns.context: The trigger is the continuous phrase “in this study”, especially in abstract body text to introduce findings; preceding text may describe results or background.

patterns.name: Research-design labels in titles
patterns.context: The trigger word appears after a colon, in a noun phrase in the latter part of a title, often indicating a study type, trial, or research context; specific collocations vary across segments.

patterns.name: Research/evaluation wording in NIH project aims
patterns.context: In project descriptions or research plans, the preposition “on” introduces the subject receiving treatment, a trial, or an intervention; segments 8 and 9 also contain project aims and evaluation wording, but no shared explicit trigger phrase.

patterns.name: Drug susceptibility and fungal terminology
patterns.context: Occurs when discussing data or endpoints for in vitro antifungal drug susceptibility testing.

patterns.name: “a” construction after a title colon
patterns.context: The indefinite article “a” immediately follows a colon and introduces a study type or description; however, not all segments with this structure are distinguished by this feature alone.

patterns.name: Pharmacodynamics and clinical breakpoints involving Klebsiella
patterns.context: The title focuses on exploring pharmacodynamics and proposes the need to revise current susceptibility breakpoints.

patterns.name: Disease-intervention studies in titles
patterns.context: Research titles describe disease treatment or prevention, highlighting a population or region; the former is an epidemiological intervention trial, while the latter is a systematic review.

9_3053.concept: 研究摘要中的方法与对象表述
9_3053.description: 激活分散于医学摘要与项目描述：含“in this study”、研究标题中的研究设计/情境短语、目标对象介词结构，也见真菌敏感性测试及疾病干预标题；未见单一稳定触发模式。

patterns.name: 研究文献中的固定短语“in this study”
patterns.context: 触发点是连续短语“in this study”，尤其位于摘要正文中，用来引出研究发现；前文可描述结果或背景。

patterns.name: 标题中的研究设计标签
patterns.trigger: «a»10 prospective study；«a»10 epidemiological intervention trial；«an»10 Asian setting；«a»9 systematic review
patterns.context: 触发词出现在标题冒号之后、标题后半部分的名词短语中，常用于标示研究类型、试验或研究情境；不同段具体搭配不同。

patterns.name: NIH 项目目标中的研究/评估措辞
patterns.context: 在项目描述或研究计划中，介词“on”引出接受治疗、试验或干预的对象；段8、9还出现项目目标与评估措辞，但没有共同的明确触发短语。

patterns.name: 药物敏感性与真菌术语
patterns.context: 在讨论抗真菌药物体外敏感性测试的数据或终点时出现。
patterns.domain: PubMed 药物学/微生物学摘要

patterns.name: 标题冒号后的“a”结构
patterns.context: 冒号后紧接不定冠词“a”，引出研究类型或研究描述；但并非所有此结构的段都只靠这一点区分。

patterns.name: 涉及克雷伯菌的药效与临床断点
patterns.context: 标题以探索药效学为主题，并提出修订当前药敏断点的必要性。
patterns.domain: PubMed 抗菌药物研究标题

patterns.name: 标题中的疾病干预研究
patterns.context: 研究标题描述疾病治疗或预防，突出人群或地区；前者是流行病学干预试验，后者是系统综述。

en.concept: Relational and referential words in scientific narratives
en.description: Activation often falls on the referential word this, the preposition on introducing a research subject, over for a time range, and noun phrases following a. It also occurs in study design, evaluation terminology, and sporadic medical terms, without forming a single semantic category.

patterns.name: Referential this for a study/project
patterns.context: Refers to a study, analysis, or relationship mentioned earlier; often occurs in structures such as “This study,” “this protein,” and “this relationship.”
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts and research project descriptions

patterns.name: on introducing the research subject
patterns.context: Connects research, experiments, or measurements to their subjects, as in “on the mRNA,” “on mice,” “on a pig,” and “on a group of proteins”; it can also indicate a relationship or topic being studied.

patterns.name: Time span with over
patterns.context: Occurs in time phrases indicating sustained observation or the scope of a study, such as “over a 3 to 6 month period,” “over time,” and “over a long follow-up.”
patterns.domain: Clinical trials and descriptions of longitudinal studies

patterns.name: a followed by a number or quantity
patterns.context: The word or phrase after a forms a quantity, subject, or noun phrase; in three passages it is followed by a number, laboratory animal, or group, and elsewhere by “a need” in a title.

patterns.name: Research process and efficacy evaluation terminology
patterns.context: Describes research objectives, feasibility testing, experimental implementation, or evaluation of intervention effects; it does not depend on a specific disease or experimental subject.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research abstracts and grant applications

patterns.name: Local anomalous triggers in technical terms or titles
patterns.context: Activation falls on subwords of technical terms, title words, or fixed expressions; these examples do not clearly share the same semantic condition.

patterns.name: Molecular or medical subject terms
patterns.context: Occurs in descriptions of specific mechanisms, measures, or biomedical subjects; activation is scattered, with no consistent category of specific entities.

patterns.name: Interventions and application settings
patterns.context: Describes an intervention, treatment, or application/testing subject; the specific procedures and subjects vary across examples.

9_3053.concept: 科研叙述中的关系与指代词
9_3053.description: 激活常落在科研叙述的指代词 this、研究对象介词 on、时间范围 over 及 a 后名词短语；也见于研究设计、评价术语和分散的医学专业词，无法归为单一语义类别。

patterns.name: 研究/项目指代词 this
patterns.context: 指向前文所述研究、分析或关系；常出现在“This study”“this protein”“this relationship”等结构中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、科研项目描述

patterns.name: 研究对象上的 on
patterns.context: 连接研究、实验或测量与其对象，如“on the mRNA”“on mice”“on a pig”“on a group of proteins”；也可表示研究某关系或主题。

patterns.name: 时间跨度 over
patterns.context: 在表示持续观察或研究范围的时间短语中，如“over a 3 to 6 month period”“over time”“over a long follow-up”。
patterns.domain: 临床试验、纵向研究描述

patterns.name: 冠词 a 后接数字或数量
patterns.context: a 后的词或短语构成数量、对象或名词短语；三个段落中后接数字、实验动物或群体，另有标题中的“a need”。

patterns.name: 研究流程及效能评价术语
patterns.context: 描述研究目的、可行性验证、实验实施或干预效果评估；不依赖特定疾病或实验对象。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究摘要与项目申请

patterns.name: 专业名词或标题中的局部异常触发
patterns.context: 激活落在专业术语、标题词或固定表达的子词上；此类例子并不明显共享同一语义条件。
patterns.domain: 实验方法、生物医学标题

patterns.name: 分子或医学对象词
patterns.context: 出现在具体机制、指标或生物医学对象的叙述中，激活位置分散，未见一致的特定实体类别。

patterns.name: 干预与应用场景
patterns.context: 描述干预、处理或应用/测试对象；各例的具体操作和对象不同。

en.concept: Time span of a study or event
en.description: The main response is over indicating how long a study, project, observation, or material covers, especially multi-year reviews and study duration; it also involves comparisons across study periods, funding-period retrospectives, and fixed treatment courses. A few activations fall on product re-release, experimental subjects, or local expressions such as “in this study”.

patterns.name: Duration/span of study years
patterns.context: Indicates the time span covered by a study, support, observation, or material; followed by a duration such as years or weeks, often alongside study design or project history.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts, NIH project descriptions, software community reports, and product copy

patterns.name: Duration in study design
patterns.context: In clinical or experimental research descriptions, a duration phrase indicates the study implementation or observation period; numbers and time units may vary.

patterns.name: Historical comparison and retrospective review
patterns.context: Reviews or compares past studies, cases, or institutional experience over multiple years or periods; common in abstract titles or research background.

patterns.name: Funding-period retrospectives
patterns.context: NIH project narratives review research, models, or usage accumulated during the funding period and state the project duration in years.

patterns.name: Fixed treatment course/intervention period
patterns.context: Specifies the duration of an intervention or treatment; may use weeks or years and is usually accompanied by a protocol, drug, or research objective.

patterns.name: Long-term availability copy
patterns.context: Promotional or product descriptions emphasize that something is reissued or becomes available again after a period of time.

patterns.name: Computational experiment scale/test problem
patterns.context: A technical paper describes testing computational equipment on a specific problem; the trigger falls near “on” and the experimental subject, with no clear multi-year span.

patterns.name: Deictic expression in a research finding statement
patterns.context: A results section uses “in this study” to introduce findings from the current study; this does not fully match the dominant duration expressions.

9_3053.concept: 研究或事件的时间跨度
9_3053.description: 主要响应表示研究、项目、观察或材料覆盖时长的 over，尤以多年回顾和研究持续期为主；也涉及研究期比较、资助期回顾及固定疗程。少数落在产品回售、实验对象或“in this study”等局部表达。

patterns.name: 跨期时长/研究年限
patterns.context: 表示研究、支持、观察或材料覆盖的时间跨度；后接年、周等时长，常与研究设计或项目历史同现。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、NIH 项目说明、软件社区报告及产品文案

patterns.name: 研究设计中的持续时间
patterns.context: 临床或实验研究描述中，时长短语标示研究实施或观察期；数字和时间单位可变。
patterns.domain: 医学论文摘要、研究计划

patterns.name: 历史比较与经验回顾
patterns.trigger: «review»« of»4 …« and»3 comparison« with»5« previous»1« observations»
patterns.context: 以多年或多个时期回顾、比较既往研究、病例或机构经验；常见于摘要标题或研究背景。

patterns.name: 项目资助期回顾
patterns.trigger: «over»10« the»5« last»5 funding« peri»1«ode»1；«through»4« the»1« support»
patterns.context: NIH 项目叙述中回顾资助期间累积的研究、模型或使用情况，并说明项目持续年限。

patterns.name: 固定疗程/干预周期
patterns.context: 明确干预或治疗施行的时间长度；可用周或年，通常伴随方案、药物或研究目的。
patterns.domain: 临床研究计划、医学摘要

patterns.name: 长期可获得性文案
patterns.trigger: «Available»« for»1« the»« first»2« time»« in»2« over»10« 2»5« years
patterns.context: 宣传或产品介绍中强调某物在一段时间后重新发行或再次可获得。

patterns.name: 计算实验规模/测试问题
patterns.trigger: «test»4« of»2« the»1« five»2-bit« computer»1« on»10« a»7« problem»
patterns.context: 技术论文中描述在特定问题上测试计算设备；触发落在“on”及其后的实验对象附近，未见明确多年跨度。

patterns.name: 研究结果陈述中的指示语
patterns.context: 结果段中以“in this study”引出当前研究发现；与主导的时间跨度表达并不完全吻合。

en.concept: Structure of medical research titles and abstracts
en.description: Activation is concentrated on structural expressions in medical paper titles and abstracts: a introduces a supplementary research item after a colon, on/in introduce research subjects or conditions, and trial/study indicate study design. Other sporadic patterns include transitions in the main text, this study, experimental conditions, and project descriptions.

patterns.name: Continuation after a colon in medical paper titles
patterns.context: The title first introduces a research topic, then uses the indefinite article a after a colon to add a trial, study, or study-design detail; this position activates most strongly across multiple titles.

patterns.name: Research subject or outcome after on
patterns.context: on introduces the subject, impact, or biological effect being investigated; in titles, the core research question often follows this preposition.

patterns.name: Research condition or population after in
patterns.context: in is followed by a patient population, volunteers, research subjects, or a study setting, often specifying the type of subjects or conditions under which the research was conducted.

patterns.name: Description of study design or evidence type
patterns.context: The end of a title or text after a colon specifies whether the research is a trial, single-center study, preliminary study, or prospective study.

patterns.name: Case or method details after a colon in medical titles
patterns.context: Rather than a study design, the text after the colon introduces a judgment or recommendation with a, followed by need to revise.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial transition to the abstract body after a section break
patterns.context: After the title or preceding text ends and a line break occurs, The introduces a new sentence in the abstract body, followed by background or results.

patterns.name: this study in research reports
patterns.context: In the abstract body, this study refers to the current study and introduces its findings or discussion.

patterns.name: Research and population in medical project descriptions
patterns.context: In a first-person institutional project description, the text after study specifies the research subjects and related factors, then uses in to introduce children with the condition.

patterns.name: Method steps or experimental conditions in the abstract body
patterns.context: The body text shifts to a process or experimental conditions following exposure; this differs from the study-design templates in titles.

patterns.name: Experimental settings and in vivo/in vitro validation conditions
patterns.context: The abstract lists laboratory, in vitro, and in vivo validation settings and mentions pigs as experimental subjects.

patterns.name: Degree or effect expressions in abstracts
patterns.context: Involves efficacy, safety, or functional maintenance, but these words occur in different contexts, so a distinct, stable trigger pattern cannot be confirmed.

9_3053.concept: 医学研究标题与摘要结构
9_3053.description: 激活主要集中于医学论文标题及摘要中的结构性表达：冒号后以 a 引出研究补充项，on/in 引出研究对象或条件，以及 trial/study 等设计说明；另见正文转接、this study、实验条件和项目叙述等零散模式。

patterns.name: 医学论文标题中的冒号后续语
patterns.context: 论文标题先提出研究主题，冒号后以不定冠词 a 引出试验、研究或研究设计的补充说明；在多个标题中该位置激活最强。

patterns.name: 介词 on 后的研究对象或结局
patterns.context: on 引出研究考察的对象、影响或生物学效应；标题常在该介词后进入核心研究问题。

patterns.name: in 后的研究条件或人群
patterns.context: in 后接患者群体、志愿者、研究对象或研究场景，常用于交代研究在哪类对象或条件下进行。

patterns.name: 研究设计或证据类型的描述
patterns.trigger: «epidemiological»6« intervention»5« trial»4；«single»4« centre»6« study»4；«preliminary»6« study»5；«prospective»8« study»6
patterns.context: 标题末尾或冒号后说明研究是试验、单中心研究、初步研究或前瞻性研究。

patterns.name: 医学标题中冒号后的病例或方法细节
