patterns.context: 冒号后不是研究设计，而是以 a 引出判断或建议，后接 need to revise。

patterns.name: 分段后摘要正文的句首转接
patterns.context: 标题或前文结束并换行后，The 引出摘要正文的新句，后接研究背景或结果。

patterns.name: 研究报告中的 this study
patterns.context: 摘要正文中以 this study 指向当前研究，并引出研究发现或论述。

patterns.name: 医学项目叙述中的研究与人群
patterns.context: 第一人称机构项目叙述中，study 后说明研究对象及其相关因素，随后用 in 引出患病儿童。

patterns.name: 摘要正文中的方法步骤或实验条件
patterns.context: 正文转入曝光后的过程或实验条件；与标题中的研究设计模板不同。

patterns.name: 实验环境与体内外验证条件
patterns.trigger: «Experiments»1« in»5« the»4« laboratory»3«,»3« in»4« vitro»2«,»6« and»7« in»6« vivo»4
patterns.context: 摘要列举实验室、体外和体内的验证环境，并提到猪作为实验对象。
patterns.domain: 技术与生物医学交叉摘要

patterns.name: 摘要中程度或效果表达
patterns.context: 涉及疗效、安全性或功能维持，但这些词在不同语境中出现，不能确认是独立而稳定的触发模式。

en.concept: Testing and validation statements in research
en.description: The main response involves test/testing and will/plan to expressions in research-plan or experimental contexts, especially testing a hypothesis, model, or system; it also responds to test subjects introduced by on and Specific Aim structures. Segments 5 and 8 contain testing/test but lack the same planning structure, leaving some elements unexplained.

patterns.name: Test verbs and objects in research plans
patterns.context: In research plans or experimental descriptions, test/testing is followed by a model, hypothesis, premise, system, or computer being tested; often adjacent to a plan, phase, or experimental step.
patterns.domain: NIH research plans, engineering/computer science experimental papers

patterns.name: Preposition on in plans and aims
patterns.context: When describing testing, experimentation, validation, or control of a sample, subject, data, or system, on introduces the object of application. Often overlaps with the test pattern, but can also occur in experimental-results validation contexts.
patterns.domain: Research plans, experimental papers, engineering papers

patterns.name: Future/intention expressions in research plans
patterns.context: NIH plan text uses we as the subject, followed by will or plan to introducing a proposed research action; adjacent to specific aims, phases, or research hypotheses.

patterns.name: Structured research aims/plan numbering
patterns.context: After proposing a research hypothesis or testing a premise, the text lists the research-plan structure using Specific Aim(s), aims, phases, or numbering.

patterns.name: Research subjects or experimental materials introduced by a
patterns.context: In experimental/validation contexts, the article a immediately precedes a noun phrase for experimental material, an animal, or a numerical experiment; may be a weak local collocational cue.

9_3053.concept: 研究中的测试与验证表述
9_3053.description: 主要响应研究方案或实验语境中的 test/testing、will/plan to 等表达，尤其是检验假设、模型或系统；也响应 on 引出的测试对象及 Specific Aim 结构。第5、8段虽含 testing/test，但缺少相同的计划结构，仍有未解释成分。

patterns.name: 研究方案中的测试动词与对象
patterns.trigger: «test»5 this« model»3« in»10« two»7« stages»3；«test»5 this« hypothesis»3« in»10；«test»5 our hypothesis；«testing»5 of»3« the»2« delivery»2« system；«test»3« of»2« the»2« five»2-bit»1 computer
patterns.context: 在研究计划或实验描述中，test/testing 后接模型、假设、前提、系统或计算机等被检验对象；常与方案、阶段或实验步骤相邻。
patterns.domain: NIH 研究计划、工程/计算机实验论文

patterns.name: 计划与目标表述中的介词 on
patterns.trigger: «on»10« a»7« set»4« of»7« known»6« target»3« samples；«on»9« a»7 pig；«on»9« independent»3« data»2；«on»9« the»3 attitude control»4« of»5« a»5 spacecraft
patterns.context: 描述测试、实验、验证或控制所针对的样本、对象、数据或系统时，on 引出应用对象。与 test 模式常重叠，但也可出现在实验结果验证语境中。
patterns.domain: 研究计划、实验论文、工程论文

patterns.name: 研究计划中的未来/意向表达
patterns.trigger: «We»2« will»2« test»5；«we»1« will»2« test»5；«we»1« will»2« design»4« and»2« optimize»5；«We»1« plan»2« to»4« test»5
patterns.context: NIH 计划文本中以 we 作主语，will 或 plan to 引出拟进行的研究动作；紧邻具体 aims、阶段或研究假设。

patterns.name: 结构化研究目标/方案编号
patterns.trigger: «in»10« Specific»1 Aim« #»1«1»2；«in»9« three»6« Specific»1 A«ims»1；«in»10« these»8« three»5« specific»5« aims»2: (1
patterns.context: 在提出研究假设或测试前提后，以 Specific Aim(s)、aims、阶段或编号列出研究计划结构。

patterns.name: 研究对象或实验材料由 a 引入
patterns.trigger: «a»7« set»4 of known target samples；«a»7 pig；«a»5 numerical experiment
patterns.context: 实验/验证语境中冠词 a 紧接实验材料、动物或数值实验等名词短语；可能是局部搭配信号，证据较弱。

en.concept: Structural words and evaluation in medical research descriptions
en.description: Primarily responds to research time spans (especially over), trials and efficacy evaluation; it also responds to sentence-initial In and the article an. It additionally covers specific research contexts such as pediatrics, molecular testing, and metabolism.

patterns.name: Research time span
patterns.context: Occurs when describing the time span of a study, trial, or project; sometimes followed by a specific period or year
patterns.domain: Medical research abstracts and NIH research plans

patterns.name: Article an
patterns.context: The article an is followed by a noun or modifier beginning with a vowel sound, as in “an epidemiological intervention trial” and “an open, randomized study”

patterns.name: Expansion on research or project content
patterns.context: Introduces a study design, project phase, clinical module, or specific task at the beginning of a sentence or item

patterns.name: Efficacy and clinical evaluation
patterns.context: Discusses the effects and safety of treatment, prevention, or intervention, or evaluates a formulation, regimen, or clinical outcome

patterns.name: Trials, study designs, and study periods
patterns.context: Describes the type, protocol, duration, and implementation of a clinical trial or study
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts and NIH research funding descriptions

patterns.name: Medical treatment and disease terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in descriptions of diseases, treatments, drugs, or clinical populations

patterns.name: Epidemiological intervention and prevention
patterns.context: Evaluates the effects of diet or supplements on disease prevention or treatment

patterns.name: Research on severe pediatric illness and psychological distress
patterns.context: Studies children with life-limiting illnesses and related psychological or clinical factors

patterns.name: Molecular probe and assay development
patterns.context: Designs and optimizes primers and probes, and validates assay performance
patterns.domain: Molecular biology and diagnostic technology development

patterns.name: Metabolism and insulin resistance projects
patterns.context: Describes metabolic relationships and plans to study patients over time through clinical modules

patterns.name: Light-induced immune effects
patterns.context: The sentence shifts to a description of changes in natural isomers after UV exposure; activation falls on “On exposure”

9_3053.concept: 医学研究描述中的结构词与评估
9_3053.description: 主要响应医学研究文本中的研究时间跨度（尤其 over）、试验与疗效评估，也响应句首 In、冠词 an；另覆盖儿科、分子检测和代谢等特定研究语境。

patterns.name: 研究时间跨度
patterns.context: 在描述研究、试验或项目的时间跨度时出现；有时后接具体周期或年份
patterns.domain: 医学研究摘要及 NIH 研究计划

patterns.name: 冠词 an
patterns.context: 冠词 an 后接以元音音素开头的名词或修饰语，如 “an epidemiological intervention trial”“an open, randomized study”

patterns.name: 研究或项目内容展开
patterns.context: 句首或分项介绍研究设计、项目阶段、临床模块或具体工作

patterns.name: 疗效与临床评估
patterns.context: 讨论治疗、预防或干预的效果、安全性，或评估配方、方案及临床结果
patterns.domain: 临床医学与药物/治疗研究

patterns.name: 试验、研究设计与研究周期
patterns.context: 描述临床试验或研究的类型、方案、周期及执行方式
patterns.domain: 医学摘要与 NIH 研究资助说明

patterns.name: 医学治疗及疾病术语
patterns.context: 处于疾病、治疗手段、药物或临床人群的叙述中

patterns.name: 流行病学干预与预防
patterns.context: 评估饮食或补充剂对疾病预防、治疗的影响

patterns.name: 儿科重病与心理困扰研究
patterns.context: 研究患有限寿疾病的儿童及相关心理或临床因素
patterns.domain: 儿科与心理/临床研究计划

patterns.name: 分子探针与检测开发
patterns.context: 设计并优化引物、探针，验证检测性能
patterns.domain: 分子生物学与诊断技术研发

patterns.name: 代谢与胰岛素抵抗项目
patterns.context: 阐述代谢关系并计划通过临床模块随时间研究患者

patterns.name: 光照诱导免疫效应
patterns.context: 句中转入 UV 暴露后天然异构体变化的说明；激活落在 “On exposure”

en.description: The core response is over and its compound forms: it is often used for time span or range, and also occurs in overarching and over-the-counter; examples appear across medical, research, legal, and business texts. The specific usage in segments 2 and 6 is unclear due to truncation.

patterns.name: Time-span or duration usage of over
patterns.context: over is followed by a period, quantity, or range, indicating duration, span, or basis; examples include over a 3 to 6 month period, over two periods, over an eleven month period, over 4 hours, overarching, and over-the-counter.
patterns.domain: Research abstracts, NIH project descriptions, patents, legal texts, business news

patterns.name: Compound words or prefix over
patterns.context: over combines with a following element to form overarching (overall) or over-the-counter (over-the-counter), rather than functioning as an independent temporal preposition.

patterns.name: over at the beginning or within body text
patterns.context: over is followed by a period or time span, common in treatment courses, observation periods, legal narratives, or dosing regimens; in segment 8 it instead means adding something beyond what was already collected.
patterns.domain: Medical research, legal narratives, research project descriptions

patterns.name: Sporadic activation on unrelated words
patterns.context: In segments 2 and 6, activation falls on an isolated over token, but the provided context is insufficient to determine its specific grammatical or semantic role in the original sentence.

9_3053.concept: over 的词形与用法
9_3053.description: 核心响应是 over 及其组合形式：多用于时间跨度或范围，也出现在 overarching、over-the-counter 中；不同医学、科研、法律和商业文本里均有实例。片段2、6的具体用法因截断而不明。

patterns.name: over 的时长或时间跨度用法
patterns.context: over 后接一段时间、数量或范围，表示持续期间、跨越或在此基础上；包括 over a 3 to 6 month period、over two periods、over an eleven month period、over 4 hours、overarching、over-the-counter。
patterns.domain: 科研摘要、NIH 项目描述、专利、法律文本、商业新闻

patterns.name: over 的组合词或前缀
patterns.context: over 与后续成分构成 overarching（总体的）或 over-the-counter（场外交易的），不是独立的时间介词。
patterns.domain: 科研计划书、能源交易新闻

patterns.name: 正文中的句首或句中 over
patterns.trigger: «over»10« a»7；«over»9« two»5；«over»9« an»5« eleven»5 month»；«over»9« 4»3« hours»
patterns.context: over 后接期间或时间跨度，常见于研究疗程、观察期、法律叙述或给药方案；在片段 8 中则表示在已有收集之外、额外增加。
patterns.domain: 医学研究、法律叙述、科研项目描述

patterns.name: 无关词汇上的零散激活
patterns.trigger: «over»9 在局部内容中并未完整显示或无法由可见上下文确认
patterns.context: 片段 2、6 中激活落在孤立的 over token，但所给上下文不足以确定它在原句中的具体语法或语义作用。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目描述、PubMed 摘要

en.concept: over in expressions of time span
en.description: Strongly responds to over, especially in time-span expressions followed by an article, number, or time unit. These cover research periods, duration of judicial acts, historical retrospectives, and short-term testing; the domains and styles vary widely.

patterns.name: over in expressions of time span or duration
patterns.context: over introduces a duration, retrospective time range, or quantity range; the time unit may be explicit or supplied by surrounding context.
patterns.domain: Research projects, medical papers, legal judgments, news reports, and academic abstracts

patterns.name: Research design and evaluation expressions
patterns.context: In NIH project descriptions, explains that a trial, protocol, or study is conducted or evaluated over a specific time span; adjacent time expressions also trigger activation in this passage.

patterns.name: Duration of coercion in legal cases
patterns.context: Describes an act, confinement, or control continuing for a period; the duration may be specified as a period or in hours.
patterns.domain: Legal judgments and findings of fact

patterns.name: Long-term retrospective or state of research
patterns.context: Reviews the development, observation, or discussion of a study, experience, or phenomenon over past years or decades.
patterns.domain: Medical paper titles, news reports, and academic abstracts

patterns.name: Testing or monitoring over a short period
patterns.context: Describes biological marker testing or monitoring over a short time span.

9_3053.concept: 时间跨度表达中的 over
9_3053.description: 强烈响应 over，尤其是其后接冠词、数字或时间单位的时间跨度表达，涵盖研究周期、司法行为时长、历史回顾与短时检测；各段领域和文体多样。

patterns.name: 时间跨度或时长表达中的 over
patterns.trigger: «over»9，常与 a/an/the、数字或时间单位相邻
patterns.context: over 引出一段持续时间、回溯时间范围或数量跨度；时间单位可显式出现，也可在前后文中补足。
patterns.domain: 科研项目、医学论文、法律判决、新闻报道及学术摘要

patterns.name: 研究设计与评估表述
patterns.trigger: «over»10« a»7« 3»1« to»1« 6»2 month« period»；«over»10« the»5« past»4« 5»1 years
patterns.context: 在 NIH 项目描述中，说明试验、方案或研究在特定时间跨度内开展或评估；本段触发词也包括相邻时间表达。
patterns.domain: NIH 资助项目与临床/生物医学研究

patterns.name: 司法案件中的强迫持续时间
patterns.trigger: «over»9« an»5« eleven»4 month period；«over»9« an»4 hour
patterns.context: 描述行为、拘禁或控制持续一段时间；时长可由 period 或 hour 明示。

patterns.name: 长期回顾或研究现状
patterns.trigger: «over»9« the»6« past»4« 2»2« decades；«over»9« last»4« few»5 years
patterns.context: 回顾某研究、经验或现象在过去数年或数十年间的发展、观察或讨论。
patterns.domain: 医学论文标题、新闻报道、学术摘要

patterns.name: 短时段内的检测或监测
patterns.context: 描述在短时间范围内进行生物标志物检测或监测。

en.description: The most stable pattern is over introducing a time span or quantity range, found across all ten segments. Several other scattered local highlights may reflect weak lexical or contextual responses, but cannot be summarized uniformly.

patterns.name: over time spans
patterns.context: The trigger over occurs before a time, duration, or quantity phrase; the following span may be expressed by an article, number, or noun phrase.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including research abstracts, technology discussions, news commentary, art introductions, and legal texts

patterns.name: Other nearby highlighted words
patterns.context: In segment 1, these occur in the same clinical-trial sentence as highlighted over, but do not appear to be a trigger pattern shared across segments.

patterns.name: Other local highlighted words
patterns.context: Segment 2 is instructional content discussing the CAP theorem; highlighted words occur in the same segment as over, but do not appear to be shared triggers across segments.

patterns.name: Other local highlighted words
patterns.context: Segment 3 describes a paper prompting follow-up research; these are near over time but may be independent local responses.

patterns.name: Other local highlighted words
patterns.context: Segment 4 introduces drug derivatives with such as; these may be independent local responses.

patterns.name: Other local highlighted words
patterns.context: Segment 5 describes cancer types and treatment resistance; there may be local responses that cannot be fully explained by the over time-span pattern.

patterns.name: Other local highlighted words
patterns.context: Segment 6 introduces research collaborations and studies of childhood diseases; these may be local lexical responses.

patterns.name: Other local highlighted words
patterns.context: Segment 7 is a forum comment mentioning encryption features; highlights are scattered, with no clear shared semantics.

patterns.name: Other local highlighted words
patterns.context: Segment 8 describes a genomics research project and its progress; these may be local responses.

patterns.name: Other local highlighted words
patterns.context: Segment 9 introduces books and archival materials; these may be local responses.

patterns.name: Other local highlighted words
patterns.context: Segment 10 concerns case facts and government actions in a legal-text context; these may be local responses.

9_3053.concept: over引出的跨度
9_3053.description: 最稳定模式是 over 引出时间跨度或数量范围，遍及全部十段；另有若干分散的局部高亮词，可能反映弱的词汇或语境响应，无法统一概括。

patterns.name: over 时间跨度
patterns.trigger: «over»9/10 后接时间或数量跨度，如 “over a 3 to 6 month period”“Over the course”“over the last several years”“over a year”“over 500 volunteers”“over one hundred”“over an eleven month period”
patterns.context: 触发词 over 位于时间、持续期或数量短语前；其后跨度可由冠词、数字或名词短语表达。
patterns.domain: 科研摘要、科技讨论、新闻评论、艺术介绍、法律文本等多种文体

patterns.name: 其他邻近高亮词
patterns.context: 第1段中与高亮 over 同处临床试验句，但未显现为各段共有触发模式。

patterns.name: 其他局部高亮词
patterns.context: 第2段讨论 CAP 定理的教学内容；高亮词与 over 同段出现，但不像跨段共同触发项。

patterns.name: 其他局部高亮词
patterns.context: 第3段描述论文引发后续研究；与 over time 邻近，但可能是独立局部响应。

patterns.name: 其他局部高亮词
patterns.context: 第4段以 such as 引出药物衍生物，可能是独立局部响应。

patterns.name: 其他局部高亮词
patterns.context: 第5段描述癌症类型及治疗耐受性，可能存在局部响应，不能由 over 时间跨度完全解释。

patterns.name: 其他局部高亮词
patterns.context: 第6段介绍研究合作与儿童疾病研究，可能为局部词汇响应。

patterns.name: 其他局部高亮词
patterns.context: 第7段论坛评论提到加密功能；高亮位置分散，未见明确共同语义。

patterns.name: 其他局部高亮词
patterns.context: 第8段描述基因组研究项目及其进展，可能为局部响应。

patterns.name: 其他局部高亮词
patterns.context: 第9段介绍书籍及档案资料，可能为局部响应。

patterns.name: 其他局部高亮词
patterns.context: 第10段法律文本中的案件事实与政府行为语境，可能为局部响应。

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to the preposition over, especially when it means during a period, across a period, or for a duration. In a few cases it denotes spanning a distance. Trigger forms occur across several research genres and encyclopedia descriptions.

patterns.name: over followed by time or duration
patterns.context: “over” denotes spanning a period or continuing for a duration, followed by a time, period, or notion of duration; syntax and domain vary.

patterns.name: over followed by a distance
patterns.context: “over” denotes covering or spanning a distance, occurring in a description of emergency transport conditions.

9_3053.concept: over（跨越时间或距离）
9_3053.description: 主要对介词 over 作强烈反应，尤其是表示在一段时间内、历经某时期或持续期间；少数情况下表示跨越距离。触发形式出现在多种科研文体及百科说明中。

patterns.name: over 后接时间或持续时长
patterns.context: “over”表示跨越一段时间或持续期间，后接时间、时期或持续性概念；句法和领域各异。
patterns.domain: 医学研究、科研叙述、天体物理

patterns.name: over 后接距离
patterns.context: “over”表示覆盖或跨越距离，出现在急救运输条件的说明中。

en.concept: over and its spans and beyond-meaning uses
en.description: All segments contain over. It commonly precedes a quantity, duration, or distance to indicate coverage or exceeding a limit; over and above and over-expression also occur. Activation is concentrated on over and may extend to neighboring tokens.

patterns.name: over followed by a quantity or time span
patterns.context: Often occurs when over is followed by a number, quantifier, or time span, for example “over the previous five years”, “over a 3 to 6 month period”, “over 500 volunteers”, “over distances”, “over 300 families”, “over the past 2 decades”, “over 130 active collaborations”, “over-expression”, “over and above”, and “over the past 30 years”. In these examples, activation often falls on over and several following tokens, with a stronger response on over.
patterns.domain: Primarily NIH grant abstracts and medical/biomedical texts; also encyclopedia descriptions and gene-expression terminology.

patterns.name: Spanning, covering, or exceeding
patterns.context: over indicates spatial distance, duration, or exceeding an existing range, rather than the literal position of an object above something; activation may extend over the following span or quantity expression.
patterns.domain: Medical project abstracts, encyclopedia descriptions, and project descriptions.

patterns.name: over- compound expression
patterns.context: over and expression are joined to form the biological term over-expression; over- also elicits strong activation, indicating that the response is not limited to the standalone preposition over.

9_3053.concept: over及其跨度、超出用法
9_3053.description: 所有片段都含 over；常见于 over 后接数量、时长或距离，表示覆盖或超出，也出现 over and above 及 over-expression。激活多集中于 over，并可延伸至邻近 token。

patterns.name: over 后接数量或时间跨度
patterns.context: 多出现在 over 后接数字、数量词或时间跨度时；例如 “over the previous five years”、“over a 3 to 6 month period”、“over 500 volunteers”、“over distances”、“over 300 families”、“over the past 2 decades”、“over 130 active collaborations”、“over-expression”、“over and above”、“over the past 30 years”。在这些例子里，激活常落在 over 及其后的若干 token，尤其强于 over。
patterns.domain: 主要为 NIH 资助摘要和医学/生物医学文本；另有百科说明及基因表达术语。

patterns.name: 跨越、覆盖或超出
patterns.trigger: «over»，如 “over distances”、“over the previous five years”、“over and above”
patterns.context: over 表示空间距离、持续时间或超出既有范围，而非字面上的物体位于上方；激活可能延伸到后续跨度或数量表达。
patterns.domain: 医学项目摘要、百科说明及项目描述。

patterns.name: over- 复合表达
patterns.context: over 与 expression 连写构成生物学术语 over-expression；其中 over- 也产生强激活，表明响应不局限于独立介词 over。

en.concept: The over string and its extended uses
en.description: Primarily sensitive to over and adjacent subword fragments: it can introduce a quantity, time, or distance, and can also occur in words such as over-the-top and overseeing. Common in research texts, but not limited to medical content.

patterns.name: Quantity or time-span marker
patterns.context: “over” means exceeding a limit and is followed by a number, distance, or amount of time; some examples also show activation on subsequent tokens.
patterns.domain: Research abstracts, encyclopedia descriptions, forum texts

patterns.name: Preposition over and compound boundaries
patterns.context: over combines with following elements to form a hyphenated compound or a split form of oversight; it does not indicate ordinary quantity excess.

patterns.name: Quantity reporting in biomedical research
patterns.context: In NIH project descriptions, over introduces counts of samples, families, or collaborations.
patterns.domain: Biomedical grant applications and research abstracts

patterns.name: Time range in research protocols
patterns.context: over is followed by a period of time to indicate how long a study lasts or what period it covers.

patterns.name: Distance or atypical terrain range
patterns.context: Air ambulance services are suitable for distances or terrain where ground transport is difficult; activation falls on over distances.

patterns.name: Expression of exceeding expectations
patterns.context: In over-the-top, before reaction, over indicates an excessive or exaggerated degree; activation is distributed across over and the compound.

patterns.name: Word-internal segmentation in overseeing
patterns.context: over combines with seeing to form overseeing, including oversight arrangements at historical institutions; this is not a quantity expression.

9_3053.concept: over 字符串及其延伸用法
9_3053.description: 主要对 over 及其相邻子词片段敏感：它可引出数量、时间或距离，也可能位于 over-the-top、overseeing 等词中。多见于科研文本，但并非只响应医学内容。

patterns.name: 数量或时间跨度标记
patterns.trigger: «over»10 后接数量、距离或时长，如 «over»10« 500»4、«over»10« 300»3、«over»10 distances»1、«over» a year
patterns.context: “over”表示超过，后接数字、距离或时间量；有的例子在标记后续 token 上也有激活。
patterns.domain: 科研摘要、百科说明、论坛文本

patterns.name: 介词 over 与复合词边界
patterns.context: over 与后续成分构成连字符复合词或 oversight 的拆分形式，不表示普通的数量超过。

patterns.name: 生物医学研究中的数量报告
patterns.context: NIH 项目描述中 over 引出样本、家庭或合作项目数量。
patterns.domain: 生物医学资助申请与研究摘要

patterns.name: 研究方案中的时间范围
patterns.trigger: «over»10« a»6« 3»1 to 1 6 month period；«over»10« the»5« previous»4 five»4 years
patterns.context: over 后接一段时间，说明研究持续或覆盖的时期。
patterns.domain: 临床试验和研究项目说明

patterns.name: 距离或非典型地形范围
patterns.context: 空中救护适用于地面交通难以通行的距离或地形；激活落在 over distances 上。

patterns.name: 超出预期的程度表达
patterns.context: 在反应前以 over-the-top 表示程度过分或过度；激活分布于 over 和复合词内部。

patterns.name: overseeing 的词内切分
patterns.context: over 与 seeing 连成 overseeing（监督），包括历史机构的监督安排；不是数量表达。

en.description: All passages contain over/over-: forms range from over + a quantity, duration, or scope to over-the-counter and overarching. There are also sporadic word and line-break activations, without a unified condition.

patterns.name: over followed by a duration, quantity, or scope
patterns.context: The local trigger form is over, followed by a quantity, duration, range, or compound phrase; meanings vary and include “exceeding,” spanning/covering, and the fixed expression over-the-counter.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain encyclopedia entries, medical research, project descriptions, business news, etc.

patterns.name: Other sporadic activating words
patterns.context: These markers are scattered across passages, with no shared local syntactic or semantic condition; they may be secondary sporadic responses, but their pattern cannot be determined from the samples alone.

9_3053.concept: over 及其后续表达
9_3053.description: 所有段都出现 over/over-：从 over + 数量、时长或范围，到 over-the-counter、overarching 等形式；此外有零散单词和换行激活，缺乏统一条件。

patterns.name: over 后接时长、数量或范围
patterns.trigger: «over» 后接 «10 distances»、«500 volunteers»、«a 3 to 6 month period»、«one million cases»、«the -the-counter»、«50 of the best places»、«two months»、«a number of years» 等
patterns.context: 局部触发形式是 over，后续接数量、时长、范围或复合短语；词义不完全一致，包括“超过”、跨越/涉及以及固定表达 over-the-counter。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的百科、医学研究、项目介绍、商业新闻等

patterns.name: 其他零散激活词
patterns.context: 这些标记分散在各段，未见共同的局部句法或语义条件；可能是零散的次级响应，不能仅凭样本确定其模式。

en.concept: The string over and its morphological uses
en.description: Activation is concentrated on the letter sequence “over”: it may be part of a compound or fixed expression, form a prefix word, or directly modify a value to mean “exceeding.” It occurs across fields and genres.

patterns.name: Compounds or fixed expressions formed with over-
patterns.context: The letter sequence over is followed by a hyphen or directly by another morpheme to form a fixed expression or compound; it occurs in different positions.
patterns.domain: News narratives, research abstracts, energy-industry texts

patterns.name: over- meaning overturning or excess
patterns.context: over functions as a verb or noun prefix, indicating overturning, excess, or intensification.
patterns.domain: Historical and political narratives, local news, research abstracts

patterns.name: over + quantity
patterns.context: over directly modifies a numerical value to indicate that it is exceeded.

9_3053.concept: 字符串 over 及其构词用法

9_3053.concept: Over/over 词形及用法
9_3053.description: 主要响应 Over/over 词形：时间、数量或反复表达，over-the-top 固定短语，以及 overriding、over-expression 等 over- 构词；各例横跨多种文体。
